There is a shovel mark in the grass here, but it's not very deep.

special_tiles.title: Fish Calling Point
special_tiles.description: Here is a large blue stone with a pictograph of an ear chiseled into it.  If you know the name of the fish who lives here, you can call him from this location.  If you don't know the correct name, you can get away by digging near the center of the isle.
There is a shovel mark in the grass here, but it's not very deep.

special_tiles.title: Pony Express Headquarters
special_tiles.description: Twine and paper are arranged in an orderly fashion against one wall and you see large plastic tubes spitting out and organizing some of the mail into giant bins.  A nice gentlemanly fellow quickly checks his list and stamps each box as they flow smoothly over the counter.

special_tiles.title: Witherton Jumping Arena
special_tiles.description:
Compete against others in this competition  that is based less on your horse's stats. Only 6 horses can compete at one time.  Be aware.  Horse stats and special tack play very little to no part in the scoring of this arena.
Be careful when viewing other things before your competition begins.  It may cause it to not start up.^T4View the top scores for this arena^BSHSimple Jumping Arena^R1

special_tiles.title: Witherton Farrier
special_tiles.description: This is a new building, but the farrier himself has been at his job for a very long time.

special_tiles.title: Witherton Livery
special_tiles.description: This bright, airy, fresh-smelling stable is the perfect place to board your tired horses.
The south wall of the maze here has a mark on it.
You almost trip into a little hole filled with small twigs, grasses, and soft fur.

special_tiles.title: Mother Goose's Home
special_tiles.description: Her home is fairly simple, and very neat. She has a few bookcases crammed with various bedtime stories, fairy tales, and classic children's stories. Not too surprisingly, she keeps a couple of geese as pets. You hope they don't bite.

special_tiles.title: Gingerbread Bakery
special_tiles.description: Welcome to Hansel and Gretel's brand new bakery! The aroma permiating the surrounding area is drawing you into the shop.  Everything looks so good, and of course, Gingerbread is their specialty!

special_tiles.title: Sun-bleached Skeleton
special_tiles.description: Another pirate skeleton. Bet this one was part of the skeleton crew!

special_tiles.title: Sun-bleached Skeleton
special_tiles.description: No bones about it, with the skull seeming to smile up at you, this skeleton gives you the jitters.

special_tiles.title: Newly Built Cabin
special_tiles.description: You are standing in a pleasant cabin filled with books and blueprints on a variety of roofing styles and methods.  There is an assortment of roofing supplies neatly stacked in one corner.

special_tiles.title: Construction Site
special_tiles.description: The construction site is a buzz with activity!  There's a hole about ten foot deep with dirt tossed about on all sides.  Cats with hardhats are moving dirt with heavy machinery, sawing boards, nailing nails, and all while the Foreman shouts instructions over the noise.

special_tiles.title: Katinka's Cottage
special_tiles.description: The cabin is warm and welcoming, with neat stacks of hand knit goods all around.

special_tiles.title: Leasa's Garden
special_tiles.description: Here is a beautiful rock garden full of perennials and a colorful annual or two.  The smell from the mock orange tree is delicious.

special_tiles.title: Leasa's Cottage
special_tiles.description: This cottage is warm and cozy with a quilt or two decorating the wall and over the back of the sofa.   Pictures of children and grandchildren are hanging on the walls and sitting on small endtables.  The smell of a delicious pie baking wafts from the kitchen.

special_tiles.title: Torrid Isle Docks
special_tiles.description: A small boat is tied to the side of the dock ready to take passengers.   The dock is cluttered with crates and nets though, making a bit difficult to get to board the boat.  Should you be low on money, it would be best to speak with the owner.

special_tiles.title: Oasis
special_tiles.description: A cooling breeze wafts over this large oasis.  Your horse is enjoying a nice roll in the shade of one of the palm trees.

special_tiles.title: Oasis
special_tiles.description: A cooling breeze wafts over this large oasis.  Your horse is enjoying a nice roll in the shade of one of the palm trees.

special_tiles.title: Bee's Nest
special_tiles.description: There are lots of bees here! If you want though, you could try to take their honeycomb...^T4Steal Honeycomb from Bees^BMbees.swf?m=^R1

special_tiles.title: Pyramid #10
special_tiles.description: If you wish,  you could explore the Labyrinth within this pyramid!!!^T6Explore Pyramid^BMpyramidmaze.swf?MAZE=10&QUEST=2977&j=^R1^X^Z

special_tiles.title: Laurence's Hut
special_tiles.description: The walls of this bright, airy hut have been swathed in fabric, in simulation of a sumptuous desert tent.  Rattan furniture and gold plated decor are polished to gleaming, and the floor of a lustrous orange wood was recently waxed and shined with care.

special_tiles.title: Vivian's House
special_tiles.description: Here lives a true horsewoman.  You see books on horses, pictures of horses, statues of horses, horse tack and equipment, riding apparel... but no sign of an actual horse anywhere.

special_tiles.title: Maude's Hut
special_tiles.description: This hut is a disaster.  Papers, toys, craft supplies, dishes, books, yarn, string, swatches of fabric, bits of cotton (and much more) are stacked in huge piles over every horizontal surface, including the floor.  Perhaps the occupants have just moved in.

special_tiles.title: Vine Isle Docks
special_tiles.description: This small dock looks like it is barely used.  There are vines covering the dock and the small building.

special_tiles.title: Viney Rocks
special_tiles.description: This rock shop is tiny but has every possible spot filled with different gems, stones and jewelry.  The small storekeeper appears engrossed in whatever stone he is currently looking at.

special_tiles.title: Warm and Cozy Treehouse
special_tiles.description: You enter a treehouse in the jungle and get the immediate smells of dried florals and art supplies.^T6Paint Esther's Picture^BMpainting.swf?PAINTING=15&QUEST=3443&j=^R1

special_tiles.title: The Hot Spring of Frigid Meadows
special_tiles.description: A mist slowly rises from this warm spring.  You can feel heat coming from it, and there is a smell of minerals in the mist.

special_tiles.title: Clarissa's Cabin
special_tiles.description: This is a remarkably comfortable cabin for one so far to the north.

special_tiles.title: Nedrick's House
special_tiles.description: The walls of this house are completely full of mounted insects in frames.

special_tiles.title: Polar Isle Docks
special_tiles.description: This is a pleasant enough dock; there is very little breeze here.  But it would be much nicer were it a little warmer.

special_tiles.title: Jada's Cottage
special_tiles.description: This cozy cottage offers a warm fireplace to sit beside.^T6Paint Jada's Picture^BMpainting.swf?PAINTING=13&QUEST=3444&j=^R1

special_tiles.title: A well built snowman.
special_tiles.description: The air crackles and smells like magic in this particular spot.

special_tiles.title: Ted's House
special_tiles.description: This small home seems rather poorly insulated for being on such a cold isle.  There is dust all over and it appears to be very drafty, making it quite chilly in places despite the fire in the fireplace.

special_tiles.title: Sandcastle Moat #21
special_tiles.description: ^T6Straighten out the Moat^BMsandcastlemoat.swf?BOARD=21&QUEST=3049&j=^R1^X^Z

special_tiles.title: Olivia's Cabin
special_tiles.description: The cabin is small, cozy and warm.  In the kitchen you can smell a pie in the oven and there are cookies sitting out on the counter.

special_tiles.title: Alexi's Cabin
special_tiles.description: Alexi is crouched over a table peering at the paper that is scattered all around her.  She seems quite glad to see you.

special_tiles.title: Tree House
special_tiles.description: A relatively empty, but spacious set of rooms high up off the ground.

special_tiles.title: A Small, Cozy Cabin
special_tiles.description: A well-made and sturdy home. There are sea maps on the walls and a telescope pointing out the window.

special_tiles.title: North Shore View Hammock
special_tiles.description: An extremely peaceful and serene area.  You decide to relax and bask in the warm sun.^X^Z

special_tiles.title: North Shore View Hammock
special_tiles.description: An extremely peaceful and serene area.  You decide to relax and bask in the warm sun.^X^Z

special_tiles.title: Hat Isle Specific Store
special_tiles.description: The Hat Isle Specific Store sells this one might not expect of pirates--and the wares are of exceptional quality.

special_tiles.title: Hat Isle Rowboat
special_tiles.description: One look is enough to tell you that the owner of this rowboat would rather be anywhere apart from here.  He's so eager to get back that the trip back to Skullton is free.

special_tiles.title: DO NOT ENTER Sign
special_tiles.description: The sign here makes it abundantly clear that company is not wanted.  Could they be referring to you though? ^X^Z

special_tiles.title: DO NOT ENTER Sign
special_tiles.description: The sign here makes it abundantly clear that company is not wanted.  Could they be referring to you though? ^X^Z

special_tiles.title: DO NOT ENTER Sign
special_tiles.description: The sign here makes it abundantly clear that company is not wanted.  Could they be referring to you though? ^X^Z

special_tiles.title: Beebonnet Buck's Hut
special_tiles.description: The interior of the hut is bestrewn with scraps of yarn. There is a cat in the corner batting at the pieces.

special_tiles.title: No-Navel Nancy's Hut
special_tiles.description: As you walk in the hut, you notice a peculiar milky smell. You look up to see that the interior of the ceiling is studded with coconut shells! No-Navel Nancy catches you looking up and gives you a glare, as if to say, "What you lookin' at?"

special_tiles.title: Foolin' Fred's Hut
special_tiles.description: You're assaulted by color the moment you walk in the door- Foolin' Fred has painted the interior walls in great swirls of yellows, reds, greens, and blues.

special_tiles.title: Mums-The-Word Maria's Tent
special_tiles.description: The tent is jam-packed with books and papers. It looks as though the tent is the seat of pirate academia- if pirates indeed value academics. Mums-The-Word Maria sits in the middle of it all in an armchair, chewing a candy pipe, facing a most incongruously placed empty couch.

special_tiles.title: Boxy Bernie's Tent
special_tiles.description: Boxy Bernie clearly loves rats. It looks like they are swarming the inside of his tent! But as you look closer, you realize there's some sort of method to this madness. The rats seem to have specific runs where they're contained in one area of the tent, and some of them are swimming around a small pool. As you watch, one leaps up onto a platform in the middle of the pool and starts grooming his whiskers. Boxy Bernie checks his pocket watch and notes down the time.

special_tiles.title: Whorl Isle Dock
special_tiles.description: This dock has an amazing view of the snow isles off in the distance. The breeze is always a bit nippy here and the water a bit choppy. That doesn't stop the locals from sailing around the bend though. The dockhouse has plenty of seating if you'd like to watch the boats go in and out- if you count vast piles of mail-stuffed sacks "seating"- and an enormous picture of a stern-looking woman in a military uniform hanging on the wall.

special_tiles.title: Whorl Isle Observatory
special_tiles.description: A small, private observatory with a rather front-heavy refracting telescope.

special_tiles.title: Gytha's House
special_tiles.description: The house is completely spotless- floors polished, tablecloth without a single crumb, china ornaments on the mantel glistening. Gytha reigns in the middle of it all, sprawled in an overstuffed floral armchair, her feet up on an ottoman.

special_tiles.title: Esmerelda's Home
special_tiles.description: As you enter the house, it seems deserted. The oil lamp isn't lit and the silence is almost eerie. As you look around, you have the prickling sensation that you're being watched- and suddenly you see Esmerelda over in the corner, looking straight at you.

special_tiles.title: Ismond's Cabin
special_tiles.description: The shutters are locked up tight and the door is locked, bolted, and chained shut.
The shoreline on this side of the isle seems hard, as though it's been regularly trampled by someone pacing.
The shoreline on this side of the isle seems hard, as though it's been regularly trampled by someone pacing.
The shoreline on this side of the isle seems hard, as though it's been regularly trampled by someone pacing.
The shoreline on this side of the isle seems hard, as though it's been regularly trampled by someone pacing.

special_tiles.title: Ring Pond
special_tiles.description: This small pond is shaped almost exactly like the isle itself.  It's almost like someone shaped it themselves instead of nature doing the work.

special_tiles.title: Ring Isle Observatory
special_tiles.description: The Ring Isle Observatory is a public observatory, which can be used by anyone lucky enough to be able to get time on the telescope's schedule.  A large bulletin board and calendar on the wall shows that telescope time is booked many months in advance.

special_tiles.title: Web Isle Docks
special_tiles.description: The Web Isle Docks appear to be very old, but have been carefully maintained.

special_tiles.title: Ring Isle Dock House
special_tiles.description: The Ring Isle Dockhouse is practically empty, as if nobody's been here for a long time.  You can make out a trail of footprints in the dust though, from the front door to the desk and back.

special_tiles.title: Jane and Gillian's House
special_tiles.description: The aroma of fresh-cut wood pervades the small house- almost stronger than the smell of wet dog.

special_tiles.title: Andrea's Home
special_tiles.description: Andrea's house has a small lean-to attached to the back, from which you can hear cheeps and caws. You peer around the corner and see the whole shed is full of birds!

special_tiles.title: Mythic Shoppe
special_tiles.description: The Mythic Shoppe is very clean, and seems to sell only two things: golden pellets and cyan pellets.

special_tiles.title: Kelda's Home
special_tiles.description: The house is filled with brightly painted nesting dolls and Dala horses. Over in the corner, you see a workbench with additional dolls and horses in various degrees of completion, along with paint, brushes, sandpaper and wood carving tools.

special_tiles.title: Lilibeth's Hut
special_tiles.description: You are amazed at all of the dried flowers in Lilibeth's home.  There are flowers and wreaths hanging everywhere!

special_tiles.title: Woody's Hut
special_tiles.description: Woody's hut is filled with animals of all descriptions as well as dolls and native figurines, all carved by Woody.  In the corner you see an ample supply of wood waiting for Woody's skillful touch.

special_tiles.title: Chanda's Hut
special_tiles.description: You find Chanda dipping a candle in a series of pots of colorful wax.  Her hut is filled with more candles than you have ever seen.^T6Paint Chanda's Picture^BMpainting.swf?PAINTING=14&QUEST=3441&j=^R1

special_tiles.title: Alton's Hut
special_tiles.description: Alton is sitting at a counter carefully cutting pieces of fruit.   The entire hut is filled with flower arangements that look good enough to eat....wait a minute that daisy is made from a melon!  They really are good enough to eat!!!

special_tiles.title: Shoneah's Hut
special_tiles.description: You find Shoneah hunched over a work table too busy to notice you. He has examples of his fine jewelry designs displayed around his hut.

special_tiles.title: Web Isle Wishing Well
special_tiles.description: Though it appears relatively dilapidated, this wishing well still appears to work.

special_tiles.title: Balloon Game
special_tiles.description:
Collect the blue bubbles and avoid the red ones! ^T6Hot Air Balloon^BMhotairballoon^R1
^T4View the top scores for this game^BSHHot Air Balloon^R1
^X^Z

special_tiles.title: A Gryphon's Lair
special_tiles.description: As you carefully peer into this cave you can see two Gryphons hard at work building a nest.

special_tiles.title: Apollo's Hut
special_tiles.description: As you enter, you notice a golden charriot parked next to the hut.  Once inside, it's as bright as can be!  You almost need sunglasses to counter the glare.  Even Apollo, himself, is glowing!

special_tiles.title: Scoria Rowboat
special_tiles.description: Well, it's not the most seaworthy-looking vessel- covered in seaweed and smelling strongly of salt and jellyfish- but you suppose it will get you from point A to point B. You hope, anyway.

special_tiles.title: Basalt Isle Rowboat
special_tiles.description: This decidedly seaweed-covered vessel looks like it could hardly cross a creek, let alone an ocean, but it did after all get you here...

special_tiles.title: A Gryphon's Lair
special_tiles.description: As you carefully peer into this cave, you see two Gryphons. One is sitting on the nest and the other is standing guard. Looks like the one just laid an egg!

special_tiles.title: Turquoise Jewelry Workshop
special_tiles.description: Inside the workshop there's a desk where Lapis works on all the jewelry that comes into her workshop.  There are bins of tools as well as metal and leather remnants on the desk and floor.

special_tiles.title: Basalt Isle Boardwalk
special_tiles.description: Water dragons lounge across the weathered boards of the dock, flicking their long tails into the sea as they soak up the sun.

special_tiles.title: Hanska's and Christel's Home
special_tiles.description: The little house is scrupulously neat, but entire walls are filled with shelves of toymaking supplies.
It looks like someone was fishing here.

special_tiles.title: Shilling Cottage
special_tiles.description: The name of this house is a bit of a non-sequitur, but don't ask Mal or Polly about it. They'll just look at each other, then at the portrait of a woman hanging on the wall. Then one of them will say "On the bottom!" and they'll both double over in laughter. It's not worth the explanation.

special_tiles.title: Martina's Cabin
special_tiles.description: Her walls are covered with lists and swatches and pictures. Everything a premier wedding planner could need.

special_tiles.title: Fluff's Cave
special_tiles.description: The few steps between the glittery stone walls of the cave represent a mere fraction of an acre... and independence.

special_tiles.title: Astrid's Home
special_tiles.description: The few timbers of wall not taken up by windows are covered by hand-painted star charts.

special_tiles.title: Horn Isle Docks
special_tiles.description: Welcome to Horn Isle Docks.  Be aware of clouds and high winds from all sides of the isle.

special_tiles.title: Treasure Isle Pirate Resort Office
special_tiles.description: This looks like a hotel lobby complete with a front desk. Theres a handsome woman behind the desk smiling at you. Behind the desk is a chalk board with space to enter the names of guests after each tent number.  Doesn't look like there are any keys. Makes sense. After all, you can't lock a tent!

special_tiles.title: Sun-bleached Skeleton
special_tiles.description: Yikes! You can see through the rib cage right to the backbone of this poor soul. A shiver just ran up your spine! You can almost hear the tune to Dem Bones, Dem Bones, Dem....Dry Bones!

special_tiles.title: The cozy home of Indigo and Bettina
special_tiles.description: The workbench has assorted carving tools, and small ebony carved figurines on it. There is a beautifully carved kitchen table with two carved chairs.

special_tiles.title: Cordovan & Cecilia's House
special_tiles.description: The home is filled with interesting aromas. There are different herbs and flowers hanging from the rafters that look like they are in various stages of drying. A rack with skiens of wool sits next to a spinning wheel.

special_tiles.title: Howling Moon Boutique & Sweets
special_tiles.description: The charming store has assorted handcrafted island goods including alpaca hair throws, ebony carved figurines, beautifully crafted guitars and coconut body products. A large sign at the counter says "Sweets for the Sweet!"  A glass display case holds an assortment of berry pies. Looks like there is a special on freshly churned vanilla ice cream today.

special_tiles.title: Home of Twyla and Victor
special_tiles.description: The house is filled with the scrumptious smell of coconut. A series of shelves are lined with stacks of homemade soaps and jars of lotion.

special_tiles.title: Isaac's House
special_tiles.description: Isaac's home has at least a dozen guitars standing up against the walls. They are all made of the same dark wood, but have different designs inlaid in different colors.

special_tiles.title: Dog Isle Community Center
special_tiles.description: Well this is a change. Unlike the past times you have stopped by, there are no signs of any kind of crazy celebration having taken place recently. The Community Center is spotless. The shoe and hat that was under one of the tables and moved to the fireplace mantle are still there. A sign in the shape of a tulip says CLOSED - remember to mark your calendar for the upcoming Spring Extravaganza!^X^Z

special_tiles.description: A tiny rowboat is tied to a rock that is tossed up on the beach to keep the boat from floating away.  The tattered, small boat barely looks seaworthy.

special_tiles.title: Vine Isle Rowboat
special_tiles.description: A small, tattered boat is sitting on shore, waiting to cross the water.  It barely looks seaworthy.

special_tiles.title: Vladyk and Svetlana's Cabin
special_tiles.description: This cabin is delightfully cozy. There are beautiful embroidered curtains on the windows, wooden carved pictures of elk and deer on the walls and a crackling fireplace that gives off plenty of heat.

special_tiles.title: Ruslan and Olena's Cabin
special_tiles.description: This is an older but well kept cabin that is on the larger side. There are traditional Ukrainian embroidered linens on the table, and decorative pillows on the sofa. The entire place looks welcoming and colorful.

special_tiles.title: Vasyl and Lesia's Cabin
special_tiles.description: This cabin is warm and cozy. There is a display case filled with beautifully decorated eggs in the traditional Ukrainian style called pysanky. A small work bench next to the case has assorted tools and eggs in different stages of completion. Looks like the artist lives here!
Looks like a pair of Joshua Trees.
Looks like a Joshua Tree.

special_tiles.title: Cabin Isle Dock
special_tiles.description: Looking out from the dock, you see the green of many small islands in the distance. Suddenly, a humpback whale breaches the surf just off to your left, arcs up, up, up and then falls back into the water with a mighty splash. Whew! That was exciting.

special_tiles.title: The Whoa and Go General Store
special_tiles.description: Cabin Isle's general store is quaint but cozy. Looks like it caters to the local residence.

special_tiles.title: Anathema's Cabin
special_tiles.description: The windows and door to the cabin are flung wide open, as if the person who lived here didn't have a care in the world. The lacey curtains are made from pixie dust stitched delicately together with the thread of silver linings. Who could have made such an amazing thing? There are spools and spools of silver lining stacked against the wall.

special_tiles.title: Frannie Oakley's Log Cabin
special_tiles.description: This cabin is very well cared for. Everything is clean and spotless.

How can I get a horse?
What is the drop-down box by the chat box?
What is the Shovel/Magnifying Glass/Binoculars/Rake for?
How do arena competitions work?
Is there a faster way to get around?
How can I improve my horses' abilities?
How do I get a ranch?
Chat Rules
The moderators don't do anything!
EXIT HELP

chatpoints.chat_text: Walk around using arrow keys.  The map at the upper left is a vast overview.  You can only see other players and buildings.  Horses and objects cannot be seen unless they are 'at' the same spot as you.  So you need to explore the map by walking around.

replies.reply_text: Back to Main Question List.
EXIT HELP

chatpoints.chat_text: Lots of ways!  Find objects in woods or beaches and sell them at a shop. Performing jobs (mini-games) when asked, and completing quests when offered are just a few of the ways to earn money.

replies.reply_text: Back to Main Question List.
EXIT HELP

chatpoints.chat_text: You can find a wild horse by walking around the different areas of Horse Isle.  When a horse is on the same 'spot' as you, they will show up in this window.  No wild horses will be in the towns.

replies.reply_text: Back to Main Question List.
EXIT HELP

chatpoints.chat_text: What is selected in the drop-down box will determine who can see your chat.

replies.reply_text: Explain CHAT NEAR
Explain CHAT BUDDIES
Explain CHAT HERE
Explain the names in the box.
Explain CHAT ISLAND
Explain ADS CHAT
Back to Main Question List.
EXIT HELP

chatpoints.chat_text: Just the people on the screen can hear you with CHAT NEAR.

replies.reply_text: Back to Chat Explanations.
Back to Main Question List.
EXIT HELP

chatpoints.chat_text: Just those on your buddy list will see your chat with CHAT BUDDIES.

replies.reply_text: Back to Chat Explanations.
Back to Main Question List.
EXIT HELP

chatpoints.chat_text: Just the people on the same square as you will see your chat with CHAT HERE.  This is especially useful when in art rooms, such as the drawing room or poetry room.

replies.reply_text: Back to Chat Explanations.
Back to Main Question List.
EXIT HELP

chatpoints.chat_text: The names in the drop down box are of those people currently online.  You can pick any of those names and only that person will see your chat.

replies.reply_text: Back to Chat Explanations.
Back to Main Question List.
EXIT HELP

chatpoints.chat_text: These objects are used for quests.  Residents may ask you to find something for them, or look for clues.  These objects will be needed to finish many of the quests on Horse Isle.

replies.reply_text: Where can I get these objects?
Back to Main Question List.
EXIT HELP

chatpoints.chat_text: These objects are permanently in your tool box.  Simply push the wrench in the lower right hand corner to open up the tool box, then click whichever tool you need to use.

replies.reply_text: Back to Main Question List.
EXIT HELP

chatpoints.chat_text: The arenas let you compete, using one of your horses, with other players in the game.  There is a starting time to each event, so once your horse is entered, you need to wait until the event starts.

replies.reply_text: Do I need to stay in the arena after I have entered?
What does my horse need in order to compete?
What do I need in order to compete?
Back to Main Question List.
EXIT HELP

chatpoints.chat_text: No.  When it is time for the competition to start, it will just pop up in your window no matter where you are.

replies.reply_text: What does my horse need in order to compete?
Back to Main Question List.
EXIT HELP

chatpoints.chat_text: Your horse needs to be fed, watered, not too tired, have horse shoes on, healthy, and fully tacked in order to compete.

replies.reply_text: How do I know if my horse is ready to compete?
Do I need to stay in the arena after I have entered?
What do I need in order to compete?
Back to Main Question List.
EXIT HELP

chatpoints.chat_text: You don't need anything other than what your horse needs.  You can, however, have some competition clothes on.  Any of these items can be found in the clothing stores in the different towns.

replies.reply_text: Back to Main Question List.
EXIT HELP

chatpoints.chat_text: When you look at your horse, there are stat bars that will tell you how their health, hunger, etc is.  Those need to be above 200.  Below the stats bar, it will show you what tack your horse is wearing.  It should have a saddle, saddle pad, and bridle on.

replies.reply_text: Where do I get everything for my horse?
Back to Main Question List.
EXIT HELP

chatpoints.chat_text: The different towns have the stores and services needed to get your horse all ready for competition.

replies.reply_text: Back to Main Question List.
EXIT HELP

chatpoints.chat_text: If you have a horse that is fully tacked, you may ride it around.  That allows you to move faster.  Also, there are wagons that go between towns, and boats that go between islands.

replies.reply_text: Back to Main Question List.
EXIT HELP

chatpoints.chat_text: There are trainers located in different towns around Horse Isle.  They will train your horse for $1000, but you can only train your horse once during that game day.

replies.reply_text: Back to Main Question List.
EXIT HELP

chatpoints.chat_text: Ranches are very expensive, so you need to save up a lot of money in order to buy one.  Some of them vary in price, but they are all the same.  There is no advantage to buying a more expensive one...  Except maybe for the location.

replies.reply_text: How do I get money?
What is a ranch good for once I buy one?
Where are the ranches?
Back to Main Question List.
EXIT HELP

chatpoints.chat_text: The ranch building itself rests you, you can pick up your mail, and it determines how many out-buildings you can have.  Each of the different out-buildings have different bonuses.

replies.reply_text: Explain the barn.
Explain the shed.
Explain the water well.
Explain the grain silo.
Explain the trainer.
Explain the windmill.
Explain the flower garden.
Explain the wagon.
Explain the vegetable garden.
Explain the big barn.
Back to Main Question List.
EXIT HELP

chatpoints.chat_text: All ranches are on the mainland of Horse Isle, Tail Isle, or Starfish Isle.  The ones on the mainland are mostly below Earton.

replies.reply_text: What is a ranch good for once I buy one?
How do I get money to buy one?
Back to Main Question List.
EXIT HELP

chatpoints.chat_text: Having a barn allows you to have three more horses.  You can have an unlimited number of barns on your ranch.

replies.reply_text: Back to Ranch Building Explanations.
Back to Main Question List.
EXIT HELP

chatpoints.chat_text: The shed allows you to carry 20 more items in your inventory.  You can only have up to two sheds on your ranch.

replies.reply_text: Back to Ranch Building Explanations.
Back to Main Question List.
EXIT HELP

chatpoints.chat_text: The water well waters you and your horses when you stop into your ranch.  It really doesn't pay to have more than one.

replies.reply_text: Back to Ranch Building Explanations.
Back to Main Question List.
EXIT HELP

chatpoints.chat_text: The grain silo will feed all your horses when you stop in your ranch.  It really doesn't pay to have more than one.

replies.reply_text: Back to Ranch Building Explanations.
Back to Main Question List.
EXIT HELP

chatpoints.chat_text: The trainer trains all of your horses for free, one point in all of their stats once per game day.  This is only done when you click on the trainer and tell it to train all of your horses.  Since training can only be done once every two hours, there is no reason to have more than one.

replies.reply_text: Back to Ranch Building Explanations.
Back to Main Question List.
EXIT HELP

chatpoints.chat_text: The windmill earns you $500 every 12 game hours.  You can have as many on your ranch as you want.

replies.reply_text: Back to Ranch Building Explanations.
Back to Main Question List.
EXIT HELP

chatpoints.chat_text: The flower garden is just for looks.  Nothing else.

replies.reply_text: Back to Ranch Building Explanations.
Back to Main Question List.
EXIT HELP

chatpoints.chat_text: The wagon will take you to the nearest wagon station for free.  This also allows for free wagon transportation around the isles.  It really does no good to have more than one at your ranch.

replies.reply_text: Back to Ranch Building Explanations.
Back to Main Question List.
EXIT HELP

chatpoints.chat_text: The vegetable garden feeds you whenever you stop at your ranch.  There is really no reason to have more than one.

replies.reply_text: Back to Ranch Building Explanations.
Back to Main Question List.
EXIT HELP

chatpoints.chat_text: Swearing is pretty straight-forward.  Offensive/inflammatory language includes, but is not limited to, racist remarks, pushing religion, political statements, ethnic stereotypes, etc.

replies.reply_text: Back to Chat Rules.
Back to Main Question List.
EXIT HELP

chatpoints.chat_text: Here is a list of the basic rules for chat conduct.  Click REPLY for an explanation.

replies.reply_text: No swearing or offensive/inflammatory language.
No date-speak.
No cheating the filter.
No sharing or asking for personal information.
No chat spamming/flooding the chat.
No use of all caps.
No ruining the fun for others.
Use the Ads Chat for any advertising.
No giving out passwords or riddle answers in global or island chat.
Back to Main Question List.
EXIT HELP

chatpoints.chat_text: No looking for a girl/boy friend or any other chat that is related to relationships.  This is not a dating site.

replies.reply_text: Back to Chat Rules.
Back to Main Question List.
EXIT HELP

chatpoints.chat_text: The filter is set up for a reason.  Some words are flagged, while others are changed.  Do not do anything to purposely cheat the filter.

replies.reply_text: Back to Chat Rules.
Back to Main Question List.
EXIT HELP

chatpoints.chat_text: This includes age, email address, phone number, home address or city that you live in.  This also includes screen names for messengers and websites such as Myspace.  No advertising other sites.

replies.reply_text: Back to Chat Rules.
Back to Main Question List.
EXIT HELP

chatpoints.chat_text: Chat spam is typing nonsense just taking up space.  It is also pasting the same thing multiple times in a row.  This applies to socials and buddy-adding as well.

replies.reply_text: Back to Chat Rules.
Back to Main Question List.
EXIT HELP

chatpoints.chat_text: All caps is considered yelling and rude.  It is fine to have one or two words in all caps in order to emphasize the word in a sentence, but not all.

replies.reply_text: Back to Chat Rules.
Back to Main Question List.
EXIT HELP

chatpoints.chat_text: This includes harassing/bullying/name calling.  This also includes tricking other players out of horses, items or money.

replies.reply_text: Back to Chat Rules.
Back to Main Question List.
EXIT HELP

chatpoints.chat_text: This allows different people to see your advertisement when they want to buy or sell horses.  Also, people can mute this channel if they don't want to see it.  This channel is set so each player can only post once per minute.  This prevents spamming of ads.

replies.reply_text: Back to Chat Rules.
Back to Main Question List.
EXIT HELP

chatpoints.chat_text: The moderators handle most everything in private messages, so most players will never actually see them handling problems.  Please feel free to help players with questions in the game and such, but let the mods handle the problems.

replies.reply_text: Back to Main Question List.
EXIT HELP

chatpoints.chat_text: Many people want to solve these on their own.  If someone blurts it out where they can see it, it ruins the fun for them.

replies.reply_text: Back to Chat Rules.
Back to Main Question List.
EXIT HELP

chatpoints.chat_text: Just the people on the same island as you can hear you chat on CHAT ISLAND.

replies.reply_text: Back to Chat Explanations.
Back to Main Question List.
EXIT HELP

chatpoints.chat_text: This is where all advertising should occur.  Posts can be seen by anyone that hasn't muted it.  All players are limited to one post per minute.

replies.reply_text: Back to Chat Explanations.
Back to Main Question List.
EXIT HELP

chatpoints.chat_text: The big barn allows you to hold an extra 6 horses instead of the normal barn, which only allows for 3 more horses.  You may have as many big barns on your ranch as you want.

replies.reply_text: Back to Ranch Building Explanations.
Back to Main Question List.
EXIT HELP

npc_list.name: Mary Molasses
npc_list.long_description: Mary Molasses is sweet, outgoing and energetic. Horses and people love to be around her.

chatpoints.chat_text: Anything I can help you with?

replies.reply_text: Any other horse stores around here?
What feed is the best bargain?
No thanks, just looking around.
Not really, but do you have something to do to pass the time?
Yes, actually, Ted Capocella sent me.  He said you should have some hay ready for him?
What was I doing for you again?
I have those bales you needed.

chatpoints.chat_text: Nearest one would be in Treeton, but I have some great deals!

replies.reply_text: Can you tell me which feed is the best bargain?
Thank you for your help.

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, hay is cheap and a little filling, while oats are expensive, but very filling.  It's a toss-up between them.

replies.reply_text: Any other horse stores around here?
Do you happen to have any free samples?
Thanks much for the advice!

chatpoints.chat_text: Sure thing!  Here take this Horsie Treat.

replies.reply_text: Great, thanks a lot!

chatpoints.chat_text: Actually I do!  For a $1,000 entry fee, would you like to try your hand at a simple horse quiz? If you can answer all my questions, I'll give you $50,000.

replies.reply_text: Sorry, I don't think I know enough about horses yet.
Sure, I'd love to give it a whirl. (Hand her $1000.)
Maybe some other time.
Yeah, I'm ready!
I think I should go study, maybe next time.  You can keep my $1000, though.

chatpoints.chat_text: First Question: Where does the Azteca originate from?

replies.reply_text: Brazil
Mexico
India
England

chatpoints.chat_text: INCORRECT!  That was not the correct answer.  I'm sorry,  but I have won this challenge.  Try again sometime if you would like!

replies.reply_text: All right.  I'll come back after I've studied in the library!
Maybe I'll get it next time!
Bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: Correct! Second Question: How deep can the Bashkir Curly dig for its food?

replies.reply_text: 1 foot
4 inches
2 meters
3 feet

chatpoints.chat_text: Correct again! Third Question: When was the National Show Horse first developed?
Correct! Fourth Question: The Welsh Cob can sustain what gait for long distances?

replies.reply_text: Canter
Trot
Gallop
Piaffe

chatpoints.chat_text: Correct once again! Fifth Question: What breed’s lines were added to the French Trotter to make it a faster horse?

replies.reply_text: Thoroughbred
Welsh Mountain Pony
National Show Horse
Standardbred

chatpoints.chat_text: Correct! Sixth Question: What was the original Knabstrup’s height?

replies.reply_text: 16.3 hands high
12.2 hands high
14.3 hands high
15.2 hands high

chatpoints.chat_text: Correct! Seventh Question: What was the Suffolk Punch originally bred for?

replies.reply_text: Plowing
Trail Riding
Dressage
Jumping

chatpoints.chat_text: Correct again! Eighth Question: Which of these were NOT crossed to create the Gelderland?

replies.reply_text: Friesian
Appaloosa
Oldenburg
Hackney

chatpoints.chat_text: Correct! Ninth Question: The Missouri Fox Trotter is most frequently used by whom?

replies.reply_text: Farmers
Carriage Drivers
Jumping Competitors
Forest Rangers

chatpoints.chat_text: Correct! Final Question: The Friesian was an ancestor of what breed?

replies.reply_text: Fell Pony
Exmoor Pony
Caspian
Dartmoor Pony
Thanks!

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, I did have his hay ready, however I thought he had forgotten and I sold it this morning.

replies.reply_text: Oh, no!  Is there anything I can do?  He really needs that hay.

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, if you can get me three more bales I could put back what I had to sell.

replies.reply_text: I don't have time right now.  I'll be back later.
I suppose I could do that.  Where should I get the hay?
That doesn't sound too hard.  I'll be back as soon as I have them.

chatpoints.chat_text: I need three more bales of hay to complete Ted's order.  You should be able to build them by the jumping arenas to the north of here.

replies.reply_text: I remember now.  I'll be back soon.
Thanks, you too.

chatpoints.chat_text: Hey there... Don't see many people in these woods...

replies.reply_text: Why are you named Twig?
What are you doing in the woods?
Later Twig...
I'm back! And I have something from your sister.
Help me out here, Twig. I think I was supposed to be doing something for you, but I can't remember what it was.
Hi, Twig. I'm on an errand for Mino and he needs some moss and lichen.
Hi Twig!  Mehitabel asked me to find Archy, and Tobias said he was coming to see you.  I don't suppose he's still around?
Sorry to bother you again, Twig, but where did Archy go again, after he left you?

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, err, it's not my real name... It's just my nickname 'cause I like the forest so much!

replies.reply_text: Okay...   What are you doing in the forest?
Later, Twig. I'm going to go now.

chatpoints.chat_text: I'm searching for the very rare red pine cones!  I'll pay you $1000 if you ever find one!

replies.reply_text: I've got one to give you!
Well, good luck with that!  Bye!
Aren't you lonely out here by yourself?

chatpoints.chat_text: Really?

replies.reply_text: I actually have another one to give you!
Thanks. Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: Lonely? I guess a bit. I do miss my sister Daf. I haven't seen her since she moved to Wington.

replies.reply_text: Is there anything I can do to help?
Oh, dear. This sounds too personal. I'd rather stay out of it. See you next time!

chatpoints.chat_text: If you wouldn't mind, could you take her these yellow roses? She loves daffodils, but I don't know where to get any of those.

replies.reply_text: I'd be happy to take roses to her.
I just don't think I'm up for island jumping right now. Sorry!
Where did you say I could find her?

chatpoints.chat_text: She lives in the north part of Wington.

replies.reply_text: Great! I'll be back in a jiffy.
I've got to get going now. Enjoy your new pet!

chatpoints.chat_text: Did she like the roses?

replies.reply_text: She loved them! And look at the goldfish she sent back for you.

chatpoints.chat_text: You were taking roses to my sister Daf in Wington, remember?

replies.reply_text: Got it! I'll get right to it.

chatpoints.chat_text: Really? I mean, well, I like the moss and lichen here very much. It adds a lot of character to the trees, and of course, you always know which direction is north from looking at it, but I'm curious why Mino would want it.

replies.reply_text: (You quickly explain about Mino's anniversary surprise and how hummingbirds need it for their nests.)

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, that certainly explains it. Let me fill up a basket for you. Wait here a minute.

replies.reply_text: I'll do that.
I'm sure it'll be perfect. Thanks so much. This will mean a lot to Mino.
Looks like I'm on my way to Treeton.  Thanks, Twig. See you around!

chatpoints.chat_text: You're no bother. Archy was heading to Treeton when he left.

replies.reply_text: Treeton for the oats, now I remember.  Thanks Twig!

npc_list.name: Sera
npc_list.long_description: Sera is so wrapped up it's hard to see what she looks like. Her voice sounds friendly.

chatpoints.chat_text: Hi!  My name is Sera!  Welcome to my igloo.  How do you like Snow Isle?

replies.reply_text: It's okay, are there any other cool places to go up here?
I hate it here!  It's so cold! I'm going south!
I love this place!  There are snowballs everywhere!
I heard I can have a free nap and free cocoa?
It's okay.  A bit cold, though.
It's freezing up here! I hear that Winter Lotus blossoms grow up here. Have you seen any around?
Hello Sera, do you happen to have a big fur coat I can buy?

chatpoints.chat_text: Actually, if you travel up to Santa's workshop, you can wrap any object and turn it into a present.

replies.reply_text: Wow! That's really cool, I'm going to go try it out right now.
But I don't GET a present?  Eh, that's no fun.  See ya later.
That's neat.  Brrr!  It's cold!  Do you have anything warm to drink?

chatpoints.chat_text: Christmas Isle is nearby, if you haven't seen it already.

replies.reply_text: Christmas Isle? All year round?  Are there presents?
Well, what kind of Christmas Island is this?  I'm leaving!
Oh, okay.  I'll just have some cocoa.
Yawn!  I'm sleepy, I think I'll take a nap.
Thanks!
Whew!  I've had so much cocoa I'm going to burst!  I better go!
Now I'm sleepy.  I think I'll take a nap.

chatpoints.chat_text: I'm glad you like it here!

replies.reply_text: It's very nice, but I'm kind of thirsty, can I have something to drink?
Yawn!  I'm sleepy.  I think I'll take a nap now.
What are you talking about!  I hate this place, I'm leaving!
ZZZZZzzzzzzZZZZZzzzzzz...............

chatpoints.chat_text: So....  Are you going to wake up now?

replies.reply_text: ZZZZZzzzzzzZZZZZzzzzzz...............
Huh?  Wuh?  Did you say something?
Well, now I am.  That was pretty rude, I'm leaving.

chatpoints.chat_text: Hey!  You're kind of boring.

replies.reply_text: ZZZZZzzzzzzZZZZZzzzzzz...............
(Sleepily.) Sugar plum fairy... sugar plum fairy... Zzzzzzzz

chatpoints.chat_text: Pay attention to meee!!!!

replies.reply_text: ZZZZZzzzzzzZZZZZzzzzzz...............
(Sleepily.) A monkey stole my horsie... Come back Mr. Giggles... come... back... Zzzz
Huh?  Wuh?  Did you say something?

chatpoints.chat_text: Ahhhh!  Stop it!  I can't handle it anymore!

replies.reply_text: What's wrong with you! You must be crazy!!
I'm sorry, I did sleep for a long time, but you seem a little stressed out, so I'm going to go.

chatpoints.chat_text: Really?  You think I'm crazy?

replies.reply_text: YES!  I'm leaving.
Ummm.... No.... It's... uh...... great here....
No, you're just a little lonely all the way up here, but I'm going now.  Thanks for the nap!
No, just lonely. I would be, too.  Could I have some cocoa now?

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, um, nope!  You can go back to sleep, if you want!

replies.reply_text: Oh, great!
No, I think I'll get going now, c'ya!

chatpoints.chat_text: Yeah, it is.  But you sort of get used to it.  Having a good coat helps, too.

replies.reply_text: A coat would probably help fight off the cold.
I'm sure it does.  Well, off I go.

chatpoints.chat_text: You bet!  Speaking of coats, there's a man down on Desert Isle that was supposed to send me up some, but I haven't heard from him.  Leroy is his name.

replies.reply_text: Desert Isle is a long way away.

chatpoints.chat_text: Sure is, and I don't like the heat, else I'd go down there and get the coats myself.  Hey, maybe you could go get them!

replies.reply_text: Yeah, I could!
Umm, I really don't want to run down to Desert Isle right now.  Maybe some other time.

chatpoints.chat_text: Great!  He lives down on the southern part of the isle, between Santon and Hotton.  It's a long trip, so you better get going!

replies.reply_text: Right.  I'll be off right away.

chatpoints.chat_text: Welcome back!  What can I do for you?

replies.reply_text: I got those coats from Leroy for you!
Is there anything else to do around here?
Can I have a free nap and some cocoa?
This place is just so great!
I'm way too cold!  I'm outta here!
I was supposed to pick up coats for you...  Where was that again?
I hear that Winter Lotus blossoms grow up here. Have you seen any around?
Hello Sera, do you happen to have a big fur coat I can buy?
Thanks so much!  I'm glad I could be such help.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, all right.  Come again.  You can have that free cocoa or nap anytime you want!
Get them from Leroy.  He lives down on the southern part of Desert Isle, between Santon and Hotton.

replies.reply_text: Great.  I'll get right on that.

chatpoints.chat_text: The Winter Lotus? Oh, sure, they're rare, but you're definitely in the right place!

replies.reply_text: Oh, good, what a relief! I'm supposed to take one to Pattini on Jungle Isle. Can you tell me where they grow?

chatpoints.chat_text: Jungle Isle? You know that as soon as you pick the flower it starts to melt, right?

replies.reply_text: That's what I'm afraid of. Do you have any ideas?
I know, but I need to try. Can you tell me where they grow?

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, it seems to me that some sort of ice box would be logical, to keep the flower cold. You might try talking to one of the elves on Christmas Isle. That seems like the sort of thing they could construct.

replies.reply_text: I'll do that, thanks!
Good idea. Can you tell me where I can find the flowers as well?

chatpoints.chat_text: There's some growing just outside, around the frozen pond close to my house. You have to look closely to see them, since they are so white; they blend in with the snow.

replies.reply_text: Oh, good to know! Do you have any ideas on how to keep it from melting?
I'll look by the pond, then. Thanks for the help!

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, no, I need these coats.  You could try Leroy down on Desert Isle.  He's the one who provides me with coats, you might remember.

replies.reply_text: Oh, of course.  How could I forget?  Thanks!

npc_list.name: Ernie Angler
npc_list.long_description: Ernie Angler is a very tall man with a passion for fishing that is contagious.

chatpoints.chat_text: Welcome to my store!

replies.reply_text: Where can I go fishing?
What do I need to go fishing?
You don't have any fishing poles in stock?
I have some fish that I caught.  Is there anything I can do with them?
I just came from Stella's.  Do you happen to have her sack of fish ready?
Here are your 25 earthworms.
Hello, can I buy a bottle of tuna oil from you?
Hello. I was wondering if you know someone by the name of Patience?

chatpoints.chat_text: There are a few ponds just south and east of my store!

replies.reply_text: Thanks!
I have another question...

chatpoints.chat_text: Well...  Just a fishing pole,  bait,  and the right attitude!

replies.reply_text: Thanks!
I have another question...

chatpoints.chat_text: I don't!   But I can quickly make you one if you give me $100 and a strong skinny branch!

replies.reply_text: Okay...  I'll go look for one!
Okay!  I've got a branch right here.  Please make me a fishing pole!
Okay!  Bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, of course!  You can sell them to me, or I can fry them up for you so you have fresh fish to eat!

replies.reply_text: Okay!   Thanks for the information.
Could you fry some fish for me?

replies.reply_text: Hello, I am looking for a place to have a bite to eat and maybe rest my head for a while.  I have had a long day of travels.
Hello, I am new to town and I just thought I would stop in for a moment and see what you had for food.
Hi George. I noticed that you served hot meals. Would you happen to have a copper-bottomed stock pot? I'm in the market for one.
Hi!  Dr. Heimlich told me that your cat recently had kittens. Would you happen to have a pure white kitten in that litter?
It's what I can do for you, today!  Special delivery from the Pony Express!
Good day George.  I'm trying to find Olav, the roofer, for his sister and I understand he might be staying here... maybe??
Sorry to bother you again, but where did you say Olav went?
Hiya George!  I've got a package from Woody.
I noticed your cheery fireplace and was wondering if you could spare some of the wood ash from it?

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, you have definitely come to the right place. I have two excellent dishes: pizza and a soda or a cheeseburger and fries, both cooked to order.  Also, I have clean rooms and comfy beds.  So make yourself at home and enjoy your stay.

replies.reply_text: Thank you, I think I will do just that.   By the way, do you have any children?
Great!  Thanks.

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, let me know if I can help you with anything.

replies.reply_text: Thank you.

chatpoints.chat_text: Why, yes I do.  I have two little angels.  A six year old girl named Star, and a 4 year old boy named Chase.  They are the apple of my eye.

replies.reply_text: What interesting names.  I hope I will get to meet them while I am here.

chatpoints.chat_text: You just might get to.  Either way, enjoy your meal and sleep well.

replies.reply_text: Thanks again.

chatpoints.chat_text: I'm sorry, I'm more of a griddle-and-oven kind of chef. You want to talk to someone who does slow cooking. That's what a copper-bottom stock pot would typically be used for.

replies.reply_text: I see. Would you know anyone like that?

chatpoints.chat_text: Not really. Sorry I can't help you more.

replies.reply_text: Thanks for trying. Bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: Sorry, mate... Blackie gave us 6 little black and white bundles of fur, not a solid color in the lot!  Could you use a black and white kitten? ...Please??

replies.reply_text: No thanks, I need to find a solid white cat... Good luck finding homes for these guys!
I sure will, and I'm sure the kids will enjoy their new toys!

chatpoints.chat_text: Olav?  Sure he was here.  Did a lot of work on the barn roof and the pet shop, but he left when it was finished.

replies.reply_text: Left?!?  I missed him again?  Do you have any idea where he went after leaving here?
Tropicton?  It is warm there, here's hoping he's still there.  Thanks for the help.  Bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: No problem.  I said he sent me a postcard from Tropicton.  Try there.

replies.reply_text: All right.  Thanks!

chatpoints.chat_text: (George quickly puts his hand over your mouth.) Ssssshhh!! Be quiet, I don't want the kids hearing about this just yet.

replies.reply_text: (Whispering.) Sorry, Woody said this has all of the cages and animals your kids could possibly want. Here have a look. (You offer the box to George.)
Sure, five logs back to Woody, I got it!  Bye, hope the kids have fun with that.

chatpoints.chat_text: Sorry. I clean out the fireplace first thing every day and throw the stuff away.

replies.reply_text: Darn! Looks like I have to try somewhere else.

npc_list.name: Basil Snoremore
npc_list.long_description: Basil Snoremore has his brown hair neatly parted on the left side. He is wearing a crisp, pin striped shirt with a sweater vest. He has grey trousers on and his brown loafers are well polished.

chatpoints.chat_text: Welcome, traveler.  Sit a spell near the warm fire.

replies.reply_text: Thank you,  I will.
Why should I eat or drink?
Basil!  Please, I have no money.  Could I have a little something to eat?
Hi Basil. Would you, by any chance, have a copper-bottomed stock pot I could buy, or know where I could get one?
Good day, Basil. I'm trying to locate Olav, the roofer. I was told that he spent some time here.
Sorry, but who did you say Olav was staying with?
Hi Basil! Do you need anything?
I feel like I was doing something for you... Was I?
I'm back! You ready to get messy?
You sure have a toasty looking fire going there. Would you mind if I took some of the wood ash?

chatpoints.chat_text: Hmm...  Strange question.  I couldn't imagine competing while starving!   You would likely do very poorly.

replies.reply_text: Makes sense.   Thanks.
Thank you, Basil!  I'll just sit by this fire for a bit.

chatpoints.chat_text: Sure don't. Sorry.

replies.reply_text: Darn. Okay, thanks anyway.
Thanks, I'll go see Karl.  Bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: Last I heard from Olav, he was staying with Karl in Whiskerton.

replies.reply_text: That's right, I forgot!  Thanks again.

chatpoints.chat_text: Hello! Hmm... Do I need anything? No, I don't thi-- Oh, wait! I know exactly what I could use right now.

replies.reply_text: What might that be?
Eep, I've just remembered I left the oven on! I'd better go turn it off. See you later.

chatpoints.chat_text: Paint! You see, I splatter paint in my spare time. It's an old hobby of mine.

replies.reply_text: ...Splatter paint? (You look around at the pristine, spotless inn.) Isn't that kind of messy?

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, yes. Yes, indeed. It gets all of the disorganization out of my system so I can keep the inn clean. It's also a good stress-reliever.

replies.reply_text: I see. That makes sense now. I'll pick some up for you if you can tell me where I can get it.
Uh-huh. Well, I need to feed my rat, so I'd better scat. Bye!
Oh, okay. That's not too far. I should be back soon.

chatpoints.chat_text: You were getting paint from Pablo on Art Isle so I can splatter paint.

replies.reply_text: Oh, right! Thanks!

chatpoints.chat_text: Great! I can't wait to see what colors Pablo gave me this time around!

replies.reply_text: Here you are. (You hand him the paint.)
Uh... Sure. Whatever you say. Thanks for the stuff, though.
Yeah! You'll have to show me what you end up with! Have fun. Oh, and thanks for the reward!

chatpoints.chat_text: Ugh! I hate dealing with that messy stuff. I have a friend come over every night and clean it out for me. Sorry!

replies.reply_text: (Sigh!) Darn. Thanks anyways.

npc_list.name: Belinda Buckle
npc_list.long_description: Belinda Buckle has her wavy brown hair pulled back into a neat pony tail. She is a confident gal, probably in her late 30's.

chatpoints.chat_text: Hi!  Welcome to my gear store, where you'll find all the basics you need to start riding.  I sell all kinds of stuff so come on in and let's talk tack!

replies.reply_text: You sure do have a lot of gear to choose from, Belinda. Who knew riding was such a science?
Okay.  Thanks,  bye.
Hiya!  Have you heard about Sumiko Stallman's Riding for the Handicapped program?
Is tack all you're interested in?
Hiya, uhm.... I had to race home and paint the... uhm... alligator.  What was it you wanted again?
Hi, I'm back.  Will this necklace do?

chatpoints.chat_text: Science?  Who said anything about science!  I'm here to help you get your butt in the saddle, not the chemistry lab! We just need to find out what kinda training you plan on doing so we can get you set up, sorted out and sitting pretty!

replies.reply_text: I like all kinds of riding. If there's a horse involved then I'm happy. I'd love to buy something, but some of this stuff is really expensive!
Okay.  Thanks,  bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: You bet it is!  My horses are better dressed than I am most of the time.  But you get what you pay for.  Most of this gear is made out of leather and leather costs money.  It'll last a long time, though and sure looks pretty in the show ring!

replies.reply_text: Okay.  Thanks,  bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, yes I have.

replies.reply_text: She needs halters with leads and used saddles, preferably child-sized.  Do you have anything like that that she could have, or buy if for not too much?

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh!  I have just the right thing for her.  Just got this in and already have someone interested though.  But for such a good cause, I'll let Sumiko have it for $200.

replies.reply_text: That's a lovely child's saddle!  Yes, I think she'd really like it.
Nice as it is, $200 is too much.  Sorry.  Bye.
Thanks so much.  I'll see that she gets this!  Bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, it's my area of expertise, so it's what I know most about.  But you know what else I'm keen on? Fashion accessories!

replies.reply_text: For horses?  Or for people?
Ugh.  Just the thought of fashion gives me acne.  Bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, for people! For example, look at this! (She shows you a picture in a sketchbook, showing a remarkable purple jacket she's designed.) I've already had this jacket made. But you know what it needs? A silver amethyst necklace! Don't you think?

replies.reply_text: Don't tell me, don't tell me, let me guess:  I could really, really make your day by getting you a silver amethyst necklace.
Augh, I sense a quest coming on.  Bye!
Okay, well, I'll be on my way then.  Bye!
Well, guess what?  It just so happens that I happen to have such a thing on me even as we speak!

chatpoints.chat_text: You were getting me a silver amethyst necklace.

replies.reply_text: Oh!  Yeah, right!  I'm on it.  I'll be back.
Oh!  I was was wondering what I was doing running around with this extra necklace.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh? You have the necklace I asked for?  Let's see it.

replies.reply_text: Here you are.
Have a fashionable day!

npc_list.name: Sarah Seams
npc_list.short_description: Owner of clothing shop in Earton
npc_list.long_description: Sarah Seams is a young designer with fresh new ideas for the residents of Earton.

chatpoints.chat_text: Welcome to my store!  Please enjoy looking through my shop!

replies.reply_text: Okay. Thanks.
If you are so fashionable, why do you only really have t-shirts and jeans?
Hello, I wonder if you can help me.  I'm looking for costumes...........?

chatpoints.chat_text: Because those clothing items are very fashionable.  Other competition clothes actually help your horse in the competition.  All of my clothes, except the polo shirt, are just for looks.

replies.reply_text: Oh, all right.  Maybe I'll look around some, then.
Why would I buy them, then?

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, well, to be highly fashionable during your competitions, of course.

replies.reply_text: Umm...  All right.  I'll think about it.

chatpoints.chat_text: Costumes?  Not here.  Definitely not here.  My apologies.  Costumes.  Really!

replies.reply_text: Yeah... Do you happen to know anybody who might do... that kind of thing?

chatpoints.chat_text: Let me see.... let me see... Well, there's Stella Styles, she does custom sewing.  She's in Shellton these days, I believe.  You could try her.  Oh, and there's Barb Sower too, also in Shelton, she might consent...

replies.reply_text: Okay, thanks.  I'll head off that way.  See you!

npc_list.name: Kathy McKure
npc_list.long_description: Kathy McKure has brown shoulder length hair and green eyes.

chatpoints.chat_text: Hello. How are your horses today?

replies.reply_text: Oh, they are all fine.  I'll be on my way!
Well...   I was wondering, how can they get sick?
Why do some of my horses cost more to heal than others?
My horses are fine, thanks.  I need your help finding a kitten.  Do you know if there are any recent litters of kittens in your town?
They're great. Actually, I'm here because Atreyu's friend, Falcor, has been sick for the past week and isn't showing any signs of getting better. Can you help him?
Fine and dandy, thanks for asking! I'm looking for a dentist. You wouldn't happen to know of one, would you?

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, many ways.  You must be careful out there.   If you don't keep them well fed and hydrated, they can become ill, also drinking from an unclean water source may sometimes cause them ailment.

replies.reply_text: Hmm...   Any other ways?
Thanks, bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, I've heard that once in a while a scorpion in a desert can bite a horse if you are riding it!

replies.reply_text: Thanks, bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: The cost is based on how much treatment the horse needs, or rather, how sick it is.

replies.reply_text: Thanks, bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: No, sorry, no new kittens in Earton.  At least none that I'm aware of!

replies.reply_text: Thanks anyway.  I'll keep looking, bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: Is this Falcor a horse? If not, I probably won't be able to help. I mainly treat horses, so I only have medicine that will work with horses.

replies.reply_text: Uh... No, he's not. So I guess that means you can't help, then?

chatpoints.chat_text: No, I'm afraid not. Sorry.

replies.reply_text: Bah. All this traveling is getting annoying. Thanks anyway.

chatpoints.chat_text: Not personally. Although I did hear mention of someone setting up a practice out of their home, not far from here.

replies.reply_text: Thanks!

npc_list.name: Franklin Forge
npc_list.short_description: Owner of the Farriery in Earton
npc_list.long_description: Franklin Forge has leathery skin. His face shows a lot of character through his many wrinkles.

chatpoints.chat_text: Welcome to my shop,  youngin.

replies.reply_text: Why does my horse need shoes?
Why would I spend the extra money on steel shoes?
Thanks. Just looking.
Rebecca sent me to get some stuff.  She's making a new pottery wheel for Genevieve.  She said you would know what she needs.
Hello.  I just came from Shaylene, with the goats.  She asked me to ask you for a curd knife.
Why thank you!  I was wondering if, by any chance, you work with brass?
Why thank you!  I was wondering do you work with brass?

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, to compete in any competition, they are required.  They protect the horse's hooves while walking around.

replies.reply_text: Thanks for the information!

chatpoints.chat_text: The shoes themselves are only maybe one quarter better, but some people are willing to pay a premium that can afford it.   If money is tight, I wouldn't bother, honestly.

replies.reply_text: Thanks for the information!

chatpoints.chat_text: Rebecca?  Pottery wheel?  All right.  Let me go grab some things.

replies.reply_text: Okay.
Oh, wait.  Umm...  hang on.  I'll come back later.  I've got to go.
I would assume.  Thanks.

chatpoints.chat_text: A curd knife?  What's she want with a curd knife?

replies.reply_text: She's going to try to make some goat cheese.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, goat cheese, eh. Hmmm... curd knife, curd knife, ah! This might work. (Franklin shows you a long knife, somewhat like a palatte knife, very flat and with a rounded end.) $300. Should work fine, won't scratch if you're careful.

replies.reply_text: No thanks, I'm not spending any more money on this quest.  Goodbye.
Great!  I'll take it.
Okay.  Thanks!

chatpoints.chat_text: Sorry, youngin', I work with iron and steel only.  I think I heard tell of some one down south who works with brass, the name eacapes me though.  Good luck!

replies.reply_text: Thanks anyway, I'll keep looking.  Bye!

npc_list.name: Brock Limestone
npc_list.long_description: Brock Limestone has curly, messy brownish hair. Brock loves rocks. You imagine that most of his daylight hours are spent searching for them.

chatpoints.chat_text: There are many precious stones to be found on Horse Isle and I buy them all!

replies.reply_text: Great.  Where can I find these stones?
Do stones have any other uses?
Good to know, but I'm here to give you something from the Pony Express!
Hi there.  Where was I supposed to look for those meteors for you again?
Wow, looks like you have every kind of stone there is here!
Hi there. I'm back with the meteorites you asked for.
Hi again. Can you give me any better directions for the location of the tektite you wanted?
I'm back with the tektite!  Here you are!

chatpoints.chat_text: Mostly on the beaches.

replies.reply_text: Great, I'll go looking!
Are there any other uses for stones?

chatpoints.chat_text: You can make them into jewelry, but that's basically it.  They are just beautiful!  Isn't that enough?

replies.reply_text: Umm...  Yeah, I guess so.
Okay.  Thanks,  bye.
Thanks!  Bye.
Wow, thanks so much!

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, I wish I did.  Maybe someday, maybe someday.  You never know.

replies.reply_text: What is it you're missing?
I'm sure you'll find them eventually!  I mean, everyone comes to Earton.  Good luck!  Bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: I'd love to carry meteorites!  Both kinds.  And tektites, too.  I guess those are also meteorites.  But they're so hard to come by.  I'd pay a lot for 'em, though!

replies.reply_text: Good luck finding someone to search for them.  I have a hard time finding my toothbrush in the morning.  Bye!
You would, eh?  Well, I'm really great at finding things!  Tell me what you want, and I'll get it for you, how's that?

chatpoints.chat_text: I'll take you up on that!  You'll have to go to the snow isles, though.  But I can give you hints where to look.

replies.reply_text: Wonderful!  What do you want, and where is it to be found?
The snow isles?!  Nevermind, then.  I hate the cold.  Bye!
I thought you wanted meteorites, not... chon... ...?
Okay, where do you want me to look?

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, that's okay.  A chondrite is a kind of meteorite.  There are plenty of sub-types, too, but you don't need to worry about that.

replies.reply_text: Good.  Where shall I look?

chatpoints.chat_text:
Well, I've been told there was a fall of nickel-iron meteorites on Icicle Isle a month or so ago. Friend of mine found one and says she built a snowman on the spot. So if you can scout around there, you might find more pieces of it.
Chondrites are usually found on Ice Isle. If they're still up there, they're probably in a pile of rocks in the middle of a triangle formed by three Snow Caves. That's all I know.

replies.reply_text: And the Tektite?
On my way!

chatpoints.chat_text: I'll have to go consult a letter from another friend to see where those are.  Why don't you go to the Snow Isles and get me those other two, and I'll have that information when you get back.

replies.reply_text: Okay, will do.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, good!  Let's see what you've brought me!

replies.reply_text: Here they are. (You lay out what you've found on the countertop.)
Okay, I'm on my way to find the tektite.

chatpoints.chat_text: I wish I could, but that's all I know.  It's on the southwest end of Torrid Isle where the sand is a little disturbed or windblown or something.

replies.reply_text: Thanks, I'll find it!
I will!  Thanks so much!  Bye!

npc_list.name: Simon Goods
npc_list.short_description: Owner of the Earton General Store
npc_list.long_description: Simon Goods is a handsome and kind man.

chatpoints.chat_text: Welcome to my store!  I always try to carry more goods than anyone else in town.  Why shop anywhere else!?

replies.reply_text: Great, thanks.  I'll look around.
Hmm...   Your prices seem... high!
I see you stock all kinds of things. Any chance you'd have some less-than-fresh fruit?
Hello, Ms. McGraw-Hill, the librarian, said she sold you some books about pirates recently.
I hope you do. Murray sent me to get (You pull out the list, checking it carefully.) 2 buckets and 4 brushes.
I'd like to buy some colorful tissue paper, please.
I'm looking for lemons. Would you have any, or if not, could you order some?
Dolly over in Hotton sent me to pick up three ice cream makers.  Do you have them in stock?

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, you pay a little extra for the convenience!  Who wants to spend all day running around town for this or that!

replies.reply_text: Thanks for your insight.

chatpoints.chat_text: Imagine that! Someone wanting spoiled fruit. That's a new one on me. But I can't help you. This is a general store. You should see if Eli can help you. He runs the food store here.

replies.reply_text: Thanks. I'll do that.

chatpoints.chat_text: Yes, she sent some books about pirates in the last shipment.  Is there a specific book that you are looking for?

replies.reply_text: Yes, actually, I'm looking for "The Pirates Own Book" by Charles Ellms.  It's a three book set.

chatpoints.chat_text: Ellms, you said?  Let me check my inventory list.  No, I have "The Tragedy of the Seas" by Ellms, but I don't see "The Pirates Own Book", sorry.

replies.reply_text: Oh well, thanks for checking for me.  Goodbye.

chatpoints.chat_text: Whitewashing time again?  Those ranch owners sure keep old Murray hopping.

replies.reply_text: Yeah, he certainly is busy.  Do you have his buckets and brushes?
Thanks!  I'll tell him.  Bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: I wish I could help you, but I've never seen tissue paper available on the islands before. Maybe someone could craft it for you.

replies.reply_text: That's an idea! Thanks.

chatpoints.chat_text: All of a sudden, everyone is asking me about lemons! I have to tell you the same thing I've told everyone else, I can't order them. But I did hear a rumor going around that someone on Pirate Isle might be in possession of lemons.

replies.reply_text: Thanks for the tip! Have a great day.

chatpoints.chat_text: You're in luck, I only have three left.  They're $100 each, so that will be $300.

replies.reply_text: That seems rather pricey, but Dolly said to get them from you....  Okay here's the money.
Thanks, I'll tell Dolly you want a full report!

npc_list.name: Daisy Gerbera
npc_list.long_description: Daisy Gerbera is an artist when it comes to her floral arrangements. She talks to the flowers the entire time... it's as if they were working together.

chatpoints.chat_text: Hi there!  Welcome to my shop. I've got a great offer for you if you deal with me directly!

replies.reply_text: No thanks. I am just looking.
What is this offer you have?
Why is your flower selection so small?
I don't see any flowers I like here today.
Still?  Well, okay, I'll bite, what is it this time?
Got 'em!  Here you are, lovely fresh... kinda... Anyway, here they are.
I was doing something for you, I'm sure of it, but I have no idea what it might have been.  Could you enlighten a poor traveler?

chatpoints.chat_text: I prefer quality over quantity. All of my flowers are in beautiful condition. You won't see any brown or droopy ones here.

replies.reply_text: Oh, well, that's good.  I'll look around some.  Thanks.

chatpoints.chat_text: Okay, let me know if you need any help.

replies.reply_text: I will.  Thanks.

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, if you buy a bunch of daisies from me for $6, I'll give you a red rose for free!

replies.reply_text: Wow, that's a good deal.  Here is $6.
Hmm...  Not interested.  Thanks anyway.

chatpoints.chat_text: Thanks for stopping by, and come again.

replies.reply_text: Bye.
Thanks.  Bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, as it happens, I've just got in a shipment of these beautiful Theobroma jerseii and while they are of a lovely color and are absolutely fresh, they don't have the spots that this flower usually does and, you know, they rather lack a certain je ne sais quoi if you will. So! I thought, how about if I remove one petal on each one and replace it with.............. you'll never guess what I want to replace it with!

replies.reply_text: A duck?
Treacle?
Cat hair?
You're right, I never will.

chatpoints.chat_text: Tsk!  I thought I would take some peacock feathers and delicately cut those shiny blue eyes out of the middles and replace a petal with one of those.  Wouldn't it be just darling?

replies.reply_text: And I suppose you'd like me to go get you peacock feathers, then, yes?
Oh, have you got hold of the wrong person!  Bye-bye!
I see.  I'll be back with them when I can.  Bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, aren't you the class clown!  Five peacock feathers are what you were fetching, and good ones, now, not old, scraggly ones.

replies.reply_text: Right. I'll be back.
I hope you find the result pleasing!  Bye-bye!

npc_list.name: Phyllis Clipper
npc_list.admin_description: New quests must start at CP7

chatpoints.chat_text: Do you have my broom yet?

replies.reply_text: Yes, I have it right here.
No, not yet, sorry.
Who did you say you lent it to again?

chatpoints.chat_text: Hello, did you need something?  I'm sort of busy at the moment.

replies.reply_text: Not really, but you do look like you could use some help.
No, I was just looking.  I'll just be leaving, then.
Umm, do you think I could have some of that hair piling up on the floor there?

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, yes, actually I could use a little help, if you don't mind.

replies.reply_text: I have some time.  What do you need done?
Sorry, but I'm a little too busy myself right now.  Maybe some other time.

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, I let Ed Klippit in Hotton borrow my broom.  As you can see, it's a bit of a mess in here. Do you think you could see if he's done with it yet?

replies.reply_text: Sure, I can do that.  Where did you say he was again?
Hotton?  But isn't that on Desert Isle?  Sorry, but I'm too busy for that right now.
All right, I'll hurry back.

chatpoints.chat_text: I let Ed Klippit, the owner of the Hotton Groomer, borrow it.

replies.reply_text: Oh, that's right. I'll hurry back.
I'll just leave you to it, then.

chatpoints.chat_text: Thank you again for returning my broom.  Right now, though, I'm a little busy.

replies.reply_text: Umm, do you think I could have some of that hair piling up on the floor there?
No problem.  I can see you're busy, so I'll be going now.

chatpoints.chat_text: Hang on a second and I'll get you some.

replies.reply_text: Thank you, I will.
Bye, and thanks again!

npc_list.name: Eli Grits
npc_list.long_description: Eli Grits is a man with a past, the town's past that is.

chatpoints.chat_text: Howdy! Looking for something specific?

replies.reply_text: Nope. Just getting my daily items, thanks.
Your bread is very expensive.
Do you have any sugar here?
I heard that you know the area very well. I have even heard that you may know a few secrets. Is this true?
Do you happen to carry any cilantro?
I'm looking for fruit that isn't quite fresh. Mino wants some for a special surprise he's creating.
Not really, no.  I do like to run errands for people.  Do you have anything that needs doing?
Hi! I'm here as a representative for Hansel and Gretel's new bakery on the Cloud Isles. They would like to know if you would be able to supply them with any of these items? (You show Eli the list.)
I'm sorry to bother you again, but who did you say I should see about the molasses?
Actually, I was just trying to remember what I was doing for you.
Nope!  I'm back with your strawberries and chocolate, though.
Lemons, actually!

chatpoints.chat_text: That is because I bake it myself with high quality ingredients.  It's worth it!

replies.reply_text: Oh, ummm..  Okay.

chatpoints.chat_text: Of course.

replies.reply_text: Great.  Thanks.

chatpoints.chat_text: You heard right. I do know this town very well. In fact, I might be able to let you in on one secret.

replies.reply_text: Wow, that is fascinating!  Please tell me more.
Hmm... That doesn't really interest me. Thanks anyway!
Thanks!

chatpoints.chat_text: Okay, here's the skinny, partner. You give me $100 and I'll tell you a secret!

replies.reply_text: Okay, here's $100!  What's your secret?
$100!  You must be crazy, old man.  No thanks.

chatpoints.chat_text: Hmm, cilantro ...cilantro, no, don't think I do.  You might want to check with some of the other food shop owners.  They may know where to get some.

replies.reply_text: Okay.  Thanks. I'll do that. Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: Must be some kind of surprise. Wish I could help you, but I can't. Sorry.

replies.reply_text: Okay. Thanks anyway.

chatpoints.chat_text: Nope, I'm just a retailer.  You need a wholesaler to handle this kind of volume.

replies.reply_text: I don't suppose you might have any suggestions, do you?
Oh, goody, just what I wanted...  Back to the pirates.  Thanks!

chatpoints.chat_text: My molasses guy?  That's Captain Jack in Skullton, remember?

replies.reply_text: Oh, yeah, that's right, I forgot.  Thanks again!

chatpoints.chat_text: Hmm...  You know what?  I have really been wanting to try selling chocolate covered strawberries.  I don't have time to collect the chocolate or the strawberries, though.

replies.reply_text: I could get those things for you!
I take back what I said.  I really don't want to pick strawberries right now.  Bye!
