Nope, not at all.  I'll get right on that.

chatpoints.chat_text: You were going to Tropicton to get some chocolate.  Be sure you pick 25 strawberries somewhere along your travels also!

replies.reply_text: Do you know where in Tropicton?
Oh, yeah.  I'll go get that stuff now.

chatpoints.chat_text: Check with the general store or the food store.  One of them should have it.

replies.reply_text: All right.  Bye.
Thanks!  Good luck.
I'm sure they will.

chatpoints.chat_text: Then you are plum out of luck!

replies.reply_text: Gesh! That's not helpful.

chatpoints.chat_text: Hello there, I am Penny. Can I help you?

replies.reply_text: (Smiles nervously.) Yes... but where is everyone?
Oh, no. I'm just checking in.

chatpoints.chat_text: (Smiles) Don't worry, not many people come here. Mostly they're at jumping shows.

replies.reply_text: Jumping shows?
Oh, well, I guess I'll go watch them.

chatpoints.chat_text: (Nods.) All right. Have a nice day.

replies.reply_text: Thank you. You too.

chatpoints.chat_text: Yes. Earton had the very first jumping arenas!  We're quite famous for them.  There are now also jumping arenas at the Equestrian Park, and in Witherton.

replies.reply_text: Oh. Have you ever ridden in one?
Oh! Thank you. I'll go check them out.

chatpoints.chat_text: Yes, when I was younger. Bitsy and I were an undefeatable team. (Laughs.) But that was a long time ago. Now others have beaten our scores.

replies.reply_text: Wow. Undefeatable, huh?
Wow. I better be going now. Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: (Smiles.) Yes, you could become one too, if you keep practicing.

replies.reply_text: Really?! I better go practice, then. Thank you!

chatpoints.chat_text: (Laughs.) You're welcome. Good luck.

replies.reply_text: Thank you. Bye.

npc_list.name: Warren Cash
npc_list.long_description: Warren Cash is well dressed and his gelled hair is parted and combed perfectly.

chatpoints.chat_text: Thanks for stopping in. Can I take your money... Er, I mean, how can I help you?

replies.reply_text: (Terrified by the greeting.) Uh... I'm not sure now.
I think I want to deposit some money, but I am not sure.
Please give me all my money back.
I'd like to withdraw some money, please.
Uhm... hi there, I wonder, would you please tell me once again what it was you wanted?
I'm baaaaaack.
Hi there!  You look rather pensive.

chatpoints.chat_text: I'll give you some time to think and gather your money up.

replies.reply_text: All right.  Thanks.  Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: Don't think.  Just deposit.  I'll take good care of your cash and I'll try not to spend it.

replies.reply_text: You'll try not to spend it?! You're a bank! I guess I'll go elsewhere. Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: No, unless you make me.

replies.reply_text: But you're a bank.  You must give me back my money if I ask.  Maybe I'll just take it all back now.  Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: Sure, just fill out that DEPOSIT slip over there and I'll be glad to help.

replies.reply_text: Umm...  Wow, you are a tricky one.

chatpoints.chat_text: Pensive.  You're dang right I'm pensive!  Pensive.  Hah!

replies.reply_text: Would it be too much for one to ask what you might be pondering?
Well, now that's settled, I want my money.

chatpoints.chat_text: Money!  Money, money, money, and that's a fact!  And you know what I'm THINKING about money?  Go ahead, take a guess!

replies.reply_text: Uhm... you're thinking about devaluing the leaf?
Let's see... the fact that you don't have all of it?
What color it is?
I give up.
I think I will leave and let you go back to your cogitation.  Au revoir!

chatpoints.chat_text: Awww, use your noodle!  Has it ever occurred to you that the real problem with this world is that there is ONLY ONE KIND of money?!

replies.reply_text: Well, yeah, okay, in this part of the planet there's only one kind of money.  But I don't see why that's bad.
I don't know, I always thought that was kind of a good thing.
You're a loony.  I'm out of here!

chatpoints.chat_text: Good thing, eh?  Ha!  It's a lousy thing!  Suppose, just suppose, that somebody takes a look at this money and says, "Wow, look how this money shines!  I think I'll go grab up all the money!"  And they grab up all the money.  And where are you then, hunh?  Nowhere! See?  Simple economics, that is.

replies.reply_text: If you say so.  I think I'll go ... do my banking elsewhere.  Bye.
Well, I'll grant you, that could in fact be a problem.  But how will having another kind of money solve it?

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, here's what I'm thinking.  We can't have someone have all the money just because they collected all the shiny stuff.  So my idea is simple: UGLY MONEY!

replies.reply_text: Yup.  You're definitely a loony.  There's a nice bank over in Hotton, I think I'll go there.  Bye.
Well, you know what they say, "Ugly is in the eye of the beholder."
I've never met anybody who thought any kind of money was "ugly".

chatpoints.chat_text: Who the heck have you met? Philistines? Hah! Me, I have a highly-cultivated sense of Art. Anybody who's anybody has a highly-cultivated sense of Art. And they won't want ugly money. You know what that means? I get it ALL! HAHAHAHAHA! MINE, MINE... a... ahem... Yes. Well, ugly money. Really it's the only way to go.

replies.reply_text: Okay, assuming for the moment you have a point, what are you considering monetising?
Okay, well... everything I can think of that's been used as money has also been used a jewelry, so... okay, what have you settled on?
I think... if it's all the same with you, I'll go back to hanging out with the Philistines.  See you!

chatpoints.chat_text: I don't care about the beholder, I care about the ME-HOLDER.  I want to be THE holder of all the ugly money on these isles!  Everybody's got to have a dream.  That's mine.

replies.reply_text: You need help!
Fine, fine.  Tell me all about it then.

chatpoints.chat_text: All right.  Here you go!  Greatest idea ever to occur to the mind of man!  Now, for something to be useful as money, it has to be small and more or less uniform in size so you can pile it up nicely.  I think.... I HAVE IT!  EARTHWORMS!

replies.reply_text: WHAT?!  EWWW!!!!  BYE!!!
Worms?!  What?  You can't ... I mean ... you can't STACK worms!   You... but...
Worms.... that's genius! Nobody else would want to keep them and if you feed them they multiply!

chatpoints.chat_text: Yes! WORMS! If you feed them, they multiply!  By themselves!  Exactly!! Just think!  If I had a dozen worms and, say, a nice, juicy rotten tomato, in a couple of months I could be rich beyond the dreams of avarice!!

replies.reply_text: Oh, oh oh.  Don't tell me, let me guess.  You will give me some fabulous amount of pretty money if I go fetch you a dozen earthworms and some food for them.
No, sorry, this is just... no.  Bye.
Right.  Back anon.
Oh!  Is that all?  Well, never fear, then!  I happen to have that right here.  Here you are.

chatpoints.chat_text: Why?  Did you forget already?

replies.reply_text: Yes.
No, it's just that I'm not sure I believed you the first time.
Oh, never mind.

chatpoints.chat_text: I can see that.  Did you bring me what I asked you for?

replies.reply_text: No, I decided it was just too gross.  I came here to withdraw all my money, I don't want slime all over it.  So give me my money.
Me?  The Greatest Quest Performer in All Space-Time?  Of course I did!  Here you go!
Thanks!  Me, I'll stick with this "pretty" money.  Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: Come on in!

replies.reply_text: No, thanks.  Bye.
Thanks, how are you?
Is it true you give out orange samples?
Thanks.  Flavius sent me to pay his bill.  He gave me $500.
Thanks. I don't mean to offend you, but you wouldn't have any bad fruit by any chance?
Hi! Ms. Roget, the Appleton librarian, said she sold you some books about pirates recently.
Hello, I'm looking for a retired fisherman who used to live around here, you don't know who that might be, do you?
I'm completely brain dead lately, where did you send me again?
Thanks!  I was wondering if you have seen Trigger's Saddle Pad?
Thanks, I think I will!  Floria asked me to stop by and pick up that bolt of Cotton Damask she ordered.
I will, thanks. Do you happen to know of a supplier of lemons?
Thank you! I can only stay long enough to deliver this gift from Karee Dentin.
Hi there.  I'm trying to find a resident, or a former resident. Her name would have been either "Miss Knight" or "Miss Bishop."

chatpoints.chat_text: Great, thanks for asking. Is there anything I can help you find? Or are you just passing time?

replies.reply_text: Hmm... Not at the moment. Thank you, though.
You got it. Just passing some time.

chatpoints.chat_text: All right.  Thanks for picking my store to pass time in.

replies.reply_text: No problem. I'll see myself out when I'm ready.

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, if you are meaning price, then yes. Now, if you are meaning would they be useful? Absolutely, they can help you look up high in the trees or long distances. You never know when you might need them.

replies.reply_text: I meant price. I think everyone knows what binoculars are.

chatpoints.chat_text: (Her cheeks turn bright red, and she starts getting flustered.) Ah... um... yeah... you're right. Of course. Okay, then, umm, thanks for coming and uh... I need to get back to stocking.

replies.reply_text: Sorry, I didn't mean to embarrass you. You were very kind and helpful.
I think I'm going to take off now.

chatpoints.chat_text: (Still embarrassed.) Right. Thanks for coming.

replies.reply_text: Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: Great, thanks for asking.

replies.reply_text: Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: That is nice of you to say. I should be getting back to stocking the shelves now. Thanks for stopping in.

replies.reply_text: Sure. Have a good day.

chatpoints.chat_text: Why, yes it is, would you like one?

replies.reply_text: Yes, please.
Tempting, but no.
Thanks.
All right.  Thanks.

chatpoints.chat_text: Is this some kind of a joke?

replies.reply_text: (You quickly explain about Mino's anniversary surprise and the hummingbirds' need for protein.)

chatpoints.chat_text: Now I understand your problem. You need to ask at a food store, not a general store. Good luck!

replies.reply_text: Ohhhh. That makes sense. Thanks.

chatpoints.chat_text: All of the books she sold me are on the shelves over there. (She casually motions to her right.) I have them alphabetized by author. Take a look and let me know if you see anything you like.

replies.reply_text: (Looking over the shelves.) I don't see the books I'm looking for and Ms. Roget was sure she sold it to you.

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, let me check my receipts.  What was the name of the book?

replies.reply_text: It's a three book set called "The Pirates Own Book" by Charles Ellms.

chatpoints.chat_text: (Shuffling through a pile of receipts.) Pirates Own... Pirates Own... got it! Here... "The Pirates Own Book" set was sent to Skullton Antiquities, along with several other books about Pirates.

replies.reply_text: I didn't think Blythe Booty sold books.  I thought she only sold pirate plunder.
Okay, I'll check with her, then.  Thanks for the help!  Bye bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: You might want to try asking Mr. Fin; he knows all sorts of seafaring people.

replies.reply_text: Okay, thank you.

chatpoints.chat_text: I told you to go see Blythe Booty at Skullton Antiquities.  Geez, you sound like one of my Flipperton customers!

replies.reply_text: Oh, yeah, right.  Thanks.  See ya!

chatpoints.chat_text: Hmm...  I swear I may have...  It just escapes me.  Sorry.  Keep asking around.  I'm sure someone will know.

replies.reply_text: That's all right.  Thanks.
Thanks a lot!  And don't worry, I'll tell Floria about her next order.  Goodbye!

chatpoints.chat_text: Let me think...  Hmmm...  Pirates might have some.  Other than that, I don't know.  I don't have them.  Sorry.

replies.reply_text: Sounds good.  Thanks.
Nope, its just a gift. Enjoy!

chatpoints.chat_text: Knight... or Bishop... hmmm... There was a Miss Rook here for a while, but she moved long ago.  Iona is outside all the time, why not ask her?  She sees everyone.

replies.reply_text: Iona.  Okay, will do.  Thanks.

npc_list.name: Ruby Stonesthrow
npc_list.short_description: Owner of the Shellton Rock Shoppe

chatpoints.chat_text: (Looks up at your approach and smiles warmly.) Hello, welcome to my shop. How may I help you?

replies.reply_text: (Smiles in return.) Hello. Do you have any rare gems?
No thanks. Thank you anyways, though.
Have you seen a blue wacky arm tube guy thingy?

chatpoints.chat_text: Enjoy your day, then. Bye.

replies.reply_text: I will. You too.

chatpoints.chat_text: All of our stock comes from travelers like yourself. You could find anything ranging from the simple agates to the beautifully divine diamonds.

replies.reply_text: Oh, wow! I guess I'll have to keep my eyes out!

chatpoints.chat_text: What's a Blue Wacky thingy?

replies.reply_text: Oh well, nevermind then.

npc_list.name: Stella Styles
npc_list.short_description: Owner of Rachel's Boutique in Shellton
npc_list.long_description: Stella Styles is well dressed and carries herself with confidence. She would be a good fashion role model.

chatpoints.chat_text: Hello, may I help you?

replies.reply_text: I need a yellow dress...
Yes, you can! I need a red dress.
Do you have any green dresses?
Sure, if you have a purple dress for sale.
No thanks, I'm just browsing.
Yes, I need a yellow dress for Svea's sister.
Yes, you can! I need a red dress.
Hello, I'm looking for someone who can make me a... well, a hoop skirt.  For a play, you understand.
Have you seen a blue wacky inflatable arm tube guy thingy?

chatpoints.chat_text: A red dress! We just got a splendid one in today, for $300. Would you like to purchase it?

replies.reply_text: Yes, please! Rosemary at the inn was needing it.
Um... Not right now, actually.

chatpoints.chat_text: I'm sorry, we don't carry any dresses in that color. They would look dreadful and be totally unstylish! Haha!

replies.reply_text: Oh, drat... I guess I'll have to try something else.
Thank you! Rosemary will be so pleased! Not to mention Veronica. Bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: Let's see.  I have this yellow one.  I don't normally carry yellow dresses, but I do have this one.  It costs $700.

replies.reply_text: Great.  I'll take it.
Hmm...  I guess I don't have the money right now.  I'll go get some, then I'll be back.
All right.  Thanks.

chatpoints.chat_text: Wonderful choice!  I have a beautiful one right here.  It's $700.  Would you like to take it?

replies.reply_text: Sure.  That would be perfect.
Umm...  Let me go find some money, then I'll be back to get it.
All right.  Thanks.

chatpoints.chat_text: A hoop skirt?  Costumery is hardly my line.

replies.reply_text: Oh.  Then I probably shouldn't ask you for the Modern Major General's outfit, either.
Oh, never mind.  Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: Ah, a Savoyard, are we?  Well, I would love to help you, but I can't.

replies.reply_text: A what?  Well, can you recommend someone?

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, as it happens, I do know someone connected with the theatre.  Try Ethel Barryjam in Hotton.  I make dresses for her, you know, and she was once one of the great Shakespearean actresses of her day.  She may know someone.

replies.reply_text: I'll do that.  Thanks.  Goodbye.

chatpoints.chat_text: I'm sorry, I haven't seen anything that strange around here.

replies.reply_text: Okay, thanks.  I'll keep looking.

npc_list.name: Calla Lilly
npc_list.short_description: Sales Associate at La Fleur flower shop
npc_list.long_description: You can't help but notice that she is quite a looker. She must turn heads everywhere she goes. She doesn't talk much, but seems content to just smile and run her fingers through her hair.  The rumor is that she is not very good with product questions so don't expect a lot of advice, information or care instructions from her.

chatpoints.chat_text: Hello. ( Smiles at you, showing her perfect teeth. ) I'm Calla Lilly.

replies.reply_text: Hello. This is a lovely shop.
Um... Hello. I have to.. Um.. Go. Yea, that's it.  I have to go. Goodbye.
Hi!  Bailey over on Lilac Isle asked me to pick up the roses she ordered.
Hi Ms.Lilly!  I've got a delivery of seeds from Jack O'Lantern for you.
Hi.  Have you happened to see a blue waving arm guy thing around?

chatpoints.chat_text: Thank you.  It's my mother's. She's away at the moment though.

replies.reply_text: Oh. So you look over the shop when she's gone?
Oh. I'll come by later then.

chatpoints.chat_text: Yes. She's away a lot taking care of the elderly residents.

replies.reply_text: Aww. Thats really nice.

chatpoints.chat_text: All right. I'll talk to you later then. Have a nice day.

replies.reply_text: Thank you. You too. Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: Yep, I'm proud of her.(Smiles happily)

replies.reply_text: (Returns the smile.) I'm proud of her too, but I should go.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh. It was nice talking to you. Have a nice day. (Waves goodbye.)

replies.reply_text: Bye. (Waves back)
You're certainly right about how beautiful these roses are.  I'll get them right over to Bailey, thanks.

chatpoints.chat_text: The crates have dozens of flowers and plants that Jack uses to make his dyes and paints. I'm sure you're aware of how "green" our Jack is.

replies.reply_text: I knew he liked things to be natural, but I didn't realize how committed to the cause he was!
What's all this?

chatpoints.chat_text: And just in time, it's almost planting season and our customers have been asking me when we will get his seeds.

replies.reply_text: I didn't know his seeds were so popular.  Where should I put these?

chatpoints.chat_text: He's very committed.  Run along now, and tell Jack that the children around here can't wait to see his mask collection this year.

replies.reply_text: Okay, will do!  Bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: No, I'm sorry.  I haven't seen anything like that.

replies.reply_text: All right.  Thanks, though.

npc_list.name: Mathilda Emdee
npc_list.admin_description: New quests start at CP7

chatpoints.chat_text: Hello.  Can I help you?

replies.reply_text: No, just looking around.  Bye!
Is there anything I can do to help you?
Oh, Zuzz! I forgot what I was doing again. Can you please tell me?
I'm back from delivering the medicine to WildFire.
I hope so.  I'm looking for a white kitten.  Do you know of anybody who's cat may have had kittens recently?
Yep. Falcor has been sick for the past week and isn't showing any signs of getting better. Can you help him?
It would make my day if you can. I'm looking for a dentist.

chatpoints.chat_text: Actually, I do have a delivery that I need help with.

replies.reply_text: Okay, what do you need done?
Umm, maybe I can help some other time. See you.

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, I need some medicine taken to WildFire by the rock pile in the forest north of Appleton. Since he's been living on his own, we all have been keeping an eye on him to make sure that he is healthy and happy. If you could take it to him, I'd be very grateful.

replies.reply_text: Okay, I'd be happy to help.
I don't have time for this right now. I'll come by some other time.
You're welcome.

chatpoints.chat_text: Thank you for your help delivering the medicine to WildFire.  I hear that he is doing better now.

replies.reply_text: You're welcome, any time.
No problem!  Right now, however, I'm looking for a white kitten.  Do you know of anybody who's cat may have had kittens recently?
Happy to have helped. I'm hoping you can help me now. I'm looking for a dentist.

chatpoints.chat_text: You were delivering medicine to WildFire who lives by the rock pile in the forest north of Appleton.

replies.reply_text: Oh, I'll go and do that now.  See you later.
You're welcome, any time.

chatpoints.chat_text: I think... either the Inn or the barn has a cat that recently had kittens.  Go ask them.

replies.reply_text: Thanks, I will!  See ya!

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, Falcor's sick? That's awful! I think that's the first time he's been ill the entire time he and Atreyu have been here.

replies.reply_text: So can you help him? He's doing this funny part cough and part sneeze thing that's a little creepy-looking.

chatpoints.chat_text: No, I can't, unfortunately. Luckdragons don't seem to get sick very often, so it's just not feasible to keep medicine for them on hand.

replies.reply_text: That makes sense. I guess it's off to the other vets I go, then. See you later.

chatpoints.chat_text: You know, I heard about a dentist recently. Now where was it that she started her practice? Hmmm. Seems like it was one of the islands west of Horse Isle. Is that helpful, at all?

replies.reply_text: It sure is! Thanks so much.

npc_list.name: Claire Rayzor
npc_list.short_description: Owner/groomer of The Clip and Curl
npc_list.long_description: Claire Rayzor wears her hair in braids just like the ones she makes for the horses.

chatpoints.chat_text: Hello.  How are you?

replies.reply_text: Fine, thank you.  It's very clean in here.
Great, but I must be going.  Goodbye.
I was wondering if you might have some horsehair? I'm on an errand for Mino, and he's looking for bird nesting materials.
Have you seen a blue wacky arm tube guy thingy?

chatpoints.chat_text: You're welcome. Yes, we take pride in our store's cleanliness. Do you need anything?

replies.reply_text: Yeah.  Can you groom my horse?
No, thank you.  I was just looking.

chatpoints.chat_text: Yep. Do you have a dressage competition?

replies.reply_text: Yep.
Dressage competition?

chatpoints.chat_text: All right.  What horse do you need to be groomed?  Please select one.

replies.reply_text: Okay.  Thank you.

chatpoints.chat_text: It's a competition on Horse Isle that judges your horse's movement and groom.

replies.reply_text: Oh, what town is it in?
Oh all right.  Thanks for the info.

chatpoints.chat_text: Treeton.  It's north of here.

replies.reply_text: Oh. Okay.  I'll go check that out.  Thanks.

chatpoints.chat_text: No problem.  Come back soon.

replies.reply_text: I will. Thank you.

chatpoints.chat_text: Of course. I heard about Mino's surprise for Lelu. That couple is so cute! Hang on just a minute, and I'll get you some.

replies.reply_text: Okay.
Thank you so much! I'm sure Mino will be pleased. Bye now.

chatpoints.chat_text: I don't even know what that is, so I don't think I have!

replies.reply_text: It's got arms and it's wacky... and... Oh well, thanks anyways.

npc_list.name: Rosemary Sleepytime
npc_list.admin_description: &  New Quests must begin at CP9
npc_list.long_description: Rosemary Sleepytime is wearing a green sweater and beige pants.

chatpoints.chat_text: Well hello, dear! How do you like Turtle Isle?

replies.reply_text: It's great! Everything is so pretty here. Does much happen here, though?
Ehh... it's all right, but I can't enjoy it much. I'm tired and hungry.
Oh, it's very nice. Actually, I think I'll go back out and get some fresh air. Bye!
It's nice. Actually, I'm looking for someone who might sell me a copper-bottomed stock pot. Since you run an inn, I thought perhaps...
I'm sure it's great, but I'm here because Dr. Emdee said she thought your cat recently had kittens.  Would you possibly have an all-white kitten in that litter?
Have you seen a blue wacky inflatable arm tube guy thingy?
Hi there, Rosemary.  Say, I have something of an odd request, if you've got a moment.
Good day, Rosemary.  I'm looking for a roofer named Olav, I believe he might be staying here...
Sorry to bother you again, Rosemary, but where did you say Olav went when he left here?
I love Turtle Isle, thanks for asking! I noticed you have a raging fire going. Could I have some of the wood ash from it?

chatpoints.chat_text: All the time.  In fact, there's something going on in town right now!  It's Veronica's birthday.

replies.reply_text: Oh, cool! Are you getting her a present?
I should go wish her a happy birthday, then. See you!

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, dear! Well, you've come to the right place- we have some very delicious meals, and some rest options as well. You'll feel right as rain in no time!

replies.reply_text: Your inn does seem quite cozy. Thanks!

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, I know exactly what I want to get Veronica.  A nice new dress!  She'd like that, I think.  The only trouble is she's so particular about what she wears, and I'm not sure what her favorite color is.

replies.reply_text: I could ask her for you, if you'd like.
Oh well, it's the thought that counts, right? Nice chatting with you! Bye.
No problem! I'll be right back.

chatpoints.chat_text: Hello again! Have you talked to Veronica yet?

replies.reply_text: Yep! She said her favourite colour was red.
No, not yet.
Thanks! Is there anything else I can help you with?
Yum, a cookie. Thanks Rosemary! Bye now.

chatpoints.chat_text: Please try to hurry.  I don't want to miss her birthday!

replies.reply_text: Don't worry, I will!

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, I do have a bit of a dilemma. You see, I need to go to Rachel's Boutique to get the red dress for Veronica, but I can't leave my inn.

replies.reply_text: I can pick it up for you!
Oh, well I hope you find some way to get it. Goodbye!

chatpoints.chat_text: Hello again! Thanks for helping me out with Veronica's birthday present.

replies.reply_text: You're welcome! Need anything else?
It was no problem. Bye now!
You're welcome! Did Veronica like the dress?
You're very welcome. By the way,  I'm looking for someone who might sell me a copper-bottomed stock pot. Since you run an inn, I thought perhaps...
It was nothing.  I'm here this time because Dr. Emdee said she thought your cat recently had kittens.  Would you possibly have an all-white kitten in that litter?
Have you seen a blue wacky arm tube guy thingy?
Hi there, Rosemary.  Say, I have something of an odd request, if you've got a moment.
Good day, Rosemary.  I'm looking for a roofer named Olav.  I believe he might be staying here...
Sorry to bother you again, Rosemary, but where did you say Olav went when he left here?
I love Turtle Isle, thanks for asking! I noticed you have a raging fire going. Could I have some of the wood ash from it?
I'll be back soon with the dress! Bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: Did you manage to get the dress yet?

replies.reply_text: I did! Stella said that it was very stylish.
Not yet... See, I kind of... spent that money you gave me.
Where did I have to go again?
Oh, not yet. I'll get right on it!
Thanks Rosemary! I'll see you later!

chatpoints.chat_text: You what? Oh, dear... Well, maybe if you play one of the mini-games here you can make the money up again. I'm afraid I don't have any left!

replies.reply_text: I'll go do that... Sorry.

chatpoints.chat_text: Rachel's Boutique.  It's here in Shellton, not far away at all.  Just talk to Stella and see if they have any red dresses in stock.

replies.reply_text: Oh, I remember now. I'll be back soon!

chatpoints.chat_text: She adored it! It was just what she wanted. And she was so surprised! Thank you again for all your help, you're a real sweetheart.

replies.reply_text: Aww, it was fun. I'll see you later!

chatpoints.chat_text: I'm sorry, my stock pot isn't for sale.

replies.reply_text: Would you happen to know where I could buy one?

chatpoints.chat_text: I sure don't. This was handed down from my grandmother. A good stock pot is hard to find.

replies.reply_text: So I've come to learn. Thanks for your time. Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: (Laughing quietly.) That Mathilda is working too hard! She thought my Prince Vigor had kittens? Fathered them maybe, he's a tom. Can't help you, sorry!

replies.reply_text: Well, I guess there are no kittens here, then!  I'll keep looking, thanks!

chatpoints.chat_text: I'm sorry, but I'm much too busy to see anything that wacky!

replies.reply_text: Thanks anyways and I'm sorry to bother you.

chatpoints.chat_text: An odd request, eh?  Well, maybe.  Let's hear it.

replies.reply_text: Uhm... nevermind, it's way too odd.  I think I'll get back to this some other time.  Bye.
(You explain Max's request for a "hotel pillow" -- preferably one with the name of the hotel on it!)

chatpoints.chat_text: (Listening to your story, Rosemary nearly falls over laughing!) A ferret would prefer a hotel pillow to a dragon eggshell? Oh, for... hahahahahahaha, here, I'll tell you what! (Rosemary runs off to an upstairs room.)

replies.reply_text: (You tap your foot while waiting.)
(You sing, "I Am The Very Model of a Modern Major General" while waiting.)
(You recite, "I wandered, lonely as a cloud..." while waiting.)
(You fall asleep while waiting.)

chatpoints.chat_text: Here you go! (Rosemary is still chuckling.) A nice new pillow! Thanks, I needed a good laugh today! And I don't have my pillows embroidered, so there's no name, but I'll tell you what. Hand me that pen, will you? Now, what was the ferret's name again?

replies.reply_text: Here you go.  His name is Max.
Aww, thanks!  I hope he'll like it.  Thanks a lot!  Bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: Olav?  Sure, he stayed here while he was putting a new roof on Jayne's place.  Jayne would only let the best work on his house. He left after he finished the job.

replies.reply_text: I missed him again?!  I don't suppose you know where he went after he left here, do you?
Thanks, I'm off to Appleton.  I hope he's still there!  Bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: I told you that he got a job in Appleton.  Check at the inn there.

replies.reply_text: Oh yeah, I forgot.  Thanks again!

chatpoints.chat_text: Goodness! Seems like I'm suddenly getting a ton of requests for wood ash. I gave away my last bit of ash just moments ago.

replies.reply_text: Seriously? I am so bummed! Okay. I'll go check somewhere else.

npc_list.name: Lucy Reins
npc_list.long_description: Lucy Reins is a good looking lady with a good knowledge of Tack.

chatpoints.chat_text: Uh...  Hi...  Um...  What may I help you with?

replies.reply_text: I was just looking around.
Why are you chasing mice?
Why is your tack so expensive?
Hi.  I've come on behalf of Sumiko Stallman.  She's setting up a new Riding for the Handicapped center and needs some things.
Was I supposed to be running an errand for you?  I'm afraid I can't remember.
I'm glad to see you aren't chasing mice anymore.
Why are you chasing mice?
I have a cat for you!

chatpoints.chat_text: All right.  Let me know if you need anything.

replies.reply_text: I will. Thanks.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, I can't stand the things.  They always seem to get in, somehow.  No matter what I do.

replies.reply_text: Hmm...  Anything I can do to help?
I don't like them much, either.  I think I'll be going.

chatpoints.chat_text: No, not really...  Let me know if you need some help picking out tack, though.

replies.reply_text: All right.  Good luck.
I was kind of wondering why your tack was so expensive.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, I only sell the best tack.  It's especially good for dressage events.  They will help you win at the arena in Treeton.

replies.reply_text: That's neat.  I may need to save up my money in order to get it, though.
Well, that's crazy expensive.  I suppose I'll be going now.

chatpoints.chat_text: That's understandable.  If everyone could afford it, it wouldn't be special, now would it?

replies.reply_text: I suppose not.  Thanks!

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, yeah.  Her and everyone else.  What does she need?

replies.reply_text: Used things, that maybe people have given you in trade?  Halters with leads, and childrens' sized saddles.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh. Nope, nothing like that here. I don't keep it, I send it all to Earton.  You might try there.

replies.reply_text: I will!  Thanks!

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, I can't stand the things.  They always seem to get in, somehow.  No matter what I do.  And every time they startle me, I jump on a chair!  Or a table.  Or sometimes a customer.  Anything to get away from those mice!

replies.reply_text: I hope you, um, find a solution.  Let me leave before you wind up jumping on me.
Wow... They're just little furry animals.  Have they always upset you this much?

chatpoints.chat_text: They only make me so nervous because I hear them when I'm in here alone.  I love animals in general.  Wait, that's the solution!

replies.reply_text: Well, I'm happy I could help!  I'm going to leave before you send me on any errands.
I'm afraid I don't understand what you mean.

chatpoints.chat_text: A cat!  A good cat that could scare away the mice and keep me company, too!  Oh, can you find me a good cat?

replies.reply_text: I'm sorry, I don't have time now. And I think perhaps I'm allergic. Yes *achoo!* I'm sneezing just at the thought. Good luck finding your cat.
Sure, I can stop at the pet store for you.
All right.  I'll remember that.  Bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: Yes, you were going to check the pet stores and find me a cat.   To keep me company and chase away the mice, remember?

replies.reply_text: I remember now.  I'll keep working on that, then.

chatpoints.chat_text: Nope!  My good cat keeps them all away.  And with him around, noises don't scare me anymore.  Well, maybe sometimes they do.  But I haven't jumped on a customer in days.

replies.reply_text: That's good to hear.  I still don't want to be jumped on though, so perhaps I'll leave now.

chatpoints.chat_text: Thank you so much!  Which store had him?

replies.reply_text: Actually, he's from the cat pack on Cat Isle.
Glad to be able to help.

chatpoints.chat_text:
And would you believe it? There it was! Huge and blue and sparkly and just... You can't imagine! But I saw it with my own eyes! It was THIS BIG, honest! And I'll never forget it!
(The crowd ooohs and aaahs and chatters amongst themselves.)

replies.reply_text: What was it?  Sorry, I came late...
Excuse me for interrupting, Mr. Bronze, but Grey Slate recommended you to me...
Mr. Bronze, you wanted 10 iron ores and a honeycomb?
Mr. Bronze, hello!  I came to get some stuff for ... an acquaintance.
You wanted ten chunks of copper ore for the armatures. Here you go.
Excuse me, but I'm here with a proposition for you.
Here's the $5,000.
Sorry to interupt, Mr Bronze, but could you possibly repair this brass bell?
Sorry to interupt, Mr Bronze, but could you possibly repair this brass bell

chatpoints.chat_text:
(Earl Bronze's eyes widen!) Well, you see it was like this--
Customer: Oh, don't get started again, Earl! Take care of your paying customers first!
Earl Bronze: All right, all right. Now, what do you need?

replies.reply_text: I have these plans that Vern made for a building set for Whystan's grandchildren.  Can you make these doors?
Oh, nothing, sorry.  I was just curious about your story.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh!  Let me see that.  Why, sure, I can make these!  Easy, easy!  And... ooo!  You've got horse stalls, too?  Why, they need iron grates so the horses can see each other, but not bite each other.  Well, not easily!  Yes, I can make those, sure!

replies.reply_text: How much will it cost me?

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh!  And I could make some coping strips to make the buildings nice and flat on the top, in case you want to see inside and not have a roof!

replies.reply_text: Uhm, Mr. Bronze...

chatpoints.chat_text: And railings for front steps!  Gotta have those, the building code requires 'em, you know!

replies.reply_text: Yes, whatever you want to make is fine, Mr. Bronze, but how much is it going to cost?
No thanks, this is getting out of hand.  Goodbye, I'll try elsewhere.
I see.  Okay, I'll go round that stuff up for you.

chatpoints.chat_text: Yup, that's what I needed.  Have you got it with you?

replies.reply_text: Not yet.  Just wanted to make sure that's what you wanted.  I'll go get it now.
Here it is!
You've got them already?  I thought you needed the things I brought to you in order to make them.
Thanks!  Bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, no.  I should have said, I guess.  I just wanted the things you brought to replace the stock I used to make these.  Thank you very kindly for bringing it!

replies.reply_text: You're welcome,  and thank you for making the parts so quickly!   Do you know anyone who would be good at making the windows out of glass?
Thanks a lot!  Goodbye, now!

chatpoints.chat_text: Hmmm, now let me think...  Oh!  Yes, there's a lady up in Chillton who does glass work.  Can't remember her name, though.

replies.reply_text: Thanks!  Bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: Ah, did you now!  You must be one of those questing types!  What can I do for... whoever?

replies.reply_text: I'm not sure exactly what she wants, but here is a drawing.  Can you make these?
You mean, you don't have the ores? (You look around and see that the place is just brimming with chunks of ore.)
Okay, I'll go get those for you.  I'll be back in awhile.
As it happens, I just happen to have 10 chunks right here.

chatpoints.chat_text: Yeah, I do. And once I make these here little items, I'm going to have that much less so, if you want this stuff, I want 10 chunks of copper ore and that's the way it is.

replies.reply_text: Well, if it's what you want, it's what you want.  I'll go get them and be back.
Okay. Ten chunks of copper ore. (Root around in your pack.) Here you are.
Here you are.
What?!  I just brought you ores!
Sorry, I don't have that much on me.  I'll be right back.

chatpoints.chat_text: (The crowd in the smithy gives a hearty collective chuckle.) That was to replenish my stock, not for my hard and, I'll have you know, talented labor! $5,000 or I keep it as a warning to others. (The crowd gives loud guffaws at this!)

replies.reply_text: You think I'm an idiot, don't you?
Oh, all right, here. (Put $5,000 on the counter.)
That makes sense, I guess.  As they say, "The laborer is worthy of his hire."  Here you are.

chatpoints.chat_text: No, but I might think you're someone who wants stuff on the cheap!

replies.reply_text: Fine. Here. (Put money on counter.)
Not cheap, just not overpriced! But I realize the parts are small, and I''m sure your talent is worth it. Here you go.
Thanks.  See you around!

chatpoints.chat_text: You have a proposition for me?  Let's have it.

replies.reply_text: Iona, over in Flipperton, is holding a Founder's Day Crafts Festival.  She's heard about your copperwork and wants to know if you'd like to display it.  Here's your Invitation.
I'll be sure to tell Iona that you'll be attending.  Goodbye!

chatpoints.chat_text: I could, but I won't. I just started work on a huge project and I just won't have the time for that! (points at the bell) I think there's a fellow on the mainland who might help you. Can't remember his name though.

replies.reply_text: Oh, okay, guess I'll just keep looking.  Bye!

npc_list.name: Amelia Hays
npc_list.short_description: Owner of the Shellton Feed Store
npc_list.long_description: Amelia Hays is a friendly and informed sales person. She is dressed in jeans and a flannel shirt. if you have questions then she has the answers.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, hello.  Need any help with anything?

replies.reply_text: Nope.  Just looking.  Thank you.
Yes.  What do you think is probably the best feed?
Why yes, actually, Murray sent me to pick up (You check the list.) 3 large sacks of hydrated lime.
Hiya! I hope you don't mind me mentioning but... you do seem to have something of a mouse problem.
Hi.  Uhm... what was I getting for you again?
I have returned with the fixings for Waldorf Salad!
Okay, I found the grapes!
Celery and mayo!

chatpoints.chat_text: Hay is the cheapest and filling to a horse.

replies.reply_text: Oh.  Why are oats a lot more expensive?
All right.  Thank you.
What about pitted horse dates?

chatpoints.chat_text: Anytime.  Come again.

replies.reply_text: I will, thanks.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oats are expensive but much more filling.  Fills a horse right up.

replies.reply_text: Oh.  All right.

chatpoints.chat_text: Pitted dates are a treat that fills a horse and makes them happy.

replies.reply_text: Oh okay.  Thanks.

chatpoints.chat_text: Have a nice day then.

replies.reply_text: Yep.  You too.

chatpoints.chat_text: I see.  It must be whitewash season again!

replies.reply_text: Yep!  And he needs the lime as soon as possible, but why hydrated lime?
Oh, is that why he uses the hydrated lime?  Well, I'll get this back to him.  Thanks!

chatpoints.chat_text: (Turns around and back.) Oh, you mean Betty and the Twins? Nah, they're all right. They only eat Waldorf Salads.

replies.reply_text: Well, at least they have taste.  Good day to you.
Waldorf Salad?  What's that?

chatpoints.chat_text: Waldorf Salad.  It's named after a hotel on an isle far, far away.  It's celery, apples, walnuts and grapes, with a mayonnaise dressing.

replies.reply_text: Eww.  They can have it then.  I'll just have a look around.
Celery, apples, walnuts, grapes.  I'll be right back!

chatpoints.chat_text: I beg your pardon?

replies.reply_text: Celery, app... oh, I'm sorry, I thought you were giving me a quest.
Oh... uhm... never mind, I'll just go read all the labels on the feed bags.  Good day.

chatpoints.chat_text: I see... well, I hadn't thought of that, but, you know I am extremely busy and if you could get me the makings I'd be very, very grateful.

replies.reply_text: Oh, I'd be happy to do it for you.  I know where to get apples and walnuts.  Where do you usually get your celery?
Wait... it's not a quest, heh-heh, it's just a conversation.  Well, I think I'll sign off before it turns into one.  See you!
Two each apples, celery, walnuts, grapes--I assume you mean a bunch--and a jar of mayonnaise.  Gotcha!  I'll be back as soon as I can.
I don't know, I think I'll pass on this one.  Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: Waldorf Salad!  Celery, apples, walnuts, grapes!

replies.reply_text: Oh right!  Where was I supposed to get the mayo and celery?
Waldorf Salad.  Gotcha. Back soon.

chatpoints.chat_text: I get the celery in Hotton.  The mayo you should be able to get right here in town.

replies.reply_text: Okay, thanks.

chatpoints.chat_text: Excellent!  Okay, let's see.  Do you have the apples and walnuts?  Two of each?

replies.reply_text: You bet!  Here you go!
Oh... no, I forgot about those.  I'll be right back.
Oh, rats, I forgot.  Be right back.
Lovely grapes!  Here you are.
Celery and mayonnaise.  Right here.
Oh... no, I forgot about those.  I'll be right back.
I hope they enjoy it!  Thanks!  Good-bye!

npc_list.name: Phoebe Wares
npc_list.short_description: Owner of the Shellton General Store
npc_list.long_description: Phoebe Wares looks crabby today. She is wearing jeans and a red and white checkered flannel shirt that is very raggedy.

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, hello there.  What may I help you with?

replies.reply_text: Mr. Tuttle sent me to pick something up for him.  He said you would know what he needs.
Nope.  Just looking around.  Thanks.
Hello, do you sell paint?
Hi. Hazel sent me with some hazelnuts to be delivered to you.
I'm pretty sure you can't help me, but I'll ask anyway. I need some old fruit. Would you have any?
Hi! Ms. Bibliophile, the librarian, said she thinks she sold you some books about pirates recently.
Have you seen a blue wacky inflatable arm tube guy thingy?
Would you happened to have any colorful tissue paper for sale?
Hi there, Phoebe! Could you order lemons for me, please?
I was wondering if you have paraffin wax.
Hello, I hear you sell mayonnaise.

chatpoints.chat_text: I was starting to wonder where he was.  I'll go get the box for you.

replies.reply_text: All right.
Oh wait, I have something I need to do.  I'll be right back.
I guess so.  Thanks.

chatpoints.chat_text: No.  No paint, sorry.  Don't know anybody who sells paint, unfortunately.

replies.reply_text: Oh well.  Thanks anyway.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, yes, I had discussed getting some from her.  Thank you for bringing them.

replies.reply_text: You're welcome.  Hazel really needed the help getting all the deliveries made and I was glad to help out.
I will, thanks.

chatpoints.chat_text: Don't make me throw you out of here! What a crazy question.

replies.reply_text: Sorry!

chatpoints.chat_text: Yes, she sent me a batch of books, but there weren't any books about pirates among them.

replies.reply_text: Sorry to have bothered you. Bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: I'm sorry, I have no idea what you're talking about.

replies.reply_text: Thanks anyways.

chatpoints.chat_text: Gosh, I sure don't. Have you tried Trayja? She makes paper.

replies.reply_text: No, I haven't. I'll go talk to her now. Thanks!

chatpoints.chat_text: Gosh. You are like the 4th person today that has asked me for lemons! I'm going to need to find a supplier for them. But for now, the answer is no, I can't order them. So sorry!

replies.reply_text: Darn. Okay. Thanks.

chatpoints.chat_text: I should. Let me see... (Disappears in the back for a minute.) Yep! Here it is. That will cost $500.

replies.reply_text: Here you are.
Off to the bank I go, I guess.
Thanks!

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh!  Looking for fixings for Waldorf Salad, are you!  Well, fear not!   Mayonnaise I have.

replies.reply_text: How did you know it was for Waldorf Salad?
Fabulous!  How much for a jar of mayo?

chatpoints.chat_text: Are you kidding?  Do you know what mayonnaise is made of?  Waldorf Salad is the only excuse for its existence!

replies.reply_text: Okay, you've got a point there.  How much for a jar of mayo?
No, what's in it?

chatpoints.chat_text: It's a mixture of oil, egg yolk, and vinegar.  Mostly oil.  Churns my stomach just thinking about it.

replies.reply_text: Eeeeeeewwww... Oh well, it's not for me anyway.  How much for one jar?
Yeah, but put them all together, and they're delicious!   How much for one jar?
No thanks, I think I've just changed my mind.  Bye.
$1500.  Here you go.
Hunh.  I don't have that much on me.  I'll be back.
Thanks!

npc_list.name: Sasha Stocker
npc_list.long_description: Sasha Stocker is quite young to be a store owner. She has red hair and high energy.

chatpoints.chat_text: Hullo there.  What can I do for ya?

replies.reply_text: I need Dalton's medicine.
I don't need anything.  Bye.
I'm back, Sasha!  Lars told me to give this to you.
Hi. The Easter Bunny has sent me to get some chocolate icing.
I'm looking for fruit that isn't quite fresh. Mino wants some.
Hi there.  I need a box of party favors, and I was told this is the best place to get them.
Hi there. I was wondering if you could special order some indigo dye for Trudy?
Hello there!  I was hoping you stocked colorful tissue paper.
Would you by any chance have lemons?
Hello Sasha. I'm here on behalf of Ira. He ordered a set of utensils that I need to pick up.

chatpoints.chat_text: Old Dalton sent cha here, did he?

replies.reply_text: Yes, he did.
No.  I was just looking.

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, I have the medicine all ready to go.  Before I give it to ya though, would ya mind running this here sandwich over to Lars, the blacksmith?

replies.reply_text: Sure thing!
No.  See you later.
I'll be back in a jiffy.
I'll be sure to hurry back to Dalton!
I won't.  Goodbye.

chatpoints.chat_text: Mino's got something up his sleeve, huh? Wish I could help, but I can't. Try Minnie. She runs the food store here.

replies.reply_text: Thanks for the tip. Bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: Party favors... party favors... party... (She rummages around behind the counter and finally takes out a very old, dust-covered box.) This is all I've ever had in the way of party favors, and really, I doubt whatever's in here is very fashionable these days. Do you want it anyway? Are you buying it for yourself?

replies.reply_text: Oh, no.  I was sent here by a little old lady.  I guess that will do.  How much?
No thanks, I think I'll hold out for something more fashionable.  Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, it's so old... $100.

replies.reply_text: Excellent.  Here you go!
No thanks!  I'm not paying that much for anything so old and dusty!  Bye!
I'll get these back to Rain Isle right away, thanks!

chatpoints.chat_text: Well doesn't that just beat all? I happen to have some in stock. It must be your lucky day. Wait right here and I'll get it for you.

replies.reply_text: I'll do just that! (You wait patiently while Sasha goes into her storage room at the rear of the store.)
Waiting. Waiting. Waiting! And since I'm the impatient type, I think I'll just leave now!
(You do a little tap dance. You sing a little tune. You play patty cake with yourself. Finally, you just leave.)
Thanks a ton, and have a great day!

chatpoints.chat_text: Ohhh! Sounds like a party in the making! But I can't help you there. Why don't you talk to someone who makes paper.

replies.reply_text: Gosh. Why didn't I think of that? Thanks!

chatpoints.chat_text: Sure don't. But rumor has it there's a stash on Pirate Isle.

replies.reply_text: Oh! Great tip! Have a super day!

chatpoints.chat_text: It's so great Ira is finally back from his vacation. It seemed like he was gone for years! Here's the set. I added some ribbons since Ira said this was a thank you gift. (There must be at least a dozen ribbons tied to the crock holding the utensil set. Sasha may have gone a wee bit overboard!)

replies.reply_text: Wow! The ribbons certainly add a festive touch. I'm sure Ira will appreciate your extra efforts. (Surprisingly - or maybe not - Sasha suddenly blushes.) Thanks so much and have a great day.

npc_list.name: Max Attire
npc_list.long_description: Easy-going and expansive, Max Attire is as perfectly at home in his shop as it is possible to be.

chatpoints.chat_text: Hello, may I help you?

replies.reply_text: Delivery from the Pony Express!
No, thank you. I'm just looking.
Nah, not really. But maybe I can help you. I'm looking for jobs.  Got anything a traveler can do to earn a few bucks?
Hi there... What was the title of that book you wanted again?

Okay, I went to the library, and she said that as far as she knows, the author hasn't finished the book yet.  Or if she has, she hasn't published it.  At any rate, it's not in the library yet.  Here's your card back.
Hi!  Got your book!
Have a nice day!
Fruit bats... Okay, I'll be right back.

chatpoints.chat_text: "Our Friend, the Fruit Bat."

replies.reply_text: Right.  I'll be back.

chatpoints.chat_text: I refuse to accept it!

replies.reply_text: What?!

chatpoints.chat_text: I want the book!  And I shall have the book!  I shall not receive that library card unto mine hands again until it is accompanied by the book I have chosen!

replies.reply_text: (Back away slowly until you reach the door, then run!)
But--

chatpoints.chat_text: Please go to Flo and see if she knows when and where I can get a copy.

replies.reply_text: (Sigh.) Fine, where is she?
Okay, okay, I'll be back.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, do you?  Let's see!

replies.reply_text: Here you are, and here's your library card back.
Thanks!  Enjoy your book!

chatpoints.chat_text: She's in Appleton, at the flower shop, where else?

replies.reply_text: Appleton?!  I was just there!  Oh, well, I'll be back.

chatpoints.chat_text: Yes, in fact. A new book has just come out that I'm keen to read: Our Friend, the Fruit Bat. Would you be able to run to the library to get it for me?

replies.reply_text: Sure!  Which library?
Scratch that.  Libraries freak me out.  Sorry.

npc_list.name: Dewey Waders
npc_list.long_description: Dewey Waders is a man living his dream. He spends his work hours talking about fishing and his evenings and weekends fishing.

chatpoints.chat_text: Why, hello there!  How may I help you?

replies.reply_text: Could you make me a fishing pole?
Could you fry some fish for me?
I don't need anything now.  Thanks.
I don't really need anything myself. Just looking around. These fishing lures you have on display are awesome.
Actually, I was wondering if you could send me to Loch Isle again?
Package delivery!
I need help finding a woman named Patience. I believe she wanted to go fishing. Has she been by here?
Dewey package delivery - delete this reply when it goes live.

chatpoints.chat_text: Sure.  I'll just need $100 and a strong, skinny stick.

replies.reply_text: All right.  Here ya go.
I don't have a strong skinny stick..  Where can I find one?
Guess I don't have what you need right now.  Maybe I'll be back later.
All right.  Thanks.

chatpoints.chat_text: There should be some in the forests.  Just wander around some.

replies.reply_text: Neat.  Thanks.

chatpoints.chat_text: Sure thing!  I'll have it done in a jiffy.  It does cost $5 for little fish, $10 for normal fish, and $20 for big fish.

replies.reply_text: Okay.  Here's a little fish.
Okay.  Here's a normal fish.
Okay.  Here's a big fish.
Oh.  Ummm, nevermind.  Bye.
All right.  I have another little fish.
Here's a normal fish.
Here's a big fish.
That's all for now.  Bye.
All right.  I have  another normal fish.
Here's a little fish.
Here's a big fish.
That's all for now.  Bye.
All right.  I have another big fish.
Here's a little fish.
Here's a normal fish.
That's all for now.  Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: Thankee. I make 'em all meself, right here. People from all over Horse Isle order my special lures. In fact, I've gotten swamped with deliveries lately. You look like the agile type. Don't suppose you'd be willing to make a special delivery for me?

replies.reply_text: I'm not really that agile. Maybe someone else can help you. Bye!
Well, sure. I've got a little time, I can help you out. Who do they go to?

chatpoints.chat_text: Go ahead and give them to Davy on Loch Isle. He likes to take his grandfather fishing. Now there's a true angler, Sam is!

replies.reply_text: That sounds kinda far. Maybe I'll pass after all.
Okay, but... how do I get there?

chatpoints.chat_text: I'll send you there. No need to come back when you're done. Thanks for the help!

replies.reply_text: Thank you. I might just head out and do some fishing!

chatpoints.chat_text: Don't recall someone by that name. Sorry I can't help you.

replies.reply_text: Thanks anyway.

npc_list.name: Lars Temper
npc_list.long_description: Lars Temper is a hard working, older man that doesn't hear well.

chatpoints.chat_text: Why, hullo there!  What can I do for ya?

replies.reply_text: Sasha wanted me to give this sandwich to you.
I don't need anything now. Thanks.
I think I need some horse shoes for my horses.
Cedric needs a new blade made for his axe.
Murray sent me.  He needs 2 kegs of nails for the fences.
Hi Lars!  I'm back with the iron ore!
Good day to you, Lars! I was wondering if you could help me with this (You hold out the bell and clapper)
Hi Lars!  I was wondering, do you work with brass by any chance?
Okay.

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, you've come to the right place.  I sell steel and iron shoes.  Just pick whichever you want for you horse, and I'll put them on for ya.

replies.reply_text: All right, thanks.

chatpoints.chat_text: Eh?  Why does he need a new axe blade?  What happened to the old one?

replies.reply_text: Well, he lost his axe in the snow.  All we could find was the handle, so he asked me to come to you so you could make him a new one.

chatpoints.chat_text: I see.  Well, give the handle here.  I don't usually make blades, but I'll see what I can do.

replies.reply_text: Here you go.

chatpoints.chat_text: There!  Good as new.  You tell that Cedric to be more careful with that thing.

replies.reply_text: I will Sir.  Thank you so much!

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, it's fence-mending time again?  Poor Murray.

replies.reply_text: He does seem a tad overworked about now.  How much do you want for the nails?

chatpoints.chat_text: I'll tell you what, I'll give Murray the nails free and clear, if you will bring me 50 pieces of iron ore to replace the ore I used making the nails.  Deal?

replies.reply_text: That sounds like a good deal. I'll be back as soon as I have all the iron ore.
No way.  That was not part of the deal.  He'll have to figure this out himself.  Bye!
Thanks a lot, I'm sure Murray will appreciate this.  Bye!
I'll be back as soon as I have all the iron ore.

chatpoints.chat_text: Sorry, can't help you this time.  I'm a traditionalist, I only work with iron or steel.  Besides, I can't think of anyone who does work with brass.

replies.reply_text: That's okay, I just figured I'd ask.  Thanks anyway!

chatpoints.chat_text: Good day!  Can I help you?  Are all your animals feeling well?

replies.reply_text: They're all fine, thank you!
Oh, everyone is fine, but I need your help with something else.
Sorry, I forgot... Where am I going again?
Hi Nora, I'm back!
As far as I know they are. However, Atreyu's friend, Falcor, has been sick for the past week and isn't showing any signs of getting better. Can you help him?
They sure are! Thanks for asking. By the way, would you happen to know a dentist you could recommend?

chatpoints.chat_text: How can I be of assistance?

replies.reply_text: Do you know if any of the cats around here have had kittens lately?

chatpoints.chat_text: As a matter of fact, my cat, Frosty, recently had kittens.  Why do you ask?

replies.reply_text: Jack O'Lantern sent me to find a white kitten for a friend of his.  The catch is, for whatever reason, I can't buy the kitten.  I can barter or trade for it, but I can't buy it.

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, you may be in luck.  Frosty had three calicos, one all black, and one all white kitten.  I still have one of the calicos and the white kitten.

replies.reply_text: Great, what do you want for it?

chatpoints.chat_text: You could pick up a couple of orders I placed for the office.  Do that for me and the kitten is yours.

replies.reply_text: No problem!  Where am I going?
I don't actually have time now.  I'll stop by later.  Bye!
That's Shellton and Wington.  I'm on it!  Bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: I asked you to go to Ollie's Pet Shop in Shellton, and Kay's Pet Shop in Wington, remember?

replies.reply_text: Uh, yeah, that's right, Ollie and Kay.  I'm on my way!
Thanks, he's adorable!  I'm sure he's going to a good home.  Bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, I've seen those two flying around offshore before. It's sad that Falcor isn't feeling well. Unfortunately, I can't help. Luckdragons aren't very common, so medicine for them isn't in very high demand. I'm afraid you'll have to ask elsewhere.

replies.reply_text: I had a feeling you'd say that. Goodbye.

chatpoints.chat_text: If there were several dentists around, that would be an option. But as far as I know, there's only one. Although rumor has it that she is excellent! But where she practices, I haven't a clue.

replies.reply_text: Darn. Okay, thanks anyways.

chatpoints.chat_text: Hello there!

replies.reply_text: Hi.
Hi. Actually, I need to leave. Sorry.
Hello.  I've just come from Sumiko Stallman in Appleton.  She asked me to ask around for some old supplies you could donate, or sell cheaply.
Hello!  I was doing something for you, right?
Hi.  I am back from giving Colina her package.

chatpoints.chat_text: What can I do you for?

replies.reply_text: Nothing, thanks. Just looking.
You have so many saddles to choose from. It's overwhelming. How do I pick one?
You have quite the nice shop here.  Anything you need done?  Polishing saddles or an errand or something?

chatpoints.chat_text: Yes, I do carry a wide range of saddles. The best advice I can give you is to take a peek at the saddle descriptions that the library offers you.

replies.reply_text: Thanks, that's good advice. I think I'll go there now. Bye.
Why can't you just tell me which one to buy?

chatpoints.chat_text: Okay. Just holler if you need some help. And... if not, then thanks for stopping by.

replies.reply_text: Will do.  Thanks.

chatpoints.chat_text: Different strokes for different folks. Listen, I could tell you, but it would take a while and you are going to need some time to think about which one suits you best. Again, my advice is to do some research at the library. It's free and worth it.

replies.reply_text: No thanks.
All right, I guess I'll go check it out. Thanks and goodbye.

chatpoints.chat_text: Don't sweat it. Maybe I'll see ya again sometime.

replies.reply_text: Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: You have wonderful timing!  I was needing to make a special delivery, but didn't know when I would be able to get out to do it.

replies.reply_text: Well, I'm a pro at deliveries!  What do you need me to deliver?
A delivery?  You know what, I'm actually a little busier than I thought.  Maybe I'll come by later.

chatpoints.chat_text: You're going to have to go to Lava Isle.  Can you do that?

replies.reply_text: You bet!
Not yet, sorry.  I guess I'll get to work on some quests and come back later.  Bye.
I'll head out now.  Bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: I heard about that.  What's she need?

replies.reply_text: Halters with leads, and old saddles, child-sized if you've got them.

chatpoints.chat_text: Hmmm...  No, nothing like that, sorry.  But I'll sure let her know when I get some in.

replies.reply_text: That would be great!  Thanks!  Bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: Were you?  Ah, yes, the package.  That should go to Colina in Ashton.

replies.reply_text: That's right.  I'll deliver that now.  Bye!
Thanks!  Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: Welcome!  Come on in.  Look around.  Anything I can help you with?

replies.reply_text: Nope.  Just looking around.  Thanks.
What is the difference between Horse Candy and Treats?
Yes.  I need to pick up 5 bags of oats for Temperance.
Yes, I need to pick up some foal formula for Phyllis Colt, if you happen to have some in stock?
Actually, yes.  I'm trying to find Archy for Mehitabel. Has he been by here yet?
Yes there is. I've forgotten where you said Archy went after he finished his business with you?

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, Horse Treats will make your horse happy, and is a little bit of food as well.  The Horse Candy will make your horse happy and give it a little more energy.

replies.reply_text: Oh, that makes sense.  Thanks.

chatpoints.chat_text: Aaah, yes.  The monthly bags of oats.  I'll go grab them.  Oh, it will cost $900.

replies.reply_text: All right.
Oh...  Umm..  I don't have that.  Let me go make some money, quick.  I'll be back soon.
Bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: Yes, I have it right here.  That will be $500 even.

replies.reply_text: Phyllis gave me just enough to cover it all.  Here you go!
Well, maybe I'll come back later when I have the cash.
I sure will!  Thank you very much!
He always visits Ryland when he's in Treeton?  I guess he's next on my list.  Thanks, Oliver!

chatpoints.chat_text: No worries. I told you to drop in on Ryland. Archy always stops to check on him whenever he's in town.

replies.reply_text: That's right, I have to see Ryland next!  Thanks Oliver!

npc_list.name: Minnie Biscuits
npc_list.long_description: When you enter the Food Shop, you are immediately struck by a tantalizing aroma of nuts and bread.  A door opens and a plump, merry sort of woman peeks out, disappears for a second, and then comes out, clapping flour from her hands.

chatpoints.chat_text: Good day, love!  Nice to see you 'ere.  How are you?

replies.reply_text: Fine, thanks.  Just stopped in to see what you've got.
Wonderful, thanks!  What's that smell from the kitchen?  It's delicious!
I've come for nut bread.
Hi Minnie! I have the cardamom you asked for.
Minnie, could you please send me back to Spice Isle?
Hi Minnie.  Would you happen to have any cilantro?
Actually, I'll be a lot better if you have any fruit that has gone bad.
I'm great, thanks for asking! I was told you could help me with some spices I need.
Hi again, Minnie. (You sniff the air in the tiny kitchen) Something smells... different. What is that?
Greetings Ma'am. I'm here on behalf of Hansel and Gretel and their new bakery. He's looking for vendors for the following items. (You show Minnie the list.) Are you interested?
I'm back from Rika's.  Do you have the berry vendor for me?
Excuse the intrusion, but where should I go for the berries again?
I'm running in circles, it seems. I can't find lemons to buy anywhere. You wouldn't have any, would you?

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, that's me world famous nut bread!  Would you like to try a slice?  Fresh out the oven, just now!

replies.reply_text: No thanks, I really don't have time.
Fresh nut bread?  I'd love some!
No thanks.  After the bite I had last time, I don't really need any more....
I really can't right now, but I have to ask... What makes it smell so good?

chatpoints.chat_text: Suit y'self!  Bye now!

replies.reply_text: Bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: I'll go cut you a nice big slice! (Minnie turns and walks back into the kitchen, and a moment later, you hear a THUNK! as if something large were cut, not with a knife, but with an axe! Soon, she brings you a steaming slice of nutcake on a plate.) There you go, nice and fresh! Go on, have a bite!

replies.reply_text: (You pick up the slice and bite down--and while it smells delicious, the cake is rock hard and utterly inedible!) Augh! That's... I mean, don't get me wrong, it smells wonderful, but... ow!

chatpoints.chat_text: (Minnie looks utterly crestfallen.) I know it's a bit... dense... but he used to -so- like them that way! "The denser the better," he said!

replies.reply_text: Somebody actually... ate these?!
Ow.. I think I'll go take care of this tooth.  See you!

chatpoints.chat_text: Why, yes!  This fella from another Isle... Pablo, I think, his name was; Spanish chap... Why, Pablo'd come in here and bring me walnuts and acorns, and for every ten of each he brought me, I'd make him a loaf.  And right happy he was to have 'em, too!  Used to buy them by the dozen, he did!  And always he'd say to me, "Minnie, if ever anybody brings you walnuts and acorns and you bake this bread, and I can't come down and get it m'self, send it to me and I'll buy it and pay 'em well, whoever it is brings it!"

replies.reply_text: (You stop yourself saying, "You've -got- to be kidding!" just in time.)
"Pablo", did you say?  Hmmm, I might have heard that name.
Not now, thanks.  Maybe some other time.
Okay, here are ten acorns and ten walnuts.
Where can I find walnuts and acorns?

chatpoints.chat_text: They grow on trees, don't they?  There's plenty of walnut trees on Jungle Isle, and there's oaks all over the Isles, wherever there's grass.

replies.reply_text: Okay, I'll try to find you what you need.  Bye now!

chatpoints.chat_text: All right then, let's see...

replies.reply_text: I have more!
That's all for now.  I'll be back, though!  Bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: Ah, yes dearie, that'd be the spices I use in it.  Only the very finest, you know!

replies.reply_text: Well, it certainly smells good.  Bye now.
Spices? Where do you get those from?

chatpoints.chat_text: Why, from The Spice Shoppe! Speaking of that dearie, do you suppose you could run a quick little errand for me?

replies.reply_text: Oh, my! Look at the time!  I have to run right now. Perhaps another time? Bye!
I suppose I could fit that into my schedule. What do you need done?

chatpoints.chat_text: Thank you dearie! I am making hermit cookies, and need a small bag of ground cardamom from The Spice Shoppe.

replies.reply_text: Well, actually, I really don't have time for that. I'll stop back in soon and try to get that for you.
Sure, no problem! Uh... How do I get there?
Oh, Rika said she appreciates your business. Thanks and bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, that's no problem, I'll send you there. Rika will be able to send you back.

replies.reply_text: Sure.  See you soon.

chatpoints.chat_text: No, sorry. I don't keep that in stock. I usually get it direct from Rika at The Spice Shoppe when I need it.

replies.reply_text: Oh, well, could you please send me there?

chatpoints.chat_text: My goodness. What an unusual request.

replies.reply_text: (You quickly explain about Mino's anniversary surprise and the hummingbirds need for protein.)

chatpoints.chat_text: I'm sorry, dear, but I don't have what you need. You'd better try the other shops.

replies.reply_text: Oh, well. Thanks anyways.

chatpoints.chat_text: I can't help you with that, but I can get you to the woman who can!

replies.reply_text: That would be terrific!

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, my, yes. That's my first attempt at my soon-to-be-famous Berry Pie for the county fair this year! I am so excited because I came across a recipe for a huckleberry and thimbleberry pie. The only problem is that now I am all out of berries. Do you think you could go out and pick me some fresh ones for me? There’s a loaf of my famous nut bread in it for you… (Minnie holds up a fresh baked loaf of nut bread to tempt you.)

replies.reply_text: Sure thing, Minnie.  I just love your nut bread!  How many berries do you need?
Ummm... No thanks.  It sounds gross, just like your nutbread.
I'll be right back!
You're welcome, Minnie. Good luck at the county fair!

chatpoints.chat_text: You can find huckleberries on the grassy lands. They shouldn't be too hard to find, but you have to be patient because they are few and far between! Thimbleberries are found in bushes. You have to find the bushes first. (Minnie smiles sweetly.) Good luck!

replies.reply_text: Thank you for the tip.  I'll be back soon!

chatpoints.chat_text: Back so soon, dearie?  Did you find the 15 huckleberries and thimbleberries that I needed for my berry pie?

replies.reply_text: No, not yet.  I'll be right back this time.
I can't find any berries, Minnie!  Can you give me any hints?
I got them right here, Minnie!
No, but in the meantime, could you please send me back to Spice Isle?

chatpoints.chat_text: Hmmmm. (Looking over the list.) I can help you with the spices and the berries.

replies.reply_text: You can?! That's great.  Now let me give you the letters of credit.

chatpoints.chat_text: Slow down, I'm not saying I can handle this volume.  You need to see Rika Millgrater on Spice Isle.  I'm sure she can handle that sized order.  I can send you there, and when you get back, I'll give you the berry supplier.

replies.reply_text: That's wonderful, could you send me to her?
I have to go to Spice Isle?  I really can't right now.  I'll come back in a bit.  Bye.
Thank you. Then it's off to Molten Meadows for me! Goodbye.

chatpoints.chat_text: Why, you poor dear.  All this running around has you quite turned around, doesn't it?  I said that you might find a berry vendor in Molten Meadows.

replies.reply_text: That's right, thanks again!

chatpoints.chat_text: I sure don't. But why don't you try George on Pirate Isle? I bet he could help you out.

replies.reply_text: Minnie, I could hug you! Thanks so much.

chatpoints.chat_text: Hello. How are you?

replies.reply_text: I am well, and yourself?
I'm good, just looking.
I'm great, thanks for asking. I'm here for Mino's plants.
Where did you say I should look for the well-rotted manure?
You mentioned something about amending the soil. Will Mino know what you mean by that?

chatpoints.chat_text: I am well also. Do you need help with anything?

replies.reply_text: Yes. What is probably the best flower to get someone for a gift?
Nope. Thank you.

chatpoints.chat_text: All right.  If you need anything, just ask.

replies.reply_text: I will.  Thank you.

chatpoints.chat_text: Hmm. Depends, really. I like roses, but my friend, Vicky, loves daisies. I guess it just varies person to person.

replies.reply_text: Oh. Thank you for the advice. I should go now.

chatpoints.chat_text: Yep anytime. Goodbye.

replies.reply_text: Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: Ah, yes. I've got a great assortment of sages, and of course, honeysuckle and trumpet vines. He's getting a lot of plants here for the $1000 we agreed upon.

replies.reply_text: $1000? No problem. He gave me money to cover that.
I'll be back with the money in awhile.
Amend the soil? Will Mino know what you mean by that?
I'll get these right to him.

chatpoints.chat_text: We discussed it when he ordered the plants. He won't be able to grow much if he doesn't. Puuhonua Isle is mostly sand. Well-rotted manure will enrich the soil and give it the ability to hold moisture. He probably just forgot to mention it to you.

replies.reply_text: Thanks! I'll remind him.
I might as well get it now, while I'm out and about. Any idea where to get manure?

chatpoints.chat_text: Check at some of the livery stables. One of them is bound to have some.

replies.reply_text: Thanks!

npc_list.name: Cecil Shuteye
npc_list.admin_description: Woodworker of miniatures
npc_list.long_description: Cecil looks and talks more as if he were the captain of a ship than the owner of an inn.  Perhaps he was, at one time.  His eyes sparkle and his voice, while quiet, is that of someone who's perfectly at home with his work.

chatpoints.chat_text: Good day.

replies.reply_text: Hi there.  Just passing through.
Hello.  I just came from Vern and Grandpa Whystan in Tropicton.  They're looking for building blocks.  Can you make them from plans?
Hi!  It was 1 log of ebony wood and 5 regular logs you needed?  I think I have them here.
Good day, are the blocks ready?
Hey there, Cecil! Would you, by any chance, have an extra copper-bottomed stock pot I could buy? Or know where I might get one from?
Hi Cecil! I'm looking for cookies. Chocolate chip walnut cookies, to be precise. You wouldn't happen to have those?
Hi Cecil! I'm back with $100 to buy a cookie.
Any chance I could have some of the wood ash from your fireplace?
Hello, Cecil!  I have a proposition for you...

chatpoints.chat_text: From plans, eh?  Always good to have plans.  Let's see those plans.

replies.reply_text: Here you go.

chatpoints.chat_text:
Aw, these are cute! All right, I'll make these. Maybe I'll make a set for my nieces and nephews, too. Now let's see here...
Oh, you know what would be perfect? If some of these blocks were hardwood and some were ebony! Wouldn't that be fun? And look here... You've only got 1x2 blocks. What happens when you get to a door or a window? You'll need some half-size, 1x1 blocks! I'll make some of those too, just let me make a mark...

replies.reply_text: This project is getting bigger every time I go see someone!

chatpoints.chat_text:
Nothing wrong with that. Here, let me copy these plans real quick.................
(Cecil pulls out a pad and pencil and scribbles hurriedly.)

replies.reply_text: Take your time...
Okay.  I'll go get them for you.
Hold on, I think I have them here.
Okay, will do.  Thanks!
$500?  I didn't realize it was going to cost me!  No thanks!
Thanks.  These are just right.  See you!

chatpoints.chat_text: Copper-bottomed stock pot, you say? Hmmm. Seems to me I saw one being used recently.

replies.reply_text: Here? In Treeton?

chatpoints.chat_text: No, it was while I was vacationing. I can't for the life of me remember who was using it though. Just their cat -- cute little fellow! Kept curling around my ankles.

replies.reply_text: Okay. That's a start. Which island did you vacation on?

chatpoints.chat_text: I traveled to Jungle -- amazing scenery! And to the desert isles. I went through a ton of sunscreen there.

replies.reply_text: Perfect! It must have been one of the inn keepers in Tropicton or Hotton.

chatpoints.chat_text: No, I was looking for adventure, so I didn't see it in any town. I'm more of an off-the-beaten-path kind of traveler.

replies.reply_text: Yikes. That leaves a lot of territory for me to search. Can't you remember anything more about the pot?

chatpoints.chat_text: No, sorry. But you might want to ask those inn keepers. They might be able to give you more information. It never hurts to ask.

replies.reply_text: Okay. Thanks for the suggestion.
I've got that right here.
I'm going to have to make a bank run.
Thanks very much!

chatpoints.chat_text: Can't help you with that. I just cleaned it out. But since you are here, you might want to consider some of our fried chicken. It is scrumptious!

replies.reply_text: Thanks for the offer, but I think I'll pass.

chatpoints.chat_text: A proposition you say?  This could be the highlight of my day.

replies.reply_text: Well Iona over in Flipperton wants to hold a Founder's Day Crafts Festival.  She's hoping you can attend and display your work.  Here's your invitation.
I'm sure you'll have a good time there.  I'll let Iona know.

npc_list.name: Reid Pebbleton
npc_list.long_description: Reid is a small young man, who no matter what he does, appears to be reading cue cards far off.  He is not a dreamy sort, nor is he blind; he appears to genuinely not be too sure exactly where you are.

chatpoints.chat_text: (Looks up and smiles warmly at you.) Hello. Welcome to my shop. May I help you?

replies.reply_text: (Smiles in return.) Hello. Do you have any rare gems?
Nope, just looking.  Thank you.
Actually, I'm hoping I might be able to help you.  Have Horse, Will Quest, you know.  Is there anything you need found, fetched, carried or conjured?
Sorry to be a pest, but what was it you had me looking for again?
I'm back from the Great White North!

chatpoints.chat_text: All of our stock comes from travelers like yourself. You could find anything ranging from the simple agates to the beautifully divine diamonds.

replies.reply_text: Really? I better go collect some more.

chatpoints.chat_text: All right.  If you need anything, just ask.

replies.reply_text: I will, thanks.

chatpoints.chat_text: (Smiles.) Beaches and the deserts will probably be the best place to find gems. For ores, search collections of rocks.

replies.reply_text: (Smiles in return.) All right, thank you.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh. Oh. I see. Yes, I see. (Reid looks at you briefly, as if he hasn't ever seen anything like you before; then looks away and taps the counter in thought.) Hmmm.... novel idea that, let me think.

replies.reply_text: Are you all right?
(You look around the shop while he thinks things over.)
I'll come back later when you've had a while to think about it.  Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: All right?  Yes, I'm very well, thank you very much for asking.  Yes.  Now what was it I can do for... oh wait.  You wanted to do something for me, didn't you?  Yes, that was it.  Let me think.

replies.reply_text: (You look over the shop. There are some really find specimens here.)
I think I'll come back later after you've had some time to think.  Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: "As far to north as you can go, to an isle with center snow.  Right between a man and bird, dig and you'll find my last word."

replies.reply_text: Thanks.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh.  I've thought of something, but it will be a lot of work.  Do you mind a lot of work?  Because if you do there's no point in carrying on this discussion.

replies.reply_text: Not at all!  "Nil Sine Magno Labore," that's my alma-mater's motto, and mine too!  Tell me what you need.
Oh no, I hate work.  I just want someone to hand me money and lots of it.

chatpoints.chat_text: Ha, you're on the wrong planet, I must say!  Good day to you then.

replies.reply_text: Okay, okay, I was just being sarcastic.  I'll do your job for you.
Sheesh, grow a thicker skin, why don't you!  Good.  Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: Sarcastic, are you?  Well, I am blind to sarcasm.  I expect you to mean what you say, and say what you mean.  That should not be too much to ask.  Good day to you.

replies.reply_text: Look, if you can't handle a little sarcasm--
I'm sorry.  I didn't mean to be rude.   What would you like me to do for you?

chatpoints.chat_text: Good day to you.

replies.reply_text: Fine. Be that way. (Walk out.)
(Nod and leave the store quietly.)

chatpoints.chat_text: There is a great university in the Foreign Lands that I have always dreamed of attending.  The problem is that it's far away and it's expensive.  I've been running this rock shop for years to try and earn the money for it, but I'm nowhere close.
