chatpoints.chat_text: I daresay it might be!  Oh dear, and here I was thinking it had been a gift dropped by Santa.  You better hurry and return it to Larissa.  You'll tell her I'm sorry I didn't return it to her, won't you?  I wouldn't want her thinking me a thief.

replies.reply_text: I'll be sure to tell her.  Thank you!

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, my!  A gift for me?  How wonderful!  Tell her that's it's quite understandable, and there are no hard feelings.

replies.reply_text: I'll tell her.  Bye!
That does sound good.  I need to be getting back but hopefully your pie will be done soon.  Bye!
I will, I'm glad you like it.  Goodbye.

npc_list.name: Abigail
npc_list.admin_description: New Quests must start at CP 11
npc_list.long_description: Abigail is in her mid 30's. She is physically fit and stays that way by participating in many outdoor winter activities. She is always friendly and helpful. She has long, dark brown wavy hair.

chatpoints.chat_text: Come in!  You must be freezing!  Would you like a cup of hot cocoa?  It's my own special blend.

replies.reply_text: Yes, thank you.  Hot cocoa sounds wonderful!
It smells wonderful, but no thank you.
No thanks.  See ya later!
Mmm...  Smells so good.  Thank you!
Thanks!  I'm going to head out now.

chatpoints.chat_text: What a shame.  Are you sure you don't want any?

replies.reply_text: Well, if you insist.  I'd love a cup.
No, I'm sure.  Thank you  though.
I'll pass.  Bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: Speaking of hot cocoa, I have some I made special, just for Heinrich.  I'd usually run it over to him myself, but I've seemed to have misplaced my ice skates and would like to find them.  Do you think you could run the hot cocoa to Heinrich for me?

replies.reply_text: You bet!  Uh...  Where does Heinrich live?
No.  I'm going to go now.  See ya!
I'll hurry.  I promise.

chatpoints.chat_text: Welcome back!  Did you get that hot cocoa delivered to Heinrich all right?

replies.reply_text: Yep.  It was a piece of cake.  Did you manage to find your ice skates?
Oh, no.  I guess I better go do that.
Yes I did.  I wonder, do you happen to also make spiced apple cider?

chatpoints.chat_text: What?  Oh  no.  They've seemed to have vanished off the face of Horse Isle.

replies.reply_text: Maybe I could find them for you!
Oh, how sad.  Could I have more hot cocoa?
That's too bad.  I hope you find them.

chatpoints.chat_text: Do you think you could?  I mean, you'd be willing to go out in the cold to find my ice skates?

replies.reply_text: Of course!  It's not that cold.
Well, it is a bit chilly.  Maybe when its warmer.
You'll have your skates back in no time!

chatpoints.chat_text: Hi again.  What? You found them! You found my ice skates?

replies.reply_text: You bet I did!  They're right here.
Oh no.  I better go find them for you.
No, not yet.  Who did you say might have some information about them?
They were up near that rock, not far from the pond, right where you left them!
Thank you so much!
Hi Abigail!  I know that you make a special blend of hot cocoa... do you also make spiced apple cider, by any chance?
You know what? Maybe I could find those ice skates for you!
Thanks,  but I've gotta be going now.

chatpoints.chat_text: Valarie might know where they are.  She has a house down the road on the north side.

replies.reply_text: All right.  I'll go see what I can find out.

chatpoints.chat_text: Neat.  Well, thank you so much.

replies.reply_text: You're welcome.  Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: Indeed I do!  I blend dried apple cider mix with my own secret ingredients.  Not many people know about it, though.  Those particular spices are hard to come by.

replies.reply_text: I have a friend who can't leave his home, but spoke fondly of your apple cider.  I can pay for some, if you could part with it.
It's just one thing after another.  Before you ask:  No, I don't want to go fetch spices for you.  See you around.
I'll pass that along to him, I'm sure he'll be tickled.

npc_list.name: Cedric
npc_list.long_description: Cedric is a tall, lean man with a firm handshake.

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, don't dally outside.  It's freezing!  Come join me by the fire.

replies.reply_text: Thank you.  I won't stay long though.
I just dropped in to get Nolan's book back from you.
Nah.  I think I'm just going to go.
Cedric!  Look what I found!
I'm back!  Lars said to be more careful with it.
Hi Cedric.  Ben Burlap sent me to let you know that hockey practice starts in two weeks.
Greetings Cedric!  Murray sent me to get his fence rails.
Okay, I'm back and I have your logs and your money.
Thanks Cedric!  It's so nice and warm in here!  I wonder if I could ask you for a tiny favor.
Don't mind if I do, Cedric.  Olav sent me to pick up his shingles, are they ready yet?
I'm sorry, but what am I getting for you again?
Hi!  I'm back and I have everything you asked for.
Thanks, I was wondering, do you do wood carving?
Hi Cedric!  Has Archy picked up his shingles yet?
Sorry to be a bother, Cedric, but where did you say Archy was going next?
Thank you, Sir.  I'll return it to him right away.

chatpoints.chat_text: That's quite all right.  I should be going out myself.  I've lost my axe and I must find it.  Everybody in Chillton relies on me to gather firewood, and I can't do that without my axe.

replies.reply_text: Oh no!  That's horrible.  What will you do if you can't find your axe?
That's horrible.  Good luck finding it.  Bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: I'm not rightly sure.  Probably make a trip down to Treeton to buy another one, though that's a long trip, and not one I'm fond of making this time of year.

replies.reply_text: That's understandable.  Hey, maybe I could help you find it!
Well, good luck.  I'm going to head out.

chatpoints.chat_text: Maybe you might!  I'll go up and check the northern part of the woods, and you can head south towards the beach.  I'm pretty sure I lost it near a big rock when I set it down to fix my snowshoe.  I just can't remember which rock.

replies.reply_text: All right.  I'll look south, near the beach then.

chatpoints.chat_text: Great!  I'll meet you back here as soon as you've found something.

replies.reply_text: I'll see you soon then!

chatpoints.chat_text: The handle, huh?  Well, that's something, but an axe without the blade isn't much use.  You didn't see any trace of the blade, did you?

replies.reply_text: No.  All I could find was the handle.  I'm sorry.

chatpoints.chat_text: That's all right.  You did a great job!  Better than I could have done.  Guess it looks like I'm going to have to make that trip to Treeton after all.

replies.reply_text: Why don't I go for you?  I don't mind making the trip.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, great!  Go talk to the Farrier in Treeton.  Lars will probably be able to make up a new blade for me in no time.  Oh, here!  Take this with you.  Lars will need the handle to put the axe together.

replies.reply_text: All right.  I'll hurry back as soon as I can.

chatpoints.chat_text: Splendid!  Why, this is even better than it was new!  Thank you so much.  You've been a big help.  Here, take this as a small reward.

replies.reply_text: Thank you, Sir!  Try not to lose it again.

chatpoints.chat_text: It does? Great! I can't wait for it.  Are you telling everyone on the team?

replies.reply_text: Yorick asked me to.  Any idea where I should head next?
Okay, I will head out now. Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: Did he really now?  Did he mention paying me?

replies.reply_text: Yes, actually, he did.
Okay, I'll be back with the logs as soon as possible!
Thanks!  I'll get these back to Murray.

chatpoints.chat_text: That's all well and good, but I still need 50 more logs to finish his order.  Do me a favor and go get me 50 logs while I work on Murray's fence rails more.

replies.reply_text: Fifty logs?!?  No way.  I thought I was just going to pay in money, not go hunting for logs.  Good luck with that.  Bye!
I can do that.

chatpoints.chat_text: Depends upon how tiny.  You've certainly helped me out in the past, so I'll try to help you.

replies.reply_text: Well, you see this stick of cedar wood I have here - it needs to be hewn along these markings.  I'm hoping that would be an easy thing for you to do?

chatpoints.chat_text: I was afraid it would be something to do with Ol' Betsy.  You see, she's gone pretty dull on me lately.

replies.reply_text: How can you chop wood with a dull axe?  It's still toasty warm in here... You must be able to get wood.

chatpoints.chat_text: Yes, I can still chop firewood, but for the kind of precision work you need for this small bit of wood, this dull axe won't cut it. (Snicker)

replies.reply_text: Heh heh... (Sigh) Well, I guess I can take the axe back to Lars in Treeton and have him fix the axe again. He's still your blacksmith of choice, correct?
Oh, well.  I guess I'll come back later.  Maybe you'll have your axe sharpened by then.

chatpoints.chat_text: Axes aren't as sharp as you might think!  They're almost used as a wedge.  Lars probably couldn't get Ol' Betsy sharp enough for this particular use.  I'm not sure who could.

replies.reply_text: What kind of tool would someone need to use to get Ol' Betsy sharp enough?
I think I'll back off for now.  I wouldn't want to mess up your axe.
Thanks.  I'll be very careful with Ol' Betsy.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, there you are!   Have you brought Ol' Betsy back to me?  Did you have any trouble?

replies.reply_text: Sorry, I'm not done with her yet.  I'll bring her back as soon as I can.
Sorry, Cedric, I haven't gotten her sharpened yet.  Could you remind me who could do that?
Yes, here's Ol' Betsy now!  Ryland said that the very sharp edge would not last very long on an axe.  Will this work for the cedar?

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, anyone who knows how to use a whetstone could give her a precision sharpening.

replies.reply_text: Great!  I think I know just who to ask.
That was very fast!  Thank you!  I'd better get this back to Krista right away.

chatpoints.chat_text: Well I'm almost finished, but I'll need more logs.  I'm dipping into the town's supply to finish this order.

replies.reply_text: And what do you need me to do?
Ten logs it is!  I'll be back soon.

chatpoints.chat_text: Is the cold affecting your brain?  I asked you to bring me ten logs.

replies.reply_text: Oh yeah, that's right.  Be back soon.

chatpoints.chat_text: Did you bring all my logs?

replies.reply_text: I sure did, here
Thanks Cedric.  These should do nicely.  Bye bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: Nope, I don't have the patience for that sort of fancy woodworking, sorry.

replies.reply_text: That's okay, I'll keep looking, thanks for the warm up!
You say he went to Rupert's?  Well, I guess that's my next stop.  Thanks!

chatpoints.chat_text: It's no bother. Archy was going to stop in to see Rupert.

replies.reply_text: Rupert, I remember now.  Thanks for the reminder, Cedric!

npc_list.name: Nicolette
npc_list.admin_description: NO NEW QUESTS, full
npc_list.long_description: Nicolette is a beautiful young girl with exuberance and talent.  Stuck on her head are a pair of purple glasses, used to make working with molten glass easier.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, hello.  What brings you to this out-of-the-way side of the world?

replies.reply_text: Just touring, thanks.  Bye!
Just wanted to see what was up here.  You're a glassworker, I see.
Hello!  I have copper ore for you!
Hello.  Just popped in to ask if you make beads out of shell and stone and so forth?
Hi there!  I noticed you do glass work, and I was wondering: would you be willing to make the windows for this building set?
Hi!  Glass parts ready?
Hello, Nicolette, I really hope you can help me with something.
I'm back, Nicolette!
Hello again.  Are the pigments ready?
Nicolette, I have these leftover chemicals, do you want them?
Sorry, I didn't have the money for the paint.  Here it is.
Hi Nicolette, Inigo Webster sent me to see if you could make something for one of his pieces.
What was it you needed again?
Hey, I am back with the tin oxide.
Nicolette, is the glass scene ready for me to take back to Inigo?
Hi there.  Do you, by any chance, do any coppersmithing?

chatpoints.chat_text: Yes.  I make all kinds of things out of glass.  Anything from beads to glasses and plates, you name it.  Moved up here because it's cool.

replies.reply_text: I can imagine!  Glassworking requires a lot of time spent by an open flame.

chatpoints.chat_text: It does. Well, it will if I ever find my copper. I'm sure I packed it! It's got to be in here somewhere! (She rummages in her boxes with increasing frustration.)

replies.reply_text: Copper?  What do you use copper for?

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh. All kinds of things! (Nicolette stands up and stretches her back.) Depending on the glass formula and how you heat it, copper can give you any color from luscious orangy-reds, to pure turquoise blues, all kinds of greens, and even purple! Valuable stuff, copper. I love it!

replies.reply_text: Well, I'm sure you've just misplaced it.  Have a good day!
That's sure not something I'd like to lose!   Is there no native copper around here you can use?

chatpoints.chat_text: So I heard, yeah. And gold and silver, too; those give lovely reds and yellows. But I haven't had time to look for them. I really want that copper, though! Where did I put it?

replies.reply_text: Do you need it right away?

chatpoints.chat_text: Yes, I just got an order for a huge set of green and blue glass flatware!

replies.reply_text: Do you know where some might be?  I'll try to find you some!
Well, I guess I'll let you search, then.  See you!
I'll see what I can find!  Ciao!
Oh!  That stuff!  As it happens, I think I have some here!

chatpoints.chat_text: You do? Fabulous!  Let's see what you've got!

replies.reply_text: Here is an ore.
Here's another one.
That's all for now!  I'll come back when I have more!

chatpoints.chat_text: Yes, I can do that.  It'll cost you, though.

replies.reply_text: How much?
That's fine.  So long as you can do it.

chatpoints.chat_text: $1000 for a set of four.  I only do four at a time, otherwise it's not worth it for me to set up my equipment.

replies.reply_text: I don't have that on me.  Sorry.  Thanks anyway.
Okay, that's fair.

chatpoints.chat_text: What do you need made?

replies.reply_text: I need these Beaded Periwinkle Shells made into beads.
I need these aquamarine crystals made into beads.
I need these pieces of Amber made into beads.
I need these Black Fire Opals made into beads.
That's all.  Thanks!
Thanks.  That's all I need.
I need some other beads made, too.
Thanks.  That's all I need.
I need some other beads made, too.
Thanks.  That's all I need.
I need some other beads made, too.
Thanks.  That's all I need.
I need some other beads made, too.
Uhm... Thanks!  Goodbye!

chatpoints.chat_text: Let me see what you've got there... Oh!  Yes!  I had a set like that too, when I was young.  My little brother ate it.  Sort of.  I'd love to make the windows... and OH!  You know what's missing?  There were clear blocks in this set too!  I could make those out of glass!

replies.reply_text: I think Whystan may have mentioned clear blocks.

chatpoints.chat_text: Yes!  They were the best part of the whole set!  You could make glass-brick walls, or use them as windows, or decoration!   Oh, I'd be happy to do this for you, yes!

replies.reply_text: Great!  Do I need to get you anything, and how much will this cost?
Do I need to bring you anything?

chatpoints.chat_text: No.  I've got all the things I need, it's just a matter of finding them.  Give me some time, and I'll have it ready for you.

replies.reply_text: Great!  Thanks!
These are wonderful!  Thanks so much!

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, I'll try my very best.  What is it you need?

replies.reply_text: Okay.  I need paint.  Red, yellow, green and blue, a liter of each.  Can you make such a thing?

chatpoints.chat_text: Paint?  Well, hmm.  Paint isn't really my field but, so long as it's not artist's paint you need, I could make you the pigments to make paint from, I think.  Then if you can find some paint base, sure, we can make paint!  That would be fun!

replies.reply_text: Oh, that's wonderful!  That will do perfectly!  Do you have the materials on hand, or can I get them for you?

chatpoints.chat_text: You'll have to get them, I'm afraid, and one or two are hard to find on these Isles.

replies.reply_text: I think I'll give up now while I'm ahead, but thanks anyway.
Okay, what do you need?
Where do I get the... oxides?  And what are they?

chatpoints.chat_text: Oxides are a mixture of oxygen and... whatever else.  They are very stable and durable and make great pigments in themselves.  They're usually sold as powders.  You can probably get them from one of the blacksmiths; oxides are used a lot in metal refining.  Try the one in Appleton, I get a lot of my pigments from him.

replies.reply_text: Oh.  I see.  Okay, I'll go get these and come back when I've got them.

chatpoints.chat_text: Do you?  If you can get some of that, that would be great!

replies.reply_text: I'll be back as soon as I can!  Bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: Hello there!  Have you got everything on the list?

replies.reply_text: I have the tin and chrome here, and the ores.
I'm sorry, I haven't been able to find everything yet.  I have the ores, though.
I already gave you the oxides, but here are the ores.
Well, I gave you everything on the list.  Now what?

chatpoints.chat_text: Please, make it easier on both of us, and come back when you have everything.

replies.reply_text: All right.  Bye.
Okay...
Oh, sorry.  I don't have that stuff.  I'll go get it now.
Great.
Okay, I'll come back tomorrow sometime.  Bye.
Well, I'd like to ask... I see how you're going to get the green.  But how about the other colors?

chatpoints.chat_text: Splendid!  Then once I have the pigments, we have something to mix them into.

replies.reply_text: Is it okay to ask, how are you going to make the colors?
I thought they might be useful!  I'll come back tomorrow!  Bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, and before you come back, I'll need something in which to mix the colors I'm making.  So, either white paint if you can find it, or a milk base, or some such.

replies.reply_text: Okay!
What?  I thought you could make the paint!
Milk base?

chatpoints.chat_text: The pigments are ready, but I need a paint base to add them to.  Either some prepared white paint, or a milk-based paint will do, I think.

replies.reply_text: Oh, no.  Sorry, this is all getting to be too much work.  Sorry to put you through all the trouble.  Goodbye.
Okay, I'll go find paint, then.  Goodbye.
Milk base?
I have some milk from Tony Grocer here.
Ah!  As it happens, I have four cans of white house paint with me!

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, yes!  In the past, most house paints were milk-based.  You need skim milk and lime... chemical lime, not citrus fruit, and boiled linseed oil.

replies.reply_text: And you'd need me to get those for you, right?
Oh, well,  don't need it anyway, I have some white house paint I got from Vern right here!

chatpoints.chat_text: Just the milk.

replies.reply_text: No thanks. I give up.
Where around here do you get milk?
I'll get it.  See you.

chatpoints.chat_text:
Well, for that I will use my kiln. The chrome oxide is fine the way it is, it's quite a lovely green. But I need iron oxide to make the yellow.
The iron oxide I need is, essentially, a yellow rust. If I heat these iron ores in the kiln at just the right temperature, they will oxidize; and the oxide can be ground to a powder and made into a yellow pigment.

replies.reply_text: I see.  And the blue and red, how will you get those?
More information than I wanted.  See you tomorrow!

chatpoints.chat_text:
Both of those require copper! For each, I will mix up a batch of glass, and add copper. To the one to be blue, I'll add some of the tin oxide you brought, and melt the glass in the kiln with lots of oxygen. For the red, I'll put only a very tiny bit in the glass, and fire the kiln with as little oxygen as possible.
Then when the mix is cool enough to take out of the kiln, I put it in water, and it will shatter. The resulting "frit" is ground into a powder, and there's your pigment!

replies.reply_text: Wow.  Imagine that.  Say, all this work is going to cost me, isn't it?

chatpoints.chat_text: I'm afraid so.

replies.reply_text: Figured.  See ya.

chatpoints.chat_text: Very good.  Let's see, what have you got there?

replies.reply_text: Here's the white paint.
Here's the milk.
Oh, dear... I think I may have forgotten that part...
And we already have buckets!
It's goat's milk.  That was all he had.

chatpoints.chat_text:
It will have to do, then. Hmmm....
(Nicolette goes to the back of her cabin, and pulls out a bucket lined with cheesecloth. Into this, she pours the milk and the lime. Soon the milk curdles, and she gathers up the cheesecloth and pulls. The curdles stay in the cheesecloth, and these Nicolette transfers to another bucket. To this, she adds the linseed oil. She mixes this well (requiring you to help) and finally determines all is finished.)

replies.reply_text: Now what?

chatpoints.chat_text: You don't have any spare cans or jars, do you? No, didn't think so. Hang on... (Nicolette goes rooting around her supplies once again, and finally emerges with four old cans.)

replies.reply_text: Are we there yet?

chatpoints.chat_text:
Come see the colors!
(On a table in a corner sit the box of chrome oxide, and three mortars and pestles. Inside are powders: leaf green, dusky pumpkin orange, deep sky blue, and dark mulberry. I can mix you up the paint for $4000 for the lot.

replies.reply_text: This pirate better really be rich!  Here you go.
I can't believe this.  I've already spent much more than Silver Mary gave me for expenses!  I'm sorry, I can't afford it.
Thanks so much for all your help!  And all I've learned!  Goodbye!

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, is that right?  And what am I supposed to do with this, then?

replies.reply_text: I'm sure you can find someone to sell it to.  I'm sorry.  Goodbye!

chatpoints.chat_text: A paint base?  White paint of some kind.

replies.reply_text: Okay, I'll find that. Somewhere....
And oxides... What are those?

chatpoints.chat_text: Try the blacksmith in Appleton.  That's where I typically get my oxides.

replies.reply_text: All right.  Thanks!

chatpoints.chat_text: What is he looking for?

replies.reply_text: He is making a huge menorah for King Phil, and would like a glass scene in the middle. It should be some kind of blue with white animals and measure 12"h X 18"l X 1"w.

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, that shouldn't be a problem - I have quite a few ideas that could work for that. And it's for King Phil, you said? I better dress it up some, then.

replies.reply_text: Do you have everything you need?

chatpoints.chat_text: I have enough copper for the color - but I will need more tin oxide for the blues. Can you go and get some for me?

replies.reply_text: That is a really long way, I think I will just come back later. Maybe you will have some in stock then.
I guess so.
See you later. Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: I need tin oxide from Arthur Temperton.

replies.reply_text: That's right! I will be on my way now.
$500? I can do that. I will go and see the elves and come back in a bit.
I'll make sure and tell him. Thanks - bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: Hello again.  Have you got the oxides and ores for me?

replies.reply_text: Not yet.  Where did I need to go to find the oxides again?
Yes, I do.  Here they are.
No, I don't have them yet, sorry.  I'll get them now.
I gave you the oxides.  Here are the ores.
You should have everything now.
Yes, here it is, thanks!
No, I want to keep it, it's... got such sentimental value.  Bye!
Thanks a bunch!  Goodbye!

chatpoints.chat_text: No, I don't do any coppersmithing, sorry.  There's someone in Appleton who does, though, I think.

replies.reply_text: Oh.  All right, thanks!

npc_list.name: Rupert
npc_list.admin_description: &  New Quests must begin at CP7
npc_list.long_description: Rupert is wearing a wool shirt and pants. He has a wool horse blanket around his shoulders.

replies.reply_text: All right.  Maybe I'll bring some later.
Here's another one.

chatpoints.chat_text: Hello!  Come in.  Do you have any more logs for me?

replies.reply_text: I sure do.  Here you go.
No, not right now.  Maybe I'll find some later for you.
Not at the moment, I just wanted to ask you about Archy.
Not right now, Rupert. Sorry to barge in again, but where did you say Archy was heading after he left you?

chatpoints.chat_text: That would be great.  Just look for logs in any of the forests on the other isles.  I'll give you $100 for any log you bring me.

replies.reply_text: Great.  I'll see what I can find.
Oh, actually, I have a log.  Here you go.

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, actually, I could use some firewood.  My stash is running low and I have to go to one of the other isles in order to get some.  I don't make that trip too often.

replies.reply_text: I guess I could go get some for you.
I actually have some right here.
Well, I don't have any now, maybe I'll bring some by later.

chatpoints.chat_text: Probably.  But I feel that would be cruel.  Plus, I enjoy her company.

replies.reply_text: Very nice.  Well, is there anything I can do for you?
Interesting.  Well, off I go, then.  Goodbye.

chatpoints.chat_text: I couldn't very well make her live outside in this cold, now could I?

replies.reply_text: Most horses should be able to stand the cold.
I suppose not.  Well, have fun with your horse.   Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: I realize this isn't a conventional home, but make yourself comfy.

replies.reply_text: It does seem to be an interesting way to live.  Why do you let your horse in?
You're right.  It really isn't.  It smells a bit like Chilly, too.  I think I'll head out now.

chatpoints.chat_text: There you go, Chilly.  Oh, hello.  Come in.  Get out of the cold.

replies.reply_text: Umm, no thanks.  I think I'll be going.
All right.  Thanks.
Thanks, but I really wanted to ask you about Archy.
Thanks, Rupert. Sorry to barge in again, but where did you say Archy was heading after he left you?
I missed him again?  Well, looks like I'm off to Ice Isle. Thanks Rupert!

chatpoints.chat_text: That's okay, I like company.  Archy said he was going on to Ice Isle next.

replies.reply_text: More snow, now I remember. Thanks Rupert. Stay warm until the next time!

npc_list.name: Santa Claus
npc_list.long_description: In front of you is a large man with a full, white beard.  He seems to really enjoy the color red also...

chatpoints.chat_text: Ho, ho, ho, meeeerrrryy...  Oh, wait...  It isn't quite that time of year yet.  I do get wrapped up in my work up here.

replies.reply_text: That's all right.  I'll leave you to your work.  I see that you are busy.  Bye.
I can get presents wrapped here?
You look like you could use some help. Is there anything I can do?
Okay, I'm back.
You don't look so good.  Are you okay?
Here is that soup Mrs. Claus made for you!
Hi Santa!  I was given a poem by Holli Daysin from Tropicton, and I'm pretty sure it says I have to get something from you.
Hello again, Santa!  I'm back!
I'm sorry, Santa, but what did you need me to get?
Hello Santa!  Have you seen a monkey around here, by chance?
Hi Santa!  It actually is about that time of year now!
Santa, I have an Alpaca throw I need wrapped for a birthday gift. Can you do that?

chatpoints.chat_text: Why, of course!  Just pick whatever item you have to be wrapped and one of my helpful elves will wrap it for you.  Then you can give a secret gift to anyone you want.

replies.reply_text: Great!  Thanks.

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, see, Mrs. Claus and I have an anniversary coming up and I have just been too busy here to get her something.  I don't know if I will have enough time now.

replies.reply_text: Oh, that's too bad. I suppose it's a good thing you're Santa Claus - you can just find her a present. Ha ha.
Oh, well, I could probably help you, but I don't really know what she would like for your anniversary.

chatpoints.chat_text: I have already gotten something picked out for her, actually.  I heard of a woman called Aura Hayward on Bird Isle that makes beautiful strings of flashing lights.  I would like to have her make the missus a red and green one.

replies.reply_text: Bird Isle? Then all the way back here? No way. That's too much traveling for me. My horse gets seasick, you know.
Bird Isle, huh? Well, that isn't too far out of my way. I could do that for you. Is there anything I need to take to her?

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, that's right - there is. She buys her own metals and I will give you her fee of $2000. She also needs 15 rubies and 15 emeralds to make the lights. And, ho, ho, ho, I have been so busy here I haven't had time to get those.  I don't suppose you could provide those and I will reimburse you for them when you get back?

replies.reply_text: Now I have to provide the gems, too?? No way. Sorry Santa, but you are on your own for this one.
Well.... I suppose I could do that. After all, you are Santa and I like being on the nice list.
See you in a while.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, good! Do you have the lights?

replies.reply_text: Um, no? I kinda forgot what I was supposed to be doing.
Yes, here they are. I hope she loves them.
Thanks!

chatpoints.chat_text: You were going to Aura Hayward on Bird Isle to have her make Christmas lights for Mrs. Claus. You had to get 15 rubies and 15 emeralds first.

replies.reply_text: Oh, that's right.  I will be on my way.  Thanks for the reminder.
Thanks Santa!

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, it is!?  Oh my, I am running late.  Would you mind if I gave you your present directly?

replies.reply_text: Sure, go right ahead!
No, no thanks.

chatpoints.chat_text: Thank you for asking.  I actually seem to have a cold.

replies.reply_text: That doesn't sound good.  I know you have a lot to do before Christmas.  Is there anything that I can help with?
I hope you feel better soon.  I need to go do some other things, so I will leave you alone.

chatpoints.chat_text: Mrs. Claus said she was going to make me a soup.  Maybe she could use some help?

replies.reply_text: I would be glad to help!  I'll go talk to her now.
If I get some time later I may, but, unfortunately, I have a lot to do right now.
Okay!
You're welcome.  I need to be going now.

chatpoints.chat_text: Really?  How does the poem go?

replies.reply_text: Okay, here goes: "Go to the land of the holiday snow; and get from its most famous resident something to show." I am at the right place, right?

chatpoints.chat_text: Ho, ho, ho! That's quite a compliment!  Well, I suppose I could give you one of my wood carvings, but I need you to do something for me first.

replies.reply_text: Always a catch!  I don't have time for this.  See ya!
Somehow, this is not a surprise.  Okay, Santa, what do you need?
Sure!  I'll be back as soon as I have everything. Bye!
This is really neat!  I'll make sure to give Holli your best, Santa.  Goodbye!

chatpoints.chat_text: Ho, ho, ho!  I asked you for 10 ebony logs and 25 wood logs.

replies.reply_text: That's right.  I'll get right on it!

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, ho, ho... no.  No, I don't believe I've seen a real monkey in the workshop.  Only toys.  But then again, I have been very busy this year.  Maybe you should ask one of the elves if they have seen any monkeys running about.

replies.reply_text: Thanks for your help, Santa.  I'll check with Dilly and Jilly Chilly to see if they spotted one.

chatpoints.chat_text: Of course! Blink your eyes twice - and tada! All done!

replies.reply_text: Wow! You are really a master at wrapping. Thanks again!

npc_list.name: Dilly Chilly the Elf
npc_list.admin_description: New Quests must start at CP10
npc_list.long_description: Dilly Chilly the Elf is a small boy with pointed ears. He is dressed all in green and red. He likes pranks.

chatpoints.chat_text: HAH!  Almost got you!

replies.reply_text: Hey! That could have hurt!  You're mean! Bye!
HA! No way, I'm too quick for you!
I'm going to tell Santa on you!

Hey, hey, hey there!  I don't want a snowball fight, I just need to ask you about something. I got this poem and it says that I need to go to the land of the holiday snow and get from it's most famous resident something to show.  Any suggestions?
Hey, Dilly.  Have you seen a monkey on Christmas Isle?
Dilly, have you seen that monkey again?

chatpoints.chat_text: Yep.  You ducked pretty fast, I'll give you that.... So what brings you to my workshop?

replies.reply_text: Just getting out of the cold for a while. I'm warmer now... See you.
I was just passing by and thought I'd see what's in here. Now I have to go. Bye.
Well, it wasn't to get hit with a snowball!  What's your name anyway?
I need something special built. I need something to carry a Winter Lotus in so that it doesn't melt. Can you make me something that will work?
I'm back with your 20 snowballs and 4 logs!

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, I'm sorry.  Where are my manners?  My name is Dilly Chilly.

replies.reply_text: Hi Dilly, nice to meet you!  So what's with the slingshot and snowballs?
Well, now I have a name to give Santa when I tell on you!  Bye!
What a silly name!  And what a silly elf you are! See ya!

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, I'm testing out a new toy for Santa, but it isn't going very well.

replies.reply_text: Oh? Why not?
That's too bad, but I guess I should be going now.  Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: Well... The snowballs keep melting before I can get a good supply of them and try the slingshot.

replies.reply_text: Yep, it is too warm in here and now I'm warmed up too.  I'm off to find Santa now, bye.
Is there anything I can do to help?

chatpoints.chat_text: Well if you'd be willing to get me a lot of snowballs say... 25. That would be a big help!

replies.reply_text: I will freeze before I find 25 snowballs!  Find someone else, bye.
25, huh?  Well, I think I could find that many...
You're welcome. Bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: Welcome back!

replies.reply_text: Thanks.  My hands are frozen but here are 25 snowballs!
I got too cold before I could get them all.

chatpoints.chat_text: Did some melt?  This isn't enough.

replies.reply_text: Yeah, they must have... I'll go and get more, bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: Thanks again for those snowballs!  I even splatted Jilly with one. Hehehe.

replies.reply_text: You're welcome.  Bye.
Glad I could help. I need help this time, though. I need something to carry a Winter Lotus in so that it doesn't melt. Can you make me something that will work?
I'm back with your 20 snowballs and 4 logs!

I don't want a snowball fight, I just need to ask you about something. I got this poem and it says that I need to go to the land of the holiday snow and get from it's most famous resident something to show.  Any suggestions?
Hey, Dilly.  Have you seen a monkey on Christmas Isle?
Dilly have you seen that monkey again?
Okay.  Bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: Hey, what a grand idea! That'd be useful to me, too, so my snowballs will quit melting! I'll get to work on a design if you can bring me a couple of items.

replies.reply_text: Uh, sure! What do you need?
You can't make it out of thin air? What kind of elf are you? I'm just gonna go.

chatpoints.chat_text: I need lots of snow, say about 20 snowballs, and probably 4 sturdy logs. That sound all right?

replies.reply_text: Not a problem! Be right back!

chatpoints.chat_text: Great! Let's see them!

replies.reply_text: Here they are.
Great! This is pefect. Thanks so much! Good luck with your snowballs!

chatpoints.chat_text: Hmmmm.... Sounds like you need some sort of special Christmas ornament.  Sorry, I don't do the ornaments, go see Jilly or ask at the big house.

replies.reply_text: That's okay... I'll keep asking around. (You duck as a snowball goes whizzing past your shoulder.) Missed again! Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: Yup, I did.  He's hanging out in that Christmas tree next to Santa's workshop.  I've been watching him eye every person that's been visiting Santa!  He looks very sneaky, too.

replies.reply_text: Oh, really?  Which tree did you say?

chatpoints.chat_text: The one on the right of Santa's workshop and just across from my house here.  He's hanging out pretty high up there and I'm sure if you have the right tool, you'll be able to spot him!

replies.reply_text: Thanks so much, Dilly!

chatpoints.chat_text: Come to think of it... I haven't.  Not since you asked about him before!  Maybe he's gone to a more tropical location.  You know, something more suited for a monkey?

replies.reply_text: Thanks Dilly.  Maybe I'll check back with the President of the Monk, errr with Matata and see if he knows what's up.

npc_list.name: Jilly Chilly
npc_list.admin_description: & New quests must start on CP 8
npc_list.long_description: Jilly Chilly is a girl elf. She is dressed mostly in green with a little red.

chatpoints.chat_text: Hi there! You must be cold after that long trip up here. I'm sorry, I would offer you some eggnog, but I just finished the last of it.

replies.reply_text: That's okay.  I don't really like eggnog anyway.  Can I ask what you're doing?
It's too cold here!  I'm going to find some place warmer.
That's okay. I'm actually wondering if you can make something special to carry a Winter Lotus blossom in so that it won't melt?

No thanks, what I really came for is some help.  I have this poem with clues, and it says to go to the land of the holiday snow and get from its most famous resident something to show.  Do you have any suggestions?
Hi, Jilly.  Have you seen a monkey around here or on Christmas Isle?

chatpoints.chat_text: I'm busy making toys for next Christmas.  There's a lot to do between now and December 24th!

replies.reply_text: Yeah I bet... Good luck! I'd better be going.
Maybe you need more elves!  I think being an elf would be fun!

chatpoints.chat_text: Would you like to be a temporary elf?  I could really use the help!

replies.reply_text: Sure! Where are the pointy shoes and funny hat?
No... That sounds like too much work. Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: Great!  Santa asked me to finish filling some stockings, but I've run out of candy canes.  I need 25 more to finish these.

replies.reply_text: Wow, that's a lot!  But I'll see what I can do.
25? No way!  I'm off to pet a reindeer!

chatpoints.chat_text: Thanks! There should be a lot to pick right now.

replies.reply_text: Okay, 25 candy canes coming right up!

chatpoints.chat_text: Wow, back already?

replies.reply_text: Yes, and here are the 25 candy canes you needed.
Yes, but I couldn't get all that you needed.

chatpoints.chat_text: If you look around, I'm sure there are more.

replies.reply_text: Okay, I'll be back as soon as I can. Bye.
Okay, bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: Hello!  I gave the finished stockings to Santa.  He was very pleased to have them done.  The next time I need a temporary elf, I'll be sure to look you up!

replies.reply_text: Hi, Jilly.  Have you seen a monkey around here or on Christmas Isle?
That would be great!  Bye.
I'm actually wondering if you can make something special to carry a Winter Lotus blossom in so that it won't melt?

No thanks, what I really came for is some help.  I have this poem with clues, and it says to go to the land of the holiday snow and get from its most famous resident something to show.  Do you have any suggestions?

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, that's really not my specialty. You might try asking Dilly Chilly instead.

replies.reply_text: Okay, thanks. Bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: I doubt it. I make toys, and that sounds like you need a special type of ornament.  Go ask Dilly, or maybe up at the main house.  One of them should be able to help.

replies.reply_text: Okay, thanks anyway.  Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: No, I haven't.  But you can check with Santa or Dilly.  Dilly does enough monkeying around that I'm sure he's attracted a whole lot!  Hehehe.

replies.reply_text: Thanks, Jilly!   Bye!

npc_list.name: Reindeer
npc_list.long_description: Reindeer is big and brown with a huge rack of antlers. He has a reddish nose and what appears to be a silly grin.

chatpoints.chat_text: Ppppnnuuuuhhhh (The reindeer looks up at you inquisitively.)

replies.reply_text: Hi there!  Do you know where Santa is?
(Pet the reindeer.)
See ya!
Mrs. Claus wanted you to have these. (Give the Reindeer 3 carrot treats.)

chatpoints.chat_text: Nnneeeeeerrrrrrrrtttttttttthhh (The reindeer shakes his head northward.)

replies.reply_text: Thanks!
Do you know where Santa is?
(Pet the reindeer.)
See ya!
I think I'll go tell Mrs. Claus that you seemed to like them.

npc_list.name: Ryland
npc_list.admin_description: &  New Quests must begin at CP12
npc_list.long_description: Ryland is dressed in camouflaged pants and shirt. He is wearing a matching baseball cap.

chatpoints.chat_text: I do indeed.  Unfortunately, I have lost my bow in the woods to the southeast.

replies.reply_text: Oh, how sad!  Maybe I could find it for you!
That's too bad, but I'm not really in the mood to help you.  See ya later!

chatpoints.chat_text: Greetings, stranger.  How are you this fine day?

replies.reply_text: Good.  I see you have a lot of hunting trophies.
Good.  Have a good day!
I found your bow!
Hello Ryland, may I test the Liza's Leaky Bucket quest, please?  I've got an axe if you know how to use a whetstone...
So sorry to bother you again, Ryland, but where did you say Archy went?
Greetings, Ryland. I'm trying to find Archy for Mehitabel.  Oliver Oates said he was on his way to see you.

chatpoints.chat_text: You would be willing to search for my precious bow?

replies.reply_text: Of course!  I'll be back before you know it!  Ah... Where did you say you lost it?
Nah, I don't think I want to.

chatpoints.chat_text: In the forest to the southeast.  Try looking in the section directly east of the road that goes to the beach.

replies.reply_text: Thanks!  Off I go.
Thank you, sir!  Try not to lose it again.

chatpoints.chat_text: Welcome back! Thank you so much for finding my bow.

replies.reply_text: I was starting to look, but forgot where you wanted me to look for clues.
No problem!  How have things been going for you?
Yep.  See ya.
Guess what!  I found a clue!
I've found your whetstone!
Hi, Ryland. I'm trying to find Archy for Mehitabel.  Oliver Oates said he was on his way to see you.
So sorry to bother you again, Ryland, but where did you say Archy went?
I will, I promise.

chatpoints.chat_text: Good.  I've seem to become quite the butterfingers, though.

replies.reply_text: Really?  How so?
Really?  I'm sorry.  You should learn to be more careful. Bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, as it just so happens, I managed to drop my whetstone.  Now I can't sharpen my knives.

replies.reply_text: That's horrible!  Would you like me to go look for it for you?
That's too bad.  Good luck finding it.

chatpoints.chat_text: You did, did you?  Well then, let's hear it.

replies.reply_text: I found where you dropped it, and there were tracks that went back into town.
Nah, I don't think I'll tell you.  I'll just find it on my own.
All right.  I'll come back when I find something out.
Don't worry about it.  I'm glad I could help.

chatpoints.chat_text: Welcome back!  I can't thank you enough for finding my things.

replies.reply_text: Don't mention it.
You're welcome! Say, Ryland, one of those things I found for you was a whetstone, wasn't it? Do you happen to know how to use a whetstone?
Don't mention it.  And thank you for helping me with that axe!   I've got to run it back up to Cedric now.  Bye!
Don't mention it.
Hi, Ryland. I'm trying to find Archy for Mehitabel.  Oliver Oates said he was on his way to see you.
So sorry to bother you again, Ryland, but where did you say Archy went?

chatpoints.chat_text: Welcome back.  How did the hunt go?

replies.reply_text: Not well.  I'll keep looking.
What was I looking for again?
Great!  I found your bow!

chatpoints.chat_text: My precious bow.  In the forest to the southeast.  Try looking in the section directly east of the road that goes to the beach.  You might try checking near a fallen log.  I remember tripping over one before I lost my bow.

replies.reply_text: Oh, right.  I'll go start checking.

chatpoints.chat_text: Of course I know how to use a whetstone!  Is this some sort of trick question?

replies.reply_text: Sorry... This whole bucket thing has made me a little bonkers, I think.  Would you mind putting a precision edge on this axe for me?

chatpoints.chat_text: Oooh, you know... (Smacks lips thirstily.) My whetstone is much too dry to be used right now... (Smack, smack.)

replies.reply_text: Wait, don't tell me.  I don't even want to know what you need.   I'm outta here.
So, what is it I can do to help?  You need me to take the whetstone to the Lady of the Lake, or something?
I can certainly do that for you.  I'll be right back.

chatpoints.chat_text: Hi! Did you bring back the pail of water? (Smack, smack)

replies.reply_text: Pail of water, pail of water... I'll remember this time.  It's amazing what you can forget in the short time it takes to cross the road.
Yep!  I've got it right here.
You know... that's horse water.  The bucket might not have been all that sanitary.

chatpoints.chat_text: (Ahhhhh!) Much better. Now for that whetstone.

replies.reply_text: Ah, okay!  Back to the matter at hand.  How long will it take to...
Nevermind.  Things just got too weird.  I'll see you later.
That's fine.  It only has to stay sharp for a few little intricate cuts.  Thanks very much, Ryland!
Okay, hope you enjoy the soup, and I'm off on the road to Shellton!  Take care, Ryland.

chatpoints.chat_text: That's all right, Archy said he was going on to Shellton next.

replies.reply_text: Shellton...that means he was heading to Ollie Scooper.  Thaks for the help, Ryland!

npc_list.name: Dalton
npc_list.admin_description: & New quests start at CP12. After Dalton's Recovery need to bring him back to Treeton before new quests- adjust req on Isle of Hardly Dalton visibility.
npc_list.long_description: Dalton is a good man. People from all over come to him for advice or at least his opinion.

chatpoints.chat_text: Come in, come in.  I'm not feeling quite myself.

replies.reply_text: I'm sorry.  Is there something I could do to help?
Ugh! You're sick?  I'm outta here!
I'm back with your medicine!
I'm sorry you're not feeling well.  I was just wondering if you knew anything about Ryland's missing whetstone.
I'm a scripter, and all I care about is testing Puff the Magic Dragon.

chatpoints.chat_text: Eh?  You'd really like to help us out?

replies.reply_text: Of course! Just tell me what to do.
Well... maybe not.  Hope you feel better soon. Bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: Sasha, up at the General Store, has some medicine for me, but my poor grandson doesn't want to leave me alone.  Will you run up to the store and pick it up for me?

replies.reply_text: Sure. I'll be back before you know it!
Well... maybe not.  Hope you feel better soon. Bye!
Get feeling better soon, Dalton.
No problem.  Be back soon.

chatpoints.chat_text: Thank you very much for getting that medicine for me.

replies.reply_text: No problem.  Are you feeling any better?
You're welcome.  I gotta go.
I'm glad I could help.  Hey...  I was just wondering, do you know anything about Ryland's missing whetstone?

You're very welcome.  I've brought you something else that might help you feel better.  I thought you might like this beautiful <font color='#990099'>purple</font> and <font color='#FF00FF'>fuchsia</font> rug.
I forgot to ask how the rug worked out!  I'd like to mention it to Linnea.

chatpoints.chat_text: Yep, a bit.  I just need some more rest.

replies.reply_text: Well, I will leave you to sleep.  Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: Ryland's lost his whetstone, has he?  Nope. I'm afraid I don't know anything about it.  I'm sorry.

replies.reply_text: That's all right.  Hope you're feeling better!
Please take it, compliments of Linnea of Crystalton. She sent me with the rugs to give to people who might enjoy them...

chatpoints.chat_text: This is such a treat, and purple is my favorite color!  Why did you think of me?

replies.reply_text: Temperance mentioned to me that she thought you'd like it, and it might help you feel better.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, how right she was!  Temperance is such a good mayor.  If you plan to see her again soon, could you please tell Temperance how much I appreciate it?

replies.reply_text: I'll be happy to do that.
I don't have time to do that.  I still have one rug to deliver.  Bye.
That's wonderful.  Linnea will be so pleased.

chatpoints.chat_text: Welcome! Thank you very much for all that you've done for me!

replies.reply_text: No problem.  Are you feeling better?
No problem.  I should be going.  Bye!
Glad I could help, but now I'm looking for Archy.  Have you seen him recently?
So sorry to bother you again, Dalton, but where did you say Archy went?

chatpoints.chat_text: (He raises a finger to ask you to "Hold on" while he coughs heavily. His grandson Justin reaches across you to hand him a glass of water.)

replies.reply_text: I guess that's my answer...
I'm sorry you're obviously not doing great.  I'll just leave you be.

chatpoints.chat_text: (Points to Justin.)

replies.reply_text: Okay, I'll talk to him.

chatpoints.chat_text: (Smiles at you in between coughs, and gives you a thumbs-up.)

replies.reply_text: Right on.

chatpoints.chat_text: (He waves at you from his bed. You can tell from the gray of his face that he's not well, but he looks cheerful enough.)

replies.reply_text: Hi Dalton! I just stopped by to see how you were doing.

Hi Dalton! I've come from Fluff. I met Petunia the unicorn, and Astrid, the star you saved. Astrid's sent you Stardust and Petunia's given you her last Unicorn Horn Serum... but I'm afraid the Isle of Hardly is doing poorly, too.
Dalton, what was I doing for you?
Dalton, what was I doing for you?
Dalton, I'm back! I had Martha make that cake for you, with the Stardust and the Unicorn Horn Serum, and some other magic besides. Here, see if it helps you!
Hi Dalton! I hope you're feeling better! What was I doing for you?
Dalton, look who I brought!
Dalton, what was I doing for you?

chatpoints.chat_text: (Dalton waves you closer. In between coughs, he says: ) Had... idea. (Pushes a grubby piece of paper into your hand.)

replies.reply_text: Uh... well, I'll see what I can do with this...

chatpoints.chat_text: Stardust... Horn serum... Martha... (He scrabbles in his bedside table. You try to help him, but Justin gets there first, and hands him whatever he was after.)

replies.reply_text: What's that?

chatpoints.chat_text: (Points to the picture in your hand.)

replies.reply_text: Oh... Okay, well, I'll see how I can move on with that.

chatpoints.chat_text: (Dalton gestures you closer, while Justin, looking skeptical but intrigued, gets a plate and cuts the cake in half for his grandfather.)

replies.reply_text: Bon appetit!

chatpoints.chat_text: (Takes one bite, then another.)

replies.reply_text: I'll do that! I'm so glad it seems to be making a difference!

chatpoints.chat_text: Yes, I do feel much better! Did you take the cake to my friend Fluff?

replies.reply_text: On my way!

chatpoints.chat_text: Fluff! My old friend Fluff! (Dalton jumps from his bed to embrace the dragon. Out of the corner of your eye, you see Justin looking completely poleaxed!)

replies.reply_text: The cake Martha baked for both of you fixed up Fluff, and the Isle of Hardly! Isn't that the isle you meant when you were talking to Justin- the place where you were cured as a child?

chatpoints.chat_text: (To your vast shock, Dalton jumps on Fluff's tail, and the two fly off!)

replies.reply_text: Well, I think that's a first... a dragon flying a man out of his own bedroom! What do you think, Justin? Uh, Justin?

chatpoints.chat_text: (He coughs again, long and hard, and hardly has the breath to talk after; but he mimes forking something into his mouth.)

replies.reply_text: I'm not sure what you meant with the cake picture, but I'm working on it, I promise.
Yes, the cake! I have it! I had Martha make it for you, with the Stardust and the Unicorn Horn Serum, and some other magic besides. Here, see if it helps you!

npc_list.name: Larissa
npc_list.long_description: Larissa likes everything pink and frilly. Her clothes and her house are very girly.

chatpoints.chat_text: Welcome darlin'!

replies.reply_text: Hi! How are you today?
Goodbye!
Hi.  I'm looking for Ryland's whetstone.  Do you know anything about what might have happened to it?
I'm back, and I have a clue about your missing cloak.
Look Larissa!  I've got your cloak!
Kaliska got you a gift!  She asked me to deliver it for her.

chatpoints.chat_text: Nope.  I'm afraid I haven't got a clue.  I mean, I know he dropped it, the poor thing, but beyond that, I haven't the foggiest.

replies.reply_text: That's all right.  Thank you anyway.

chatpoints.chat_text: I'm just wonderful!  Except, someone's stolen my favorite pink cloak!

replies.reply_text: Stolen?  Hmm..  That's too bad.  I'll leave you so you can find it.
Stolen?  Are you sure?  Maybe you just misplaced it.

chatpoints.chat_text: No.  It's been stolen for sure!  I just don't know who the culprit is.

replies.reply_text: That's not good.  Would you like me to try finding out who stole it?
That's not good.  Well, good luck with that.  Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: You bet I would!  I'd try talkin' to the folks up in the north part of town.  The mayor lives up there, so most of the people that come into town drop by up there to say hello.  I bet someone up there saw something!

replies.reply_text: All right.  I'll be back as soon as I learn anything.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, do tell!

replies.reply_text: Jaelyn's friend, Nadine, was wearing a pink cloak when she was visiting the other day.

chatpoints.chat_text: Nadine?  She lives in Earton, doesn't she?  You'll go see if that was my cloak, won't you?

replies.reply_text: Of course!

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, my!  Did Nadine have it then?  I never would have thought Nadine a thief.

replies.reply_text: No, no.  Nadine had just borrowed it from Valarie.

chatpoints.chat_text: Valarie!?  In Chillton?  Why, I'd never have thought her capable of stealing, either.

replies.reply_text: She didn't steal it!  She found it in the woods!

chatpoints.chat_text: Found it? In the woods?  But that means that I... I lost it!  Oh no!  And here I was, ready to accuse everyone!  How horrible of me!  Here, take this, as a reward for helping me.

replies.reply_text: Thank you so much.  Keep a good hold on that cloak of yours!

chatpoints.chat_text: Welcome back!  Might I ask you to do a teensy little favor for me?

replies.reply_text: I'd be glad to!
Bye Larissa.
Kaliska got a gift for you!  She asked me to deliver it for her.

chatpoints.chat_text: See, I prepared these two gifts, one for Nadine, and the other for Valarie.  To say sorry for accusing them of stealing my cloak.  Would you deliver them for me?

replies.reply_text: That was very nice of you.  Of course I'll deliver them.  Uh... Where was it they lived again?
That was very nice of you.  Of course I'll deliver them.
Maybe I won't.  I'll come back later, though.

chatpoints.chat_text: Nadine is in Earton, and Valarie lives in Chillton.  I'm sorry that they both live so out of the way.

replies.reply_text: It's all right.  I'll deliver these right away.

chatpoints.chat_text: All right.  And when you've finished with that, if you come back, I'll give you a little something for your troubles.

replies.reply_text: I'll be back soon, then.  Bye Larissa!

chatpoints.chat_text: Really?  What did they say?

replies.reply_text: Both Nadine and Valarie said it's all right.  Neither has any hard feelings, and they both forgive you.
Thank you so much.  I'm glad I could be of such help!

chatpoints.chat_text: That would be great.  I'm sorry that they both live so out of the way.

replies.reply_text: It's all right.  I'll deliver these right away.

chatpoints.chat_text: Did you get the gifts delivered?

replies.reply_text: I did.
Not yet...  Where did Valarie and Nadine live again?
Not yet...  I'll get right on that.

chatpoints.chat_text: Nadine is in Earton and Valarie is in Chillton.  It's a bit far, but if you come back after you deliver the gifts, I'll give you a little something.

replies.reply_text: All right.  I'll get right on that.

chatpoints.chat_text: Thank you so much for all you've done for me.  It is greatly appreciated.

replies.reply_text: Anytime.
Kaliska got you a gift!  She asked me to deliver it for her.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, she did?  That's so thoughtful of her.  What is it?

replies.reply_text: Here you are.
I'm glad you enjoy it.  Palila made it.
Well, enjoy the box.  Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, it's just wonderful.  Let her know she did a lovely job.

replies.reply_text: I will.  Bye.

npc_list.name: Parry
npc_list.long_description: Parry is a man that lives simple. He has brownish hair and nice eyes.

chatpoints.chat_text: You can come on in, if you want. There's not much here for you, though.

replies.reply_text: Oh, thank you, but I think I'm just gonna go.
Thank you.  I just dropped in to ask if you knew anything about Ryland's lost whetstone.
I see you aren't into clutter, are you?

chatpoints.chat_text: Ryland's whetstone?  Is that who this thing belongs to?

replies.reply_text: Yes.  Do you have it, then?
Thanks so much!

chatpoints.chat_text: Clutter? No, I don't do clutter - unlike others I could mention.

replies.reply_text: Oh, go ahead and mention. I have found people that have clutter tend to lose things, and I like looking for lost things.
Yeah, I prefer to avoid clutter myself. I also like to avoid conversation. I'll just go now.

chatpoints.chat_text: You like searching for lost things? (Gets a faraway look in his eye.)

replies.reply_text: Sure! Did you lose something?
No, not really. Bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: I did lose something. (Scratches his head.) Maybe I should say someone.

replies.reply_text: This is not something I want to be involved with. I'll just leave you to your memories.
Oh, a lost love? This sounds like a story I would like to hear.

chatpoints.chat_text: It is quite a story. (He goes to a cabinet and pulls out a box.)

replies.reply_text: You keep mementoes? Somehow that surprises me.
Oh, I'm not really interested.

chatpoints.chat_text: Ah, yes, there is a very special memento in this box. It really belongs to my long lost love.

replies.reply_text: Oh, well, at least you have something to remember her by. See ya!
Oh, do you want some help getting it back to her?

chatpoints.chat_text: If I only knew where she was, I would do that. Maybe you have seen her in your travels?

replies.reply_text: I've seen a lot of people. Can you give me a description?

chatpoints.chat_text: She loved winter and the snow. She never liked it here because we have no snow. And... (Shudders)

replies.reply_text: What? What is it?

chatpoints.chat_text: She... she collects... she collects EVERYTHING! She used to say she collects collections. (Shudders again) The last I heard she was collecting miniature horses.

replies.reply_text: Miniature horses? I think I remember hearing about someone that collected those. Maybe I can find her. If I can, what do you want me to do?
I don't want to bother with this.

chatpoints.chat_text: If you could find her, you could take her this miniature stable. I had it made for her to house her horses.

replies.reply_text: Sure, I could do that. I'll try my best to find her.
What a silly idea. I am not going to help you do that.
I'll get right on it.

chatpoints.chat_text: Were you able to deliver the stable to my long lost love?

replies.reply_text: Oh, wow! Thanks for reminding me. I completely forgot what I was supposed to be doing.
Yes! She sent you a letter. Here it is.
Well, okay. Umm, you're welcome.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, hello there!  I'm so glad you've come to visit me.  Would you like a cookie?

replies.reply_text: I'd love a cookie!
No, thank you.
Um...  No thanks.  I was wondering if you knew anything about Ryland's missing whetstone.
No thanks.  That's a beautiful piano you have over there.
Hi there.  I don't know if you remember me, but you gave me a delicious cookie once.
Thank you so very much. Bye!
Thank you.  Hey, do you know anything about Ryland's missing whetstone?

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, let's see here...  I remember him telling me he'd lost it over a plate of cookies... but I'm afraid I don't know what became of it.  I'm sorry.

replies.reply_text: That's all right.  Thank you anyway.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, thank you, sweetie.  I'm not very good at playing it, though.  I was hoping someone could show me how to play a song.

replies.reply_text: I could play a song... depending on what you had in mind.
I don't play piano.  Sorry.

chatpoints.chat_text: That's all right.  You can try if you like.  Just fiddle with the keys for a bit until you get the tune down.

replies.reply_text: Hmm...  I guess I could try that.  What song did you have in mind?
Naw, I don't have time to do that now.  Good luck finding someone.  Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: It would be great if you could play all of Twinkle Twinkle.  I know it's long, but I'll give you a bit of a reward for it.

replies.reply_text: Okay, I'll try.
Okay, I'll try.  Do you have any hints on how to start?
Umm, I'm not going to be able to play that.  Sorry.  Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: Sure, dear; start on C, the lowest note.  Then you'll have to make a bit of a jump.  Up to the fifth note, I believe.  The middle of the song starts on that same note you jump to after C in the beginning, I believe.

replies.reply_text: All right.  This may be difficult.
All right.  I'll give it a try.

chatpoints.chat_text: I'm sure you'll do great.

replies.reply_text: Wow, these are great.  Now, about that question...

chatpoints.chat_text: Awww, I thought you said my cookies were delicious!

replies.reply_text: All right, since you insist!  Thank you!
No, really.  I just want to ask you something, since you bake.

chatpoints.chat_text: All right then, what would you like to know?

replies.reply_text: Do you bake wedding cakes?  Not for me--it's for Princess Lilianna!

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, sorry, no; I only bake cookies. I don't know what it is, all my cakes turn out flat. Sometimes they run all over the bottom of the oven, and, honestly, I look at it and think, "I didn't put that much batter in there, did I?"

replies.reply_text: That's too bad.  Oh, well, do you know anyone who bakes cakes?

chatpoints.chat_text:
Cakes... cakes... Hmmm, let me think, cakes........
Oh! Yes, I remember now, there's a lady on Saddle Isle who bakes cakes, as I recall. And there's a lady in Flipperton, too, but she only bakes fruitcakes. And whatever you do, don't ask Minnie at the food store!

replies.reply_text: Well, I'll look around there, then.  Thanks a lot!

chatpoints.chat_text: Why, yes, of course I remember you!  Come in and sit down.  Would you like a cookie?  I have some just made!

replies.reply_text: Oh, yes, please!
No thanks, I just wanted to ask you a question.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, come in, come in. Make yourself at home.

replies.reply_text: Thank you.  I just came to give you this.  It's from Octavio.
Ah, no thanks.  Bye!
Er... I was just wondering if you knew anything about Ryland's lost whetstone.
Thanks.  I noticed that easel in the corner.  What's that for?
Thanks.  I will.

chatpoints.chat_text: Hmm...  Maybe I do.  Go give a chat to Parry.  I think he might know where it is.

replies.reply_text: Thanks a bunch.

chatpoints.chat_text: Octavio?  What on earth could this be?  Let's see...  Oh, my...  Why, I never knew.  What a sweet man!  Would you take something back to him for me?

replies.reply_text: I'd be glad to!
I'll hurry.  I promise.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, that.  I was going to have a painting done.

replies.reply_text: I could do it for you.
Interesting.  Well, I should be going.

chatpoints.chat_text: Really?  Well, there's nothing too odd about it.  Just a brown squirrel holding a tan and orange acorn.  Oh, the trees there are gray and the shrubs tend to be lighter than the grass...  Oh, and don't forget the black eyes!

replies.reply_text: Hmm...  All right.

chatpoints.chat_text: Make sure not to get paint anywhere other than on the canvas, please!

replies.reply_text: I'll be careful...

chatpoints.chat_text: Wonderful!  Oh, are you interested in a very odd quiz challenge?  The questions are a bit out of this world, but maybe you will get them.

replies.reply_text: Hmm...  Sounds creepy.  I think I'll pass.  Bye!
Sure!  I love challenges!

chatpoints.chat_text: Great!  Then I will bet you $1000 that you can't answer them all.  If you get any wrong, I keep your money.  If you get them all right, I'll give you 10 times more!

replies.reply_text: Umm...  Being I have no idea what these questions are going to be, I think I'll pass.
Sure! Let's do it! (Hand her $1000.)
I changed my mind.  You can keep my $1000, but I'm out of here.
Okay.  I'm ready.

chatpoints.chat_text: INCORRECT!  That was not the correct answer.  I'm sorry, but I have won this challenge.  Try again sometime, if you would like!

replies.reply_text: Drat.  All right.  I'll try again later.
I think I'll go see if I can find some of these answers somewhere.  Bye!

Blue

Jon and Amanda

Trim

replies.reply_text: Strength and Speed
Agility and Intelligence
Speed and Endurance

replies.reply_text: To give players free money and horses.
Giving a step-to-step guide for all quests.

npc_list.name: Octavio
npc_list.admin_description: & New quests must start on CP 10
npc_list.long_description: Octavio is a bachelor. He doesn't mind living in a mess and he eats mostly easy microwave meals.

chatpoints.chat_text: Come in and make yourself at home.  Just don't mind the mess.

replies.reply_text: Oh, um... All right.  What's with all the papers?
No, I think I'll be going.
Hey, do you think it's possible that you have Ryland's lost whetstone somewhere in this mess?

chatpoints.chat_text: I suppose it's possible, but I don't think so.  I'll keep an eye out, though, just in case it managed to fly in through the window.

replies.reply_text: All right.  Thanks.

chatpoints.chat_text: Those?  Those are just letters.  See, I'll write a letter to Vianca, letting her know how I feel about her and all, but then I chicken out before I can deliver it, so it just gets added to the mess.

replies.reply_text: Oh, my.  Why don't you just deliver your letter to her?
Huh.  I'll leave you to your problems.

chatpoints.chat_text: I'm afraid, see.  Her house is so tidy and clean, while mine...  Well, you can see how mine is.

replies.reply_text: I can see.  Hey, why don't I deliver the letter for you?  That way you won't be able to chicken out.
Yeah.  It's a mess.  I can't stand it anymore.  Goodbye.

chatpoints.chat_text: You would?  Could you?  I mean, I don't want to trouble you with such a silly task as that.

replies.reply_text: I don't mind!
I'll hurry over to Vianca's.  Don't worry!  I'm sure she'll love it!

chatpoints.chat_text: A rose?  Is this... Is this from Vianca?

replies.reply_text: Yes, it is!

chatpoints.chat_text: Why, I'll be... Thank you so much!  Here, I don't have very much, but you're welcome to it!  This just... oh... You have no idea what this means to me!

replies.reply_text: You're welcome!  I hope things go well between you two.

chatpoints.chat_text: So?  How'd it go?  Did she read the letter?

replies.reply_text: She did, and I have something for you.
Oh, I haven't gone yet.  Sorry.

chatpoints.chat_text: You still have the letter?  Hurry and give it to Vianca before I can change my mind and take it back!
Thank you so much for delivering that letter!  I've been writing more letters to her, and I've already delivered some to her myself.

replies.reply_text: That's great!  Good luck with your letter-writing!
Hey, do you think it's possible you have Ryland's lost whetstone somewhere in this mess?

npc_list.name: Jaelyn
npc_list.long_description: Jaelyn is dressed in khaki capris with a coordinating top and a straw hat.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh... um, come in.  Hope you're not going to stay long.  I was just thinking about taking a walk through the woods.

replies.reply_text: I won't keep you, then.
I just wanted to know if you knew anything about Ryland's lost whetstone.
Hi.  Kaliska said she lent you Nolan's book.  May I have it back to return to him?
I'm back!  Guess what, I found it!
Um... Mayor Temperance said she remembered seeing someone with a pink cloak coming to visit you.  I was just wondering if you could tell me who it was.
Larissa's pink cloak is missing.  Have you seen it?

chatpoints.chat_text: Ryland's lost his whetstone, has he?  That boy will never learn, I tell ya.  No, I'm afraid I don't know where he's lost it, or what might have happened to it.

replies.reply_text: All right.  Thank you.  Enjoy your hike.

chatpoints.chat_text: Um... Oh dear... I'm afraid you can't.  You see, I lost his book while I was taking a walk.  I looked everywhere for it, but I just couldn't find it.  I'm so horribly sorry!

replies.reply_text: Well... That's all right.  Maybe I can find it.

chatpoints.chat_text: You'd be willing to look for it?  Even though I tried and failed?

replies.reply_text: You bet!

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, what a wonderful person you are!  I was walking in the bit of forest to the east of here.  I'm sure I stopped on a rock pile to read for a bit.  Though I'm sure I checked all the rock piles.  Good luck!  I hope you find it.  If you do, come back.

replies.reply_text: I'll find it in no time.

chatpoints.chat_text: You did!?  Oh, that's wonderful!  Here, take this as a gift of my appreciation.  Thank you so much!  You better return that book to Nolan now.
A pink cloak?  Oh!  That was just my friend Nadine from Earton.  Why were you wondering?

replies.reply_text: Larissa thinks her pink cloak has been stolen.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, dear!  I don't think Nadine would be one to steal something like a pink cloak, but maybe you should go talk to her, just in case.

replies.reply_text: I will.  But first, I should go tell Larissa.

chatpoints.chat_text: My friend, Nadine from Earton, was in here wearing a pink cloak.

replies.reply_text: Larissa thinks her pink cloak has been stolen.

npc_list.name: Joylyn
npc_list.long_description: Joylyn is wearing a headband to keep her hair off of her face.

chatpoints.chat_text: Hi there!  What can I do for you?

replies.reply_text: Nothing. I will leave now. Thanks.
I was wondering...  What you are doing with all of these grasshoppers?
Are these grasshoppers for sale, or just to look at?
I don't suppose you know anything about Ryland's lost whetstone, do you?
I was just wondering if you'd seen anyone with a pink cloak walk by here.
Hello there! Since you know so much about grasshoppers, I was wondering if you knew about crickets.
Hi!  I was wondering if that brown goo that grasshoppers spit up is called "lac".

chatpoints.chat_text: All right, thanks for dropping by.
These grasshoppers are my personal collection, and are not for sale, but thanks for asking.

replies.reply_text: Oh...  Okay.

chatpoints.chat_text: I study them!  I plan on writing a detailed account of the fascinating lives and relationships of grasshoppers!

replies.reply_text: It just so happens that I have some grasshoppers!
Umm... I don't think I want to get involved in this.

chatpoints.chat_text: You do?  I will pay you $100 per grasshopper!

replies.reply_text: Okay, here is a grasshopper!
I guess I don't have any...  Sorry.
I have another one!
Okay, great.  Good luck with your 'friends'!

chatpoints.chat_text: Unless it was eaten by a grasshopper -- which I doubt -- then I'm afraid I've no clue.
A pink cloak?  You mean like Larissa's?  I do seem to recall seeing someone, but I don't know where they were going.  I'm sorry.

replies.reply_text: That's all right.  Thank you.

chatpoints.chat_text: Why, of course I do! Crickets and grasshoppers are closely related.

replies.reply_text: Perfect! One of the lighthouses is overrun with crickets. I'd like to know what would eat crickets?

chatpoints.chat_text: What? You want something to... EAT them? Those poor crickets! I won't help you do that. Please leave before you upset my grasshoppers.

replies.reply_text: Oops! Sorry.

chatpoints.chat_text: I've never heard it called that. Of course, my babies never spit the stuff onto me, but I've heard about it happening to those who scare the poor, sweet things. (Joylyn eyes you suspiciously)

replies.reply_text: Oh, I would never want to scare a grasshopper.  Don't worry!  I'll try somewhere else.

npc_list.name: Barnabas
npc_list.admin_description: & New quests start at CP19
npc_list.long_description: Barnabas is the husband of Caelin. He has very short blond hair and a crooked smile. His clothes don't match at all.

chatpoints.chat_text: Welcome to our home!  Do make yourself comfortable.

replies.reply_text: Ah, I think I'll pass.  Thanks though.
I'll only be staying a minute.  Do you know anything about Ryland's lost whetstone?
I will thanks!  It is a little cramped though.

chatpoints.chat_text: No, I daresay I don't.

replies.reply_text: Oh.  Well, thank you anyway.

chatpoints.chat_text: Yes well.  We are most comfortable when we are comfy.  Don't want all that open space letting the cold air flow around.

replies.reply_text: Oh, umm. Okay.  Well, have fun with that!  Bye!
I was able to complete your wife's horse challenge.  She's a smart one!
Anything you need done?

chatpoints.chat_text: That she is!  Actually, I have a challenge of my own.  If you know these isles well, you will have no problem with it.  You interested?

replies.reply_text: Sure!  That sounds like fun.  Same deal as with Caelin?
No thanks.  I don't know these isles quite well enough to do that I think.

chatpoints.chat_text: Actually, I have an interesting challenge.  If you know these isles well, you will have no problem with it.  You interested?

replies.reply_text: Sure!  I'm game!
No thanks.  I don't know these isles quite well enough to do that I think.

chatpoints.chat_text: Here's the deal.  You give me $1000 and if you get all the questions right you'll get 10 times that much back.  If you get any question wrong, I get to keep your $1000 though.

replies.reply_text: Sure! (Hand him $1000)
You know?  Maybe not this time.  I should figure out the isles a little better first.  Bye!
Okay.  I'm ready.
I changed my mind,  you can keep my $1000,  but I'm out of here.

replies.reply_text: Drats.  Okay, bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: Did he?  Oh, I'm sorry.  I lent it to Jaelyn in Treeton.  You'll have to go get it from her.

replies.reply_text: Oh.  All right.  Thank you!

chatpoints.chat_text: I have a painting of my old pony I would love done, but I haven't found anyone to do it yet.

replies.reply_text: I'll do it!
That's too bad.   I should be going.

chatpoints.chat_text: That would be wonderful.  She was an orange chestnut with a white spot on her rump.  She had beautiful black eyes and a golden mane.  It was always bright when she was around...  The tree's leaves were a bit on the dark side, compared to the rest of the surroundings though...

replies.reply_text: Well, I'll see what I can do.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, that's wonderful.  I actually got that as a gift for Larissa.  I haven't been feeling well, so I can't leave to deliver it to her.  Would you be able to deliver it for me?

replies.reply_text: Sure.  I can do that.  Where is she?
Umm....  Maybe later.
Okay.  Thanks.

chatpoints.chat_text: Leatherwork? No, but that reminds me of this one time, when I was a child. I was at camp, and we got to make little leather wallets! It was great fun. I wonder what happened to my little wallet?

replies.reply_text: I'm sorry, I have no clue. Thanks for your time.

npc_list.name: Reuben
npc_list.long_description: Reuben is wearing a big rubber nose, a cowboy hat, funny huge shoes and a clown outfit. He seems to think that it's normal to be dressed this way; even though he's home alone...

chatpoints.chat_text: Hello there!  Come on in and sit down.

replies.reply_text: You have quite the collection of fun stuff here.
No thanks.  Gotta go.  Bye.
Sabella's horse, Apples, is missing.  Have you seen or heard anything that might help?
I was just in Shellton and there is a woman up there with 3 kids that would love to have identical balloon animals for them.
Hi Reuben!  Did you ever work for a circus?
Hello Reuben.  Can you remind me who the turban-wearing performer was in the circus?
Thanks for the offer, but I can't stay. I was hoping to get two dozen balloons.
Hey there! Just poking my head in to ask if you know of anyone who works on leather?
I would but I am busy delivering packages from Pony Express. I've got one for you!

chatpoints.chat_text: Yep. I sure do like to entertain people.

replies.reply_text: You do seem happy.
Well, that's nice.  I should get going.  Bye

chatpoints.chat_text: I am.  I can make a balloon animal for you, if you want.  It will cost $15, though.

replies.reply_text: Cool!  Yeah, I'd love one!
Umm...  No thanks.  You're a bit too cheery for me.  I need to go.

chatpoints.chat_text: You know what?  I did see Apples walking by earlier today.  She was being led by a little boy.  I didn't see him well, though.

replies.reply_text: Really?  They were heading towards the forest?
Oh.  Well, thanks for the info.  I'll keep looking.
Thanks for the info!  I'll get right on that.
Hmm...  I don't think I want to try chatting with him, then.  I'm gonna go.  Thanks.
Where does he live?

chatpoints.chat_text: Just east of here in Moon Forest.  Follow the path and you'll find his rickety shack.

replies.reply_text: Thanks.
Neat!  Thanks!
Oh, I didn't realize I was a bit low on money.  Sorry.  Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: Hmm...  All right.  I can do that.  I'll make the three, but it will cost $35.

replies.reply_text: All right.  That's fine.
But she didn't give me money for that.  Too bad for her.  I'll be going now.
Hopefully.  Thanks.  I'll bring these to her now.
Oh, sorry.  I didn't realize I was low on money.  Off I go.

chatpoints.chat_text: As a matter of fact, I did!  I entertained many children with my act.  Those were the good old days.

replies.reply_text: What happened?

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, we had a great show, but we saw less attendance as time went on.  People started complaining that our acts were too scary for little kids.  I guess it just went out of fashion.  Finally, the circus closed.

replies.reply_text: What happened to all the performers?

chatpoints.chat_text: We settled all over the place... We were very well traveled and we each had our favorite spots.  Now I'm thinking of getting a job as a rodeo clown.  Rodeos are much more popular than circuses.

replies.reply_text: That's a shame about the circus.  You wouldn't happen to remember a performer who wore a turban and a tuxedo in his act, would you?
Thank you very much, Reuben, you've been extremely helpful. Best of luck on the rodeo clown endeavor!

chatpoints.chat_text: Gritty.  I don't know where he is now, though.

replies.reply_text: Thanks.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, of course - The mesmerist act. The Great Grittini was the name of the act. He was a little scary, I guess. Gritty was a bit gruff in manner, and he had beady black eyes...
