(Reuben shudders.) Well, his act was more than slight-of-hand and tricks. It seemed like the real thing to me.

replies.reply_text: Mesmerist.... You mean hypnotism?

chatpoints.chat_text: Two dozen? That's a nice sized order. Things have been slow lately. Not as many parties as there used to be. I would be happy to fill that order. I charge $15 per balloon.

replies.reply_text: Hmmm. That's more than I wanted to spend. Would you be willing to discount the price to $300?
I understand. If my calculations are correct, that will cost me $360. Darn it! I'll have to run to the bank. Be back in a jiffy!

chatpoints.chat_text: Make it $325 and you've got a deal!

replies.reply_text: Fantastic! I've got the money right here.
No thanks. That's still more than I want to spend on a bunch of balloons.
Thanks a ton. These balloons are bound to make anyone who sees them smile!

chatpoints.chat_text: Can't say I do. Therefore, I won't say that I do! Ha, ha, ha!

replies.reply_text: Gee, a funny man. Thanks a lot. Not!
Well thanks. I guess.

npc_list.name: Adrianna
npc_list.admin_description: New quests must start at CP4
npc_list.long_description: Adrianna is an athletic young woman with shoulder length green hair. She is wearing overalls with a bright pink shirt.

chatpoints.chat_text: Hello! Can you please help us! Our favorite horse WildFire has gone missing!

replies.reply_text: I'm sorry. I do not have time right now. Goodbye.
Sure, I guess I can try to help. Where did you last see him?
I have news of WildFire!
Sabella's horse, Apples, is missing too!
Sorry, I can't help right now, but Dr. Heimlich told me that your cat has recently had kittens, would you have any white ones?
Okay.  Well...  I'm off!

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, really? Excellent. Please tell me!

replies.reply_text: He told me that he is happy now being free, and that he does not want to come back...

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh my...  Well...    I suppose...   I was worried he was lost.  I guess as long as he is happy, that's what is most important. Thank you so much for your help.

replies.reply_text: I was happy to help.  Goodbye.

chatpoints.chat_text: Thanks for your help finding WildFire... Even though he did not return, we are grateful to know that he is okay!

replies.reply_text: No problem!  Bye.
That's great that Wildfire's fine...  but now another horse is missing!  Sabella's mare, Apples.
That's okay, but I need to ask you a question...Dr. Heimlich told me that your cat has recently had kittens, would you have any white ones?
You're welcome.  I was wondering though, I need to find Ted Capocella's racing saddle and he remembers letting you borrow it.  Do you still have it?
Thank you! Whenever I see Wildfire, he seems to be doing great. I just wanted to stop in and let you know that. Have a great day!

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, that's terrible!  I know how she feels.  I wish I could help, but I've been so caught up with my problem with Wildfire, that I haven't noticed anything else.  I'm sorry.

replies.reply_text: That's all right.   You have a lot on your mind.  Thanks anyway.

chatpoints.chat_text: Let's see, Queenie had 5 kittens, a real assortment of colors and markings, but not a solid color in the bunch!  Sorry, want one any way...Please???

replies.reply_text: No thanks, I need to find a white kitten...I'm sure you'll find good homes for these kittens.  Bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: Yeah, I remember that.  I was wanting to try racing and he was allowing me to borrow it.  Unfortunately it seems one of the straps broke.  You'll need to have it fixed.

replies.reply_text: I don't have much time for that right now.  I'll come back and pick it up later.
Do you know who might be able to fix it?
Okay, thank you.

npc_list.name: Faustus
npc_list.admin_description: &New Quests must start at CP12
npc_list.long_description: Faustus lives without indoor plumbing... this helps keep people away which is what he wants.

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, I saw Elliott walk by earlier leading an Appaloosa.

replies.reply_text: That must have been Apples!  Do you know where they went?
An Appaloosa?  I wonder if that was Apples...
That couldn't have been Apples.  I did all that work and you didn't even have good info!

chatpoints.chat_text: Go away!  I don't want any visitors!

replies.reply_text: Why not?
Sorry. Bye.
But I was told you might be able to help me....
Sabella's horse was taken.  Have you seen anything that might help me find her?
I'm sorry to bother you, but Bruno said that Archy was coming to see you the other day. Might he still be here?
Just a fast question, Faustus.  Where was Archy heading again?

chatpoints.chat_text: Because I like my quiet, and I don't need people just wandering around in my house.  Now go away!

replies.reply_text: All right, all right!   Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: Help you?!  Help you with what?

replies.reply_text: Sabella's horse was taken from her, and Reuben said he saw a boy taking Apples this way.  He thought you might have seen something.
Nothing.  Sorry to bug you.

chatpoints.chat_text: Why should I help Sabella?  She's done nothing for me.

replies.reply_text: To be a nice neighbor!  Maybe she will bake you a pie or something if you help her.
Fine, don't help her, you crabby man.  I'll try to find Apples myself.

chatpoints.chat_text: Hmm...  I do love apple pie.  Why don't you go get one for me first.  Then I'll tell you what I saw.

replies.reply_text: All right, fine.  I'll go get one from Sabella.
What?  You can't just tell me?  That would be the right thing to do!
You're mean.  I'm going.

chatpoints.chat_text: There's no benefit to me if I help.  A pie, however.  That would be payment enough.

replies.reply_text: Fine.  I'll go get one from Sabella.
You're mean.  I'm going.
Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: So, did you get my pie?

replies.reply_text: Yes I did.  Here you go.
Not yet.  I'll go get it now.
No I haven't, and I'm not going to, either.  I'll find Apples on my own.
So, what did you see?

chatpoints.chat_text: They were headed south.  There was a saddle and bridle on her, so he was probably headed to the meadow below my house.

replies.reply_text: All right.  I'll go see if they're there.  Thanks.

chatpoints.chat_text: I would imagine it was.  Apples and Appaloosa do kind of go together.

replies.reply_text: Well, did you see where they went?
You don't need to be snippy about it, just tell me where they went.

chatpoints.chat_text: Thanks for the pie.  Did you find the horse?

replies.reply_text: I did.  Thank you for the information.  It helped.
Not yet.  I'll go look now.
I'm sorry to bother you, but Bruno said that Archy was coming to see you the other day. Might he still be here?
Just a fast question, Faustus.  Where was Archy heading again?

chatpoints.chat_text: Good.  Now leave me be.

replies.reply_text: Gladly.  Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: Of course it was Apples!   Apples and Appaloosa kind of go together.

replies.reply_text: Well, did you see where they went?
You don't need to be snippy about it, just tell me where they went.
The clearing below your cabin?  I hope he's still there, thanks!

chatpoints.chat_text: And I thought I have problems remembering things.  Archy parked his wagon in the clearing below my cabin.

replies.reply_text: Right....the clearing.  Thanks again, Faustus!

npc_list.name: Rolando
npc_list.admin_description: &New quests start at CP10
npc_list.long_description: Rolando is a beaming, attendant husband.

chatpoints.chat_text: Howdy, stranger!  Come on in and make yourself at home!

replies.reply_text: Oh, thanks.  I was just wondering if you might have seen some sign of Abril's horseshoe.  It broke when he lost it, and I could only find half of it.
Thank you!  I should be going, though.
Thanks. I am here with a message from Yorick.
Hi there!  I'm just passing through, looking for any little jobs you might need done.  Do you have anything?
Hi, Rolando, two blue butterflies and three bunches of daisies, is that what you wanted?
Hello, Rolando! How's it going?

chatpoints.chat_text: Abril lost his horseshoe!  And it broke?  That's horrible, I tell ya.  I'm afraid I haven't seen it.  Not even a hint.

replies.reply_text: That's all right.  Thanks a bunch.

chatpoints.chat_text: Really? Then it must be time for hockey practice to start!  Whoo hoo! I can't wait to be back on the ice!  Is there anyone else that you have to tell?

replies.reply_text: Well, you tell me. I have told Ben, Cedric, Remy, Pillan, Hudson and you.  Oh, and I picked up the goalie mask, the helmet combos, the hockey sticks and the pucks.  Anyone else I need to talk to?
I am heading that way now. Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: Do I?  Why yes, in fact!  You can see we're kind of busy, what with the baby coming and all. You know, there's something I'd really, really like!

replies.reply_text: Oh, yes?  What's that?

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, I was thinking, you know, there are some really beautiful blue butterflies over on Flower Isle.  I think even a tiny baby would love to see them, don't you?  And of course we'll need some daisies for them to feed from, so they stay around, you know?

replies.reply_text: Yes, I understand.  So you'd like blue butterflies and daisies?
Well, actually, I was looking for something a little closer to... here.

chatpoints.chat_text: Sorry, no, not right now.

replies.reply_text: Okay, thanks!  Bye!
Okay, great. I'll go get those right away!
You know, I think I've got those already!  Here you go!

chatpoints.chat_text: Yes, indeed!  Have you got them for me?

replies.reply_text: Not yet, just wanted to make sure I knew what you wanted!  I'll go see to that.
Right here!
You're welcome!  Happy to help!  And thanks for the reward!  Bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: Shhhh! My new son is sleeping!

replies.reply_text: New son? Congratulations. I'll just let myself out.
Thanks. I am here with a message from Yorick.

npc_list.name: Abril
npc_list.long_description: Abril is a tall, lean, older man. His once black hair is almost all gray. You can tell that he is a hard worker.

chatpoints.chat_text: Hello there!  Why don't you come on in?  Make yourself at home!

replies.reply_text: Oh, why, thank you!  That's very nice of you.
Uh, actually, I was just popping in, but I'm gonna head out.  See ya!

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, it's not hard being nice, so I might as well, right?

replies.reply_text: Right.  Hey, those are some nice pictures.  Are they of your horse?
I suppose.  Well, I need to be going now.  Sorry for such a short visit.  Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: Yeah, but I'm sad to say he's not with me anymore.  Good horse, though.  Used to have one of his horseshoes.

replies.reply_text: Oh, may I see it?
Oh, that's too bad.  I should be going.  Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: What?  Oh.  No.  I'm afraid I lost it.  I used to carry it around with me everywhere.  I got caught up in a storm on the beach and lost it.  I haven't been able to find it since.

replies.reply_text: That's tragic!  Have you tried looking for it?
That's terrible.  I hope you find it.  Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, of course I have!  I just can't find it.  It's probably buried beneath the sand somewhere, and I don't have a shovel.

replies.reply_text: I have a shovel!  Maybe I could try finding it for you!
I don't have a shovel, either...  Well, if I get one, maybe I'll come help.

chatpoints.chat_text: You'd try finding it?  Really?  Oh, wow!  You're the best!  I know just where you should start looking, too.

replies.reply_text: Great!  So... uh... where should I start digging?

chatpoints.chat_text: There's this big rock pile just to the east of my house.  I'm sure that's where I was when I lost it.  Why not start looking there?

replies.reply_text: All right!  Hi-ho, off to dig I go!

chatpoints.chat_text: Welcome back!  What did ya find?

replies.reply_text: Well, I think I found part of it.
I found the other half!  Deidra had it.
Oh, I forgot what I was doing.  Could you tell me again?
Um... What was I doing again?  I sorta forgot.
Nothing yet, but I'll keep looking around.

chatpoints.chat_text: Part of it?  What do you mean, "part of it"?  Here, let me see that! ...Yes, yes, this is definitely part of my horseshoe, but where's the other half?

replies.reply_text: I don't know.  It wasn't there.

chatpoints.chat_text: Hmmm.  Maybe you should try asking my neighbors.  Maybe one of them found the other half on the beach somewhere.

replies.reply_text: All right.  I'll see if they don't know where it could be.

chatpoints.chat_text: That doesn't surprise me one bit!  Deidra's always picking things up from the beach.  I'm glad she had it!

replies.reply_text: Me too!  So, what next?

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, I guess the next step would be to get the thing fixed, right?

replies.reply_text: Right!

chatpoints.chat_text: Right!  So why don't you run it up to Arthur, the blacksmith in Appleton.  He'll probably be able to patch it up good as new!

replies.reply_text: All right!  I'm off to Arthur, blacksmith of Appleton!

chatpoints.chat_text: Welcome back!  Did Arthur fix it?

replies.reply_text: Yep!  It's right here, good as new!
Oh, not yet.  I'll get on that.
Not yet.  Where is Arthur again?

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, wow!  You're the greatest!  I can't tell you how much this means to me!  Here, please take this.  Oh, and thanks again!

replies.reply_text: You're welcome!  And thank you!  I was so glad I could help.

chatpoints.chat_text: Hello again, my friend!  What can I do for you?

replies.reply_text: Nothing much.  Just dropping by!

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, you bet!  To the east, on the beach, there's a large rocky area.  I'm pretty sure that's where I dropped the horseshoe, though I bet it's buried in the sand by now.

replies.reply_text: Oh, all right.  Thanks.

chatpoints.chat_text: Right now you need to go and talk to my neighbors.  I think one of them might have seen something about the other piece of this broken horseshoe.

replies.reply_text: Oh, okay.  Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: He is the blacksmith in Appleton.

replies.reply_text: Oh, right.  Thanks.

npc_list.name: Isadora
npc_list.long_description: Isadora is wearing blue, linen shorts and a white tank top.

chatpoints.chat_text: Please, do come in.  I love guests.

replies.reply_text: I will, thank you.
I can't right now.  I should be going.
Oh, thank you.  Actually, I just stopped by to see if you might have found half of a horseshoe.
Thank you. Actually, I have a question for you.  Were you out on the beach a few days ago and saw a charming-looking surfer hitting the waves?
Isadora, I'm back and get ready for more guests!
Hey there.  Um... Is there anyway you could send me back to your father?  Thanks.
Hey Isadora!  Your father sends his blessings along with the Sea Kingdom and...
I'm sorry, what was I doing for you again?

chatpoints.chat_text: Do you like the music?  I enjoy listening to it.  It reminds me of the ocean.

replies.reply_text: It's quite nice, but you live on the ocean...  Why would you need to be reminded of it?
Not really...  I need to go.
What's the easel for?

chatpoints.chat_text: One can never think of the ocean too often.  It is so beautiful.

replies.reply_text: I suppose so.

chatpoints.chat_text: I would love to have a painting done.  If you had some time to do it for me, I sure would appreciate it.

replies.reply_text: Sure.  I can work on it.
I really don't have time right now.  Sorry.  Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: The painting's of a blue butterfly with a yellow body.  There should be purple and smaller red accents on the wings.  They are symmetrical, of course.  The cloud behind it should be a beautiful blue.  That would complement the darker colors of the butterfly.

replies.reply_text: I will see what I can do.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, no.  I don't think I have.  I'm sorry.

replies.reply_text: That's all right.  Don't worry about it.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh?  What do you mean?

replies.reply_text: Crash is coming to visit!  He wants to meet you, too!
I don't remember now.  Just kidding!

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh! Well, yes I was! (She blushes a deep red.) He was very charming, wasn't he? And adorable when he saw me, he just crashed right into the waves! I hid behind a tree and watched him, to make sure he was okay, but I just wasn't brave enough to talk to him.

replies.reply_text: Well, I know who he is, and he would really like to meet you!
Ew!  All this lovey-dovey stuff is making me feel gross!  I need some air!  See ya.

chatpoints.chat_text: He would? Oh my! Well, I um... Wow, I don't know what to say! My heart is just a pitter-pattering in my chest! (She blushes a deeper shade of red.) Would you be able to send him a message for me?

replies.reply_text: I've done enough already.  I think I better get going.
Sure, I can do that!  It's kind of fun playing Cupid!
I'll run this over to him right now!

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh. OH!  Oh, dear.  Oh, no, no, no!  This can't be happening!  He can't come to visit now!  Not yet!  Oh, no, what am I going to do??

replies.reply_text: Wait... What?  I thought you wanted to meet him?  I'm so confused!
Okay, well, he's still coming over, and that means I should leave you two love birds alone.  Bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: My father just sent me a message, and has heard that I have fallen in love with a land-dweller!

replies.reply_text: Fathers can be a bit protective, I understand, but what do you mean, "land-dweller"?
Well, that's not good.  Oh well!  Not my problem.  Later.

chatpoints.chat_text: You won't understand.  He's concerned about the kingdom, and that I can only fall in love with royalty!  He's very upset with me... again!

replies.reply_text: You're right.  I don't understand all this royalty and love stuff, so... Bye!
I don't get it?  You're... royalty?  Are you related to Princess Pookie or something?

chatpoints.chat_text: No, no, no.  That's not it.  You see, my father is the Sea King.  I left the Ocean Kingdom when I was way too young to fully understand the consequences because I loved land more than the sea!  I longed to be part of this world!  Little did I know that I would lose my fins, my friends, and all the ties to my family.  Except for my father.  He let me go, but made sure I fully understood what would happen when I left.  I could never return home, but I still have a family oath to keep.

replies.reply_text: You can only fall in love with royalty?
That sounds like the biggest fish tale ever!  I think I'm just going to leave now.

chatpoints.chat_text: Yes, that's correct.  No matter how much I love the ocean and being free from my father's domain, I still have an oath and tradition to keep to my family.    Oh, this is terrible!  I never should have fallen in love!

replies.reply_text: There, there.  It's okay.  Don't cry, Isadora.  You can't help who you fall in love with! Maybe I can talk to your father on your behalf?  I mean, I can be pretty persuasive if I try.
Please don't cry.  I hate it when people cry.   I'll just go.  Bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: You would do that for me?  I can send you to him, but I don't know how you will be able to get back.

replies.reply_text: It's all right.  I want to help you so... Send me!
On second thought, I don't think I want to meet an angry Sea King after all.  I'm just gonna duck out now!
I'm so glad you and Crash can be happy together!

chatpoints.chat_text: You were headed to see that charming surfer for me with my message and a seashell necklace!  Well... maybe this isn't a good idea.  Maybe I should have it all back?  Oh, goodness!

replies.reply_text: Right!  I forgot.  And no way, it's too late!  I'm heading over to see Crash right now!

npc_list.name: Deidra
npc_list.long_description: Deidra has shaggy, sun bleached hair and a tan that's a bit too dark.

chatpoints.chat_text: Hello there, fellow wanderer!  If you ever happen to come upon some natural wonders on the beach,  let me know!

replies.reply_text: I have actually found some.
What do you do with these 'treasures'?
Actually, I was wondering if you might have found a not-so-natural wonder on the beach.
Hello!  I just came from Albert's and he has lost his inventory list.  Would you happen to have seen it?
Sorry to bother you, but Galvin has asked me to place a special order for a peacock feather necklace. Is that something you can make?
I'm back with 15 peacock feathers!
Say, you deal with the sea a lot.  I noticed that way to the east there are a lot of large, dark islands.  Can you tell me about them?
Hi there.  Can you send me to Sir Sleepwell again?
Hi there!  I have a question for you.  Were you out on the beach the other day and saw a charming looking surfer hitting the waves, perchance?
I'm actually hoping you can make me a semi-natural wonder... for an octopus.
Speaking of natural wonders, where did you say your coral farm was again?
Hi Deidra, I've come back with the coral and the obsidian.
Hi!  You were telling me about those dark islands over there but I must have been distracted.  Do you know if there's a way to get there?

chatpoints.chat_text: I usually make myself, or others, jewelry out of the shells and pearls.   It is a fun hobby for me.

replies.reply_text: Okay.  Well,  have fun!
I have actually found some.
Oh, would you be able to make me a necklace?

chatpoints.chat_text: Really?  I can give $300 for a pearl or $25 for shells!

replies.reply_text: I have a pearl I can give you!
I have a seashell I can give you!
Oh, well, actually, I'm not interested.  Thanks!  Bye.
What do you do with them?
I have another pearl to give you!
I have a seashell I can give you!
Okay.  Thanks.  Bye!
I have another seashell to give you!
I have a pearl I can give you!
Okay.  Thanks.  Bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: Eh?  Whatcha mean "not-so-natural"?

replies.reply_text: Abril lost his horseshoe when he was walking along the beach in a storm.  It broke.  I found half and I was hoping you might have found the other half.

chatpoints.chat_text: Half a... OH!  You know, I just so happen to have half a horseshoe.  Now, I'm not sure it's part of Abril's, but you're welcome to take it!

replies.reply_text: Thanks so much!  I think this is just what I was looking for.

chatpoints.chat_text: Why, yes!  I saw it on the table after he left.  I was planning on running over there later to give it to him.

replies.reply_text: I can deliver it to him now, if you like.  He really could use this to organize his store!
You're welcome. Bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: I sure can!  I need either 15 pearls or 15 seashells.  I do like to get them all at the same time too, if that's not too much trouble.

replies.reply_text: All right.  I'll go see what I can find.
I have 15 seashells right here.
I have 15 pearls right here.
That's a lot to get at one time.  Maybe I'll try some other time.
All right.  Thanks.
I have some individual treasures I can give you too.
All right.  Thanks.
I have some individual treasures I can give you too.

chatpoints.chat_text: A necklace of peacock feathers? Absolutely! It's not often someone asks me for something so unique. I will be glad to take on the job! I just need you to bring me 15 peacock feathers.

replies.reply_text: Uhh.. I'm not so much in the mood for gathering. Nevermind.
Fifteen feathers? That should be no problem.
Okay, bye.
Actually, I think I have enough right here.
Thank you! I appreciate it.
Hmmm.... Doesn't sound like my kind of place, really.  But thanks for telling me about it.
Sounds interesting!  How does one get there?

chatpoints.chat_text: The only way I know of is to get Sir Sleepwell, the Retired Knight, to send you.  I can send you to him.  I can't send you directly to Ashton, alas my reach isn't quite that long.

replies.reply_text: No, that's too much travelling for me.  Thanks anyway, bye.
That's okay, can you send me there?

chatpoints.chat_text: Hrm.  Let me think.... no.  I haven't seen a surfer around these parts in a long time! The tide is way too dangerous for the beginner surfer.  Sorry.

replies.reply_text: All right.  Well thank you for your time then.

chatpoints.chat_text: An octopus. You want me to make a necklace for an octopus?

replies.reply_text: Yes. I know it sounds crazy, but he's courting another octopus and wants to send her a necklace.
Yes. Sometimes I wonder what it is I'm doing with my life. But today, I'm asking you to make a necklace for an octopus.

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, heck, I've never done that before. Sounds like fun. What was supposed to be in this again?

replies.reply_text: Obsidian and coral. They're symbolic, but trust me, you don't want me to repeat it.

chatpoints.chat_text: Hm... the obsidian is easy. You can bring me a piece of that from one of the Lava Isles. Or buy it, whatever works. But the coral's harder. Not very environmentally friendly to harvest the stuff growing wild, of course, but there are a couple of places where people are growing coral colonies and you could take a sample from there. In fact, why not- you can take some from my own coral farm.

replies.reply_text: Oh, so I won't be disturbing a wild reef? That's good, I was worried about that. Where can I find your coral farm?
Thanks! I'll be very careful so I don't harm your coral farm.

chatpoints.chat_text: My coral farm is on the south-east point of Starfish Isle. Be really careful when you dig it up, please!

replies.reply_text: Thank you!
Thanks Deidra! Can you send me straight to the Lava Isles? I'd like to take it straight to Octavia.
Thanks Deidra! I'll wait a minute before going to Octavia.

npc_list.name: Opal Sandstone
npc_list.admin_description: New Quests must start at CP 25
npc_list.short_description: Owner of the Wington Rock Shop
npc_list.long_description: Opal strikes you as a very sweet person--but definitely not the type one would cross.  And she looks as she has been sorely tried of late.  Nevertheless she comes to the counter and greets you cheerfully.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, good day there, and what can I help you with today?

replies.reply_text: Nothing, just looking around.
Actually, you look like you need some help yourself!  Is there anything I can do?
Opal!  I'm back!  I was on the Solomon Island and...
Opal!  I'm back!  I was on the Solomon Island and...
I examined the case, Opal.
Opal, is there anything else at all that you remember about the crime?
Hi, Opal!
Hi Opal!
Hi Opal!
Hello!

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh... Well, really, I don't think it's anything you can help me with.  This is... Well, nevermind.

replies.reply_text: Is what?  Please tell me, I love a mystery!
That's okay, I don't mean to pry.  G'day!

chatpoints.chat_text:
Oh, this is a mystery, right enough! (She turns and points to an elaborate display case on a far wall. The glass front is broken, but not smashed, and the lock has obviously been forced. There is a velvet-covered plinth inside, but whatever had been resting upon it is now gone.).
You know what was in there? The "Star of Solomon" Sapphire! The real one, mind you! But gone it is, now. I'm miserable over it.

replies.reply_text: Stolen?  That's terrible!  It must have been really valuable, if you had it in such a secure case!

chatpoints.chat_text: Valuable?  Oh, it was valuable all right!  A blue star sapphire as big as your eyeball!  Had a legend associated with it, and you know how much that kind of provenance adds to the value of a stone.

replies.reply_text: A legend?  Really?
Oh, I'm sure that was just some kind of advertising hokey.

chatpoints.chat_text: Yes!  I read it in one of the library books.  Legend about how this stone is supposed to be part of a magical lock on the door to a mine, or a treasure-trove, or some such.

replies.reply_text: And, not to be rude, but how did you come by such a fabulous stone?  Did you believe the story?

chatpoints.chat_text: You may think what you like.  Maybe the story's got some truth in it, but I didn't get the stone because of that.  I got it for the Isles Gem and Mineral Show.  Every couple of years, see, all us mineralogists and gemologists and just fans, we all get together on one of the isles and show off the best we’ve been collecting.  The best gems and minerals win big prizes, see.  I even won that show myself, many years ago.  Was sure I could win it this time!  But that stone's gone now.

replies.reply_text: Sorry to hear it.  People do such awful things.  Well, I must be going, thanks for the story. Hope you get the Star of Solomon back someday.
Please, tell me more!  Where did you get the stone?  And who do you think might have stolen it?

chatpoints.chat_text: And who do you think you are? Ms. Mabel, the Great Detective? (Opal gives a little laugh.) Well, if you really want to know...

replies.reply_text: I do!  Really!  Do go on!
Nah, I was just kidding.  Bye!

chatpoints.chat_text:
Well, all right. It's like this. I had a pirate feller come in 'ere, and he said he had this stone and wanted to sell it. He showed it to me and I bought it, instantly! Paid a fortune, but I didn't care. O' course, being a pirate, he wasn't about to tell me how he happen to come by it...
Then I went to the library and looked up famous stones, and there it was, the "Star of Solomon"! Supposed to have a mark on the back, and sure enough, there was the mark, a horse's profile carved in the stone!

replies.reply_text: Wow!  So you had the cabinet built for it, then?

chatpoints.chat_text: Yes!  Rebecca made the case, and Franklin in Earton made the lock and the hinges.  But it got broken into anyway... and only two weeks before the show, too.

replies.reply_text: I'm sure you looked carefully for other clues...?
Would you mind if I searched the case for more clues?
I will, thank you!

chatpoints.chat_text: And how did it go?

replies.reply_text: I didn't find anything, sorry.
Well, I found one clue, but it may not mean much.

chatpoints.chat_text: It's been looked over and looked over, but I doubt you'd find a clue that'd mean anything to anybody except old Ms. Mabel.

replies.reply_text: Who is Ms. Mabel?

chatpoints.chat_text: Ms. Mabel?  Oh, she was a right famous sleuth in her day!  Been retired now, going on thirty years, I'd expect.  She may not still be alive.  But she could find hints and clues almost anywhere, she could!  She was a marvel!

replies.reply_text: I don't think I can do anything more for you, I'm afraid.
Where can I find her?

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh well, at least you took an interest.  Goodbye, then.

replies.reply_text: Goodbye!  I hope you get the "Star of Solomon" back someday.

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, like I said, I'm not sure she's still alive.  But if she is still around, I'd expect she'd be in that nice retirement community on Dolphin Isle.

replies.reply_text: I'll try to find her!  It would be great just to see a stone like the "Star of Solomon"!  I'll let you know what I find out!

chatpoints.chat_text: Hey, now, don't go running off just yet!  I've got another clue for you!

replies.reply_text: Really?  That's great!  What is it?
Thanks, that helps a lot!  Goodbye for now!

chatpoints.chat_text: Hello again!  Did you manage to talk to Ms. Mabel?

replies.reply_text: Not really, no.  I'll go do that now.

chatpoints.chat_text: Hello there!  Nice to see you again.

replies.reply_text: Thanks, good to see you, too.

chatpoints.chat_text: Sorry, dear.  I've told you everything I know.

replies.reply_text: Thanks anyway, Opal.  I'm working on it!  Bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: Slow down, slow down!  Tell me all about it, one step at a time!

replies.reply_text: (You carefully, and with much backtracing, tell Opal everything that happened, up until the point you made your choice.)

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, my, that's so exciting!  And what did you bring me, then?!

replies.reply_text: Here it is, Opal, safe and sound: the "Star of Solomon."
I'm sorry.  I couldn't take the Star of Solomon away from her.  But I brought you this: "Barry Solomon's Beryl."  It's pretty, isn't it?
Happy to do it!
Sorry, but it was the best I could arrange.
Oh, my!  You're very generous, thank you so much!  Goodbye!

npc_list.name: Dominique
npc_list.admin_description: New Quests must start at CP 4
npc_list.long_description: Dominique is raising her child alone while her husband is overseas working on Pirate Isle.

chatpoints.chat_text: Hi there!  My poor child has lost her teddy bear!   Could you please help find it?

replies.reply_text: Sure, do you have any idea where it might be?
What is your child's name?
Sorry.  I do not have time right now.
I have found Tally's teddy bear.  Here, take it!
Umm...  Not now, sorry, but could you tell me if you've seen Trigger's bridle?
Hello.  Just wondering, by any chance did you see or hear anything the night Opal's gem was stolen?
Hold that thought- I'd be happy to help you later, but right now I'm helping Cadence get together all the seeds for the community garden. Do you have some for her?

chatpoints.chat_text: Her name is Tally.  She is 3 years old and the cutest thing...  Please help her!

replies.reply_text: Okay, I suppose I can.  Do you have any idea where it might be?
Sorry.  I do not have time right now.

chatpoints.chat_text: Well...  South of here is a tiny forest.  Zamora's cabin is in it.  I believe she lost the teddy bear in the center of that forest!!  If you had a tool that could see better than me, maybe you would have better luck!

replies.reply_text: Okay, Dominique.  I'll try my best!
Okay!

chatpoints.chat_text: Tally thanks you very much for finding her teddy bear! (Tally waves to you from a chair where she is cuddling the teddy bear.)

replies.reply_text: I was happy to help.
That's great.  I was wondering if you've seen Trigger's bridle around?
Hello.  Just wondering, by any chance did you see or hear anything the night Opal's gem was stolen?
Hi there, Dominique!  Hope all's well with you these days.
Hi.  I searched the beach, but didn't see anything.  Perhaps I'm looking in the wrong place.  Where was that bottle again?
I've got it!
You're welcome.  I was wondering if I could hear that letter that was in the bottle again?
Tally is very welcome! I'm actually here from Cadence to pick up your seeds for the community garden.

chatpoints.chat_text: No.  I haven't.  I've been a bit preoccupied with my daughter.

replies.reply_text: All right.  Sorry I bothered you.

chatpoints.chat_text: No, I haven't seen anything.  Sorry.

replies.reply_text: All right.  Thanks.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, things are okay, just been busy.  Children can really wear one out, you know!

replies.reply_text: I do indeed!  Say, is there anything else you need done?  I've got some time.
A three-year-old can be quite a challenge.  But I'm sure you're up to it!  See you!

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh!  Well, come to think of it, there is!  I was walking with Tally before, and she got away from me.  I had to go racing after her, and while I did, I thought I saw a bottle with a message in it.  I couldn't stop though, and I forgot about it until just now.  Please, can you go get it for me?

replies.reply_text: Sure I can.  Where exactly did you see it?
Beach?  Not today, thanks, I'm in my brand new shoes.  Some other time, perhaps.  See you!
I'm on my way!

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, I thought I saw it just south of here, and maybe a little west, by a palm tree?  I remember there was a big rock offshore, too.  Now, the tide may have covered the bottle up or even washed it away, so look carefully for it, please.

replies.reply_text: Okay, I'll keep searching.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh!  Wonderful!  And it does have a note in it!  Would you like to hear what the note says?

replies.reply_text: No, thanks, I've got places I need to be.
Ooo, yes, please!

chatpoints.chat_text:
(Dominique begins reading:)
"My Dearest Brother, Please forgive the too-great length of time since I have written to you. I said that I would write as soon as I was aboard ship, but, alas, for many reasons I have been unable to keep that promise. But here is a nice long letter for you, and may it gladden your heart as I believe I have found a land that will suit all the wishes and desires of our community!"

replies.reply_text: Please, go on!
Nope, bored already, sorry.
Nevermind.  I don't have time to listen to this now.  Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: "I will not go into detail of how I found this land, lest this letter somehow fall into the wrong hands.  But in my travels I have found an archipelago of islands great and small that teem with creatures and peoples of every kind and description--and that, most importantly of all, teem with horses!  In this chain of islands which goes from high mountain to arctic ice to deepest jungle to driest desert, but is mostly the greenest pasture, I have found horses heavy and light, big and small, swift and steady.   The islands abound with them, running wild.  When caught and tamed, these horses are loyal, willing and companionable.  Our whole community would be so at home here among them!"

replies.reply_text: Ooo, interesting!    Keep going, please.

chatpoints.chat_text: "And marvelously, we would not be alone, for I have found here also peoples of many kinds!  Upon my arrival, I was welcomed by a small, sturdy folk called Dwobbits, who clothed me, fed me and sheltered me for a time, and who built my cabin.  When I did not feel comfortable on their ponies, they helped me capture a wild horse and train it.  And it was the Dwobbits, dear brother, who finally enabled me to send this letter to you, by means of the splendidly trained carrier pigeons they so skillfully raise.  Another people, the Smurls, live on islands of rampant growth and enormous flowers.  They are silly, and often self-centered, but friendly enough although they keep to themselves.  They make their homes in giant, hollowed-out mushrooms, if you can believe!"

replies.reply_text: Imagine that!  What else does it say?
I can't hear any more of this, sorry.
Sounds interesting, but I should probably be going.

chatpoints.chat_text: "In most parts of this little island world, one sometimes can come across the most curious sight: squirrels, wearing spectacles.  They look up at you with the most benign curiosity, and they say nothing, although I can, dear brother, honestly say that I am sure I have heard them mutter behind my back.  The mountainous parts of this land are full of caverns, and some of these are inhabited by great dragons, and others ugly little trolls.  The trolls are worth avoiding as their odor is very peculiar, though not offensive.  The Dragons (the Dwobbits call them Draggets) however are huge, powerful and much to be feared and avoided at all cost.  Out upon the ridges of these mountains, I have also seen giant Ducks who build nests upon the cliffs.  And everywhere one goes, one is likely to encounter Elfins.  And woe to them that do, for they are tricksters extraordinary, not to mention thieves!"

replies.reply_text: Looks like you're nearly at the end!

chatpoints.chat_text: "On some of the islands I found creatures called Furburs, smallish creatures somewhat like bears, gentle and kind and ever ready to help a traveler in distress, or simply entertain a passer-by.  They are few in number and live high in enormous trees.  One could almost want to have one as a pet, but they will gently dissuade all ideas of such folly.  On the northern isles, amongst the ice floes, live the Lynucks, penguins who are fond of gadgets and sometimes quite difficult to understand.   In my travels I found a group of isles upon which there appear to be ghosts!  I have only seen one, and I have not gone back to those places."

replies.reply_text: Penguins?!  Please read on!
Weird!  Now I know this is made up.  Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: "I enclose what I believe are directions to this land.  It is big, and wide, and we may live in peace with as many horses of whatever kind we like!  Come to me, dear brother, and bring our family and friends and all our own horses; the young will enjoy it here, and the old will find peace and perfect calm and all the good food and attention they might desire!  Hoping to hear from you soon.  Your loving sister,  SeaHorseLass"

replies.reply_text: Is that all?  Is there a map?
Neat!  Thanks for reading it again.  Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: (Dominique looks at a blank sheet of paper with a few stains on it.) I suppose this is it. Well, I suppose this was it. But it can't be read now.

replies.reply_text: That's too bad.  Well, maybe sometime in my travels, I'll come across someone who can restore it.  Very interesting!  Anyway, I must go...
Oh, well.  Thanks!
Yes, interesting indeed!  Oh, well, goodbye now!  And thanks!
Aww, how sweet! I'm sure Tally will enjoy it as much as you did.

npc_list.name: Hannah
npc_list.long_description: Hannah is a very pleasant young girl and once you get to know her she can be quite funny.

replies.reply_text: Why, hello there.  You're a bit shy, aren't you?
Hello.  How come you have an easel over in the corner?
I can see you're uncomfortable.  I'll leave.
I heard you like 4 leaf clovers.  I have one for you.
I think I'll go.
I'm glad you like it.  I have another one.
I'm glad you like it.
I'll leave now.  Bye.
So now will you tell me about the easel?

chatpoints.chat_text: I like cupcakes.  Will you paint me one?

replies.reply_text: Sure I will.
Umm...  Not right now.  Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: It has to have light blue candles and a yellow wrapper.  I like purple and blue.  Purple frosting is the best.  Blue looks neat next to the strawberries...

replies.reply_text: I'm sure it does.

npc_list.name: Levi Shoogerkube
npc_list.short_description: Owner of Wington Feed and Seed
npc_list.long_description: Levi Shoogerkube is a quiet, serious man.

chatpoints.chat_text: Hello there.  Anything I can help you with?

replies.reply_text: No thanks.  Just looking around.
Actually, I was wondering what good the horse treats are.
Yes, actually.  Caeralus sent me to get some feed for him.
Yes.  I'm looking into the theft of Opal's sapphire.  Did you notice anything, anything at all, the night the stone was stolen?
Yes, I need to buy four bales of wheat straw. They're for thatching a roof.

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, buying a treat for your horse will not only give them something for their stomach, but it will make them a bit happier as well.

replies.reply_text: Great.  Thanks.

chatpoints.chat_text: Did he now...  Huh...  Finally managed to trust someone else.  Interesting...  Well, let me go to the back room and get it for you.  Wait right here.

replies.reply_text: Okay...
Will do.  Thanks.
All right...  Caeralus seems a little, well, paranoid.

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, I suppose he does have reason to be.  Can't really blame him.  I guess it's a good thing he likes to live out there where people can't find him easily.

replies.reply_text: He has reason to be?  Why is that?
I guess...  Well, I'll go get him this feed. Thanks.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh!  You don't know?  I just assumed...  Well, off you go now.  Get that feed back to him.

replies.reply_text: All right...

chatpoints.chat_text: There was a lot of barking that night, and the horses were all in a lather.  But that happens sometimes.  Not all that unusual.

replies.reply_text: Did you notice anyone in with a donkey, or a zebra?

chatpoints.chat_text: There's always such folk about.  Why?

replies.reply_text: Just wondering.  Thanks for your time.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, no problem. That will be $400.  $100 a bale.

replies.reply_text: Okay, I've got that on me!
I'll come back when I have it.
Thanks Levi!

npc_list.name: Gertrude
npc_list.long_description: Gertrude is a mess just like her house. Her clothes and hair are in what appear to be a constant state of disarray.

chatpoints.chat_text: Hello!  Hello!  Come in!  My neighbor Elaina  and I were just having a chat, but I'm afraid she's leaving now.

replies.reply_text: No thanks.  It's a bit too messy in here for me.
I can come back later when you're not busy.
Okay, thanks.
Hi... uh... Can I ask you a quick question...? Did you see anything or hear anything the night Opal's sapphire was stolen?
Oh, I'm only here for a minute. I'm just picking up the seeds you wanted planted in the community garden.

chatpoints.chat_text: Bye Elaina, and thanks for the cookies! (Elaina waves and heads back home.) Now dear, what brings you to my door? A bit of gossip perhaps?

replies.reply_text: No... No gossip.  I was just looking around.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, that's too bad.  I do love to keep up on what's happening on the Isles.  You're sure you haven't heard anything interesting?

replies.reply_text: No sorry.  I'd better be going.  Bye.
Well... There is a rumor that a Unicorn has been spotted on Horse Isle.
I don't like to gossip... Thanks for the hospitality.  Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: A Unicorn, you say?  Well, if that don't beat all!  Are you sure it's a Unicorn?

replies.reply_text: Yep.  Big as life!
Well, that's what I've heard, but I could be mistaken.  It's getting late, I'd better go now.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, I wish I didn't have so much to do around here, otherwise I'd run and see if Breezy has heard anything about it.

replies.reply_text: Well, I could help out for awhile.  I have some free time.
Okay, you're busy.  I should be going now.
I'm sure she has by now.  I gotta run now.  See you!

chatpoints.chat_text: Well I could use a spare set of hands around here.  As you can see it's gotten a little messy.  I was going to give the place a good sweeping but someone has borrowed my broom.

replies.reply_text: I could go and get it for you....who borrowed it?

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, that's just the thing... I can't remember who I lent it to.  Let me think... Evelynn was here bringing me some honey... It might have been her.

replies.reply_text: Sorry.  I really don't have time to go running all over.
I can go and ask Evelynn if she has it.  No problem.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, thank you.  That would be so nice of you!

replies.reply_text: Be back in a bit.

chatpoints.chat_text: Did Evelynn have my broom?

replies.reply_text: No, she said she didn't borrow it.
Oh, I don't know...  I haven't talked to her yet.  I'll go check.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh dear... I was sure she was the one I lent it to... Hmmm... Well, Iris was here bringing me some lovely wildflowers fresh from her shop.  It might have been her that I lent it to.

replies.reply_text: Iris?  Okay, I've been in her shop here in Wington before.  I'll run and ask her.  Be back in a jiffy.

chatpoints.chat_text: Did you find it?

replies.reply_text: Yes.  Iris was using it.  She wanted me to tell you thank you for letting her borrow it.
No.  I didn't.  Who was the person you thought may have it?
No, not yet.  I'll get right on that.
Okay. Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: Iris may have borrowed it, check with her... She owns the flower shop here in Wington.

replies.reply_text: Okay I'll go and ask her.

chatpoints.chat_text: Thank you for finding my broom.  It's already getting a bit cleaner in here.

replies.reply_text: You're welcome.  It is starting to look a bit nicer in here.  Good luck with your cleaning.
Hi... uh... Can I ask you a quick question...? Did you see anything or hear anything the night Opal's sapphire was stolen?
Oh, I'm only here for a minute. I'm just picking up the seeds you wanted planted in the community garden.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh!  How exciting!  Is the case open again?  Wonderful!  Let's see, what did I hear? What did I see... well... no... hmm... well.... Actually, I heard dogs barking and horses running but... on these Isles, horses are always running somewhere.

replies.reply_text: But you didn't see anyone strange?  Or anything strange?

chatpoints.chat_text: Mmm, I wish I had!  But I didn't, really, sorry.  But I did hear something about a donkey... Can't remember what, though.

replies.reply_text: Thanks for your time anyway. Goodbye.
They do do that. Hopefully they won't riot too much.

npc_list.name: Zamora
npc_list.admin_description: &  New Quests must start at CP 6
npc_list.long_description: Zamora is wearing a big, baggy sweater and sweat pants.

chatpoints.chat_text: What do you want!

replies.reply_text: Bye bye, crabby.
Why are you yelling?
I have brought your Family Stone back!
Hi.  I wonder if you might remember anything about the night Opal Sandstone's "Star of Solomon" sapphire was stolen.
Can you remind me what I was doing for you?
Uh... just to pick up the seeds you wanted planted in the community garden.
Cadence said that Archy came by to see you.  I don't suppose he's still around?
Sorry to bother you again, Zamora, but where did you say Archy was going to?

chatpoints.chat_text: What is it to you? (Continuing to yell.)

replies.reply_text: Bye bye, crabby.
I feel bad for you.  Is there anything I can do to help?

chatpoints.chat_text: You feel bad for me? Well... good! (She suddenly turns crabby instead of angry, though there doesn't seem to be too much difference.)

replies.reply_text: Bye, I do not have time for this crabbiness.
Well, what's the matter?

chatpoints.chat_text: Why should I tell you? (She says in a not-so-crabby manner.)

replies.reply_text: Bye, I do not have time for this.
Well, maybe I can help...

chatpoints.chat_text: Really?  Well...   All right, I lost my family's jewel!  It is a beautiful blue stone!  I believe it's somewhere in the flower patch west, near my cabin, but there is so much brush and grass I can't find it...

replies.reply_text: I doubt I could help.  Bye.
I'll go give it a shot!  Maybe with a rake I could have some luck.
Thanks!

chatpoints.chat_text: What do you want? Oh, it's you again... my favorite person!

replies.reply_text: Well that's sweet of you! I was just stopping by to say hi. Have a great day!
Hi.  I wonder if you might remember anything about the night Opal Sandstone's "Star of Solomon" sapphire was stolen.
Uh... just to pick up the seeds you wanted planted in the community garden.
Cadence said that Archy came by to see you.  I don't suppose he's still around?
Sorry to bother you again, Zamora, but where did you say Archy was going to?

chatpoints.chat_text: How many times do I have to say this?  No!  I was asleep!  I saw nothing!  Heard nothing!  Nothing, nothing, nothing!  Now go away!

replies.reply_text: All right.  Bye.
I certainly hope they prove you right.
I'll head over there right now!

chatpoints.chat_text: Family jewel? Blue stone? Flower patch west, near my cabin? Any of that ring a bell to you? Shesh!

replies.reply_text: Shesh is right! I think I'll just leave you to your crabbiness!
Oh, that's right! Thanks for the reminder. I'll go search there now.
He went to get the tar? (Checks list.) Okay, off to see Karl. Thanks Zamora!

chatpoints.chat_text: Don't you listen when people talk to you?  I said that Archy said that he was going to get the tar next.  Got it this time?

replies.reply_text: Tar?  Oh, that's right, he was heading to Karl!  Thanks again, Zamora, bye-bye.

npc_list.name: Patience
npc_list.admin_description: & New quests must start on CP 11
npc_list.long_description: Patience is soft and round.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oooo, a visitor!  Do come in, come in.

replies.reply_text: Umm...  You're a bit hyper for me.  I need to go.
Great.  I will.  Thanks.
Hi.  Sorry to bother you, but I'm asking around to see what folks heard or saw about the time Opal's big sapphire was stolen.
Sure, but just for a few minutes. I'm actually here to pick up your seeds for the community garden.
Hello! I am soooo excited to find you. Humpty has been heartsick since your disappearance. He is going to be thrilled when he learns that you are here, on Bird Isle.
Who did you say I should talk to about someone with an amazing voice?
I'm sorry to bother you, but I really must talk to you about Humpty. Humpty Dumpty? That name must mean something to you. Something deep and personal.
Umm. So when you said you didn't know Humpty, were you really, really, REALLY sure? I've come such a long way to find you.

chatpoints.chat_text: Hmm...  Let's see...  Oh, I have some cookies and coffee, if you would like some.

replies.reply_text: No thanks.  I should go.
Sure.  That'd be great.
No thanks.  You seem a bit excited...
No thanks, really, I just want to find out about the sapphire.  I'm asking everyone, and I'm kinda short on time.
Oh, great.  Could I have some more?
All right.  You seem awfully cheery.
Thanks.  I should be going.
Now, about that night...?

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, yes, well, I don't get visitors too often.  I do so enjoy company.

replies.reply_text: Well, is there anything I can do for you while I'm here?
Well, that's too bad.  I should be going now, though.  Hope more people come visit.  Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: There is.  I was really hoping to get a seashell necklace.  They are so pretty.  I really don't know where to get one, though.

replies.reply_text: How am I supposed to get you one if you don't even know where they are?
You don't?  Well, maybe during my travels I'll come across a way to get one for you.

chatpoints.chat_text: The seashells are all over the beach, but I just can't make a necklace out of them.  If you do find someone that can, I would love to have one made.

replies.reply_text: I'll see what I can do.
That is way too much work.  I'm not going to go hunting all over looking for a necklace.  Sorry.  Bye.
No problem.  I'll come back whenever I find one.

chatpoints.chat_text: Hello hello!  How have your travels gone?

replies.reply_text: Great!  I found that necklace for you.
Quite well.  I was wondering if I could get a cookie and coffee again?
All right.  I suppose I should get back out there.  Bye.
What was it that you were wanting again?
Hi.  Sorry to bother you, but I'm asking around to see what folks heard or saw about the time Opal's big sapphire was stolen.
Not too terribly.  I'm actually here to pick up the seeds you had collected for the community garden.

chatpoints.chat_text: I was hoping you happened to stumble across a seashell necklace someplace.  If you haven't found one yet, that's quite all right.

replies.reply_text: Oh, yes.  I did actually find one for you.
Oh, that's right.  Well, I haven't found one yet.  I guess I'll keep my eye out.
Great.  Well, maybe I'll stop by again for some treats when I'm around.

chatpoints.chat_text: You are always welcome.

replies.reply_text: Thanks!

chatpoints.chat_text: Thank you so much for finding me that necklace!  I love it!

replies.reply_text: No problem.  I'll be going now.  Bye.
No problem.  Could I possibly have a cookie and some coffee?
Hi.  Sorry to bother you, but I'm asking around to see what folks heard or saw about the time Opal's big sapphire was stolen.
You're very welcome. I'm actually here to pick up the seeds you had collected for the community garden.

You are very welcome. And let me tell you, I am soooo excited to be talking to you. Humpty has been heartsick since your disappearance. He is going to be thrilled when he learns that you are here, on Bird Isle.
Who did you say I should talk to about someone with an amazing voice?
I'm sorry to bother you, but I really must talk to you about Humpty. Humpty Dumpty. That name must mean something to you. Something deep and personal.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, a good sleuth never hurries, you know!  Sit down and have some tea. Now.  What did I see, what did I see... Oh yes!  There was something very odd.

replies.reply_text: Yes?  Go on, please.

chatpoints.chat_text: There was a loose horse wandering on the island that night.  Well, that's not unusual, but I remember this one quite clearly, because it was such a very loud appaloosa!

replies.reply_text: You could see that it was an appy, even at night?
Did you see it again after that?

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, I wish I had.  But I didn't.  I assume someone caught the horse, or it was a traveller's and it just got loose.

replies.reply_text: Well, thanks for your time.  Goodbye.
Well, I hope you have a bumper crop then.

chatpoints.chat_text: Humpty? I think you must be mistaking me for someone else.

replies.reply_text:
Are you sure? (She gives a look that says she is quite sure. Your excitement fizzles out like a firecracker in a rainstorm.)
Well darn. Sorry to have bothered you. Guess I'd better go talk to Humpty some more.

chatpoints.chat_text: Seriously. I don't know, and have never known someone named Humpty. And I have no clue what you are talking about in regards to a tarantula. Although they are lovely creatures, aren't they?

replies.reply_text: You think tarantulas are lovely? That sure doesn't sound like the woman I'm looking for. Wait a second. Your name is Patience. You sing like a lark, right? Maybe the trauma has made you forget. That's it! You've suffered from amnesia!

chatpoints.chat_text: I assure you, I don't have amnesia. I wish I sang like a songbird. Unfortunately, singing is not one of my talents. (Patience taps her lip and looks deep in thought.) I do seem to remember hearing about someone with an exceptionally beautiful voice. Who was that? Oh right! I was at the bank and Grant mentioned it.

replies.reply_text: Thanks so much! I'll head up there now.

chatpoints.chat_text: Grant, over at the bank. Good luck on your search!

replies.reply_text: Thanks so much.

chatpoints.chat_text: I don't know what to tell you. I've heard rumors about Humpty. Most people have. But I am quite sure I've never met the man.

replies.reply_text: Look. I'm sure the whole unfortunate fiasco with the tarantula was embarrassing. But Humpty meant no harm. Really. He wanted to impress your father because he was, I mean IS in love with you!

chatpoints.chat_text: Absolutely. But I wish you luck on finding whoever it is you are looking for.

replies.reply_text: Thanks. (Drat! Now you've got to head back to Dumpty and tell him the news.)

npc_list.name: Elaina
npc_list.admin_description: &New quests start CP13
npc_list.long_description: Elaina is very motherly towards all who visit her. Her children are all grown and out on their own and she is lonely.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, hello, dear.  Do come in.  Make yourself at home.

replies.reply_text: I will, thank you.  Oh, that's a nice piano you have.
No thanks.  I should be going.
Oh, thank you.  That's very nice of you to offer.
Hello, I'm looking into the theft of a sapphire from Opal Sandstone.  Could you help me?
Hi there. (You quickly explain the situation with Stacie.) I didn't want to move her if it was a serious injury.
Thanks, but I won't be staying long. I'm here from Cadence to pick up your seeds for the community garden.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, well, thank you.  I was hoping someone could play a tune for me.

replies.reply_text: I could try, I guess.  What did you have in mind?
With these fat fingers?  I don't play piano, sorry.

chatpoints.chat_text: If you could play me "Mary Had a Little Lamb", I would be, oh, so happy.

replies.reply_text: I'll give it a try.  Do you know which key to start on?
I don't even know that song.  Sorry I can't help.  Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: It's not too hard if you want to just try.

replies.reply_text: Well, I'll give it a try, I guess.  Do you know which key to start on?
Hmm...  No thanks.  I'm heading out now.  Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: Start the song on E.  It's the third key from the left.  Thank you for doing this for me.

replies.reply_text: Well, don't thank me yet.  We'll see how I do.

chatpoints.chat_text: I'd offer you some cookies, but I'm all out of flour!

replies.reply_text: Drats.  I love cookies!
Oh, dear.  I hope you get some flour soon.  Bye now!

chatpoints.chat_text: I know!  It's such a shame, isn't it?  I just love baking cookies!  Apparently I love it so much, I used up all my flour.

replies.reply_text: Hmm... Cookies sound really good.  Maybe I should go get some flour for you.
I don't like cookies all that much.  Maybe someone else will get some flour for you.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh! Would you?  If you go and get me some flour, I can whip up a batch of cookies in no time!

replies.reply_text: Sure, I'll go get some flour!  Ah... Where should I go to get it?
Weeeell.  I think I'll go get it a bit later.  Bye now!

chatpoints.chat_text: There's a little food store up in Wington.  Cara should have my flour ready and waiting.  I just haven't been able to go pick it up yet.

replies.reply_text: All right, then.  I'll go talk to Cara about getting that flour!

chatpoints.chat_text: Welcome back!  Did you manage to get the flour?

replies.reply_text: You bet I did!
Uh, I was supposed to get you flour?  Oh, right!  Could you remind me where I'm supposed to go?
Oh, that sure is a nice piano you have there.
Not yet.  I'll just hurry and get it now.
Hello, I'm looking into the theft of a sapphire from Opal Sandstone.  Could you help me?
Not quite yet.  I'm here from Cadence to pick up your seeds for the community garden.

chatpoints.chat_text: Of course I can remind you!  Just go up to Cara in the Food Store in Wington.  She should have the flour all ready for you.

replies.reply_text: Oh, right!  Thanks a bunch!
All right!  I'll be back to see you soon!

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh!  Welcome back again! Please, have a seat!  Would you like a cookie?

replies.reply_text: Oh, yes, thank you!
No, thank you.  I was just admiring your piano. It's quite beautiful.
Thanks, but I'm just gonna go.  Bye now!
Hello, I'm looking into the theft of a sapphire from Opal Sandstone.  Could you help me?
Hi there. (<l>You quickly explain the situation with Stacie.</l>) So, I didn't want to move her if it was a serious injury.
Not right now.  Thanks though.  I'm here from Cadence to pick up your seeds for the community garden.
Thank you!

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, my!  I heard about that.  That was the night all my horses got loose!  I'll never forget it, I was so worried about them.  But we found them all.

replies.reply_text: Oh, no!  I'm glad you got them back, I'd be worried, too!  Did they all stay together?

chatpoints.chat_text: Yes, they did, all except Mousy.  We found him off by himself on the northern end of the island, where those odd prints were.

replies.reply_text: Odd... You mean... How do you mean, odd?
Thanks!  Interesting, I'll go speak to the farrier.  Thanks for your help!  Bye!
I've already spoken to him--or tried to--but I'll try again!  Thanks, Elaina!
Thanks, I'll see what I can find out.

chatpoints.chat_text: You did the right thing. Tell you what. I'll tend to the child and you go tell her aunt. I'll bring Stacie to her as soon as I get her fixed up.

replies.reply_text: Thank you so much! I'll head over to Art Isle right now. I'm sure Heather will be grateful for your help.
I'll let her know. Thank you!

npc_list.name: Tessa Strapp
npc_list.admin_description: & New Quests must start at CP11
npc_list.long_description: Tessa Strapp is a hard working, bubbly blonde.

chatpoints.chat_text: Hello!

replies.reply_text: Hi. Can I get a glass of water?  I am parched.
Hi. I'm in need of a new saddle.
(You are speechless while staring at the crumbling wall and water-damaged roof.)
Bye.
Hi! I'm looking for clues to the disappearance of Opal's "Star of Solomon".  Did you see or hear anything the night of the theft?
Hiya!  Have you heard about Sumiko Stallman's Riding for the Handicapped program?

chatpoints.chat_text: Actually, you'll have to go somewhere else for that.  I don't have any clean water,  just what you see collecting in the buckets here and that's dirty water from the roof.

replies.reply_text: Really? Okay, then. Guess I'll have to go elsewhere. (Muttering... What does she drink?)

chatpoints.chat_text: I can help you with that.  I'll be honest and let you know that I don't have much.  I've got your high-end and your mid-range.  Nothing really cheap, but both ooze quality.

replies.reply_text: I appreciate your honesty. Truthfully, I am looking for something a bit cheaper. Thanks for your time. Bye.
Sounds good. I'll have a look around, then. Thanks.

chatpoints.chat_text: Sorry about that. Oh, and I have excellent hearing, so to answer your question...  I drink the water from the leaky roof.

replies.reply_text: Is that healthy?!?
Really?  Umm...  Well, I'll be going.  Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: (Starts laughing.) Yeah, the place is a bit of a mess. I'll get it fixed up eventually.

replies.reply_text: Huh.  Well, I'm going to get out before something falls on me.  Bye.
Anything I can do to help?
You better get on that.  You wouldn't want it to ruin your merchandise.

chatpoints.chat_text: I like to keep my customers happy.
Sure.
Actually, I've been so busy running the store that I haven't been able to get any supplies.  Would you be able to pick up some things for me?

replies.reply_text: Well...  I really don't want to do a bunch of running around.  Sorry.  Bye.
Sure thing.  What did you need?

chatpoints.chat_text: No, I really wouldn't, but it will probably be a bit before I can get any patching up done.

replies.reply_text: Sorry to hear that.  I need to be going.  Bye.
Anything I can do to help?

chatpoints.chat_text: I really need to patch these holes.  Could you go visit Karl in Whiskerton?  He collects pitch from the pine trees in the nearby forest.  I'll need probably 3 buckets.

replies.reply_text: Sure thing.
Go to a different island?  I don't think so.  Bye.
Okay.  I'll be back soon.

chatpoints.chat_text: Welcome back!

replies.reply_text: Hi. I'm in need of a new saddle.
I got those pails of pitch for you!
What did you need me to do for you again?
Bit of a mess you have here still.  I'm outta here.
Were there any other supplies you needed me to get for you?
What was I doing for you again?
I got those planks for you.
You said there was one other thing you needed?
What did you need me to do again?
I got that bucket of nails for you.
How are the repairs going?
Hi! I'm looking for clues to the disappearance of Opal's "Star of Solomon."  Did you see or hear anything the night of the theft?
Hiya!  Have you heard about Sumiko Stallman's Riding for the Handicapped program?

chatpoints.chat_text: Head to Whiskerton and see Karl.  He collects pitch from the forest.  I need about 3 pails' worth.

replies.reply_text: All right.  Be back soon.
Sounds good.  Thanks.

chatpoints.chat_text: Probably not, but it's the only thing I have available.  The store is a bit in shambles.

replies.reply_text: That's too bad.  Well, I'll be going.  Bye.
Anything I can do to help?

chatpoints.chat_text: Yes.  I need wood to start working on the roof and walls.

replies.reply_text: Okay.  Where can I get the wood?
Well, I'll come back a little later, maybe, and help you.

chatpoints.chat_text: Go get 10 logs out of the forest and bring them to Rebecca in Carrotton.  She works with wood a lot and should be able to shape them for what I need.

replies.reply_text: Carrotton?  There isn't even a direct route from here.  No thanks.  Bye.
Okay.
Great.  I'll be back as soon as I can.

chatpoints.chat_text: Go collect 10 logs then bring them to Rebecca in Carrotton.  She'll make some planks for me.

replies.reply_text: Oh, right.  Be back in a bit.
Great.  Thanks.

chatpoints.chat_text: Yes.  In order to actually get these boards up, I need some nails.

replies.reply_text: All right.  I can do that for you.
Oh, there's something else I need to do now.  Maybe I'll be back later.  Bye.
Sounds good.  I'll be back shortly.

chatpoints.chat_text: Go see Liam at the local blacksmith.  He should be able to give you a bucket of nails I can have.

replies.reply_text: Oh, right.  I'll be right back.
Thanks.  You know, Liam seemed pretty happy to help.
Thanks.  Good luck fixing stuff up.

chatpoints.chat_text: Yeah.  I thought he would.  Thanks again for everything.  You've been a big help.

replies.reply_text: You're welcome.  I hope the repairs go well.

chatpoints.chat_text: Great.  Slow, but good.  I'll get everything fixed eventually.

replies.reply_text: Good, good.  Have fun.  Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, sorry, I don't know anything about it.  I was staying with a friend on Cat Isle that night.

replies.reply_text: That's okay.  Thanks anyway.  Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: I heard about that, I'm pretty sure.  What's going on?

replies.reply_text: She's gotten her new property and she asked me if I'd go around finding halters with leads, and old saddles, child-sized if you've got them.

chatpoints.chat_text: I vaguely remember hearing something about it.  What's up?

replies.reply_text: She's gotten her new property and she asked me if I'd go around finding halters with leads, and old saddles, child-sized if you've got them.

chatpoints.chat_text: I don't have any children's saddles, but I do have a really nice, old, used one here.  It needs to be cleaned and polished a bit, but I can sell it to her for pretty cheap.

replies.reply_text: How cheap is "pretty cheap"?

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, say, $100?

replies.reply_text: That would be great!  I'll take it!
That's more than I've got with me.  Sorry, no thanks.
Thanks, this will do fine!  I'll get it to her right away.  Bye!

npc_list.name: William Sleapwhell
npc_list.short_description: Owner of The Colt of Wington
npc_list.long_description: William Sleapwhell is a well dressed man in his late 40's.

chatpoints.chat_text: Greetings! Welcome to my home. May it be a place you can hang your hat. Please come in.

replies.reply_text: Thank you! What a warm welcome.
I'll have to come back some other time.
Hi.  I wonder if you might remember anything about the night Opal Sandstone's "Star of Solomon" sapphire was stolen.
Thank you so much! I'm wondering if you could help me. I'm in search of a copper-bottomed stock pot.
Can I have some ashes from your fireplace?
Good day, Martina sent me with the menu choices for Holli's wedding.
So, is everything ready to go?
Thank you. Zachava said I might be able to get an onion and a head of cabbage from you?

chatpoints.chat_text: It's always warm here. Warm and relaxing. How can I be of service to you?

replies.reply_text: I'm in need of a nap. Can't seem to keep my eyes open.
I'm famished. Got any good grub?
I'm tired and hungry...
I just wanted to meet you and now I must go. Thanks!

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, then, you have come to the right place, my friend. You'll see that I have it on my menu of services.  Just pick the nap option and you'll get a nice rest.

replies.reply_text: Great.  Thanks.

chatpoints.chat_text: Of course I do. Glad you asked. I would recommend the ham and eggs, but my wife is smitten with the stew. Take your pick; they will both hit the spot.

replies.reply_text: Great.  Thanks.

chatpoints.chat_text: I happen to have a remedy for both. You can eat some delciously warm food and take a relaxing nap. That should make you new again.

replies.reply_text: Great.  Thanks.

chatpoints.chat_text: That's a little strange, but whatever tickles your fancy. Come back sometime for my wife's stew. It's a treat!

replies.reply_text: All righty.  Thanks.

chatpoints.chat_text: Thanks for stopping by and come again.
Hmmm.  I remember that night.  Except for the theft itself, no, I can't say there was anything unusual going that night.

replies.reply_text: Or any time before or after?

chatpoints.chat_text: No, not really.  Well, one of the guests complained about a funny smell outside his window but that was all.  Never found out what it was.

replies.reply_text: Thanks a lot!  Goodbye.

chatpoints.chat_text: A stockpot? That's interesting. I had a fellow in here a couple weeks back looking for one. But I couldn't help him, either. Sorry.

replies.reply_text: Really? Do you know where he was from?

chatpoints.chat_text: I couldn't say. I told him to ask at the other inns around the island. Maybe another inn keeper could give you more information.

replies.reply_text: Okay. Thanks for the suggestion.

chatpoints.chat_text: Just gave my last bit to another traveler that came through asking. Sorry I can't help you!

replies.reply_text: Darn. Okay. Have a nice day.
Thanks, I will! (You start nibbling on some cookies while waiting.)
(You pass the time looking out of the Inn's window, watching the horses entering the Draft Arena.)
Yes sir, Holli chooses 6 appetizers and the cutoff date on changes is 2 weeks prior to the wedding.  Thanks, see you soon!

chatpoints.chat_text: Yes indeed you can! I've got some in the root cellar. Great stuff for soup! Let me grab you those. (William disappears for a couple of minutes and then comes back out with a brown paper bag.)

replies.reply_text: What do I owe you?

chatpoints.chat_text: Not a thing. This will be my good deed for the day. Just pass on the good will.

replies.reply_text: Thank you so much. I will be sure to do that.

chatpoints.chat_text: A French Horn!  A most discerning gift, I must say!  Very classy!  Yes, as it happens, I have several in my collection.  What price range were you considering?

replies.reply_text: Considering whom this is going to, I'm interested in a good one, regardless of price.
Cheap.  Well, okay, inexpensive.

chatpoints.chat_text: Good morning there.  And what is it today?

replies.reply_text: Nothing, really, just passing by.
I just came from Lucie B. Euro, she said she was a band student of yours, yes?
I'd like some information. I understand you know a thing or two about someone with an exceptionally beautiful voice?

chatpoints.chat_text: Lucie....?  Lucie.... Oh, yes!  Second Trombone!  A very capable student.   What about her?

replies.reply_text: I'm looking to buy a French Horn for ...a... friend of mine, and Lucie suggested you might have one.

chatpoints.chat_text: In that case, I have a very fine, nearly new French Horn which I might consider selling, or trading for.  From a very reputable maker, and with a grand sound.  I will sell it for $5,000.

replies.reply_text: Oh, no!  That's way too high.
Hmmm.  Okay, I'll take it!

chatpoints.chat_text: It's less than I paid for it!  A good instrument is very pricey, you know.

replies.reply_text: Yes, but that's out of my league entirely.  Sorry.  Do you have anything cheaper?
Oh, all right.
Thanks.  Goodbye.

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, I do have in my office ...and I must say, I have no idea why... an old horn that was used for many years worth of students.  The sound... is probably still passable although it doesn't have the great richness of tone that a good horn will have.  It needs polishing and some minor... well, let's just say I'll sell it very... cheap.  $500.

replies.reply_text: That's good enough.  I'll have that one.
Hmmm. Let me think now.... will Silver Mary be satisfied with an old one?  I don't dare go back and ask... Okay, I'll take the expensive one just be safe.
Thanks, goodbye.

chatpoints.chat_text: Unfortunately, JUST a thing or two. A lovely, lovely lady with a voice sweeter than a nightingale. She came through town and then left almost immediately. Much to my sorrow. She said Bird Isle was just too small for two women of the same name.

replies.reply_text: Would you have any idea where she headed to after leaving here?

chatpoints.chat_text: She mentioned something about a groundskeeper. I believe it was her uncle? I think she was heading there. If you do find her, please give her my best regards. My very, very best regards.

replies.reply_text: Umm. Sure. Thanks for that tidbit. I remember seeing a groundskeeper on my travels. Have a great day!

npc_list.name: Liam Flux
npc_list.long_description: Liam Flux likes being a blacksmith but he doesn't like dealing with the customers.

chatpoints.chat_text: Who's there?

replies.reply_text: Umm...  Just me.  I was wondering about your horseshoes.
Wow, crabby man.  I guess I'll take my business elsewhere.
Tessa was hoping you would have a bucket of nails she could have....  She said she'd return any that she didn't use.
It's me, Mr. Flux.  Can I have a minute of your time?  It's about Opal's sapphire.
I'm sorry to bother you, but Elaina said I should ask you about those odd horseshoes.
Hello again, Mr. Flux.
Hey, did you know you have a monkey in your metal tree?
