chatpoints.chat_text: (The poor man has bags under his eyes and looks exhausted.) It be long in the telling, and complicated in the fixin', matey. Ye'd be needin' a ton o' time on yer hands.

replies.reply_text: Time? Sorry, I don't have enough of that for another quest today. Maybe some other day. Bye!
Complicated? The more complicated the better for me, I say! And I've got plenty of time to listen.
I'm tired already! I'm outta here!

chatpoints.chat_text: It all be on account of Hyrokkin. Makin' me lighthouse keepers' stay on their toes, keepin' a sharp eye out to show ships a way to safe harbor. But Crow's Nest Carrie were fallin' asleep on the job and lettin' the oil run out. No oil, no light. Soon as she'd wake up and figure it out, she'd blow that dang blasted foghorn. On account of havin' to sound the alarm. We already be missin' one ship an' her crew that ain't made it back from plunderin'. I fear fer their lives, matey. Fer their very lives.

replies.reply_text: Yikes. I need you to back up a bit. Hyrokkin?
So the foghorn's the problem?
So Crow's Nest Carrie is the problem?
Whoa! Way too many details. You've made my head swim. I think I'll go lay down and take a nap. I'm gone like yesterday's sneeze!

chatpoints.chat_text: Aye. That sea hag's taken to stirrin' up trouble in these here parts. She be sendin' fierce storms our way. Tryin' to sink our ships out of pure spite, no doubt.

replies.reply_text: So, let me see if I've got this straight. A sea hag is sending storms this way, and one of your lighthouse keepers isn't doing their job right?
Sea hag? I am so outta here!
I know a little something about those lighthouse keepers. I am not in the mood to take on one of them right now. Maybe some other day. Good luck, Cap'n!

chatpoints.chat_text: Aye, ye got the gist of it. Crow's Nest Carrie were blastin' that dang foghorn all hours of the night. Ain't none of us were gettin' no sleep. And now the Skulls be all up in arms, on account of them not gettin' a bit o' shut eye either.

replies.reply_text: Yikes! Sounds like there's trouble brewing. We sure don't want anymore pirate feuding. I'll do my best to convince Crow's Nest Carrie to stop falling asleep on the job.
Potential pirate wars? I am so outta here!
This sounds like its going to take a lot more time than I've got. Sorry!

chatpoints.chat_text: Do not use, do not delete

replies.reply_text: Hopefully, everyone will soon be sleeping well and your lighthouse keepers will ALL be doing their job!

chatpoints.chat_text: It be that and more. I'd be needin' ye to find out what be keepin' Crow's Nest Carrie from gettin' any shut eye. And that just be the first part o' this here problem.

replies.reply_text: That DOES sound complicated. Oh well. Not to worry. I am more than qualifed to figure it out. I'll go talk to Crow's Nest Carrie and find out what the problem is.
Sounds like another one of those dreaded Lighthouse Quests! Too long and involved for my taste. I am so gone!
Yikes! You pirates have complicated lives! I'm gonna need some convincing on this. Would it be well worth my time?

chatpoints.chat_text: I be in need of a bit of good news. Let me be hearin' that first.

replies.reply_text: I found out why Crow's Nest Carrie's falling asleep. The place was overrun with crickets. Their chirping was keeping her from sleeping more than an hour or two at a time.
I've solved the cricket problem and Carrie's sleeping again.
The good news is that the Skulls are willing to tell me where the foghorn is.
The good news is that I'm back. The bad news is... I don't remember what I was supposed to be doing for you.
The good news is that its a great day to find a wild! I'm on my way now! Good day, to you, sir! Good day! Oh, and that's the bad news, too!
The good news is that I'm back. The bad news is that I don't remember what I was doing for you!
I gave the Skulls the red beans and rice they wanted in exchange for the foghorn.
The good news is that I'm working hard at resolving the issues.

chatpoints.chat_text: That be the good news? And the bad news be?

replies.reply_text: Yes. I'm going to get rid of the crickets. I'm working on that now. The bad news is I haven't figured out yet how to get rid of the crickets. I'll be back as soon as that's resolved.
That is good news, Sir. But she's been sleeping so soundly, the Skulls snuck in and stole her foghorn!
They want something in trade.
The bad news is that I give up on this quest! But I sure hope you find someone else willing to do all this running around for you! Have a great day!
I haven't found the foghorn yet.
The bad news is that I'm tired and hungry and I've got other things to do. Good bye!
The bad news is that I'm still working on the problem. I think I've found a solution. I'll let you know how it all works out.
Unfortunately, the bad news is that things have gotten a bit more complicated. But I'm working on finding a solution. I'll let you know the results.

chatpoints.chat_text: Blast those scurvy rats! Can you infiltrate their camp and get back the foghorn?

replies.reply_text: (Gulp!) Don't think so! I am gone like last year's snow!
Sorry. I'm not going to go sneaking around a pirate camp! Later!
Well, certainly. I've been practicing my sleuthing and sneaking around skills. I'd be happy to try to find the foghorn.
Be back soon! I hope.

chatpoints.chat_text: Arrrrg! And what be the thing that they be a wantin'?

replies.reply_text: Something to fill their bellies with so as to insure a good night's sleep, Sir. They want red beans and rice!
Red Beans and Rice. That was the worst quest ever! I just can't face going back to Stinky Breeches Vincent.
Arrrrg be right! It doesn't matter what they want! What matters is what I want! And I want to quit this quest. So I do. I quit!
Thanks for the reward, Cap'n. See ya around!

chatpoints.chat_text: Hmmm. (The Captain rubs his chin. Suddenly, his blood-shot eyes light up.) I got it! The very thing! You'll be needin' to get them a big pot of Red Beans and Rice. Puts me crew to sleep every time.

replies.reply_text: Terrific! I know just where to get those. Crow's Nest Carrie should have her foghorn back in no time.

chatpoints.chat_text: Be sure an see me after. I'll have a reward fer yer efforts, matey!

replies.reply_text: I'll be back soon!

chatpoints.chat_text: Ye were getting Red Beans and Rice for the Skulls. So they'd tell you whereabouts they hid the foghorn.

replies.reply_text: Oh right! I'll be back.

chatpoints.chat_text: Ye were goin' to talk to Crow's Nest Carrie 'bout her excessive use of the blimey foghorn.

replies.reply_text: Ah yes! I'll head over there now.
I did agree to do that, didn't I? Okay, I'm on my way.

Exactly! I didn't talk to her about that... exactly. But I did find out that she wasn't sleeping because the lighthouse was swarming with crickets. But I took care of them and everyone should be sleeping well again!

chatpoints.chat_text: Aye! T'would be well-worth yer time, Matey. If ye be smart enough for it!

replies.reply_text: And unfortunately, I just don't have time for this today. Maybe next time! Later!
Is that a challenge? You are questioning my intelligence? You've got it! I'll prove I'm smart enough to figure this mess out!
I'll prove how smart I am and just skip this quest, thank you very much anyway!

chatpoints.chat_text: Mind yer attitude, Matey. Hyrokkin ain't just any old Sea Hag!

replies.reply_text: Point taken. I had the pleasure of getting fish for her awhile back. I think I'll go see if she wants anymore. Later!

Apologies, Cap'n! I didn't mean any disrespect. Let me rephrase that. I believe it is beyond my talents to help you with Hyrokkin. On the other hand, if I understand you correctly, Crow's Nest Carrie is also part of the problem?
On that note, I'll be minding my attitude right on outta here! See ya!

chatpoints.chat_text: (The poor Captain shrugs.) It ain't be making no sense. She be one of the finest lighthouse keepers around. Until lately. I sent some of me crew to talk to her and she just kicked their salty bottoms right out of there. They happened to mention she be wearing awful bags under her eyes. From lack o' sleep, evidently.

replies.reply_text: Kicked their salty bottoms? What's to stop her from kicking mine? That doesn't sound too appealing to me. I think I'll pass. Later, Cap'n!
Okay. So Crow's Nest Carrie isn't doing her job right anymore, due to lack of sleep - and she isn't willing to talk to anyone about it? Is that right?
Maybe she's just having a bad week. I have a bad week sometimes. I say just give her time. Speaking of which, its time for me to feed the horses. Later, Cap'n!

chatpoints.chat_text: Ye were gonna infiltrate the Skulls, and see about finding that foghorn!

replies.reply_text: Oh that's right! I'm heading over now!
I'm on my way. Oh, joy! Knowing Vincent, it won't be easy.

chatpoints.chat_text: Buck up. I know ye can do this. Look at all bravery ye already be showin'. I be promisin' ye the reward will be worth it!

replies.reply_text: At this point, I just don't feel very brave. Sorry.
Reward? Usually that's tempting. But not today. Sorry, Cap'n.
(You suck in a deep breath.) Okay. You've talked me into it.

chatpoints.chat_text: Well now, ye best be gettin' to it!

replies.reply_text: Right. Who wouldn't want to dig through smelly barrels. Sigh. On my way!

chatpoints.chat_text: Good job, Matey. But I ain't the one needin' it!

replies.reply_text: Oh, right! I'll take it to Crow's Nest Carrie right now.

chatpoints.chat_text: Ye was gonna give the Skulls beans and rice for the foghorn.

replies.reply_text: Why, yes indeed I was. I'll get right to it.

chatpoints.chat_text: Sounds like she's gotten fearful feisty these days. Did ye try bribin' her with somethin' to soften her up? That be all I can think of.

replies.reply_text: Bribe her, huh? Might be worth a shot. I'll give it some thought and see what works. Thanks for the suggestion, Cap'n!
Bribe a pirate? I don't know. She's in a pretty foul mood. I'm not sure that wouldn't just make her madder. Mad pirates are scary!

chatpoints.chat_text: No, and I ain't sad about it, neither! I heard tell of a pirate who once did, and he was never seen from again!

replies.reply_text: I'm actually looking for a pirate who saw a kraken and did come back, so that's no good. Thanks anyhow.

chatpoints.chat_text: Me crew be an honest bunch. They ain't pirated a ship in many a storm. Ye best be jawin' at Cap'n Jack. His crew might be knowing a thing or two about what ye be asking 'bout!

replies.reply_text: Okay, I'll head over there now. Thanks!
Well, I hate to be telling you this, but I just spoke with Cap'n Jack. He seemed to imply that his crew had nothing to do with it.

chatpoints.chat_text: I'm tellin' ye, them Skulls are a sneaky lot. I'd say they be the ones ye be lookin' fer. Ye can't trust them as far as ye can throw the lot!

replies.reply_text: Okay, I'll head over there now. Thanks!
I'm sure your crew did it! Just admit it!

npc_list.name: Silvertooth Sam
npc_list.long_description: Expecting to see a metal grin, this pirate does not disappoint.  All but a few teeth have a metalic, silver sheen to them.  Which would make sense, being they are all made from the local silver ore.

chatpoints.chat_text: Ahoy there!

replies.reply_text: Uh, hi, uh, pirate.
Hi!  I can't really stay, sorry.  Bye.
Hello Sam.  Bart mentioned that Calico Jack may have left a couple of scraps of paper with you...
Hi!  Could you tell me where I could find something etched on a bone?
Ahoy! Crow's Nest Carrie asked me to find out what you do with your spare time.
Avast Sam!  Cannonball Cate siad you might be able to help me.

chatpoints.chat_text: What can I do for ya?

replies.reply_text: I was wondering if there was anything I could do for you?  A job, or something.
Oh, nothing.  Just looking around.  I'll be going now.

chatpoints.chat_text: For that, ya would have to see the Cap'n.  Surely he would have a job for ya.

replies.reply_text: Sounds good.  Thanks.
But I've already seen the captain.  I finished his job.
I did, and he's having me dig up chests by old shipwrecks.

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, then there be nothin' I can do for ya now.  Good luck on yer travels.

replies.reply_text: Okay.  Thanks.

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, ya best be gettin' to it, then.  Don't want to keep the Cap'n waitin', now.

replies.reply_text: I guess.  Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: Aye, he did.

replies.reply_text: Well, I just thought you'd like me to take them off your hands.  You're so busy with your pirating, and all - you don't want to have to carry around little bits of paper all day, right?

chatpoints.chat_text: Aye.  Ye can take 'em off me hands.  Only five amethysts payment to me fer havin' to hold 'em this whole time.

replies.reply_text: Ah, well, I'll just go get five amethysts now.
Oh well, here you go.  Five amethysts it is.
They're kind of filthy, but at least I can still read them.  Thank you, Sam.

chatpoints.chat_text: Why ye be botherin' me with such drivel?  Dunno... don't care!

replies.reply_text: Thanks anyway!
You collect old maps? (You look around his cabin.) I would never have guessed. I'll let Carrie know, thanks.
Obvious is an understatement, thanks anyway!

chatpoints.chat_text: So, Cate sent yer, did she?  And what is it that she thinks I would or could help ya with?

replies.reply_text: (You briefly explain what you are looking for and why) So…this is why Cate said I should talk to you.

npc_list.name: Joe Longbeard
npc_list.admin_description: pirate on middle island
npc_list.long_description: The name suits him, being he has a beard that goes almost down to his waist.

chatpoints.chat_text: Ahoy there, matey!  What brings ye to me little isle?

replies.reply_text: Just passing through.  Bye.
Just exploring.
That's quite the beard you have there.
I'm sort of stuck here...  Could you bring me somewhere?
Hello, I was just wondering, living here all alone, if you might have any chores I could do for you?
I'm looking for something etched on a bone, any suggestions?
A supply boat was pirated and I'm trying to figure out who did it. You wouldn't happen to have any ideas on that, would you?
Ahoa, there! I was doing something for you and I can't remember what. I'd appreciate a reminder!
Hi!  I hope you're enjoying your popcorn and cocoa!  Umm... Say, who did you say was the pirate behind the thieving?

chatpoints.chat_text: Ye be careful with these different pirate bands.  They don't much like each other.  Best not to get stuck in the middle.

replies.reply_text: I noticed that.  I assume that's why there are passwords to cross the bridges?
I'll remember that.  Thanks.  Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: Aye.  I hope ye know at least one of them, otherwise ye be stuck here.

replies.reply_text: Well, I forgot them.  Do you know what they are?
I do.  Thanks for the tip.  Speaking of passwords, I should get going.  Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: Aye, but I can't be tellin' ye the passwords.  That would get me in a bit of trouble with both groups.  I like to keep both sides happy.

replies.reply_text: Oh, come on.  You couldn't give me a hint?
Oh, I understand.  Well, hopefully I'll remember one of them soon...
They won't know you told me.  Just give me a hint.

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, just think of pirate words.  One of them I actually used in our conversation.  That be all I can say.

replies.reply_text: All right.  Hopefully that helps.

chatpoints.chat_text: Aye.  I do enjoy me beard.

replies.reply_text: Why do you live on this little island?
I can see that.  Well, I best be on my way.  Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: I don't like being confined to one group.  I prefer me solitude, but I can help me friends on either side of the bridges.

replies.reply_text: That makes sense.  Well, thanks for the chat.  Bye.
I can understand that.  I'll leave you be, then.  Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: Sure thing.  It be a bit out of me way, but I could bring ye near Earton for $500.

replies.reply_text: What?  All the way to Earton?  No thanks.  Nevermind.
Okay, sure.  That's fine.

chatpoints.chat_text:
Avast ye landlubber why ye be botherin' me...
(As Joe turns into the sunlight, you notice that his beard is a tangled, ratty mess.)
An' what be ye starin' at, I should like to know!

replies.reply_text:
Well, you look like your beard is in need of a little grooming.
Can I get you anything for your beard?
Me?  Staring??  Naw, not me... I've got to be going.  See ya!!

chatpoints.chat_text: Now that ye asked, could ye be goin' to Captain Solomon fer me and ask him how he keeps his beard in trim?  He's got a right manly beard, he does.

replies.reply_text: Sure.  I'll go ask him and let you know what he says.
I would, except those guys scare me... Maybe some other time. Bye!
I'll be back in a little while. See ya!

chatpoints.chat_text: Ye back so soon?

replies.reply_text: Yep!  The Captain said that you can get everything you need from Ricardo in Hotton.  He'll make up a complete kit for you just like Captain Solomon's.  He did say it would be expensive, but well worth the price.
I'm sorry, what was I doing for you again?
Hi! I've got the kit!
Well, I'd love to help more, but my... uh... horse, yea that's it, my horse threw a shoe and I have to go.  Bye!
Which captain was I supposed to talk to again? I can't tell them apart.
Um, excuse me Joe, but I did give you that grooming kit...
I'm sort of stuck here...  Could you bring me somewhere?
Okay, so it's off to Hotton then... Ummmm...  By the way, the Captain said that you should pay me well for my services, just thought I'd tell you...

chatpoints.chat_text: Ye be goin' to Hotton to see Ricardo!

replies.reply_text: Oh, yeah... I forgot... Be right back!

chatpoints.chat_text: Don't worry, I'll take care of ye when ye return.

replies.reply_text: Okay, okay.  I was just telling you what the Captain said... Geez!
Here you go, you have a handsome brush and comb set, and the finest trimming scissors.  You also have the best shampoos, conditioners and assorted hair care products in all of the Horse Isles.
Don't worry, my lips are sealed.  I'm sure with all this, your beard will be looking yar in no time!  Thanks for the necklace!

chatpoints.chat_text: Aargh! Ye be feeble-minded to boot.  Ye be goin' to Captain Solomon at the Cross Bones!

replies.reply_text: Sorry, my bad... I'll be right back.

chatpoints.chat_text: Arrgg! I told ye I keeps to me own self.  Dunno... Couldn't say.

replies.reply_text: Yeah, I forgot... Thanks anyway.

chatpoints.chat_text: I might, iff'n the incentive was right!

replies.reply_text: What kind of incentive might you be looking for?
Maybe I'll just keep on asking around. I'd rather do that than have to pay for information!

chatpoints.chat_text: We ain't got the tastiest vittles up here. Me mouth be waterin' something fierce for a fine hot cup of cocoa and some tasty popcorn. Ye get me them things and I be givin' ye the name of the piratin' scoundrel!

replies.reply_text: So, if I get you some hot cocoa and popcorn, you'll tell me what you know about the pirated ship and who's responsible? I would be happy to do that for you!
Ugh! I don't have time to run down your munchies list! Maybe some other day. Later!

chatpoints.chat_text: Aye! I gots a name fer ye when ye gots me my munchies!

replies.reply_text: I've got the goodies right here!
I'll go get those and be back in a jiffy!
Thanks for the information, and enjoy your munchies!

chatpoints.chat_text: My mouth be waterin' all this time for cocoa and popcorn and ye forgot!?!

replies.reply_text: Ah, ha ha? I was just teasing you? I've got the goodies right here!
Yikes! Totally forgot about that. I'll be back before the sun rises!

chatpoints.chat_text: The scoundrel ye be lookin' fer is Milo. He be a rowboat guard tryin' to start up his own pirate crew! Ye can find 'im on Saddle Isle.

replies.reply_text: Oh yeah.  Thanks!

npc_list.name: Maddog Robert
npc_list.admin_description: lost/ruined hat quest; new quests must begin at CP11

chatpoints.chat_text: Blasted!  Where be me hat!  Ah, ahoy there.

replies.reply_text: I'll leave you be.  Sorry.
Your hat?  What happened to your hat?
Your hat?  You won't need to worry about that anymore!  The sky is falling!  One Eyed Bill said the world is ending!
Ahoy!  Shark Soup Brady feels really sick, and I'd like to try and help her.  Can you give me any advice?
Ahoy!  Could you help me find something etched on a bone?
I don't know, but I'm wondering what happened to Crow's Nest Carrie's foghorn!

chatpoints.chat_text: I was walking by the beach and some blasted wind blew it right off me head.

replies.reply_text: That's too bad.  Good luck finding it.
Really?  Well, I could go look for it for you, if you give me more specific instructions.
All right.  I'll go find it.

chatpoints.chat_text: Did ye find me hat?

replies.reply_text: Not yet.  I'll get right on that.
Where did you say to look?
I did, but, umm...  The crabs kind of ruined it.

chatpoints.chat_text: The north shore by driftwood.  Those blasted crabs probably got it.

replies.reply_text: Oh, all right.

chatpoints.chat_text: Those blasted crabs!  Fine.  Now ye get to make me a new one.

replies.reply_text: Uh, what?
Okay.  I can do that.  Where would I do that?
No thanks.  I did what I said I would.  I'm not running all over trying to make you a new hat.

chatpoints.chat_text: Ye get to go make me a new hat.  Just like this one.

replies.reply_text: No. (Run away.)
Okay, fine.  Where do I go?

chatpoints.chat_text: Aye, but you will.  Because I say.

replies.reply_text: No. (Run away.)
Okay, fine.  Where do I go?
Fine.  I'll see what I can do.
That's fine.  I think I know where to go anyway.

chatpoints.chat_text: Where be me shiny new hat?

replies.reply_text: Oh, uh, I don't have it yet.  Sorry.  Be back.
Oh, that's what I was doing for you.  Right.  Be back.
Right here.  Hope you like.
Thanks.  Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: Ahoy there, matey!  Thanks again for me hat!

replies.reply_text: No problem.  Bye.
One Eyed Bill said the world is ending! The sky is falling!
Ahoy! Shark Soup Brady feels really sick, and I'd like to try and help her.  Can you give me any advice?
Ahoy! Could you help me find something etched on a bone?
I don't know, but I'm wondering what happened to Crow's Nest Carrie's foghorn!

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh no!  You best be figurin' somethin' out.  Go on.  Go warn the others.

replies.reply_text: All right.

chatpoints.chat_text: (Growls)

replies.reply_text: Thanks for the great advice.

chatpoints.chat_text: Arrgg!  Dunno... don't care!

replies.reply_text: Geez... Sorry!

npc_list.name: Saggin' Jowls Willie
npc_list.long_description: Saggin' Jowls Willie might be the skinniest man you'll ever see.

chatpoints.chat_text: Yeah?

replies.reply_text: Umm...  Nothing.  Sorry to bother you.
One Eyed Bill said the world is ending!  The sky is falling!
Shark Soup Brady feels really sick, and I'd like to try and help her...
I'm sorry to bother you, but I'm looking for something etched on a bone and a lot of your neighbors said that you're the best.
Howdy!  I'm back with your supplies!
Good day, Sir! I was wondering if you had noticed a foghorn anywhere around here lately?
Er... Excuse me, but what am I fetching for you again?
Uh... Ahoy there! I have a proposition for a scrimshander. That would be you, right?

chatpoints.chat_text: Too bad.  Be on yer way.  I don't much care for doomsday talk.

replies.reply_text: Okay...

chatpoints.chat_text: Dunno nuffin', didn' see nuffin'.

replies.reply_text: Okay.

chatpoints.chat_text: Thank ye fer the compliment. (Willie actually puts down his sword and gestures for you to sit down.) I'm right proud of me work, I do proper scrimshaw. No cuttin' corners.

replies.reply_text: Then I am at the right place, good!  Can I get a piece that would really represent the Pirate Isles?

chatpoints.chat_text: Aye, I have a proper piece here that shows a Pirate Galleon under full sail...  Aarrr, she be a beauty, all right!

replies.reply_text: It's perfect, how much do you want for it?

chatpoints.chat_text: I didn't say I'd sell it to ye.  I need some supplies.  Fetch them fer me and she be yours.

replies.reply_text: I just want the scrimshaw, I don't have time for anything extra, sorry!
Okay, I really don't have much of a choice.  What do you need fetched?
The ink and tools I understand, but why the dinosaur bone?

chatpoints.chat_text: I likes dinosaur bones.  They be havin' more to work with!

replies.reply_text: Okay, then.  I'll be back as soon as I can!
Wow!   This is the most beautiful piece I've ever seen.  I know someone who will get a great deal of pleasure from this.  Thanks!

chatpoints.chat_text: Are ye completely daft?  I asked ye to go to Salvador fer me ink and new tools and I needs another dinosaur bone.  Have ye got it this time?

replies.reply_text: Okay, I'll get right on that for you!

chatpoints.chat_text: (Saggin' Jowls Willie glares at you and doesn't utter a word.)

replies.reply_text: Alrighty then! I'll take that as a no.

chatpoints.chat_text: Arrrr, so ya has a proposition fer me?  What be yer proposition?

replies.reply_text: Well Iona, over in Flipperton, wants to hold a Founder's Day Crafts Festival.  She's hoping you can attend and display your work.  Here's your Invitation.
Righty-o See you there!

npc_list.name: Blackbottom Annie
npc_list.long_description: Blackbottom Annie is an independent, seasoned lass of the sea.

chatpoints.chat_text: Well 'ello.  What can I do for ya?

replies.reply_text: Oh nothing.  Sorry to bother you.
One Eyed Bill sent me to warn that the world is ending!
Shark Soup Brady feels really horrible, and I'd like to try and help her.  Can you give me any advice?
Could you help me find something etched on a bone?
Hello! I seemed to have misplaced my foghorn. You wouldn't have seen one around here recently, would you have?
I'm looking for something and was told that maybe you could help

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh no!  That's terrible!  What will we do?

replies.reply_text: Just wait in your tent.  We'll figure something out.  Gotta go warn the others!

chatpoints.chat_text: 'Tis about time that lass felt 'orrible about her scurvy manners.  She's me neighbor, 'tis true, but she never be sharing me pies, neighborly-like.   Brady don't want no cookin' 'cepts her own.

replies.reply_text: I meant she feels sick...  Can't you help?

chatpoints.chat_text: Ar, by rights she should be feelin' sick about it!  Don't be askin' me fer no favors!

replies.reply_text: Never mind.

chatpoints.chat_text: Arr. Do ye think I be one of them arts and crafty wenches?  Be off with ye!

replies.reply_text: Sorry!

chatpoints.chat_text: (Blackbottom Annie glares at you.) What tricks be ye tryin' to pull? Best ye be headin' out me door. Now!

replies.reply_text: Aye. Yes. I am so gone!

chatpoints.chat_text: What you lookin' fer?

replies.reply_text: I'm looking for information about the Lioness of Brittany, can you help me?

chatpoints.chat_text: Sorry dearie, never heard of it.

replies.reply_text: Thanks, I'll keep looking.  bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: Ahoy there matey!

replies.reply_text: Hi!  Just looking around.  Bye.
One Eyed Bill said the world is ending!  The sky is falling!
Ahoy!  I was just wondering if there is anything I can do for you?
Shark Soup Brady feels really sick, and I'd like to try and help her.  Can you give me any advice?
Could you please remind me what I was supposed to do for Brady?
Ahoy!  Could you tell me where I could find something etched on a bone?
Ahoy! I'm in need of a foghorn. I heard there was one somewhere on the island. Would you happened to know where that 'somewhere' might be?

chatpoints.chat_text: That be terrible.  Thanks for the warning.  Be off with ya.

replies.reply_text: Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: Arg.  Well, there be one thing I be needing, if you're up to the task, matey.

replies.reply_text: Well, I dunno... What is it?
Sorry, I can't right now. I have some other things to do, maybe later.
Sure, I'm up to any task!

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, mate, I need some coconuts.

replies.reply_text: Coconuts?
Seems like heavy work.  I don't think so.

chatpoints.chat_text: I need giant coconuts!  Lots of 'em!

replies.reply_text: That sounds like something you should ask someone else to do.
Okay...just how many do you need and where am I going to get them?

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, they be laying all over the palm forest to the west of here.  A skallywag like you should be able to find me 10 in no time.

replies.reply_text: Ten giant coconuts?  Okay, I'll see what I can do.
This skallywag has thought of something better to do!  See ya.

chatpoints.chat_text: Be quick about it matey, I have plans for those giant coconuts!

replies.reply_text: I'll be back as fast as I can!

chatpoints.chat_text: Arg, there ye be.  Did you get what I needed?

replies.reply_text: Ummm, what was it you wanted me to do again?
Yep!  Here you go, 10 giant coconuts!
No, I haven't, but I'll go and look some more.

chatpoints.chat_text: I need 10 giant coconuts!  And be quick about it!  Go look in the palm forest to the west.

replies.reply_text: Oh, okay.  I'll be back with those soon.
Okay, thanks.  Bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: Thanks for getting those coconuts for me, mate.

replies.reply_text: Sure, no problem.  Was there anything else you needed?
You're welcome.  Bye.
Could you please remind me what I was supposed to do for Brady?
Shark Soup Brady feels really sick, and I'd like to try and help her.  Can you give me any advice?
Could you tell me where I could find something etched on a bone?

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, I could have you deliver these to Windy Pick on Ice Isle.

replies.reply_text: Nah, I was gonna hang around on the isle for awhile.  Maybe later.
Okay, sure.  I'll deliver them for you.

chatpoints.chat_text: Good.  She lives on Ice Isle and runs the general store there.  You'll probably need some traveling money, so this should cover it.

replies.reply_text: Okay.  I'll get these delivered right away!

chatpoints.chat_text: Thanks for the help, mate.

replies.reply_text: You're welcome.  Bye
Ummm, what was I doing for you again?
Shark Soup Brady feels really sick, and I'd like to try and help her.  Can you give me any advice?
Could you please remind me what I was supposed to do for Brady?
Could you tell me where I could find something etched on a bone?

chatpoints.chat_text: Delivering 10 giant coconuts to Windy Pick on Ice Isle.  Now ye'd better hurry.  She's waiting for that delivery!

replies.reply_text: Oh, right.  I'll do that right now.

chatpoints.chat_text: You be off ta seein' Doctor Audrey in Hotton, fer Brady's sake.

replies.reply_text: Oh, right.  I'm going now.

chatpoints.chat_text: Aye, matey.  That lass is lookin' weak.  I gets to feeling poorly at times, meself. She ortin' ta be seein' a doctor.

replies.reply_text: She won't go see a doctor, she says she thinks it's the end!

chatpoints.chat_text: Aye, Brady's a stubborn lass!  Ye be off ta seein' the doctor yersef... Get somethin' fer Brady.

replies.reply_text: That hardly seems like the best way to go about it, but I guess if she won't take herself to the doctor, I have no other choice.

chatpoints.chat_text: Yer a kindly soul, I reckon.  Well, off ye go.

replies.reply_text: But, Scurvy Gums, I don't know of any doctors to ask!
Nah, it seems like you pirates are taking advantage of my selfless nature.  I think I'm going to go mine some diamonds instead.

chatpoints.chat_text: Heh heh, a brave adventurer like yersef, an' ye've ne'er met a doctor? They be in almost ever' town, if ye dare t' enter one. Go t' Audrey in Hotton. She don't look over-hard at what a man does fer a livin'.

replies.reply_text: Audrey's not exactly a... Oh, never mind.  Off to Audrey!

chatpoints.chat_text: Aye, matey.  The salt ye be lookin for lives right across the way.  Go see Willie.  He has continued the scrimshaw tradition.

replies.reply_text: Thanks, I will!

chatpoints.chat_text: I do, Matey! I do. But unless the Cap'n be sayin' otherwise, I won't be pointin' ye to the somewhere ye be lookin' for!

replies.reply_text: Just my luck...

npc_list.name: One Eyed Bill
npc_list.long_description: One Eyed Bill is a Skull Pirate and proud of it. He gave himself his nickname and wears a patch over one eye. No one's sure if he needs to, but they don't ask cuz Bill's a bit crazy.

chatpoints.chat_text: Help!  Help!  Ye must help warn the others!

replies.reply_text: Uh, no thanks.  Later.
Umm...  About what?
Uh... Maybe later.  I just need to know if you know where I can get something etched on a bone?
I'll be happy to warn the others, if you will just PLEASE tell me where Crow's Nest Carrie's foghorn is!

chatpoints.chat_text: The sky is falling!  The world is ending!  Please!  Ye must warn the others!

replies.reply_text: You're crazy!  The sky is not falling, and the world is not ending.  Goodbye.
Really!??!  Oh, no!!  What am I to do?!  I'm so young!  So much life to live!
I'm sure it's not that bad.  You probably had a dream or something.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, pull yerself together!  Ye must warn the others.  Then we'll figure something out.

replies.reply_text: All right, all right.  I'll go do that now.
But, but... Okay.  Phew.  All right.  I can do this.  I'll go warn the others.  In a sort of calm-like manner.

chatpoints.chat_text: Nay, but I wasn't!  See?  I have the bump on me head to prove it.

replies.reply_text: Ooo, ouch.  All right.  Well, something's going on.  I'll go tell people.
Wow!  That's nuts.  I'll definitely go warn people.
You're crazy.  Something just fell on your head.  I think I'll just leave you to your delusions.
I'm going, I'm going.

chatpoints.chat_text: Did ye warn 'em?  Did ye warn 'em?

replies.reply_text: I'm still working on it.  I'm talking to everyone.
Here.  Shimerin Shimm said you were just hit on the head with a giant coconut, not the sky.  So, the world isn't ending.

chatpoints.chat_text: Don't forget those in the forest.  They need to be warned, too!

replies.reply_text: Oh, all right.
Okay.  Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: Ahoy there, matey!  Thank ye for the help.  I told everyone the world isn't ending.

replies.reply_text: Good.  I'm glad.  Bye.
I was glad to do it, but now Shark Soup Brady needs help.  She's feeling very sick and weak.  Can you give me any advice?
Glad to hear it.  I just need to know if you know where I can get something etched on a bone?
I'll be happy to warn the others, if you will just PLEASE tell me where Crow's Nest Carrie's foghorn is!

chatpoints.chat_text: Brady don't got no time for Bill, Bill don't got no time for Brady.

replies.reply_text: Brady seems so well-liked.  Thanks anyway.

chatpoints.chat_text: Dunno... Don't care... More important things to do!

replies.reply_text: (You just back out of his tent.)

chatpoints.chat_text: Didja see me bump on me old noggin? The sky is fallin! Ye gots to warn 'em!

replies.reply_text: Ugh! You aren't the least bit helpful!

npc_list.name: Barnacle Ben
npc_list.long_description: Barnacle Ben is an old sailor.

chatpoints.chat_text: Ahoy there!

replies.reply_text: Hi.  Sorry, just looking around.  I'll leave you be.
Guess what?  The world is ending!  One Eyed Bill said the sky is falling!
Wow! Umm.... interesting ... decor you have here.
I was wondering .. it's still kinda, ummm, bleak in here. Do you need help with any thing else?
Shark Soup Brady feels really sick, and I'd like to try and help her.  Can you give me any advice?
Ahoy! I was wondering if you could help me with something...
I'm looking for a foghorn and I can't seem to get any cooperation from your fellow crew members. I'm hoping you'll be different.

chatpoints.chat_text: Did he now.  That be terrible!  Any other instructions?

replies.reply_text: Oh, well...  no.  He said we'll figure something out soon, but first everyone needs to know.

chatpoints.chat_text: Aye.  Well, I'll be a waitin'.

replies.reply_text: Okay.  Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: Ahoy, it needs t' be cleaned up. Gar, it looks like a dank cave.

replies.reply_text: Well then, you better get started.
Oh, things aren't that bad. I could help if you knew what you wanted done.
Hmm I guess I'll be back later.

chatpoints.chat_text: Ahoy matey! Did you get them jolly rogers taken care of?

replies.reply_text: What was I supposed to be doing again?
Yep got them all right here - fixed up and washed.

chatpoints.chat_text: Arrr, take the jolly rogers t' be fixed up and cleaned o'er on Turtle Isle.

replies.reply_text: Right! On my way.
Good luck!
Be back in a bit.
No problem - enjoy your new look.

chatpoints.chat_text: Aye, well, now that you mention it... Me would like some art from one o' the people on Art Isle. Can you check and see if any o' them have anythin' I can buy? Gar.

replies.reply_text: That's quite a ways away. Perhaps you should see if they have a mail order service.
Oh well, I don't know. I guess so, but I think I will need money for traveling expenses this time.
Sure. I'll head over there now.
Be back soon.

chatpoints.chat_text: Arrr, did you find some art for me?

replies.reply_text: Oh that's right. I must have gotten distracted - I'll head to Art Isle now.
I have some paintings right here.

chatpoints.chat_text: Does I looks like a doctor?

replies.reply_text: Nope.

chatpoints.chat_text: Arrr, do ye take me fer an information desk? Be gone landlubber!

replies.reply_text: Geez...sorry to bother you!

chatpoints.chat_text: Arrrr. Ye got 3000 diamond necklaces to pay for information about dem old foghorn, Matey? That be what it'd take to pry that from me lips!

replies.reply_text: Gesh! Its just a foghorn!

npc_list.name: Greasy Palms McGee
npc_list.long_description: Greasy Palms McGee is covered in soot and ash.

chatpoints.chat_text: Ahoy there!  What do ye want?

replies.reply_text: Nothing.  Sorry.  Just looking around.
One Eyed Bill said the world is ending!  The sky is falling!
Shark Soup Brady feels really weak, and I'd like to try and help her...
Ahoy! I was wondering if you could help me. I'm looking for something etched on a bone.
I want to find a foghorn. Its gone missing from one of the lighthouses.

chatpoints.chat_text: Did he now.  That can't be good.  Good warning.  Now be on ye way.

replies.reply_text: Oh, all right.

chatpoints.chat_text: Aye, I loves th' lasses who be all weak and wimpy like.  Them blotches on her skin only add to 'er charms.

replies.reply_text: Thanks, you've been astoundingly unhelpful.

chatpoints.chat_text: Are ye now. I'd go see me mate, Willie.  He be a right fine scrimshander. The best around these parts!

replies.reply_text: Scrimshander?

chatpoints.chat_text: Aye, that's what a bloke who makes scrimshaw items is called!

replies.reply_text: Oh... that's what he'd be called.  Thanks, I'll go see Willie then. Bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: I wish I could help ye, Matey. But there be Pirate's Code. You'll need ta be talkin' with the Cap'n!

replies.reply_text: Thanks for the tip!

npc_list.name: Scowlin' Sid
npc_list.admin_description: Change CP#0 1550 to 3634 when ready to go
npc_list.long_description: Scowlin' Sid has dark, straggly hair and only a few teeth left in his small mouth.

chatpoints.chat_text: Arrgh!  What do ye want?  Leave me be!

replies.reply_text: Sorry. I'm gone!
One Eyed Bill said the world is ending!  The sky is falling!
Shark Soup Brady feels really sick, and I'd like to try and help her.  Can you give me any advice?
Excuse me, but do you know where I can get something etched on a bone?
I just want to know if you've seen a foghorn anywhere around here.
You know, you don't seem like a very happy camper. Is there something I can do to help?
Hey there! I'm back and guess what I have for you? Custom made cowboy boots just for you!
Hey, why are you still scowling? You have the most amazing cowboy boots in all of the islands. That should have wiped out that scowl permantly!
Was there something I was doing for you?

chatpoints.chat_text: Leave!  I don't care what that looney has to say.
Arrrgh!  Get outta here, ya scalawag!

replies.reply_text: I'm on my way!

chatpoints.chat_text: Cast yer shadow away from me tent now, ya pestering scalawag!

replies.reply_text: Seriously, anger comes from hurt. Somewhere, sometime, you've been hurt - by someone or something. Please let me help.
Okay already! What a grump! I'm gone, gone, gone.

chatpoints.chat_text: Go! Begone! LEAVE! Can I be tellin' ya any clearer?

replies.reply_text: Nope. Not going. I've taken it upon myself to help those in need. And I'm not leaving until you tell me why you have such a scowl on your face.
As clear as day! I'm already gone.

chatpoints.chat_text: I gots me a scowl because I ain't no cowboy. Me daddy was a pirate and me granddaddy was a pirate and me great-granddaddy was a prirate. So me family figures I gotta be a pirate. But did anyone ask me what I wanted? Noooooo!

replies.reply_text: Oh. I see. So, why can't you just be a cowboy then?
Yikes! Those are some scary teeth you've got there! You obviously didn't take good care of them. Speaking of that - I think I'll go brush my own right now!

chatpoints.chat_text: Are ye daft as well as blind? Ya see any cowboy boots on me feet? (A quick glance and you see Scowlin' Sid is barefoot, and boy are those feel dirty!)

replies.reply_text: Well, if all it takes is getting you some cowboy boots, I am on it!
Nope. No cowboy boots. And no manners. You are as rude as you could possibly be. Therefore, I am leaving!

chatpoints.chat_text: I don't want any old cowboy boots. I want customized boots like a real cowboy would have. None of them fancy schmancy drugstore boots.

replies.reply_text: Okay already! I will get you some customized boots. Just like a real cowboy. Agreed?

chatpoints.chat_text: Jus' what 'xactly be I agreein' on?

replies.reply_text: Let's see. It was quite the adventure when I got shoes for Farley, so you need to agree to be patient. And how about a dozen diamond necklaces? Does that suit you?
More than you can afford because that's an adventure I don't care to repeat! So long.

chatpoints.chat_text: ( Scowlin' Sid bursts out laughing. He has a devious look in his eye that you aren't sure you can trust.) Well, I ain't going nowheres no how, so have at it iffi'n it makes ya leave me alone.

replies.reply_text: Wonderful! Your feet look like the same size as mine, so that will make things a bit easier. I'll have the scowl off your face in no time!

chatpoints.chat_text: Arrrgh! Ya promised me cowboy boots, ye rotton scalaway! Now get outta here, and don'tcha be darkenin' me doorway until ye bring me boots.

replies.reply_text: Oh, that's right. I am on the job like a frog on a lily pad! You'll be smiling in no time, you just wait and see!

chatpoints.chat_text: Go away already! Can't ye leave a man in peace?

replies.reply_text: But...but... we had an agreement. A... what do you call it?  An accord! We had an accord! I get you customized cowboy boots and you give me a dozen diamond necklaces.
Fine! I'll just take these boots and wear them myself! Grumpy pirate!

chatpoints.chat_text: Why would I be daft enough to make an accord like that? (Ugh! He's got that devious twinkle in his eyes.)

replies.reply_text: Because you said you wanted to be a cowboy and you needed cowboy boots to be one!

chatpoints.chat_text: I ne'er be sayin' such! I said no one asked me iff'in I wanted to be a pirate!

replies.reply_text: You said you were scowling because you didn't have cowboy boots! We had an accord. You have to abide by it. It's pirate's code of honor!

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh ye be a pesterin' bugger. Like a festerin' sore that jus' won't let a man sleep. I told ye them things so ye'd be leavin' me be. I didn't think ye'd find someone to make 'em. But fine already! I'll be takin' dem boots.

replies.reply_text: Gesh! After all the work I went through to get them, you'd better! Here!

chatpoints.chat_text: (Sid lets out a low whistle.) Dems nice boots alright! I hates ta admit it. Worse, I ain't got no dozen diamond necklaces fer ye.

replies.reply_text: Well, if ten are all you've got, I'll have to settle for that. Darn it. I was counting on a dozen. Well, have a good day I guess.

chatpoints.chat_text: I was born a pirate, Matey. Me daddy were a pirate and his daddy were a pirate and his daddy too. It be in me genes. So nows I'm a pirate with cowboy boots. Davy Jones be rollin' in his grave at such a ridiculous sight!

replies.reply_text: Arghhhh! There is no winning with you! I am so outta here.

chatpoints.chat_text: Other than leavin' me be? Ya said ya was gonna search for some customized cowboy boots! I ain't see em in your hands, so stop darkenin' me doorway!

replies.reply_text: Oh that's right! I'm going to wipe that scowl right off of your face! You just wait and see. Ta-ta now!

npc_list.name: Porthole Wilma
npc_list.long_description: Porthole Wilma has an infectious smile.

chatpoints.chat_text: What do ya want?

replies.reply_text: Nothing.  Sorry.
One Eyed Bill said the world is ending!  The sky is falling!
Shark Soup Brady feels really sick....
Um... I'm looking for something etched on a bone... Can you help me?
G'day to you, ma'am.  Captain Jack sent me to discuss a little business with both of you fine ladies.
If you give me the signed copy of the letter and the first shipment of coconuts, I'll bring them back to Hansel for you.
A foghorn. Please. Give me an old foghorn. A new foghorn. I don't care. I just want a foghorn!

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, he said that, did he?  I doubt it.  If it is, I don't much care anyway.  Be on yer way.

replies.reply_text: Umm...  Okay.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, nay! What's that ye say? Not Brady! How we'll miss her! (Wilma sobs uncontrollably into a huge rough handkerchief that looks like it was ripped from coffee sacking. She peeks at you to see if you're buying it.)

replies.reply_text: Pirates are such helpful types.

chatpoints.chat_text: Avast, ye lilly-livered landlubber, do I look like the artsy-crafty type?  Out wit ye!

replies.reply_text: Okay, okay....  I was just asking!

chatpoints.chat_text: Did he really? What sort of business did that mangy dog say we'd be discussin' with ye?

replies.reply_text: I represent Hansel and Gretel's new bakery in the Cloud Isles. Hansel has sent me to arrange for vendors for the following supplies. (You show Wilma the supply list.) Captain Jack thought that you ladies might be interested.

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, blow me down.  I have been lookin' fer a legit-like business venture that would support me in me golden years, and these islands are lousy with coconut palms.

replies.reply_text: Sounds like this would be a perfect match, don't you think?

chatpoints.chat_text: Aye, I've been tryin' ta figure out what ta do with all these coconuts anyways. (She motions to a huge pile of coconuts in the corner of the tent.) I'll do it, I'll be yer supplier fer coconuts, but yer gonna have to ask Cate about the molasses.

replies.reply_text: Very good.  Here's a letter of credit from Hansel.
Well, you have to sign it and give me a copy and I'll take the first delivery for the bakery with me, okay?
On behalf of Hansel and Gretel, thanks for the coconuts!  I'd better talk to your companion now.  Bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: (Porthole Wilma starts laughing hysterically) In yer dreams, Matey. In yer dreams!

replies.reply_text: Thanks for nothing!

chatpoints.chat_text: Hello!

replies.reply_text: Hi!  Just looking around.  Sorry to bother you.
One Eyed Bill said the world is ending!  The sky is falling!
Hi!  I, umm, have a note and a rose from someone for you.
Oh, I left before you could give me anything.  Did you have anything for Nathaniel?
Hi Cate!  Can you offer any advice on how to treat a person who's very weak, and has purple blotches on her skin?
Hi!  Can you help me find something etched on a bone?
Ahoy Miss Cate!  Captain Jack and Wilma said that I should speak to you about a little business venture.
Sorry, I wandered off.  Do you have the molasses and the letter ready?
Hi there. I seemed to have misplaced a foghorn. You haven't seen one, have you?
Greetings Miss Cate, How be yer business?

chatpoints.chat_text: Did he?  Hmm...  Have you warned the pirates in Patch Forest?  They would be a good group to talk to.

replies.reply_text: Okay.  Bye.
Oh that's right...  Sorry.  Hang on.  I'll go get one.  Something must have happened to the one he gave me.
He is quite clean now.  His hut smells all pretty too.

chatpoints.chat_text: Well how nice.  I first met him when a ship I was on almost hit a ship he was on.  He was grimy then.

replies.reply_text: It sounds like he cleaned up for you.  He was hoping for something in return?..
Gross.  Umm..  He was sort of hoping you had something for him?
All right.  Thanks.

chatpoints.chat_text: Aye!  Molassas cookies be th' cure fer thems who be feelin' pale - to fortify yer blood.

replies.reply_text: May I have some to take to Brady?  Maybe they'd help her!

chatpoints.chat_text: Brady?  That lass be as stubborn as a woolly headed mule about her victuals. She will nae touch me good cookies.

replies.reply_text: Oh well, thanks anyway.

chatpoints.chat_text: Aye, ye be seeking some scrimshaw.  It's an old skill from the whalin' days... Somebody around here still does it, but I can't be recallin' who.  Keep lookin'!

replies.reply_text: I'll keep looking, thanks.

chatpoints.chat_text: And what type of business did they say I'd be interested in?

replies.reply_text: Please allow me to explain. I represent Hansel and Gretel's new bakery and they're looking for someone who can supply the bakery with molasses. A grocer I spoke to sent me to Captain Jack and he sent me to you. (You show Cate the list.)

chatpoints.chat_text: Blimey!  That be a big order fer molasses.  I suppose I could handle it, though.  The delivery might be troublesome.

replies.reply_text: The Captain said to tell you he'd help get the orders delivered, for old times sake, and er, a percentage.

chatpoints.chat_text: Aye, that scurvy old dog doesn't miss a trick!  I'll do it. What be the next step?

replies.reply_text: Very well.  Here's a letter of credit from Hansel.
All you have to do is sign a copy and I'll take that and your first shipment back to Hansel with me.
Thank you, and I think you're right about the profitable arrangement.  Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: Blimey! I wouldn't be tellin' ye iff'n I did. Clear outta me tent. Go on!

replies.reply_text: Fine! I'm leaving already.

chatpoints.chat_text: Why by the depths of Davey Jone's locker, it be me muse!  If it t'weren't fer you. I would not have me business.  What kin I do fer ye?

replies.reply_text: Well, I'm looking into the history of the Lioness of Brittany and her treasure.  Ever heard of her?

chatpoints.chat_text: (She looks questioningly at Wilma and Wilma looks skeptical) And who be putting you on the hunt fer this information?

replies.reply_text: Well, I'm not at liberty to say right now, but let me just say that she's another female pirate who is in deep trouble.  I promised her I would do whatever I could to help.

chatpoints.chat_text: Do we know her?

replies.reply_text: Most likely, don't you all know all of the pirates around all the islands?

chatpoints.chat_text: (Again looks at Wilma, this time Wilma nods) Ok, ye helped us and it bein' fer another sister pirate I'll tell ye what we know.

replies.reply_text: Thank you, now what can you tell me?

chatpoints.chat_text: The Lioness of Brittany's name were Jeanne de Clisson, her husband twas executed by the king of France. She swore vengeance so she put together a fleet of 3 ships all painted black, sails of red and set sail in the English Channel.

replies.reply_text: Wow!  Then what happened?

chatpoints.chat_text: She be set that the King of France would pay for what he did.  She and her sons and her crew attacked and slew almost every person on every French ship they encountered in the English Channel.  The English loved her, the French, not so much!

replies.reply_text: Almost everyone?  She left survivors?

chatpoints.chat_text: Aye, she left a couple of survivors on each ship ta make sure the King of France knew wot happened and who did it.

replies.reply_text: So, what finally happened to her?

chatpoints.chat_text: The Lioness actually lived to retire after 13 years on the boundin' main, she married an English lord and lived happily ever after.

replies.reply_text: That's it?  What about her treasure?  What happened to her treasure?  After 13 years as a pirate, there had to be treasure!!
So I should talk to Silvertooth Sam then?

chatpoints.chat_text: Aye, he be the one. May Neptune's daughters guide you on this journey!

replies.reply_text: Thanks for the help, see you soon!

chatpoints.chat_text: Ahoy there, Matey!

replies.reply_text: Aren't you really young to be running a store selling such old junk?
This is not like any antique store I have ever been in. I think I will go now.
Hi there. You don't look like any pirate I ever saw before.
Shark Soup Brady feels really sick, and I'd like to try and help her.  Can you give me any advice?
Ahoy yourself!  Trixie Traderton in Flipperton sent me here.  She said she sent you some books about pirates.
Hi, I'm back!
I'm sorry, but what did you ask for again?
Who got those books again?
Ahoy!  Can you help me find something etched on a bone?
Ahoy, yourself! I'm wondering if you know anything about a foghorn?
Ahoy, I'm looking for something and was told that maybe you could help.

chatpoints.chat_text: Junk? This is not junk! This is genuine good stuff - straight from the ships the pirates raided.

replies.reply_text: Oh, so you mean this is all stolen property?
It still looks like junk to me. If you want to call it good stuff that is okay with me. I am going to be going now.

chatpoints.chat_text: Stolen? Of course not! Pirates don't steal. They take what others no longer need. That is not stealing.

replies.reply_text: Okay, whatever you say. I'll just be on my way.

chatpoints.chat_text: You know a lot of pirates, do ya?

replies.reply_text: Well, hmmm, no not really. I guess, I mean you don't look like any from pictures I've seen.
No, and I don't think I want to, either. Bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: You must not be reading the right books, Matey.

replies.reply_text: I don't think any books have pictures of pirates with purple hair.
Maybe I should go to the library and read now. Bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: I'm sure you must be right. I have not always had purple hair. I haven't always been a pirate either. I can't remember which came first - - - me being a pirate or me having purple hair?!?

replies.reply_text: You and your purple hair are just too strange for me. I have to go!

chatpoints.chat_text: Be ye wantin' ta gossip, or be ye wantin' ta buy? I nay be in th' mood t' chat.

replies.reply_text: Gee Blythe, your accent really comes and goes!  It's okay, I'll ask elsewhere.

chatpoints.chat_text: Aye, she did that fer sure.  Why be it any of yer business?

replies.reply_text: Well, I'm looking for a set of books that she said were part of that shipment.

chatpoints.chat_text: Arrr...and what be the name of the books ye be lookin' for?

replies.reply_text: Okay, here it goes... "The Pirates Own Book" by Charles Ellms.

chatpoints.chat_text: Aye, I had them books, but yer a wee bit late.  One of me shipmates already laid claim on them along with a book about the great pirate Henry Morgan and his secret codes.

replies.reply_text: Aw, gee.  I really need to get those books!  Can you tell me who bought them?

chatpoints.chat_text: I don't know if I should be tellin' ye this. (Blythe now has a sly smile on her face.) What be it worth to ye?

replies.reply_text: That depends.  What do you want for the information?
Five emeralds?  I guess that's fair.  I'll be back with them soon!

chatpoints.chat_text: Aarrgg.  Did ye bring what we agreed upon?

replies.reply_text: That I did.
Oh, maybe not.  What was it we agreed on?
Thanks for the information, now it's off to Shimerin Shimm I go!

chatpoints.chat_text: Has the salt air made ye feeble minded?  I said 5 emeralds will jog me memory right proper.

replies.reply_text: Oh, yeah.  I forgot!  Be right back with the emeralds!

chatpoints.chat_text: Are ye completely daft?  I told ye, Shimerin Shimm wanted the books.

replies.reply_text: Sorry.  Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: Ye be lookin' fer some scrimshaw.  But, much as I'd love to make a fair profit off of ye, I don't have any right now.  Ask around, a couple of these sea dogs still do scrimshaw.

replies.reply_text: Okay, thanks.  I'll keep looking!

chatpoints.chat_text: (Blythe raises an eyebrow at you.)I might. Then again, I might not. All depending on what me Cap'n be tellin' me to know. Iff'n you get my drift?

replies.reply_text: Great! Maybe I'll just go ask him!

chatpoints.chat_text: What am I supposed to know about and why would I help you?

replies.reply_text: I'm looking for information about the Lioness of Brittany, can you help me? Player:  Greetings Miss Cate, How be yer business?

chatpoints.chat_text: I've heard of her, but that's about all I know about her, her name.

replies.reply_text: That's OK, thanks anyway!

chatpoints.chat_text: Arrr!  What do ye want?  Buy or sell.

replies.reply_text: Oh, ummm...  Buy.
Well, uh...  Sell, I guess.
Nothing.  I'm getting out of here.
Umm, uh, well.... I'm here to pick up some hockey sticks?
Shark Soup Brady is ailing, and I'd like to try and help her.  Can you give me any advice?
Ummm. Buy, I think. You wouldn't happen to have any old fruit for sale?
Buy, if you have what I'm looking for.
Actually, I want some information.

chatpoints.chat_text: Get to it then.

replies.reply_text: Okay.

chatpoints.chat_text: Hockey sticks? Arrrr! Do I be lookin' like I have them here?

replies.reply_text: Yeah, uummm, not really? But Remy said you would have the hockey sticks for the Horse Isle Battalioneers.

chatpoints.chat_text: Aye!! Arrrr! I be carryin' those special for them.

replies.reply_text: Oh, that's good!  Can I pick them up please - and do you know who I might need to tell next about their practice starting?
Okay.  Yep.   On my way! Leaving now.  Seeyabye!

chatpoints.chat_text: Arrr, she's keeps a tight fist on that Ginger Ale recipe.  If she wants yer help with making it, I don't see why ye be askin' my advice.

replies.reply_text: Some pirates are in their own little world.  I'll ask elsewhere.

chatpoints.chat_text: Are ya lookin' to lose your head on the blade of me cutlass?

replies.reply_text: Yikes. I guess that means no. I'm outta here. NOW!

chatpoints.chat_text: And what be ye lookin' fer, landlubber?

replies.reply_text: I'm trying to find something etched on a bone.
I'm trying to buy some lemons. I know that pir.... uh, I mean - sailors - use lemons to prevent scurvy, so I was hoping you'd have some.
Darn. Looks like I forgot. If I remember, I'll come back.

chatpoints.chat_text: Avast ye scurvy dog, I don't sell no scrimshaw! Now quit pestrin' me and go!

replies.reply_text: Geez... Okay.  I'm outta here!

chatpoints.chat_text: Aye, ye be a smart one. I could spare a bag of me lemons. But it'll cost ye $200.

replies.reply_text: $200? For some lemons? That's crazy. I'm going to see if anyone else sells them.
Yikes! That seems pretty costly. But since I've come all the way out here, I'll go ahead and buy them.
Darn. I don't have that much money on me. I'll have to come back.
Thank you so much. And I'm gone like last winter's snow!

chatpoints.chat_text: Arrrr! I ain't in the business of information! Now quit pestrin' me and go!

replies.reply_text: Gesh! What a grumpy head!

npc_list.name: Shark Soup Brady
npc_list.admin_description: New Quests start at CP 11
npc_list.long_description: With a name like Brady, you were expecting a man, instead there is a woman with an eye patch in front of you.

chatpoints.chat_text: (Brady laboriously rises to her feet.) Ahoy there. Be ye needin' something, friend?

replies.reply_text: Nope, just passing through.  Don't get up.
It looks to me like you “be” needing some help, Ms. Brady.
A little help, maybe.  Do you know where I can find something etched on a bone?
Hi there. Sorry to bother you. I was wondering if you might have an extra stock pot for sale? Or know where I could buy one? With a copper bottom?
I do, indeed! I need a foghorn.
I'm looking for something and was told that maybe you could help.

chatpoints.chat_text: (Brady chuckles weakly.) Arrr, landlubbers and yer fancy talk! Ye best just be callin' me Brady. I reckon I'll not hear yeh half the time, if ye be puttin' on airs!

replies.reply_text: Haven't you ever heard the phrase “The customer is always right”?  I'm outta here.
Okay, “Brady” it is.  Do you need some help, Brady?  You don't look very well!

chatpoints.chat_text: Arrr, ye've got a fast eye and a stubborn nature -- I like that, friend!  Yar, in right poorly shape, I be.  I feel like a pepper barrel that lost me cork.  Eyeball these ugly purple splotches on me legs, too.  Yar, the end be near, friend.

replies.reply_text: Oh, maybe it's not as bad as all that.  You're just weak and you have blotches on your skin?  Why can't you go see a doctor?
That does it!  I'm sure you're contagious.  Goodbye!

chatpoints.chat_text: Nay doctors.  Did I no' tell ye, I'm on me way OUT?

replies.reply_text: Well, I have to help you...  I can't just leave you like this.  If anything, you're much too sick to do your job.  I'll just ask some folks around here to see if anyone has ideas.
I think you just have an overstimulated drama gland, so I'll be on “me” way out as well.  Bye.
I'll be back shortly!

chatpoints.chat_text:
(Brady is still looking listless.)
Ahoy again, friend. Be it fair or foul wind that blows ye through me door?

replies.reply_text: Brady, what was I doing for you again?

I've got great news, Brady.  The symptoms you're showing are most likely the early stages of scurvy.  The doctor said you should eat one or two of these oranges every day till they're gone, and you'll be well again soon.

chatpoints.chat_text: Arr, ye said ye was spreadin' the sad tidin' of me plaguey sickness, I reckon.

replies.reply_text: Actually, I was asking the other pirates for something that might help you.  I'll get back to that, now.
Uhh, I don't know how to say this, Brady, but while we're on the subject, did you ever think of offering more variety on your menu?

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, friend, what were you saying?  It takes a brave soul to bellyache about me cookin'!

replies.reply_text: Belly ache is right! If you offered some different menu options, you might actually get compliments! So only for the sake of your business, I've brought you some different fruits... 10 strawberries and 10 tomatoes!
Oh, that's just a myth.  They're both delicious - I'm a living testament.  The tomatoes are especially good made into a sauce for noodles.
Thanks very much, and get well soon!

chatpoints.chat_text: Ahoy again, friend!  Thank ye for yer help before.

replies.reply_text: You're welcome.
You're welcome.  Did you have a chance to try that other fruit?
Ahoy Brady!  I brought you some more tomatoes!
You're welcome.  Now I need little help.  Do you know where I can find something etched on a bone?
Hello again! I was wondering if you might have an extra stock pot for sale? Or know where I could buy one? Oh, and it has to have a copper bottom.
I do, indeed! I need a foghorn.

chatpoints.chat_text: Aye, friend, that I did.  I don't much care for them strawberries, but ye were on ta somethin' with the tomato sauce!

replies.reply_text: That's great to hear.  I could probably bring more, if you'd like me to.
I'll remember that.
I have some more!
I'll bring more soon.

chatpoints.chat_text: Aye, one of me best customers does that carvin' thing... Go see Willie.  He's yer man!

replies.reply_text: Thanks for the tip!

chatpoints.chat_text: No. I don't have an extra one, and I sure don't know where you could find one. I don't get around these here islands much. Being a pirate an' all. Try asking at the inns.

replies.reply_text: Darn. Okay. Thanks anyway.

chatpoints.chat_text: Ye best be talk'in to the Cap'n then!

replies.reply_text: Thanks. I'll head over to his place now.

chatpoints.chat_text: Depends, what ye be lookin' fer?

replies.reply_text: I'm looking for information about the Lioness of Brittany, can you help me?

chatpoints.chat_text: Sorry, mate, can't help ya with that one!

replies.reply_text: OK, thanks any way.  Bye!

npc_list.name: Crossbones Pirate
npc_list.admin_description: takes you to bird isle

chatpoints.chat_text: Off we go!

replies.reply_text: Okay.
No, wait!  Not yet.

chatpoints.chat_text: Here we be.

replies.reply_text: Thanks.

npc_list.name: Skull Pirate
npc_list.admin_description: takes you from Skull to Saddle Isle

chatpoints.chat_text: Off we go!

replies.reply_text: Okay.
No wait!  I'm not ready yet.

chatpoints.chat_text: Here we be.

replies.reply_text: Thanks.

npc_list.name: Skull Pirate
npc_list.admin_description: takes you from Saddle Isle to Skull of Pirate Isle

chatpoints.chat_text: Off we go!

replies.reply_text: Okay.
No wait!  I'm not ready.
A moment of your time, if you would sir. Do you know where I could find a scrimshander?

chatpoints.chat_text: Here we be.

replies.reply_text: Thanks.

chatpoints.chat_text: Ye be lookin' fer a scrimshander? Saggin' Jowls Willie does some right fine scrimshaw, he does. He done the work on me leg. (Proudly shows you his peg leg with a 7 masted ship etched on it.)

replies.reply_text: Wow, that's impressive!  I'm ready to go now.

npc_list.name: Crossbones Pirate
npc_list.admin_description: takes you from Bird to crossbones on Pirate

chatpoints.chat_text: Off we go.

replies.reply_text: Okay.
No, wait!  I'm not ready yet.
Pardon me, Captain.  Would you happen to know of a pirate who is also a scrimshander?

chatpoints.chat_text: Here we be.

replies.reply_text: Thanks.

chatpoints.chat_text: Ye be lookin' fer a scrimshander?  Saggin' Jowls Willie over in Skullton does some right fine scrimshaw, he does.

replies.reply_text: I'm ready to go now.

chatpoints.chat_text: Hahaha!  Ahoy!

replies.reply_text: I'll leave you to your feathers.  Bye.
One Eyed Bill sent me to warn you!  The sky is falling!  The world's going to end!
Shark Soup Brady feels really sick, and I'd like to try and help her.  Can you give me any advice?
I don't suppose you could help me find something etched on a bone, huh?
Ahoy! Would you be able to tell me anything about a foghorn?

chatpoints.chat_text: Is it, now?  Ahhaha!  No big deal.  I'm sure things will be fine.

replies.reply_text: Okay.  If you say so...

chatpoints.chat_text: Ahahahaha!

replies.reply_text: (Nonplussed silence.)

chatpoints.chat_text: Ahahahaha!

replies.reply_text: It wasn't that funny...

chatpoints.chat_text: Ahahahaha!

replies.reply_text: Guess that means no.

npc_list.name: Black Bart
npc_list.admin_description: collect anchors; Future quests must start at CP 8
npc_list.long_description: This pirate's hair is so black you can understand why he got his name.  For a pirate though he has an awfully nice grin.

chatpoints.chat_text: Ahoy there matey!

replies.reply_text: Hi.  Sorry, just looking around.  Bye.
Hi!  Wow, these are really neat things you have in your hut here.
Hello, Black Bart.  Would you happen to have a couple of scraps of paper that used to be Calico Jack's?
Bart!  It's good to see you're back on your feet!  Could you remind me where I need to contine the trail of Calico Jack's paper scraps?
Ahoy there!  Can you help me find something etched on a bone?
Hi matey!  Crow's Nest Carrie wanted to know what, if anything you might do with your spare time?

chatpoints.chat_text: Arrr!  Thank ye.  I collect anchors.

replies.reply_text: I see that.  Nice collection you have here.
What an interesting, and heavy, thing to collect.  They're very nice, but I need to go.  Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: Aye.  But ye goin' to help me get more!

replies.reply_text: Am I now?  All right.  I guess I can.
I don't think so.  Find someone else!
Oh!  That sounds like fun!  I'll do that for you.
But I've already dug around the ship parts looking for Captain Solomon's chests!
Okay.  I'll start looking.

chatpoints.chat_text: I guess ye know where the ship wrecks are then.  Get going!

replies.reply_text: All right.  Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: How did ye fair?  Did ye find any anchors?

replies.reply_text: Where was I supposed to look for those?
Not yet.  I'll get right on that.
I did.  Here.

chatpoints.chat_text: Dig near the ship parts both here and on the skull.  I hope ye know how to get to the skull without getting stuck though.  Har har har.

replies.reply_text: Okay.
All right.  Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: Ahoy!  Me anchors be beautiful.  Thanks!

replies.reply_text: You're welcome.  Bye.
Hello, Black Bart.  Would you happen to have a couple of scraps of paper that used to be Calico Jack's?
Bart!  It's good to see you're back on your feet!  Could you remind me where I need to continue the trail of Calico Jack's paper scraps?
Ahoy there!  Can you help me find something etched on a bone?
Hi matey!  Crow's Nest Carrie wanted to know what, if anything you might do with your spare time?

chatpoints.chat_text: I have nothin' like that.

replies.reply_text: Oh, that's a shame.  I guess I'll keep asking around.
Do you know anyone else who might have some?

chatpoints.chat_text: Arrr, mate, ye keep doggin' a body till ye get yer answers, don't ye?

replies.reply_text: Sorry, I didn't realize I was being a pain.

chatpoints.chat_text: Ooch, there ye go again, hounding away.  Will ye no' give it a rest?

replies.reply_text: Wow, I guess there's nothing else to say.  I seem to be doing nothing but making trouble for you.

chatpoints.chat_text: Arrr, what's that matey?  Nae trouble!  Ye just go see me wife, Rhianna, just like I told ye before.  She'll set ye straight.

replies.reply_text: What?  But didn't you... you didn't... ahh.. okay, yeah, just like you said before.  Thanks for the tip, Bart!

chatpoints.chat_text: Argh, argh!  Away wi' ye!  Ye'll be getting no tips out o' me, mate!

replies.reply_text: Sorry!  I'll just be -

chatpoints.chat_text: Headin' out to talk to Sam and that lad what rows the dinghy?  Good, good... that'll be the way to go.

replies.reply_text: Oh!  Thanks!  I'll remember to --

chatpoints.chat_text: 'Ow many time do I harf ta tell ye?  I dunno nuffin'!  Ye've got the wrong man!  Now, git!  Git!

replies.reply_text: Anything else you'd like to tell me, that you might or might not have told me before?
Pirating is bad for the nerves!

chatpoints.chat_text: I'm not sayin' I haven't seen 'em, but I don't have 'em.  Talk to me wife Rhianna, and ye might stop to talk to Sam, and also the lad who rows the dinghy, while yer at it.

replies.reply_text: Thanks again, Bart.

chatpoints.chat_text: Etched on a bone, eh?  I dunno of no tar hereabouts that does that artsy stuff.  Try them salts over by Skullton.

replies.reply_text: Okay, thanks.  I'll ask there.  Bye!
Anchors, I should have guessed.  I'll let her know, bye!
Well, it's different all right, I'll let Carrie know, thanks.

npc_list.name: Squalid Nathaniel
npc_list.admin_description: & New Quests must start at CP10
npc_list.long_description: You can't imagine how he got his name.  He is the cleanest and most put-together pirate you have met yet.

chatpoints.chat_text: Ahoy thar, landlubber!

replies.reply_text: Hi!  Just passing through.  Bye.
You have an interesting name.  What does it mean, though?
Interesting name.  It doesn't really describe you, though.
Hi, Nathaniel.  Silver Mary told me that you have a couple of scraps of paper that you got from Calico Jack.  Could I talk you out of them?
Hi, Nathaniel!  I'm here about the scraps?  Do you have a couple of them?
Hi!  I was wondering if you could help me.  I'm looking for something etched on a bone... Ring any bells?
Ahoy Nathaniel!  Crow's Nest Carrie wants to know what, if anything, you do with your spare time.  In other words, do you have any hobbies?

chatpoints.chat_text: Filthy.  Or so I been told.

replies.reply_text: Huh, okay.  Well, I guess I'll be going now.
You don't really fit your name.

chatpoints.chat_text: Nope.  Not anymore.  I have cleaned up.

replies.reply_text: I noticed.  For any particular reason?
Well, good for you.  That's wonderful.  I'll be on my way now.  Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: Aye.  Thar be a girl.  She's a Skull Pirate, though.  So I can't even go see her.

replies.reply_text: That's too bad.  Well, good luck.  Hope you figure something out.
I would offer to help you out, but I can't get across the bridge...  I'm sorry.
Well, I could bring a note or something to her, if you want.

chatpoints.chat_text: Can't help ye thar.  Don't know the Skull's password.  Cap'n Solomon should have given you ours.  I can't tell ye it if ye don't know, though.

replies.reply_text: Well, I guess I'll go do some work for Captain Solomon first.  Then maybe I can help you out.
I already helped the Captain out, so I know that password.  I guess I'll have to find a different way to get to the skull side of Pirate Isle.
Oh, all right.  Well, I'll go figure out something.  Then maybe I'll come back to help you out.  Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: Thar may be a way over there if ye leave Pirate Isle and go to the skull by a different rowboat.  I don't know where that be, though.

replies.reply_text: Oh, all right.  Well, I'll bring a note to Cannonball Cate if you like, then.  I think I may know how to get there.
That sounds like way too much work.  Maybe I'll come back and help you later.  Once I can get to the other part of Pirate Isle.  Bye.
Okay.  Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: Did ye give her the note and rose?  What did she say?

replies.reply_text: I didn't yet.  I'll get right on that.
Not yet.  Where was I going?
I did and she gave me this to give to you.

chatpoints.chat_text: I gave ye a note and yellow rose to give to Cannonball Cate.  Let me know what she says.

replies.reply_text: Oh, right.  Okay.
Thanks.  I hope things work out for you.

chatpoints.chat_text: Ahoy matey!  Thank ye for delivering that letter.

replies.reply_text: No problem.  Bye.
Hi, Nathaniel.  Silver Mary told me that you have a couple of scraps of paper that you got from Calico Jack.  Could I talk you out of them?
Hi, Nathaniel!  I'm here about the scraps?  Do you have a couple of them?
Hi!  I was wondering if you could help me.  I'm looking for something etched on a bone... Ring any bells?
Ahoy Nathaniel!  Crow's Nest Carrie wants to know what, if anything, you do with your spare time.  In other words, do you have any hobbies?

chatpoints.chat_text: Aye, mate, ye can take 'em with me compliments – fer only 5 topazes.

replies.reply_text: Aw, I've been saving these for silver necklaces!  Oh well, it's for a good cause.  Here you go.
I'll have to go find some more.  I'll be back soon.
Thanks!  Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: Ye've lost yer reason!  I gave me scraps to ye a'ready!  I told ye the bridge guard had a few.

replies.reply_text: Oh, oops.  Thanks!

chatpoints.chat_text: Arrgg! We don't fancy no artsy things here in Crossbones.  Keep lookin'.

replies.reply_text: Sorry to bother you, bye!
Hmmm...stamps. (Nathaniel shoots you a dirty look.) Oh right, no time for hobbies, got it (You wink back.)
I'll let Carrie know you only do piratey pirate things. (You return his wink.) I'll go tell her.

chatpoints.chat_text: Ahoy there, ye landlubber.

replies.reply_text: Ahoy there!  Your cabin is remarkably...
Ahoy there.  I'm back.
Here is all of the stuff.
I gave you the french horn.  What next?
All right.  I gave you the drum.  Now what?
You have the dress now.  What next?
Here's the paint.
Whew.  You have everything.
I hope your production is going well!
Hello there.  The Captain told me you had some pieces of paper that you got from Calico Jack.  I think they might help Jubal in some way. Would you mind if I had them?
Hello there.  The Captain told me you had some pieces of paper that you got from Calico Jack?
Ahoy!  I'm looking for something etched on a bone, any suggestions?
Ahoy! Crow's Nest Carrie asked me to find if you have any hobbies in your spare time.

chatpoints.chat_text: Neat!  Tidy!  I be proud o' it!  Just because ye 'appen to be a pirate, don't mean ye should be all disorganized like.

replies.reply_text: I see.  Well, I'll leave you be, then.  I'm just passing through.

chatpoints.chat_text: Passin' through?  Just passin' through?  Nobody come to a pirate village just to pass through!  And if ye come through this here pirate village, matey, why ye should just better be prepared to make yerself useful!

replies.reply_text: No thanks.  I'll be on my way.
Useful?  Well... okay, what do you need done?

chatpoints.chat_text: Arr, now that's the spirit!  There is summat you can do fer me, and I'll pay ye well fer it, too!  But ye'll have to do it all quiet-like, because it'll end up bein' a surprise, see.

replies.reply_text: Okay, tell me what you want done.

chatpoints.chat_text:
Well, as it happen, I've heard tell that there be folk abroad, landlubbers and other scurvy sorts, what thinks us bucaneers be churlish, crass folk by nature, see? But I say different! An' I aims to show 'em that we be as cultured and civilized as any other lot! So what I be doin' is this, see:
I be organizin' all the pirates on these isles into an actin' troupe. An' together, we be performin' Gilbert & Sullivans' The Pirates of Penzance! Arr, how 'bout that, eh?

replies.reply_text: I'm... interested how you're going to get the Skull pirates and the Crossbones pirates together to do this.
Uhm, no, this sounds kind of explosive.  No thanks, I don't want to be anywhere near this.  Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: That be my problem, me bucko.  What be your problem is getting me some props!  Ye can see that supplies be a bit limited on these isles.  So I be givin' ye a list what things I be needing.  An' if you finds 'em and brings 'em back good an' proper, I'll reward ye, an' well, too.

replies.reply_text: Oooooo-kay.  Let me write this down.
