chatpoints.chat_text: I have, I think, a good plan! You bring, to me, maybe, I think, seventeen peacock feathers, and then, I can wear them, and be just, exactly like, a beautiful peacock!

replies.reply_text: Sure, I can do that!
No, sorry, that's too much trouble for such a silly thing.
Seventeen? Why on earth seventeen?

chatpoints.chat_text: Fifteen, that number, it is too small, and eighteen, or nineteen, or twenty, is too much, too high.  So, seventeen!  It is perfect!

replies.reply_text: All righty, then...
No way am I doing something so dumb. Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: You can! Oh, thank you, thank you so, so very much! This is very, it is nice of you to help me!

replies.reply_text: No problem. I'll be back with those feathers soon.

chatpoints.chat_text: Hello, friend! Did you, have you brought, for me, those feathers?

replies.reply_text: Not yet.  What exactly was I supposed to do again?
I'm still searching for them all.
I've got them right here!

chatpoints.chat_text: I need, to be like, a beautiful peacock, to have, just seventeen, of their feathers.

replies.reply_text: Oh, yeah. I'll be back soon.
Oops- I'll be back with all of them soon.
You're welcome! Thanks for the present.

chatpoints.chat_text: You are, at last, back to see me! Hello! Do you, can you see my very beautiful, special new plumage? (He has a few peacock feathers tied to his tail with string.) I am, I think, now just like those birds, like, a peacock!

replies.reply_text: You look great!
Uhh... Yeah. Bye now.
Your plumage IS very beautiful. Can you tell me again, where I was suppose to check out the scary noises made by a love-sick frog?

chatpoints.chat_text: Thank you! I am, very, very pleased! Oh! And, I have some news, information, to tell you, if you wish to hear.

replies.reply_text: Maybe later. I have to go now.
Ooh, tell me!
Tell me, tell me! I need a little spice in my life, and sometimes news can be spicy, so to speak!

chatpoints.chat_text: Since now I am so beautiful, I took a quick flight, around, to show off to others, my new feathers!  While I was, flying around, over the isle, which looks, to me, like a saddle, I saw, down south, on the beach, a man! I think, that perhaps, he was washed up, on the beach, from the sea!

replies.reply_text: Hmm, maybe I'll check it out sometime. Thanks for the tip.
Where exactly did you see him?

chatpoints.chat_text: Hmm, I think, it was, the far, southeast shores of the saddle-shaped isle.

replies.reply_text: Thanks for the info. I'd better go now. Bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: With my new feathers, I think I am, newly beautiful, flitting about, I was, well, as proud, peacocking about. You see, right? These feathers, mustn't waste, so much beauty, I think, such a shame, to soar and swoop, see me shine! But as I flew, and flutter, I did, perchance, above a cotton patch, a horrid noise, I heard.

replies.reply_text: Oh dear. I don't like frightening noises, or horrible noises either. So I will just take my leave and say good day to you Sir!
This is interesting. Can you tell me a bit more why you think this might be of some importance?

chatpoints.chat_text: Mysterious, a horrid commotion, an unruly raucous. Swooped, and listened. I think, it seems, distressed and maybe? Forlorn? A frog? Forsooth? Love lost? Or found?

replies.reply_text: So, you heard a horrid commotion, some mysterious sounds, from a frog? Pray tell, what part of the island exactly are we talking about?

Mysterious? Horrid commotion? Unruly raucous? I don't think I'm up for any of those things today! Should I decide, at some future point in time, to pursue such distractions, I will surely come calling again. So in the meantime, good bye, good bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: A fishing pond, oh fish a fine meal they make! Sardines! Sardines! A past-its-prime dead tree. Tip toe through the cotton fields, alas I do not tip toe. Delicious, delectable berry bushes! Anyway, because you've asked, and because I should answer, answer I shall. Should I not?

replies.reply_text: Well, I'm not sure it will amount to much, but I'll check it out.
So, out in the middle of nowhere, basically? I might ride by there some day and check it out, but I've got things to do, people to see and places to go. So go I must!

chatpoints.chat_text: Thank you! I enjoy the look, peacock proud, I think, I am proudly. The frog, forlorn or love lost, Oh! The fishing pond, and berry bushes! A tasty meal that makes! East you go. The dead tree. And faires! Berries! East, and southeast a tad more. Dinner. Munchies. I have none. Do bring me some!

replies.reply_text: That's right. I'm on my way!

npc_list.name: Dusty
npc_list.admin_description: change cp0  1550 to 4400 and delete cp4 1550 when ready to go live
npc_list.long_description: Dusty is a short man with grey hair and is full of dust.  Every time he moves dust shakes out of his hair and clothes.

chatpoints.chat_text: Hey there youngun'! You've traveled awful far to get to my hut.

replies.reply_text: I know, sheesh it took forever!
Yeah, now that I'm here I don't want to be anymore.
Yes I have. And I am here to deliver a package from Pony Express!
You had mentioned that you had a brother. Can I ask who that might be?
Hi Dusty. Can you remind me what I was supposed to be doing for you?
I'm back with good news! I gave your letter to Gritty.

chatpoints.chat_text: What brings you here?

replies.reply_text: Can you send me to Dust Isle?
Um, just checking things out.  I'll be going now, though.

chatpoints.chat_text: Sure don't know why you'd want to go there but I'll send you.  Look for my buddy over there to send you back.  He stays close to the cacti.

replies.reply_text: Okay, great!
Thank you so much!
If you don't mind me asking, who's your brother?

chatpoints.chat_text: Gritty. I miss him. No matter how prickly he can be. Family is family. Since we hadn't talked in years, I figured we never would. Then he sent me the package.

replies.reply_text: Well, some family can be like that. Speaking of family, I need to join mine for dinner. Bye!
Gritty? He's that grouch on Art Isle! Hey - Gritty and Dusty. Your parents weren't trying to start their own version of the seven dwarves, were they? Oh, never mind! I'm outta here.
What was in the package?

chatpoints.chat_text: I'm not sure. I haven't opened it yet, but I suppose I should. (Dusty opens the package and finds an old toy truck. He tears up again! Then he turns to you.) I haven't seen this since I was 5 years old! Gritty took it. I thought he'd thrown it away. Would you be willing to do me a favor?

replies.reply_text: I might. But only if you are asking me to do something nice. I think Gritty is trying to make amends here.
I stay clear of family disputes. Sorry!

chatpoints.chat_text: I agree! Hang on one minute. (Dusty quickly writes a letter. He folds into the shape of a dove and hands it to you.)

replies.reply_text: Hey! You know origami! That's really cool. Okay, I'll head over there now. Wish me luck that he doesn't kick me out of his house before I can hand this to him!

chatpoints.chat_text: You were taking my letter to my brother Gritty.

replies.reply_text: Oh. I did agree to that, didn't I. Drat. Okay, I'll get to it sooner or later.

chatpoints.chat_text: And? And? Tell me! What did he say? What did he do?

replies.reply_text: Well, he teared up. And he said that he taught you how to make that dove shape. And then he gave me a big bear hug!

It was amazing! To see that grouchy old man get all soft and sentimental! I'm not sure he'd want anyone to know he cried. Or hugged me. But I knew you would want to know that you touched something deep in that walled up heart of his!
Thank you so much and have an awesome day!

npc_list.name: Jayne
npc_list.admin_description: New Quests at CP21
npc_list.long_description: If there's one word that describes Jayne, it's muscles. Jayne is a big tough guy who is fiercely loyal to a select few, and simply fierce to everyone else.

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, now, what have we here? What brings a drifter such as yourself to this lofty abode?

replies.reply_text: I'm just passing through, I'll be off now.
This is an... interesting place you have. I wouldn't expect a tough guy like you to be living in such a girly house...
Hey Jayne.  Holly on Art Isle sent me to see if you have any old hats that you can spare for her snowman.
Hi Jayne.  I have a delivery for you from the Pony Express!
Hi Jayne, question for you... that bed I asked you to take into Sierra's house?
Hi Jayne, I have a question for you.

chatpoints.chat_text: Do I look like a girl to you? (Jayne appears highly offended.) It just so happens that this here domicile were once home to one of the luckiest sneaks in the 'verse, Hexia Mattersby! It's just the sort of perfection for a Livin' Legend like me!

replies.reply_text: Sorry... I was just wondering. "Jane" is a girl's name, after all...
Did I say girly? I meant... uh... burly! Really, it is an awesome house!
Living Legend? Like... a hero?

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, Jayne ain't a girl! Go on, get! A sassing tongue ain't welcome here.

replies.reply_text: Sorry... Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: (Jayne looks quietly proud.) Well, I know it ain't as fancy as some of them others who got pieces of pretty up to their eyeballs, but places like that have a way of seriously damaging my calm. I get all sorts of uncomfortablenesses, feeling like I don't belong. I just ain't that steely.

replies.reply_text: Yeah... I ain't steely, either. Don't you get lonely living here by yourself, though?
I guess when you put it like that... fancy isn't that great.

chatpoints.chat_text: I ain't the soft type likely to get all lonely! I like my space, like to do what I please whenever the fancy takes me, no one around to tell me I can't. Nah, this is the life!

replies.reply_text: True enough! Well, I'll let you get back to... whatever you were doing. Bye!
Don't you have any friends at all?

chatpoints.chat_text: Don't mistake my meaning, now. Every man likes his share of shiny. Heck, I don't say no to the occasional fortune that happens my way, no sir! You're a fool if you ain't lookin' to get paid, and paid well. I just don't believe in silly frills, is all.

replies.reply_text: Yes, frills are definitely overrated. I have to go now. Bye!
What about that picture on your wall? It looks like you're wearing a knitted hat that looks kinda... well... frilly.

chatpoints.chat_text: That hat ain't frilly! It makes me look cunning! My mom made it, so don't you go saying nothing bad about it, dong ma? Besides, that hat ain't here no more.

replies.reply_text: Right, sorry. I'll just go then. Bye.
Aww, you lost the hat your mom knit for you? What happened to it?

chatpoints.chat_text: I was out doing important hero-type stuff, you know... prospectin' and all, when I happened upon a giant creature that was all manner of ugly! It looked at me something fierce, and I ain't ashamed to admit I turned and lit.

replies.reply_text: I don't blame you! Did the... uh... creature steal your hat, then?

chatpoints.chat_text: Nah, it came off as I was runnin' under a tree. Branch caught it, and I wasn't about to stop. Been afraid to go back ever since. No livin' legend is dumb enough to go up against them odds!

replies.reply_text: Good point! That's too bad you lost it, though. I have to go now. Bye!
Aren't you sad, though, to lose the hat your mom made for you?

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, of course I am! It ain't every day your mom knits you such a cunning hat, is it? You think you coulda done better?

replies.reply_text: No... I suppose not. I'll just be off, then.
Hard to say, since I wasn't there. Seems like you ought to be able to sneak back and get it from the tree, though.

chatpoints.chat_text: I ain't goin' back there! No way, no how! If you're so brave, why don't you just do it?

replies.reply_text: No, I think you're right. It's too risky. I'll just leave you alone now.
Well... If you tell me where it was, I can see what I can do...

chatpoints.chat_text: Truly? Well.... well I suppose I could. But don't you come back here complainin' if you get hurt! Frankly, I think you belong in a bughouse, going out there.

replies.reply_text: I'll be careful. Now, where was this tree?
Well, maybe you're right. Maybe I'll just skip this one.

chatpoints.chat_text: Friends are just another way of gettin' yourself into a world of trouble. They ain't worth the bother. Family's the only thing you can count on to watch your back.

replies.reply_text: That's kinda sad you feel that way. My friends always make me stronger. I'll just go now.
You must have a close family. Do you see them often?

chatpoints.chat_text: Nah, but my mom, she sends me letters and sundries as she can. She knit me a hat once, that was as fancy a hat could hope for. Made me look cunning. I lost it though.

replies.reply_text: What a bummer! Good luck getting it back. Bye now.
Is that the hat in this picture on your wall? Isn't it a little.... um... frilly?

chatpoints.chat_text: You bet! Even got my own mudder town named after me! Robbed from the rich, gave to the poor... I aimed to misbehave and now, I even got my own song!

replies.reply_text: Wow, that's fascinating! You're a real live Robin Hood!
A mudder town? Doesn't sound all that glorious. I think I'll just take off. Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: That's me all right! Now excuse me while I go get me some grub. Livin' Legend needs eggs, ya know!

replies.reply_text: Eggs. Right. Goodbye, then!

chatpoints.chat_text: Just to the east here is a black sort of creepified tree. That was where I was brutally assaulted. You be careful, now, that you don't run into that beast while sussing around those trees!

replies.reply_text: No worries, I'll be back soon!

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, you look to be back in all of one piece! Lucky you didn't run afoul of that crazy beast!

replies.reply_text: I haven't actually started looking yet. I'll go do that now.
Not yet... I forgot where you told me to look.
There wasn't any fearsome creature, just a cute little bunny with a craving for carrots!

chatpoints.chat_text: Among the trees to the east. It's one all black and creepified. There'll be the spot where I was set upon.

replies.reply_text: Black creepy tree to the east. Got it, thanks!

chatpoints.chat_text: That wasn't the way of it before! It was a foul and ugly beast, all manner of fearsome and devilishness! You're just bein' mean, is what. Have you got the hat, or ain't ya?

replies.reply_text: Of course I got the hat! Take a look, it wasn't harmed one bit! It's still just as fril.. er... I mean as cunning as ever.
Thanks! Just glad to be useful. Bye now!

chatpoints.chat_text: Hello! Help yourself to some mighty shiny frozen grapes. There's a bag on the table. Make yourself comfy in my humble heroic home!

replies.reply_text: Uh... I'll pass, thanks. No telling where that bag has been. I was just passing through.
So... You really are a hero?
Hey Jayne.  Holly on Art Isle sent me to see if you have any old hats that you can spare for her snowman.
Hi Jayne.  I have a delivery for you from the Pony Express!
I believe I have something of yours!
Hi Jayne, question for you... that bed I asked you to take into Sierra's house?
Hi Jayne, I have a question for you.
That hat looks great.  Thanks.

chatpoints.chat_text: I got post?  Shiny!  My package for Vera!

replies.reply_text: Here you go.  Wait, who's Vera?  I don't think I've met her before...
Ohhhkay.  I won't ask again.

chatpoints.chat_text: I can't think of a thing you could have that I would be wantin'.  Well, except maybe if I'm gettin' paid.  Am I gettin' paid?

replies.reply_text: No, not paid, but I've got your hat.  This is yours, right?
Nothing, I guess.  Sorry to bother you.
Yep, looks good.  Bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: I took it in already. Where ya been.

replies.reply_text: Oh... I see. Thanks.

chatpoints.chat_text: (Pauses, one end of a sofa in his hands.) Wha? Can't ya see I'm busy? I'll get to ya in a sec- you and your MUDDY BOOTS, ugh, go stand outside, I'll talk to ya there!

replies.reply_text: Wow, okay... (Head outside.)

npc_list.name: Nina
npc_list.admin_description: Raptor lady  new quests at CP14

chatpoints.chat_text: Please.  Come in.  I hope you don't mind birds.

replies.reply_text: Actually, they kind of freak me out.  Umm...  Bye.
Oh, I love birds.  Yours are beautiful!
I don't mind.  They do seem to make a bit of a mess, though.
Actually, I'm here because I'm looking for a golden sheep, and your brother, Galvin, said he sent one to you.
Hi again! I'm here to deliver a new birthday present from your brother, Galvin!

chatpoints.chat_text: Thank you.  I care for them.  They are free to go where they please, but if they need anything, they know where to find me.

replies.reply_text: That's really neat!
Interesting.  Anything I can do to help?

chatpoints.chat_text: Yes.  But it's worth it.  They are wonderful to have around.

replies.reply_text: Glad you think so.  The feathers flying around is starting to get to me, though.  Bye!
It looks like.  Anything I can help you with?

chatpoints.chat_text: They enjoy it that way.  I care for them if they get hurt or are sick.  Speaking of, would you be able to do a favor for me?

replies.reply_text: I sure can.  What did you have in mind?
No thanks.  I'm a little busy right now.  I'll probably come by another time.

chatpoints.chat_text: Actually, there is.  One of the eagles, Leuko, was injured yesterday, and she got scared by something and flew off.  I'm afraid she might hurt herself more.

replies.reply_text: That's terrible!  I hope she's all right.  I'll leave so you can go find her.
I can go find her, if you would like.

chatpoints.chat_text: One of the eagles, Leuko, was injured yesterday, and she got scared by something and flew off.  I'm afraid she might hurt herself more.

replies.reply_text: That's terrible!  I hope she's all right.  I'll leave so you can go find her.
I can go find her, if you would like.
Sounds good.  I'll be back later to fill you in.  Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: Welcome back.  Did you find her?

replies.reply_text: What was I doing for you again?
Not yet.  I'll go look some more.
I did.  She flew away because she has a nest of eggs she needs to care for, but she's injured.

chatpoints.chat_text: I wanted you to find Leuko, an eagle, in that small forest down Tail Isle, and see if she's all right.  She was injured earlier.

replies.reply_text: Oh, right.  Okay, I'll get right on that.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, no.  I was afraid of that.  Could you run to Appleton and see Henry Heimlich at the vet?  He always keeps medicine I need in stock.

replies.reply_text: Sure, I can do that.
I really dislike running errands.  Maybe another time.
Be back in a bit.

chatpoints.chat_text: Welcome back.  How'd the trip go?

replies.reply_text: Oh, I haven't gone yet.  I'll go get on that.  Bye.
What did you need me to do again?
Great.  I got the medicine.  Here you are.

chatpoints.chat_text: I need medicine in order to help Leuko.  I'm all out.  That would be great if you could run to Appleton and talk to Henry Heimlich, the vet there.

replies.reply_text: Oh, that's right.  I'll head out now.
All right.  Thanks.

chatpoints.chat_text: Thank you for your help earlier.  Feel free to visit any time.

replies.reply_text: I will.  Thanks.
Actually, I'm here because I'm looking for a golden sheep, and your brother, Galvin, said he sent one to you.
Hi again! I'm here to deliver a new birthday present from your brother, Galvin!
Hi!  I just came from Leuko.  Her eggs have hatched!

chatpoints.chat_text: Yes, he did. It was a birthday present. Poor Galvin, he tries so hard. See, I'm really more of a bird lover. I'm afraid I have no idea what to do with a sheep.

replies.reply_text: I see. Well, good luck with that.
Yes, I can see that. All your birds are beautiful! But I don't see the sheep here... What happened to it?

chatpoints.chat_text: I think the poor thing could tell I was out of my league. She just never seemed happy at all. She ran away the next morning, and I don't know where she went.

replies.reply_text: Ran away? Shoot. I guess I'd better go tell Candide he's out of luck.
Oh, no! Well, she can't have gotten too far. Did you see which way she went?
Thanks for your help!
It was no trouble. Happy birthday!

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, that's wonderful!  I haven't been able to get out there recently.  How is she?

replies.reply_text: Well, not great.  Her wing is still bothering her, and it appears she isn't able to get enough food yet to feed both herself and the babies.  She sent me here for food.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, that's too bad. I'll have to go check on her soon. See why that wing hasn't healed up yet. Now, eaglet food... Let's see. Hang on! I'll be right back. (Nina runs off to what appears to be a store room, and you hear things being moved around.)

replies.reply_text: Okay.  I'll just stay right here.
All right. (You take the time to glance around at the other birds flying and perched around her place.)
All right.  Thanks!

npc_list.name: Crossbones Pirate
npc_list.admin_description: jumps you to pirate ship

chatpoints.chat_text: Ahoy there!  If ye want to go to Pirate Isle it be important that ye can work.  Ye must have half of yer jobs done from these isles first.  Also, I'll be needing 2 pearls.

replies.reply_text: I do.
Really?  Oh, umm...  I guess I'll go start working on my quests, then.
Hi!  Did Calico Jack leave a couple of scraps of paper with you?
Excuse me, but would you know who might be a Scrimshander among your fellow pirates?

chatpoints.chat_text: Aye, as a matter of fact he did!

replies.reply_text: Could you bear to part with them?  I think they might be a clue to help a friend of mine.

chatpoints.chat_text: I don't mind partin' with them, fer a fee, o' course.  Only five topazes.

replies.reply_text: Five topazes?  I have those here.
Oh, I'll need to go find some MORE topazes.  See you later.
Thanks!

chatpoints.chat_text: Arrr, ya should be asking me Captain when I drops ye off at his ship.  He knows all them seadogs.

replies.reply_text: Thank you, I'll ask him.

npc_list.name: Skull Pirate
npc_list.admin_description: jumps you to pirate ship (Milo)
npc_list.long_description: This pirate doesn't look all that tough. Actually, he looks pretty young to be a pirate!

chatpoints.chat_text: Ahoy there! If ye want to go to Pirate Isle, it be important that ye can work. Ye must have half of yer jobs done from these isles first.  Also, I'll be needing 2 pearls to pay fer yer passage.

replies.reply_text: I do.
Really?  Oh, umm...  I guess I'll go work on my quests, then.
Ahoy there yourself!  I'm looking for a scrimshander. Would you know of one?
Hey, Milo. How's it going?
Hi there, Milo. Staying out of trouble?

chatpoints.chat_text: I keeps to meself. Ya can ask me Captain if ya wants.  He might know.

replies.reply_text: I guess I will ask him.  Ready whenever you are.

chatpoints.chat_text: I be fine and dandy. And... Hey! How'd ye know me name was Milo?

replies.reply_text: Joe Longbeard told me some things about you. And you aren't going to be so fine and dandy if you don't return those stolen goods you pirated from that supply boat ASAP!
I read minds. It was a simple trick learning your name. I'm magical that way!  Oh, hey, lunch is on its way! Bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: ( Milo looks visibly shaken. ) I... I ... ARGH! I sure ain't cut out to be no piratin' pirate! I swear on Davy Jone's Locker, I be takin' them goods back TODAY!

replies.reply_text: I'll be checking with Vee and if she doesn't have the goods by sundown, I'll be back!

chatpoints.chat_text: I've gone straight, I swear to ye! I ain't doin' nuthin' but guardin' this here boat.

replies.reply_text: Sounds good, Milo. Just remember, I'm watching you!

npc_list.name: Fitzgerald
npc_list.short_description: the only resident of Dust Isle

chatpoints.chat_text: Hi, what are you doing out here?

replies.reply_text: Just looking around.  Umm...  Can you send me back to, well, another isle?
What are you doing out here?
Hi!  Uhm... What can you tell me about that island just east of here?
Hello, could you please send me back to Aesop Isle?
Hi!  Sani from Santon asked me to pick up some 3 leaf sumac for Yepa's baskets.
I bring greetings from Augie!
I am here to deliver a package from Pony Express!

chatpoints.chat_text: This is my isle.  It's all mine!

replies.reply_text: Wow, that's, um, great and all... but can you send me somewhere else?
Huh.  All right.  Well, I'm just going to wander around some more...

chatpoints.chat_text: I suppose.  Hope you had a nice time while you were here.

replies.reply_text: I did... Thanks!
Oh, actually, I wanted to look around some more.

chatpoints.chat_text: That's fine.  Just remember, my isle!  Come see me to get back to the Sand Isles.

replies.reply_text: Umm...  All right.

chatpoints.chat_text: That one way out there?  Oh, there's no one there.  Well, so I heard.  But someone once told me some very fine grapes grew there once.  That's all I know.

replies.reply_text: Grapes?  That's all?  Nah, not my kind of place.  Thanks anyway.
Hmmm!  Well, I'd like to see it.  How does one get there?

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, I can send you if you really want to go, I suppose.

replies.reply_text: Well, not right now, thanks.
Could you?  I'd really appreciate it.

chatpoints.chat_text: Certainly, I have them right here.

replies.reply_text: Why can't they grow this by their home?  Why do they get it from you?
Okay, I'll get these right back to Yepa, thanks!

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, that's a nice bit of news for these old ears. I often think about that boy.

replies.reply_text: He says he really misses you and your roasted scallops.
Thanks so much. I know Augie and Shadow will appreciate them. Could you send me back now?
Thanks!  I think I'll explore the isle a little before I head back.
Thanks so much and adios amigo!

npc_list.name: Leuko
npc_list.admin_description: New Quests must start at CP 21
npc_list.long_description: A large, brown and white raptor.

chatpoints.chat_text: Haaaawwwwwaaaak! (The eagle belts out a warning cry.)

replies.reply_text: It's okay, Leuko.  Nina sent me to check on you.
Well, I'll be on my way!

chatpoints.chat_text: Haaawww Hawwwk.. (She makes a strained noise.)

replies.reply_text: Leuko, are you injured?
I'm sorry, I must be going now.

chatpoints.chat_text: Haww! (She makes a sharp, confirming noise.)

replies.reply_text: Oh, that's terrible!  Why did you leave Nina, then?
That's too bad.  I hope you get better soon.  Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: Haawwwkk! Haaww. (Points to a nest in the next tree.)

replies.reply_text: Oh, you have eggs here that you need to protect?  I see.  Well, I'll go tell Nina.  Maybe she'll have some medicine for you.
I have no idea what you're saying.  I'm sorry.  Good luck.  Bye.
Great!  I'll go tell Nina now.

chatpoints.chat_text: Haaawwwwak, haawk.

replies.reply_text: It's all right.  I'll go tell Nina what's wrong.
Nina should be here to help you soon.  It's going to be all right.

chatpoints.chat_text: Haawk. (She holds up the bandaged wing.)

replies.reply_text: Oh, she's been here?  That's great.  It does look like you're doing a bit better.
Oh, your wing is bandaged.  That's wonderful.  Well, now that I know you're doing better, I'll be on my way.

chatpoints.chat_text: Haawwk! Haaawwwwaaak!! (She starts waving the other wing around, pointing at her nest.)

replies.reply_text: Calm down, you're going to hurt yourself again.  Is something wrong with your nest?
Something's wrong?  With your nest?  What is it?

chatpoints.chat_text: Haw, haaawk. Haaawww, haaawwww, hawk. (She looks down the side of the tree from the nest towards the ground.)

replies.reply_text: What?!  An egg dropped from your nest?!
You lost an egg out of your nest?  Did something take it?
You're afraid of heights?!  That's too bad you're a bird, then.

chatpoints.chat_text: Haw! (She quickly shakes her head.) Haawwk. Haaw. (She fluffs her tail.)

replies.reply_text: I guess I don't get the bird speak...  Good luck!  Bye.
Oh, I get it.  It didn't fall out of the nest, a squirrel took your egg.  Do you want me to look for clues as to where it went?

chatpoints.chat_text: Haw! (She swiftly nods and fluffs her tail.)

replies.reply_text: A squirrel grabbed it out of your nest?  Do you want me to look for clues as to where it went?
I'm really sorry that something happened to your egg, but I don't have time to help you now.  Good luck!

chatpoints.chat_text: (Hanging her head.) Haaawwwwkk! Haawaa! (She glances off the nest edge, and fluffs her tail.)

replies.reply_text: Wow, I feel dumb...  Of course you're not afraid of heights.  Umm...  But I still don't know what you need.  Hopefully someone can help you.
Oh, whoops.  Umm...  Sooo a squirrel took your egg?  Do you want me to look for clues as to where it went?
All right.  I'll start looking for clues around this bitty forest and see what I find.

chatpoints.chat_text: Haaw?

replies.reply_text: Oh, oops.  I was looking for your egg, wasn't I?
I haven't found any clues yet.  I'll go look more now.
Oh, I found some little squirrel footprints!  They were leading towards the road to the west!
I found some little squirrel footprints!  They were on the road leading towards those trees up the road!
Look!  A squirrel, Scooter, had your egg.  Here you go.

chatpoints.chat_text: Hawwkk!

replies.reply_text: Oh, keep looking?  All right!  I'll find your egg!
Oh, thanks!  I'm glad you have your egg back.  Bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: Haawkk.

replies.reply_text: Hi Leuko.  Glad to see you're doing well.  Bye!
Hi.  How is everything going?

chatpoints.chat_text: Haaaaw! Haawk! (She waves her wings around and looks over the edge of the nest.)

replies.reply_text: Oh, my.  Not again.  I'm going.  You figure it out yourself this time.
Oh, no!  You lost another egg?

chatpoints.chat_text: Haaw haawwwk! (She shows you acorn shell bits and little, bitty footprints.)

replies.reply_text: Oh, someone took it?  Someone that lives near oak trees?  I'll go see if I can find your egg for you.
You eat acorns?  I never would have guessed.

chatpoints.chat_text: Hawk! Haw! (She shakes her head.)

replies.reply_text: Oh, I see.  Someone stole your egg that eats acorns?  I could go try to find the person for you.
Apparently I'm just not understanding.  Good luck finding your egg!
So there are oak trees near Tail End?  At the west end of Tail Isle?  All right.  I'll start looking for clues near those trees.

chatpoints.chat_text: Haaw?

replies.reply_text: Nope.  I haven't found your egg yet.  I'll keep looking.
Where was I supposed to look again?
I did find your egg.  A wood elf has it, and she won't give it back until I get her another egg.  So I'm getting an Easter Egg from the Easter Bunny.  Then I'll have your egg.
I finally got your egg!  Here you are.

chatpoints.chat_text: Haawk haaw. Haaaaawww hawk. (She points to the acorn shells and footprints, and then off to the west.)

replies.reply_text: Oh, right.  You pointed out there are oak trees by Tail End at the west end of this isle.  I'll go look closely around them for clues.
Thanks!  Now keep a closer eye on your eggs!  Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: Hawk! (Two small, odd-looking heads peek over the edge of the nest.)

replies.reply_text: You're welcome.  Bye!
You're welc...  Oh, wow!  Look at your babies!  How... ummm... cute!

chatpoints.chat_text: Haww! (Leuko fluffs herself up, looking very proud.)

replies.reply_text: Oh, that's wonderful!  Well, good luck.  Bye!
That's great!  Is there anything I can do for you?

chatpoints.chat_text: Haaawk haawak hawk. (She nods her head, motions at her babies, then her still-bandaged wing.)

replies.reply_text: Hmm..  Umm.. Your wing is still bothering you?  Shoot.  I still haven't gotten very good at this whole bird-speak thing.
Your wing still hasn't gotten better?  That's too bad.  So, do you need food for your babies?

chatpoints.chat_text: Haaaaaawww hawk haaawaak! (Her babies start chirping, and she gives you a sad look.)

replies.reply_text: I'm sorry.  I still have no idea what you need.  I guess I'll just go.  Good luck!
Oh!  Your babies are hungry, and you can't get enough food because of your wing!

chatpoints.chat_text: Haaw. (She nods her head in approval.)

replies.reply_text: Well, good luck finding food.  I'm pretty busy now.  Bye!
I can get food for your little eaglets.  What do you want?
Let's see.  East.  Oh!  Nina is to the east.  I'll go see her.  I'll be back soon.

chatpoints.chat_text: Haaw?

replies.reply_text: Hi Leuko.  What was I supposed to do for you again?
Hi Leuko!  I'm back from Nina's.  She had food.
Oh. That's right.  I'll be right back.

chatpoints.chat_text: (Leuko motions towards the east, and motions at her babies and injured wing.) Hawak.

replies.reply_text: Oh, yes.  I need to go see Nina about food for your babies.  I'll be back soon!
Thanks!  Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: Hawk! (The little eaglets are bouncing around all over in the nest.)

replies.reply_text: You're welcome.  Good luck with the little ones!

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, hello!  Welcome to my little island.  You must have met my sister, Temperance.  The mayor of Treeton.

replies.reply_text: Yes, I did.  She is quite nice.  She had me bring these bags of oats for your horses.
Yep.  I think I'm going to look around your neat little island some more before we chat.
It's very cozy. I'm wondering, though, if you have seen any sheep on your island lately? I'm looking for four Golden Sheep who were lost at sea near here...
Good.  Well, I'm going to look around some.

chatpoints.chat_text: Thanks for bringing those oats for me.  How are you liking my little island?

replies.reply_text: It's quite nice, thanks.  Oh, and you're welcome.
I love it.  It's very...  isolated.
It's very cozy. I'm wondering, though, if you have seen any sheep on your island lately? I'm looking for four Golden Sheep who were lost at sea near here...

chatpoints.chat_text: Yes, I do enjoy my privacy.

replies.reply_text: Well, I guess I'll leave you be, then.
There are so many little islands around.  Do you get to go to any others?

chatpoints.chat_text: Actually, there is a spot, if you dig, you'll find a tunnel that will pop you out onto a nearby small island.

replies.reply_text: That sounds way too weird.  I think I'll just head back to the mainland.  Bye.
Really?  Neat!  Where?

chatpoints.chat_text: Dig on the beach on the inside corner.  Basically right in line with the rocks to the island northwest of here.  Oh, I heard there's a treasure of some sort on that island.  I don't know where, though.  So, good luck!

replies.reply_text: Thanks for the information!  I'll go check it out.

chatpoints.chat_text: No, I didn't see any. I did hear something odd the other night during a storm, however. I didn't get out of bed to look around, but the next morning I found tracks on the beach in the northwest corner. It's possible the sheep found the tunnel up there to Palm Isle.

replies.reply_text: Tunnel? Which tunnel is that?

chatpoints.chat_text: Ahh, hello!  And what brings you to this island?

replies.reply_text: Just exploring, thanks.
I'm glad I found you.  Do you have some time to spare?
I'm looking for Karina.  Have you seen her?

chatpoints.chat_text: Time to spare?  Oh, no.  We all have only the time we have.  Right now, it is time to talk to you, I see.  Tell me, what is it you seek?

replies.reply_text: Me? Nothing, I'll just be on my way, then.  Thanks.
Well, this may sound a bit odd, but... I'm doing a quest for Guru Wiseman.  Do you know him?

chatpoints.chat_text: Guru Wiseman, you say... Nooooooo, no, him I do not know.  Guru, really.  Is he very wise?

replies.reply_text: I don't know, honestly.  He's never told me anything particularly wise.
No, actually I think he's a bit of a loony.

chatpoints.chat_text: Ah, well, it's very wise to keep one's wisdom to one's self, they say.  And what it is about Guru Wiseman you wish to speak to me about?

replies.reply_text: (You explain about Guru Wiseman's Encyclopedia of Wisdom.)
Oh, well, let's forget it.  You don't really want to be bored with this stuff.  Bye, and thanks for your time.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, so it may seem to you.  But the wise know things that make them seem a bit odd, you know.  And what it is about Guru Wiseman you wish to speak to me about?

replies.reply_text: (You explain about Guru Wiseman's Encyclopedia of Wisdom.)
Oh, well, let's forget it.  You don't really want to be bored with this stuff.  Bye, and thanks for your time.

chatpoints.chat_text: Wisdom, eh?  Wisdom, oh that's asking a lot.  You might not want to hear what I have learned after all my many years.  No, you might not.  Anyway, I don't know really what I care to add.  Well, except, maybe only one thing.

replies.reply_text: One thing is great!  What is it?
Oh, good one, thanks!
Hunh?  I don't understand.  The whole point of wishing for something is that you might get it!

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, then, you go on, and think about it.  Think of something you really, really want, and then think of how much of your time and money and energy you will have to spend to keep it, every single day.  Think about it.  You will see what I mean.

replies.reply_text: Thank you, sir, I will.  Goodbye!

chatpoints.chat_text: Ah, she is a nice lady.  She was just here somewhere.  I have been on my daily walk, so you may want to ask some of the others.  Maybe they know where she is at.

replies.reply_text: Will do.  Thanks!

npc_list.name: Arbuckle
npc_list.admin_description: New quests must start at CP4
npc_list.long_description: Arbuckle is a fairly young man, skinny as a rail with slightly tousled brown hair.

chatpoints.chat_text: Just a little to the left. No, that's not it... Right, no, up now... Oh! Sorry, I didn't see you there. I was just putting my new vase on the mantel. What do you think?

replies.reply_text: It's nice, but I have to go iron a sandwich. Bye!
It's nice, but it's kind of ...empty.
I've returned with your cattails!
What was I supposed to find again?
I think it would look better with some pumpkins. (Offer them to him.)
Hi there, got your stump! Full of stumpness!
What was I doing for you?
That's very nice...and even.  Karl told me that Archy stopped in recently. Is he still here?
Sorry to bother you again, Arbuckle. Where did you say Archy was going?

chatpoints.chat_text: You know what it needs? It really needs some cattails. What do you think? About 10 should do it.

replies.reply_text: I think you're right. Why don't I go get those for you?
Sorry,  I really don't have time for that sort of thing.
Okay.  Off I go.
Okay.  Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: Thanks for your help with the cattails earlier! They look just perfect.

replies.reply_text: Yes, you should be in Better Huts and Cabins.
Is there anything else you'd like to decorate your place with?
Hi there.  About the peacock feathers.  Five, you said?
Thanks! You know what would look even better? These pumpkins from Jack o'Lantern.
Hi there, got your stump! Full of stumpness!
Hi, what was I doing for you?
That's very nice.  Karl told me that Archy stopped in recently. Is he still here?
Sorry to bother you again, Arbuckle. Where did you say Archy was going?

chatpoints.chat_text: I need 10 cattails to fill this vase on the mantel.

replies.reply_text: Oh, right.  I'll get right on that.
I have them right here. I can't believe I forgot!

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh... Well, yes, all kinds of things, really, but do you know what would be perfect?  Peacock feathers.

replies.reply_text: Peacock feathers go with cattails?
Fine, how many?  I'll get them for you.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, yes.  Why, can't you see the similarity?  They're both long and skinny and have fancy tips!

replies.reply_text: Oh, well, yeah, I guess so.  How many do you want?
Huh.  I don't see it.  I can't be a party to this travesty.  Sorry.
Okay, I'm on it.  I'll be back shortly.
As it happens, I think I've got that many on me.  Here you go.  Five, you said?

chatpoints.chat_text: Five.  Have you got them there?

replies.reply_text: Yes, I do.
Not yet, I just wanted to check and see how many you needed.  I'll be back.
You're welcome!  Enjoy!
Yeesh! Okay, okay, give me a second!
Er... okay. But what the heck am I supposed to do with these jack o'lanterns?
Whoop, free jack o'lanterns!

chatpoints.chat_text: (He ignores you.)

replies.reply_text: Maybe I should just... go...
Signs? (Checks list again.) Yep. signs are on there. Thanks and bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, no bother. Archy said he had to pick up his signs next.

replies.reply_text: Signs? (Look at your list.) Yep, that's on here. Thanks Arbuckle!

npc_list.name: Windy Pick
npc_list.long_description: Helpful and friendly, Windy loves the people who stop into her store.

chatpoints.chat_text: Come and welcome!  Is there something I can help you with?

replies.reply_text: Ummm, no thanks, just looking.
Actually, I have something for you.
Yes, there is.  Viola on Berg Isle sent me to get a bushel of apples for her.
Mrs. Claus sent me for some carrots, she says you have the best.  Do you have some?  I really don't want to have to go digging.
Well, I've got something for you.  Jack O'Lantern sent you his pumpkin seeds.
Hi there. I'm embarassed to ask, but would you have any fruit that's maybe bruised and not as fresh as it should be? It's for Mino.
This is weird. I'm looking for a flagon of mead.

chatpoints.chat_text: Really?

replies.reply_text: Yes.  Scurvy Gums Morgan sent me with a delivery.

chatpoints.chat_text: Shhhh, not too loud.  I don't want it getting around that I deal with pirates!  But it's the only way I can get giant coconuts this far from Pirate Isle.

replies.reply_text: I see... Well, here you are.
Thanks!  Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, yes, I always keep some in the back for her.  One moment and I'll get those for you.

replies.reply_text: Okay, thanks.
Okay, I'll tell her.  Bye.
Thank you so much!

chatpoints.chat_text: Wonderful, I've been waiting for them.  Everyone here loves his pumpkin seeds.  Not too much salt, you know.

replies.reply_text: Really?  Is that his secret?  Where do you want me to put them?
What's in the box?

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, that?  That's a custom-made set of pumpkin carving tools, made to Jack's specifications.  Only the best for our man Jack!

replies.reply_text: That's really kinda neat.  Custom-made pumpkin tools.  Wow!

chatpoints.chat_text: I hope he likes them.  Thank him for the seeds and let him know we're waiting for this year's specialty items!

replies.reply_text: Okay, I'll do that.  See you around!

chatpoints.chat_text: I'm not even going to ask why you would want something like that. But I can tell you that in this cold climate, we're lucky to get any fruit at all. You should try a food store in a warmer climate.

replies.reply_text: Okay. Thanks for the suggestion.

chatpoints.chat_text: (Starts laughing.) Ted, huh?

replies.reply_text: Yeah, how'd you know?
What, he's a regular or something?

chatpoints.chat_text: That man! He always comes in demanding 'mead.' Well, we don't carry it. Never have, never will! But that's all right, because that's only what he SAYS he wants. What he ACTUALLY wants is a big pitcher of hot tea with honey. For his throat, right? So I'll send you back with that. It'll be $500. Trust me, it's what he wants.

replies.reply_text: Well, whatever you say. (Hand her the money.)
Let me hit the bank first.
Thanks!

npc_list.name: Crazy Eddie
npc_list.admin_description: New Quests must start at CP 5
npc_list.long_description: Crazy Eddie has short messy hair that sticks up in funny places.  He doesn't look threatening... just a little odd.

chatpoints.chat_text: Hello!  I'm Crazy Eddie!

replies.reply_text: Ack!  Crazy?!?  RUN AWAY!!
Hey.... Um, anything I can do for you?
Uh... Hi. I'm wondering if you have seen a Golden Sheep lately?
Eddie, my man!  How's it goin'?

Yes, I know that. It is why I'm here. I'm hoping you remember a mysterious rider coming through here wearing a purple vest.  I need to find him and I don't know his name. I'm trying to backtrack where he came from.
Can you tell me again the name the mysterious rider mentioned?

chatpoints.chat_text: Suure!  Can I have something to eat?

replies.reply_text: Okay.... What do you want?
No! Eat a coconut or something.  I'm outta here!

chatpoints.chat_text: I love strawberries!  Can I have one of those?

replies.reply_text: Sure, here you go.
I don't have one... Maybe if I get bored I'll come back and give you one later.
Um... Okay... See ya.
Can you send me back to one of the bigger islands?

chatpoints.chat_text: Sure!  You were so nice enough to give me a strawberry.

replies.reply_text: Yeah, you were rude enough to burp in my face....

chatpoints.chat_text: Back again?

replies.reply_text: Could you send me to one of the bigger islands?
Ooooh, no... I didn't mean to talk to you... Eeek!
Yes, I'm looking for a Golden Sheep. Do you know where one is?
Yes. Rumor has it that you've got some kind of a critter problem?
Hey Eddie, I can't find them anywhere. Are you sure you saw baby octopuses?
I'm back with the babies!
Eddie, my man!  How's it goin'?
Yes, I am. I'm hoping you remember a mysterious rider coming through here wearing a purple vest.  I need to find him and I don't know his name. I'm trying to backtrack where he came from.
Can you tell me again the name the mysterious rider mentioned?

chatpoints.chat_text: There you go!  Come back and visit any time!
Ooo!  The Solomon Island, eh?  Wow, the place is getting popular.
Maybe. I might have. That is to say, I wouldn't be totally lying if I said or didn't say whether or not I might happen to know where a Golden Sheep may or may not be.

replies.reply_text: Does that mean 'yes'?
Wow, my head hurts now. Nevermind.
Do you even understand what you just said?

chatpoints.chat_text: (Eddie looks terribly offended.) Of course I didn't!

replies.reply_text: Oookayy... I think I'll just go.
Look, I really need to find this sheep. Can you just tell me what happened to it?

chatpoints.chat_text: It could. I'd much prefer to talk about strawberries, though.

replies.reply_text: You're hopeless. I'm just gonna go.
Look, I really need to find this sheep. Can you just tell me what happened to it?

chatpoints.chat_text: Can you give me another strawberry first?

replies.reply_text: I don't have another one. I'll have to go find one. Don't move, I'll be right back!
(Sigh.) I suppose. Here you go.
King Phil? Isn't he a little bit crazy?

chatpoints.chat_text: Who are you calling crazy?!? (Crazy Eddie frowns heavily at you.)

replies.reply_text: Er... no one. Nevermind. Thank you for your help.

chatpoints.chat_text: It's goin' up, it's goin' down, it's just plain gone!  Woo-hoo!  What brings you to my island paradise.  Strawberries?  Got some?

replies.reply_text: Oh no... I don't think I have any strawberries, sorry.  Will this do?
Sure, here.  Of course!  Would I come to see you and not bring a strawberry?  What do I look like, a loopy person?
I'm wondering if by any chance anything ... anything at all... has washed up on your island recently.

chatpoints.chat_text: Washed up? Washed up! (Sings:) Ta-ra-ra-BOOM-dee-ay, did you wash your FEET today? I washed mine YES-terday, that's why they SMELL today!"

replies.reply_text: Eddie....
Oh this is futile!  I'll just go rake up the whole beach, don't mind me!

chatpoints.chat_text: Okay, okay.  Do you want to know about flotsam or jetsam?

replies.reply_text: EDDIE!!!
I think I will go check in to a rest home.  Goodbye.
There's a difference?

chatpoints.chat_text: According to Maritime Law there is.  One of them is stuff that sank on its own and one is stuff that was deliberately jetissoned.  You get to guess which.  Anyway, all that stuff washes up on the north side of the isle.

replies.reply_text: Finally!  Thank you and good-night.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, just look on the north-ish shore.

replies.reply_text: Finally!  Thank you and good-night.

chatpoints.chat_text: Maybe I do, and maybe I don't. What's in it for me?

replies.reply_text: I thought I might help you, but if you are going to be rude, I can always leave.

chatpoints.chat_text: I see where you're coming from. Okay. Can you please help me? And can I have a strawberry?

replies.reply_text: I already gave you a strawberry. Maybe you can find one on your own? And sure, I'll help you. What's the problem?

chatpoints.chat_text: Fine. I'll get my own strawberry. But I've got baby octopuses! They're stranded here. There was this big storm. And it rained. And some driftwood got washed ashore. And there were these baby octopuses on it!

replies.reply_text: Well, some people like them. I've heard they make great pets. What do you need me to do?

chatpoints.chat_text: I need you to catch them. Poor little flippy-floppy things. Too small. I've looked and looked and I don't know where they are. If a rat gets on the island, it might eat them! I can release them back into the ocean, but catch them? Ewwww! Yuck! Gag!

replies.reply_text: Okay, okay already! I start looking now.

chatpoints.chat_text: Yes! Yes I am. They are itsy-bitsy teeny-weenie yellow-polka dotted babies! And they cling to things. And I'm so worried.

replies.reply_text: Okay, I'll start looking for something really small!
I can always use these. Thanks!

chatpoints.chat_text: I'll tell you if you give me a strawberry.

replies.reply_text: Seriously? Fine. Here.
I don't have one. I'll have to come back.
Now can you please tell me about the mysterious rider?

chatpoints.chat_text: Yes! Yes, I can! He was tall, dark and handsome. And he wore purple. And he sailed away on a boat.

replies.reply_text: That's not exactly helpful. Did he say anything about where he was traveling from? Where he lived? Did he mention anyone else's name?

chatpoints.chat_text: Gosh you are grumpy! He mentioned Hudson. Good enough? And since I did a favor for you, you have to do one for me.

replies.reply_text: If he mentioned Hudson, that's who I need to visit next. And I am happy to take the starfish off your hands. Thank you so much.

chatpoints.chat_text: Will you give me a strawberry? Oh, I see by your frown that's not likely! Fine! He mentioned Hudson.

replies.reply_text: Right. Hudson. Thanks.

npc_list.name: Atreyu
npc_list.admin_description: Start of Neverending Story Quest .   New CP14
npc_list.long_description: Atreyu is an older man, looks as though he has weathered much in his years.  He has a relaxed kindness about him.

chatpoints.chat_text: Welcome, stranger...

replies.reply_text: Thank you.  You look upset, is anything wrong?
Thanks, just passing by.
Thanks, I'm looking for Archy and Ollie Scooper told me that he was planning on visiting you.  Have you seen him?
Hi Atreyu.  I'm sorry to bother you, but where did you say Archy went?

chatpoints.chat_text: A few days ago, a terrible storm came through here. My beloved steed Artax, was swept away in the giant waves...

replies.reply_text: Oh no!  Thats terrible!  Is there anything I can do to help?
I'm sorry!  Good luck!

chatpoints.chat_text: I've tried searching along the shores of this island with no luck. . .   I'd keep searching, but I need to rest.. .  With the help of my old friend, do you think you could check the nearby islands?

replies.reply_text: Sure, you bet!
I'm sorry,  I do not have time right now.

chatpoints.chat_text: Please do not answer this lightly.  I am asking much of you.  This could take a lot of time.

replies.reply_text: I can handle it.  I will do all that I can to find your horse.
Oh, well,  I guess I can't help right now.
Okay, I'm off to search for Artax!

chatpoints.chat_text: How is the search going!?  Any news on Artax?

replies.reply_text: Could you remind me what I should be doing?
Sorry,  I have not found him yet.
I have brought Artax back!

chatpoints.chat_text: You will find my old friend Falcor on the beach by my cabin.  He is not as young as he once was,  but should still be an invaluable help in finding my poor horse Artax.  He was washed out to sea in the big storm.  Please search the islands nearby for him!

replies.reply_text: Thanks.  Off I go.
Thanks.

chatpoints.chat_text: I am in your debt for your help with my horse earlier.  Thank you.

replies.reply_text: Sure thing.  Could you use help with anything else?
No problem,  bye for now.

chatpoints.chat_text: Well..  now that you mention it..  I have a rather large friend who comes to visit once in a while...

replies.reply_text: Okay..  Go on..
That sounds a bit scary.  Nevermind.  I don't think I want to help.

chatpoints.chat_text: He enjoys a certain type of rock.  He considers it candy!   Yes,  this is a strange creature.   These soft rocks are commonly found on the Neverending Isles.  Could you do this for me?

replies.reply_text: Yes!   I can get right on it.
Not right now,  I'm terribly busy with fate-of-the-planet matters. . .
Sounds good.  I'll be back when I find them.

chatpoints.chat_text: Any luck finding 7 soft rocks off of the Neverending Islands yet?  You should be able to find them by digging where other rocks are. Falcor should be able to provide transportation.  He is on the beach near here.

replies.reply_text: Yes!  I have gathered the soft rocks.
I'm off to search more right now.
Thanks.

chatpoints.chat_text: You are a great adventurer.  Thanks for your help earlier.

replies.reply_text: No problem.
You're welcome. (You look out the window and it seems as if Falcor is coughing or sneezing... or some combination of the two.) Uh... What's Falcor doing? Is he all right?
I'm back with medicine!
What was I doing for you?
It was nothing, but now I need your help.  Have you seen Archy lately?
Hi Atreyu.  I'm sorry to bother you, but where did you say Archy went?

chatpoints.chat_text: No, it seems my old friend has come down with some form of a cold. He usually does not fall ill, so we were hoping it would pass on its own. It has been a week, but he shows no sign of improvement.

replies.reply_text: I hope Falcor feels better soon! See you later.
Is there anything I can do to help him?

chatpoints.chat_text: You are too kind. Will you find a vet that can help Falcor? I could not bear to leave my friend alone while he is ill.

replies.reply_text: Of course I can! I couldn't stand leaving Falcor while he's sick!
And go into all those doctors' offices? No way! I'm scared of doctors. Good luck!
All right, I'll come back when I've got the cure!
Yay, traveling! (You try to hide your sarcasm to the best of your ability.) I'll be back soon.

chatpoints.chat_text: You were looking for a vet that could help Falcor.

replies.reply_text: Oh, that's what you wanted! Be back soon.

chatpoints.chat_text: Excellent! I cannot wait for Falcor to get well! May I have it?

replies.reply_text: Of course! That's why I got it, after all! (Hand the box to him.)
Nope.
It was no trouble at all! Send Falcor my best!
(You check your list.) Okay, he's picking up nails in Hotton. Thanks Atreyu!

chatpoints.chat_text: As I recall, Archy said that he was heading to Hotton next.

replies.reply_text: Hotton, that's right!  Sorry Atreyu, I have to go...bye!

npc_list.name: Elizabeth
npc_list.admin_description: get her 50 pine cones; New Quests must begin at CP 6
npc_list.long_description: Elizabeth looks like a nice, sweet lady.

chatpoints.chat_text: Hello there, you're far from the beaten path.

replies.reply_text: Whew! I sure am.
How do I get off of this island?
Don't I know it! I'm actually looking for a Golden Sheep that may have washed up on this island. Have you seen any lost sheep lately?

chatpoints.chat_text: I don't get out much. Since you're such an experienced traveler.... Could you do something for me?

replies.reply_text: Sure... Why not...
Nope!  I'm sick of running everyone else's errands.

chatpoints.chat_text: I'm trying to make a gigantic sculpture of a squirrel on this small island.  It will be beautiful and everyone will know that this is the best island of them all!

replies.reply_text: Woah... You really don't get out much.
Good luck with that... I'll be heading out the door....

chatpoints.chat_text: Nope, not at all.  I'm making this sculpture entirely out of pinecones so I need you to get a bunch of pinecones for me.

replies.reply_text: Sure, I can do that, they're all over the forests... How many do you need?
You know, I think I hear my horse neighing for me outside.  I better get going.

chatpoints.chat_text: Fifty would be enough for now.  I'd pay you well each time you brought me 50 pinecones.

replies.reply_text: Fifty! Are you serious!? I didn't think pinecones were important, so I haven't collected any yet!
That's way too many, I don't think so.

chatpoints.chat_text: Hello there, how's it going?  Do you have fifty pinecones?

replies.reply_text: Yes, here they are.
Nope, not yet, sorry.
Do you know how I can get off this isle?  I forgot.
Not today. Actually, I'm looking for a Golden Sheep that may have washed up on this island. Have you seen any sheep wandering around lately?
Actually, I was in the neighborhood, so I thought I would stop by and see if you needed anything other than pinecones?
No, not with me, but I do have your glue and six S'mores from Zeke.
I'm sorry, wasn't I supposed to be doing something else for you?

chatpoints.chat_text: Yup!  It's gotta be fifty.

replies.reply_text: Okay grumble, grumble fine.
I sure hope so.
I'm sure it will be.

chatpoints.chat_text: Go over to Crazy Eddie's Island over the bridge.  He'll send you back.

replies.reply_text: Okay, thanks.

chatpoints.chat_text: Actually, strange as it may sound, I have. Crazy Eddie was chasing one all over the meadow the other day. I didn't see what happened to it, I had to get back to my sculpture. You might try asking him, though. Assuming he'd tell you anything that made sense, that is.

replies.reply_text: Uhh... Thanks. I'll give it a try.

chatpoints.chat_text: Now that you mention it, I do need someone to pick up my glue, I'm running low.

replies.reply_text: Where am I supposed to find glue around here?  I think I'd rather collect pinecones, how many do you need?
Like I said, I don't feel like gathering pinecones, where do you get your glue?
Sorry, I'm looking for something more exciting than pinecones or glue.  See you on my next pass through these parts!
Witherton it is!  Would you happen to know a faster way to get there?

chatpoints.chat_text: Go over to Crazy Eddie's Island over the bridge.  He'll send you to Saddle Isle.

replies.reply_text: Okay, I'll be back with your glue soon.
Gee thanks! Oh, by the way, (You wink at Elizabeth.) Zeke sends his regards. Good bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: Why yes your were.  I asked you to run over to Zeke's store and pick up my glue.

replies.reply_text: Zeke's?? Glue?? (Scratching your head.) Oh, I remember now! I'll get right on it, see you soon!

npc_list.name: Falcor
npc_list.admin_description: Falcor On Beach By Atreyu's Cabin; New Quests must begin at CP 4
npc_list.long_description: This large creature is a cross between a dog and a dragon!  What a wondrous sight!  All furry and soft looking, you just want to cuddle him!

chatpoints.chat_text: Heeeellllooooo      Greeeeetinggsss...   Any friend of Atreyyuuuu   is a friend of minnnneee.

replies.reply_text: Thanks!  It is nice to meet you also.
Ummm...  Hi...   Please don't eat me!
Hello,  I must be going now!  Bye.
Helloooooooo! I'm looking for a dragon who knew a boy called Dalton. That isn't you, by chance?
Hello Falcor! Would you mind flying me back to the Isle of Hardly, please?

chatpoints.chat_text: So  weee arrree ooffff toooo loook for Arrrtax?

replies.reply_text: Sure.  Let's go to the nearest island that he may have washed up on.
Soon.  I can't go just yet.

chatpoints.chat_text: Haaahhaaa  haaaaahaaaahaaaa   Yooouu  arrreee  a likable  one!   Of course I wonnn't eat yooouuu.

replies.reply_text: Oh,  good!
I am leaving this place! (Run away)

chatpoints.chat_text: Heeeyyyy there.  Niice too seee you agaiin.

replies.reply_text: Can you take me to the islands again?
You too!  Bye.
Helloooooooo! I'm looking for a dragon who knew a boy called Dalton. That isn't you, by chance?
Hello Falcor! Would you mind flying me back to the Isle of Hardly, please?

chatpoints.chat_text: Oooooooohhh, yoooooou mean my brooooooooooother. Eeeeaaaach Luckdragon picks a person of our ooooooooown to help, and Daaaaaaaaalton was his.

replies.reply_text: Oh, wow. I don't suppose you could take me to see your brother? Dalton may need some help.
