replies.reply_text: I hope to try her tamales one day soon. Thanks so much and I will be sure to pass on your hello.

chatpoints.chat_text: I sell tons of things, but crates aren't one of them. You might try asking Nana. I've seen crates in her place before.

replies.reply_text: Thanks so much!

npc_list.name: Nilan
npc_list.admin_description: NPC Manning Jungle Hut after Invisible Trap Maze

chatpoints.chat_text: Stranger!  How did you find your way here?!

replies.reply_text: Trial and error...  What a pain!!
I deciphered the code you left on the rock.
I followed others making the journey.

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, your perseverance has paid off.   You made it to my lowly hut!   Why did you try so hard?

replies.reply_text: Well, I had wondered if you might need something, all hid away like this.
You are right! What am I doing here? (Shake your head, turn around and leave.)

chatpoints.chat_text: Ah, how very intelligent of you.  Congratulations!   I leave that there for myself, since I always seem to forget the way.

replies.reply_text: Thanks, I was wondering if you could use any help?
Thanks, have a nice day.

chatpoints.chat_text: Teamwork is a very powerful method.  Good idea.  Although I'm not sure I welcome all the company...

replies.reply_text: Is there anything I can do for you?
Okay, well, I've got to go join my friends.

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, come to think of it, I need to replenish my walnut stocks.   I really need 100 walnuts.

replies.reply_text: 100!  I can't carry that many!
I do not have time for this right now.

chatpoints.chat_text: I imagine that would be tough.   I can accept two deliveries of 50, though.  That should be more manageable for you.

replies.reply_text: Okay, that sounds reasonable.  I'll do it!
I do not have time for this right now.
Okay, off I go.

chatpoints.chat_text: How is your search of walnuts for me going?

replies.reply_text: Fine, I'm still working on it. (Turn and leave.)
Where exactly can I find this many walnuts?
I've got the first delivery of 50 right here.
I've got the second delivery of 50 right here.

chatpoints.chat_text: There are many walnut trees throughout the jungle.   Just look around them is what I normally do.

replies.reply_text: Okay, thanks.  Off I go!

chatpoints.chat_text: Thanks much for the wonderful walnut collection earlier.

replies.reply_text: You bet.
Okay, off I go.
Thanks, enjoy them!

npc_list.name: Shawnah
npc_list.admin_description: Girl running the crazy plants in jungle;  New Quests must begin at CP7

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, hello there!   It is very seldom we have guests who brave the dangers to visit!

replies.reply_text: WHAT ARE THOSE THINGS!?
Interesting plants you grow here...
I've been sent here to collect leaves from fireflower plants. I have a feeling I'm in the right place...

chatpoints.chat_text: They are an experiment of my father's... He's away right now, so I am caring for them.  It is a full-time job, and I'm afraid I'm running out of food for them!

replies.reply_text: I could fetch you some!
I suggest you stop feeding them.  They are too dangerous!

chatpoints.chat_text: NO!  They are like my children!   But please, do stay away from them.   As long as people respect them, all is well.

replies.reply_text: Well,  I can't be apart of this.  I must go.
I guess I could help find some food for them.
Okay, off I go.

chatpoints.chat_text: Jungle swamps...  I believe there are some west of Tropicton.

replies.reply_text: Okay.  Thanks.

chatpoints.chat_text: Did you manage to find the food I require for my plants?

replies.reply_text: No, not yet, still working on finding it.  Where did you say it grows?
Not yet, still working on it.
You bet.  I've got it right here.
Thanks.  Bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: Thanks so much for your help with my plants earlier.   Would you like to feed them?

replies.reply_text: Ah, no...  I'm what they refer to as... 'sane'...  Have a nice day!
(Shake head violently.) No.
Actually, I've been sent here to collect leaves from fireflower plants. I have a feeling I'm in the right place...

chatpoints.chat_text: Indeed, you are! There are several in bloom right now. They like to grow near the tall venus fly trap plants. Just be careful as you approach them. They can be a bit playful at times!

replies.reply_text: Playful? Is that what you call it? Don't worry, I'll be careful... Thanks.

chatpoints.chat_text: Come in, Honey. Look around and let me know if I can help you with anything.

replies.reply_text: I don't have time to look around. I might come back later on.
Thanks! I see you have a lot of fruit. Is it all native to the island?
Maybe you can help. Mrs. Claus sent me for celery and said that you had the best.  Do you have any?
Hi there.  Do you happen to have any cilantro?
I'm sorry to bother you, but Venus sent me to get some chocolate.
Hello! I've got a delivery from Jack O'Lantern.
Would you happen to have any spoiled fruit?
As a matter of fact, I think we can help each other. I'm here on behalf of Hansel and Gretel and their new bakery.
I'm sorry, but who did you say I should see?
Do you happen to have chocolate?
I'm back to buy the chocolate!  How much was it?
Thanks.  Say, were you at Rashida's party last night?
Actually, yes, Dolly sent me to pick up her bananas and chocolate.
Could you tell me if you sold a rider bananas in the last couple of days?
Could you tell me where you get your wooden crates from?
What kind of nuts did you say the strange rider was snacking on?

chatpoints.chat_text: I do have local fruit, but I also get some fruit in from the other islands.

replies.reply_text: How is the fruit transported here?

chatpoints.chat_text: Sometimes I go for it. Every now and then, someone who is passing through will bring me some. I am fairly well stocked right now, but check back with me and I may need you to bring me some one day soon.

replies.reply_text: Okay, I can do that. I will just be going now.
I will, thank you!

chatpoints.chat_text: No, sweetie, I'm afraid I'm fresh out.  I usually get it from The Spice Shoppe, but I haven't gotten a shipment in a while now.

replies.reply_text: Oh, well, that's okay. Thanks!  Bye!
I'll let her know, thank you!

chatpoints.chat_text: Come on in!  How's Jack doing?

replies.reply_text: He's all right... I guess.  He sent these pumpkin seeds for you.

chatpoints.chat_text: Come, bring them into my store room, will you?

replies.reply_text: Okay, sure. (You follow Nana Knutkake into her store room.)
What does he use all these walnuts for?  He bakes brownies or something?

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, my dear, no!  He uses the shells to make brown dyes and paints.  He's all natural, you know.

replies.reply_text: Wow!  That's neat!

chatpoints.chat_text: It sure is.  Be sure to tell Jack I'm looking forward to this year's pumpkin crop!

replies.reply_text: Okay, I will.  Bye bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: What do I look like? Some kind of nut? I would never sell fruit that has gone bad!

replies.reply_text: Of course not. Let me explain. Mino needs the fruit to attract fruit flies for some hummingbirds. It's going to be an anniversary surprise for Lelu.

chatpoints.chat_text: Awww! That man is such a romantic! This is your lucky day - hang on a minute and let me get some.

replies.reply_text: Wonderful. I'll wait right here.
Thanks so much.

chatpoints.chat_text: Really?? Now how does Hansel and Gretel's bakery help me?

replies.reply_text: Hansel is looking for vendors who can help him with these supplies. (You show Nana the list.) Do you think you could handle any of these items?

chatpoints.chat_text: No, not the volume that Hansel would need.  I can, however, suggest a couple of people here in the jungles that might be able to handle it.

replies.reply_text: That would do.  Who are they?
Okay, Manco in Rainy Meadows, and Cinnamon down south of here.  Got it.  Thanks!

chatpoints.chat_text: I told you to see Chief Manco in Rainy Meadows, and Cinnamon down at the southern end of this island.

replies.reply_text: Oh, yeah, that's right.  Thanks again!

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, it's not something I always carry.  I do have some baking chocolate in powder form and also a brick here, if that's what you are looking for.

replies.reply_text: The brick is what I would probably need.  How much?
Umm...  I'm not sure.  Let me look around town a little more to see if anyone else has anything.
Wow!  That is pricey!  I think I'm going to do some shopping around first.  Bye.
I don't have the money on me now.  I'll come back later.
I suppose I could get that.  Here's the money.
But Ben at the General Store said he could sell a brick to me for $1,000.

chatpoints.chat_text: Really?  I wonder how he can afford to sell it that cheap...  I really can't, sorry.  I may have to talk to him later and find out where he gets it.  Sorry.

replies.reply_text: Well, I'll just buy it for the $1,500, then.
That's all right.  Hopefully he can help you find a cheaper source.  Bye!
Thanks!  I will.

chatpoints.chat_text: I said I could sell it for $1,500.

replies.reply_text: Oh, yeah.  Maybe I'll be back.  Bye.
But Ben at the General Store said he could sell a brick to me for $1,000.
That sounds good.  Here's the money.

chatpoints.chat_text: I was, but only for a very short time at the beginning of the evening.

replies.reply_text: Oh okay.  Did you happen to see anyone playing chess?
All right.  Thanks.

chatpoints.chat_text: Umm...  No, it hadn't been taken out yet.  So, while I was there no one was.

replies.reply_text: Okay.  Thanks.

chatpoints.chat_text: Sure honey, they're in the back. I'll go get them, be back in a flash!

replies.reply_text: Okay, thanks.
I'll be sure to give Dolly your message, bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: Why yes! I do remember that rider. He had grand plans on making a profit from his trip to Jungle Isle. I'm not sure what the bananas were for, but he bought a good amount.

replies.reply_text: I'm trying to backtrack where he was before he came here. Did he say anything that might give me a clue?

chatpoints.chat_text: Goodness! Bananas are my speciality - hence the Nana's Bananas sign. (Nana is pointing to the sign over a crate full of bananas.) I sell them every day, all day long. You are going to have to be more specific.

replies.reply_text: Well, from what I understand, it was a rider full of tall tales about indigenous people and thieving flowers who planned to rescue a bunch of parrots.

chatpoints.chat_text: Of course! Vern is the dear who makes them. A waste of talent, making something as basic as crates. He's such a gifted builder. But I need crates and he's happy to provide them.

replies.reply_text: Thanks so much!

chatpoints.chat_text: Let's see. He was very excited about exploring Jungle. What else? Something about his lost monkeys. Maybe it was lost marbles? Oh wait! He had a bag of hazelnuts. The way he was eating them, I'd say he was enjoying them immensely!

replies.reply_text: A bag of hazelnuts? That rings a bell. I know what town to go to next. Thank you so much.

chatpoints.chat_text: Hazelnuts, Dear. Thinking about hazelnuts takes me back to when my grandma would make hazelnut cookies. Fond memories! Fond, indeed.

replies.reply_text: I've never tried that kind but I'm sure they were yummy. Thanks so much for the reminder and have a most awesome day!

chatpoints.chat_text: Howdy, partner! Get on in here and get something for that special steed of yours.

replies.reply_text: Hi, ummm, partner. Yeah, I could use something special for my, hmmmm, steed.
I am not your partner. I think I will part ways here. You are a little too friendly.
Hi.  Question for you.  Were you at Rashida's party last night?
Howdy, partner!  I'm trying to track down Archy for his Misses. Has he been here yet?
Howdy!  I'm sorry, where did you say Archy went when you two had concluded your business?

chatpoints.chat_text: You got everything you need for that fine animal for your trip into the jungle?

replies.reply_text: Will I not be able to get food in the wild?
I have some food, but I might need to add to my supply while I am here.

chatpoints.chat_text: Along with the basics, you might want to choose a treat. Your horse will be working hard. It's a real jungle out there. Haha!

replies.reply_text: A real jungle? Haha, yeah, right. I think I will go now.
So, is getting through the jungle really hard?

chatpoints.chat_text: You might find some food in the wild, but I wouldn't count on being able to keep your horse nourished. This is a big island with lots of areas that are difficult to get through. You don't want to be stranded with hungry horses, do you?

replies.reply_text: Well, I'll just take my chances.
Good point. Guess I will shop while I am here.

chatpoints.chat_text: It's not easy, but a smart cookie like you ought to be able to do just fine. Just keep your eyes and ears open for danger.

replies.reply_text: Danger? I think I might go back to a safer island.
I'll do that. Thanks for the advice.

chatpoints.chat_text: I sure was.  Why?

replies.reply_text: (Explain about Rashida's missing chess piece.)

chatpoints.chat_text: Let's see.  I played against Orson Shells.  After he kicked my butt, I went to play a different game.  I didn't notice who played after us though.

replies.reply_text: Okay.  Thanks.
I feel I'm getting closer. Orson Shells you say? (Harry nods.) Thanks a lot Harry, bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: Sure enough!  He was heading over to see Orson Shells at the Gem Shop.

replies.reply_text: Okay, Orson at the gem shop, got it.  Thanks!

chatpoints.chat_text: Hello there. Have you captured a llama yet?

replies.reply_text: No, and I am not really interested. I think I will stick to my horses.
No, I am here in the jungle to look for one, though.
Yep, I have. I need to buy some of that wonderful-looking tack so I can start riding.
Hiya!  Have you heard about Sumiko Stallman's Riding for the Handicapped program?
Hello!  I actually have a question.  Have you seen a woman around by the name of Karina?
I don't suppose you have any time for repairs at the moment?
Do you have Ted's saddle fixed yet?
Actually, I'm not here about llamas.  Were you at Rashida's party last night?

chatpoints.chat_text: Looking for the elusive llama can be quite a challenge. Are you up to it?

replies.reply_text: Sure! I am always ready for a challenge. Do you have any advice for me?
Challenge? Oh, maybe not. I think I'll just ride my horse.

chatpoints.chat_text: Congratulations! You are going to really enjoy the llama experience.

replies.reply_text: Thanks!

chatpoints.chat_text: I don't think you'll find too many right in town. Try to get out into the wilds of the jungle. Maybe even explore the smaller islands that join the main island up north.

replies.reply_text: Okay, I can do that. Thanks!

chatpoints.chat_text: Be sure and come back here to buy your tack!

replies.reply_text: I will.  Thanks!

chatpoints.chat_text: No, I haven't. Is she starting one?

replies.reply_text: Yes.  She's got land and a stable and horses, and she's asked me if I can find her some used, cheap halters with leads, and some children's saddles.

chatpoints.chat_text: No problem. Sumiko has a wonderful reputation on these isles. Hold on a moment.... (Bridgett runs into a back room.)

replies.reply_text: Okay. (You stand behind the counter and ponder the sound of one hand clapping.)
Thank you so much!  Sumiko will be thrilled!  I'll get these back to her!  Bye now!

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh sure!  She stopped by and spent some time looking over the llama tack and asking me about llamas.  It's been a few days since I've seen her though.  Maybe try the inn.  I bet she would be staying there.

replies.reply_text: All right.  Thanks.

chatpoints.chat_text: I suppose I have some time to do some small repairs.  What is it that you're looking for?

replies.reply_text: Oh, nevermind I'll be back a little later.
Well, Ted Capocella lent his racing saddle to Adrianna and one of the straps broke while she was borrowing it.  I was wanting to have it fixed up for him before I returned it.
Thank you.  I'll be back tomorrow.
This is wonderful!  I'm sure he'll be happy.

chatpoints.chat_text: Sure.  Remind me that I missed it.  I had to stay here cleaning and dealing with inventory.

replies.reply_text: Oh okay.  Sorry.  Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: Come on in. I'm kinda busy right now. You know, lots and lots of horses need attention after being in the jungle. Have you been yet?

replies.reply_text: Yeah, it is pretty wild out there. My horse's grooming has really suffered since we have been in there.
Not yet. We just arrived. We are about to go exploring, though.
Actually, I was wondering if you have any horsehair I could have?
Umm, yeah, but I was actually wondering if you have seen someone lately.  Karina?
I had a question to ask you, actually. (Explain about Rashida's missing chess piece.)

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, you be really careful out there. You never know what you might run into out in the jungle.

replies.reply_text: Oh, uh-oh.  Thanks.

chatpoints.chat_text: Your horse will look a whole lot better once I get him all fixed up.

replies.reply_text: Thanks!
That's great!  How do you get all these crazy tangles out?

chatpoints.chat_text: I'm sorry, I'm too busy to try and gather any up.  I keep most of it cleaned up anyway.  Good luck, though!

replies.reply_text: Thanks anyway.  Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: No no.  I'm much too busy to be chatting.  I'm not great with names, either.  Good luck in your search!

replies.reply_text: Thanks.  Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, I have a special solution I use that really helps with tangles.  Come to think of it, I'm just about out...

replies.reply_text: That's too bad.  I hope you are able to get more soon.  Bye!
I could get more for you, if you like.

chatpoints.chat_text: That would be wonderful!  The general store in Carrotton should have the oil I need to make more.  Would you be willing to run there and pick it up for me?

replies.reply_text: Sure.  I can head over there for you.
That's way too far.  Sorry.  Maybe another time.
Thanks!  I'll be back soon.

chatpoints.chat_text: Welcome back!  Did you get that oil yet?

replies.reply_text: I did!  Here you go.
Not yet.  I'll go do that now.
Where was I supposed to go to find that?
Thanks!

chatpoints.chat_text: Head to the general store in Carrotton.  Betsy Burlap normally carries just the type of oil I need.

replies.reply_text: All right.  I'll head there now.  Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: That's too bad.  That chess set is just marvelous.  I didn't see anything though.  I was never near it.  Sorry.

replies.reply_text: Okay.  Thanks.

chatpoints.chat_text: (La, la, la, ta, da, da, dum...) Oh, hello there.

replies.reply_text: Sorry, didn't mean to interrupt. I'll be going now.
Hello, I didn't mean to interrupt your lovely song.
Hi, I just came by to see if you've made any progress on getting away to see the other islands?
Hello!  I'm back bearing gifts!
I gave you everything, right?
What was I supposed to do again?
Hello there! I was wondering if you could help me. I'm trying to find a copper-bottomed stock pot. You wouldn't happen to have one, would you?
Good day, Miss.  I'm looking for a roofer named Olav and I understand he might be staying here.
Hello!  I'm wondering if you have seen Karina in town?
Sorry, Miss Holli, but where did you say Olav was heading?
Hello.  Say, were you at Rashida's party last night?
Excuse me, Alton sent these centerpieces for the party.
Hello! I noticed you've got a fire going. Could I have some of the ashes?
Hello, again!  I was in the area and decided to drop by and see how things are going with your handsome rider.
Sorry to bother you Holli, but where did you ask me to go again?
Hello there! Do you know of anyone who sells empty crates?

chatpoints.chat_text: No worries. I always enjoy company.

replies.reply_text: Oh good, I like to visit, too.
Well, I don't really have time to visit right now. Maybe later.

chatpoints.chat_text: Business here at the Inn has really picked up over the last few days. Has it been like that at your other stops?

replies.reply_text: I haven't really been paying attention. I just do what I need to do and leave.
I have seen a lot of people heading this way. I wondered what all the excitement was about, so I decided to explore Jungle Isle myself.

chatpoints.chat_text: I wondered if you were one of the explorers.

replies.reply_text: Maybe a wanna-be an explorer is more like it. I am a little uncertain as to what to expect.
That's me. I'm always ready for the next big adventure.  Speaking of..  I should get back to that.  Bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: I'm sure you'll be fine. I wish... Well, I wish I could go explore the islands.

replies.reply_text: I'm sure you'll get your chance one day. I better be off now.
You mean you haven't explored this island either?

chatpoints.chat_text:
Oh, I've seen a few things on this island. I'm talking about the other islands. (She gets a dreamy, faraway look in her eye.) I hear of camels, unicorns and other mystical creatures.
Oh my, my day is wasting away. I really should get busy.

replies.reply_text: Okay, I can take a hint. Goodbye!
I have seen some of those things. Maybe I can come back through, and we can talk about the things we have seen.

chatpoints.chat_text: (Holli sighs.) I wish I could have the opportunity to explore the isles.

replies.reply_text: You mean you haven't explored this island either?

chatpoints.chat_text: Please come back by and tell me all the exciting things you discover here and on the other isles.

replies.reply_text: Sounds like the perfect plan to me.

chatpoints.chat_text: I was puttering around the inn and this tall, dark, (Holli sighs dreamily.) and handsome rider came in and asked to see our menu. I gave him one, of course, and we started talking.

replies.reply_text: You met a guy and now you have a boyfriend.  That's great. I'm happy for you, and I'm outta here!
This is getting good!   And? ....And??  Don't keep me hanging.  What happened next???

chatpoints.chat_text: Funny you should ask about that.  The strangest thing happened to me recently.

replies.reply_text: Really?  Tell me more!
Strange?  I'm really not into strange right now, maybe you can fill me in on my next visit.  Bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: He stayed for a few days, and he told me all about his travels and adventures.  He's had such a thrilling life!  When he left, he said he'd be back, but that's what they all say...

replies.reply_text: Did he?  Did he come back?  You must continue this story!!
Yeah, yeah, he dumped you... Life is tough, kiddo.  You'll feel better soon.  Bye-bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, imagine my surprise when he came back the following month! He told me he couldn't stop thinking about me (Holli blushes.) and that he had to find a way to let me experience these islands from my home. Then he said he knew what to do.

replies.reply_text: Okay, so he's taking you around the islands for a honeymoon... Congratulations.  See you when you get back!
So, what did he come up with??

chatpoints.chat_text: He gave me this beautiful framed map of all of the Horse Isles, and that hand-carved Curio Cabinet. (She gestures towards the wall by the fire place.) Then he gave me this poem and said that I should find someone who has been VERY adventurous who could decipher it and bring me back everything it asks for. Then I can display them all in that cabinet. He said that whoever I choose should be 50% more adventurous than our average traveler.

replies.reply_text: A mysterious poem.  That sounds like a real challenge!  I've been very adventurous, can I help?
Sounds like too much work.  I'm sure you'll find some other rider to help you.  Bye!
I'd love to help you, but I think I need to go on more adventures before I meet your requirements.  I'll be back as soon as I have more experience under my belt.  Good bye for now!
That's great!  Now what?
This should be a lot of fun!  I'll be back as soon as I can.  Bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: Oooo.  Let me see what you brought!

replies.reply_text: Here's the egg beyond compare.
Here's a carving of stone the color of night.
Here's something to show from Santa himself!
Here's something etched on a bone from a very piratey pirate.
Here's a painting of sand.
That should be everything.
That's all I have now.  I'll come back when I get more.  Bye!
But wait, I have more!
I have to go get the rest of the things. I'll be back as soon as I can.
That should be everything.
I have more!
I have to go get the rest of the things. I'll be back as soon as I can.
That should be everything.
But wait.... There's more!!
I have to go get the rest of the things. I'll be back as soon as I can.
That should be everything.
And that's not all!
I have to go get the rest of the things. I'll be back as soon as I can.
That should be everything.
There's more!
I have to go get the rest of the things. I'll be back as soon as I can.
That should be everything.
Thanks!  This was so much fun, I almost feel guilty accepting this.  Be sure to keep me posted on how you and your gentleman friend are progressing!

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh!  I gave you that poem. You are supposed to decipher it and bring back everything it asks for.

replies.reply_text: That's right.  I'll get right to it.  Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, don't I wish! My mother used to have one of those. They are hard to come by. There was a guy looking for one a while back.  I thought I heard that he found one somewhere. Check with him. He was from one of the desert islands.

replies.reply_text: I'll make sure to do that. Thanks.

chatpoints.chat_text: You're looking for Olav?  He was here.  He repaired several of the roofs both in town and in Rainy Meadows, but he left when all that was finished.  Said he liked the heat but not the humidity here.

replies.reply_text: Drats, missed him again!  I don't suppose you know where he went next, do you?
Okay, Hotton makes sense... Hot and dry.  I'll go look there.  Thanks for the help.  Bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: Like I said, last I heard from Olav, he was in Hotton.  Look there.

replies.reply_text: Hotton... Now I remember!  Thanks.

chatpoints.chat_text: Karina?  Hmm.. Karina.. Karina.  Oh!  She was that shop owner from Hotton?  She did stay here for a few days.  After learning what she could in town here, she wanted to head into the jungle.  I told her to talk to Witherton Jones.

replies.reply_text: Thanks!  I'll go talk to him.  Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: Sadly, no.  I couldn't leave the inn.

replies.reply_text: All right.  Thanks!

chatpoints.chat_text: Fabulous!  I was beginning to get worried.

replies.reply_text: Where should I put them?
Will do, bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: I'm sorry! I've got a friend who uses it for her garden.

replies.reply_text: Okay, thanks anyway.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh it's you again!!  You have no idea how much I've been hoping you'd come by.

replies.reply_text: Really?  What happened?  Is there something wrong?
I'm not sure I like the sound of that.

chatpoints.chat_text: No, no.  Nothing bad, in fact it's good.  No, not good, it's wonderful!  No, not wonderful, it's...it's the most incredible news!

replies.reply_text: Well, in that case, do tell!!
So...what's the scoop?

chatpoints.chat_text: Malachy, that's my beloved's name, has asked me to marry him!  You were so instrumental in bringing us together I want you to help me with my wedding.

replies.reply_text: I'm honored that you would ask me to help, but I'm afraid that I have too much on my plate right now.  Congratulations anyway!
Of course I'll help!  Tell me what you need, I am at your service.
I'm on my way!

chatpoints.chat_text: That's okay, I asked you to see my wedding planner, Martina on Whorl Isle.

replies.reply_text: (You make a face.)Your wedding planner, how could I forget! I'll get right on it.

chatpoints.chat_text: You could try Vern. He's a woodworker.

replies.reply_text: Thanks so much!

chatpoints.chat_text: Helllloooo! Come on in and make a deposit. You don't want to be carrying all that money into the jungle, now do ya?

replies.reply_text: Is it any safer here?
Oh, you are probably right about that.
Hello, this is sort of an odd request, but Xamba suggested you might have a French horn?  Or know someone who does?
Probably not, but that's not why I'm here.  Were you at Rashida's party last night?

chatpoints.chat_text: Of course your money is safe here. You can also earn interest, and make a little money while you are off exploring.

replies.reply_text: Oh, that sounds like a good idea. Thanks.

chatpoints.chat_text: A French horn?

replies.reply_text: Yeah, I'm looking for a French horn for Silver Mary.  Xamba said you might know something....?

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh!  Yes, I was in band, once, but I played trombone.

replies.reply_text: Oh.  Well, sorry then.
Wington?  Good heavens, that's far away.  Thanks anyway.  Bye.
Okay, I'll try him!  Thanks for your help!

chatpoints.chat_text: I was.  Was there a problem?

replies.reply_text: (Explain about Rashida's missing chess piece.)

chatpoints.chat_text: I didn't play chess, but I did see Orson Shells playing chess.  He wasn't the one that put it away though.  Maybe talk to him.  He might know who played after him.

replies.reply_text: Great!  Thanks.

npc_list.name: Bob Barnett
npc_list.admin_description: Owner Tropicton Livery
npc_list.long_description: Bob Barnett is a young man who looks as if he's lost his way and is still trying to figure out what he's doing in this store.  You notice he still has a price-tag on his jeans.

chatpoints.chat_text: Hullo.  Can I do something for you?

replies.reply_text: Hiya!  Have you heard about Sumiko Stallman's Riding for the Handicapped program?
No, just looking, thanks.
Why, yes, you can! I'm trying to find some well-rotted manure for Mino.
Delivery from the Pony Express!
Good day, Sir! Would you happen to have any empty feed sacks?
Hi!  I was wondering if you have seen a shop owner named Karina around here lately?
Yes.  I was wondering if you were at Rashida's party last night.
Yes, Martina sent me with an order for a carriage for Holli's wedding.
Do you have everything ready for me?

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, I am so sorry.  I would love to help, but, as you see, we are new and have nothing to spare at the moment.

replies.reply_text: That's all right.  Thanks!

chatpoints.chat_text: This is not your lucky day. I can't help you with that. So sorry.

replies.reply_text: Darn. Oh, well, have a nice day.
That's okay.  I understand that money is hard to come by nowadays.  Take care!

chatpoints.chat_text: Karina?  Name doesn't ring a bell.  Sorry.

replies.reply_text: All right.  Thanks anyway.

chatpoints.chat_text: Rashida's?  No way!  I mean, she's nice and all; I'm just not into those games.  Plus, I had to watch the horses.

replies.reply_text: Thanks.

chatpoints.chat_text: Right,  Holli came by a while ago asking a lot of questions about carriages and teams and fancy tack and the like.

replies.reply_text: Well, Martina sent me with this order form to finalize everything, I guess...here...
Sure, take your time. (You wander over to pet the pony while you wait.)
I'll just visit with your horses while you do that.
Wow, these sure are some fancy saddles and carriages!  Holli and Martina will have a hard time choosing from these. Thanks!

chatpoints.chat_text: Velcome to my lit-tle store.

replies.reply_text: Hmm, where did you get your accent?
Thanks. Your voice sounds like someone I heard in a movie.
Hi.  Have you seen someone named Karina around?
Hi. I have a question for you. (Explain about Rashida's missing chess piece.)
Thank you.  Say, who did you say played the chess game after you?
Thank you. I wonder if Archy might still be here with you?  Mehitabel is getting worried...
Sorry to bother you again, Orson, but where did you say Archy was going after he left here?

chatpoints.chat_text: Vell, a very long time a-go, my vamily lived on an island very var avay from here. Ve have not lost the ac-cent of our old vorld.

replies.reply_text: Vow! Um, I mean, wow! What brought you here?
That's neat!  I really need to being going, though.  Bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: Yes, I have been told there are others who speak as I do.

replies.reply_text: Neat.  Well, I'll take a look around the store.

chatpoints.chat_text: Ve came to explore the vorld of the horse just as you have. Ve fell very much in love vith the vorld ve found here. Ve decided ve vould settle here.

replies.reply_text: So, how did you get into selling and buying rocks?
Interesting.  Well, I really should get back to my exploring.  Bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: Ve have alvays vorked around things that are old. Vhat is older than rocks, no?

replies.reply_text: No. I mean, yes. I mean... I'm not sure what I mean. I think I will get back to exploring. Goodbye!

chatpoints.chat_text: No.  Sorry.

replies.reply_text: Thanks anyway.  Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: I vas playing chess last night, but all pieces vere accounted for then.

replies.reply_text: All right.  Thanks.
Do you remember someone else playing it after you?  Or maybe someone that helped put it away?

chatpoints.chat_text: Vern.  Vern played chess after me.

replies.reply_text: Great!  I'll ask him about it.  Thanks.
Veb....I mean Web Isle you say?  I better get a move on if I'm ever going to catch up with him!

chatpoints.chat_text: No bother, I actually velcome wisitors.  Archy vas going to go on to Veb Isle ven he left here.

replies.reply_text: Veb...I mean Web it is.  Thanks Orson!

chatpoints.chat_text: Get yourself on in here. That there horse is in need of some shoes. Not good to let one run around like that.

replies.reply_text: Yeah, I guess I do need to do that. Thanks for the reminder.
I don't think I need them right now. I'll keep you in mind when I do.
Oh, but I am just here to drop off these design plans for Rocco Shale.
Oh, umm, I gave you those plans for Rocco's sign.  Did you need anything to start work on that sign?
Oh, right.  But I'm here for Ginger at the feed crafting store.  She needs more scoops made, but with a more durable handle.
Oh, sorry. I had a question for you. (Explain about Rashida's missing chess piece.)
That's okay, I don't need shoes right now.  I do need some help though.  Do you work with brass?
You can take care of my horses next time I'm around here, but for now I need some brass work done.  Can you do it?
I agree, but I'll get that taken care of next time. Right now, I'd like to have you create some gold foil for me. Kelda thought that was something you could make.
Actually, I need help with something other than horse shoes. I see you work with fire. Would you happen to have any charcoal you could spare? I need to deodorize the stench from the swamp.
Well, I've done what I said I would do.  I will just be on my way now.
Do you have everything you need to get started?

chatpoints.chat_text: Nope, I don't. I will need a couple of things to get 'er done.

replies.reply_text: Good thing you live in town, you can go buy what you need, then.
What things do you need? I can get some things for you.

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, that would be mighty accomodating of you. I am going to need some agate rock and iron ore to get this done. Fifty of each should be just about right.

replies.reply_text: What??!! That's nuts. There's no way I will be able to get all that. Sounds like you better hire a helper.
Well, I guess I can do that. It might take a while, though.

chatpoints.chat_text: There ya are. Did you get the items I need?

replies.reply_text: Nope.  What is it I am looking for again?
Yes.  Here they are!

chatpoints.chat_text: I need 50 agate rocks and 50 iron ore for Rocco Shale's sign.

replies.reply_text: Okay.
Something else? No, I think I better quit while I am still ahead.
Something else? Oh, I guess.  What now?

chatpoints.chat_text: I need a wood frame and post for the sign. Xamba does the best work. Why don'tcha take these plans to him and see if he can do it?

replies.reply_text: Forget it. I am done with traveling around this place.
Okay, fine.  I can do that.
Okay, bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: Did you get the frame and post done?

replies.reply_text: Not yet. Where was I heading to again?
Yep.  I have them right here.

chatpoints.chat_text: Take them to Xamba and he will make them.  He lives on the western part of Jungle Isle.

replies.reply_text: Okay, I will head over there now.
I will get this back to him right away.
Okay.  See you later with the items.
Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: Is that so?  Well, I guess I could make her a few more.  I'm guessing she'll want the same galvanized iron scoops, then?

replies.reply_text: Whatever you said.  Look, forget it.  This is boring me already.  I'll come back later.
Yes, but with stronger handles.   Wait, what does galvanized mean?

chatpoints.chat_text: Galvanizing is a metallurgical process that is used to coat steel or iron with zinc to prevent the item from rusting.  It's a special way to treat the metal and to protect it.  So I'll be needing some iron to replenish my stock.  I think I have plenty of zinc.

replies.reply_text: I can get that for you!  What do you need, exactly?
Boring!  I'll come back with there's something more interesting I can do.
I'll be back in a jiffy!

chatpoints.chat_text: Did you get that iron yet?

replies.reply_text: No, what was it you needed again?
Yup, I got it right here!

chatpoints.chat_text: Ten chunks of iron ore and $1000 to cover the labor.

replies.reply_text: Okay, thanks for reminding me.  I'll be right back!
I'm sure she will!

chatpoints.chat_text: That's too bad for her.  Hopefully you find it.  I wasn't at the party, though.  I had a backlog of work to finish up on.

replies.reply_text: Okay.  Thanks.

chatpoints.chat_text: That's not the kind of metal work I do.  See if Inigo Webster can help you.  If he can't I don't know of anyone else, sorry.

replies.reply_text: That's okay, thanks anyway!

chatpoints.chat_text: Not normally. It is a time consuming labor of love. I don't have the equipment to make it the new fangled way, but I can do it the old fashioned way. By beating gold ore over and over again with my hammer. Seeing as I'm not busy, I'll make you some for three pieces of gold ore. Deal?

replies.reply_text: Deal! I have that on me now.
Sounds good to me! I'll be back when I have the ores.
Thanks so much and have a super day!

chatpoints.chat_text: Is that where that malodorous stench is coming from? I'd be happy to help out.

replies.reply_text: Thank you so much! Have a most wonderful day.

npc_list.name: Caren Hart
npc_list.admin_description: Change CP#0 to ? when ready to go
npc_list.short_description: Owner of the Tropicton Vet Clinic
npc_list.long_description: Caren Hart is friendly and courteous, although slightly reserved.

chatpoints.chat_text: Hello there.  How can I help you today?

replies.reply_text: Just came in to see what was here, really.  Thanks.  Bye.

(Looking around the pristine reception room, you notice an interesting blanket hanging on the wall; a hand-woven rug or shawl with four horses on it: one black, one white, one palomino, and one... blue?) That's a very interesting weaving.
Nizhoni is... very peculiar.
I hope so.   I was wondering if you knew of anybody hereabouts that might have a white kitten looking for a good home?
Hi there!  Pigeon delivery!
I have a question for you. (Explain about Rashida's missing chess piece.)
Atreyu's friend, Falcor, has been sick for the past week and isn't showing any signs of getting better. Can you help him?
Hello. Dr. Heimlich in Appleton said you might be able to help me.
Hi there. The Hotton vet said you might be able to help me. I'm here for a friend whose horse is a non-sweater. Do you happen to have any medication that could help?
Have you heard of anyone who is a dentist? I have a need for one and can't seem to find one.
I sure hope so. There's this guy named Sundance. He wants me to pick up some package for his horse.
Please send me back to see Nizhoni.

chatpoints.chat_text: Do you like that?  It was made for me by Nizhoni the Weaver. All hand-woven.  She does wonderful work.

replies.reply_text: I don't believe I've heard of her.
How nice.  Well, see ya.

chatpoints.chat_text: She's a somewhat reclusive resident of these isles. Odd sort. I visited her on her island once to tend her horse, Sahkyo. (Dr. Hart gazes off into the distance, as if considering something.) Yes, very odd. But there are all kinds of eccentric characters on these isles.

replies.reply_text: I didn't know any of the vets here went on farm calls.
Well gosh. I've had enough "odd" lately. I think I'll just go look for a wild horse or two.

chatpoints.chat_text: We don't, normally.  But Nizhoni is a special case.

replies.reply_text: Oh.  Well, then.  Bye.
How? Pardon me for being nosy, but I'm intrigued.

chatpoints.chat_text: Let's see.  Well, most of us here on these islands have several horses, all of different breeds.  And they specialize in different things; running, jumping, pulling, and all that.  But Nizhoni has only Sahkyo.  And Sahkyo is... well rather astonishing.  He can do it all.

replies.reply_text: That's not so odd, many breeds are good all-rounders.
Speaking of running and jumping, I need to buy some new tack. Later!

chatpoints.chat_text: True.  But the ones who are good all-rounders are rarely very good at any one thing.  It's like that old saying, "Jack of all trades, master of none."  But Sahkyo... Never seen anything like him.  And then there's the marks on him.

replies.reply_text: Go on, please!
Jesh! I wish you had gotten to the point already. I've got to run. Bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: He has four of them.  A hand print, a paw print, a lightning bolt, and a set of three parallel lines.  I thought they were paint, but they don't come off.  Nizhoni says that these marks were put there by the Spirit Horses, as marks of special ability.

replies.reply_text: Wow. Spirit horses? What else can you tell me.
I put marks on my horse every Halloween! Big deal! I'm so outta here!

chatpoints.chat_text: She said there is a legend about them, but I was busy and didn't have time to listen to her; I had to get back here.  Oh, well, maybe one day I'll go back.

replies.reply_text: Interesting.  Well, I must be going.  Thanks for the story!
Does... Nizhoni enjoy having visitors?  I'd love to visit her and hear about that legen.

chatpoints.chat_text: I couldn't say, actually.  She did give me a way to pop over there when she needed me.  I suppose you could try it and if she's not in the mood for company, she'll just send you straight back.

replies.reply_text: That would be awesome.  I'd love to see this amazing horse, if nothing else.

chatpoints.chat_text: Sure!

replies.reply_text: Thanks!

chatpoints.chat_text: Yes, she is rather.  But interesting, don't you think?

replies.reply_text: Yup, I suppose so... Would you be able to send me back there again later on?  She sent me for some... stuff.
I do. I'm ready to go back and see her, please.

chatpoints.chat_text: Sure, I can do that.

replies.reply_text: Okay, I'll be back, then.  Bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: I know of a couple of cats who have had litters recently, but not a white kitten among them, sorry.

replies.reply_text: That's okay, I'll keep looking.  Bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: Hooray!  I've been waiting for this.  Let me have it, I've got a nice spot all set for it.

replies.reply_text: Here you are.
I'll let him know that all's well.  Bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: Hmm... I did have time off, so I was at the party.  I didn't see anything, though.  I didn't play chess, either.  I'm terrible at that game.  Cards is more my thing.  Sorry.

replies.reply_text: Thanks.

chatpoints.chat_text: If by "friend" you mean "person", I'm afraid I can't help you. I only treat animals.

replies.reply_text: Well, people are animals, too! I'll be back later; I need to think.
No, by "friend" I mean "luckdragon". Can you help him?

chatpoints.chat_text: Luckdragon? Can't say I've heard of that. What is it?

replies.reply_text: A luckdragon is part dragon and part dog. They speak very slowly, too.
You know, I really haven't a clue what one is, either. I'll go look that up. Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: They talk? Interesting... I'll go see if I can find something that'll help him. Wait right here. (She goes into the back room and you hear slight rustling and tinkling noises of bottles as she moves them around.)

replies.reply_text: (You stand patiently, glad all the searching is finally over.)
Phew, finally! (You flop down onto one of the armchairs in the office's waiting room to rest while you wait.)
Awesome! I'll get this to him as soon as I can. Thank you very much!

chatpoints.chat_text: With what, may I ask?

replies.reply_text: Well, Atreyu's friend, Falcor, has been sick for the past week and isn't showing any signs of getting better. Can you help him?
Um... I forgot. Sorry. I'll come back when I remember.

chatpoints.chat_text: Ah, Audrey sent you then? I did develop a medication for anhidrosis, as it happens. It can be a real problem here because of the humidity, and of course the horses are miserable. You said you're here for a friend? Just leave his name here, I'll bill him for it if you end up getting some for him.

replies.reply_text: I'm sure he'd love to try it. He's tried managing it in other ways but it just hasn't worked for his horse.
Thanks so much! I'll tell him!

chatpoints.chat_text: I have heard about a dentist! I believe she's running her practice out of her home. Try one of the smaller islands to the east of here.

replies.reply_text: Thanks tons!

chatpoints.chat_text: Here it is!

replies.reply_text: Thanks so much.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh... Hello.  Come in!

replies.reply_text: No need to get up!  Just here to see what's going on.  Are these your...
That's all right, I'm just passing by.  Good day.
Hello, Grandpa Whystan!  I'm back!
Hello, just stopping by to say hi!

chatpoints.chat_text: Grandkids.  You bet.  They wear me out, though.  They're a handful.  Hard to keep them entertained.  Got a lot more energy than I do.

replies.reply_text: Young kids are a handful, that's for sure!

chatpoints.chat_text: I'm at my wit's end.  I love them, don't get me wrong.  And they're nice kids.  But I wish I could find them something to do that would really capture their imaginations and keep it on one thing for more than half an hour.

replies.reply_text: Hmmm...  I don't know.  I couldn't even stay still for half an hour when I was their age!  Can't help you there, I'm afraid.
I remember something that used to keep me entertained for hours when I was their age!

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, well.  I'll just get back to keeping an eye on them, then.  Nice of you to drop in.

replies.reply_text: Bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: Really?  What was that?

replies.reply_text: I had a set of interlocking building blocks.  Not many colors, and not many shapes.  But you didn't need them.  They were just props for my own imagination.  I built all kinds of things with them, and told myself stories about them as I went along.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, now that might be interesting!  I had that kind of thing when I was young, too!  You don't know where you can get a set, do you?

replies.reply_text: You can't anymore, unfortunately.
I have no clue.  At least I gave you the idea.  I'll let you figure out the details.  Good day!

chatpoints.chat_text: Aw, that's too... No, now wait a minute.  It might just be possible to have a set made up!  Somebody who's good with plans can design them.  Somebody who's good with wood can make the blocks.  Somebody who's good with metal can make the little doors and fences, that would be fun... and somebody who's good with glass, why, they can make clear blocks, and windows, too!

replies.reply_text: You think so?  I'd love to have a set like that for myself, if I could find all the people to do it!
Uh, no.  I'm going out of the scavenger hunting business.  But if I hear of someone who still has a set, I'll let you know.  Bye now!

chatpoints.chat_text:
Well, I know someone who's good at plans--Vern, down the road! He's an architect and he probably had that toy, too! He may know who else you need to talk to, to get the parts made.
Tell you what, if you could get me a set of those blocks, I'll pay you well for them! And I'll give you money to start out with, for travel, you know, and so on.

replies.reply_text: I've passed Vern's house.  I'll go talk to him.  Sure, I'll try and have that set made for you!  Please, though, tell me exactly what you expect.
That sounds like way too much work.  Sorry.  Good luck finding someone who will do that for you!  Bye!
Thanks a lot!  I'll do my best!

chatpoints.chat_text: Did you have the set made?

replies.reply_text: Yes, I did!  Let me show you what I brought.
No, not yet, but I'm working on it.
Well... I got the plans...
I have the wooden blocks.

chatpoints.chat_text: Great!  I can't wait to see it all!  Now, you got the wooden blocks, right?

replies.reply_text: Oh, no.  I forgot all about them!
Right here!
I already gave them you.  Sorry I had to duck out so quickly.  But here are the metal parts.
I already gave you those and the metal parts.  Sorry I had to duck out so quickly.  But here are the glass bits.
Those were made by Cecil Shuteye, from plans by Vern.  Now, here are the metal bits.
Ooops!  I forgot all about the roofing!  Yay, Earl Bronze!  And last, here are the glass bits.  Nicolette in Chillton made these.
Wow!  Thanks so much!  I hope the grandkids enjoy them!  Goodbye!

chatpoints.chat_text: Did yu already give me the metal parts?  I'm old, I forget a lot.

replies.reply_text: Yes, I did.  All that's left is the glass parts.
No, I've got those here.

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, it's kind of pointless asking kids this age to play with plans, don't you think?

replies.reply_text: Yeah.  Sorry.  I'll get the wooden parts made.
I thought you might have wanted to see them before you committed to this design.

chatpoints.chat_text: Aww, well, could you hang on to them until you have everything?  I wanted to surprise the kids with the whole set.

replies.reply_text: Okay.

chatpoints.chat_text: Aw, no.  Vern's good, he knows what he's doing.  I trust him.

replies.reply_text: Okay.  I'll get those blocks made, then.  See you!

chatpoints.chat_text: Hello! I am so glad to see you!

replies.reply_text: You don't even know me. This is weird. I'm going now.
Oh, nice, I think. I guess I am glad to see you, too.

chatpoints.chat_text: I am in the middle of a huge, gigantic, enormous project, and I need help!

replies.reply_text: Are you always so excited about everything?
I am not in the mood to help. I think I will just go ride my horse.

chatpoints.chat_text: YES! YES! YES! Especially about this!!!

replies.reply_text: Um, okay, you are kind of strange. Ay.
WOW! It must really be amazing! Tell me!

chatpoints.chat_text: OOOHHH! It is! It is! I have been on a trek to sketch all of the wonders of the Horse Isles.

replies.reply_text: Wonders of the Horse Isles? I am not sure there are any wonders.
That sounds like a lot of work. I am traveling around the islands, do you need some help?

chatpoints.chat_text: Yes! Help would be wonderful!!!

replies.reply_text: Nevermind, I changed my mind.
I really like to help, so I will do it.

chatpoints.chat_text: I hope you like to solve puzzles, too. I can only give you a clue for the journey. When you find each wonder, you will be given a clue as to who has the sketch for you. When you find that person, you will be given the sketch and the next clue for the next wonder.

replies.reply_text: Hmm, I think that is too much trouble.
So, this is not a one-stop job?

chatpoints.chat_text: Of course not! There are 8 wonders remaining!

replies.reply_text: Eight!?! You have to be kidding! No way!
I am ready to take on the challenge!
Off I go!

chatpoints.chat_text: Hello again! Do you have all 8 sketches?

replies.reply_text: 8? I was supposed to get 8? I don't have that many. I'll be back.
Yes, here they are!
Can you give me the first clue again? I can't remember what it was.

chatpoints.chat_text: Mammal-shaped island. Parts numbered as 3. Two are same in shape and size. In the center of town a botanical specimen associated with sadness grows. Find a clue as to who holds the sketch of this most magnificent species.

npc_list.name: Samora
npc_list.admin_description: Science Quizer   New Quests must begin at CP14

chatpoints.chat_text: Hello!  Welcome.   I am very smart with science.  Would you be interested in a challenge of 10 science questions for $1000??  If you get any wrong, I keep your money.  If you get them all right, I'll give you 10 times more!

replies.reply_text: No, I do not know much about science, I'll pass.
Sure! Lets do it! (Hand her $1000.)
Okay, great.  I'm ready.
I changed my mind.  You can keep my $1000, but I'm out of here.

chatpoints.chat_text: First Question: Of the following 4 planets, which is the largest?

replies.reply_text: Mercury
Earth
Neptune
Mars

chatpoints.chat_text: INCORRECT!  That was not the correct answer.  I'm sorry, but I have won this challenge.  Try again sometime, if you would like!

replies.reply_text: Drats...  Okay.  Bye.
You are smart!  I'm off to study up.

chatpoints.chat_text: CORRECT! Second Question: Which element combines with oxygen to form water?

replies.reply_text: Helium
Hydrogen
Carbon
Uranium

chatpoints.chat_text: CORRECT! Third Question: How many meters are in a kilometer?
CORRECT!  Fourth Question:  Which of these is a coniferous tree?

replies.reply_text: Maple
Mahogany
Palm
Spruce

chatpoints.chat_text: CORRECT! Fifth Question: Limnology is the scientific study of what?

replies.reply_text: People

Darn. I thought I had more, but it looks like I was mistaken. I'll be back!
Those are the weirdest things ever! I'm really glad I didn't get cactus spines in me!
But wait, I've got more!
That stuff is sure messy! I peeked in the bag and dust got in my eyes!
But wait, I've got more!
They were the only lemons I could find. Sorry I couldn't find better ones.
But wait, I've got more!
They are fresh, aren't they? Glad you like them.
But wait, I've got more!
I think that color tissue paper will be awesome!
But wait, I've got more!
I had a tough time not eating them!
But wait, I've got more!
Purple tissue paper. Imagine that!
But wait, I've got more!
Yellow is a happy color!
But wait, I've got more!

chatpoints.chat_text: I don't mind at all. What is your question?

replies.reply_text: I haven't seen lemons for sale anywhere on the isles. Would lemonade work?
You list wood ash. What is it and where can I find it?
I don't even know how to pronounce the cluster thinga-ma-giggies. And I sure don't know where to begin to look for them!
I guess that's all for now. If I think of more questions, I'll be sure to come back.
About the wood ash, I don't know how much to get for you.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, dear. No it won't. The lemon juice has not only been diluted, but it has been contaminated with sugar. Maybe you could ask some of the stores if they can order you some.

replies.reply_text: Okay. Thanks for the suggestion!
I've got another question, if you don't mind?
Why do you need lemons, anyway?

chatpoints.chat_text: Wood ash is simply that - the ashes, or powder, left after wood has been burned. You might try the inns. I've noticed they tend to have toasty fires going all year long.

replies.reply_text: Huh. That makes sense! Thanks for the suggestion!
I've got another question, if you don't mind?

chatpoints.chat_text: Ah! The cochineal clusters! Pronunciation isn't important. However, many people say 'caution-eel.' They are a scale insect that feed off the prickly pear cactus. You'll see what looks like a messy blob of cotton on the pads of the cactus. You'll need to look at several sides of the cactus to find it.

replies.reply_text: Thanks! I think I'll head to the desert isles now.
I've got another question, if you don't mind?
So if you don't mind me asking, why do you need bugs to make tissue paper?
How do I tell a prickly pear cactus from the rest of the cactus?

chatpoints.chat_text: Once dried and crushed, the cochineal are the basis of dye. I can make red dye, and by adding lemon juice, I can make orange dye, too!

replies.reply_text: Cool! Thanks.
I've got another question, if you don't mind?
All right.  Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: A small bagful would be great.

replies.reply_text: Thanks! I'll be back shortly.
I've got another question, if you don't mind?
Wow! Thank you so much. These are festive colors! These should be perfect for Car... I mean, perfect for me! Thanks so much!

chatpoints.chat_text: Excellent question! Look for the cactus that has what looks like flat ovals stacked on their edges. I think of them as the jugglers of the desert. I've also heard some kids call them lollipop cactus. But I would caution against trying to eat one.

replies.reply_text: Thanks!
I've got another question, if you don't mind?

npc_list.name: Omand
npc_list.admin_description: New Quests must start at CP 19

chatpoints.chat_text: Welcome to my humble home.  I have seen many places all over the world.

replies.reply_text: Really?  What kind of places have you seen?
That sounds interesting.  What are you doing now?
Sounds like you must be busy, then.  Unfortunately, I am too, and I need to go.
That sounds exciting!  I'll have to hear about it another time, though.  I'm looking for Karina right now.  Have you seen her?
Neat!  Say, were you at Rashida's party last night?

chatpoints.chat_text: I have traveled to the Cloud Isles, Rock Isle, the desert isles, and even some of the smaller unknown isles.

replies.reply_text: It sounds like you have had quite a few adventures.  What are you going to do now?
I was thinking about traveling to a few of them.  Which do you suggest?
I think I am going to go visit a few of them myself.  Goodbye.

chatpoints.chat_text: For now, I am going to rest at home awhile.  Though having company would be nice.

replies.reply_text: I could keep you company, if you like.
Hopefully someone comes along soon.  I need to leave, though.

chatpoints.chat_text: It really just depends on what type of climate you enjoy.  I like the jungle, so I prefer to spend my time exploring it here on Jungle Isle.  If you like hot sun, though, you may prefer the desert isles.

replies.reply_text: I will definitely keep that in mind.  I think I am going to go and explore now.  See you later.
I will have to keep that in mind.  What are you going to do now?

chatpoints.chat_text: Would you really?  Oh!  How about a quiz to help pass the time?

replies.reply_text: Sure!  What kind of quiz?
Actually, I just remembered I have something else that I need to do, sorry.

chatpoints.chat_text: Just a few questions about the different isles.  They aren't that hard, really.  If you give me $1,000 to play, I will give you $50,000 if you win!

replies.reply_text: I would love to, but unfortunately, I don't have the money to spend.  Perhaps I will come back later.
Only $1,000?  All right, it sounds easy enough.
Yes, I am.  Let's start!
I think I've changed my mind.  You can keep the money, but I have to leave.

chatpoints.chat_text: First Question: Which of the following is the largest isle?

replies.reply_text: Desert Isle
Saddle Isle
Jungle Isle
Tail Isle

chatpoints.chat_text: I'm sorry, but that is not correct.  Perhaps you could try again later, but you will have to pay again.

replies.reply_text: I want to try again now.
I think I will wait and come back later.

chatpoints.chat_text: That is correct! Second Question: Which of the following is the smallest isle?

replies.reply_text: Dust Isle
Quiet Isle
Rock Isle
Snowball Isle

chatpoints.chat_text: You are correct!  Third question: Where can Dieter be found?

replies.reply_text: Cantle Meadows
Rock Isle
Lilac Isle
Sunshine Meadows

chatpoints.chat_text: That is correct! Fourth question:  What is the only terrain where you can find Llamas?

replies.reply_text: Grass
Flower
Jungle
Cloud

chatpoints.chat_text: Correct! Fifth question: Where can you find the Easter Bunny?

replies.reply_text: Christmas Isle
Flower Isle
Cloud Isle
Hare Isle

chatpoints.chat_text: You are correct again! Sixth question: Which of the following is not an isle?

replies.reply_text: Bunny Isle
Turtle Isle
Cat Isle
Bird Isle

chatpoints.chat_text: That is Correct! Seventh question: How many individual isles does Cloud Isle have?
Once again you are correct! Eighth question: What is the only isle that Camels can be found on?

replies.reply_text: Desert Isle
Dust Isle
The Sand Isles
All of these

chatpoints.chat_text: Correct again!  The ninth question is either True or False: Horses can only be caught on grass.

replies.reply_text: True!
False!

chatpoints.chat_text: Now for the Tenth and final question: Which of the following is the only isle that Zebras can be caught?

replies.reply_text: Pirate Isle
Cat Isle
Jungle Isle
Cloud Isle
I will leave you to your packing, then.

chatpoints.chat_text: (He seems to be busy packing.) Did you need something?

replies.reply_text: No, I can see that you are busy now, so I will leave.
Oh, not really. I was just stopping by to see if you wanted some more company, since you're still packing.
I'm back again, Omand, and ready to learn about the mysterious beast for you!  Now, where should I start?
Hi, Omand.  Could you remind me how to get to your observation decks?
Hi, Omand.  I found the access point to the decks, but I can't figure out how to move through them.
Hi Omand.  Could you remind me how to move around once I'm up in your observation decks?
I can't find the animal, Omand.  Where did you last see it?
I found the animal Omand!
I'm back with news of the mystery animal, Omand!
I'm sorry to bother you again, Omand, but I was wondering if you knew where I could buy a pith helmet.
Sorry to bother you, but I was wondering if you have seen someone named Karina?
Yeah.  I was wondering if you were at Rashida's party last night?

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, hello again, brave traveler.  I was hoping you'd come back before I left.  I have a little something for you to help me with, if you feel you're up to the task.

replies.reply_text: Thanks, but I'm just passing through for now.
That sounds interesting, what's the task?

chatpoints.chat_text: I'm a photographer, as I'm sure I told you. I prefer to observe from a distance, if you catch my meaning. There's a strange animal deep in the jungle that I've only started seeing recently.  I'd really like to categorize it.  It looks something like a massive jaguar without the spots.  I've never seen anything like it before.  Do you mind taking a close look at it?  I'm hoping an experienced traveler will be able to identify it for me.

replies.reply_text: That sounds like a good job for me!  I have an affinity with animals.
That sounds dangerous to me.  Approaching any wildlife is incredibly risky.
No thanks.  I don't feel like blazing a trail through the jungle today.

chatpoints.chat_text: Normally I would never send anyone face to face with a huge cat, but I'm certain this is a sentient creature... I've seen it muttering to itself.  I'm hoping you can talk to it.

replies.reply_text: Oh!  In that case, I'll give it a try.
Sentient animals?  That's even scarier.  See you later.
Well, the journal will have to wait.  I forgot that my horse was due for its training session.  I'll be back to help you in a while.
Me too!  Tell me, where should I start looking for this animal?

chatpoints.chat_text: I've had two gigantic observation posts built high in the canopy of the jungle -- ramps, braces, platforms, the works!  They're quite sturdy.  Up in the trees is where I really feel at home, and these decks allow me to comfortably observe and photograph the most untouched parts of the jungle.

replies.reply_text: I've never seen any observation decks in my travels through the jungle.  Could you tell me their general location?
This doesn't sound like fun anymore.  I'll see you later.

chatpoints.chat_text: First, head down the east coast of this main part of Jungle Isle. Go past the first ancient stone head, to a forked piece of driftwood... It's not too far down the coast.

replies.reply_text: East coast, past stone head to the forked driftwood, check.  What's next?
Wait... Wait... This sounds complicated.  I'll be back after I get something to write on.
East coast, past stone head to the forked driftwood, check.  What's next?
After I'm up on the observation decks, how can I move around and get down again?
Ew, that jungle looks damp today, and my horse has a sniffle.  I'll come back some other time.
Where were you, exactly, when you saw the animal?
I'm going to go try that out now!  See ya.
I think I need to write this all down.  I'll come back sometime, after I find a pencil.

chatpoints.chat_text: The last I saw, the creature was in an inaccessible area, just to the south of my larger set of ramps.  There are a number of different areas where you can jump down to the jungle floor from my decks, though.  Feel free to explore while you're in there!

replies.reply_text: Thanks!  I'll try not to make it a habit.  I wouldn't want to mess up untouched wilderness.  I'll be back after I learn about your creature!
Could you be more vague please?  I might have too easy of a time finding the creature.   I'm going to go do something else for now.  Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: From the driftwood, go west, into the jungle.  It's a fairly straight path in.  When you hit a dead end, just look around until you find the access to my observation decks.

replies.reply_text: Thanks very much.
Where were you, exactly, when you saw the animal?
After I'm up on the observation decks, how can I move around and get down again?

chatpoints.chat_text: Just keep using your binoculars, and you'll easily spot the next platform.  When you get to any place that abuts the jungle floor, you can just hop down the ramp.

replies.reply_text: Thank you.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, good!  What's the news?

replies.reply_text: Well, he's a lion.  He does talk, and he's not a native of the jungle at all.  In fact, I got the impression that he's thinking of moving out soon.
No news is good news, as they say.  I'll leave now, so you can stay blissfully uninformed.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, good!  What did you find out about the animal?

replies.reply_text: Err... Nothing, actually.  I'll go back and have a nice chat with it now.

chatpoints.chat_text: A lion, you say?  I might have thought that, but he doesn't have a big mane.  Well, that's a disappointment.  I was hoping for a brand new species. It might not be a complete loss, though.  The scientific journal might still be interested in how he's adapted himself to jungle life.  Does he seem to be thriving?

replies.reply_text: He seems healthy enough, but he was complaining about the humidity.  I don't think he likes living in the jungle.
Access into the jungle has been reward enough, but I really appreciate this, too!
Thanks.  I'm glad that's over.

chatpoints.chat_text: Yes, they carry those horrible things at the general store.

replies.reply_text: Thanks very much!  I'll leave you to your packing now.

chatpoints.chat_text: I haven't seen her lately.  She was fun to talk to.  Asked me all sorts of questions about where I have been.  Maybe try the inn.

replies.reply_text: I'll do that.  Thanks.

chatpoints.chat_text: That I was.  It was quite a great shindig.  Wonderful food, company and games.

replies.reply_text: That's nice. There is a problem though. (Explain about Rashida's missing chess piece.)

chatpoints.chat_text: I didn't notice the chess game.  I was in other areas of the home most of the time.

replies.reply_text: Okay, thanks.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh.  Hello.  Do come in.  Don't mind the mess!  Now.  What can I do for you?  Need something built?

replies.reply_text: Just visiting, thanks.

As a matter of fact, yes! I was just talking to Whystan about an old building set we both seem to have had... (You go into some detail with your description.) ...and he was wondering, since you're good with designs...
Hi, do you have the plans ready for me?
Hi!  Nothing just now.  Thanks again for doing those plans for me.  Bye!
Uhm... Excuse me, I got sidetracked. Who does the small woodworking again?
Uhm... Excuse me, I got sidetracked.  I got the blocks, but I can't remember where to go for the other things.
Hello.  I need paint.  In large amounts.  Do you know where I can get some?
Hello again.  Do you still have that white paint you mentioned?
Hi, Vern!  Say, do you, by any chance, design greenhouses?
Hi, Vern.  Are those greenhouse plans ready?
Hi, Vern.  Sorry, it's been a long day.  Was there something else I needed to do before you give me the plans?
Not right now.  I'm actually wondering if you have seen someone named Karina around?
Actually, I have a question for you. (Explain about Rashida's missing chess piece.)
I have a question for you.  Rashida is missing a chess piece from her set and Orson Shells mentioned that you played chess after he did.  Have you seen the piece?
Hello.  I'm sorry, but I can't remember who you said you invited to the party.
I'm wondering if you provided a strange rider with a crate recently? I'm trying to backtrack his movements and I know he left this island with a crate of parrots that he'd rescued.
Excuse me. What was it that you said the strange rider was carrying?
Thanks so much!  I'll go out and do something else in the meantime.  See you tomorrow!

chatpoints.chat_text:
Yes! I do! Come look at this...
(Vern spreads several sheets of paper out on a desk.)
I made a few changes--additions, really--to Whystan's original plan. I know his grandkids like horses, so I made plans for horse-stall doors and dividers, too, and some paddock fence!

replies.reply_text: Oh, how cool!  Now, should I take these to Rebecca, or Xamba?

chatpoints.chat_text: Mmmm.  Better not take them to either.  Xamba doesn't like to do this kind of thing, and Rebecca doesn't do work this small.  How about.... I know!  Cecil Shuteye!

replies.reply_text: Cecil Shuteye?  Isn't he an innkeeper?
All the way to Treeton?!  No, this is too much.  I'll just give Whystan these plans and he can have them made.

chatpoints.chat_text: Uhm, pardon me, but I haven't given you the plans yet. And if you're not going to keep your word to Whystan, I'm not going to give them to you at all.

replies.reply_text: Fine!  Be that way!  See if I care!  Bye.
You're right.  I'm sorry.  That was very rude of me.  I'll keep my word.
Thanks.  I'll be on my way now.  Goodbye.

chatpoints.chat_text: Yes, he is.  But he's a fine woodworker in his spare time and he specializes in very small parts.  He's just the person to do this.

replies.reply_text: All right.

chatpoints.chat_text: Cecil Shuteye, the innkeeper in Treeton.

replies.reply_text: Oh. Right. Thanks.

chatpoints.chat_text: Try Nicolette in Chillton for the glass, and Grey Slate, he's good with small metal parts.

replies.reply_text: Sounds good.  Thanks.

chatpoints.chat_text: Paint?  House paint, you mean?

replies.reply_text: Yeah, I suppose so.  I mean, I suppose it will do, it's for painting props in a play.
Yeah, I suppose so.  I mean, I suppose it will do, it's for painting props in a play.
No, I don't think so.  Thanks for your help, though.  Bye.
Hmmm... No, those aren't the colors I need.  How long does it take for an order to come in?
Now there's an idea!  Can I have the white?  Maybe I can find something to add to it to color it!

chatpoints.chat_text: Three weeks?  Four weeks?  Has to be shipped in, you know.

replies.reply_text: I don't think I have the time, but thanks a lot for your help!  Bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: Sure!  I'll just give it to you.  It's worthless to me now, anyway.  I'm sure you can find a use for it.  She probably needs white paint anyway for a stage show.

replies.reply_text: Great!  I'll take it!
No thanks.  But if I find out she wants it, I'll come back.  Bye now.
Thanks a lot!  Bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: Hmmm... No.  Had some, but I gave it away.  Sorry.

replies.reply_text: Okay, thanks anyway.

chatpoints.chat_text: Greenhouses?  Hmmm!  Never done one before, but I'm always up for a challenge!  What have you got in mind?

replies.reply_text: It's not for me, it's for Emma, the Chocolatière Royal to King Phil.

chatpoints.chat_text: He has a Chocolatière Royal now, does he?  What a fruitcake.

replies.reply_text: Yeah, he is.  Anyway, here is a sketch of what Emma has in mind.  She wanted to know if you can make real building plans from them.
Well, since cocoa beans grow on trees, I guess she needs lots of space.  Can you build this?

chatpoints.chat_text:
Oh, yes, I can build this, sure. But I need to design it properly first. And I'll tell you this! This is going to require lots of materials to build. I'd say, ooooohhh, at least 50 regular logs and oh, 25 logs of Ebony Wood.
Tell you what, before you leave Jungle Isle, why don't you go start collecting that ebony wood? Once you've got all you can find, come back here and I'll have the plans ready for you.

replies.reply_text: This is sounding like way too much work.  I think I'll pass on it, if you don't mind.
Oh, I hate going into the jungle!  I always get lost in the Jungle Maze!

chatpoints.chat_text: Hah!  Lost in the maze?  You're never lost in a maze! If you do any maze making only left-hand turns (or right hand turns if you're a righty), eventually you get out!  May take you a while, but it always works!  Try it, you'll see!

replies.reply_text: Okay, I'll be back.  See you!
Okay, I'll do it.  Thanks.
What about the glass?

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, we'll need tempered plate glass.  I'll order that in.  I take it this all goes on Phil's tab, right?

replies.reply_text: Sure, okay.
King Phil has a tab with you?!

chatpoints.chat_text: Eh!  "King" Phil has a tab with everybody!  See you!

replies.reply_text: Goodbye!

chatpoints.chat_text: No, not really.  I just thought you might want to collect those ebony logs while you're here.  This plan will take about 25 of them.

replies.reply_text: Ah.  Right.  Oooo-kay, I'll get on that.  Thanks.

chatpoints.chat_text: Let's see.  She did stop by here, but I wasn't able to help her with whatever it was she needed.  Haven't seen her for a bit now, though.

replies.reply_text: Well, thanks anyway.  Bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: Hmmm...  Well, I played chess, but all the pieces were there when I was done.

replies.reply_text: All right.  Thanks for another dead end.
Did you see anyone else play after you?  Or maybe someone that cleaned up the game?

chatpoints.chat_text: Actually, I put it away with a friend of mine.  I swear I remember all the pieces being there.  I wasn't exactly counting, though, I guess.

replies.reply_text: Could you check anything you brought home last night and see if maybe it slipped into your stuff on accident?
Then you must have seen it!  Where is it?

chatpoints.chat_text: Sure, let me take a look. (He disappears into another room and you hear rustling, then he reappears.) I don't see it, sorry. You know, I invited Rebecca, from Carrotton. She helped me put it away. Maybe go talk to her.

replies.reply_text: Great!  I'll do that.  Thanks.

chatpoints.chat_text: Excuse me?  I do not like your tone or what you are implying.  I'm simply trying to help.

replies.reply_text: Well, obviously you aren't helping.  I'll just go.  I can tell I'm not going to get anything out of you.
I'm sorry.  Could you check anything you brought home last night and see if maybe it slipped into your stuff on accident?

chatpoints.chat_text: Rebecca.  She's the woodworker in Carrotton.

replies.reply_text: Oh, that's right.  I'll go talk to her.

chatpoints.chat_text: I did! Said he intended to rescue as many as he could to resell. The poor man needed traveling funds and figured that was one way to do it, I guess.

replies.reply_text: Would he have mentioned where he was traveling from by any chance? Or say anything that might give me a clue as to where he came from?

chatpoints.chat_text: Not anything that stands out to me. Oh wait. He did have a rather large amount of bananas he was carrying. I thought that was odd.

replies.reply_text: Awww! They are so cute. Thank you. And the bananas are a clue I can follow up on. All I have to do is figure out where to get bananas.

chatpoints.chat_text: Way more bananas than a family could eat in a couple of days!

replies.reply_text: Thanks so much! I think I know just where to head next.

npc_list.name: Cookie
npc_list.admin_description: new quests start on CP0 and CP19
npc_list.long_description: A very slim young woman with dark curly hair. She is always busy doing things for other people. She seldom has time do take care of her self.

chatpoints.chat_text: Don't just stand there, come in and help me find my recipe.

replies.reply_text: (Looking around, you wonder if this is something you want to do, but you agree.) Okay, I love to help. What recipe is it? Where should I start looking?
(Seeing all the recipe cards, you know this is not something you want to try.) No way. I am not getting into this mess.
Another recipe? I'd love to help but I am actually here to see if you know where I can get some struffoli.
Hi Cookie.  I'm back.
Is the struffoli ready now?
Hi there!  Hope you don't mind me asking, but you do a lot of baking... Do you make wedding cakes, by any chance?

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, it is a recipe for banana pudding. I have been hungry for one for so long, I can hardly wait to make it.

replies.reply_text: I am allergic to bananas. I have to go now before I have a reaction from just talking about them!
Banana pudding? I love banana pudding. Where can I start looking?
Banana pudding, huh? Well, I guess I can help you look, but I don't have much time.

chatpoints.chat_text: (Jumps up - a yellow recipe card in her hand.) I found it! I found it!

replies.reply_text: Great! Does that mean you can make banana pudding now?
Oh well, guess you didn't need my help after all. I'll just go now.

chatpoints.chat_text: (She hurries to the kitchen.) Yes! I can make the pudding now. (You hear a groan from the kitchen.) Oh no!

replies.reply_text: What is it? What is wrong?

chatpoints.chat_text: I am out of bananas. (She comes back in the room and slumps in her chair.)

replies.reply_text: Oh, is that all? I can just run to the store for you.
That is too bad. Well, I am on my way to my next adventure. Goodbye!

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, I wish you could. But I don't like store-bought bananas. I need someone to go get them from my sister, Cupcake.

replies.reply_text: Oh. Well, you go do that. I'll leave.
Your sister is named Cupcake and you are Cookie? What were your parents thinking?

chatpoints.chat_text: My parents were bakers. They named all of us after something they baked.

replies.reply_text: That is just too weird. I think I am going to go now.
Wow, I would like to meet someone named Cupcake. I could go get the bananas for you. Where do I find her?

chatpoints.chat_text: She lives on the south part of the island in a treehouse just like mine. Have you seen the strange plants that tend to eat your money if you get too close? She lives just to the north and west of them.

replies.reply_text: I like visiting that part of the jungle. I'll get right on it.
Woah! That is way too far to go.
Thanks! I'll be back as soon as I can.

chatpoints.chat_text: You're back already?
