replies.reply_text: Yep! And here are your bananas and a letter from your sister. This was so much trouble; I hope your banana pudding is worth it.
What was I supposed to be doing for you? I forgot with all the fun things to do here on Jungle.
I couldn't find your sister. Where did you say she lives?

chatpoints.chat_text: I needed a bunch of bananas from my sister. You were going to get them.

replies.reply_text: That's right. Where does she live?
Oh that's right.  I'm headed out now.

chatpoints.chat_text: She lives on the south part of the island in a treehouse like mine. It is north and west of those plants that like to steal money.

replies.reply_text: I'm headed that way now.
Wow, thanks! Is there anything else I can do for you?
You're welcome!  Bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: While you were gone, I realized I was out of milk. Would you be willing to go get some milk for me?

replies.reply_text: Do you use store-bought milk?
No, I don't think so. Goodbye!

chatpoints.chat_text: Of course not. I was hoping you could go get fresh milk from my sister, Cinnamon. She keeps a couple of cows near her treehouse.

replies.reply_text: Oh, sure. I have nothing better to do than traipse around the island looking for girls named after baked goods.
No, I am tired. I think I will just go off and rest.
Okay.  I'll be back ASAP!

chatpoints.chat_text: You're back again! Did you get the milk?

replies.reply_text: Oh, that was what I was supposed to do! I'll be right back.
Yes, here is the milk you needed for the pudding.
Where did your sister live again?

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, thank you so much. Her house is not too far from Cupcake. She is at the far south end of the jungle in a treehouse.

replies.reply_text: Back to the other end of the island? I'll pass on this adventure.
It is a good thing I like traveling around the island.
Thanks! Maybe I will stop by for some pudding when I am in the area.

chatpoints.chat_text: Hi there. I still don't have that pudding ready. Maybe later.

replies.reply_text: Hi Cookie.  I am here to see if you know where I can get some struffoli?
Hi Cookie.  I'm back.
Is the struffoli ready now?
That's all right.  I'll stop by some other time.  Bye!
Hi there!  Hope you don't mind me asking, but you do a lot of baking... Do you make wedding cakes, by any chance?

chatpoints.chat_text: Her house is not too far from Cupcake. She is at the far south end of the jungle in a treehouse.

replies.reply_text: Oh, right.  I'll head out now.

chatpoints.chat_text: Struffoli? Who wants that?

replies.reply_text: It's for King Phil.  He wants struffoli and milk.

chatpoints.chat_text: Hmm, let me check on something.... (Rummaging through her recipes, she pulls one out.) Aha! I knew it. I have a recipe for that. Let's see, butter, eggs, flour.. Yep, I think I have everything I need except one thing.

replies.reply_text: I should have figured on that.  Perhaps I'll come back another time.
What do you need?

chatpoints.chat_text: I need 5 honeycombs.  Could you get them for me?

replies.reply_text: What? Why do you need honeycombs?
No way!  Those are impossible to get.  King Phil can just do without!

chatpoints.chat_text: (Laughs) Because, silly, that's what struffoli is - fried honey balls! So..... Can you do it?

replies.reply_text: Yeah, fine.  I'll be back when I have them for you.
See you later then.

chatpoints.chat_text: Great.  Do you have the 5 honeycombs I needed?

replies.reply_text: Oh, that's right.  I forgot what I needed. I'll be back soon.
Yep.  I have them right here.
Okay, I'll be back shortly.
Thanks.  I'll take these to him right away.

chatpoints.chat_text: Wedding cakes?  Oh, good heavens, no, I don't.  It's so hot and humid here, it's just not... good cake country, if you know what I mean.

replies.reply_text: I guess so.  Is there anybody you can recommend?

chatpoints.chat_text: Hmmm.... You know, I heard of someone named Martha who's good at cakes, but I don't know where she lives.

replies.reply_text: Well, I'll see if I can find her.  Thanks so much for your help!  Bye!

npc_list.name: Cupcake
npc_list.long_description: Cupcake studies the wildlife of the jungle. Her current favorite animal is the Jungle Monkey.

chatpoints.chat_text: Sssshhhh! Be very, very quiet. You'll scare off the rare monkeys in the clearing.

replies.reply_text: Oh, sorry to bother you. I'll go now.
(Whispering) Rare monkeys? Can I see?
Oh, sorry, I'll be quiet.  I was wondering if you've seen a monkey named Matata lately?
Hello, Cupcake, I was wondering... I need a wedding cake made.  Do you possibly...?

chatpoints.chat_text: Yes, grab those extra binoculars and come over here.

replies.reply_text: Okay. (You tiptoe over to the window.)

chatpoints.chat_text: Do you see them? There - over in the northwest corner of the clearing?

replies.reply_text: Wow! That is amazing!
I can't see them...  Umm...  Good luck monkey watching.

chatpoints.chat_text: Sssshhhh! I said whisper!

replies.reply_text: Oh, right. Sorry.
Nevermind. Looking at monkeys is not worth being quiet.

chatpoints.chat_text: Now, what brings you to my treehouse?

replies.reply_text: Oh, I almost forgot! Your sister, Cookie, asked me to get some bananas from you.
I'm just on an adventure and wanted to see what was in this part of the jungle.
Actually, I was here because Venus sent me.  She says that she needs a bunch of bananas and you have the best.

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, now that you have seen the monkeys, you'll need to go. I need to get back to my studies.

replies.reply_text: Thanks for letting me see the monkeys. Goodbye!

chatpoints.chat_text: BANANAS? OH THAT IS NOT GOOD AT ALL!

replies.reply_text: Sshh! Thought we were supposed to be quiet. What is wrong?

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, sorry. Some other monkeys came into the clearing last night and made off with my bananas. I don't have time to go find them.

replies.reply_text: Oh well, then I guess she won't get to make pudding. Goodbye.
Stolen by monkeys? I guess I could go look for them for you.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, that would be great! Are you sure you want to do it?

replies.reply_text: Oh, sure. I'll give it a try.
Not really. I think I will leave.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, thank you so much. Now, you'll have to figure out where they live.

replies.reply_text: You mean you don't know?
If I have to figure things out, I think I'll pass. Bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: It shouldn't be that hard. I know they came from the south.

replies.reply_text: South. Right. Anything else?
If that is all you know, it is going to be too hard. I'll pass on that.

chatpoints.chat_text: Yes, these are rather odd monkeys. They like to be by the trees, but they really enjoy being around the rocks. I heard them not far from here last night. So, you might start looking for clues at the rocks near here.

replies.reply_text: Okay, south, rocks, near trees. That should help a lot. I'll go see what I can do.
Hm..  Nevermind.  This is sounding like a bit of a pain.  I guess Cookie just won't get her bananas now.

chatpoints.chat_text: Thank you so much. Please come back here when you find them. I would like to send a note to Cookie as well.

replies.reply_text: Find bananas and come back here. Right.

chatpoints.chat_text: Yes. I told you that you should start looking for clues just south of here by some rocks.

replies.reply_text: Okay.  I'll go look now.
I'll get right on it.

chatpoints.chat_text: Hello again. Thanks for the help. I really need to get back to my monkeys.

replies.reply_text: Bye.
I'm sorry to bother you, but I have a letter from your sister.
Oh, I gave you those bananas, but forgot to get them for Cookie.  There was something else you wanted to send too, wasn't there?
Oh, sorry, I'll be quick.  I was wondering if you've seen a monkey named Matata lately?
Hello, Cupcake, I was wondering... I need a wedding cake made.  Do you possibly...?
Hello.  Venus sent me.  She says that she needs a bunch of bananas and you have the best.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, there you are. Did you find the bananas?

replies.reply_text: Bananas? That was what I was supposed to find, wasn't it?
Yep! Here they are. Those monkeys sure were tricky.
Now, what all did you want me to take back to Cookie?

chatpoints.chat_text: Thanks for remembering. Here is a bunch of bananas and a letter from me.

replies.reply_text: I know she'll be glad to get both of these.
I'll hurry!
Wonderful!  Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: Matata?  Well sure, he's around here all the time.  Has he gotten himself into trouble again?

replies.reply_text: Well, yes, actually. He's stolen Materia's constellation map.  She's asked me to come and find him.
No, I was just curious that's all.
Thanks!

chatpoints.chat_text: Hmmm... Oh!  You know who might do it?  There's a lady named Martha, she's on.... Rider Isle, or maybe Saddle Isle, I think?  She's not a professional baker, but she has a natural talent for cakes.

replies.reply_text: Thanks, I'll give her a try. Goodbye!

chatpoints.chat_text: A wedding cake?  Oh, how wonderful!  Is it for you?  Congratulations--

replies.reply_text: Oh no!  It's not for me!  No, it's for Lilianna, the princess on Cloud Isle.

chatpoints.chat_text: Cloud Isle?  She doesn't have her own baker?

replies.reply_text: I suppose not.  I know you come from a baking family, can you make a wedding cake?

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, my goodness! No, not me! And even if I did, how ever would you get it to her in one piece? No, I don't do that, sorry.

replies.reply_text: Oh well, sorry to waste your time, then.  Goodbye.
Well, is there anyone you can recommend?
I'll take them right to her!  Thank you.

npc_list.name: Cinnamon
npc_list.long_description: Cinnamon loves cows. She likes all kinds of cows. She even has a few cows around her house in the jungle. Not what you expect to find on Jungle Isle.

chatpoints.chat_text: Hello! Come in and sit down. Would you like a glass of milk?

replies.reply_text: No thanks. I have a lot to do here on Jungle. I'm going back to exploring.
Your sister Cookie sent me to get some milk from you.
I am so thirsty. There is not much to drink in the jungle. I would love a glass of milk.
Hello.  I'm looking for cheese, actually, and I noticed you have cows.  Do you have cheese?
Hi Cinnamon! King Phil sent me for some fresh milk!
Where was I supposed to check for the struffoli again?
No, thank you, but I would like to speak to you about a wonderful opportunity I have to offer.
Did you hear that?  Anyway, do you have the milk ready?  I'll bring it to Hansel for you.
No thanks.  I actually needed some cream.  Would I be able to buy a bottle from you?
Thanks but no thanks. I'm actually looking for some sour cream. Would I be able to buy some from you?

What a kind offer, but I'll pass on that today. Although I'm sure you have the finest milk around. Which is the exactly why I am here. You would be the perfect person to come to for a special request.
Excuse, we were talking about a special order of junket. Could you tell me the clue again?
Thanks! This milk is really great.

chatpoints.chat_text: You have been to Cookie's house? How is she?

replies.reply_text: I guess she's fine. She is wanting to make banana pudding but has had a hard time getting everything she needs.

chatpoints.chat_text: Yes, she does seem to have a problem with her organizational skills. What has she lost now?

replies.reply_text: Well, first it was her recipe. Then she was out of bananas and now milk.

chatpoints.chat_text: Out of bananas? Does that mean you have seen Cupcake?

replies.reply_text: Yes. I saw her. She is studying some rare monkey species.

chatpoints.chat_text: Now, what was it you wanted from me?

replies.reply_text: Cookie wants 4 glasses of milk for pudding.
Nothing. I am leaving now.

chatpoints.chat_text: I really miss her. Could you take a letter back by Cupcake's treehouse on your way back to Cookie?

replies.reply_text: I guess I could do that.
Sure! I'd be happy to do that.
No, I am going the opposite direction.
What about that milk for Cookie?
Thanks! I'm off to see your sisters.

chatpoints.chat_text: Cheese?  Oh no.  I can't, really, the climate here isn't good for cheesemaking, I wouldn't think, though I've never tried it.

replies.reply_text: Hmmm.  Any chance I might convince you to give cheesemaking a try?
Oh, I see.  I'll look elsewhere, then.  Do you know anyone else who raises dairy animals?
Oh, well, that's all right.  I really need to get this milk to Shaylene.  Bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: Make cheese?  Oh no.  Even if milk didn't spoil so quickly here, I don't have a clue how to make cheese, really.  Sorry.

replies.reply_text: Oh well.  Thanks anyway.  Goodbye.
As it happens, I know someone who makes goat cheese.  Could I buy some cow's milk from you, maybe she can use it.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, you mean Shaylene?  I've heard of her, didn't know she was making cheeses, though.  Well, hmm... I can probably sell you about four liters of cows's milk if you'd like, but Shaylene lives so far away I'm sure it would spoil by the time you got there.  I'd hate to see it go to waste.

replies.reply_text: You know best.  Well, thanks for your time, anyway.  See you!
Well, I'd like to give it a try.  Can I buy four liters of milk from you?

chatpoints.chat_text: All right, if you insist. I can sell you a 4 liter jug full for $200, but you must get it to Shaylene without any delay or it will spoil!

replies.reply_text: $200?  No, I can't.  But thanks anyway.
Okay. Here's $200, I'll take it.
I'll get this to Shaylene right away!  Thanks!  Goodbye.
Shaylene Shampu who owns the grooming place?  I'll try her.  Thanks!

chatpoints.chat_text: Huh, he did? Okay.  How much does he need?

replies.reply_text: I have no idea.  Maybe 2 liters?

chatpoints.chat_text: I can sell you that.  It will be $100.

replies.reply_text: Oh, but, I don't want to spend my money on this. I'm just going to go now.
That's not so much. Here you go.
Thanks! Say, you wouldn't happen to know where I can get some struffoli made, would you?

chatpoints.chat_text: Hmmm....  Why don't you check with my sister, Cookie?  She may know where to get some from.

replies.reply_text: Okay thanks, bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: Really? And what would that be?

replies.reply_text: I represent Hansel and Gretel's new bakery in the Cloud Isles.  They are looking for a supplier of fresh milk and since you are so close to Winchell and his balloon, you are a perfect fit!

chatpoints.chat_text: It's an interesting proposal... How much milk did they have in mind? (You show Cinnamon the list.) Oh, I think I can handle that!

replies.reply_text: That's wonderful! Now all you have to do is sign this letter of credit...
Now, I'll take the signed copy and the first delivery up to Hansel and Gretel for you.
Yes ma'am!  I'll get this milk to the bakery immediately.  Thanks!
Thanks!

chatpoints.chat_text: Sure thing!  That will be $300.

replies.reply_text: I don't have that much on me right now.  I'll be back when I do.
That sounds fair.  Here you are.

chatpoints.chat_text: You are in luck! I just finished up a fresh batch today. Premium stuff! Creamy and decadent with just the right tang! I can sell you a container for $100.

replies.reply_text: Perfect. I'll take it!
Oh gosh. I don't have that much on me. I'll be back shortly.
Thanks so much!

chatpoints.chat_text: Special requests? I love special requests! What did you have in mind?

replies.reply_text: Have you had any requests for something called junket?

chatpoints.chat_text: Ah, junket! That lovely creamy decadence! I've had a standing order for years now.

replies.reply_text: Wonderful! Please tell me who you have it delivered to.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh dear. That's rather private information. That would be gossipy of me to share it without permission. Unethical.

replies.reply_text: Seriously? But I'm on a mission regarding true love. Don't you care about true love?

chatpoints.chat_text: (Cinnamon's eyes suddenly look glassy, as if you've struck a nerve. She sighs heavily.) I care deeply about true love. But... maybe I can give you a clue. Night crawlers. That is the best I can do.

replies.reply_text: Well. I appreciate what you've shared. First it was spiders. Now night crawlers are in the picture. I best share this with Humpty. He might have some insight.

chatpoints.chat_text: This makes me very uncomfortable. I feel badly that I told you the first time. Please don't ask again. All I can say is night crawlers.

replies.reply_text: Thank you so much! I'm sure to remember it now. Hopefully Humpty will know what it means.

chatpoints.chat_text: Come in, come in. I am very, very busy. I can only chat for a few minutes.

replies.reply_text: If you are busy, I'll just go.
Oh, what are you busy doing?
I'll be quick - Do you know of anyone who could repair this leaky bucket so that the repair matches the style?
Krista, what was it I was looking for?
Krista, I have returned with the lac!  Does this look right?
Are you too busy for a present?
Sapphire really looks good on you, Krista.

chatpoints.chat_text: I have oh so much to do. I have baskets to make, and catnip to harvest. Then I have to deliver catnip to some of the merchants.

replies.reply_text: That is a lot to do. Can I help?
That makes me tired just hearing it. I think I will go now.
You make all these baskets?

chatpoints.chat_text: Help? You mean that?

replies.reply_text: Sure, I can help. What do you need?
Help? Did I say that? I was only kidding. Goodbye!

chatpoints.chat_text: I use branches and dandelions to craft my baskets. Do you think you can get them for me? I need them in bundles of 10 only.

replies.reply_text: I am always coming across dandelions and branches. Will you be paying for them?
I don't waste time picking up branches and dandelions. If I change my mind, I'll come back.
I have 10 dandelions for you!
I have 10 branches for you!

chatpoints.chat_text: I will pay $100 for every 10 branches or 10 dandelions you bring me.

replies.reply_text: Okay, I'll go get started gathering them! Thanks!
That's not enough for me. Goodbye!
I have 10 dandelions for you!
I have 10 branches for you!
I have 10 dandelions for you!
I have 10 branches for you!
That's all for now. I'll be back.
I have 10 dandelions for you!
I have 10 branches for you!
That's all for now. I'll be back.

chatpoints.chat_text: Yes, I do. I have been so busy making the baskets, I have not been able to get them delivered.

replies.reply_text: Could I help you with that?
That's too bad. I'm going to go now.

chatpoints.chat_text: That would be great! Can you just run this order over to Tulippe on Flower? She probably thinks I am not ever going to get them to her. You'll need to come back with the payment, too.

replies.reply_text: It is too hard to go to Flower Isle. I think I'll pass.
Sure, I like doing things like that.
I'll be back as soon as I can!
Enjoy your basket-making.

chatpoints.chat_text: Welcome back. Were you able to deliver my baskets to Tulippe?

replies.reply_text: I couldn't remember what I was supposed to do. I'll get right on it.
Yes, I did. She sent a payment back with me.

chatpoints.chat_text: I'm sure I could repair it to match, if I had the right plug for it.  You see how this bucket is made of cedar?  I work with cedar branches from time to time.

replies.reply_text: I can pay you for your work, if you can do it.  The owner is specifically interested in the patch matching the style of the bucket, but she also needs for it to be functional.
Oh, that's good to know.  I'll come back soon to talk it over.

chatpoints.chat_text: Certainly.  I am a business woman after all.  I want to make sure my customers are well satisfied!  I'm sure I can patch this bucket to match, but I'll need someone else to cut the plug first.

replies.reply_text: Why is that?

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, the tools I use are modern ones, and they make precise cuts.  What I want to start out with in this case is a rough hewn plug, so the repair will look old-fashioned.  Are you willing to help me gather some supplies?

replies.reply_text: Yes, I think I'm in this for the long haul.  What should I do first?
No, I don't think so.  I'd better come back some other time.

chatpoints.chat_text: I first need you to get me a little bit of a resin called lac.  Just a couple of ounces will do.  This old bucket was finished with shellac, and I'll need a little time to recreate a matching finish for the repair.

replies.reply_text: All right.  Where can I get lac?
Wish me luck!

chatpoints.chat_text: I need a couple of ounces of a resin called lac, so I can make some shellac to match the bucket.   Any person with a strong knowledge of insects should be able to help you find some lac.

replies.reply_text: Thanks, I'll think about that.
What do I need to do next?

chatpoints.chat_text: Hello!  Back again, eh?

replies.reply_text: Yep!  I remember I got you the lac to make into shellac... What was I supposed to do next?
Hiya, Krista!  Could you remind me what I'm doing with this length of cedar wood that keeps banging around in the bottom of my pack?  I'm sure I got it from you....
Hi, Krista!  Remember those bucket repairs?  I got kind of lost... er.. Can you help me remember what I was doing?
I'm finally back with the little cedar plug, Krista.  See if this is what you needed.
Yep, I'm back.  How's that bucket coming along?
Yes, back again.  Is the bucket ready this time?
I'm afraid to ask - How's the bucket repair coming along?

chatpoints.chat_text: While you were out looking for the lac, I matched a length of cedar to the old bucket, peeled it, and marked where I need to have it hewed.

replies.reply_text: I assume you know who to send me to, to get the wood hewed.

chatpoints.chat_text: (Ahem) I'm afraid I don't get out much. I'm not the explorer type.

replies.reply_text: Well, that figures.  What kind of tools would someone need to hew this wood correctly?

chatpoints.chat_text: The word "hew" itself implies an axe.... Surely someone in the world uses an axe. Why don't I give you this marked length of wood, and you can ask around, if that's all right with you?

replies.reply_text: I think I have a good idea who to ask, go ahead and give me the wood.
You know, now that I've given you the lac, perhaps I should quit for now and rest my horses before I ask them to carry that heavy-looking twig.  I'll be back later.
I'm sure I will be.

chatpoints.chat_text: Yes, you needed to find someone who's handy with an axe to hew that wood to the size I've marked.

replies.reply_text: Riiiight!  Hew, axe... hmmm.  Well, I'll run along now.
I'm sure he doesn't think of himself that way, but he does know his craft.  So, when will that bucket be repaired, Krista?

chatpoints.chat_text: You can't rush art!  Cat Isle is lovely this time of day, why don't you take a stroll and come back in a few hours?  Oh, by the way, I'll need $1000 for the restoration, so you might want to gather that together before you come back, too.

replies.reply_text: All right.  I'll figure out something to do for a few hours.
Okaaaaay.   It's just so hard to wait.
This is taking a lot longer than I expected.  I'll be back later.
I'm sure Liza will be thrilled with your craftsmanship.  I'll pass your name along to her, for future reference.  I've got to hurry off now!

chatpoints.chat_text: Splendidly!  I've finally finished.  What do you think of it?  You can't even see where the patch is, and I made sure to put extra shellac on the worn out spots.  It looks like a perfect old bucket now, don't you think?  Like a collector's item!

replies.reply_text: Yep, you're right, it looks like an old bucket.  Now, you said it would cost $1000, right?  I have that with me here.
Oh, a masterful job!  I forgot to bring the money to pay for it, though.  I'll be right back.

chatpoints.chat_text: Don't go asking for a present!  I hardly know you!

replies.reply_text: No, no!  I have a present for you!
Fine, you're very, very busy.  And very, very abrupt.  Goodbye.

chatpoints.chat_text: Don't go giving me a present!  I hardly know you!

replies.reply_text: Right.  This is not going well.  I'll come back when you're in a better mood.
Wait!  Would you just let me talk?  It's from Jade!

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh!  Well, why didn't you say so!

replies.reply_text: On second thought, Jade can deal with you herself.  I'm out of here.
(Sigh) Jade says that since you were born in September, your birthstone is the sapphire. She sent you a sapphire necklace.
I know.  You're very, very busy.

chatpoints.chat_text: Thank you.  I haven't made it over to Jade to thank her yet.  But I will.  Soon.

replies.reply_text: I'm sure you will.

npc_list.name: Kiah
npc_list.long_description: Kiah is at one with the jungle. She spends much of her time caring for and harvesting the local plant life.

chatpoints.chat_text: Tut! Asha'aho! Stop right there! What is the First Law of the Jungle?

replies.reply_text: Whoa, You're way too intense. I'm leaving.
Umm... Survival of the fittest?
Beauty is only skin (or, in this case, bark) deep.
We are all part of The Great Conversation.
Is it: Always look a gift horse in the mouth?
That's easy. Walk softly and carry a big stick!
I was wondering if you needed help with anything else?

chatpoints.chat_text: Your soul is still lost. Come back when you have seen the spirit of the Jungle.

replies.reply_text: Okay, bye...

chatpoints.chat_text: You have seen truly. Every action we take has eternal consequences on all that surrounds us. What can I do for you, Namaste?

replies.reply_text: Nothing for today. I am just exploring your beautiful jungle.
Namaste? What does that mean?
Actually, I need to find some red jamuti clay, and Genevieve said you might know where to find some.
All of these plants you have here are amazing. What do you use them for?
Actually, I was wondering if there was anything I could do to help you out?
Actually, I was wondering if you needed me to gather anything else for you?
Is there anything else you might need help with?
I have the fireflower leaves!
Kiah, I know you have a vast knowledge of herbal remedies.  Have you ever heard of camphor or witch hazel?

chatpoints.chat_text: Namaste, simply stated, means "I bow to the divinity within you."

replies.reply_text: Oh, that's beautiful! Thank you for the sentiment. (You bow on your way out the door.)

chatpoints.chat_text: Ah, the jamuti clay. Very rare and difficult to find. You are in luck today, however, Namaste. I spotted several clumps in the clearing near here, where the Temple sits. If you dig carefully in that area, you should find some. Please be careful, though, not to disturb the rest of the area, and do not take more than you need.

replies.reply_text: I won't, I promise. Thank you for the information.

chatpoints.chat_text: I use them in my pashni'ka, my medicine closet. The people of the jungle often come to me when they are lo'kasnu.

replies.reply_text: That's really interesting. I'll let you get back to work.
That's great they have someone so dedicated. Do they keep you busy?

chatpoints.chat_text: Often, yes, which is why I must work to keep my pashni'ka filled.

replies.reply_text: I see. I won't take up any more of your time. Goodbye.
Is there anything I can do to help?

chatpoints.chat_text: (Kiah turns and looks you over with a fierce intensity. She walks up to you and plants her finger in your chest.) Is your heart true? Is this what you think?

replies.reply_text: Uh... Maybe I'm in the wrong place. (You back quickly out the door.)
Yes, I... I believe so. (You find yourself swallowing hard.)

chatpoints.chat_text: Hmm.... We shall see, Namaste. (Kiah's eyes narrow as she seems to be attempting to read your thoughts.) Very well. I will set for you a hrasaa task, one that is simple to do. If you succeed, you may prove worthy.

replies.reply_text: Actually... I think I've changed my mind. I'll just go now.
What would you like me to do?

chatpoints.chat_text: To the south of here, at the edge of the jungle near some rocks, grows a plant that is short, with many green leaves like a fern, although it has small pink flowers which are very fragrant. This plant is named valerian, no'hani? You bring me some root from this plant, and then we shall see. Remember to only take what you need, and do not disturb the area more than you must!

replies.reply_text: All right, I'll be right back.
I'm sorry... I didn't know...
I think that's all I want to do for now. Maybe I can help you again later. Bye.
I'm ready! What's next?

chatpoints.chat_text: Perhaps. (Kiah looks you over, looking for something, though you can't tell what.) Perhaps. You may be kii enough to complete another task for me.

replies.reply_text: Um, you're actually a little scary. I think I'll just go now.
Assuming that being kii is a good thing... then yeah, I'm up for it.

chatpoints.chat_text: Asha'aho! You have no business here.

replies.reply_text: I'm sorry... Bye.
I really am sorry... Isn't there anything I can do to make it up?

chatpoints.chat_text: Maa'hala. The next troha you can gather for me lies a bit further away. There lies a temple on the smallest island to the west of here, no'hani? Directly behind the temple is a neem tree whose bark is ready for harvesting. Bring me bark from that tree, and then we shall see.

replies.reply_text: I'll find it, no problem. Be back soon!

chatpoints.chat_text: (Kiah's eyes narrow in suspicion.) You think you can regain your kii? Well, perhaps you deserve the chance.

replies.reply_text: Um, I'm not sure kii is something I want to have... I think I'll just go.
Yes, I'm willing to do anything you say! Just please let me make it up to you.

chatpoints.chat_text: It is not to me you should be making up! It is the Jungle you harmed, no'hani? If you truly feel sorrow, there is something you can do. Some time ago, a greedy little elf stole something from the Jungle. Find her and retrieve this sacred treasure, and you will restore your kii.

replies.reply_text: I don't think I feel like chasing down elves right now. Maybe later...
I think I know exactly what little elf you mean. What is the treasure?
I don't know where to find any elves. Do you know where she is?
I'll do my best.

chatpoints.chat_text: The trees tell me she makes her home on the Isle of the Tail. You know this place?

replies.reply_text: Yes, I've been there. What does the treasure look like?

chatpoints.chat_text: I sent you for a sacred jungle treasure taken by an elf who lives on the Isle of the Tail. (Kiah's eyes narrow.) Mmm.. Perhaps you do not have enough kii...

replies.reply_text: No, no! I have kii, I promise! I'll get right on that.

chatpoints.chat_text: You are back, I see. Do you have the object?

replies.reply_text: No, I'll get right on that.
No, what was I looking for again?
Yes, I've brought this... (You hand over the stone.)
Yes, Gidget gave me this. She says she's very sorry, she didn't know it was special. (You hand over the nut.)
It looks like a special kind of stone...

chatpoints.chat_text: No! This is a very rare and precious hushulu egg! The hushulu are so rare, they are almost never seen and are very nearly extinct. This egg is a sacred treasure indeed! It is not what I sent you for, but it is better! You do indeed have great kii. I will let the elf know she can keep the other in return for this egg. And you, Namaste, are most certainly welcome here again.

replies.reply_text: Wow, that's really cool! I'm glad I could help! Can I do anything else for you?
That's great! But I really have to be off now. Bye!
Wow, that's really cool! I'm glad I could help! Can I do anything else for you?
That's great! But I really have to be off now. Bye!
But the squirrel...... All right. Be back soon...
What?! I'm the one who was harmed! That's it, I'm outta here.
No creature was harmed, I promise. I'll be fine. Is there anything else you need?

chatpoints.chat_text: There is one more troha I am in need of, but this last troha lies even further away, and is even a little dangerous to collect.

replies.reply_text: Dangerous? Maybe you'd better find someone else to help you, then. Bye!
'Danger' is my middle name! What is it you need?
It was no problem. I really need to get going now, though. Bye!
I'm just glad I could help. Was there anything else you needed?

chatpoints.chat_text: I am in need of leaves from the very rare and very beautiful fireflower. There is only one place in the jungle these flowers grow. Far to the south, they take shelter in the shadow of very tall, carnivorous plants. In this manner does the fireflower protect itself, as the taller, more dangerous plant scares away all visitors, you see? Bring me the leaves from three of these fireflowers. Bring the leaves, only, mind you! The fireflower itself, if you touch it, will burn you, no'hani?

replies.reply_text: Carnivorous? I think I changed my mind. Uh... Bye!
Uh... Yes, I understand. I'll be careful.
Be back soon!
Thank you very much! Good luck with your medicine!

chatpoints.chat_text: Na'shuli! A moment, friend. What is the Second Law of the Jungle?

replies.reply_text: I have no idea. So long!
Is it: A bird in the hand is worth two in the bush?
I believe it's: Let sleeping dogs lie.
That's easy. You must Exist for the Other.
Uh, money doesn't grow on trees?

chatpoints.chat_text: You have seen truly. We must care for that which is around us before fulfilling our selfish desires, else we will lose that which we most wish to keep. What can I do for you, Namaste?

replies.reply_text: Nothing, I was just dropping by.
Actually, I need to find some red jamuti clay, and Genevieve said you might know where to find some.
I was wondering if you needed help with anything else?
I can't seem to find Murukan the Lion. Can you tell me again where to find him?
Kiah, I know you have a vast knowledge of herbal remedies.  Have you ever heard of camphor or witch hazel?

chatpoints.chat_text: You are back, I see. Do you have the roots?

replies.reply_text: No, not yet. I'll go do that now!
Where do I find those again?
Yes, I found the plant right here!
Yep, here's what I've collected.

chatpoints.chat_text: Look to the south of here, at the edge of the Jungle. The valerian plant likes to grow near rocks.

replies.reply_text: Will do, thanks!

chatpoints.chat_text: You are back, I see. Do you have the neem bark?

replies.reply_text: Oh, yes, I'll go get that now.
Not yet, where do I find that again?
I have it here!
Yes, I have it, no thanks to a mad little squirrel!
Yes, here is some more. I hope it's enough this time...

chatpoints.chat_text: On the smallest isle west of here, look behind the temple.

replies.reply_text: Got it, thanks!

chatpoints.chat_text: You are back, I see. Do you have the fireflower leaves?

replies.reply_text: I have them here!
No, where do I find those again?
Not yet, I'll go get those now!

chatpoints.chat_text: Far to the south, almost to the very end of the Jungle. You will find them growing in the shadow of tall carnivorous plants.

replies.reply_text: Thanks, I'll be back soon!

chatpoints.chat_text: No, there is nothing else I must gather now. If you feel you would like to become closer to the Spirit of the Jungle, however, I suppose you could deliver this pashni yourself. You helped create it after all. You have earned the right to see it through, if you should desire.

replies.reply_text: Um, I'm not sure I want to know the jungle quite that well. Bye now.
You talk about the Spirit of the Jungle like it's a real thing... like a person, almost.

chatpoints.chat_text: That is because the Spirit is a real being. Her name is Katukilal. It is her duty and kanja to watch over the Jungle and protect it. Her destiny. She is one with the Jungle, and the Jungle is in her.

replies.reply_text: Wow, that's cra-.. uh... very interesting. I think I'll just leave now. (You back slowly out the door.)
The junge spirit has a name? Huh. So you can actually, like, see her?

chatpoints.chat_text: I can, yes. Whether or not you are able to see her is yet to be determined. However, if you so wish to attempt it, then I will help you begin this journey. I warn you though, it is not easy. She may even, in the end, choose not to show herself to you. What do you think, Namaste? Do you wish to try?

replies.reply_text: It sounds really difficult. I think I'll pass for now. Bye.
I would love to meet a jungle spirit! What must I do?

chatpoints.chat_text: You must find and pass her three guardians first: Murukan the War Lion, Pattini the Mother Horse, and Katavul the All-Seeing Eagle. I can tell you where to find the first one. The rest will be up to you.

replies.reply_text: Lion?! How foolish do you think I am, to go searching after a lion? I'm outta here!
Uh... The lion won't eat me, will it?
Oh wow, sounds exciting! Which way do I go?

chatpoints.chat_text: He will not, if you do not make him angry. (Kiah looks at you sternly.) I suggest you do not make him angry.

replies.reply_text: Actually... I think I'm going to sit this one out, after all. I'm feeling slightly ill. Bye!
I'll do my best. (You swallow hard.) How do I find him?

chatpoints.chat_text: There is a sacred place in the Jungle, where an ancient ring of statues stand. This place is not hard to find. But you will not find Murukan there. You must look a little further south of that place for a single Walnut tree, standing alone within a ring of peers. This is Murukan's tree. No'hani? If you approach with humility, Murukan will show himself to you. You must do as he says, and then ask him how to find the other guardians. Only he will know. Here, take this pashni. Give it to Katukilal when you find her.

replies.reply_text: Thanks, I think I can find it. Wish me luck!

chatpoints.chat_text: I can tell you that he is far to the south. He wanders in an area of the jungle that is sacred. Seven statues stand in this area. But you will not find Murukan where the statues are. His tree stands further south still, in a small clearing surrounded by a circle of other trees. This is where you will find Murukan.

replies.reply_text: Thank you! I think I can find him now.

chatpoints.chat_text: My knowledge of the plants of these jungles is great; much of it was passed to me by my mother.  I know not of the plants you speak.  There is one who studies books from foreign lands, and is also well versed in healing.  Find Engolo-mbe, of the Tumetai Tribe.  He may know.

replies.reply_text: Thank you, that's very helpful!

chatpoints.chat_text: Welcome.  Come in, please.

replies.reply_text: No thanks.  I should really be on my way.
All right.  Thank you.
Hi there.  I'm looking for little jobs and so on I could do.  Do you need anything done, or gotten, or found, by any chance?
Hi.  I've looked and looked, but I can't find your daughter.  Can you be a little more specific about where she might have gone?
Hello there, I've found your daughter, but I can't get her to come home.
We're back!
Thank you, I just stopped by to see how you and Mtomka are doing.
Sorry to bother you, but who am I supposed to see for you?
Hi Nomasonto, I'm back from Lapis Maki's!

chatpoints.chat_text: Would you like a cup of jasmine tea?  I was just heating up some for myself.

replies.reply_text: Sure.  I would love some.
No thanks.  I don't really like tea very much.
Not right now.  Thanks, though.  I was wondering if you happen to know where Karina is?  She should, hopefully, be around here somewhere.
Thank you.  It was quite delicious.  I should be going, though.  Thanks again!

chatpoints.chat_text: That is too bad.  I hope your travels are going well.

replies.reply_text: Speaking of travels, I should probably get back to them.  Bye!
They are.  This jungle is a bit crazy, though.  I keep getting lost.

chatpoints.chat_text: That is not atypical.  Don't forget to check your map often.  I'm sure you will find your way.

replies.reply_text: Thanks.  Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh. Why, yes. My daughter. (Nomasonto chuckles.) She wanders the forest. This isle, the next one to the left. She knows her way. She's just late coming back. Could you find her and tell her to come home? That will be a big help to me.

replies.reply_text: Uh, no thanks.  I'm allergic to the jungle.  I'll pass.  I'm sure she'll be home soon.  Bye.
Sure.  I can do that.
I'll have her back as soon as I can.  Bye now!
Can you possibly be more specific about where she might have gone?

chatpoints.chat_text: No, sorry.  So much energy at this age, needs to burn it off.  Goes all over the islands, but usually she stays in the forests.  On this island or the next one, to the north-west.  She likes the temples.  You could look there first.

replies.reply_text: Okay, thanks!

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, dear.  Please try again.  The food is done and it will be cold!

replies.reply_text: Okay.  I'll do my best.
No, I think I've had enough for one day. I'm sure she'll be fine.  Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text:
(Without so much as a glance at anyone, Mtomka slides off your horse and runs into her bed in the corner of her hut. She pulls the blankets completely over her. You can hear nothing, but you can tell by the way the blankets jerk that she is crying.)
Oh, my. What happened?

replies.reply_text: Honestly, I'm not really sure.  Her friend who was with her left suddenly, I guess.

chatpoints.chat_text: Her friend?  Which friend?  All the village children are here, and have been all afternoon.

replies.reply_text: Odetho's been here.... all afternoon?

chatpoints.chat_text:
(As you speak the boy's name, Nomosanto's eyes first become very wide, and then she rolls them and struggles to contain a giggle. She beckons you to follow her outside the hut, and says to you confidentially....)
I'm so sorry... She doesn't think I know. Odetho is her imaginary friend.

replies.reply_text: Her... I searched that jungle for........ Uggghh.
Thanks.  Yeah, that is a difficult age; not a child, but not a teen, either.  Well, I hope she gets over it okay.

chatpoints.chat_text:
I'm sure she will. Alas, she is at the age where our imaginary friends all seem to desert us. (Nomosanto shrugs. As you prepare to ride away, you hear her talking soothingly to her daughter. And one of the few things you are able to distinguish is...)
That's the way it is in life. But don't worry. When you get to be grandmother's age, sometimes those old friends come back!

replies.reply_text: Giddy-up....

chatpoints.chat_text: She is in the area.  I just had tea with her this morning.  I cannot say where she is right at this moment, though.  Manco will probably know, though.

replies.reply_text: I'll ask him.  Thanks!

chatpoints.chat_text: Ah, Mtomka is fine, she is growing up but I'm afraid she having a hard time accepting the inevitable.

replies.reply_text: Yeah, growing up is hard.  I don't envy you the next few years with her.  Good luck with that, bye
Accepting the inevitable?  What's going to happen to her?

chatpoints.chat_text: Nothing is going to happen to Mtomka that hasn't happened to every girl in the world....soon, she will no longer be a little girl.  Soon she will be a young woman.

replies.reply_text: Oh.....I forgot.  Does your tribe have any sort of coming of age ceremony?
My, that means you'll soon be the mother of a teenaged girl!  Might I suggest a good Shaman?  A little ritual here and there should help you through the teen years.

chatpoints.chat_text: That won't be necessary, I've survived her older sisters, I can survive one more.

replies.reply_text: Well, good luck.  I'll stop by again on my next trip through the jungle.

chatpoints.chat_text: We don't have a special ceremony for the girls, but when a girl comes of age she recieves a special necklace from the women of her family.

replies.reply_text: Well, it seems like you have everything under control, see ya next time!
Ooo, I love traditions!  Can I see the necklace?

chatpoints.chat_text: I do not have the necklace yet, it must be specially made for the girl.

replies.reply_text: Hmmmm, do I sense a quest coming?
I'm sure you'll have the necklace finished in time.  Bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: I need to get Mtomka's made by a very special person, I hate to be a bother, but could you help me?

replies.reply_text: I'd love to help, but I really don't have the time right now.  I'm sure you'll find someone to help you.
Sure I could. where do I have to go?
All right, Ring Isle it is!  I'll be back as soon as I can.

chatpoints.chat_text: That's all right, we all have our moments.  I asked you to go see Lapis Maki on Ring Isle.

replies.reply_text: Lapis Maki on Ring Isle......Oh yeah, I remember now!  I'll be back in a jiffy!

chatpoints.chat_text: Do you have Mtomka's necklace?  Can I see it?

replies.reply_text: Sure, here it is! (You hold up the necklace for Nomasonto's approval.)
Awww, what a pretty polly.  Thank you and I hope Mtomka likes her coming of age necklace. Bye bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: Welcome, traveler!  What has brought you into our village?

replies.reply_text: Just passing through.  Nice village, though!
Treasure hunting, got any? (Manco looks startled!) Just kidding, sorry. Bye!
Nana Knutkake in town told me that you are starting a walnut business for your village, is that correct?
I'm sorry, I wandered off to watch the jungle creatures.  Are the walnuts ready?  This will be a good venture for you, I'm sure.
I'm here looking for Karina.  Have you seen her?

chatpoints.chat_text: It might be, stranger.  Why do you ask?

replies.reply_text: I represent Hansel and Gretel's new Cloud Isle bakery, and they are looking for suppliers. Do you think you would be able to handle this large an order? (You show Manco the supply list.)

chatpoints.chat_text: That wouldn't be a problem, and you say they're opening their bakery on Cloud Isles? (You nod.) Good, makes delivery easy!

replies.reply_text: Very well, then.  Here's a letter of credit from Hansel.
Oh, sorry, it's simple, really. Just sign a copy, and I'll take the signed copy and the shipment back with me to the bakery.
And this looks like the beginning of a beautiful relationship! Goodbye!

chatpoints.chat_text: That I have.  She talked to us all about our fashions, and then wanted to take a look at some local animals.  I told her the temple would probably be a good place.  Check there.

replies.reply_text: The nearest one, I assume?  I'll go see if I can find her.  Thanks!

chatpoints.chat_text: Good day, sir.  How are you enjoying our island?

replies.reply_text: This place is fascinating. So much to see and explore!
What? Enjoy this place? No way! I am just trying to find my way back to the dock.
It's pretty nice.  I'm actually here looking for someone.  Karina?

chatpoints.chat_text: Glad you are enjoying it. Perhaps you could join me in a game of mancala?

replies.reply_text: No thanks, I would like to finish exploring.
Sounds like fun. Perhaps I can come back when I finish my current exploration.
Sure!  I would love to.  The rocks are beautiful.

chatpoints.chat_text: I look forward to seeing you then.

replies.reply_text: Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: That they are.  My other board is also quite beautiful, but it has been lost.

replies.reply_text: That's awful!  Do you know what happened to it?
That's too bad.  You know, I really should be going.  Sorry.  Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: I sometimes play my wonderful game while out in the woods.  It is nice to have a change of scenery.  I lost it the last time I was out.  A large animal frightened me and I left without grabbing my board.  When I went back, I couldn't find it.

replies.reply_text: A large animal?! I'm outta here. I sure don't want to meet any large animal! ( Run out the door.)
I'll go look for you!  It will let me see more of this neat isle!
Great!  I'll get right on that.  Bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: Welcome back!  How did the search go?

replies.reply_text: Not great.  I haven't found it yet.  I'll go look some more.
Where was I looking again?  I plum forgot.
I found your board...  but, umm...  it's broken.

chatpoints.chat_text: By an ancient stone statue northwest of here.  I was playing a game when something large frightened me away.

replies.reply_text: Oh, right.  Your mancala board.  I'll go look now.
Yeah it is.  I'm pretty busy, though.  Sorry.  Have fun trying to fix it!  Bye.
Can I help you get it fixed?  It looked like a lovely board and I'd love to see it in one piece.

chatpoints.chat_text: Hello again.  You wouldn't be able to help me get my beautiful mancala board fixed, would you?

replies.reply_text: Sure, I can do that for you.  What do you need me to do?
No thanks.  That sounds like a lot of work.  Good luck though!

chatpoints.chat_text: Of course!  That would be great help.

replies.reply_text: Wonderful.  What do I need to do?

chatpoints.chat_text: Xamba made this one for me.  If he can't fix this one, he'll be able to make me a new one.  I don't know how much he will charge though, so I will pay you when you return.

replies.reply_text: All right.  I'll do that for you.
Xamba?  Umm..  I'll probably get lost in this jungle looking for him.  Sorry.  I guess I won't be able to help.
Umm..  yeah..  sure.  I'll be back as soon as I can.
Istha-huh?  I guess I'll just start wandering and I'll find him at some point.

chatpoints.chat_text: Welcome back, traveler.  How did the trip to Xamba's go?

replies.reply_text: I haven't been there yet.  I'll go do that now.
Why was I going there again?  How do I get there?
Xamba had to make a new board for you.  Here!

chatpoints.chat_text: You were going to get my mancala board fixed.  Xamba is located on the farthest west isle that is connected to the main Jungle Isle by two isthmuses and another that connects to a smaller chunk of land.  I'm sure you will find him without a problem.

replies.reply_text: Thanks for the memory jog.  I'll head there now.
Thanks!

chatpoints.chat_text: Welcome back, young traveler.  Thank you again for making the trip to get this beautiful board completed for me.

replies.reply_text: You're welcome!

chatpoints.chat_text: Ah, yes.  She stopped by my hut yesterday.  I haven't seen her today, though.  Best to ask some of the other residents.  They should be able to help.

replies.reply_text: Thanks!

chatpoints.chat_text: Hello, hello, hello!  Come in!  Come, come.

replies.reply_text: Umm...  Uh...  You have a little too much energy for me.  I think I'll just go.
I will.  Thanks!  Wow!  These instruments are really neat!  Did you make them all?
Hi.  I brought Halian's mancala board that you made.  It sort of, well, broke.  Would you be able to fix it?
Hi there, Smiddy wanted me to bring you these plans and to see if you could make a frame for this sign?
Hi.  I need a drum and french horn made.  Would you be able to help me out?
I'm back with the materials needed for the drum!
Have you finished the drum yet?
I know you can't make a french horn, but do you know anyone that might be able to help me?
Harmony in Soaring Meadows was looking to buy a new clarinet.  She said she has an account with you?
Have you found the clarinet molds yet?
I have these clarinet molds that you made.  Did you want them back?
Did you finish the clarinet yet?
I have clarinet reeds for you, too.
Sandy finished the clarinet keys.  He said it was a pleasure to work with you again.  I brought your molds back, too.
Hi!  Can you fix this old bucket to match its style?
Thank you, I came by to see if you could make this fish for me. (You show Xamba the photo.)
Here's a new one for you, Xamba. I need to have a shield made.
Hi Xamba, what all did you need to make that shield again?
I'm back with all the materials for the shield!
Hello! Is the shield done yet?
I'm back with all the materials for the shield!
Hello, Xamba, I have a proposition for you.

Good day, Xamba. I hope you can help me. (You explain about Stacie's misadventure in the jungle and how the nesting dolls fit into each other.) I was wondering if you could create a series of 6 dolls for Kelda to paint?
Just checking to see if you are done yet with those nesting forms?

chatpoints.chat_text: Yep yep.  That I did.

replies.reply_text: That's super neat.  Well, I'll leave you to your work.  Goodbye.
Cool!  What are they made out of?  They look darker than what I'm used to seeing.  The logs around the isles are lighter than that.

chatpoints.chat_text: Aha!  Yes.  They are made from Ebony Wood.  Only found on Jungle Isle.  Special stuff, it is.

replies.reply_text: Oh!  I think I've seen some of that.  Do you need any?  I could bring you some.
Hmm...  Well, I think I'll start collecting it and selling it if it's so special.
For a price I could bring you some.

chatpoints.chat_text: Yes, sure.  Currently I am working on a, hmmm, wind instrument.  Fifteen logs of ebony wood are needed.

replies.reply_text: Fifteen?  That might be a pain.  I don't really want to get lost again trying to find wood for you.  Sorry.
Well, how much are you going to pay me if I bring you some?
That's not bad.  Sure!  I'll find those for you.

chatpoints.chat_text: Ah, I give rewards.  Don't you worry.  Worry not.

replies.reply_text: Umm, all right.  Sure, I'll find you 15 ebony logs.
That's not much of an assurance.  I won't be doing any searching today.  Bye.
Be back as soon as I find enough.

chatpoints.chat_text: Hello, hello.  Ebony wood.  You find enough?

replies.reply_text: Not yet.  I'll go look some more.
I did.  Here you are.
How many logs was I supposed to find?

chatpoints.chat_text: Fifteen.  Fifteen is the perfect amount.

replies.reply_text: Oh, right.  All right, I'll be back soon.
All right.  Good luck.

chatpoints.chat_text: Welcome back. Come in. Come, come.

replies.reply_text: Okay.  How's that instrument coming?  What are you making, anyway?
No thanks.  I should be on my way.  Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: I am making a type of oboe.  Yes yes.  A beautiful instrument.  Just about finished.  Just about.

replies.reply_text: Sounds like it.  Well, I'll leave you to your work.
Neat!  Anything I can help with?

chatpoints.chat_text: Yes!  Of course.  This must be brought to Anika.  She's waiting.  Yes.  Patiently waiting.

replies.reply_text: Sure.  I can do that.
I really hate making deliveries.  Maybe another time.
I'll be back as soon as I can.

chatpoints.chat_text: Hello, hello!  How went the trip?  Well?

replies.reply_text: Great!  Here's the money to pay her bill.
I haven't gone yet.  I'll go do that now.
Where was I going again?

chatpoints.chat_text: Anika lives in Crystalton.  Yes.  Oh!  Don't forget the money to pay my bill.

replies.reply_text: I won't.  I'll be back shortly.
Thanks.  Bye.
Oh, well.  All right.  I guess I can do that.

chatpoints.chat_text: Aha!  My wood.  Did you get my wood?

replies.reply_text: I did.  Here you go.
How much did you need again?

chatpoints.chat_text: Five pieces.  Ebony wood.  Yes, perfect.  That will work.

replies.reply_text: All right.  I'll go get them.
All right. Well, I guess I'll just wait until you get that done. (Wander off looking around.)
Really?  Umm...  all right.  I guess I better go make some money quick.

chatpoints.chat_text: Aha!  All done.  Ready?

replies.reply_text: Not yet.  I'll come back when I'm ready to take it back to Halian.
Yep.
I think so too.  Very nice.  I'll get this to Halian right away.

chatpoints.chat_text: Hmmm, yes, yes. Not an instrument, but I could do this. Ten logs. Ten logs of ebony wood needed.

replies.reply_text: You have got to be kidding!! No - No more. I'm done. I quit!
Ten logs? That shouldn't be too hard to find. I will be back shortly.
Be back soon.

chatpoints.chat_text: Did you get it? Get the wood needed? Ten logs?

replies.reply_text: Oh, right.  That is what I was doing.  I will get right on it.
I did.  I have it right here.
Wow.  Pretty.  Thanks.

chatpoints.chat_text: French horn?  Metal?  Nope.  Never.  Drum.  Hmm...  That I could do.  Yes.  Wood drum.  Yes.

replies.reply_text: Great!  Do you know where I could have a french horn made, though?
Wonderful!  Anything you need from me?

chatpoints.chat_text: Hmm...  Banker Lucie played.  Yes, yes.  She might know.  Ask banker Lucie.

replies.reply_text: All right.  So a banker named Lucie...  I'll go see if I can find her.  Thanks!

chatpoints.chat_text: Of course.  Sure.  Wood.  Always need wood.  Oh, leather too.  Yep yep.

replies.reply_text: All right.  I can get those things for you.  What do you need, exactly?
No way.  She hasn't paid me enough to do this.  Bye.
All right!  I'll go start collecting.
You don't need a leather piece or something for the top of the drum?

chatpoints.chat_text: Nope.  Already have that.  Yep.  All ready with that.  Go now.

replies.reply_text: All right, all right.  I'm off.
Okay.  I'll be back soon.  Bye.
Thanks!
Did you know who might have a french horn?

chatpoints.chat_text: Yes, yes.  No clarinets right now.  I make one with help.  A little help.  You get some things for me, yes?

replies.reply_text: Like what?
Umm...  No thanks.  Maybe another time.

chatpoints.chat_text: Aha!  Good good.  Wood parts I make.  Silver keys?  No.  Molds for keys?  Yes.  You take to Sandy Flint in Appleton.  Yes.  Perfect.  Makes keys and sell reeds, he does.

replies.reply_text: This is starting to sound too complicated.  I'm too busy right now for this.
So you want me to go see Sandy Flint?

chatpoints.chat_text: Aha.  Come back when ready.  Clarinet I will make then.

replies.reply_text: I'll see you later, then.
Sure thing, I'll be back with the wood.  Good luck finding those molds.
Get keys and reeds from Sandy.  I can do that.

chatpoints.chat_text: No, no!  Must bring these to Sandy in Appleton.  He gives you keys and reeds.  Bring back everything after.  Yes, after Sandy is finished.  Perfect!

replies.reply_text: Sandy in Appleton, that's right.

chatpoints.chat_text: No, no!  The five wood parts, yes.  But also need keys and reeds.  Talk to Sandy Flint, yes?

replies.reply_text: Sandy Flint, I remember now.
Yes, I have a box of reeds, too.  I had to go to Barrett Braunbag for those.
Maybe I will.  Thanks.

chatpoints.chat_text: No, no!  This is old wood, yes.  Light wood.  Very fine aging!  Hard to match!  This I cannot repair!

replies.reply_text: Well, thanks anyway.

chatpoints.chat_text: Can't.  Can't now.  Too busy.  Too many instruments, yes.  Sorry.

replies.reply_text: I understand, I guess I'll keep looking.  Bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: A shield, you say? Yes?

replies.reply_text: Yes. Yes indeed. (<i>You explain Spike's specifications, leaving out the bit about the winged bear- you only want to explain that one once.<i>)
That's a bit of a list. I'll get to work!

chatpoints.chat_text: Five pieces of ebony wood, three pieces of leather, two leather straps, two large buckles, and $3000, yes yes!

replies.reply_text: Right. On it!
Thanks Xamba! I'll be back.
Thanks Xamba! I'm off to see a painter about a winged bear...
Thanks! I'll be back.

chatpoints.chat_text: Propsition?  Hmmm  proposition?  What proposition?  Something I'll like?  Hmmm?

replies.reply_text: Well Iona over in Flipperton wants to hold a Founder's Day Crafts Festival.  She's hoping you can attend and display your work.  Here's your invitation.
Very good, I'll let Iona know.  Thank You, Xamba.

chatpoints.chat_text: Hmm...  A challenge.  Yes yes.  Quite the challenge.  Not for everyone!  Nope!

replies.reply_text: Wonderful! So you can do this? I suppose you need me to bring you some ebony logs?

chatpoints.chat_text: A friend just brought me a cord of the logs, so we are good there. Yes, I can do this for Kelda. I have much respect for her and her craft.

replies.reply_text: Sounds great! I'll be sure to tell her that.  In the meantime maybe I'll check out some of those jungle caves I noticed. I'll see you in a few days!

chatpoints.chat_text: Aha!  Yes yes.  All complete.  Definitely  challenge.  Fit together perfectly, they do!

replies.reply_text: No charge? Sweet! Thank you so much and I'll be sure to tell her.

npc_list.name: Ruthie
npc_list.admin_description: NO NEW QUESTS--hire her some help.
npc_list.short_description: The owner of the Last Roundup Ranch
npc_list.long_description: Ruthie is a small, round woman with striking red hair. Her face is very careworn, and there is something about her weary smile that you instantly like.  Unfortunately, at the moment, she is in a wheelchair, her left leg in a heavy cast.

chatpoints.chat_text: Hello there!  Welcome to Last Roundup Ranch.

replies.reply_text: Hello!   Good to be here.  But... I don't see a ranch anywhere...
Ruthie!  Did you know, I think there's been a shipwreck on Haven Island!
Hi, Ruthie.  What was I doing again?
Ruthie!  I'm back from searching the rocks.
The horses are all doing fine, Ruthie.
I have some Lucky Horse Hay with me.
Hi!  I never got the treats for your other two horses.  Could I get them now?
Neat place you have here.  Well, I should be going.  Bye!
Ruthie!  I found something in the rocks!
Ruthie!  I found something that might be useful!
Hello there, Ruthie, how are things going over here?
Ruthie!  Guess what?  There's a stranded Martian on Nonesuch Isle!  Can you please send me there again?
Hi Ruthie! I know this is going to sound odd, but have you ever seen any odd riddles around here?
Hi Ruthie.  I saw that shipwreck, but I can't remember if there was anything else I needed to do.
Hey there, Ruthie! I thought I'd pay you a visit to see how things were going with the horses.
Hi there, Ruthie, I've totally forgotten what Old John looks like. Could you remind me so that I can recognize him when I go to visit?
Hey Ruthie, I totally forgot what I was bringing back for you. A rubber something?
Ruthie, I'm back with the apples!
Ruthie, could you remind me of the order in which I should feed the retirees their apples? I don't want to cause a kerfuffle or ruffle any feathers out there.
I'm back with the red rubber ball!
Ruthie, you'll never guess what just happened!
Hi Ruthie, I just came back from acquainting myself with John!
Hi Ruthie, I just got back from feeding all the horses.
Hey there, Ruthie! Bruno sent some apples for you!
Hi Ruthie! Er, I don't mean to comment, but your hair looks rather in a state of disarray...
Hi Ruthie, what was I doing for you?
Hi Ruthie! I'm back with a baseball cap for Old John.
HI Ruthie! What was I doing for you?
Hi Ruthie! Old John loved that ballcap!
Hi there, Ruthie.  Say, could you send me to Nonesuch Isle again?
Hi, Ruthie!  Any shipwrecks wash up lately?

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, the ranch isn't here.  I should have said, "Welcome to the Future Home..." But you're here now and welcome.

replies.reply_text: Thanks.  I think I'll have a look around.
Right... but... this is an awful small island to have a ranch on, isn't it?

chatpoints.chat_text: No. Please, have a seat. I'm not making myself clear, am I? Sorry, I just have so much work to do, I'm kind of tired.

replies.reply_text: I can see that.  I'll leave you to it, then.
I take it you've got a story to tell, then!  I'd like to hear it!

chatpoints.chat_text: As you wish.  Goodbye.

replies.reply_text: Goodbye.

chatpoints.chat_text: Would you?  Well, you see, I used to work at a very large stable.  Very busy, lots of people and horses coming and going all the time.  It was maddening.

replies.reply_text: I can imagine it would have been!
I'm sure this is all very interesting, but I've really got to go.  I've got plants in the oven and I've got to water the cake.

chatpoints.chat_text: I needed a break, and some quiet.  But I couldn't leave because there were, also at this stable, a number of old, retired horses who could no longer work.  But they loved me, I could tell, and I didn't want to leave them.

replies.reply_text: So you stayed on, just to make sure they were happy?  You are a gem!

chatpoints.chat_text: Yes, I did.  And then, all of a sudden, I got a small bequest from a relative I never knew I had.  And I knew just what to do with it!  I bought this island, and the larger one across the bridge.  Got a great deal on them, because the sea here is so high that most boats don't want to come.  Lots of shipwrecks.  Some talk of treasure, too, like that'd ever happen.  Anyway. Then I bought those old horses, and I brought them here to live out their days in peace.

replies.reply_text: That was wonderful of you!
That was nuts of you!  I'd have bought an established ranch and just used that, rather than go through all this work!

chatpoints.chat_text: I thought of that.  But I would have been right back where I was, and think of having to move these poor old horses to a new barn that was just as busy!  So I came here.

replies.reply_text: And then?

chatpoints.chat_text: And then I built the bridge, and one day when I was moving the last horse across the bridge, the horse panicked and kicked me, and broke my leg.  He'd never been on a bridge before, I think, and he just spooked.

replies.reply_text: So you haven't been able to take care of the horses for all that time?!
I can see where this is going!  I think I'll just leave now.  Bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: Not for a few days.  But they're okay.  There's a nice pond and plenty of grass.  But still, I can really use some help!  I don't suppose...

replies.reply_text: Say no more!  My horses, companions and I are at your service!
No.  Really, I've got to be going.  Sorry about your leg and all...  Bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, that is absolutely splendid of you!  Let me think of what I need done.  In the meantime, there are four horses on the ranch now, and you should probably get to know them.

replies.reply_text: Okay.
I'll try to keep them all straight.
And the other two?
You're welcome.  Goodbye!
While I was out searching, I noticed something--there may have been a shipwreck!
Thanks.  I'll get this over to them now.

chatpoints.chat_text: Come back when you're done and tell me how it went.

replies.reply_text: I will!  See you later!

chatpoints.chat_text: You were giving treats to my four retired horses on Haven Isle, across the bridge, weren't you?

replies.reply_text: Oh.  Yeah, right.  Okay.
Here's another bale.
That's all I've got, I'm afraid.

chatpoints.chat_text: Goodbye, then!

replies.reply_text: Goodbye!
I'll be back when I have some Lucky Horse Hay!  Goodbye!
It just so happens that I have some on hand!

chatpoints.chat_text: A shipwreck?  Really?  Tell me what you saw!

replies.reply_text: Well, it wasn't really much of a shipwreck, just some debris...

Down on the very southern tip of Haven Island, where all those rocks go out right into the sea, I found many large planks, and a life-saver; and the tide is coming in, so there may be a great deal more to follow!

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh.  Well.  That's a rocky area, there's always something going on, I suppose.

replies.reply_text: Yeah, right, it is.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, no!  The poor sailors!  Please run back there now, and see if you can find any survivors.

replies.reply_text: I doubt there are any, after all... and I really should be going now.
I'll do that right away!  If I find anyone, can I bring them here?
I'm on my way!
Glad to help!  I'm looking forward to seeing that museum!  Looks like you've got a good start here already.

chatpoints.chat_text: Hello again!  Tell me what you found!

replies.reply_text: Well, I didn't actually find anything worth saving.
I found a few wooden planks!
I found a bucket and some rope.
I found a small box of golden doubloons!
That's all there was.
They should dry out nice and straight.
And this is a nice, roomy bucket, too.  Well-made.
Thanks!  Glad to help!  Goodbye!

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh well.  The sea is pretty rough out that way, it's not surprising.  Well, thank you for all your help.

replies.reply_text: You're welcome.  Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: Go check for survivors, of course!  And... I know it sounds crass to say this, but if you find anything in the wreckage that could be used on the farm, even ropes or planks of wood, please bring that, too!

replies.reply_text: I'll take a look.  Bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: Just splendidly, thanks to all your help!  Say!  If you're looking for adventure, I saw the strangest thing yesterday!

replies.reply_text: Adventure?  Oh, good grief, no!  Just came to visit.
Sure!  I love adventure!  Twisty little passages all alike, long low rooms....

chatpoints.chat_text:
Nah, you're talking about Colossal Cave! No! See that island just east of here? Bare little place. Only thing on it is plovers.
Well, yesterday I hear this great whoosh! and I saw this fireball land right on that isle! Ever since then there's been weird noises and flashing lights! I'd love to go over and take a look but... Oh well, would you do it?

replies.reply_text: Oh, no!  Not me!  Thanks for the tip anyway, but I'm not feeling adventurous today.
Sure!  Sounds interesting, but... how do I get there?
Yes, indeed!
No, I think I'll pass, but thanks anyway.

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, as a matter of fact, long before I was able to buy this place, I had come to visit it and there was an odd writing on one of the trees.

replies.reply_text: Really? Which one? The apple tree behind your house? Must be the one! I'm sure of it.
Oh, goody! Point me the way. I can't wait to see it.
That sounds like a long time ago. Speaking of that, I've been playing for a long time now. Time for me to take a break. Bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: It was on a tree that stands right where the cabin does now. I guess it must have been cut down at some point.

replies.reply_text: Oh! Well, I tried.  I guess that's that. Guess I'll just go and visit the retired horses, then.
What?! Do you happen to remember any of what it said?
Well this sounds like a dead end. Darn it.

chatpoints.chat_text: Why yes. I was so intrigued that I wrote it down. But speaking of intrigue, why did you think to ask about it?

replies.reply_text: I'm following a trail of clues for Demetrius. I'd love to see what you wrote down.
Maybe later. I just remembered I should be somewhere else right now.  Bye!
Darn. I've got chores to do. But I'll be back. I'm sure of it!

chatpoints.chat_text: A trail of clues? How exciting! Let's trade clues! I'll send your clue back to Demetrius. I owe him a letter anyway. I bet he'll get a kick out of knowing you got this far.

replies.reply_text: It's a deal!
Hmmm. I think I better hold on to this for now. Looks like its time to go eat. I'll come back to trade clues with you when I have a bit more time. Bye!
Okay, thanks! I better get to looking for that. Bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, pretty well, pretty well! Looking forward to spending some more time with them once I get out of this contraption. (Gestures at the wheelchair.) We have a new addition to the ranch, though!

replies.reply_text: Oh, yeah? Well, tell me more, tell me more!
Yeah? That's cool. Your ranch seems ideal. It's so peaceful out here.

chatpoints.chat_text: His name is John, and he's a very neat horse. He did all sorts of things in his youth- started out racing, then became an eventer, then did dressage, decided he didn't like it, showed as a hunter, and then foxhunted. And now he's come here for a well-deserved retirement!

replies.reply_text: Wow, he sounds like an old pro! Could you tell me about all of those events he did- I'm not sure I'm familiar with them all.
Sounds like the kind of horse anyone would want! How's he settling in?
Cool horse!

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, racing I'm sure you know about; it's a competition to see who's the fastest horse. The tracks where John was successful were all grass, instead of sand, so he was a "turf racer". Three-day eventing is the ultimate test of a horse's fitness. They have to do a dressage test, then jump cross-country, then show off their power and speed in a show jumping class.

replies.reply_text: Yes, dressage, what is that?
What's the difference between show jumping and show hunters?
Foxhunting... isn't that cruel to the foxes?

chatpoints.chat_text: Dressage is a demonstration of the horse's flatwork- his discipline and training schooling maneuvers in the ring, without jumps. At the high levels, it's almost like ballet!

replies.reply_text: Oh, I see! How about show jumping and show hunters, how are they different?
Gotcha! How about foxhunting? Isn't that, well, awfully mean to the foxes?
So John did all of that? Wow! And now he's come to a life of relaxation! How's he settling in?

chatpoints.chat_text: Show jumping is entirely objective- it's a competition to see which horse can jump around a course the fastest without knocking any rails down. They do that in Earton a lot! Show hunters are subjective and they're evaluated on the judge's impression of which horse seems to have the best jumping style and the best manners. Think of it as like hockey versus figure skating.

replies.reply_text: Oh, I get it! Now foxhunting... isn't that mean to foxes?
And how about dressage?
So John did both of those- he must have been a great jumper in his youth! He's certainly earned his retirement. How's he settling in?

chatpoints.chat_text: It used to be, but these days, in this area, foxhunting is more an excuse for people to go out cross-country with their horses. Many packs will do drag hunts instead, where the hounds follow an artificial scent a human has placed down.

replies.reply_text: Oh, I see. I'm glad no foxes are harmed in the making of this pastime. How about dressage, what's that?
I get it now. I love foxes, I'd hate to see them hurt. How about show jumping and show hunters, how are they different?
So John did all of that? No wonder he's come here to be retired, this is the best place on all the isles to reward a good horse like that! How's he settling into his new home?

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, I haven't seen much of him yet. I wheeled myself across the bridge the first few days he came to see how he was getting on, and he was grazing by himself, but I just can't get myself over there every day. It's hard being alone out here in this chair.

replies.reply_text: Why don't I go check on him for you and let you know?
I bet. I hope you get out of it soon.
Sure, I'll go check on him and report back.

chatpoints.chat_text: He's a big, dark bay gelding- roaning around the eyes, but no white otherwise. Please let me know how he is.

replies.reply_text: Sure thing!

chatpoints.chat_text: How is he doing? Has he made friends with the others yet?

replies.reply_text: Well, not exactly. I got the impression he was lonely.
Right-o!

chatpoints.chat_text: You were bringing back a big red ball from Ollie Scooper- a big dog toy. Oh, and five apples.

replies.reply_text: That's right!
Well, I already showed you the apples.  I'll go get the rubber ball, though.  Bye!
Will do!

chatpoints.chat_text: First Kate, she's the boss. Then Dude, then Decaf, then Ellie, and John last. Most dominant to least dominant. Otherwise you'll find them crowding you!

replies.reply_text: Okay, I'll remember it this time!

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, I see it! That should be right about the right size! Do you have the apples, also?

replies.reply_text: Yes, I brought them with me.
Oh, I brought those by earlier. You told me to feed the horses.
Well, I did, except the horses ate them!
No, I don't have them yet.

chatpoints.chat_text: Hmm...

replies.reply_text: Sure, I'll do that.

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, have you?

replies.reply_text: Not yet- I thought I should bring the ball first. I'll go off and do that, then!
Not yet. Could you remind me in which order I should feed them all?

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, grand! My, this is huge! Take it over to John and see what he makes of it. You see, where I used to work, a lot of the horses liked to play with an old rubber ball. They would play as a herd. Maybe my herd will do that, too.

replies.reply_text: Will do!

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, go get the apples first. I think this will go better if you intrigue the horses with food first. Come back to me when you have the apples.

replies.reply_text: Okay, will do.

chatpoints.chat_text: You were going to give it to John. See what he makes of it.

replies.reply_text: Okay, I'll do that. (Walk off, thinking to yourself, "What on earth would a horse do with a rubber ball?")

chatpoints.chat_text: And what was that?

replies.reply_text: Well, I gave John the ball and he started nosing it around- and then Kate came up and kicked it, and then all the other horses did, too! They're practically playing football out there!
Sure thing! Thanks, Ruthie!

chatpoints.chat_text: Everyone happy out there?

replies.reply_text: Yes, they liked the apples. Now what was it that you needed from Ollie Scooper?
Yes, they liked the apples. What am I to do with this red rubber ball?
I'll tell him! Hope you and the horses enjoy the apples!

chatpoints.chat_text: I should say it is! That newest retiree of mine, Old John- well, I wear a baseball cap whenever I'm out with the horses to keep the sun off my face. And wouldn't you know what that horse did? Took it straight off my head and ran off with it!

replies.reply_text: Oh jeez! Did you get it back?
He stole your... wow, this sounds very like a story I heard in a livery barn a long, long way away from here. Anyway, did you get the hat back?
Well, I hope he enjoys it. You may never get it back...

chatpoints.chat_text: Yes, I finally got him to drop it. Wily old thing. But it got me thinking. It is actually his birthday today. So I thought I'd get him a baseball cap to play with. Do you think that's strange?

replies.reply_text: I don't think it's too bizarre. He obviously likes to play with them. Maybe I could go get it for you as a present to the old fella.
Uh... that's a little kooky for me, yes.
Sure, I'll be back in a flash! Maybe two flashes. Or three. Anyway, I'll be back.

chatpoints.chat_text: You were going out to buy Old John a white baseball cap.

replies.reply_text: Okay. Off I go!
Sure, I'll take it out to him.

chatpoints.chat_text: You were taking that baseball cap you bought out to Old John.

replies.reply_text: Oh, that's right. Off to the field!
Actually, I did that, and he took off like a flash with it! He really looks like he enjoyed his present.
Glad to have helped!

chatpoints.chat_text: Hi!  Can't stop to talk now, but no, haven't seen anything, but I haven't been looking.  Feel free to look around Haven, stuff usually washes up on the southwest end.

replies.reply_text: Thanks!

npc_list.name: His Majesty Phil I
npc_list.long_description: This guy is a king?  Short, dumpy, balding and gruff, he'd be better as a taxi-driver or deli owner.  He looks like someone who has a sense of humor--and knows what it is for.  He looks rather like Grey Slate.

chatpoints.chat_text: (A young man in purple livery precedes you into the residence, and in a loud, clear voice announces) A visitor from the Far Islands, My Lord!

replies.reply_text: Your Majesty, I bring you the crown made for you by Grey Slate.
Your Majesty, I am ready to go back to Grey Slate now.
Your Majesty, I am ready to go back to Grey Slate now. (As you speak, a number of the white creatures in the room come up and sniff you carefully.)
Hail, Your Majesty!
Uhm... Hello?
If it pleases Your Majesty, I would like to return to the Hare Isle.
Hi!  I'm back!
Your Majesty, I was sort of wondering about your island here.
Your Majesty!  I am here on behalf of Candide, who wishes to reclaim his Golden Sheep!
Your Majesty, I have returned with the bagels and knishes you requested!
Your Majesty, I seemed to have missed where you said the sheep was....
My Leige, I come bearing gifts!!
Your Majesty, may I please be sent back to the Chocolatier Royal?
