replies.reply_text: Pirates!

chatpoints.chat_text: Pirates...  Okay.  I'll have to look around.  I'll go down and look.  Anyone comes in here, stomp on the floor, I'll come up.

replies.reply_text: Will do.

chatpoints.chat_text: (<i>Harry wanders off down a set of stairs under a trap door in the back.  Through the straw-covered wooden floor of the alley, you can hear boxes being shifted, and a raspy voice singing, "When the foeman bears his steel..."<i>)

replies.reply_text: (You look around at all the horses in the barn, who look back at you as if considering what goodies your pockets might contain.)

chatpoints.chat_text: (You hear the sound of boxes being shifted, and an angry cat hissing.)

replies.reply_text: (You begin tapping your feet. Outside, your own horse looks at you crossly.)

chatpoints.chat_text:
(After a great deal of time you hear, "A-HA!" and once more, Harry comes lumbering up the stairs. He has some clothes draped over his arms as he walks up to you.
Well, it's not a hoop skirt, exactly. But it'll do for the period. Here's a captain's uniform. Just put some more gold on it, it'll do. Just bring 'em back.

replies.reply_text: Bring them back?!

chatpoints.chat_text: I'd like 'em back.  Had 'em a while.

replies.reply_text: Well, there's a problem.  These are going to be used by pirates.  They're not really known for giving things back.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh?

replies.reply_text: So how about I just buy them from you?  How much?
But I'll do my best to get them back for you, I promise.  And if I can't, I'll pay you for them.
Oh well, I tried.  Thanks so much for your time.  Goodbye.

chatpoints.chat_text: No, if it's really those pirates... Well, I'd rather you just buy them.

replies.reply_text: Okay, how much do you want?

chatpoints.chat_text: $500 for the lot.

replies.reply_text: No, sorry that's too much.  I've already spent enough on this venture.  Thanks for your help, though.  Bye.
Okay, $500 it is.
I hope she likes these!  Thanks a lot!  You've been a great help!  Goodbye!

chatpoints.chat_text: What can I do for you?

replies.reply_text: (You explain about Mino's plans, and his need to enrich the sandy soil.)

chatpoints.chat_text: You've come to the right place! The stuff I have is well seasoned, so he won't have to worry about burning plant roots. Give me a minute and I'll grab a couple of bags for you.

replies.reply_text: Thanks. I'll stay right here.
Thank you so much! I'm sure Mino will be pleased.

chatpoints.chat_text: Maggie had 4 kittens, but they're all red tabbies.  No white ones.  Sorry.

replies.reply_text: That's okay.  I'll keep looking.  Bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: If that’s what you call it, I think so.  I found it this morning stuck to the fence rails spooking the boarded horses every time one of its arms flapped about!  But I thought it was a very funny thing and put it on the side of the barn where the wind can grab it and keep the arms flapping!

replies.reply_text: Well, Rodney is the uh, owner of the blue guy, and uh… he needs it back.  Any chance I could give it back to him?

chatpoints.chat_text: Sure, kid.  Just head to the side of the barn look up high and you'll see it.  I might have to get one from him in the future... Ha ha ha, it sure is a funny-looking thing, don’t you think??

replies.reply_text: Yes, funny.  So funny that I have to run my horse around all over the isles, talking to a million people, and catching the wacky things…

chatpoints.chat_text: Sorry. Someone came by earlier and cleaned me out.

replies.reply_text: Rats. Okay, thanks anyway.

npc_list.name: Paul Paddock
npc_list.long_description: A young man who just took over his father's business, Paul looks a bit overwhelmed.  But he is upbeat and eager, and will do well for himself down the road.  He keeps the barn tidy and quiet, and the horses here all seem quite happy.

chatpoints.chat_text: Hello, welcome to Treeton Livery.  I'm Paul Paddock, the manager.  What can I do for you today?

replies.reply_text: Just passing through, thanks.
Hi.  I've come on behalf of Sumiko Stallman.  She's setting up a new Riding for the Handicapped Center and needs some things.
Hi there. I was wondering if you could help me with a surprise Mino is planning.
I was wondering if I might buy some empty feed sacks from you?
Well, I was actually wondering if I could do something for you.
You could remind me what I was doing for you!
I come dragging a pony- did the other two make it back here okay?
I was doing something for you, right?
Hi Paul, all's well in the neighborhood- Cara Caravel has her quadrant back, and there's a little girl whose attitude was immensely improved by a cookie.
Hey there, Paul. I was wondering- someone saw a pony take off up the road towards here, did one of the ponies happen to come back on her own?

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, that's wonderful!  What kind of things does she need?

replies.reply_text: Right now she's looking for water buckets and feed tubs for the barn.  Anything old that you don't need.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh!  I'm so sorry, I just sold all the old stuff a few weeks ago.  Everything here is new.  Sorry I can't help now, but maybe later on?

replies.reply_text: No problem.  Thanks for your time!  See you soon!

chatpoints.chat_text: Mino? What's he up to?

replies.reply_text: (You explain Mino's plans, and his need to enrich the sandy soil.)

chatpoints.chat_text: I'm so sorry. Everything I have is fresh. That would burn the roots of anything he tries to plant. Why don't you try some of the other stables?

replies.reply_text: Thanks, I will. See you around.

chatpoints.chat_text: Sorry. I've got a project in mind that's going to use up all I've got. Did you try the other barns?

replies.reply_text: I will. Thanks, and good luck with your project!

chatpoints.chat_text: And I'm sure she's very upset about it, but... would you mind tracking down the ponies first? I'm worried they'll get into worse trouble.

replies.reply_text: Sure, no problem. Once I've found all three, I'll return Carolyn's quadrant to her.

chatpoints.chat_text: Well... that depends. Are you any good at tracking down lost... things?

replies.reply_text: "Things"? What kind of things?
All sorts of things! Things that thing, things that don't thing, thingy things... I'm a pro.
I'm actually terrible at it.

chatpoints.chat_text: By "things" I mean "ponies," or at least I think I do. I have three Shetland ponies, Devie, Angel, and Tigerlily. They're sort of like the livery mascots- if only because I can't find any children that actually like them. I'm afraid they haven't any manners. Anyway, they all got out of their paddock last night and went haring off and I have no idea where they went. Could you track them down for me?

replies.reply_text: Sure. Detective Me is on the case! Any idea where they may have gone?
Off I go!

chatpoints.chat_text: You were helping me track down my three bad ponies!

replies.reply_text: That's right, I was.
Oh, that must be Carolyn's quadrant. I'll go return this to her. I think I owe a little girl a cookie, too... someone seems to have eaten it.
Oh, that must be Carolyn's quadrant. I'll go return this to her.  Good thing I already brought Spike her cookie.

chatpoints.chat_text: Yes, as a matter of fact. (He points towards the back of the barn, where a little Shettie nose is peeking out above a stall door.) Came back on her own, she did... have you found the others?

replies.reply_text: Not yet. I'll keep looking.
Actually, yes, I have.
Oh, is that the pony that took Carolyn's quadrant? Can I have that to give back to her?

chatpoints.chat_text: Thanks. When you come back from doing that, I'll give you something for your time.

replies.reply_text: Great, thanks.
You're very welcome! Keep those gates shut!

chatpoints.chat_text: You were delivering that... quadrant thing... back to whomever it belonged, and you said something about a cookie?

replies.reply_text: Oh, that's right.
Oh yeah.  I already bought the cookie and gave it to Spike, so just the quadrant left.

npc_list.name: Inigo Webster
npc_list.short_description: A metal worker on Jungle Isle

chatpoints.chat_text: (Inigo walks in from the back room to greet you.) Hey there. How's it going?

replies.reply_text: Hi. What is it that you do here?
Hi, Rapunzel sent me to ask you to make a special hair piece for her.
Hi, I am back with the ore you wanted for Rapunzel's hairpiece.
Is Rapunzel's hairpiece ready for pickup?
Hi, Grey Slate sent me with a question for you.
What did you need for the menorah again?
I'm back with the iron and copper.
I'm back with the glass piece for the middle of the menorah.
Is the menorah ready yet?
Who was it again that does the glass work you wanted?
Hello.  You said you needed something for the middle of the King's menorah?
Great!  I came by because I've got a proposition for you.
Everything is great!  I could use a little help though..
Everything is great! But, I've got a bit of a problem and could use your help
Things are looking up, my friend! I need a set of new cymbals and I was hoping to barter for them.
I've got the 50 pieces of copper that you needed to make the cymbals.

chatpoints.chat_text: I basically make art with metal.

replies.reply_text: Art with metal? That sounds weird, and I don't think I want to know any more about it. Bye.
Really? That sounds neat! How do you do that?

chatpoints.chat_text: I mostly use copper sheets that I buy, and then use a lot of different methods to create designs on them.

replies.reply_text: That sounds really fascinating - and I love the designs I see here.

chatpoints.chat_text: Thanks! These are all commissioned pieces, so they aren't available for sale, but if you come back another time I may have some others available for sale.

replies.reply_text: Sounds good. Maybe I'll stop in when I am over this way again. Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: She did? Well, I can make something up for her. What did she have in mind?

replies.reply_text: She has a lot of hair so she is looking for a hair piece that is made of metal and is intricate and elegant. She wants it to be able to be woven into her braid.

chatpoints.chat_text: I think I know just what to make for her. It will be a long copper hair piece that will run the length of her hair and have prongs or teeth the hair can be woven around. I will need a few things, though.

replies.reply_text: She didn't tell me I would have to get things for you.  Nevermind it then. Bye.
What things would you need?

chatpoints.chat_text: For something like that, I have all the chemicals, but I would need 20 pieces of copper ore.

replies.reply_text: That's a lot of ore - which means it's a lot of bother. I think I will help Rapunzel another time.
Twenty pieces? That may take a while to collect. I will come back when I have it all.
I will be back with the ore soon.
Okay.  I will be back later for it.
I will take it to her right now. Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: A question, eh? Well, go ahead with it, then.

replies.reply_text: King Phil has asked Grey Slate for a menorah for his throne room - before Chanukah. Grey Slate doesn't believe he can make one suitable and wonders if you can?

chatpoints.chat_text: A menorah? For King Phil's throne room? That would have to be pretty large, then. (Inigo goes behind the counter and starts sketching a design on a notebook that appears to be there just for this purpose.)

replies.reply_text: Looks like this could take a while.  I think I will just do this when I have more time. Bye.
Grey Slate said it should be tall and slightly gaudy.

chatpoints.chat_text: Gaudy? No, I don't do gaudy. But I believe I know what he means, and with just a few more lines (He adds a few more lines to the design and turns it to you) and there. How does this look to you? (You are looking at a very tall menorah with a solid metal bottom and vines that seem to flow upward to form a beautiful metal frame. There is an open space in the middle and 9 candleholders on top.)

replies.reply_text: Wow!! That is amazing. You can make that here?
Wow! It's going to take a lot of work to make that - and from experience, I know that means a lot of travel for me. So, I'll just go now and forget this foolishness.

chatpoints.chat_text: Yes, I can make this here, and see this empty space in the middle? I have an idea of what to put there that will make it just perfect for King Phil. But first things first - I need some supplies.

replies.reply_text: I knew this would happen! Uh uh, I am outta here.
What things do you need? I can get them for you.
I'll be back with your supplies soon. Bye.
Depends on what you need for the middle of it.

chatpoints.chat_text: I would like something made by Nicolette on Snow Isle. She does amazing glass work!

replies.reply_text: Another place to go? No way.  I am just outta here.
I guess I can go there. Should she just make what she wants, or do you have something specific in mind?
I'll be back later, probably much later. Bye.
I will be back in a bit. Oh, and by the way, Nicolette said thank you for giving her the opportunity to show off her craftmanship to royalty.

chatpoints.chat_text: I need 20 iron ore and 20 copper ore.

replies.reply_text: That's right.  I'll go and get them now. Bye.
I'm going to deliver this now.  Thanks.

chatpoints.chat_text: Nicolette in Chillton on Snow Isle.

replies.reply_text: Great, thanks. I will head that way now.

chatpoints.chat_text: A proposition? You've piqued my interest.  What is it?

replies.reply_text: Well Iona, over in Flipperton, wants to hold a Founder's Day Crafts Festival.  She's hoping you can attend and display your work.  Here's your Invitation.
Increasing your market is always a good thing.  I'll let Iona know you've accepted the invitation.  Bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, what seems to be the problem?

replies.reply_text: I need to get this brass bell fixed up.  Can you fix it?
(<i>You hold out the bell and clapper<i/>) Can this be repaired?

chatpoints.chat_text: I don't usually work with brass, and I'm really busy right now, I think there is a guy on the main island who can help.  Ask around.

replies.reply_text: Okay, thanks for the suggestion.  See you next time!

chatpoints.chat_text: I think I can do that for you. I'll need to mix up some bell bronze. For that, I'll need copper and tin. I've got some tin, but I'll need some copper pieces. If you can get me those, I'll be happy to make the cymbals.

replies.reply_text: I can do that. How many do you need?

chatpoints.chat_text: 50 pieces of copper ore should do it.

replies.reply_text: I'll be right back!

chatpoints.chat_text: Perfect! Give me a day or two to get the work completed.

replies.reply_text: Sounds good. I'll see you in a day or two.

npc_list.name: Miguela Pommel
npc_list.long_description: Miguela is strong and proud, and most definitely the master of all she surveys--at least, within her store.

chatpoints.chat_text: Bienvenida.  How are you today?

replies.reply_text: Fine, thanks.
Hi.  I've come on behalf of Sumiko Stallman.  She's setting up a new Riding for the Handicapped center and needs some things.
I say, I see you have quite a large variety of tack cleaning and maintenance supplies.
I'm fine, but I am trying to find someone who spent some time here in Witherton... A master roofer named Olav, ring any bells?
Estoy bien, gracias. Say, what is that you're doing?
Estoy muy... how do you say "determined"? I want to take another try at your quiz please.
I'm fine, thanks.  By any chance has Archy picked up the saddle soap yet?
Fine, thanks, Miguela.  Sorry to ask again, but where was Archy going after he left here?

chatpoints.chat_text: No, nothing like that here.  It sells very quickly when it comes in.

replies.reply_text: Okay, thanks anyway.

chatpoints.chat_text: Yes, absolutely.  Everything from the common to the very exotic, for those who are very particular about the care of their tack.  Is there anything specific that you want?

replies.reply_text: No, not today, thanks.
There is, actually.  Do you happen to have cheesecloth?

chatpoints.chat_text: Cheesecloth?  Of course!  Cheesecloth is often used especially to polish leather tack. It's $100 a pack, and a pack contains a dozen cloths.  How many would you like?

replies.reply_text: Oh, none, actually, I was just wondering, really.  Bye.
Just one pack, I think.
Great!  Thanks a lot!  Bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: Olav? He did some work around here a long time ago, but he left and I haven't heard from him since, sorry.

replies.reply_text: That's okay, I'll keep looking, thanks anyway!
All right, I'm ready!

chatpoints.chat_text: I'm preparing a quiz. The Horse Isle Pony Club rally is next week, and I'm helping them study. In Pony Club it's important to know all about horses and their care. As a tack shop owner, I'm quizzing them on their knowledge of tack.

replies.reply_text: Oh, neat! Could I try the quiz?
That's nice of you to help them.

chatpoints.chat_text: I can't see why not. How about this. You give me $1,000 now. At the end of the quiz, if you get through it, I'll give you $50,000. But if at any point you're wrong, you'll have to start over with $1,000 again. How does that sound?

replies.reply_text: That sounds fair. (Hand her $1,000.)
Maybe another time. I changed my mind.

chatpoints.chat_text: Let's start with the most basic types of equipment. When riding, you sit in this.

replies.reply_text: Bridle
Seat
Girth
Saddle
Boots

chatpoints.chat_text: Precisely! This item of tack cushions your horse's back, absorbing impact from the saddle.

replies.reply_text: Bridle
Shock-absorber
Pad- or as they say it in some places, numnah!
Cloth- or as they say it in some places, wooly!
Girth

chatpoints.chat_text: Yes, exactly. This piece of headgear provides communication with your horse's mouth.

replies.reply_text: Halter
Hackamore
Bridle
Headcollar
Martingale

chatpoints.chat_text: Yes, the bridle. And this metal piece affixes to the bridle; it is the piece that goes in your horse's mouth.

replies.reply_text: Bit
Stirrup
Bat
Bars
Mouthpiece

chatpoints.chat_text: Correct, the bit. This piece of tack is like a belt around your horse's barrel. It holds the saddle in place.

replies.reply_text: Belt- not everything has a special name!
Martingale
Girth
Strap
Cinch

chatpoints.chat_text: Right. Depending on whether you ride English or Western, you might call it a girth or a cinch. Now we're going to get a little more complicated. This leg wrap is used to protect against mild impact. It offers very little support.

replies.reply_text: Standing bandage
Pillow wrap
Spider bandage
Polo wrap
Saratoga bandage

chatpoints.chat_text: That's right. I'm trying to weed out potential false answers still, so this question will have more possible answers- think carefully! If you wanted more impact protection, you would instead use these. They buckle or snap around the legs and can be made either of leather or of synthetic material. This specific type wraps all around the cannon bone.

replies.reply_text: Open front boots
Bell boots
Brushing boots
Full boots
Splint boots
Galloping boots
Wrap boots
Coverage boots

chatpoints.chat_text: Yes, exactly. Galloping boots, splint boots, and brushing boots are different names for the same thing. If you wanted a piece of tack to protect against damage to the coronet band, or to help prevent your horse from stepping on his heels if he steps up well behind, you would use what kind of tack?

replies.reply_text: Bell boots
Coronet boots
Heel boots
Overreach boots
Strike boots

chatpoints.chat_text: You're right, bell or overreach boots. If your horse tends to lift his head to avoid the action of your hands, you might use this piece of tack, which connects to the noseband, to prevent him from doing this.

replies.reply_text: Running martingale
German martingale
Breastplate
Yoke
Standing martingale

chatpoints.chat_text: Right, a standing martingale. Now, if you were in a jumper class, or if your horse needed more freedom of motion than a standing martingale provides, you would instead use what related piece of equipment that attaches to the reins?

replies.reply_text: German martingale
Running martingale
Yoke
Tie-down
Breastplate

chatpoints.chat_text:
Well done, it is called a running martingale. Because it provides more freedom of motion than a standing, and because it allows the horse to raise his head farther for the sake of his balance, it is legal in jumper classes whereas a standing is not.
Since you've done so well, I'll offer you a bonus question. If you get it right, you can have an extra $1000. If not, though, you won't be able to try it again. What do you say?

replies.reply_text: I say I'll give it a try!
Whew! I had enough trouble with that one. I don't think I'll be trying again, but thanks all the same! Good luck to the Pony Clubbers!

chatpoints.chat_text: This piece of equipment is called a martingale as well, but unlike the other styles, it does not help to keep the head down. Instead, it is used to keep the reins on opposite sides of the neck. What is it called?

replies.reply_text: German martingale
French martingale
Spanish martingale
Scottish strap
Irish martingale

chatpoints.chat_text: Very good, it is an Irish martingale. It is useful if, say, you take an unscheduled dismount and try to bring the reins with you. Well done! Here is the $1,000 you were promised.

replies.reply_text: Thanks Miguela! Tell the Pony Club kids I wish them good luck!

chatpoints.chat_text: No, that's not right. It's called an Irish martingale. You would see it used in horse racing; it is useful if you take an unscheduled dismount as it keeps the reins from coming over the horse's head and getting tangled. Nice try, though!

replies.reply_text: Bummer. Oh well, hope the Pony Clubbers do better than I did on that one!

chatpoints.chat_text: No, that's not correct. Maybe you'll try again.

replies.reply_text: Darn, all right...
He said he had something for Kyleigh?  Looks like that's my next stop. Muchas gracias!

chatpoints.chat_text: You are never a bother!  Archy went to Kyleigh's to drop off a gift for her.

replies.reply_text: That's right, Kyleigh, next to the bank.  Thanks, Miguela!

npc_list.name: Stephen Saddletree
npc_list.long_description: Stephen Saddletree is the ultimate man-about-his-work.  His shoulders are slightly hunched from much study and detailed craftsmanship, and he has eyes that look at you with curiosity and quiet appraisal.  Like the rest of his shop, his clothing smells of leather and polish... and horses.

chatpoints.chat_text: G'day to you.  What brings you up this way?

replies.reply_text: Just looking, thanks.
I'm looking for some used tack for Sumiko's Riding for the Handicapped center in Appleton.  She needs halters with leads and child sized saddles.
Hi Stephen. Yorick sent me.
I have a special package for you from the Pony Express!

chatpoints.chat_text: Mmm.  No, I don't think I have anything suitable right now.  Sorry.

replies.reply_text: Okay, thanks anyway. Bye now.

chatpoints.chat_text: Great - let me guess! Time for hockey practice?!

replies.reply_text: Yep. It starts in two weeks.
I will - I am on my way back to drop everything off now. Bye.
Thank you, sir, and good luck with the soap!

npc_list.name: First Little Pig
npc_list.admin_description: Before house is blown down
npc_list.short_description: The Resident of a Straw House
npc_list.long_description: The First Little Pig is glowering at you from a door that he is holding open (or, perhaps, just in place) with some effort against the wind.

chatpoints.chat_text: (Snort! Grunt!) Hello, yes?

replies.reply_text: Hello, uhm... Just passing by.  Bye!
Your brother, the Third Little Pig, asked to me tell you something.
Hello again!  Just stopped by to see how things are going.  Awfully breezy up here...

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, says you!

replies.reply_text: No!  Really!  I know he usually sends Wilson, but Wilson is missing!  Your brother can't send him to warn you about the Big Bad Wolf!
What nerve!  Oh well, I tried.

chatpoints.chat_text:
Suppose it is. Come in. Want some tea? Don't have any. Want some sympathy? Don't have--
(Suddenly from outside comes a fell voice!)

Big Bad Wolf: Little Pig, Little Pig, let me come in!

replies.reply_text: (Without even thinking, you reply:) Not by the hair of my chinny-chin-chin!

chatpoints.chat_text:
Holey Moley! (As the pig stands before you, paralyzed with fear, the wolf's voice calls:)

Big Bad Wolf: Then I'll huff, and I'll puff, and I'll blow your house in!

replies.reply_text: You're on your own, little fella!  G'bye!
Come on! Hurry! Get up here! On my horse! Sit behind me! Come on!
Let's go!

chatpoints.chat_text: With a great whoooosh! the wolf blows down the First Little Pig's straw house! You, he and your horse only just manage to get away in time!

replies.reply_text: We'd better go warn your brothers!

npc_list.name: Second Little Pig
npc_list.admin_description: No More Quests--use next pig.
npc_list.short_description: The resident of a Stick-built Cabin.

chatpoints.chat_text: Why, hello there!  Come in!  Come in!  What brings you to my cloud?

replies.reply_text: This whole cloud is yours?
I'm just passing through, thanks!
Hello!  Your brother in the brick house asked me to come find you!
Help!  Let us in!  The Big Bad Wolf just blew your brother's house in!
Hello!  Can I ask you an enormous favor?  It's for Grandmother Hood.
20 Strong Skinny Sticks?

chatpoints.chat_text: No, I suppose not.  But it's fun to think of it that way, don't you think?  Here, come sit.   What brings a... "landlubber" like yourself up here visiting pigs, eh?

replies.reply_text: I'm looking for Spider-Pig...
I've just come to see what's up here.  This is a very nice cloud.

chatpoints.chat_text: Tsk!  Spider-Pig is just a fairy tale!

replies.reply_text: Yeah, well... hee hee!   Anyway, I like your house.

chatpoints.chat_text: Yes, it is a very nice cloud.  And a very nice house, too.  I built it myself.

replies.reply_text: Is it... uhm... wolf-proof, by any chance?

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, yes, certainly it's wolf-proof.  And even if it weren't, I can always rely on my brother, the Third Little Pig, to warn me if you-know-who is up to anything.

replies.reply_text: Well, that's good to know.  I should be going now.  Thanks for your hospitality.
Actually, I wanted to talk to you about that.  Your brother in the brick house asked me to tell you that Wilson is gone, and he can't warn you about the wolf anymore.

chatpoints.chat_text: Not at all, dear!  Goodbye, and do come visit anytime!

replies.reply_text: Bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: My brother did? But... you don't look like Wilson...

replies.reply_text: No, no.  I'm not Wilson.  Wilson the Pixie is gone.  Your brother sent me to warn you that he couldn't warn you that... anyway...

chatpoints.chat_text: Well.... welllllll, yes.  Yes, of course.  Thank you for your efforts on my behalf.  Good day to you.

replies.reply_text: Okay.  Bye!
Are you absolutely, positively sure this house will hold against the wolf?
Okay, bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: The... Big Bad... Oh, dear!  Do come in!  I'll bar the door!  Sit down right there, I'll put the kettle on.  Lucky you brought him here!

replies.reply_text: We got away just in time! Now, you're absolutely sure this place is wolf-proof?
Well, I'm glad he's here safe.  I'll be going now.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, yes!  Absolutely!   Filmore, didn't I tell you to build with sticks and not with straw?  Well, I hope now you've learned your lesson!

replies.reply_text: I think you both should have built with bricks!
I think you're both nuts.  I'll leave you two to work it out.  Bye now!

chatpoints.chat_text: Bricks?  Oh, really!  That would be going overboard, don't you think?  Bricks!  Bah!

replies.reply_text: I don't know; he blew down that other house pretty easily!

chatpoints.chat_text:
Well, Filmore's house, honestly! What do you expect!
First Little Pig: Look, Percy--

replies.reply_text: I don't want to hear it!  Personally, I think you should both go to the Third Little Pig's house and--

chatpoints.chat_text:
Too late...
(From outside comes a fell voice:)

Big Bad Wolf: "Little Pig, Little Pig, let me come in!"

replies.reply_text: Not by the--oh, never mind!  Come on, you two!
Well, if you think it's safe here, goodbye!  Nice knowing you!

chatpoints.chat_text:
It's just a wolf!

Big Bad Wolf: "Then I'll huff and I'll puff and I'll blow your house in!"

replies.reply_text: I don't believe this! Come on! (In a sudden panic, the First Little Pig jumps on your horse; you pull up his brother and gallop away as the stick house comes crashing down around you!)
Go, horse, go!

chatpoints.chat_text: Grandmother Hood, you say?  Well, I suppose so.  What would you like?

replies.reply_text: It's about this birthday party for her granddaughter.  It's supposed to be a surprise, only the kid's left early and Grandmother's not ready.  So if she comes by here, could you please, just... stall her for a while?
Oh, forget it.  Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: Stall that... and listen to all that... All right.  I will.  Under one condition, horse rider.

replies.reply_text: No!  Those are in short supply anymore.  Sorry, no.  Bye.
All right.  I'll do my best.  I'll see you later!

chatpoints.chat_text: Yes, indeed!  Have you got them?

replies.reply_text: No... just checking... Later.
Here they are.
Thanks.  That will help.  Gotta run, bye!

npc_list.name: Third Little Pig
npc_list.admin_description: New Quests must start at CP20
npc_list.long_description: The Third Little Pig is keen and confident.  He looks at you directly and honestly.

chatpoints.chat_text: Hello there.  Welcome.  Would you like to come in?  It gets cold up here, you know!

replies.reply_text: No thanks.  Just exploring.  Bye.
All right, thank you.
Looked everywhere, Mr. Pig.  No sign of Wilson.
I'm back, Mr. Pig!  I did as you asked!
Hello again!
Help!  Let us in!  The Big Bad Wolf just blew your brothers' houses in!
Hello, Mr. Pig,  can you please help me with Red Riding Hood?
I've got your stuff.

chatpoints.chat_text: What do you think of my home?

replies.reply_text: I like it.  Very cozy and comfortable.
Isn't it awfully close to the Big Bad Wolf?
How do you get the clouds to hold up the bricks?!  I mean...
I looked everywhere, Mr. Pig.  No sign of Wilson.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, I'm not worried about him!  He can't get me in here.

replies.reply_text: You're sure about that?

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, yes.  You know, they say he's brighter than he looks.  And maybe he is, but I feel perfectly secure here.

replies.reply_text: Because of your brick house, right?

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, yes.  The brick house.  And old Wilson.

replies.reply_text: Wilson?

chatpoints.chat_text: Didn't you meet Wilson?  Don't tell me he's not out there doing his job!

replies.reply_text: You're nuts.  Goodbye, and good luck.
Sorry, I didn't meet anyone outside your house.  Who is Wilson?

chatpoints.chat_text: Wilson!  The Pixie.  My factotum, you would say.  Not very bright... well, not bright at all, really.  Well, actually he's uhm... quite a pest.  But he does let me know when B. B. Wolf is around so I can run inside.

replies.reply_text: Nope.  Didn't see any pixies anywhere.  Well, I'm sure he's just gone to gather pixie dust or some such.

chatpoints.chat_text: Gone?  Gone?!  He hasn't gone anywhere in at least a year!  Oh, dear.  Oh, dear!   Go outside, will you, and look around the house and see if you can find him?

replies.reply_text: Okay.  Calm down, I'll go find him.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh. Pixie dust.

replies.reply_text: Oh.  Well, gotta go.  Bye!
I see.   So you don't mind being this close to the Wolf, then.
Okay.  Don't worry, I'll be back.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, dear.   Without Wilson, I must be a siege prisoner in my own abode!   If B.B. Wolf should find out I am here without Wilson... Oh, dear.

replies.reply_text: There are plenty of pixies up here, judging by the amount of pixie dust.  Can't you just hire another one?
Well, I'm sure you'll manage.  After all, you're a big pig now.  See you around!
I don't suppose there's any point in asking the wolf to just... leave you alone?

chatpoints.chat_text: (The Third Little Pig gives you a withering frown.)

replies.reply_text: I didn't think so.

chatpoints.chat_text: Alas, you cannot just go out and get a Pixie. They... become attached to you, quite on their own. (The pig gives a shrug as if that were not all that good a thing!)

replies.reply_text: Well, good luck with all that. I'm afraid there's nothing I can do for you.
Is there anything I can do to help?

chatpoints.chat_text: Do?  Do?!  Well, if you could convince B.B. Wolf to move off these clouds, I suppose that would be something, but you can't do that, of course.  There is something you can do.  Warn my brothers!

replies.reply_text: The pig in the straw house and the pig in the wooden house?

chatpoints.chat_text:
(The pig looks up at you quizzically.) How did you know that? Are you psychic?
...Oh, well, nevermind, I suppose it's good that you do know. I can't send Wilson to warn them when the Wolf is abroad anymore, so if you'd please let them know, I will be forever grateful.

replies.reply_text: Well, at least until you have to leave your house again.
I'm on my way.  I'll come back and let you know when I've told them all, so you'll know.  Goodbye!
Well, I hope that warning was enough, until you manage to find another pixie.  Goodbye for now!

chatpoints.chat_text:
Blew what? Oh my! You can't all come here, why, there isn't room!
First Little Pig: Oh, shut up, Quincy, and get out of the way!
(The First and Second Little Pigs dive into their brother's house, slamming the door behind them.)

replies.reply_text: Well!  That's gratitude for you...
(You lean in the window.) Will you guys be all right in there?

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, I suppose so.  We'll just light a fire in the fireplace to discourage the old flea-bag from coming down the chimney.

replies.reply_text: You're not worried about him coming through the windows?
Nuts!

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, hello there!  Our hero returns!  Thank you for saving my brothers from the wolf, we're forever in your debt.

replies.reply_text: You're welcome!  Just came by to see that all was well!  Goodbye, then!
Say, have you by any chance seen Little Red Riding Hood today?
Twenty strong, skinny branches and 10 hay bales, was it?
Hi there, Quincy!  How are you?  Anything you need?
I'm back!
You're welcome.   I was just wondering if I could do anything more for you.
I'm back with the right bricks!
I was doing something for you, wasn't I?

chatpoints.chat_text: Why, no, we have not.  Should we have?

replies.reply_text: Not really, but if she does come by here, could I ask you fellows to please keep her here for a while, while her Grandmother gets her birthday party ready?

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, dear... Well, I'll tell you what. I really do need to get my brothers out of my house! So, I'll trade you a favor for a favor! If you will go and get me 20 strong, skinny branches for my second brother, and 10 bales of hay for my first brother... neither of whom seems to have learned his lesson... I'll keep that... dear child here for a while. Agreed?

replies.reply_text: No!  I'd have to go all the way back... No.  Thanks anyway.
Oh, all right.
I'm on my way.

chatpoints.chat_text: Yes, exactly!  Have you brought them?

replies.reply_text: Yes, I have them here.
No, just making sure that's what you wanted.  I'll get them now.
Awesome!  Thanks so much!  Bye, now!

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, well, hello there! Thank you for rescuing my brothers--and thank you especially for getting them out of my house! Do come in! Anything I can get you? Anything at all?

replies.reply_text: Hi, Quincy, I'm back!
Actually, I was going to ask you that.  Is there anything I could pick up for you while I'm wandering around?
Thanks, but I can't stay; I was just passing by and thought I'd say hello.  Goodbye!
Hi there, Quincy!  How are you doing now that your brothers are out of the house?  Anything you need?
I'm back!
Nope, I can't think of anything you'd be able to help me with. I was just wondering if I could do anything for you.
I'm back with the right bricks!
I was doing something for you, wasn't I?

chatpoints.chat_text: Not that I can think of right at the moment, no.  As you see, I have a very comfortable home here.  Very comfortable indeed.

replies.reply_text: Glad to hear it.  I'll be on my way, then...

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, you know, there is something, if you don't mind too terribly much.  Of course, I don't want to put you to too much trouble...

replies.reply_text: Well, what is it?

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, really, what I would genuinely love is some books to read!  I used to get down to the Tropicton library, and Marianne the librarian there had the most excellent taste!  But alas, what with one thing and another...

replies.reply_text: I can go get some books for you, if you like.  Any particular topic of interest?
Uhm... No, I'd kind of rather not.  See you around!
I'll be back when I've got the books.  I won't be long!

chatpoints.chat_text: Hello there, dear friend.  Did you bring me books from the library?  What did Marianne pick out for me?  I can't wait to see!

replies.reply_text: Here you are!
Oh, no!  I knew there was something you wanted me to do!  I'll be back!  Sorry!  Bye!
Oh, that's right!  Which library was it again?
Glad you're happy!   I'll leave you to your reading, then!  Goodbye!

chatpoints.chat_text: Go see Marianne at the Tropicton library.

replies.reply_text: I'll go now.  Bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, yes, there is something you could do for me, actually. You see, my porch is starting to look a little crumbly, so I decided to get some bricks and fix it up. A crumbly-looking porch makes the whole house look crumbly, don't you agree?

replies.reply_text: Uh, sure. Can't have a home that looks crumbly. Just won't do. What exactly do you need me to do? Find someone that makes mortar mix?
Nope, your house looks just fine to me. See you later!

chatpoints.chat_text: No, no, I already have all the mortar I need. I just need the bricks. (He points outside, frowning, at a pallet loaded with what looks like bricks to you.) There's been a slight mix-up in orders, I believe.

replies.reply_text: Pretty sure you have your bricks, so there's no reason for me to hang around anymore. Have fun fixing your porch!
What's wrong with what you have? It looks like you already have everything you need.

chatpoints.chat_text: What's wrong with what I have? What's wrong with it?! Those aren't your average bricks out on that pallet! They're adobe! My house is made out of those red bricks you see everyday, not those adobe ones! Would you bring those things back to where I got them and get what I ordered?

replies.reply_text: Yikes! I think I'll scram before you start throwing those adobe bricks at me!
Uhm, okay, sure. Who do I bring those back to?
All right, I'm on my way!

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, I hope they're the right bricks. I'd like to get started on my porch today!

replies.reply_text: Take a look for yourself! They match your house perfectly. Oh! The Postmaster also sent along his deep apologies and wanted you to know that he is ashamed for making a mistake like that.
I'm glad everything worked out for you. Thanks for the great reward!

chatpoints.chat_text: Yes, you were. You were returning those adobe bricks to the Postmaster General and getting my red bricks from him.

replies.reply_text: That's right, I remember now! I'll get right on it.

npc_list.name: Nilla
npc_list.long_description: A lively squirrel who makes her home in the jungle trees.

chatpoints.chat_text: (The squirrel nods her head enthusiastically, then seems to look at you expectantly.)

replies.reply_text: I'm sorry, I don't have any walnuts to give you. Good luck, though.
I don't mean to intrude upon your space, but I'm trying to get to that tree behind you.

chatpoints.chat_text: (The squirrel seems to take a minute to come to a decision, and then boldly holds up a walnut. You see several more walnuts piled behind her.)

replies.reply_text: Ahh, I see. Well, I'll just let you get back to your collecting.
I didn't know squirrels liked walnuts!

chatpoints.chat_text: (A lively squirrel stands before you, nose and tail twitching.)

replies.reply_text: Well, hello there, little squirrel! What are you doing out here in the jungle?

chatpoints.chat_text: (The squirrel suddenly looks menacing. You get the distinct feeling that if you dare to come closer, she will be pleased to show you the business side of her teeth.)

replies.reply_text: Uhh.. Nice squirrel, easy there, now... I'm going, see? Bye!
Look, I'm sorry, but it's really important that I get to that tree. I promise not to bother your collection.

chatpoints.chat_text: (The squirrel doesn't look the least bit swayed. She actually begins to advance toward you, and you swear you can hear a tiny growl issuing from her tiny mouth. You very nearly begin to laugh.)

replies.reply_text: Okay, I get the picture, I'll be going now.
Look, little squirrel, you need to get out of the way so that I can get to that tree. (<i>You walk up to the squirrel and push her out of the way.<i>)
Maybe we can come to an understanding. If I give you some walnuts, can I get past you?
Gah! Take it easy, silly squirrel! I just need... a little.... there! So long, squirrel!

chatpoints.chat_text: (The feisty little squirrel takes one look at your return, and immediately threatens to attack if you come any closer.)

replies.reply_text: Aaah, not you again! I'm leaving!
All right, squirrel, attack me if you wish, but I'm getting to that tree!

chatpoints.chat_text: (The little squirrel suddenly looks extremely pleased with your presence. She nods her furry head with enthusiasm.)

replies.reply_text: Great! How many would you like?
Bah, stop it, silly squirrel! Just let me get... a little more..... there! This had better be enough this time!

chatpoints.chat_text: (The happy little squirrel seems to take a moment to think, and then thrusts out both hands, fingers spread as far apart as they will go.)

replies.reply_text: Ten? That's too many, I'm sorry. Goodbye.
Ten walnuts? That shouldn't be too hard.
I'll be right back.

chatpoints.chat_text: (The squirrel looks up at you with bright, hopeful eyes.)

replies.reply_text: Oh, yes, I was bringing you 10 walnuts, I forgot. Be right back!
I have your walnuts right here!
Thank you very much! Enjoy your walnuts!

npc_list.name: Pecos Bill
npc_list.long_description: No doubt he was the rootin'est, tootin'est cowboy once, but perhaps he's retired now.  He's sun-worn and work-hardened, and taking a much deserved rest.

chatpoints.chat_text: (SKZZX! xyzzy...) What? Hunh? (The old cowboy yawns and rubs his eyes.) Howdy there, pardner!

replies.reply_text: Howdy!  Don't bother waking up, I'll be on my way.
Howdy!  Who are you, if you don't mind my asking?
I'm back, Bill.
Bill! I've got Widow-Maker! (You hand the feathery lasso over to Bill, while Widow-Maker snorts glumly.)

chatpoints.chat_text: Mind?  Dang!  I don't mind at all!  Pecos Bill's the name.  I'm sure you've heard of me!  I'm a legend all over the Wild West.

replies.reply_text: Nope, never heard of you.
You're the real Pecos Bill?  The Pecos Bill who was raised by a she-coyote?

chatpoints.chat_text: Yup!

replies.reply_text: And who once rode a tornado for fun?

chatpoints.chat_text: Carved out the Grand Canyon!  That's me!

replies.reply_text: The only cowboy who could ever ride the great bronc, "Widow-Maker"?

chatpoints.chat_text: (Pecos Bill hangs his head.) Well, yup. That sure used to be me.

replies.reply_text: Aw, sorry to hear it.  Well, you can still take credit for falling off a thundercloud and creating Death Valley!  Bye!
Uh oh.  What happened?

chatpoints.chat_text: It's Widow-Maker!  He's gone!  It was like this.  My gal, Slue-Foot Sue, she bounced on her hoop skirt clear up to the moon!  So I reckoned, if I get ol' Widow-Maker riled enough, he'd buck me up to her, y'see?

replies.reply_text: Yes?  And then?

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, Ol' Widow-Maker, he got to buckin' and kicking so hard, we ended up all the way up here! Well. I got off to find me some grub. And he went over to that... circle yonder, and next thing y'know, I hears, "POIT!" and he done fall down it!

replies.reply_text: Of course he did!  Those are teleporters.
Sorry to hear that. Maybe he'll "poit" up again one of these days. Bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: Tele-what?  Well, anyway, I ran to the hole, an' I put my ear to it, and I heared a gallopin, an' a faint "poit!" an Ol' Widow-maker, he was gone!

replies.reply_text: That's too bad.  He could be anywhere.  I don't want to get involved.
Well, you could go down the teleporters and find him.

chatpoints.chat_text: Me go down one o' them things?  Not on your life!

replies.reply_text: Aw, come on!  You're Pecos Bill!  You've used rattlesnakes as lariats!  You've ridden mountain lions!  You--

chatpoints.chat_text: --No matter what, I ain't a-gonna go down that there sparkly hole!  I'm brave, remember, not dumb!

replies.reply_text: Oh well, I guess you'll have to find another horse, then.  Bye!
Well, my horse and I do it all the time!  How about if we go find Widow-Maker for you?

chatpoints.chat_text: You would?  Why, that'd be right decent of you, and I'd be much obliged!

replies.reply_text: Sure thing.  We know he... "poited" through two teleporters, so I know roughly where he is.  Is there any trick to catching him?

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, let me think here.  You know, he's right wild.  But if you could distract him...  Maybe sorta mesmerize him with something pretty or sparkly... then I expect he might let you get a rope on him.

replies.reply_text: Hmmm!  Let me think about that.  But I'll need a rope... and preferably not one made of rattlesnakes!
Nope, on further consideration, I think I'll pass.  Goodbye.

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, you could take this here rope.  But it'll need some gussyin' up.

replies.reply_text: This is fine, but... what will I use to... "gussy it up"?
"Gussy"?

chatpoints.chat_text: "Gussy up."  You know, to get dressed all fancy-like.  To make yourself up all purty or handsome.

replies.reply_text: Oh, well, what will I use to... "gussy it up"?
That just seems crazy.  I'm not doing this.  Good luck!
Okay, will do.  Bye for now!

chatpoints.chat_text: Howdy there!  Got me ten o' them Sparkly Feathers?

replies.reply_text: Sure do.  Here they are.
Oh... Yeah, that was what you wanted.  Ten sparkly feathers.  I'll be back.
Thanks!  I'm off to find Widow-Maker!  Wish me luck!
You're welcome!  And thanks for the reward!  Bye now!

npc_list.name: Widow-Maker
npc_list.admin_description: before being caught.
npc_list.long_description: Widow-Maker looks like he certainly deserves his name!  His eyes, one brown and one blue, seem to stare wildly out of their sockets, and his ears swivel almost too quickly to see!  He never stands still, not even for a moment, and he bucks and kicks for no apparent reason...

chatpoints.chat_text: (The wild bronco rears and snaps, and glares wildly at you!)

replies.reply_text: Easy there, fellow!  Easy now!  Look what I've got!
Come on, boy.  Let's go.

npc_list.name: Widow-Maker
npc_list.admin_description: After being caught
npc_list.long_description: Is the old buckin' bronc happy to be reunited with Pecos Bill?  Who could possibly say...

chatpoints.chat_text: (Widow maker gives you a murky glower and prepares to kick.)

replies.reply_text: All right, be that way.  Bye.

npc_list.name: Dursley
npc_list.long_description: The crab looks like some ancient fossil laying there on the sand. You wonder if it is even alive. You step closer to see....

chatpoints.chat_text: I'm having a rough day here, getting slapped in the face by wave after wave, having to hang on for dear life so I don't get washed away with every surge of salt water. You'd be a grouch, too!

replies.reply_text: Did you ever think that maybe you should live on the other side of the island?

chatpoints.chat_text: Excuse me! Can you watch where you put your feet? Use your eyes, Dude! There are living creatures down here.

replies.reply_text: Ah! You must be Ebenezer's brother. You sound so much like him. Your sister Charlotte sent me.
Yikes! Sorry about that! I'll just move my feet right on out of here! Is there some reason you are such a grouch?
Sorry! Can you PLEASE call the turtle for me? I'd like a ride off this island.
It seems like there may have been something you needed from me, but I can't remember. Was there?

chatpoints.chat_text: What does she want now? I'm having a rough day here, almost being trampled and stepped on and stomped on and getting slapped in the face by wave after wave. And now SHE wants something?

replies.reply_text: I'm sorry you are having a tough day. All I know is that Charlotte asked me to give this to you. (You hold up the piece of seaweed.) She said it was a message, but I can't make head nor tails of the scratches on this.
Gosh. Such a grumpy crab! I think I'll just check out the island and ignore you for a bit.

chatpoints.chat_text: You tried to read MY message? What a bumpkin! Of course you can't read it. It is written in horseshoe crab script! UGH! You humans are so annoying. Give it here, already!

replies.reply_text: On the annoying? Back atcha, Buddy! Here, take it already! Gesh! Your sister had a much more pleasant temperament. You should hang out with her and learn some manners.

chatpoints.chat_text: (Dursley reads the note, pops down into his lonely hole. Pops back up. Back down. Back up.) So.

replies.reply_text: So? That's it?

chatpoints.chat_text: Argggg! (Dursley scuttles around in a couple of circles, pops down into his lonely hole. Pops back up. Back down. Back up.) It isn't easy being me!

replies.reply_text: I can only imagine. I take it you are having some difficulty. Do you need to ask me for a favor?

chatpoints.chat_text: (Dursley scuttles around in one more circle, then stops.) Yes! Are you happy now? Yes, I need a favor. Arggggg!

replies.reply_text: Fine. What would you like me to do? I won't bother asking you to say pretty please with a cherry on top. I can see that would never happen!
You are just too grouchy to be around! I'm gone like the wind.

chatpoints.chat_text: (Dursley holds up the seaweed message.) Arrrgggg! I need you to take this to Ebenezer. I don't have a chance in 3 blue whales of getting Charlotte what she wants.

replies.reply_text: Oh, was that a 'please' that I heard? Hmmmm? I'm not sure it was.
My goodness you are a stubborn one. Maybe I'll be back to help you some day. In the meantime, why don't you practice being nice!

chatpoints.chat_text: (Dursley uses his tail to flip over on his back, wiggles around and around, then flips right side up.) Arggggh! Fine, fine, fine. PLEASE?

replies.reply_text: Sure. I can do that for you. But I can't believe it is so hard for you to be nice!
Nope. Not in the mood. See ya later, Mr. Grumpy Pants!

chatpoints.chat_text: Scuttle about in my shell for two miles before you judge me! It isn't easy being a horseshoe crab! Sheesh!

replies.reply_text: Alrighty then! I'm off to Ebenezer's. See ya!
Okay. Say, would I be able to catch a ride on that sea turtle from here to there?

chatpoints.chat_text: With pleasure! Leave already! (Dursley clicks his tail against a rock, clicking in rapid succession. There is a large swoosh from the ocean, and there, right in front of you, is a huge sea turtle.)

replies.reply_text: Thanks!

chatpoints.chat_text: (Dursley pops down into his lonely hole. Pops back up. Back down. Back up.) Arggghhh! Humans are so frustrating! You were supposed to take a message to my brother.

replies.reply_text: Oh right! I was doing that, wasn't I? Happy to get back to doing that, as soon as I catch a sea-faring turtle ride!

chatpoints.chat_text: (Dursley clicks his tail against a rock, clicking in rapid succession. There is a large swoosh from the ocean, and there, right in front of you, is a huge sea turtle.)

replies.reply_text: Thank you, thank you!

chatpoints.chat_text: Hmmpft! Live with those noisy Fiddler Crabs? Not a chance! Now bug off and leave me alone!

replies.reply_text: Gladly!

npc_list.name: Dawn's White Horse
npc_list.admin_description: Beaded Periwinkle Shells / Glacier
npc_list.short_description: The White Horse of The North
npc_list.long_description: Standing before you is a magnificent white stallion.  No hint of grey or gold mars his coat, but he shines so brightly that you almost swear he were made of pearl. His mane and tail are long, full and so light that the slightest breeze moves them. His large, kind eyes are the most astonishing amber. Tall and splendid, he gazes down at you with the greatest benevolence.

chatpoints.chat_text: Speak, child.  What is it you wish of me?

replies.reply_text: White Horse of the North, I have come to obtain the mark of speed for my horses.

chatpoints.chat_text: To bestow that gift would mean that I had not already.  But once and just once did I have that to give. Alas, I cannot give this to you. Perchance you'd want a different sort of gift?

replies.reply_text: I don't think so.  I'll go now.
Yes, I do.  Let me offer you this gift.
Thank you!

chatpoints.chat_text: (The White Horse stands proudly, gazing into the distance.)

replies.reply_text: (You decide not to bother the glorious horse.)

npc_list.name: Dusk's Blue Horse
npc_list.admin_description: Aquamarine /Cloud
npc_list.short_description: The Blue Horse of The West
npc_list.long_description: The Dusk's Blue Horse is a great prancing stallion with a coat of pure turquoise. His mane and tail, long, full and tossed about with glee, are purest white.  He has a big blaze and high stockings that that make him all the more splendid.  His eyes are large, and deep brown.

chatpoints.chat_text: Welcome. You've traveled afar. Prey tell, something you seek?

replies.reply_text: Dusk's Blue Horse, I have come to you for the mark of strength for my horse.

chatpoints.chat_text: Bestowed that gift, but once, could I. An offering of significance, tempt me, and repayment shall be made of another kind.

replies.reply_text: Ummm. Nevermind.  I'll go now.
I offer you this Aquamarine Calumet, in return for your favor.
Thank you! (And with that, the Blue Stallion goes back to grazing, seeming to dismiss you.)

chatpoints.chat_text: (The Blue Horse stands proudly, gazing into the distance.)

replies.reply_text: (You decide not to bother the glorious horse.)

npc_list.name: Sun's Golden Mare
npc_list.admin_description: Amber/Desert oasis
npc_list.short_description: The Golden Mare of The South.
npc_list.long_description: Before you stands, proudly and alertly, a magnificent mare of pure, deep gold.  Her coat glimmers, and her long, fine white mane and tail gleam as she waves them in the wind.  Her eyes are dark, and almost blue.  She nickers as you appraoch.

chatpoints.chat_text: (The sun shimmers off the deep gold color of the mare, almost as if the mare were a mirage. The mare looks at you and lowers her head, as if inviting you to speak.)

replies.reply_text: Golden Mare, I have come to ask that you bestow your mark of agility on my horse.
I just wanted to see you.  I'll go now.

chatpoints.chat_text: A possibility long expired. What once I had is now forever gone. Was there something else you've come here for?

replies.reply_text: Uhm... no.  I'm sorry to have bothered you.  Goodbye.
(You decide you've got nothing to lose by offering the Amber Calumet.) I offer you this gift. I hope it is pleasing to you.
Thank you!

chatpoints.chat_text: (The Golden Mare stands proudly, gazing into the distance.)

replies.reply_text: (You decide not to bother the glorilous horse.)

npc_list.name: Night's Black Horse
npc_list.admin_description: Fire opal /Hat Isle
npc_list.short_description: The Black Horse of The East
npc_list.long_description: A stallion of a deep, almost invisible black. Looking more closely, you can see he is a snowflake Appaloosa, with tiny white dots like stars in his coat. His long mane and tail almost remind you of the Milky Way, and his eyes might be bright planets. In motion he is simply stunning.

chatpoints.chat_text: Welcome, child!  You have come a long way to find me here.  What do you wish of me?

replies.reply_text: Nothing, really, just wanted to see if you were real.  I'll go now.
Night's Black Horse, I wish the favor of your mark of endurance for my horse.

chatpoints.chat_text: Alas, I had the ability but once, to bestow that gift. I could gift something different in return for an offering of significance.

replies.reply_text: Nothing.  Sorry.  Bye.
Please accept my offer of this Black Fire Opal Calumet.
Thank you!

chatpoints.chat_text: (The Black Horse stands proudly, gazing into the distance.)

replies.reply_text: (You decide not to bother the glorious horse.)

npc_list.name: Aladdin
npc_list.long_description: Handsome and dark yes.  Tall... not really.  Aladdin sits in his home, tinkering with all sorts of bizarre objects.

chatpoints.chat_text: Ah!  A visitor!  Please, come in and be my guest!  I bring food!  Please, sit.

replies.reply_text: No thanks, just on my way somewhere.
That's very kind of you.  Thank you, I will.
Aladdin, I've returned.
I'm back again with the rubies and wax.
I'm back.
Prince Aladdin, has a young girl in a red riding hood been here in the last, perhaps, hour or so?
Excuse me, your Highness, did you ever perform for parties while wearing a turban and a tuxedo?

chatpoints.chat_text: I hope you are enjoying our beautiful clouds, and all the possibilities they afford one?

replies.reply_text: Oh, yes.  Very much so!  It seems there is everything up here that anyone could possibly want!

chatpoints.chat_text: Yes.  In most ways, it does.

replies.reply_text: Sorry to hear that.  I'd better be off now.  Bye.
Oh?  In what ways is it lacking?

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, nothing very important, you understand.  It's just that my lamp... but it is no matter.

replies.reply_text: Did you really have a magic lamp with a genie inside?

chatpoints.chat_text: (Aladdin looks at you very curiously.) Yes, I did have such a thing, once. A beautiful golden lamp, inside of which lived a powerful djinn.

replies.reply_text: Well, what happened to it?   Was it stolen?

chatpoints.chat_text: Alas,  I was out walking with it at night.  I came too close to the edge of the cloud, and when in my shock I realized where I was, I accidentally dropped the lamp into the sea below.

replies.reply_text: Oh, no!  And those lamps are so rare!  You'll probably never see another one!

chatpoints.chat_text: They are hard to find, yes!  But with the right materials, you can build a lamp that all djinns would envy!  I would do so, immediately; but not all the needed items are available here in the clouds.

replies.reply_text: What do you need?  I'm great at finding things!  I'll get them for you!
No, I'm not up for a scavenger hunt today.  Maybe some other time.

chatpoints.chat_text: Ah!  If you would be so kind as to gather these things for me, I would bestow upon you riches fit for royalty!

replies.reply_text: Excellent.  What do you need first?
I'll be back as soon as I've found everything.

chatpoints.chat_text: Ah!  Good, good.   Let me see what you have found for me!

replies.reply_text: Well, I didn't find it all yet.   What was it you wanted?
Here you are.
I'll get them at once!  Goodbye for now!

chatpoints.chat_text: I require five ores of the purest gold, and five silver linings.

replies.reply_text: Okay.  I'll get them at once!  Goodbye for now!

chatpoints.chat_text: Good, good, good!  Please give them to me!  The five rubies and five honeycombs!

replies.reply_text: Here you go!
Oh--that was what you wanted!  I'm sorry, I forgot.  I'll go get them now!
Good luck with that!  Bye!
You mean, how to get a djinn to live in your new lamp?

chatpoints.chat_text: Ah, yes, exactly!  Getting a djinn to move into this splendid new lamp! Oh, it is a very mysterious process!

replies.reply_text: But you know how to do it, don't you?

chatpoints.chat_text: No, to be honest, I do not know how to get djinn to inhabit magic lamps.  It is a great pity, for you have given me such a wonderful lamp.

replies.reply_text: Oh.
Thanks!  I'll come visit again some time!

chatpoints.chat_text: Ah!  You mean Miss Hood?

replies.reply_text: Yes, your highness.  Has she been by yet?

chatpoints.chat_text: Thankfully, no.

replies.reply_text: Prince Aladdin, she seems to have left before Grandmother Hood got the party set up.  If she comes by here, could you please delay her for a while?

chatpoints.chat_text: Delay her?  You mean, keep her here and listen to all that...blithering?  Are you mad?

replies.reply_text: I'm beginning to think so, yes!   Is there anything I can get for you that would make it worth your while?

chatpoints.chat_text: Ah, that is correct, you, my friend, can go Down Below!  And there is one thing from down below that might convince me to withstand such torture.

replies.reply_text: All right.  What is it?
Those are... nevermind, I'll do what I can.
No thanks, that I won't do!  Those are expensive items!  Goodbye.

chatpoints.chat_text: Ah, my friend the butterfly collector!

replies.reply_text: Hello, Your Highness.  Just stopping by.
You asked for a Blue Morpho Butterfly from Flower Isle?

chatpoints.chat_text: I did.  Do you have the beast?

replies.reply_text: No, sorry; just checking to make sure I knew what you wanted.  I'll get it now.
Yes, your highness.  I have it here.
Thank you, your Highness.  Every minute you can make available will be a treasure to Grandmother.  Goodbye.

chatpoints.chat_text: Prince Aladdin?  Perform at parties?  Have you lost your reason, or did you come all this way only to insult me?

replies.reply_text: I'm apologize, your Highness, I can see that I was too hasty in assuming it was you.  I'll go back and talk to Palila again.

npc_list.name: Princess Lilianna
npc_list.long_description: A beautiful, ginger-haired, young Princess, Lilanna looks like she's become very used to pining at her tower window.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh! (Princess Lilianna pulls herself up in mid-swoon.) Oh. Hello.

replies.reply_text: Hello.  Goodbye.
Hoping I was a prince, were you?
Your Highness. (You bow gracefully.)
I'm sorry, my Lady.  I know I was doing something for you, but I'm having a terrible time remembering.
I brought you those frogs.   Why don't you try and see if any of them happens to be a prince.
Your Highness, I've come in search of a young girl who's gone missing.  Little Red Riding Hood, a resident of these parts?
My Lady!  It's good to see you again!

chatpoints.chat_text: One can always hope...

replies.reply_text: Well, never fear. I am a prince!
Sorry to disappoint you.  Actually, I'm Napoleon.
Sorry to disappoint you.  Actually, I'm just... me.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh. Ha, ha, ha. (The princess returns to gazing out her tower window and sighing.) I suppose it's too much to ask if you might actually, like, know a prince?

replies.reply_text: I know a king...
Alas, I don't.

chatpoints.chat_text: Who, Uncle Phil?

replies.reply_text: Oh.  I guess any son of his wouldn't do, then.
My Lady, I am a Knight of the Realm!  But I suppose I will not do...

chatpoints.chat_text: I should say not!

replies.reply_text: Sorry.  Other than that, I'm afraid I don't know any royalty.

chatpoints.chat_text: (The princess closes her eyes and dreams.) Some day, my prince will come! I mean, after all this time, I'm willing to... like... hah! I'm willing to kiss frogs if I have to! And frogs are so, like... slimy!

replies.reply_text: You know, now that I've come to think of it, I may have seen a frog or two up here.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, really?  Have you?  Go and fetch me some at once!  Three will suffice. I shall reward you handsomely for one who turns out to be a prince!  Go!

replies.reply_text: Yes, your Highness.  I'll go at once.  Any particular frogs you're interested in?
Who do you think you are, a princess?

chatpoints.chat_text: Ahem!

replies.reply_text: All right, already!  Now, any particular frogs you're interested in?
I shall return when I have them in hand.  (Maybe.)

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, hello.  You brought back frogs for me to kiss, did you not?

replies.reply_text: I have them here, your Highness.
Oh.  Right!  That's what you wanted.  I'll be back!
I hope you find the prince of your dreams.

chatpoints.chat_text:
The Red Frog first. Here goes!
(After wrapping the beast in a towel to avoid touching its slimy skin, and with much trepidation, Princess Lilianna kisses the Red Frog.
Nothing happens.)
Ewww!

replies.reply_text: My Lady! (You quickly hand her one of her own handkerchiefs, and she wipes her mouth quickly with it.)

chatpoints.chat_text:
Okay. Deep breath. Calm down. Now. Okay. Green Frog please.
(This time, by the time her lips touch the frog's, she and the frog are almost the same color. Again, nothing happens--though the frog looks pleased.)
I may swoon!

replies.reply_text: Perhaps your Highness should rest before the last frog.

chatpoints.chat_text: No.  Okay.  I'm ready. Last frog.  This is it!  If this one isn't a prince, it's off with your head!

replies.reply_text: Off with my head?! All I did was bring you the frogs you asked for!

chatpoints.chat_text:
Silence!
(Once again, the princess picks up the slimy frog in a towel. But this time, when she kisses him, with a *pop* he turns into the most handsome, glamorous prince anyone could imagine!)

replies.reply_text: Ooo!  Good one!
At last!  My head is safe!
Thank you, my Lady.  May you live happily ever after!  Goodbye!

chatpoints.chat_text: Uh, no. I have a kitten named Mittens, but I wouldn't put mittens on a kitten, how silly!

replies.reply_text: Thank you, your Highness.  I'll look around outside your castle, then.

chatpoints.chat_text: You were to fetch me three frogs.  I've heard that the Red, Green and Blue Frogs are pretty special, especially since there's only one of each.  They stay by those Pegasus statues.  Go find them!

replies.reply_text: All right.  I'll go look more now.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, you're the one they... Oh, never mind. No, I haven't seen her today. Got to run! Appearances to make, all that! Goodbye!
Welcome!  How good of you to come.  Thanks to you, I now have my handsome prince.  How may I help you today?

replies.reply_text: Pardon me, my Lady, but I'm trying to find Little Red Riding Hood.  Has she, by chance, visited you here today?
Thank you, my Lady.
Excuse me, my Lady, but have you by any chance found a pair of Kitten Mittens around your castle?
My Lady!  It's good to see you again!

chatpoints.chat_text: Ah!  My dear, brave knight!  Or... whatever it is thou art.  I'm so glad thou hast come!  I've got a quest for thee!  Well, a series of quests.  And I shall reward thee handsomely for thine efforts!

replies.reply_text: Well, I'm not up for anything like that right now.  Maybe later.
You've gotten a bit... formal...  What is it I can do for my Lady?

chatpoints.chat_text: Well!  Of all the nerve!  Away with thee then, thou swell!

replies.reply_text: Sheesh...

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, Prince Anuran here and I are to be married.  It shall be a Royal Wedding, a spectacle the likes of which these Isles have never seen!  And thou shalt be my Royal Courier, and make the arrangements!

replies.reply_text: Of course, my Lady.
Uhm... I don't think so.

chatpoints.chat_text: Firstly, I shall require a ring.

replies.reply_text: Uhm.... Shouldn't your fiance be in charge of that?

chatpoints.chat_text:
Uhhhhmmmm, weeeeelllll..... (Princess Lilianna leans down and speaks in a near whisper.) His vocabulary's kind of limited, if thou knowest what I mean. Frankly, I like him that way! Hee hee hee!
My uncle, Grey, is a master goldsmith; he'll know what I want.

replies.reply_text: Of course.  And what else doth my Lady require?

chatpoints.chat_text: Next, I require a Royal Cake!  It must be a most splendid affair with all the frills!  You must seek out the finest baker in all these lands!  I want lots of sugar roses!

replies.reply_text: I shall have made for thee a delicacy of exquisite sumptuousness!  What else, My Lady?
Uhm... This is starting to look like a long, strange trip.  I think you'd better find someone else.

chatpoints.chat_text: Next, goest thou forth to mine Uncle Phil, and beg him supply me a Royal Carriage pulled by a four-in-hand of his magnificent white horses!

replies.reply_text: I shall do it with all haste, your Highness!  Is there more?

chatpoints.chat_text: Yes, there is one more thing!  My royal wedding gown!  It must be made of the finest silk, and bedecked with the loveliest jewels!  And embroidered by hand by the greatest talent on these Isles!

replies.reply_text: Certainly, my Lady.  I'll have it made at once.
I shall return, your Highness!

npc_list.name: Hope
npc_list.admin_description: NPC for mod isle
npc_list.long_description: Hope is a quiet woman, always ready to give service to travellers that come her way.

chatpoints.chat_text: Hello there! Please come in and make yourself at home. You will find peace and quiet here. Can I get you anything?

replies.reply_text: No, thanks.
What do you have available?

chatpoints.chat_text: Here, take a look at the menu...

replies.reply_text: I'll take the popcorn and soda for $25.
I'll have the pie a la mode and hot cocoa for $45.
I'll try the fried fish and lemonade for $80.
I'll just have one of your Survival Kits. That's 3 waters and 3 breads for $120, right?
Thanks!
Thanks!
Thanks!
Thanks!

chatpoints.chat_text: Is there anything you'd like to know about Pegasi?

replies.reply_text: It isn't "Pegasus"?
Can I buy a Pegasus for my own?
Can I pick the Pegasus I team up with?
What's so special about riding a Pegasus?
How do I tell a Pegasus where I'd like to go?
Why is it so expensive to rent a Pegasus?
No thanks, I think I know what I need to now.
Excuse me, sir, have you seen Little Red Riding Hood today?  Within the last hour or so?
Hello, please, can I ask you something a little odd?
Can the pegasus get to any of those little isles off to the east of Horse Isle?

chatpoints.chat_text: "Pegasi" is the plural of "Pegasus."

replies.reply_text: I see.

chatpoints.chat_text: No, you can't.  Pegasi are very independent creatures, and won't tolerate being owned by anyone.  However, they will consent to carry you for a while--if they like you.

replies.reply_text: Okay.

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, no.  That's not really a good idea.  Best to leave it to me, since I know all their personalities, and can tell which ones will get along with you best.

replies.reply_text: Okay, I'll trust your judgement.

chatpoints.chat_text: Pegasi can fly over water and trees and all; so you can go places much faster and without paying for boats or wagons.  They can also get you to islands where boats don't go.

replies.reply_text: That's useful.

chatpoints.chat_text: You can ride them as you would a regular horse; although they won't allow you to put tack on them, so you'd better have a very good seat.  And don't pull on their feathers; they won't thank you for that!

replies.reply_text: Okay.

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, as I said, Pegasi are very proud and particular.  They have expensive tastes of their own, and their feed is very pricey. Besides, you save an awful lot of money in transportation fees with a Pegasus as a partner--and they can go to Isles where there's no other transport!

replies.reply_text: I see.

chatpoints.chat_text: No!  And I'd better not see her around here!  All that yammering drives the Pegasi crazy!  She likes the Unicorns better, and thank goodness for that!

replies.reply_text: Well, if she does come by here today, just today, could you please keep her here, even for five minutes? Grandmother Hood hasn't got her birthday party set up yet!

chatpoints.chat_text: No, I will not!

replies.reply_text: Not even if I get you some honey?

chatpoints.chat_text: Excuse me?  What part of "no" is hard for you to understand?

replies.reply_text: I'm sorry.  Thanks anyway.  Goodbye.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, sure, go ahead.  Nobody ever asks me anything not-odd anyway....

replies.reply_text: Well, okay, here goes.  Did you by any chance pair up a pegasus with a pirate recently?

chatpoints.chat_text: (The look of incredulity on the Pegasus Uniter's face is astonishing.) Are you kidding? I mean... are you mad? No Pegasus would carry a pirate! I wouldn't even suggest it! It's crazy! Never happen! Why are you asking me something so silly?

replies.reply_text: Well, it's just that Princess Lilianna's been kidnapped!  I'm sure it was a pirate that did it, from the ransom note that was left.
That's all right.  Sorry to bother you.  Goodbye.

chatpoints.chat_text: And what makes you think any Pegasus was involved?

replies.reply_text: Well, I found these tracks.  Horse tracks, like a horse was standing tied, but with other tracks, like a pair of wings touching the ground as... you know?

Well, I found these tracks.  Horse tracks, like a horse was standing tied, but with other tracks, like a pair of wings touching the ground as... you know?  Then I rooted around a little, and I found this!

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, Pegasi do wander around a bit, you know.  They go all over the place. I mean, how are you going to stop them?  I need more proof than just tracks.

replies.reply_text: Sorry, that's all I could find.  Goodbye, then...

chatpoints.chat_text:
Oh.... Well! Let me see that!
(You hand over the piece of feather you found. The Pegasus Uniter examines it closely.)
This is definitely part of a Pegasus feather, all right. But if it were one of mine, I'd have known, I always.... Wait here a minute. I'll be right back.

replies.reply_text: (You hum to yourself while the Pegasus Uniter goes outside to his stable yard.)

chatpoints.chat_text: (Presently, the Pegasus Uniter returns with a troubled expression on his face.) Well, one of the Pegasi is missing part of her feather! And this part that you've found exactly matches it. But she won't say a word about it. Nope, not a word.

replies.reply_text: Oh well.  I guess I'll have to go look for more clues elsewhere, then.  Thanks anyway.
(Glancing at the piece of feather still in the Uniter's hands, you notice a bright red stain on it that wasn't there before.) What's that?
Oh well, that's not much help.  Thanks anyway.
Ah!  That's a big clue!  Thanks a lot!  And thank the Pegasus!  I'm off to rescue the Princess!

chatpoints.chat_text: Since the Pegasus can fly, when riding one, you can go anywhere.  Were you thinking of someplace in particular?

replies.reply_text: No, not really. I was just curious.  I guess I'll be on my way.  Bye.
Actually, yes.  I was wondering about those Tranquility and Serenity Isles.  They sound very relaxing.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, those.  Yes, they are quite relaxing.  I would actually recommend seeing the Unicorns for that trip.  A Pegasus could get you there, but when they go for a trip, they like to be taken out longer.

replies.reply_text: All right.  Thanks for the tip.  Bye!

npc_list.name: Aislin
npc_list.long_description: Aislin is a pretty young woman who cares very deeply about her horse. She is always looking for ways to cheer people up.

chatpoints.chat_text: Heyla! Welcome to my home. Please come in and ignore the mess. It's not usually this cluttered in here.

replies.reply_text: I don't mind. I'll let you get back to whatever it is you are doing.
What is all the wood and wire for?
Still working on your project, I see. Did you need help with anything else?
Not done building your wings yet? Is there anything else I can do to help?

chatpoints.chat_text: I'm trying to build my mare Elowyn a pair of wings. You see, living on Cloud Isle is tough for a regular horse. With all these pegasi and unicorns about, it makes a normal horse feel... well.... plain. And I love Elowyn so much, I hate seeing her so sad. So I thought if she had a pair of wings, she might feel more special!

replies.reply_text: That's crazy. You can't give a horse wings. So long.
Aww that's really sweet of you, wanting to make your horse happier.

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, what else could I do? I mean, she's my horse! It's up to me to keep her happy.

replies.reply_text: True. Well, good luck with your project. Bye!
I'd love to help you out if I can. Is there anything you need?

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, yeah, actually. I've been so busy trying to build the frame that I haven't had time to collect any feathers.

replies.reply_text: Ugh, I'm sick of collecting feathers. I think I'll sit this one out. Goodbye.
I'm great at collecting! What kind of feathers do you need?
Not a problem! I'll be right back!

chatpoints.chat_text: Welcome back! How's the hunt for feathers coming along?

replies.reply_text: Great! I don't have them all yet, but I'll be back soon with more.
Oh yes, feather collecting. How many did you need again?
I have them all here!
It's coming. Just taking a break. I'll get back to work now.
I can't remember how many you said to get.
Great! I have them all here.
I don't have them yet. I'll get right on that.
I can't find the pegasus feathers. Where am I supposed to be looking again?
You're in luck! I visited Erebus and he gave me feathers for you.

chatpoints.chat_text: Twenty peacock feathers should do. That's 10 for each wing.

replies.reply_text: All right, I'll be back soon!
No problem. Take care, now!
Glad I could help. Was there anything else you needed?

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh yes, actually, that would be great! The peacock feathers are colorful, but I want feathers that add a little shine, too. Do you think you could bring me some sparkling feathers?

replies.reply_text: More feathers? Mmm maybe not today. I'm late for a tea party with the Big Bad Wolf.
That shouldn't be a problem.  How many do you need?
Okay, be back soon!

chatpoints.chat_text: I need 20 sparkling feathers. Will that be okay?

replies.reply_text: Oh yes, I'll be right back with them.
She sure will. Goodbye now!
She'll definitely be sparkly. Was there anything else you needed?

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh yes, there is another thing. Pegasus wings are just not pegasus wings without real pegasus feathers. Do you think you can find me some?

replies.reply_text: Now you're asking for the impossible. I'm gonna go, but good luck with that!
Well... I suppose I could try.... do you know where I might find real pegasus feathers?

chatpoints.chat_text: I don't know, really. You'd have to find a pegasus to ask, I suppose. I heard a rumor that there's a nice one living on one of the main Horse Isle islands somewhere who's overly fond of flowers. Silly, I know, but it might be enough to go on.

replies.reply_text: I don't have a clue what you mean. Maybe somebody else can help you better. Bye, now.
It might. How many do you want me to get?
I'll see what I can do. Bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: You'll have to find a pegasus to ask. The rumor I heard says there might be one living down below the clouds, on one of the green islands. The rumor says he really likes flowers.

replies.reply_text: Okay.
Thank you! Just glad I could help. Hope Elowyn enjoys her wings!

chatpoints.chat_text: Welcome back! Thanks so much for all your help with Elowyn's wings. She just loves them. She prances around all day so that everyone can see how pretty her wings are.
