chatpoints.chat_text: Slow down, there... I said I could, not that I would.  I need some supplies.  Bring them to me, and we'll talk about the statue.

replies.reply_text: I should have known there would be a catch.  Later!
Okay, what do you need?
Right.  I'm on it!  See you soon.
Wow, this dragon is awesome!!  Holli is going to love this!  Thanks!

chatpoints.chat_text: No problem.  I need 5 pieces of obsidian and 25 chunks of pumice.

replies.reply_text: Oh, yeah, that's right.  Be back soon!

chatpoints.chat_text: What do you have in mind?

replies.reply_text: Well Iona, over in Flipperton, wants to hold a Founder's Day Crafts Festival.  She's hoping you can attend and display your Obsidian carvings  Here's your Invitation.
You know, you're right.  This would be a real nice vacation for you.  I'll let Iona know you will attend.

npc_list.name: Flicka
npc_list.long_description: A tall, skinny woman whose love for beetles shines through her beetle pattern dress.

chatpoints.chat_text: (She looks up from petting her "pet" and smiles at you.) Hello!

replies.reply_text: (You smile nervously.) Hello. What, may I ask, is that? (You point to the "pet")
Oh my... Creepy bug. Bye!
Wow. That looks interesting. I see you are into bugs.
Hi there. I understand you know a lot about bugs.
Hello to you, too. Since you are into ... these... critters... I was wondering if you knew of a woman named Patience?

chatpoints.chat_text: This, my friend, just happens to be the world's largest beetle. The Acteon Beetle.

replies.reply_text: Really? If that's the biggest, what would be the smallest?
Eeeww.  I'm getting out of here now.  Enjoy your beetles.

chatpoints.chat_text: The smallest would probably be the North American Feather Winged.  It's 0.25 mm long.

replies.reply_text: Wow.

chatpoints.chat_text: Yes, they are really amazing creatures, but my favorite by far is the Rhinoceros Beetle. It's the strongest beetle in the world and there's a rumor that they may even exist in our own Jungle Isle. It's just a rumor though.

replies.reply_text: On Jungle Isle? I'll have to keep my eye out for one, then. What do they look like?
I'll be sure to stay away from the jungle. Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh. All right. Bye then.

replies.reply_text: Bye. (You sprint out the door.)

chatpoints.chat_text: They're quite big and have two giant pairs of horns on their heads, black in color and very shiny.

replies.reply_text: Oh, all right. I'll be sure to keep my eye out for one. Thanks.
Wow.  Well, I'll be careful to avoid them then.  Bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: You're welcome. Thanks for stopping by.

replies.reply_text: You're welcome.  Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, absolutely! Did you know that the number of beetle species exceeds those of plants? Also that there is a Christmas beetle, but you won't find it on Christmas Isle?

replies.reply_text: Wow. That's really interesting. What else can you tell me about beetles?
Ah, no. I sure didn't. Say, this is all very interesting, but I was hoping maybe you could help me with a cricket problem.
That's terribly interesting!  Do you know of a resin called "lac"?  I don't know much else about it.
That's facinating. (You quickly fill her in on the saga of Stacie and the need for beetle shells.) I think Kelda is trying to capture the beauty of the Jungle to help Stacie get over her fears.

chatpoints.chat_text: Crickets aren't beetles. I'm afraid I don't know much about them at all. You might try talking to one of the other entomologists.

replies.reply_text: Darn. I'll do that. Thanks anyway.

chatpoints.chat_text: On tons, and tons! But I can sense you are busy. Here's something I find amusing -- a firefly isn't a fly at all -- it's a beetle! And a glowworm isn't a worm, it's a fly!

replies.reply_text: Cool! Thanks for sharing that. Maybe I'll be back again soon. Bye for now!

chatpoints.chat_text: It's amazing how the resins produced by bugs can be used by humans!  Yes, lac is a product of a few types of bugs.  They make this resin to use almost like building material!

replies.reply_text: That's fabulous!  Do you know how I can get some?

chatpoints.chat_text: Sure!  I'm normally more interested in beetles, but there happens to be a massive lac bug colony right in this area.   I've taken many samples of the resin to study.  How much do you need?

replies.reply_text: Just a couple of ounces.
I don't want to take your samples.  I'll be back later.
Thanks!  Bye now.

chatpoints.chat_text: Bugs? I know something about bugs in general. But if you want to talk specifics, beetles are my forte! Did you have a specific question, or just one in general?

replies.reply_text: Actually, if you could just tell me what eats crickets, I'd be grateful.

chatpoints.chat_text: Crickets? I'm sorry, but I can't help you with that. Would you like to know about beetles?

replies.reply_text: You know, I'm sure they're interesting, but I've got a bit of a crisis on my hands. Do you know anyone else I could talk to about bugs?

chatpoints.chat_text: You might try Kirby in Ashton. Why he likes living near volcanos is beyond me!

replies.reply_text: Thanks! I'll head over there now.

chatpoints.chat_text: I have an assortment of those. Not from live beetles of course. That would just be horribly cruel. How fun to donate them to a good cause! Hang on a minute while I get you some. (She rummages through some drawers in her desk.) Voila!

replies.reply_text: Thank you so much. I know Kelda will appreciate these, and I sure they'll help remind Stacie of the good parts of Jungle Isle.

chatpoints.chat_text: Indeed I do. And would you like to discuss? But please know, I'm not into cheesy gossip.

replies.reply_text: Oh, I'm not here to gossip. I am hoping to find her.

chatpoints.chat_text: Well that makes two of us. All I can say is, Good Luck!

replies.reply_text: Thanks so much. For no help at all! Zero. Zilch. Nada!

npc_list.name: Antonio Bandana
npc_list.admin_description: NPC for Mod Isle
npc_list.long_description: A swarthy hunk of a bronzed man.

chatpoints.chat_text: You cannot do your job as well as you'd like if you are all tense and full of stress, no?

replies.reply_text: No. I mean yes. I mean, what you said. Yea, I agree with that. Okay, let's start with the poetry then.
Good point. Okay. How about that neck rub you mentioned?

chatpoints.chat_text: (Antonio takes you gently by the hand and leads you to a comfy chair.) My Dear. Come sit. Put your feet up and relax for a bit. Shall I read poetry to you? Rub your neck? Bring you a glass of freshly squeezed lemonade? Get you an ice pack for that lump on your forehead?

replies.reply_text: Is that allowed? I'll have to find out. If it is, I want all of the above!
Oh, I think I'd like to hear some poetry, thank you!
I'll pass on the poetry. Please, just the lemonade and neck rub. Oh, and maybe an ice pack. I've been banging my head on the desk a lot today.
I'll go with the neck rub please.
Do you have ice packs to go? I have a feeling today is going to be a long day.
I'm back! I've told my friends about your tricks. I was wondering if you had any more up your sleeve?
That last trick was really something! I was wondering if I could get you to do just one more? Please?
I noticed the gryphon. Is she yours?
Last time I was here, you mentioned something about your hands being talented?
You'll be happy to know she ate the lizards right up! But she still doesn't look too happy.
Hey, Antonio. What was I supposed to be doing for you?
Bad news! She ate the mouse!
Hey, Antonio. What was I supposed to be doing for you?
Melanie loves her teddy bear, Antonio!
I'm back. You mentioned  lizards for Melanie?
So, she didn't like the mouse.  I feel a little guilty. She still isn't happy. Hey, how about a stuffed animal? Something she could cuddle up to?
I'm back! Any other tricks?
I'm back! Any other tricks?
I'm back! Any other tricks?
Hi Antonio.  Since the food didn't make her happy, can you think of anything else that might?

chatpoints.chat_text: Do not worry yourself over that. Of course it es allowed. I am here to help you relax for just a bit. Moderating the players must get tiring, si?

replies.reply_text: Si! Okay, let's start with the poetry then.
Hmmm. I think I'll start with the neck rub. You did offer that, right?
I don't want to get caught loafing on the job...
Say! Is that a griffin in the corner?

chatpoints.chat_text: "'Twas a full moon, and all through the day, de players were fighting and fussing away. It wore mightily on de moderators brave, and one by one they wearied and came to the place where Antonio would help ease their pain and leave them refreshed to start over again."

replies.reply_text: Hmmm. I was hoping for something that wouldn't remind me of all that.
Is that your first effort? If so, you've got potential. You might want to learn more about slant rhymes and meter.
Yikes! Now my headache hurts even more. Do you have ice packs to go?
I can't take anymore! I'm so gone....

chatpoints.chat_text: I will work on my poetry skills. Perhaps I'll have a better one the next time you visit.

replies.reply_text: That might be nice. So, you offered a neck rub, right?
Or not. It was just a comment. You offered a lemonade, right?
I think I'll take ice packs. To go, if possible.

chatpoints.chat_text: Si, I did. Just relax now. (Antonio rubs your neck, easing the tight muscles. You feel your tension headache dissipate.)

replies.reply_text: Well that feels better! Thank you. I'm ready for that glass of lemonade now.
Wow. I feel great. I'll pass on the rest. I'm ready to get those players into shape! Thanks, Antonio!
You are great with your hands! Any other hidden talents?
Thanks, Antonio. I should be able to face the players now.
Thanks. I think I could use the ice pack now. My head is still pounding from hitting it on the desk so much today.
Mmmm. Tastes delicious! Maybe I could stay for a few minutes more...

chatpoints.chat_text: This one player said, "You Autty be careful least you end up in jail!" Ha, ha, ha. I made that one up myself.

replies.reply_text: Riiiight. I could tell. You should leave the joke writing to someone else. Bye!
I don't get it. What's with the Autty reference?

chatpoints.chat_text: Ah!  A perfect opportunity to try out my new joke. Did you hear about the player that was mini-modding?

replies.reply_text: Heck, seems like half of them mini-mod now and then.
Thanks for reminding me about that -- I'd better head back now. Later!
I think I've heard this one before. Did you offer a neck rub?

chatpoints.chat_text: Come. Sit down. I will not burden your ears with my poor sense of poetry. Or jokes. These, it seems, I was not born to do.

replies.reply_text: Thank goodness! I mean, how smart of you to figure out what your strengths and talents are. And could I have a glass of that lemonade you mentioned?
A wise choice, Antonio. Let me just enjoy the rub.
You know, I think I hear my name being called. Must be trouble on the islands.... later!

chatpoints.chat_text: But of course. Let me work out these knots in your shoulders and neck. Then Antonio will make you a fresh glass of lemonade. Here, rest your head on this ice pack while I work.

replies.reply_text: Perfect! I'm feeling more relaxed already.  I'm ready for the lemonade now.
That's nice. How about that poetry you mentioned?
Nice work! Leaves me thirsty for lemonade.

chatpoints.chat_text: I'm so sorry. If I could, for you, I would send a month's supply. But here, sit back while I place the pack on your head.

replies.reply_text: I could get used to this...
No, I just can't take the time. How about a lemonade to go?

chatpoints.chat_text: (Antonio sighs.) You are not from Palomino server, then?

replies.reply_text: Nope.
I am. Ohhh. Now I get it. Ha. ha. Don't quit your day job to write jokes, Antonio. Gotta get back to work. Later!

chatpoints.chat_text: Autty is a mod on Palomino. So, if I must explain, es no good joke then.

replies.reply_text: That's okay. You tried. I'd better get back to work. See you later!
Ohhh. Well, then it kind of makes sense. I guess. I'd better head back to work. Later!
You know, after that, my neck muscles are all tight again. Can you help me out with that?

chatpoints.chat_text: Just relax while I work these muscles down the side of your neck like this, and like so, and massage your scalp like this...

replies.reply_text: Ohhhh. Now I know why the mods have been hanging out here. This is really nice!
Hey Antonio. Pencil me in for every day this week. Hurry. Before everyone gets in line!

chatpoints.chat_text: So. Better now?

replies.reply_text: Indeed! Thanks Antonio. See you around.
Much better. And that lemonade?
Absolutely! Hey, do I spy a creature in the corner?

chatpoints.chat_text: But of course. Let me wrap this in a nice soft towel for you. There you go!

replies.reply_text: That feels better. Much better. Okay. I'd better get back to work now. But I'm sure I'll be back soon.

chatpoints.chat_text: Slant rhyme?

replies.reply_text: In your spare time. I'm sure mods are going to be keeping you busy for awhile! I'm ready to move on to the neck rub.
Don't worry your pretty head over it, Antonio. Not everyone is cut out to be a poet. Besides, you've got talented hands. I'd stick with that if I were you.

chatpoints.chat_text: For you, I will be here. Anytime. Whenever you need me.

replies.reply_text: Super! Thanks, Antonio. Okay, high-ho, high-ho, it's off to work I go.
Terrific. And can I grab a lemonade for the road?
I'll pass on that. Anything else?
I like the idea of something to cuddle. Okay, here you go!
You know, I just might take you up on the offer some other day.
Ah, no thank you. I'll go with the neck rub instead.
I'd rather hear some poetry, if it's all the same to you.
Umm, I'll pass. Can I just have some lemonade?
You know, I think that's my cue to leave. Bye, Antonio!
Is it just me, or does she look a little sad to you?

chatpoints.chat_text: With sparkling feathers and giant coconuts, I can make you something glamorous. I would need 20 of each of them. But again, I can do this trick but once.

replies.reply_text: ( You check your inventory.) Nope, don't have those on me. Anything else?
I don't need glamorous. I don't suppose you've got any Jackrabbit gear?
Gosh! Look at the time. Time to run!
Why look at that! I have those right here! There you are!
Pretty impressive! Okay, what else can you do?
Can we go back to the neck rub? You did offer to do that, right?
Yuck! I was hoping for a bunny. Oh well. I can always sell this varmint. Bye!
How about that lemonade now?
Not bad! Anything else you can do?
Nice! Thanks, Antonio. Okay, time for me to head back. Later, gator!
Okay, how about a lemonade and then I'll hit the road.

chatpoints.chat_text: You are a tough audience! One more thing, I can do. I cannot make tack. However, for you, I can do something special.

replies.reply_text: You've perked my interest. Do continue, dear Antonio.
Choices, choices. Guess I'm going to have to get back to the motley crew and find out next time, Antonio. Later!

chatpoints.chat_text: For this, my grandest trick, I will need 35 moonbeams and 25 wishing coins. This takes much energy out of me. But for you I will do it. Only once, of course.

replies.reply_text: Are you nuts? Forget about it! I'm outta here.
You obviously have never had to search for moonbeams before. Just give me a lemonade.
Of course! Well looky, looky! What's all this poking out of my magical and ever-expanding backpack? You got it! Moonbeams and wishing coins!
Wowzers! You are gifted. Okay, back to that neck rub, please...
Well, that turned out to be a real oinker of a trick!
Looks like this little piggy needs to go to the market and get some feed. Bye, Antonio!

chatpoints.chat_text: Ha, ha, haaa! Now you make joke! You very funny.

replies.reply_text: Thanks. Now I better get back to work before someone comes looking for me. Bye!
Nice trick.  But it has left me very, very thirsty ... hint, hint!
One more trick, Antonio? Please, please, please?

chatpoints.chat_text: Now you are giving Antonio a headache. I don't feel the magic.. No feel the magic, no can do the magic.

replies.reply_text: Please, for me? Come on,  Antonio. What else have you got to do?
Gesh! What's happened to my manners? Forgive me, Antonio.
Yikes. I've pushed you too far. I'm sorry. Time for me to head out.

chatpoints.chat_text: Begging is against the rules. No? Besides, I have other necks to rub.

replies.reply_text: Antonio, you said you had gifted hands. Let's see just how gifted they are. Come on. What are you afraid of?
You are absolutely right. I'm so sorry for pushing you on this. I'll be back soon!

chatpoints.chat_text: Es no problem. I get a little carried away, showing off. No?

replies.reply_text: Well, you ARE talented, so I can't blame you. Have a great day!
I was the one who got carried away. Please forgive me. I'll be sure to send other customers your way. Later!

chatpoints.chat_text: ( Antonio rubs his head and looks beseechingly at you.) Are you sure you want Antonio to do another? Es berry, berry tricky magic., and es exhausting.

replies.reply_text: Si! Si! ( You squeal with excitement.)
Nah, you've convinced me. I was being greedy. I'll get out of your hair now. Bye, Antonio!

chatpoints.chat_text: Okay. I will need you to bring me yellow crystal shards and silver linings. I will need 15 of each.

replies.reply_text: Darn. Don't have those with me. I'll be right back.
Yellow shards and silver linings? Wowzers! This has got to be something special. Thankfully, I've got them! Here! Take them! I can't wait to see what you'll come up with this time.
Hey! Is this some kind of joke?
Raspberries? I guess I deserve that. Point made, Antonio. Point made. Bye.
Hey! You sneezed right in the middle of it! It messed up the magic. Lets try again!

chatpoints.chat_text: I am so sorry to tell you, es no joke.

replies.reply_text: No joke? No kidding! I just lost a fortune! Back to the grindstone for me!
Dang, Antonio. It really was "berry, berry tricky magic" you did there! Now that IS funny! Later, gator!

chatpoints.chat_text: No. Es no good. My magic is finished. Kaput. Broken. You must leave now. Antonio will take his pet griffin Melanie, and go rest now. Please, leave us be.

replies.reply_text: Well, gosh. I guess I don't have much choice then. Adios!
Yikes! I am so sorry... and so gone!

chatpoints.chat_text: (Antonio sighs heavily.) Your eyes do not fool you, but what to make her happy again? Antonio cannot tell.

replies.reply_text: Maybe she is hungry?
Have you thought about her life here? I mean, hanging out on a cloud isn't exactly the excitement of Lights! Camera! Action!
Hmmm.  Maybe a gift. Have you tried giving her diamonds? Females like glitter, you know.
I'm sorry.  Hopefully she finds something that makes her happy soon.  I really need to get back to those players though.  Bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: (Antonio clutches his chest, slumps to the floor and looks heartbroken.) No! Melanie no longer wishes to be with Antonio?

replies.reply_text: Hold on a minute! I'm not saying that at all. I'm just saying maybe she needs some excitement.
I'm just saying, dude... maybe she's lonely. Maybe she needs a pet!   A little mouse, perhaps?

chatpoints.chat_text: Si! I tried that, but Melanie, she tried to eat the diamond and hurt her beak!

replies.reply_text: I see. Maybe what she's looking for is a tasty meal. Something different than griffin kibble? What would she eat out in the wild?
Yikes. Not a good idea I guess. Well, I've got to get back to work. Good luck!

chatpoints.chat_text: Si! Why didn't I think of that? Would you fetch her some lizards? Fifteen would make a great lunch for my little darling.

replies.reply_text: Sure, I'd be happy to do that for you.
Ummm, I'm not big on squishy, squirmy worms with legs. Sorry.
As soon as I have the lizards, I'll take them to her!
The players are getting rowdy and I've got to get back to work.  I'll try to remember to grab some before I stop up next time.
As soon as I get a mouse, Melanie will get her pet!
I'll head over to Barb's right now. I think Melanie is going to love a teddy bear! She'll have it in no time!

chatpoints.chat_text: We talked about 15 lizards to feed Melanie. You remember, si?

replies.reply_text: Ah yes! Here they are! I'll give them to her now.
That's right. I'll be back in a jiffy.
This is great. Thanks Antonio.
Thanks! Anything else I can do to make her happy?

chatpoints.chat_text: You suggested a pet for Melanie, si? Like a mouse?

replies.reply_text: That's right! I've got a mouse right here. I'm sure she'll love it. I'll go give it to her right now.
Oh right! I'll be back as soon as I get a mouse.
I'm really sorry that didn't work out so well. Good luck with making her happy!
Thanks for the reward, but I feel a little guilty. She still isn't happy. Hey, how about a stuffed animal? Something she could cuddle up to?

chatpoints.chat_text: The mouse didn't work out so well, si? We talked about a teddy bear, instead.

replies.reply_text: Yuck, please don't remind me. I'm off to see Barb about the teddy bear now.
Riiiight. That's why I've been toting around a teddy bear! I'll give it to her now.
Wow, thanks tons, Antonio! I've got to take care of some rowdy players, but I'll be back soon.
I'm tuckered out from all that work. How about a neck rub?

chatpoints.chat_text: If she doesn't need food, then what? I am at a loss, amigo.

replies.reply_text: What about a pet mouse? That would keep her company.
That's a shame. Sorry I can't stay around and help. Got to get back to the game now. Bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: I just don't know. Do you have any ideas, my friend?

replies.reply_text: How about a stuffed animal?
Not right now, but if I think of anything, I'll come back and let you know. Bye, Antonio!
How about a pet mouse? That would keep her company.

chatpoints.chat_text: Si, si. I think that would do the trick. Would you do this for me?

replies.reply_text: Nope, sorry. Too busy. But maybe another day, I can if I find some spare time. Later, Antonio!
Get a mouse? Sure. I can do that.

chatpoints.chat_text: A stuffed animal? You mean, like a teddy bear?

replies.reply_text: Exactly! Something she could cuddle up with. I bet Barb in Shellton can make one.
A teddy bear for a big scary gryphon? I don't think so! I was considering a stuffed turkey -- you know, to eat?

chatpoints.chat_text: You mean, gobble gobble? That kind? (Antonio shudders) Think of the mess! The feathers. And then she will want mucho more. Sweet yams and marshmallows. Mashed potatoes and gravy. Cranberry sauce. Pumpkin pie. Glazed carrots. No, my friend. I do not have time for the feast she would want. I don't care for that idea at all.

replies.reply_text: Well, I gave it my best shot. And now you've made me hungry, talking about all that! I'm off to get some dinner. Later!
I was just kidding, Antonio! Of course I meant a teddy bear!

chatpoints.chat_text: I cannot leave my clients and go to Barb in Shellton for a teddy bear. Is that something you could do for me?

replies.reply_text: I'd be happy to do that for you.
Not right now, but if I have time, I'll come back and let you know.

chatpoints.chat_text: Excitement? I can no give her excitement! This is life on a cloud -- no excitement here!

replies.reply_text: Well, what else could you do to make her happy?
Then I am fresh out of ideas. You are on your own, Antonio. Later!

npc_list.name: Vesuvia
npc_list.admin_description: Volcanologist who lives in Ashton [new quests start CP12]

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh! Come in, come in! Don't mind the mess. (She quickly, but carefully, sets the rocks and tools off to the side.)

replies.reply_text: No thanks, I can see you're busy.  Bye!
Thanks!  What are you doing?
I'm back!  Unfortunately, I don't have the samples yet.  What did I need to do again?
I have all the samples!
Sorry to disturb you, I just wanted to ask a fast question.  Would you know where I could find a carved stone the color of night?

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, just studying my latest samples from my closest, erupting neighbor.

replies.reply_text: Oh?  And who is that?  If they erupt easily, I should probably try to avoid them.
That's interesting.  Well, I'll let you get back to that, then.  Bye!
That volcano near town here is active?!?

chatpoints.chat_text: (Vesuvia lets out a short, friendly laugh.) The volcano just south of here, silly. I study it, and the other volcanoes on the lava isles. Mostly in an attempt to predict when they will erupt next.

replies.reply_text: That volcano is active?!?
That sounds really neat!  The residents don't worry about losing their homes?
Wow!  Well, this sounds quite fascinating.  Is there anything I can do to help you?

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, yes.  Actually, all the volcanoes on these isles are active.  All the homes in Ashton here are built specifically to withstand lava flow.  They have worked great so far!

replies.reply_text: That's wonderful!  Well, I think I'll just get off this island.  I really don't like the idea of being that close to an active volcano.  Goodbye.
Wow!  Well, this sounds quite fascinating.  Is there anything I can do to help you?

chatpoints.chat_text: The homes are actually built specifically to withstand lava flow.  That is the reason they are up on stilts.  The residents leave during an eruption for safety's sake, but the homes have survived so far.

replies.reply_text: That's wonderful!  Well, I think I'll just get off this island.  I really don't like the idea of being that close to an active volcano.  Goodbye.
Wow!  Well, good thing someone was thinking when they built this town.

chatpoints.chat_text: Yes.  I quite agree with you.

replies.reply_text: Well, I can see you're busy with your research.  I'll just leave you to your work.  Goodbye.
So, is there anything I can do to help you?  All of this talk of volcanoes sounds so interesting.

chatpoints.chat_text: You know, there is something you could do that would be a huge help.  How do you feel about being close to a volcano?

replies.reply_text: Child's play.  I go by those volcanoes all the time.  What do you need me to do?
Umm...  To be honest, they scare me.  So, if your little job requires going near them, then I think I'll pass.  Good luck finding someone else!

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, I really need some fresh samples from the larger volcanoes.   There are a total of 8 spread around the different lava isles.

replies.reply_text: That sounds like far too much work.  I think I'll pass this time.  Bye!
That doesn't sound so bad.  So, what exactly do you need me to do to?

chatpoints.chat_text: What you need to do is find the 8 large volcanoes and dig at the northern most spot right in the middle.  That will reopen the access tunnel I use to get samples.  Once inside the wall of the volcano, rake up a small sample.  You should be able to just walk right back out once you are done.

replies.reply_text: Go inside the volcano?!?  Are you off your rocker?  I'm outta here.
Okay.  I can do that.  I suppose I have to go inside the crazy maze...
Oh, that's right.  I'll get going now.
Okay.  You also said I have to find some in the maze, right?  Do you remember which paths I need to take?

chatpoints.chat_text: You do, but there are only 2 large volcanoes in the maze.  Just take the red and yellow paths to those volcanoes.  Bring all 8 samples back when you are done.

replies.reply_text: Sounds good.  I'll be back shortly.

chatpoints.chat_text: Yes.  Take the red and yellow paths to find the large volcanoes in the maze.

replies.reply_text: Great!  I'll be back soon.
Thanks!

chatpoints.chat_text: Hello again!  Thank you for your help.  The samples have been very telling.

replies.reply_text: You're welcome.  I should be on my way.  Bye!
Great!  I'm glad I could be of some help.
Oh?  What are they telling?

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, this and that.  It is quite technical, though.

replies.reply_text: I imagine.  Well, good luck!

chatpoints.chat_text: I'm sorry, too busy for that sort of thing.  I'm sure someone else can help you.  Goodbye!

replies.reply_text: Oh... Okay.  Bye.

npc_list.name: Alexi
npc_list.short_description: an accountant, and brilliant with numbers.
npc_list.long_description: Alexi is quite the studious one! She has a pencil behind each ear. Bet she has forgotten that they are even there!

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh!  Hello there, hello!  Now, what can I do for you today?  Need help with something, do you?

replies.reply_text: No, not at the moment, but I'll keep you in mind, thanks, if I do.
Actually, I was wondering if you needed or wanted anything yourself?
I found it!  I was worried when you said it'd been years. But there it was -- just where you said it would be! It was under a bunch of sand, but it was there just the same.
Excuse me, but was I doing something for you?

chatpoints.chat_text: That's exactly what it is! And yes, I remember fondly where I used it last. I was sitting on a large rock on the beach, just east of Galvin's cabin. Ah, yes. Fond memories indeed! I was a mere child, trying to count the waves. Imagine that!

replies.reply_text: Oh gosh, look at the time. Tell you what, when I find myself with nothing to do but twiddle my thumbs, I'll come back and help you. In the meantime, I'm gone like yesterday's breakfast.
Imagine that, indeed. That's close enough I can walk there. I'll do it!
I'll be back before you know it!

chatpoints.chat_text: What? Me? Why, no one has ever asked me that before. How very interesting. I don't know quite how to answer. Let me think. What could I want? What could I need? Aha! I have it. I would love to have my dear old abacus back on my desk. I misplaced it years ago.

replies.reply_text: Lucky for me, I know what an abacus is. It's a frame with beads that you count on, right? No problem. I'm really good at finding things. Especially if I know what I'm looking for and where it was last seen. Any ideas where you used it last?
An abacus? Sorry. That just doesn't sound like a very exciting adventure to me. Hopefully, someone else can help you. Bye!
Thank you! And have a great day.

chatpoints.chat_text: You were, you were indeed! My missing abacus. You were quite sure you could find it. I am so looking forward to having it back on my desk again.

replies.reply_text: Right. That rings a bell. Something about counting the waves...
Now that does ring a bell. A dull bell. I really need to be doing something more interesting right now. Sorry!

chatpoints.chat_text: Yes! Yes, indeed. I was on the big rock just east of Galvin's cabin.

replies.reply_text: I know just where to look. I'll be back in a jiffy!

chatpoints.chat_text: Squeek!?!? (She runs, and tries to hide behind a rock.)

npc_list.name: The Cardinal
npc_list.short_description: No one expects the HorseIsle Inquisition
npc_list.long_description: This character is not intended to show up in the game much like Tim, he is here to help quest writers to get some tips on good writing practices

chatpoints.chat_text: We have 2 weapons at our disposal surprise and fear, fear and surprise and ruthless efficiency

replies.reply_text: why surprise?
why fear?
Ruthless efficiency?

chatpoints.chat_text: Because what happens on Beta stays on Beta until it goes live.

replies.reply_text: OK I can do that.

chatpoints.chat_text: Because I'm the cardinal that why.

replies.reply_text: Ohh okay. (you look to you left and right to see if anyone sees you talking to this guy)

chatpoints.chat_text: Yes if we are efficient then things can go a lot smoother for everyone.

replies.reply_text: ahh like what?

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, like when a character is giving you something you put your reply in the "Action Editor" and not the "Script Editor"

replies.reply_text: Oh why do I do that?

chatpoints.chat_text: So that if the Conversation fails due to a bug or something, then it gives the fail response in the "Action Editor" instead

replies.reply_text: Sure, no problem. Anything else?

chatpoints.chat_text: Using (italics.) to denote commentry from conversation, this is done much in the same way as it is done in the game, refer to chatpoint #6 in My script for an example. Be sure the parenthesis are outside the italics. Italicsized parenthesis look ridiculous

replies.reply_text: I can do that. Anything else I need to know?

chatpoints.chat_text: One of the most important rules of all.... the use of 1550. Where it goes and where it NEVER goes!

npc_list.name: Lornbacoll
npc_list.admin_description: New Quests must start at CP 32
npc_list.short_description: A Lady Dragon of particular elegance
npc_list.long_description: In Film Noir terms, Lornbacoll is nothing short of a knock-out.  Sleek, elegant, bejeweled, she regards you coolly.  When she speaks, her voice is low and slightly drawling, but intense.

chatpoints.chat_text:
(The dragoness, leaning against a wall, seems only to barely notice you. She looks over you and your horses and ever so coolly says in a deep, husky voice...)
Anybody got a match?

replies.reply_text: Uhm... a match?
Sorry to bother you, I'll be on my way.
I'm back.  I spoke to the Green Dragon.
Sorry to bother you again, but I couldn't remember all the facts about your lost recipe card...
Hi, I'm just here to debug Goldilocks.

chatpoints.chat_text: Yeah. A match. You know what a match is, don't you? (She smiles, ever so very slightly, and when she snorts in a small chuckle, you can see tiny flames....)

replies.reply_text: Uh, no.  No matches, sorry.

chatpoints.chat_text: (The dragoness scratches her back against the wall.) So. What do you want me to light for you?

replies.reply_text: Nothing, I just came to... see what was here, that's all. I'll be going now.
Light?  Nothing, I just noticed there was a dragon cave here, and wanted to see you, that's all.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, you wanted to see me.  Well, I hope you're getting an eyeful, then.  Say..........

replies.reply_text: Yes?
Oh, no.  No, no, no, no more quests.  Forget it, bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: You look like someone who knows the score.  Who's been around the track a few times.  Like someone who could get things done.

replies.reply_text: You could say that.  Why, are you in some kind of trouble?

chatpoints.chat_text: (Lornbacoll regards you appraisingly.) Weeeellll, it seems I have lost something that's kind of important.

replies.reply_text: What was that?
I thought I smelled a quest coming on!  Thanks, but I don't have time for this just now.  Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: A... recipe.

replies.reply_text: Do you want to tell me perhaps a little more about it?

chatpoints.chat_text: (She stands up, and sighs. Once again, she considers you with those beautiful, burning eyes.) All right, I'll level with you. It's a recipe for my favorite dessert: A Malted Falcon. It's on a card. About so big. (Her gesture indicates something the size of an index card.)

replies.reply_text: I see.  And where did you lose it?

chatpoints.chat_text: I was on my way to see my friend the Yellow Dragon.  Poor old dear. I was carrying the card in my hand and as I was flying over the maze a gust of wind came up and it got blown away.  Now she's mad.  She wanted it.  I wanted it.  And I'll pay well to get it back.

replies.reply_text: I'm not going anywhere near that maze ever again!  You'll find someone else.  Bye.
Well, okay, I can search the maze.  What exactly does it look like?
But surely you can just remember the recipe and write it down again, can't you?

chatpoints.chat_text: I'd rather have the card.  As..... a keepsake.

replies.reply_text: All right.  Well, what does it look like, then?
This is already sounding way too complicated for my taste.  Goodbye!
Isn't that a little thick for a recipe card?

chatpoints.chat_text: I don't have to tell you anything more about it.  Just that I'll pay you handsomely if you find it and return it.

replies.reply_text: All right, if that's what you want.  Where over the maze did you lose it?

chatpoints.chat_text: (The dragoness shrugs.) I don't know. I didn't know. The last time I remember having it was when I was over the Blue Dragon's place. But it could be anywhere. It was windy and I was pretty high up.

replies.reply_text: I'll let you know what I find out.  Could you possibly send me to someplace less out of the way?
I'll go do that some other time.  I'm going to go hang out with Venus.  See ya.

chatpoints.chat_text: You'd better return and try it again, rider. (Whispering) Remember - down an alley by a western volcano... please hurry!

replies.reply_text: Right, what was I thinking?  Could you send me back to Ashton please?
This seems to be getting too dangerous.  Count me out.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, yeah?  What did he have to say?  Is he going to help?

replies.reply_text: Well, I'm not sure.  You know how he is, you never really know to whom he's speaking.
Who knows.  I never understand him anyway, so I'm going to go look for the thing on my own.  Bye now!
Well, I'm not sure.  You know how he is, you never really know to whom he's speaking.
Before the Fat Dragon does?

chatpoints.chat_text:
(Lornbacoll stops short and stares intently at you. From behind a cave formation, another dragon appears, looking equally alarmed.)
Pederlaurie: The Fat Dragon? Is he here? When did he get here? Where is he?
Lornbacoll: (Lornbacoll waves Pederlaurie back.) That's all right, Peder, I'll handle this.

replies.reply_text: A-ha, so you know each other, then.

chatpoints.chat_text:
So what if we do? It doesn't matter to you. All we... that is, all I... want is the Falcon.
Pederlaurie: I want it, too! I have as much right to it as anyone! I should have---
Lornbacoll: That's enough. Rider, can you get it?

replies.reply_text: I'm sorry, this is all too complicated for me. I think I'll quit now, before my brain explodes.  Goodbye.
Well, I might be able to get it.  But first I want something cleared up: Whose is it, really?  Is it yours?  Or Pederlaurie's?  Or Cidney-Grynstrit's?

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, if it's anybody's, it belongs to the person who originally made it, I suppose you might say.  As to why we all want it, well.... Wouldn't you want it?

replies.reply_text: I don't care about it.  You guys can just get it on your own, then.
Sure, I like desserts just as much as anybody, but what if I find this thing, and you all want it.... Well, whose actually IS it?  Which of you do I give it to?

chatpoints.chat_text:
You give it to me, because I asked you first!
Pederlaurie: Now wait just a moment, I have a right to it, too! I found it first! And then you took it from me! You said you were just going to borrow it, and I had to get it back and hide it--
Lornbacoll: Peder, that's enough!

replies.reply_text: All right, all right!  Look!  Isn't there some way that the three of you could share, uh... whatever is so special about the recipe?

chatpoints.chat_text: Why don't you just find it, and we'll work out what to do with it once I've got it?

replies.reply_text: Okay. I'll see what I can do.  But let's talk about where it is first.  Is it near some volcano on the western side of the maze?  Or should I follow Cidney-Grynstrit's instructions to look for it down an alley?
All right.... I'll let you know what I find.

chatpoints.chat_text: (You gallop up to Lornbacoll's cavern, and are astounded at the sight that greets you: Lornbacoll, Pederlaurie and, amazingly, Cidny-Gryndstrit, all stand here, glaring at you.)

replies.reply_text: (You brace yourself and announce:) I have it.
Ooops, wrong cave.
Wow!  What happened?  Where's the Malted Falcon now?
This looks like trouble.  I don't have your recipe.  I couldn't find it.

chatpoints.chat_text:
Yes, I heard.
Cidny-Grynstrit: Yes, I was good enough to tell my associates about your find when I got here. Now. Hand it over.

replies.reply_text: Wait a minute!  I still don't know to whom this actually belongs!  Now, whose is it?

chatpoints.chat_text:
It's mine! I'm the one who wants to make the recipe!
Pederlaurie: And maybe it's mine, because I found the bean-gems!
Cidny-Grynstrit: And you could even say that it is mine, because it was I who introduced all these fine people, and without their combined efforts on my behalf, you would not have that little item which you hold in your hands now. So I suppose you must then make the decision. To which of us will you give it?

replies.reply_text: Tell me how to open it, and I'll give each of you a bean. (Just to make sure, you shake the Recipe Box; something inside rattles, but you can't tell how many things are there.)

chatpoints.chat_text:
That was not our agreement!
Cidny-Grynstrit: No no, that will not do at all. Surely you must understand by now that none of us is going to open this object in front of the others. Now. Whose shall it be?

replies.reply_text: Lornbacoll asked me first.  Here it is, Lorn.
I always root for the underdog.  Here you are, Peder.
It sounds like this whole thing was really your idea, Cidny.  Here it is.

I hope it's all worth--- (Suddenly there are flashes of fire, gusts of wind from beating wings, and ferocious roars! Your horse bolts from the cavern in fright as all three dragons wrestle for the prize!)
Good luck! (With that, you run out to your horse and ride off, vowing never to visit this place again!)

chatpoints.chat_text: Did you see any other dragon in the Green Dragon's maze that seemed to be out of place, rider?

replies.reply_text: Well, I saw a couple... A weird, short one with buggy eyes, and a spooky, fat one.
No, I didn't even bother to go back through the maze, I used my nifty Dorothy's Shoes and then came directly back to see you.  I guess I'll go back and look.  Could you send me back to Ashton?

chatpoints.chat_text: I know all about that odd little fellow, but the fat one...  I don't have much of a choice now, rider.  You'll have to go talk to the Fat Dragon.  Be careful, he's a sneaky one, and shouldn't be trusted.  I'll ask you not to mention too much... about the other interested parties in this matter.

replies.reply_text: Phooey, this is ridiculous.  Maybe some other day.
All right, I'll go find him.  Could you send me back to Ashton again?

chatpoints.chat_text: (Lornbacoll gets up and begins to pace her cave.) Yeah, I know how he is. So long as you can get before.... well....

replies.reply_text: Wait, who else is looking for this Malted Falcon recipe?

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, well, if it isn't you! And what brings you to my cave this time?

replies.reply_text: Nothing,  Just stopped in to say hello.  Hello!  Goodbye!
Hi there.  I'm looking for a mage.  I think they said his name was Oddly.  Have you seen him?

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, I don't know anybody named Oddly... but if there were anybody whom the name would fit, there's a weird old fellow, who walks around the volcano. You could try him.

replies.reply_text: Ah.  Okay.  Do you know exactly where he is, or does he just wander around that volcano?
Thanks, I'll go look for him now.

chatpoints.chat_text: I've never seen him in the same place.  I've never even seen him stand still!  He just walks around that volcano, around and around and around.  Just keep looking, I'm sure you'll find him, you can't miss him.

replies.reply_text: Thanks!  Bye, Lornbacoll!

npc_list.name: Pederlaurie
npc_list.admin_description: First Pederlaurie you meet outside Green Dragon's place.
npc_list.short_description: A small dragon with huge eyes
npc_list.long_description: Pederlaurie is much smaller than the other dragons you've met so far.  He has a slightly nervous manner and enormous bulging eyes.  He speaks with a high, nasal voice with a peculiar accent.

chatpoints.chat_text: Er, em... You will forgive me for asking, but what are you doing here?

replies.reply_text: I was just about to ask you the same thing.
Nevermind.  See you around.

chatpoints.chat_text: (Pederlaurie looks unexpectedly nervous.) Who, me? Why, I was just wandering around in here, I wasn't doing anything. I was just curious, that's all. I wasn't doing anything.

replies.reply_text: That's okay, I believe you.  Bye.
Are you looking for something?
Hmmmm! (As the little dragon departs, you notice a smell of gardenias....)

npc_list.name: Spike Lizzard
npc_list.long_description: Spike Lizzard, despite his rough-sounding name, is a very gentle man who just loves animals of all kinds.

chatpoints.chat_text: Daria Pale, in the feed store.  I'm sure the cat pack would love it if she got a new supply.  Make sure you say hello to her for me.

replies.reply_text: I'll bring them as soon as I can.

chatpoints.chat_text: Welcome, come on in, look around.

replies.reply_text: You have quite a variety of pets for sale here.
I was hoping to buy a cat for Lucy Reins in Shellton.
I still haven't delivered those treats to Cat Isle, who wanted them again?
Hi there! I noticed that you occasionally have birds and was wondering if you had any downy feathers?
Hello, Spike!  I have a delivery from the Pony Express for you!

chatpoints.chat_text: Yes, I love all kinds of animals.  Feel free to look around and buy as many pets as you like.  You can never have too many pets.

replies.reply_text: Thank you, I will.

chatpoints.chat_text: We have some adorable kittens at the moment, take a look. (Leads you to a pen which holds a dozen fluffy kittens with bows around their necks.)

replies.reply_text: Actually, Lucy was looking for an older cat, one that maybe knew how to catch mice?  Do you have any of those?

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, no, our customers prefer these cute little kittens. (Crooning to the kittens.) Aren't you just the cutest little things? Yes! Yes, you are! I used to carry some older ones, but no one bought them, so I let them leave if they wished.

replies.reply_text: Do you know where these cats may have gone to?

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, there's always Cat Isle, of course.  Have you tried there?

replies.reply_text: Cat Isle!  I should have thought of that.  Thanks!
I can do that, it's right on my way.

chatpoints.chat_text: Terrific.  Please tell her I said hello and I'll try to get out for a visit soon.

replies.reply_text: I will.  Bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: I'm sorry. I can't help you. Why don't you try someone who specializes in birds?

replies.reply_text: I'll do that. Thanks.
That's great! Thank you, Spike!

chatpoints.chat_text: Hello, anything I can do for you?

replies.reply_text: You sure are far from town.  How come?
Do these foals grow up, so I can ride them some day?
I don't suppose you sell any cats, do you?
Hi!  Would you know anybody around these parts who makes sandpaintings?
Actually, it's something I can do for you!  I have a delivery from the Pony Express for you!
Well, I was wondering if there was anything that you needed done?
I was going to do something for you...  What was it again?
I'm back and I have the formula you needed!
Hi there!  Back again!
Hi! I have a lead!
Victory!  I have the address!
Hiya, uhm... Sorry, I've been all of a dither. Where was I heading again?
I sure hope so. I've been told to give you these wooden discs. I got them from these Spirit Horses, and Nizhoni said I should bring them to you.

chatpoints.chat_text: There are nice breezes here from the sea.  And the foals and calves have lots of room to run around, and plenty of good grass.

replies.reply_text: Ah, that makes sense.  I'm sure they enjoy it here.
Do they ever grow up?

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, no.  It's a funny thing about Horse Isle, but once animals go there, they don't age!  So these foals will be happy, playful foals forever.

replies.reply_text: Lucky them!  Thanks!

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, no, no.  Wouldn't you like a nice camel calf, though?

replies.reply_text: Sorry, that's not what I'm looking for today.

chatpoints.chat_text: Nope, sorry!

replies.reply_text: That's okay.  I'll keep looking.
Thank you, Phyllis!  I'm sure my horse will enjoy these!

chatpoints.chat_text: You know, there is something you could do for me!  I am running a bit low on foal formula for all the babies around here.  There seems to be a surplus of babies this season!  Do you think you could run and pick some up for me?

replies.reply_text: Sure.  I have a few minutes to spare.  Where do I need to go?
No, I really can't right now because I have other important things to do.  Maybe later.
I'll be right back!

chatpoints.chat_text: You were going to see Oliver Oates in Treeton to pick up some formula for all the babies here.

replies.reply_text: That's right!  Thanks for the reminder.
Thank you!  I'm so glad I could help today.

chatpoints.chat_text: (Phyllis suddenly recognizes you.) Oh! Why hello! How have you been? Thanks for getting that formula for me, that was such a help!

replies.reply_text: You're very welcome!  How's the foal adoption business?
You're welcome.  Just looking today, thanks.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, it's going... they come, they go, you know. (She looks a bit wistfully at a stall which now houses a cria.)

replies.reply_text: Anything special come in lately?
Good to hear it!  Well, I'll be going myself. Bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: (Phyllis begins arranging things on her desk in an absent sort of way.) Not lately, no. A while ago.... You know, they come and they go and you tell yourself, 'You can't get attached to them!' but sometimes one comes in, and you can't help yourself.

replies.reply_text: Sounds like that happened recently, did it?
Yeah, no point in getting attached.  Sorry, not into sob stories, bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, it sure did!  A little dun filly came in from the Foreign Isles.  Tiny little thing, absolutely adorable!  And I thought to myself, 'Oh, she's going to love being a foal all her life!'  Spending her days playing.  Such a beautiful thing.  Almost as many stripes as a zebra!  It pained me terribly to adopt her out, but ... eventually, I did.  And I heard recently that her new owner had moved to the Foreign Isles, and taken her.  So, now she'll grow up... and I wonder whatever has become of her.

replies.reply_text: It is sad.  I guess all you can do is take good care of the ones who come in, and hope for the best.
Oh, no!  Look at the time!  I absolutely must run home and exfoliate the laundry!  Bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: I guess so.  Still, I would love to find out how that filly is doing.

replies.reply_text: Do you know who adopted her?  Or even where they lived?  Somebody in the same area should know where they went, maybe you could send a letter through them.
It might actually be better to just put it all behind you and move on.

chatpoints.chat_text: It was somebody named Miss Knight... or was it Miss Bishop?  and I think they lived in Flipperton.  I have records somewhere in storage.  It would take me forever to go through them, though.

replies.reply_text: If you can't remember their name you won't advance much.  Well, it's probably better that way.  Good bye!
I have an idea, how about if next time I'm in Flipperton, I ask around and see if anyone there has an address?  Flipperton's a small town, I'm sure everyone knows everyone who's ever been there.

chatpoints.chat_text: Yes, I suppose you're right.  Now, what can I help you with today?

replies.reply_text: Let me look around and I'll let you know.
I'll come back as soon as I hear anything definite!  Wish me luck!  Bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: You do?  Wonderful!  What have you found out?

replies.reply_text: Yes, I spoke to Iona in Flipperton and she says that Miss Knight -- it is Miss Knight, by the way -- has family in up on Hare Isle.  Apparently working in the feed store.  Maybe they know where she's gone.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, Carrotton... I'm not going to be able get up that way for ages.  Oh well.

replies.reply_text: Oh well, I did my best.  I hope you manage to find your foal someday.  Bye.
Would you like me to stop in and ask next time I'm up that way myself?

chatpoints.chat_text: Would you?  That would be very kind!

replies.reply_text: Nah, I was only teasing!  Oh dear, look at the time, I need to be rushing home to water the crocodile.  Bye!
Sure!  I'll let you know what I find out.  Bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: You do?

replies.reply_text: Well, at least I hope I have it.  Here.  I got this from Ginger Craft in Carrotton.  She's Miss Knight's sister!

chatpoints.chat_text: Do you!  Wonderful!

replies.reply_text: Well, at least I hope I have it.  Here.  I got this from Ginger Craft in Carrotton.  She's Miss Knight's sister!
I believe I've heard of the place.  I'm sure the postal service knows where it is.   Well, thanks for the reward, and best of luck finding your favorite foal!

chatpoints.chat_text: Hmm?  Oh, Flipperton, I believe.

replies.reply_text: Oh!  Right!  I'm on it.

chatpoints.chat_text: Carrotton?  Who'd have thought.  Are you going to go check out that lead?

replies.reply_text: Uhm, yeah, sure.  I'll go do that now.
Yes, I am.  I was just passing through to get some supplies and thought I'd let you know.  I'll let you know what I find out.
Oh wow! The foal is adorable! Thanks so much.

npc_list.name: Cidny-grynstrit
npc_list.admin_description: at the entry to the Green Dragon's maze.
npc_list.long_description: If this dragon didn't have arms, legs and wings, he would roll.  It's impossible to imagine how he could fly--or if he ever even considered doing so.  He is impeccably groomed and well-spoken, and happily friendly in a somewhat overbearing way.

chatpoints.chat_text: I'm sorry, you will have to move.  I'm afraid this very spot is already taken.

replies.reply_text: Yeah, I can see that. Are you visiting here?
Okay, okay, I'm going.

chatpoints.chat_text: Visiting? (Cidny-grynstrit chuckles, as if at some private joke.) Well, you might say that. You might indeed. Visiting. Very amusing. Yes, I am visiting this lovely part of the world. On a quest, you might say. Do you like to talk? I like talking to a Rider who likes to talk.

replies.reply_text: Sure, I like to talk.  What do you want to talk about?
No, actually, I've got to be somewhere.  See you!

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, that all depends.  Yes indeed, it all depends.  It depends on your character, the kind of person you are.  It depends if you are the type who can rise to adversity.  Who can notice small details.  And who likes a mystery, yes indeed!

replies.reply_text: Oh, well, then, I'm your rider!
Maybe some other time, I'm in the middle of something right now.

chatpoints.chat_text: Better and better!  Yes, quite so.  So then.  I can count on your help?

replies.reply_text: No, I'm not responsible.  You can't count on me for much.  Bye.
Well, I can't promise anything unless I know exactly what it is you want.

chatpoints.chat_text: Ah!  You show caution!  I like a rider who is cautious.  It shows strength of character, yes it does.  Well, I will tell you then.  Prepare to be astounded with a tale such as you have never before heard in your life!

replies.reply_text: This wouldn't have anything to do with the Malted Falcon would it?
I'm not sure about this.  I'll... I'm sorry, I don't have time now.

chatpoints.chat_text: (Cidny-grynstrit's eyes become very wide, but then he resumes his jovial demeanor.) Ah, so you've heard about it, I see. Well, well. And you probably think it's just a recipe, don't you? No, indeed. It's more than that. Far more. Far more. I have been trying to get it for seventeen years! Not for what it says. No, anyone could have easily copied it. But for what is inside it! Under that black facade is a collection of the finest vanilla bean pods the world has ever known!

replies.reply_text: You want me to find it for you then?
What's so great about vanilla beans?  You can get those locally.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh yes, regular, ordinary vanilla beans can be gotten.  But these ... They are gems in themeselves. They impart flavor, without losing their substance.   They are worth a king's ransom and more!

replies.reply_text: I see... And this thing is yours, then?

chatpoints.chat_text: Let's just say that I would very much like it if I could have it, yes.  Will you get it for me?

replies.reply_text: No, I don't think so.  I've got too much else to do.  Good day to you.
I'll ... see if I can find it, okay.
But, how can I find you again if I...  Oh, he's gone.

npc_list.name: Louis Penguin
npc_list.short_description: A penguin living a solitary life.
npc_list.long_description: Louis, a lone penguin living under an assumed name, rumor has it that he once lived in Australia and resided in a Zoo there.

chatpoints.chat_text: G'day mate! Nice to meet you. Don't worry. I'm not afraid. I'm quite used to people. I used to meet hundreds a day. I once lived in a zoo, but one day........ Oh, you really don't want to know........ (He looks at you with eyes that are hoping you are going to ask for more of his story.)

replies.reply_text: Yep, you're right.  Bye!!
Please continue...

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, along came a "Babbage Machine" programmer from Finland. Well, he didn't read the sign that said "Don't Touch The Penguins", and he stuck his hand in my cage.   Well, you know, instinct took over and I bit his finger.

replies.reply_text: Oh, well, nice story, but I haven't time for this.
Okay, what happened next?

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, he told his friends about me.  And then my picture started to appear all over the place, with a story of how feisty I was. So I had to leave; and I escaped to this island, where I could live in peace.

replies.reply_text: Is there anything I can do for you?
I want to hear more, but I'll come back later to do that.  See you then.
That's too bad.  I guess I will leave you in peace.  Good luck with everything!

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, now that you mention it, I really miss eating an Australian fish called barramundi.  It was a real treat, but there is only one place where you can get it here.

replies.reply_text: Please go on.
Ah, another quest, I should have guessed.  I would be happy to help, but I'll come back later.  Bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, there was an expert fisherman that lived on Dolphin Isle, but I seemed to have lost track of him.

replies.reply_text: Maybe I can help you find him and see if I can get you some barramundi fish.
No thanks.  Bye!
You're welcome.  See you later.

chatpoints.chat_text: G'day mate.  Nice to see you back.

replies.reply_text: Yes, um, can you remember what I was doing for you?
Hello, I'm back!

chatpoints.chat_text: Ah, you were going to see if you could find the fisherman who used to live on Dolphin Isle.

replies.reply_text: Sure.  I'll go do that now.

chatpoints.chat_text: Hello mate.  You were gone for a long time.  How did it go?

replies.reply_text: I managed to get 15 fish for you.  He said you could go back and get some anytime you like.
Thank you very much.  I hope you enjoy them.

chatpoints.chat_text: We must keep that in mind. Maybe you can drop in and see if he has any more for me sometime. Now let me see what you have.

replies.reply_text: Sure.  Here they are.

chatpoints.chat_text: Thank you for the barramundi fish.  I really enjoyed them.  If you ever get any more, let me know.

replies.reply_text: Sure will.  Goodbye!
Hey Louis, I have some more barramundi fish for you.
Hey Louis, I have some more barramundi fish for you.
Hey Louis, I have some more barramundi fish for you.
Hey Louis, I have some more barramundi fish for you.
Hey Louis, I have some more barramundi fish for you.
Hey Louis, I have some more barramundi fish for you.

chatpoints.chat_text: G'day mate!  If they are as good as the last lot, I'd be happy to buy them off of you.

replies.reply_text: Sure, here you go.
Sure, here you go.
Sure, here you go.
Sure, here you go.
Sure, here you go.
Sure, here you go.
You're more than welcome.
You're more than welcome.
You're more than welcome.
You're more than welcome.
You're more than welcome.
You're more than welcome. Sam said that it is the end of the season for that fish, and there won't be any more for a while.

npc_list.name: Cupid
npc_list.admin_description: New Quests need to start at cp 14
npc_list.short_description: A red headed Cherub wearing a toga.
npc_list.long_description: Dimpled with an infectious grin, Cupid looks a bit mischievous. He has such kind eyes though, you figure the only mischief he causes it probably all in fun.

chatpoints.chat_text: Yes, that's right!  Except I'm retired now.  People don't need me to be able to fall in love anymore.

replies.reply_text: I guess you probably have things to be doing.  I'll be off and let you work.
Why do you live all the way out here?  I don't expect you get many visitors.
I think people still need you. Maybe they just don't realize it!

chatpoints.chat_text: I like it out here because I don't have people bugging me anymore.  Before I would have lots of people come up to me and ask me for love potions.  I don't even know how to make them.

replies.reply_text: I think I can understand that.  I wouldn't want a lot of people bugging me either.  Don't you get lonely though?
Interesting. Well, I should be off now.

chatpoints.chat_text: Hello!  How are you on this fine afternoon?

replies.reply_text: Not so good, I have too much work to do.  See you later.
I'm good.  Why are you dressed all funny like that?
I'm great!  I gave Venus those chocolates.   Now who else did you want some chocolates to go to?
I am fine and peachy dandy! And I come bearing a gift for you!
Well, excited and curious and also extremely frustrated!
Who did you say I should talk to regarding this chest?

chatpoints.chat_text: Funny?  Oh you mean the toga and the bow?  That's because I'm Cupid!

replies.reply_text: Cupid?  Oh you mean the cherub who goes around making people fall in love?
Sorry, togas aren't my thing.  I'm out of here.

chatpoints.chat_text: Sometimes.  I don't get many visitors.  I think you are the first person I've seen in weeks.

replies.reply_text: That's too bad.  I need to be going, but I do hope that more people come to visit you.
Is there anything I can help you with while I'm here?

chatpoints.chat_text: If you wouldn't mind, I do have some valentines and candy to deliver to a few old friends.  They live around the other smaller isles.  It might be hard work though.

replies.reply_text: Just some deliveries?  I think I can manage.  Who do I need to see first?
That does sound a bit difficult.  I think I should be going now.
Sure, I'll be back as soon as I can.  Go ahead and send me.
Oh, I don't want to go quite yet.  I'll come back to you when I want to go see her.

chatpoints.chat_text: Have you given her my gift yet?

replies.reply_text: Yes I did.
No, not yet.  Do you think you can send me back to the isle?
No, but I should be going.
Of course not.  I haven't seen her yet.  Could you send me there now though?

chatpoints.chat_text: Have you talked to Eros yet?

replies.reply_text: No, not yet.  Do you think you could send me to him?
Yes I did!  He said he enjoyed the gift very much.
Do you think you could send me back to Magma Isle?
No, but I should be going.
Sure, no problem.  What do you need me to do?
No thanks, that was enough for me.
Sure, I can do that.  Will you send me there?
Sure, but I don't want to go there yet.  I'll stop by when I am ready to go.
I'm just glad I could be of some help.  I should go now.

chatpoints.chat_text: How are you today?

replies.reply_text: I'm good.  Do you think you could send me back to Venus on Magma Isle?
I'm all right.  Could you send me back to Eros on Pumice Isle?
I'm fine.  I was just leaving.
Well, excited and curious and also a bit frustrated!
Who did you say I should talk to again regarding this chest?

chatpoints.chat_text: A gift for me? How delightful! Do tell. Or show, in this case!

replies.reply_text: A little birdie told Karee Dentin that you could use a bit of help, so she's started a dental hygiene campaign.
I'll be sure to do that. Have a super-duper day!

chatpoints.chat_text: My goodness! All at the same time?

replies.reply_text:
Exactly! I found this old chest - which is uber exciting!
What's inside? (You shake the chest so Cupid can hear
the rattling of whatever is inside). Doesn’t sound like
coins. It is more of a clunking sound.

chatpoints.chat_text: And the frustrated part?

replies.reply_text: I can't see a way to open it. That's super frustrating. There's the whole question of who buried it and why bury there? Do you anything about a dark mysterious chest with strange runes that was buried smack dab in the middle of this island?

chatpoints.chat_text: Strange runes? Oh, dear me! It must be true then! I heard tales of the ugliness, but I did not want to believe it. No, I did not! To intentionally whip up storms to create havoc and chaos?

replies.reply_text: Wait! What tales? What ugliness? Who whipped up storms? What chaos?

chatpoints.chat_text: I am suspicious this chest involves a tale of a dastardly deed most unsavory. Are you sure you want to open that box of worms? Not literally speaking, of course.

replies.reply_text: Oh yuck! Nope, I want no part of this. Thanks for the fair warning.
Well now I'm even more curious! Tell me more, please. Or tell me who I can talk to about this.

chatpoints.chat_text: I'm about love and joy. I'm not going to revisit that ugliness. I do wish you'd take that chest out of my home. Now.

replies.reply_text: Please, wait just a minute. Why would a buried chest upset you so much?

chatpoints.chat_text: The Mage of Magma Isle. He wanders near the volcanos. Odd fellow. Very odd.

replies.reply_text: Thanks so much!
Would you be able to send me to Magma?
Oh dear. I'm not sure I can get there. Do you have any suggestions?

chatpoints.chat_text: This is against my better judgement, but there is a mage that wanders near the volcanos of Magma Isle. If anyone knows the truth of the tale, it would be that mage.

replies.reply_text: Thank you so much!

chatpoints.chat_text: Sure.

replies.reply_text: Thanks so much!

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, if you are willing to do something for me first, travel to Magma could be arranged.

replies.reply_text: Terrific! What do you need done?
Never mind. I figure something else out.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, hello!  I didn't see you there.

replies.reply_text: I'm sorry, I didn't mean to startle you.  I guess I should be going.  I can see that you are busy.
Sorry about that, I didn't mean to startle you.
I'm ready for the next two items now.  What did you need?
I'm ready for the next items now.  What do you still need?
Oh, sorry about that.  How is your potion going?
Oh, sorry.  What was I getting for you this time?

chatpoints.chat_text: No problem.  What can I do for you today?

replies.reply_text: I'm fine, but I was actually stopping by to see if there was anything that I could help you with?
Nothing.  I'm good.  I should be leaving, though.  It was nice to see you.
Yeah, do you think you could send me back to Cupid?
Actually, Cupid sent me here.
I have those roses you wanted!
What was I doing again?
I have the bananas and strawberries you needed!
I have the cinnamon and chocolate you needed!

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, really? I did hear that you help people out. (She thinks for a few moments.) There actually is something I need, if you wouldn't mind helping me.

replies.reply_text: Of course not!  That's why I offered to help.
Well, umm I actually just remembered I had something else I should be doing.  Perhaps I'll be back later.

chatpoints.chat_text: Did he now?  It has been a while since I have seen him.  How is he doing?

replies.reply_text: He's fine, though a bit lonely.  He says that he is sorry he can't come visit as often and sent me with this box of chocolates for you.
He's okay.  I should be going, though.  Bye.
No problem!  Do you think you could send me back to Cupid?
No problem!  I think I'm going to check out the area a little more, then maybe I'll have you send me back to Cupid.

chatpoints.chat_text: Fine by me.  Enjoy exploring.

replies.reply_text: Thanks.

chatpoints.chat_text: Thank you!  I was afraid I would have to leave to go and get the ingredients I need, but it looks like I have some help now!  I'm working on a small potion here.  I make potions that make people feel better, you see?  Not a medicine, but more of a soothing concoction that helps boost their spirits.

replies.reply_text: I think I understand.  These potions help people feel happier?  They boost their self-esteem?
I'm rather confused, I think this may be a little over my head.  I should be going now.

chatpoints.chat_text: Exactly.  There isn't really anything in my potions that make people feel better.  It's more of a mental type of thing.  The only thing I really do is make them taste good.

replies.reply_text: As interesting as this sounds, I don't think I have the time to help you with this.
Wait, so if it doesn't really do anything, then why do people get them from you?

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, that's because they usually get these from friends, family, and people they love.  It makes them special in a way.  I also don't do any sort of false advertising.  The only thing that I really say is that it tastes good.  They can also last much longer than most drinks and so can be stored up.  Though I have noticed that they cure those horrid headaches.

replies.reply_text: This sounds like it might be a little too much for me.  Maybe I'll come back later if I feel the need to get one.
I think I get it now.  So it sounds like you needed some ingredients, then?

chatpoints.chat_text: Ah, yes, that's right.  Thank you for reminding me.  I tend to get a bit off topic sometimes.  I don't want to over-burden you at the moment, so I'll start out with the first two items.  Do you think you can handle that?

replies.reply_text: Two items?  That doesn't sound too bad.  What are you in need of?
The first two?  How many are there going to be?  I don't think I can handle this.  I'll just be going now.
Okay, then.  Could you send me to Cupid, please?
I'll get right on that, but first I think I'm going to do a little exploring before I head off.

chatpoints.chat_text: That's fine.  Just come back here when you're ready to leave the isle.

replies.reply_text: Okay, I will.
Yes, what are they?
No, I don't think I am.
Hmm... That does sound a little harder, but I'm sure I can do it.  Can you send me back to Cupid now?
First I need a little break.  I'll come back when I'm ready to go back to Cupid.

chatpoints.chat_text: I needed three red roses and two yellow roses.  Please do hurry, though.

replies.reply_text: Ah, I remember now.  I'll hurry back.

chatpoints.chat_text: I need a bunch of bananas from Cupcake, and ten strawberries.

replies.reply_text: Oh, that's right.  I'll be back as soon as I can.
No, I think I need a small break.  As soon as I'm ready I'll come back.
I'm ready.  What do you need now?
I'm going to look around the island before I leave.  I'll be back when I'm done.
Okay, I can do that.  Do you think you could send me back to Cupid?

chatpoints.chat_text: I need cinnamon from Bena and chocolate from Nana.  Please do hurry.

replies.reply_text: Oh, that's right.  I'll be back as soon as I'm done.
Thank you, I was glad I could be of some use.  Bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: Wonderfully.  Thank you again for your help.

replies.reply_text: You're welcome.  Goodbye!

npc_list.name: Eros
npc_list.admin_description: A tall handsome man

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, hello!  What can I do for you?

replies.reply_text: Oh, nothing.  I think I'm going to explore a little.
Cupid sent me here to see how you were doing.
Could you send me back to Cupid?
I was just in the area and thought I would see how you were doing.  I don't imagine you get a lot of company.
Oh, nothing.  I was just passing by and thought I might as well stop in.  Is there anything that I can do for you?
Where did you say that I could find your wife Parisa again?
I found Parisa!  She was having some trouble finding the rest of a fossil.  She said that she would be home soon, though.
I talked to Nerina!  It turns out that she has a cold.
What was I doing for you again?  I can't seem to remember.

chatpoints.chat_text: You had agreed that you would check in on Nerina for me.  She lives just to the south of here.  Please come back when you have talked with her.

replies.reply_text: Oh, okay.  I remember now.  I'll hurry back.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, really?  How is he?

replies.reply_text: He's okay.  I should be going though.  Bye.
He's doing well, though he does seem to be a little lonely. He sent me here to give you this. (You hand over the chocolates.)
Sure, I can do that.  I'm sure he will be glad to hear from you. Could you send me back to him?
I'll get right on that!  But first, I want to explore a little more.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh! Well, I'm glad you stopped by.  I am actually starting to get a little worried.  You see, my wife, Parisa, has been gone a while.  It's almost dark, and I want to make sure she gets home soon.

replies.reply_text: Your wife?   I wouldn't mind finding her, if you want.
I'm sorry, but I just remembered that I have something else to do.  Bye.
Don't worry, I'll find her.

chatpoints.chat_text: You'll find her at the southeast corner of this isle, she's an archaeologist, so she should be relatively easy to find.  Just look for the dust cloud!  Ha ha! Just joking.

replies.reply_text: Thank you!  I remember now.  I'll be back as soon as I find her.
Thank you!  I am glad that I could be of some help.

chatpoints.chat_text: That is very kind of you.  You are right, though.  I really don't get a whole lot of company out here.  Though Nerina does stop in, usually.  However, I haven't seen her around lately, and I'm beginning to get rather worried.  She lives all by herself and if something happened to her, no one would really know.

replies.reply_text: I'm sure she's all right.  Maybe she is just really busy.  Kind of like me.  I'll see you around.
Oh no!  What if she fell ill?  I suppose she might just be busy, but maybe someone should check up with her, just in case something did happen.

chatpoints.chat_text: I would, but I've just been so busy lately.  Hey!  Would you mind checking up on her?  If you aren't busy, that is.

replies.reply_text: I actually have plenty of time.  Could you just point me in the right direction?
As much as I would love to help you out, I just don't have the time to be checking up on everyone.  I'm sure she's fine though.  I guess I will see you later.
After I check up on her I will be back as quickly as I can be.
She seemed like she was getting better when I talked to her.  See you later.

npc_list.name: Capri
npc_list.admin_description: First place you find Capri, as a marker of where to rake. NO NEW QUESTS
npc_list.long_description: A fragile, nervous-looking Faun.

chatpoints.chat_text: (Looks up in surprise) Oh!

replies.reply_text: I'm sorry to startle you... Do you live here?
Well, you never know what you'll see in this forest.  Back to looking for red pine cones...
Whoops!  What did I just see?

npc_list.name: Wee Troll
npc_list.long_description: The smallest, brownest, most wizened troll you've ever seen. He's certainly got a face only a mother could love.

chatpoints.chat_text: Hi, big hoo-man!

replies.reply_text: Hello Wee Troll!  Are you ready to go home to Rider Isle?  I'm here to lead you back.  Your parents are worried about you!
Ew, what a horrible looking fish!  I'll remember not to water my horses in this pond.
Oh, no... I hope he went home!

chatpoints.chat_text: (She jumps when you knock on the door.) Oh, wow. Umm, come in. Sorry, I'm a little engrossed in this puzzle.

replies.reply_text: Oh, sorry.  I'll leave you be so you can keep, um, working.  Bye.
Hi!  Sorry to startle you.  What are you working on?

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, just thinking up puzzles that can be done with a checkerboard.  It passes the time and uses the brain.

replies.reply_text: That sounds fun.  I'll leave you to it.
Say, you don't happen to have anything that needs doing, do you?

chatpoints.chat_text: Actually, I really do.  I had a dinner party last night.  Everyone on the isle was invited.  Anyway, we played a lot of games and had fun.  The problem is, someone took one of my game pieces.  It's a handcarved knight from my chess set.

replies.reply_text: Oh, no!  Someone stole it?
That's terrible!  Good luck getting it back.  Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, I don't want to jump to conclusions.  It could have been an accident.  A couple people brought their own games, so maybe it got mixed in.

replies.reply_text: Well, what can I do?
That does sound plausible.  I hope you find it.

chatpoints.chat_text: If you could ask around and see if anyone has it or has seen it?  That would be a huge help.

replies.reply_text: That's a lot of people!  Maybe I'll come back later when I have more time.
I can do that.
Phew.  I'm glad I don't have to run up to Rainy Meadows.  I'll go talk to people now.

chatpoints.chat_text: Welcome back!  Any luck?

replies.reply_text: I'm sorry, I completely forgot what I was doing for you.
Not yet.  I'll keep talking to people.
Maybe!  I talked to Vern in Tropicton.  He said he and Rebecca put it away.  So, I'm off now to talk to Rebecca.  Bye.
Yes!  Rebecca had it!  She said her long sleeves must have accidentally brushed it into her bag while she and Vern were putting it away.  She apologized profusely.

chatpoints.chat_text: You were asking my neighbors and the people in Tropicton if they have, or at least saw, my missing, handcarved knight piece from my chess set.

replies.reply_text: Ah, that's right.  I'll go talk to people now.
You're welcome.

npc_list.name: Koko
npc_list.admin_description: jumps you back to Lava Isle
npc_list.long_description: Before you is a small, but disheveled woman.  Her hair is everywhere and her clothes seem to be just thrown on without any care of thought.

chatpoints.chat_text: (She is spinning in circles and laughing hysterically.)

replies.reply_text: Wow. I'll just go. (You run out the door, almost tripping down the ladder.)
Umm...  Excuse me?
Hi again.  I need to go back to Lava Isle again.  Maybe you could get me closer to Patsy this time?  You kind of missed last time.
Hello Koko.  Patsy sent me to find you.
Okay, Koko.  I'm back.
Okay, Koko.  I looked and can't find them, who did you say might know where they are?
Look, Koko, I found the sword, now where did you throw the shield?
Hey Koko.  So, I found part of the sword.  What did you do with the hilt of it?

chatpoints.chat_text: (She stops spinning for a second.) Hahahaha!! A guest! Wonderful!

replies.reply_text: Aren't you dizzy?
Well, uh, do you know of any way off this isle?
Um, would you know anything about this chest?

chatpoints.chat_text: Dizzy? (She lets out a huge laugh.) Never! Far too much fun. Woohoo! ( She starts spinning and dancing again.)

replies.reply_text: Oh, all right.  Well, enjoy.  Bye!
Well, do you know of any way off this isle?

chatpoints.chat_text: Of course! I can even send you to Patsy, if you like. He is a friend, you know. (She lets out a snort and starts bouncing.)

replies.reply_text: You know, I don't quite trust you to get me there.  I think I'll just try to find another way.  Goodbye!
All right. I hope you can get me there. Go ahead and send me. (You shut your eyes expecting the worst.)

chatpoints.chat_text: (She stops spinning briefly.) Missed?! Impossible. Here, I do better this time.

replies.reply_text: Okay.  Go ahead and send me.  I'm ready.
You know what?  Maybe later.  Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: (She stops spinning momentarily.) Oh, goody!! I like Patsy. He's my friend!
