replies.reply_text: This sounds like its leading right into another quest. I need a break. See ya!
That's too bad. Are you hoping to find her a new home?
Maybe you need to feed her more often.
I take it you need more fish?

chatpoints.chat_text: She has to be getting tired of eating scorpions and lizards. I wish I had about three little fish for her. That would make a perfect dinner for her.

replies.reply_text: Scorpions? Lizards? Yuck!!! I don't blame her. I could get you those fish.
Looks like you need to get yourself a fishing pole. I think the closest place for you to buy one is Hotton. Good luck!

chatpoints.chat_text: Would you really do that? I'm sure you must be busy...

replies.reply_text: You're right, I really am busy. But when I find some time, I'll get those fish for you.
Busy, yes. But never too busy to help an animal in need. If she needs fish, fish she'll get!
Thank you for reminding me. I've got homework to get done, animals to feed, other quests to pursue...
I have 3 little fish right here in my saddlebags!
I'm sure I'll be back soon.
Thanks, and see you later!

chatpoints.chat_text: It's an old tradition to making adobe bricks. You cook up the prickly pear pads. Then you add soil and dried grasses to the resulting slurry. The cactus pulp helps bind the materials and make the bricks more durable. At least that is what my grandmother always told me.

replies.reply_text: That sounds interesting. If I had more time, I'd ask you more about that. However, I'm really in need of that copper-bottom pot... Can I pay you for it?
You know, while that sounds interesting, I've been here way too long already. I've got homework that needs attention. Later, dude!
Wow. Imagine that. So cactus actually is good for something!

chatpoints.chat_text: It sure is. It is used as a food, moisture and home source for many of the desert inhabitants. And we use cactus in multiple ways, too. Where do you think nopales come from? And cactus jelly?

replies.reply_text: Ah, right. I see your point. No more disparaging words from me regarding cacti! But about that pot. I really, really need it. Care to sell it to me?
Whoa! I don't have time for a nature lecture right now. I am soooo outta here!
Now that you point it out...  Pack rats use cholla for their middens, if I remember correctly.  And don't they use the organ pipe cactus, or maybe a relative of it, to make rain sticks?

chatpoints.chat_text: Exactly. Now, back to why you are here. Was there some reason you came to see me?

replies.reply_text: Silly me! I got sidetracked. I sure did. I understand you have a copper-bottom pot you might not need anymore?
Yikes! All this gabbing about cactus in the desert has made me lose track of time. I've got pets to feed and homework to do. Later!

chatpoints.chat_text: While lemonade sounds good, once I drink it, I will have nothing lasting for the trade.

replies.reply_text: That makes sense. What did you have in mind?
This is getting way too complicated for me. I'm heading back to greener pastures. If I have a change of heart, I'll let you know.
Look. I've already invested a ton of time, travel, and energy trying to get this quest done for Stinky. Just tell me what you want. Please! I assume that would make your life easier, too?

chatpoints.chat_text: Actually, I was thinking about the roasted scallops that Fitzgerald makes. I think I love them as much as Shadow does.

replies.reply_text: Oh, that's easy enough. I'll head over there now!
Riiiiight. I'm not big on shellfish. Maybe you can find someone else to help you. Sorry!
I'll be back in a jiffy!
Enjoy!

chatpoints.chat_text: Sand dunes are poetry in motion. A patchwork of patterns that sing of the shifting winds and the coming monsoons. Signs can be subtle. Sublime.

replies.reply_text: Sheesh! What are you? Some kind of new-age bard? A nomadic poet? All I want to know is -- do you have a copper-bottom pot I can buy from you?
This sounds suspiciously like it is leading to a quiz on the desert or poetry. I think I'll take my leave now. Got to gallop!
As much as I like poetry, I'd rather talk about why I'm here. I understand you have a copper-bottom pot you might not need anymore?

chatpoints.chat_text: The palm trees that grow in Patch Forest have really flexible fronds. It must be the soil or water there. Anyway, that's what I need. You'll need to search near the oasis.

replies.reply_text: Darn. I don't remember a Patch Forest. Do you know which island that is on?
Patch Forest? I know exactly where that is! I'll be back in a few!

chatpoints.chat_text: I sure don't. If you had a map of the islands, I suppose you could spend a minute or two reviewing it.

replies.reply_text: Lookie here, lookie here! That's exactly what I have! You are brilliant, dude! Later.
Good point. I'll check it right now. Later!

chatpoints.chat_text: I'm content living in the desert. I just need to figure out how to make her diet more interesting.

replies.reply_text: More interesting? Why would you say that?
How about a scorpion omelet? Lizard ka-bobs? Cactus salad? Just kidding! Good luck!

chatpoints.chat_text: That's an interesting concept. I'm not sure what you mean by that, though.

replies.reply_text: Well, if I give you a fish, you get one meal out of it, right? But if I give you a fishing pole, and teach you to fish, you can catch meals for the rest of your life! See?
I'm not sure, either. But I thought it sounded good! Okay, you want fish.

chatpoints.chat_text: That doesn't look too difficult!

replies.reply_text: It really isn't. With a little practice, you'll be catching enough fish to keep both you and Shadow happy. Here you go -- they are all yours!
Practice, practice, practice! That's what it is all about. I bet there are all kinds of varities that you'll be catching off shore. Take these, and enjoy!
Thanks! Enjoy yourself.

chatpoints.chat_text: Great, just great. But there is something else I was hoping you'd help me with.

replies.reply_text: I hope you don't want to go deep-sea fishing. I get way too sea-sick for that!
Another quest? Hmmm. Knowing you, its probably an easy one. Problem is, I'm outta time, and outta here!

chatpoints.chat_text: You were getting me some roasted scallops from Fitzgerald.

replies.reply_text: Now I remember! Be back in a jiffy!

chatpoints.chat_text: You were bringing me three little fish for Shadow.

replies.reply_text: Oh, that's right! I'll be right back.
And I have them right here!

chatpoints.chat_text: You're right.  She just finished them.  She really loved them, too.  You couldn't get more, could you?

replies.reply_text: I really don't have time now.  Maybe later.
I could, but you know that old saying, "Give a man a fish, he'll eat for a day.  Teach a man to fish, he'll eat for a lifetime." Or something like that.

npc_list.name: Shadow
npc_list.long_description: An adorable gray and white kitten that sits in Augie's shadow.

chatpoints.chat_text: Meow.

replies.reply_text: Hi kitty!

npc_list.name: Captain Spaldeen
npc_list.long_description: Slightly pointy hair, bushy eyebrows, and an enormous mustache--Captain Spaldeen stand before you.  Swaggering back and forth in a morning coat and brandishing a chocolate cigar, he appraises you in a way that would almost make your skin crawl if it weren't so comical.

chatpoints.chat_text: Hey!  What are you doing here?  Don't you know this is MY little slice of heaven on earth?  Now scram before I call a cop!

replies.reply_text: Are you Rupert T. Firetruck?

chatpoints.chat_text: Never mind that.  Who are you, and why are you here?  Come to think of it, who am I, and why am I here?  Oh!  I remember!  I'm here to chase you out of here!  Now scram!  Unless you brought a magazine or a nice big pot of coffee and a danish.  Say, do you know, you haven't stopped talking since you walked in here.  You must have been vaccinated with a phonograph needle.

replies.reply_text: You don't understand!  I've been sent by Mrs. Glory Beesdale!  I absolutely have to find the Leader of Spreedonia!  She's desperate to have him back!

chatpoints.chat_text: She's desperate? What do you call a man sitting out here all alone in the jungle with nothing to eat but walnuts? I'm just a wreck of my former self, which nobody can deny! Whoo-hooo! Here! Pick a card!

replies.reply_text: I don't want a card!  Please, Mr. Firetruck, you have to go back to Spreedonia!  The country needs you!
A card?  What'll I do with a card?

chatpoints.chat_text: You can keep it, I've got 51 left.  Now, er.... What was it you were saying about Mrs. Beesdale?  Ah, Glory...

replies.reply_text: Sorry, none of this!  I told Mrs. Beesdale I'd find you, and find you I have!

chatpoints.chat_text: You're not the only one who's find me!  The other day I was speeding down the Antelope Freeway and a cop find me.  In fact he fined $50.

replies.reply_text: Oh, your Excellency....
Look, just... get me out of here, okay?
And THEN I got this ridiculous note from Blinky.
And THEN I went searching everywhere for you... All I knew was that you were in the jungle somewhere.

chatpoints.chat_text: Look!  Just look around you!  Sun, green grass, fresh air!  Why should I go back to Spreedonia and risk life and limb trying to cross the street?

replies.reply_text: Because Spreedonia needs you!  Mrs. Beesdale needs you!  Because I worked so hard to track you down!  First I had to find Chickletti and Blinky...

chatpoints.chat_text: They should be fined!

replies.reply_text: THEN I had to get this stupid code from Chickletti--
And THEN he sold me this stupid Code Book.  Here, you've got the Code, you might as well have the Code Book.

chatpoints.chat_text: ......Well.......  All right.  For Glory B.'s sake, I'll go back to Spreedonia!  I'm sure there's something there I haven't ruined yet.  Go, young traveller, go back to Mrs. Beesdale, and tell her to meet me right outside the bank.  Go, and let no darkness hinder you and no hindness darker you.

replies.reply_text: All right, but, can you--

chatpoints.chat_text: A likely story - and probably true!

replies.reply_text: Well, will you come back?  For Glory's sake?
Well, will you come back?  For Glory's sake?

npc_list.name: Wu Kung
npc_list.long_description: Wu Kung is in his tree house practicing his forms.  He is spry for his age, although his attention occasionally drifts.  He is the master of Monkey Fist Kung-Fu.

chatpoints.chat_text: Greetings, young one!

replies.reply_text: Greetings, (You bow with respect.) venerable one.
Hi right back at ya!
Forgive me master, but where did you say you used to live?
Greetings, (You bow with respect.) venerable one. I have returned with your staff.
Again, I beg your forgiveness, but where did you say I could find Master Lau?
Master Wu Kung, (You bow with respect.) I have returned with the other four sections of the staff.
Venerable one, (You bow with respect.) I have returned. Is the next project ready?
Excuse me, Master Wu Kung, but where am I going for you again?
Greetings, (You bow with respect.) master. I have returned from Grand Master Lung Ch'uan.
Hello!  I was just looking around; didn't mean to bother you... Bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: It's about time you returned.  It's been, what, 30 years since we last saw each other?

replies.reply_text: Last saw each other?? We've never met!  I think I better be going, bye!
I'm afraid you are mistaken, but might I be of some help?

chatpoints.chat_text: Help? Help?? Do I look so feeble that I need help? (Wu Kung snatches a fly in midair with a pair of chop sticks he takes from his sleeve.) Could a feeble man do that?

replies.reply_text: Sorry if I upset you, but I was wondering if you might have any chores or errands that you need done.
Probably not.  Sorry to have bothered you.  Goodbye.

chatpoints.chat_text: Long, long ago, our master bestowed upon us a five-sectioned staff...

replies.reply_text: Excuse me, but what do you mean by "us"?
Nope, no "us" here, only you and if you're seeing more people, then it's time for me to go!

chatpoints.chat_text: You know what I mean... oh, wait... you don't.  I'm sorry, sometimes I get a little confused.  My master trained five of us in the five styles of Kung-Fu.  Each one in the style most suited to us.  Besides myself, there was Lau the tiger, Hoa the crane, Shua the snake, and Tang the praying mantis.

replies.reply_text: Oh, no... Tigers and snakes... This is not for me!
Oh, I see.  Please go on.

chatpoints.chat_text: As I was saying, our master gave us a five sectioned staff to share amongst ourselves.  At first it went well.  Each of us would hold the staff for our allotted length of time and then pass it on to the next master.  This went on for decades, but eventually we started to argue and fight over the staff.

replies.reply_text: That doesn't sound very good!
I get it, a bunch of old critters started acting like spoiled brats... Great story!  I am so outta here.

chatpoints.chat_text: Are you sure I didn't already tell you this story?  Hmmm... Maybe not.  Anyway, our bickering got back to our master. He called us together and took the staff, separated the pieces and gave each of us a section of the staff.  He told us that the staff will remain in pieces until such time that we can learn to exist in harmony.

replies.reply_text: Your master must have been very wise.
So he broke the staff and you guys learned a lesson...  What's the point?  See ya!

chatpoints.chat_text: Ah, yes, the Master is an extremely wise and venerable individual.

replies.reply_text: Okay, I understand the five pieces of the staff and all that, but what does it have to do with me?

chatpoints.chat_text: Ah, young one, it is time to unite the sections of the staff and I could use your assistance finding my section of the staff.  I hid it in the jungle many years ago for safe keeping, but I can't seem to remember exactly where it is!

replies.reply_text: You lost something in the jungle and you want me to find it? I don't think so.
I could do that for you.  Do you remember anything about where you hid it?

chatpoints.chat_text: I used to live in a tree not unlike this one, southeast of here near a small village, until they moved into my clearing.

replies.reply_text: Who are they?
So go back to your old tree and get the piece... Duh!  Good luck!
Sure, I'll be back as soon as I find your staff.

chatpoints.chat_text: I know I told you.  I used to live in the clearing southeast of here until Shawnah and her father moved there with their plants!

replies.reply_text: Oh, yeah, now I remember!  Be back soon!
Okay, I'll go see Master Lau... on an island northeast of here, you say?  I'll be back later!

chatpoints.chat_text: Ah, yes, Master Lau, like myself, has come to prefer the seclusion of life near a jungle temple.  He lives near one of the first temples on a small island northeast of here.

replies.reply_text: Look for Master Lau by the Jungle Temples on the northern islands.  Got it!

chatpoints.chat_text: Young one, I was so sure you were the chosen one to complete my mission.

replies.reply_text: I am honored, Master.
Thank you, Master Wu Kung.  Is there anything else that I can do for you?

chatpoints.chat_text: You have been a great help.  If you come see me again, I may have another task for you.

replies.reply_text: I will, farewell!

chatpoints.chat_text: Come closer young one, I must see if you are ready to assist me yet again.

replies.reply_text: All right, Master Wu Kung.
I'm honored to know that I am worthy.  Now, how can I help?

chatpoints.chat_text: If memory serves, I told you of our master and the saga of the 5-sectioned staff. (Wu Kung is now twirling the staff all around you.) It is now time to return the staff to our master to prove that we have learned the errors of our ways.

replies.reply_text: So, all I have to do is return the staff to your master?  How hard can that be?  Who's your master?
Okay, I can do that, bring back the staff to your master... cool!  What is your master anyway?  Another monkey, or a tiger?  Perhaps even another snake?

chatpoints.chat_text: Ah, our master, Lung Ch'uan, is a great dragon.

replies.reply_text: A dragon? You are sending me to a dragon?? I'm sorry, but I don't do dragons. (You turn and run.)
So, Master Lung Ch'uan is a dragon?  Okay, where can I find him?
Your master is the Red Dragon? All right, I'll bring this to him, I just hope he's receiving visitors when I get there!

chatpoints.chat_text: He will see you when he learns of your mission.  Please remember to return to me after you give Master Lung Ch'uan the staff.  I am eager to hear of his response.

replies.reply_text: Okay.  Give the Red Dragon the staff, and come back to tell you what he says.  Got it.  I'll see you soon!

chatpoints.chat_text: You are going to Lava Isle to deliver the staff to the Red Dragon.  Then you are to come back to see me.  Simple enough?

replies.reply_text: Lava... Red Dragon... back to you.  Got it!  Bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: You have returned, young one!  Did you find the Grand Master in good health?

replies.reply_text: The Grand Master is contented living his life of solitude.  He did send this package back for you.
Thank you very much, Master.  It has been a great honor to meet all of you.

chatpoints.chat_text: Wonderful.  Did he have packages for all the masters?

replies.reply_text: He did.  I already gave the others their packages.  Here is yours.
He did.  I suppose I'll finish delivering those first.

npc_list.name: Master Lau
npc_list.long_description: Master Lau is short tempered and brooding.  He is practicing his style of Tiger Claw Kung-Fu.

chatpoints.chat_text: (Master Lau looks you over, and roars ferociously!) Who are you, and why are you bothering me?

replies.reply_text: Me? I'm nobody. (Backing away.) Sorry to disturb you. Goodbye!
Are you the great and powerful Master Lau?  Wu Kung sent me to find you.
Excuse me, Master Lau, but where did you say to look for your staff?
Master Lau, I have returned with your section of the staff.
Forgive me, Master Lau, but where is Master Hoa again?
Master Lau, I've returned and I bring you greetings from Grand Master Lung Ch'uan.

chatpoints.chat_text: Yes, I am Lau. (Growling at you.) Now what did that little fur ball send you to me for?

replies.reply_text: Wu Kung told me about the five masters and the staff.  He asked me to find you and ask you for your section of the staff.
Stop growling at me, I'm trying to tell you why he sent me!  He sent me to get your section of the master's staff.

chatpoints.chat_text: (Roaring.) He did, did he?! And why should I give my section of the staff to him?

replies.reply_text: He said that the time has come to reunite the pieces of the staff.
You know? Maybe you're right and you shouldn't... I'll just go now. (You swiftly walk away.)

chatpoints.chat_text: It has been separated for a very long time, perhaps he is right... this time. But what makes you think that you are worthy enough to collect the sections?

replies.reply_text: I really don't know if I'm worthy enough, all I know is that Wu Kung asked me to get your section of the staff.... so here I am.  If you don't want to give me the section, then fine, don't.  I'm just the messenger here!
How should I know, Wu Kung sent me to you to get the section, and I'm here... Where's the section?

chatpoints.chat_text: (Laughing.) Wu Kung was always a sharp judge of character. I can see why he asked you. You are brave and quick witted, yet humble. Let's see if you can find my section of the staff. I placed it under a boulder near a jungle temple.

replies.reply_text: Do you know how many temples there are on this island?  Could you give me a little help?
After I find it, what do I do with it?

chatpoints.chat_text: If you can find my section of the staff, bring it back to me.

replies.reply_text: Okay, will do!

chatpoints.chat_text: (Growling.) Do you not pay attention? I placed the section under a boulder near one of the northern jungle temples.

replies.reply_text: Oh, right,  don't go to the southern jungles, stay to the north.  Got it!
All right, Master Hoa is next.  Thank you, Master Lau.

chatpoints.chat_text: I'm not exactly sure, but I believe you will find him on Bird Isle.

replies.reply_text: Bird Isle.  Oh, yeah, you did tell me that.  Thanks!

chatpoints.chat_text: That crafty little fur ball, Wu Kung, sent you to find the Grand Master?  I am impressed that you succeeded in finding him.  Is he well?

replies.reply_text: Yes, actually, he's quite well.  In fact, he asked that I deliver this package to you.
Why, thank you Master Lau, it has indeed been an honor. (You bow towards Master Lau.)

npc_list.name: Master Shua
npc_list.long_description: Master Shua is blunt, but quick witted. He loves puzzles. He is practicing Snake Form of Kung-Fu in the shadows of the pyramid.

chatpoints.chat_text: Who are you, and why are you disssturbing me?

replies.reply_text: Eeewww!! A snake! (You turn and run away!)
Master Shua, I presume?  I bring you greetings from Masters Wu Kung, Lau, and Hoa.
Excuse me, Master Shua, but where did you say I would find Master Tang again?
I've returned Master Shua, and this time I bring you greetings from Grand Master Lung Ch'uan.
Pardon me, Master Shua, but I seem to have spazzed out for a moment.  What was your puzzle again?

chatpoints.chat_text: Do you now?  Why would they ssssend you to find me?

replies.reply_text: Well... Master Wu Kung told me about the five sectioned staff.  He said that it's time to reunite the pieces.  I helped him find his section, then I went to Master Lau and got his section.  Then to Master Hoa and got his...

chatpoints.chat_text: It ssseemsss that they have kept you quite busssy.  Can you give me one reasssson why I ssshould give you my sssection of the ssstaff?

replies.reply_text: How about the fact that the other masters have entrusted their sections of the staff to me...

chatpoints.chat_text: Ah, you ssshow both bravery and a quick wit.  I sssee why you were chosssen.  But, you will have to work hard to get my sssection of the sssstaff.

replies.reply_text: Work hard!  So far I've had to dodge vicious plants, lift big boulders, and climb every willow tree on Bird Isle!  How hard can your chore be?
You know, I think I've worked hard enough.  Maybe I'll come back later to get your staff.  Bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: You need to learn patiencssse youngling.  If you can ssssolve 3 puzzlesss, I will give you my ssssection of the ssstaff.

replies.reply_text: All you want me to do is solve some puzzles?  That's it?
Puzzles?  Puzzles??  That's the best you got?  This is going to be a breeze!  Go ahead, shoot!
Okay, Master Shua, give it your best shot!

chatpoints.chat_text: All right young one, how much isss four sssscore and ssseven?
Try again!

replies.reply_text: Okay.

chatpoints.chat_text: A good warm up... Now try thisss one:  Five people crowd together under an umbrella, but no one getssss wet.  How can thissss be?

replies.reply_text: It's a really big umbrella!
It's not raining.
They are all wearing raincoats and hats.
They are already wet.

chatpoints.chat_text: Try again!

replies.reply_text: Okay.

chatpoints.chat_text: Now for the lasssst puzzle.  Mice are famousss for multiplying rapidly.  This breed of mousssse givesss birth once a month, having 12 babiesss each time.  Baby mice mature and can give birth after 2 monthsss.  You bought one of thesssse cute baby mice 10 monthsss ago, how many mice do you now have?
Try again!

replies.reply_text: Okay.
Thank you, Master Shua.  It has been an honor meeting you.  Now, I'm off to Flower Isle.

chatpoints.chat_text: Masssster Tang isss on Flower Isle.  He'sss a mantisss so look around the plantssss.

replies.reply_text: Flower Isle, look among the plants.  Got it!

chatpoints.chat_text: Wu Kung ssssent you to find Grand Massster Lung Ch'uan?  And how did you find the venerable old dragon?

replies.reply_text: The Grand Master is well, but now lives a life of seclusion.  He asked me to give this package to you.
Thank you, Master Shua.  Perhaps we will meet again someday.

npc_list.name: Master Hoa
npc_list.long_description: Master Hoa is a very laid back individual.  He reminds you of an aging Hippie!  He's practicing his White Crane Kung-Fu style.

chatpoints.chat_text: Far out, dude.  Welcome!

replies.reply_text: Far out, yourself.... uh, dude... (You turn and leave hastily.)
Do I have the honor of addressing Master Hoa?
Excuse me, Master Hoa, but where did you say to look again?
I'm back, Master Hoa!
I'm sorry Master Hoa, but where did you say I could find Master Shua?
Master Hoa, I've returned, and this time I bring you greetings from Grand Master Lung Ch'uan.

chatpoints.chat_text: Dig it, dude, I'm Hoa.  Like, what's happening?

replies.reply_text: Wu Kung is gathering the 5 sections of the staff your Master gave you all.  I found his section, and I have Master Lau's section.  Master Lau sent me to you for your section of the staff.
What's happening?  What's happening... Oh, yeah... Right!  Wu Kung sent me to get all of the sections of the Master's staff.  Can I have yours?

chatpoints.chat_text: Out of sight, man!

replies.reply_text: Okay... Does that mean I can have your section of the staff... or not?
I'm sorry, but I don't speak latent Hippie..  What did you say?  Can I have the staff?

chatpoints.chat_text: Like, totally, dude.  It's all yours... if you can find it!  I had it, but, like, I left it somewhere around here.

chatpoints.chat_text: Nope. Now then. Are you here to buy something or are you just wasting my time?

replies.reply_text: Oh. So sorry. Not here to buy anything, so I will stop wasting your time and leave. Like, right now!

npc_list.name: Oddly
npc_list.admin_description: New Quests must start at CP 12. Magma Isle visibility req: 2369
npc_list.long_description: Dressed in the purest jet black you have ever seen, this Mage wears a tall hat and several sets of flowing robes, embroidered with gold and silver threads.

chatpoints.chat_text: Where do you get those?  Good night nurse!  If I knew where to get them, I'd get them myself!  Now, go get me my nice dessert, if you want my jet black cloak.

replies.reply_text: All right.  I'll be back.

chatpoints.chat_text: Ooooo, well, that's not going to be very easy, no.  What I want is very exotic and is not found locally.

replies.reply_text: What do you want?  A shrubbery?  Me to cut down the mightiest tree in the forest with a herring?  What?
Please, let's just get to the point.  What is it you want?
Of course.  Well, I don't do exotic, so I'm just going to leave.
Where do I get those?
Ah.  All right.  I'll be back.

chatpoints.chat_text: I would like a cup of hot cocoa, and a pudding! (Oddly suddenly gets very misty eyed.) Just like my Nonna used to make me for dessert...

replies.reply_text: Ah.  All right.  I'll be back.
Where do I get those?

chatpoints.chat_text: Hello, yes?  Who are you?

replies.reply_text: I'm... a traveling gofer.  Is your name really "Oddly"?
Hello, I've come to see the wizard.
Oh, nothing, nothing, I'm just sort of... passing through, you know... Bye!
Hi, uhm... What was it I was doing for you again?
Okay, here I am, back with your dessert!

I'm an adventurer on a mission. I've got a strange chest that I dug out of the center of Igneous Isle. Cupid said it "involves a tale of a dastardly deed most unsavory." (You shake the chest for Oddly's benefit.)
The adventurer, remember? You were going to tell me about this chest? Could you continue, please?
Seriously? How can you not remember me? UGH!  Can you tell me what happened to Belwyn in the end?
Does it matter who I am? Can you send me back to Belwyn, please?
It is just me again. You were telling me a story about a ship and a storm but never got to the 'noble' part of the tale.
I think you need glasses! Ugh! I'm the same one you've been talking to? About the ship and all? But you were going to cut to the chase, remember?

chatpoints.chat_text: That depends!  Who's asking?

replies.reply_text: Uh, nobody really, just ... me....

chatpoints.chat_text: OooooOOooooh, a smart aleck, eh?  Well, then, what do you want?  Come on, speak up!

replies.reply_text: I need some black fabric for... Well, it's a long story, but I need some jet black fabric, and that cloak you're wearing is just perfect.
Can I buy your cloak?

chatpoints.chat_text: What are you talking about?  Of course it's perfect.  It's mine, isn't it?

replies.reply_text: Yes, I'm sure it is.  Can you tell me where you got the fabric?

chatpoints.chat_text: Buy my cloak?  BUY my Mage's Cloak?  Absolutely not!  Positively not!

replies.reply_text: Well, can you at least tell me where you got the fabric?
Oh, pleeeeeeeeeeeeaze?  No, hunh?  Oh, well, I'll try someone else, then.

chatpoints.chat_text: Get the fabric?  You can't get the fabric.  There isn't any more like this, not in the entire world!  I made it myself, I'm proud to say, and I'm not going to part with it.  Well....  not to anyone who isn't worthy, anyway.

replies.reply_text: Could you tell me how to make it?
Oh, forget it.  I can't cope.
All right, fine.  Set me a task so that I may prove myself worthy of your Unique, Special, Jet Black Cloak.

chatpoints.chat_text: No, I can't tell you how to make it!  Well, I can.  But I won't!  So there!  Thbthbthbthbthb!

replies.reply_text: How rude!  Oh, well, so.  How do I prove myself worthy?

chatpoints.chat_text: Did you find it?  Really?  Oh, let me see, let me see!

replies.reply_text: Here you are.
Thanks.  Thanks a bunch!  Bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: Ah, it's my old pudding friend! Now, how've you been?  eh?

replies.reply_text: Oh, fine, just wandering around aimlessly, as usual.

I've been good! That said, I need your help. I've got a strange chest that I dug out of the center of Igneous Isle. Cupid said it "involves a tale of a dastardly deed most unsavory." (You shake the chest for Oddly's benefit.)
Excuse, you were going to tell me a story about this chest? Could you continue, please?
Can you tell me what happened to Belwyn?
Can you send me back to Belwyn, please?
It is just me again. You were telling me a story about a ship and a storm but never got to the 'noble' part of the tale.
I think you need glasses! Ugh! I'm the same one you've been talking to? About the ship and all? But you were going to cut to the chase, remember?

chatpoints.chat_text: (Oddly's eyebrows arch, his eyes widen and his hands flutter in the air.) Oh, delightful! I wondered what happened to the chest. And there is nothing dastardly or unsavory about it. More like noble.

replies.reply_text: Noble? I love a good tale, most especially ones with great human traits like high moral ideals. Please, tell me more!

chatpoints.chat_text: (Suddenly, Oddly gets very misty eyed.) My Nonna used to tell me the BEST tales of nobility and good deeds and fine character. (Oddly shakes out his arms like a flapping chicken.) But you are not here to hear about my Nonna.

replies.reply_text: I'm sure your Nonna was a lovely woman, but you are right. I am not here about that. Please tell me more about the chest.

chatpoints.chat_text: A tale as old as time! T'was long, long, long ago, once upon a midnight dreary, there rose a dark and thundering storm. (Oddly flings his arms into the air rather dramatically.) Came a ship, ragged and listing, full of sailors sick and weary. Storm battled and sea soaked were both the boat and crew and deadly danger DANGER! lurked ahead. (Oddly sucks in a deep breath and holds it.)

replies.reply_text: (You watch Oddly turn red while holding his breath.) Please, take a breath and continue. So far I'm enjoying the story.
Oh gosh, look at the time. Got to run, no time for this kind of fun. See ya!

chatpoints.chat_text:
(Oddly releases his breath in a whoosh.)
DANGER! The storm drove the ship towards jagged rocks! DANGER! The crew scrambled to drop the sails. Alas, it did no good. The waves shoved and hammered and slammed that ship into the rocks. Oh woe! Oh sadness. The sailors were flung far and wide. Some survived. Others did not.

replies.reply_text: Wow. That's pretty dramatic. So, what has this got to do with the chest and I'm not getting the noble part of the story.

chatpoints.chat_text:
Ufta! In my telling I forgot to mention Belwyn. One cannot tell such a grande and glorious tale without mentioning Belwyn. Kind and noble Belwyn.

Belwyn was but a boy, but a mighty boy was he! He sailed upon that fateful ship to see what he could see. The rocks were drawing nearer, and nearer, but Belwyn never showed his fear! Flung high above the shattering ship he fell into the ocean quick! Too quick to save his treasure chest.

replies.reply_text: Oh my gosh! Are you saying he drowned?
This is a really long story, and my stomach is growling. I may be back. But then again, I may not! See ya!

chatpoints.chat_text: Fear not, he did not (A glass of water magically appears in Oddly's hand. He takes a long drink.) Ah! Relief for a parched throat. Now, where was I?

replies.reply_text: You were telling me about the part where Belwyn fell into the ocean.

chatpoints.chat_text:
Ah, yes! There were sinking sails, and a sinking ship, and plenty of sailors splashing about. But there were planks from the belly of the ship that had been smashed free and now were floating.

Belwyn joined a group of sailors clinging desperately to one of those planks. There were eight sailors and the boy. Day in and day out. For three days they drifted. Belwyn shared his meager stores of dried fish with the men, despite his own hunger. He told them tales of wild adventures to keep them in good spirits.

replies.reply_text: This is a really sad story. I hope it gets better soon. And I'd really like to hear the part about noble. Can you just cut to the chase?
I'm gonna to have to come back some other day to hear the end of this captivating tale. I've got to go, so good bye for now!

chatpoints.chat_text: Cut to the chase? Is that what you are saying? No patience these days! No patience. Such a sad thing. Fine. Before the plank broke up, they each took an oath that should they survive, they would do all they could to reunite some day on… Hat Isle? Treasure Isle? Well, one of the pirate islands. Anyway, another storm grew and dashed the plank to pieces. Each man clung to a bit of plank, but alas they drifted apart.

replies.reply_text: And the chest? What happened to the chest.

chatpoints.chat_text: Story has it that the old sea witch who created the storms took the chest and hid it. Guess there wasn't anything in it that held much interest for her. So there you go. End of the story.

replies.reply_text: That can't be the end of the story. What happened to Belwyn?

chatpoints.chat_text: Ah, yes. Belwyn. Since you don't care for the depth and breadth of a tale, I will leave out all those details and tell you simply this - Belwyn turned into a recluse. Understandable. You share a group experience like that and then to never see any of the others? Sad!

replies.reply_text: But what about the chest? And why was it buried in the middle of Igneous Isle? And how do I open it?

chatpoints.chat_text: Why it was buried where it was buried is a question for the sea hag. And how you open it? Well, you'll have to ask Belwyn.

replies.reply_text: Belwyn's alive? Oh my gosh! Where can I find him?

chatpoints.chat_text: (Oddly flutters his hand into the air and points somewhat northwest.) Somewhere wandering around on that dark and dismal island up there.

replies.reply_text: Thanks! See ya!
Can you send me there? I don't see any form of transport.

chatpoints.chat_text: Dig near the most Southeastern point of the island to return to Magma. There you go!

replies.reply_text: Thanks!

chatpoints.chat_text: Ask my wife.

replies.reply_text: Okay.

chatpoints.chat_text: Not now, please.

replies.reply_text: Okay.

chatpoints.chat_text: Hewwo.

replies.reply_text: Hello.
Hi there.  How are you?
Hi, little one.  Do you remember which library you got the first flag from?
Hey, Baby Bear, look what I've got! (Hand over the library flag.)

chatpoints.chat_text: Good.

replies.reply_text: That's nice. What's that you've got there? (Point to a small block in the bear's hands.)
Good.  Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: Nothin'. (The little bear tries to stifle a sob.)

replies.reply_text: Aww, come on, that's all right, maybe I can help.
Oh, fine, be that way.  Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: (The little bear shakes his head, and holds up the wooden block. It is a plain wooden cube about the size of a plover's egg, with a hole through the center.)

replies.reply_text: Let's see, now... What's this? A building block? (You examine it carefully, but it's just a block of wood with a hole, and nothing else.) Is there something that's supposed to go in the hole?
Sorry, kid, can't help you.

chatpoints.chat_text: (Sniff.) Uh-huh. (Sniff.) The wuzza fwag, ona powe. Ih fewwow. Fewdow dare. (Sniff. Points down.)

replies.reply_text: Sorry, I'm no good at babytalk.  Gotta go.  Bye.
Oh!  This was the base for a flagpole, and the flag and the pole that went in it came out and fell off the cloud... I see.  Well, I'm sorry, little one, but it's probably in the ocean by now.

chatpoints.chat_text: Waaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa!

replies.reply_text: Whoa, that's overreacting somewhat.  Nevermind.  I'm going now.  Bye.
Okay, okay, I'll tell you what.  Would you like me to go down and get a new flag for you?
All right.  I'll go now.

chatpoints.chat_text: Fwumma junggw.

replies.reply_text: Ah, okay, that will be Tropicton, then.  I'll be right back.
You're very welcome, little one!  Enjoy!

npc_list.name: Liza
npc_list.admin_description: Please start all quests at CP6
npc_list.long_description: Liza wears a crisp white blouse and a dark blue pinafore, which is so long you barely catch a peek at her vintage high top button boots.  Her overall appearance is very tidy.

chatpoints.chat_text: Welcome to Simple Gifts!

replies.reply_text: Thank you!  I take it this is a store?  I don't see anything to buy, though...
Thank you! I've brought you a gift from a dentist on a distant isle. Whew! That's a bit of a tongue twister!

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, ha ha!  No, this isn't a store.  This is my house!  You must have confused Simple Gifts with The Good Egg to the east.

replies.reply_text: But there's a sign that says "Simple Gifts"!   This isn't a gift shop?  Do you at least wrap presents?
Oh, I get it.  See ya.

chatpoints.chat_text: That's the name of our farm!  The name "Simple Gifts" refers to an old song.  I'm a subsistence farmer, and proud of it!

replies.reply_text: Subsist?  That sounds worse than "exist."  Does that mean that your quality of life is poor?

chatpoints.chat_text:
No, dear, it means that I happily work hard and can provide myself with everything I need to live. I can clothe myself, I can feed myself, and I don't rely upon others...
(Quietly) Well, that's the theory.

replies.reply_text: Theory, eh?  It's not working out that way?

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, Ashton wasn't built in a day, as the saying goes... I've got all these great primitive tools I'm learning to use!

replies.reply_text: Is there anything you need help with?
It was nice to meet you.  Bye now.

chatpoints.chat_text: Welcome back to Simple Gifts!  I remember you!

replies.reply_text: Yep, it's me again.  How's life?
Hi!  Just passing through.
It wasn't me... Must've been someone who looked like me.  Bye!
I remember you, too!  I was curious about that nice big spinning wheel you have in the corner.  Does it work, and what kind of chance would I have of talking you out of it?
I'm glad you do! I've brought you a gift from a dentist on a distant isle. Whew! That's a bit of a tongue twister!
And I remember you! I was wondering if I could purchase a skein of silken strands from you.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, not so good.  You see, my water bucket has a hole in it, and I need to fetch water.  We're getting pretty desperate!

replies.reply_text: You don't have anything else to collect water with?
That's a shame.  Well, I'll see you around.

chatpoints.chat_text: I've been using a glass, but it takes a lot of trips to the well to carry very much.

replies.reply_text: (Absently) Oh, that's nice. Have a good day now!
Is there anything I can do to help?  I could probably go buy a new bucket for you...
That's really silly.  I'd better be going now.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, no, a brand new pail wouldn't do at all.  This one is a classic!  A real wooden bucket, handmade by a skilled cooper.  It has a patina that only comes with age and use.  We're into the primitive style of décor, you see.  Would you like to see my butter churn?  It's nearly 150 years old, and it still has its original dash!

replies.reply_text: No, thanks.  I'd better be going.
I can help you get the bucket fixed, if you'd like.
That seems silly to me.  You need a functional item, not a decoration. Why not let me go get you a brand new pail?  Then you can just hang your rickety old bucket from a rafter and call it "art."

chatpoints.chat_text: I'm afraid I must be stubborn on this point.  I'm trying to recreate a feeling of simplicity that you don't find in the hustle and bustle of a modern lifestyle.  No, I just can't have a brand new pail around here... It just goes against the whole feel of the place.  Thanks anyway.

replies.reply_text: I can help you get the bucket fixed, if you'd like.
You can't say I didn't try!  See ya!
I will!

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, really?  Oh, that would be wonderful!  I can give you some money for traveling and the repairs.  Do you mind taking the bucket to my husband, Henry, first?  He's currently working in Appleton... He'll know where you can get a high quality repair for the bucket.

replies.reply_text: I would be happy to.  I can head over to Appleton right now.
Sorry, I don't have time right now.

chatpoints.chat_text: Hello!  I've been anxiously awaiting your return with my bucket!  Have you found anyone to repair it yet?

replies.reply_text: No, not yet.  I'm still working on it.  Bye.
Who was it you said I had to ask about the bucket repairs?
No, not yet.  I asked your husband though, and he said he didn't know.  He told me I would have to find a good woodworker by myself.
Yes, I did find someone - Krista on Cat Isle.  I have to help her make the right plug though, and it's not quite ready yet.  I'd better get going now.
It's a long story, but the end result is the same:  Krista of Cat Isle fixed your bucket, and I have it here now.

chatpoints.chat_text: You need to ask my husband, Henry.  He knows so many more people because he works in Appleton.  He should be able to suggest someone.

replies.reply_text: Ah, okay.  I'll just be on my way, now.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, that's a shame.  I wish he had been able to help.  I don't know of anyone, either.

replies.reply_text: Well, I'll be going now, I suppose.   I guess I'll figure out someone.

chatpoints.chat_text: I can't wait to see how it turns out!  Please hurry!

replies.reply_text: I'll be back with the bucket as soon as I can.
You're welcome, and now you can get back to your interesting lifestyle.  Bye now!

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, dear, no chance at all! That spinning wheel is the pride of my collection! It's fabulously primitive, you see. The thread it produces is lumpy and so authentic-looking, it's simply fabulous. Once you weave the rough thread into cloth, you'd be amazed at the effect.

replies.reply_text: Do you have any ideas about who might have a spinning wheel, then?   Perhaps a more modern one would be more appreciated anyway.
Oh, well.  I tried.  Thanks anyway.

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, what do you know?  It turns out I can help you after all!  My neighbors don't really understand my lifestyle, but they mean well.  Just a few weeks ago, Chaffie gave me a very modern spinning wheel that she thought I'd like.  It was a family heirloom.  She wanted someone to have the wheel who would appreciate it.  Well, I didn't have the heart to turn her down.

replies.reply_text: That's a fabulous twist of fate!  I'm trying to find a wheel for a spinner whose wheel was broken!  Can I buy the modern wheel from you?
Gosh, thanks!  Janice and her mom will be thrilled, I'm sure.
I'll be sure to tell her. Have a super day!

chatpoints.chat_text: That's not something I can create on my primitive spinning wheel. I create fabulously thick and lumpy strands. Would you be interested in some of that?

replies.reply_text: No thank you. But have a nice day all the same.

npc_list.name: Bowen
npc_list.long_description: Bowen is a hard working farmer, and it shows in his tanned-to-leather face, and calloused hands.  His baggy beige clothing is sparkling clean, and seems to match the house more than the man.

chatpoints.chat_text: Hello, friend.  You caught me just as I was finishing lunch.

replies.reply_text: Hi!  So what is it that you do here?
Didn't mean to barge in.  Bye!
Sorry to interrupt your lunch, but would you have a little time to discuss a new business venture?
Sorry to disturb you again, but who did you say I should see for the berries?
I've been so busy I left without the fruit! Do you have the letters signed?
I left without the oranges.  Are they ready?
Hi there! Are you a farmer?
Uh... About those orange saplings... Where did you say I could find them?
Then I caught you at an opportune time! I come bearing a gift from Karee Dentin, Wington's Dentist.

chatpoints.chat_text: I'm an orchard man, actually.  I grow all kinds of fruits here.

replies.reply_text: Have you always been in this line of work?
Oh, how fascinating.  Fruit, eh?  Well, I'm out of here.
Do those fruits include oranges?

chatpoints.chat_text: No.  Traditionally, our family had nautical jobs.  I was the least interested in the ocean, but I did farm fish.  I also raised the food to grow them.

replies.reply_text: What made you change to fruit?

chatpoints.chat_text: We fell into some hard times.  The fish market went to pieces, so we weren't able to make a good living anymore. About the same time, we agreed to take on my brother's son to raise.  We decided we needed a change, so here we are!

replies.reply_text: Why did you have to raise your nephew, may I ask?
This story sounds fishy to me!  Ha-ha... ?  Oh well.  See you later.

chatpoints.chat_text: Sorry, I don't have any more time to chitchat... It's time for me to get back to my crops.  Bye!

replies.reply_text: Bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: That depends.  What's the business venture you are referring to?

replies.reply_text: I understand that you are an orchard man, and I represent Hansel and Gretel's new bakery on Cloud Isle. They need a vendor to supply tree-ripened apples and oranges. (You show Bowen Hansel's list.) Think you'd be interested?

chatpoints.chat_text: Sure, we could handle that sort of volume, no problem! And by the way, I'm pretty sure you can get the berries from Dr. Fernlove.  He's a little odd, but his berries are the sweetest I've ever tasted.

replies.reply_text: Very good.  Allow me to give you 2 letters of credit; one for the apples and the other for the oranges.
All you have to do is sign them and I'll take the first shipment back to Hansel and Gretel with me.
Very good, and the oranges?
My, these fruits look absolutely scrumptious!  Hansel will be very pleased with your produce. You said that I should check out Dr. Fernlove for the berries? Thanks!
My, these fruits look absolutely scrumptious!  Hansel will be very pleased with your produce.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, that's all right, I said that you should talk to Dr. Fernlove, he lives east of us.

replies.reply_text: Okay, thanks again!

chatpoints.chat_text: Yes, indeed! I believe I can say that I grow some of the best oranges around.

replies.reply_text: You're the man I need to see, then! Charla Mae in Hotton tried some of your oranges recently and fell in love. She has her own orange orchard and was wondering if you could part with some of your saplings. She wants to try to improve her own oranges.
That's nice. I have to go, but maybe you can tell me more later.

chatpoints.chat_text: Of course she can have a few saplings. You'll have to dig them up yourself, though.

replies.reply_text: Did you want anything for them? It doesn't feel right to just take them.
Digging? Sorry, I'm allergic to getting dirty. Off to wash my hands!

chatpoints.chat_text: Yes, I'm afraid I'll have to charge you $100 per sapling you find. You can take three; that should be plenty for Charla's purposes. I'll take the money up front, before you get them, if you don't mind.

replies.reply_text: That comes up to $300, right? Here you go.
$300? That's more than I can afford, sorry. I'll be back with the money later.
All right. Thank you for helping Charla Mae with her oranges!

chatpoints.chat_text: They'll be near the orange tree, and since there's no grass here, the saplings should be fairly easy to find. Remember, just dig up three.

replies.reply_text: Aha! Thanks for the reminder!
You are more than welcome. I'll let you get back to your work now. Have a great day!

npc_list.name: Peru
npc_list.long_description: Peru is a short, gentle woman, dressed in dark blue.  She is a very hard worker, but she has a quiet, easygoing nature.

chatpoints.chat_text: Hello, dear.  I'm afraid you've caught me at a busy time.

replies.reply_text: I'm sorry.  Isn't there anything I can do to help?
I'm sorry. I'll come back again later.
Hello.  Was I doing something for you?
Hello, Peru.  I found out what happened to your seeds.
Hi Peru.  Could you remind me what I was doing for you?
Hello, Peru!  I've found the fennel!  I'm pretty sure I managed to dig up all that there was...
I won't take but a minute. I'm here to deliver a gift from Karee Dentin, Wington's dentist.

chatpoints.chat_text: (Distractedly.) Maybe you can, maybe so... We're just so busy here on the farm, it's hard to begin to think of how you can help.

replies.reply_text: I'm very experienced at all kinds of work!  I can find things that are lost, I can go fetch supplies if you need them...
Farm life is so mundane. I'd better go before you send me out to spread fertilizer.

chatpoints.chat_text: Hm?  Oh, yes... Maybe you could find something for me.  I lost my fennel seeds, you see...

replies.reply_text: I hope they were in a packet.  Random loose seeds might be hard to find.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh!  You're still here?  Seeds?  I'm sorry, dear, what were we talking about?

replies.reply_text: You were telling me that I might help you find your fennel seeds?
Whew... Is it getting stuffy in here, or is it just me?  I'd better go air out.

chatpoints.chat_text: (Focuses.) Oh! My fennel seeds! What did that boy do with them? No, I didn't lose them. Tuque said he was going to find somewhere good to plant them for me. This was months ago, dear. I can't get a straight answer out of him.

replies.reply_text: I'll go find out what happened to them for you!
Well, I'll leave you be now.  Good luck with Tuque!
I pride myself on my ability to get secrets out of people.
Well, I'll see what I can do.

chatpoints.chat_text: Yes, I think you were going to try to find out what Tuque had done with my fennel seeds.

replies.reply_text: Oh, of course.  I'll be on my way.

chatpoints.chat_text: (Distractedly.) Oh, that's nice. Well, did you bring them with you?

replies.reply_text: Tuque said that he gave them to a friend to plant somewhere else.  He said that fennel doesn't grow here.

chatpoints.chat_text: Hm... Well, if you know where Tuque planted them, maybe you could dig them up for me.

replies.reply_text: But I just said Tuque didn't... Oh, well, yeah, I can try to find them and dig them up for you.  How many should there be, and what should I look for?
Yeah, maybe some other time.  I'll see you later.
I'll go look for them now.

chatpoints.chat_text: Yes, I think you were out looking for those fennel plants that Tuque hid.

replies.reply_text: Oh, I remember now.  Tuque didn't hide them, he just gave them to a friend to plant.  I'll get back to looking for them.
You're welcome.  I'll come back soon to see if you have any other little tasks for me!

chatpoints.chat_text: Remember, dear, the plants have yellow and white flowers.  You should be able to see them clearly from afar.

replies.reply_text: I'll remember that.
I'll be sure to tell her! Thanks for taking a moment out of your busy day. Bye!

npc_list.name: Tuque
npc_list.long_description: Tuque is a rather plain looking, dishwater-blond teenager dressed in baggy white clothing.  He seems distracted, perhaps he's daydreaming.

chatpoints.chat_text: Huh?  Who's there?

replies.reply_text: Oh, were you busy?  I'm sorry to bother you.
It's just me again, Tuque.  Could you remind me where you think your friend planted the fennel?

Hey there, Tuque! I know you work with wood, and I'm wondering if you could do a quick job for me. Farley's fingernails got all chipped up from being adrift in the ocean. Do you think you could buff them or something?
Just me! Your friendly delivery person. I've got a gift for you from Karee Dentin in Wington.

chatpoints.chat_text: (Sigh.) I'm not busy, come on in.

replies.reply_text: So, what do you do here?
Don't mind me, I was just passing through.  See ya!
Say, Peru isn't sure what she did with her fennel seeds, and I thought I'd ask you if you knew... You know, I was just in the neighborhood and all...

chatpoints.chat_text: Ohhh, not much. I've been trying to figure out how I can get off this isle. Maybe I'd like to see some more of the world, learn a trade.

replies.reply_text: Well, Obsidian is worth a bit of money.  Surely you could make some money from selling that - at least enough to travel with.
Wow, that does sound like a big problem.  Hope you get it figured out.  Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, they won't let me go anyway. (Sigh.) I've asked if I can go find someone I can apprentice to, maybe learn to build boats. My Uncle Bowen says that he needs my help here on the farm.

replies.reply_text: That's tough.  Can't he find anyone else to help him?
Sounds like you're stuck.  You should listen to your uncle.  He does pay the bills, after all.  Well, I'm off to spread my wisdom elsewhere.

chatpoints.chat_text: Ohhh... (Sigh.) Maybe... I don't know. Whatever.

replies.reply_text: Ah.  I guess I'll be going, then.  Nice to meet you.

chatpoints.chat_text: Whatever.  It's all my fault, right?  She can't leave me alone.  You'd think some seeds were the most important thing in the world.

replies.reply_text: No, I don't think she's accusing you, she just happened to mention it in passing...
Well, if you want to be left alone, I can oblige.

chatpoints.chat_text: You're not a very good liar, you know?  Well, whatever.  I did what she asked.  You can't grow fennel here.  I gave the seeds to my buddy Briggs.

replies.reply_text: Oh!  Well, do you know what he did with them?

chatpoints.chat_text: He moved away months ago.  He said he'd plant them somewhere in the first big town he came to after he got off of this desolate rock.

replies.reply_text: Didn't you ever think of looking for them yourself?

chatpoints.chat_text: (Turning red.) I can't leave! They won't let me go! Aunt Peru keeps asking me about her fennel, then she doesn't let me go find it for her!

replies.reply_text: Touchy, touchy!  You can figure this one out on your own.
I'm sorry that you feel so put out by the whole thing.  I'm sure if I find the fennel for her, she'll leave you alone about it.
Thanks for your help.

chatpoints.chat_text: Briggs said he'd try to plant the seeds in the first large town he came to after he left Lava Isle.

replies.reply_text: Do you have any idea where he was headed?
Okay, that helps.  Thanks.

chatpoints.chat_text: He was going west... All I know is that he escaped and I didn't.

replies.reply_text: Thanks for the help.
Thank you so much!
No, silly! You brush your teeth with it! I'm sure you can figure out how.

npc_list.name: Chaffie Milne
npc_list.long_description: Chaffie is so absorbed in her work that she barely notices you.  You can get her attention, but she still seems pretty out of it.

chatpoints.chat_text: Hi there!  Please speak loudly so I can hear you over the noise of the mill!

replies.reply_text: How are you doing today?
I just popped in to see what was here.  Bye now!
I was told that you might be able to help me.
(Very loudly.) Sorry to bother you again, but who did you say I should see for the fruit?
(Almost yelling.)Sorry, I had to step outside a moment. The noise, you know. I said I'd take the copy and the first shipment.
I've got a gift for you! (You figure the fewer words you have to yell, the better!)

chatpoints.chat_text: Eh?

replies.reply_text: (Loudly.) How Are You?
(Loudly.) Bye Now!
(Yelling.) HOW ARE YOU!?
(Loudly.) Bye Now!

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh!  Shoes?  No, you need a cobbler for shoes!  Sorry!  I'm a miller!

replies.reply_text: (Yelling.) No... HOW ARE YOU!?

chatpoints.chat_text: Yes... Probably a cobbler could make them blue!  I'm sorry, I don't know much about shoes!

replies.reply_text: (Yelling.) BYE NOW!

chatpoints.chat_text: ...Come again?

replies.reply_text: (Louder.) Cara Cook said that you could help Hansel and Gretel's new bakery with their flour needs.
(Louder.) Minnie Biscuits said that you could help Hansel and Gretel's new bakery with their flour needs.
(Louder.) Can you supply the bakery with this? (You show Chaffie Hansel's list, pointing to the flour.)

chatpoints.chat_text: ....Please speak up... The mill you know...

replies.reply_text: (Even louder this time.) Can you supply the bakery with this? (You show Chaffie Hansel's list, pointing to the flour.)

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, you want me to supply a bakery?  I'd be delighted, and some of my neighbors could help you, too.  Go see Peru and Bowen for the orchard fruit and Dr. Fernlove for the berries.

replies.reply_text: (Loudly, waving the letter of credit in front of Chaffie.) Wonderful! I've got a letter of credit here for you.
(Yelling.) Just sign a copy and I'll take the first order back to the bakery with me, okay?
(Sighs.)Thank you, I'm sure this will work out well for you, and thanks for the tips on the fruit. BYE!

chatpoints.chat_text: Of course, I said you should see Peru and Bowen for the orchard fruit you're looking for, and that odd little man, Dr. Fernlove, for the berries.

replies.reply_text: Thanks again!
(You don't feel like yelling again, so you just wave goodbye.)

npc_list.name: Carly Cobbler
npc_list.admin_description: New quests must begin at CP 16
npc_list.long_description: Carly is a mature women knee-deep in children.  There are boxes all over the place indicating a recent move, hopefully to a larger residence.

chatpoints.chat_text: (Shouting over her shoulder) Marty... Bobby... Kenny... Suzie... Stop that!! Don't make me come up there! (Turns to you) What are you doing out there? Don't you have chores to finish?

replies.reply_text: Me?  Uh, no.  I can see you're busy, bye!
Excuse me, ma'am, I think you're mistaking me for someone else.
I'm sorry, but where was I going for you?
Well, probably, but I brought  you your bed linens and Barb sends her best wishes on your new house.
I'm sorry, but where was I going for you?
Hey, hey, hey! (A paper airplane sails out of the door behind Carly narrowly missing your eyes!) Watch it in there! Sorry, Carly!
Okay, I'm totally at a loss now... Who am I going to this time?
All right, (You duck as a football spirals out of the door next to Carly's shoulder) This is really getting old! I'm back with your blankets.
Okay, so, you mentioned one last favor?  I have time  to do that for you now.

chatpoints.chat_text: (Looks you square in the eyes.) Oh dear, you're not one of mine. I'm terribly sorry!

replies.reply_text: I get that a lot! (Grinning) You seem a little frazzled at the moment. Anything I can do to help?
That's okay.  I'll just be on my way then...

chatpoints.chat_text: That's so kind of you. We just moved from that drafty old shoe and I'm trying to get everyone settled in... But I have so many children, I don't know what to do! (Spins around suddenly) Lindy... No!!

replies.reply_text: You don't need my help (You duck as a toy comes flying out of the doorway.) you need Super Nanny! Good luck with the new house!
Er, just how many children do you have?

chatpoints.chat_text: Let's see... I have 15 or so kids still at home... Jenny stop hitting your brother!! The 5 oldest have left to make their way in the world. (Looks back over her shoulder again) Darla, would you please give Baby Alice a bottle!

replies.reply_text: So, how can I help you get organized here?
Sounds like you need some serious child psychologists here... and that's not me, bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: Let's see, the older boys can help me set up all of the beds, but I need someone to pick up the pillows and linens and blankets. (This time she doesn't even turn around.) 1... 2... 3... 4... Don't let me get to 10 Frankie! Where was I?? Oh, yes, Could you pick those up for me?

replies.reply_text: I'm sorry, but I'm too busy for a project that large.  I'm sure someone else will come along that can help!
I could do that!  What do you need and where do I get it from?
I'll get started on that right away!

chatpoints.chat_text: That's all right dear, I have my moments too... You're going to Barb Sower and taking her 25 moonbeams and 10 silver linings.

replies.reply_text: That's right!  I'll be back soon, I hope!

chatpoints.chat_text: That's so sweet of her... Harry!  Carl!  Stop jumping on the beds!!  What do you think this is, a gymnasium??    Sorry dear, we'll get started with these.  Could you do me another favor?

replies.reply_text: I don't see why not...  Here are the sheets.
Sorry, this has taken up enough of my time.  I'm sure someone else will come along to continue this for you.
All righty... I'll get the sparkling feathers and the other feathers and head on down to Floria.  I'll be back soon.

chatpoints.chat_text: You're on your way to Floria on Flower Isle.  You need to take her 50 sparkling feathers and 50 feathers, okay?

replies.reply_text: Okay, got it!

chatpoints.chat_text: Thank heavens you're back! Did you get the pillows? (Carly looks over her shoulder) Edie, will you please stir that pot before it boils over!?

replies.reply_text: Yes, ma'am!  Here they are, and Floria guarantees sweet dreams for all of your children.
Sorry, but this has taken up too much of my time already!  See you around!
(Sigh) Sure, what's one more trip? Where do I go for the blankets?
Okay, I'm off to Santon!

chatpoints.chat_text: I asked you to go to Yepa in Santon... Are you sure you don't have children, too?  They make you forget things, you know!

replies.reply_text: That's right, Yepa... Wait a minute, that thing about kids, is that true??  Anyway, I'll be back soon, bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: Boys, no playing ball in the house! You know the rules!! (Carly turns her attention to you) Thank you for all your help. Did you get everything?

replies.reply_text: Yes, here are your blankets and Yepa sent along these Dreamcatchers for the children's bedrooms.
Thanks!  Enjoy your "me" time!!

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, it's you again! (Shouting over her shoulder) Don't think I didn't see that young lady! (Now back to you) I can't thank you for all you did. Things are slowly settling in here and it's all because of you!

replies.reply_text: Oh, that's okay, it was my pleasure. (There is the sound of something breaking followed by a child's howl.) You sure I can't hook you up with Super Nanny?... Enjoy your new house, bye!

npc_list.name: Ricky Mantequilla
npc_list.long_description: A tall, elegant gentleman with tawny good looks and piercing brown eyes.

chatpoints.chat_text: Welcome to The Good Egg!  Can I help you?

replies.reply_text: Yes, I raked up a topaz necklace in your garden... Is it yours?
Yes, I dug up this carrot in your garden.  How much do you want for it?
No thanks, just looking.
Hello.  I was wondering if you had any odd jobs I could help you with.
I'm hoping.  I represent Hansel and Gretel's new bakery on Cloud Isle and they are looking for a butter and egg supplier.
I guess I spaced there for a bit.  Can I have the copies and the goods?
So much for the eggs.  What can you give me next?
So, you're saving the best for last?
Yes, you can. Would you happen to know who might be a farmer here?
You sure can! I am hoping to get a small paper bag from you.
I've got something for you! Karee Dentin has asked me to deliver this to you.
Thanks!  Maybe I can use it as a doorstop!

chatpoints.chat_text: It's a miracle!  My daughter's necklace!  She got it from her auntie for her 6th birthday, and it's been missing for nearly a year!  We looked everywhere for that necklace.  Our child was heartbroken!  Do you have the necklace now?

replies.reply_text: Here you go... Please take it back to your daughter.  I imagine she'll be excited to see it!
Well... erm... come to think of it, I was wearing a necklace when I went out to your garden.  It must've fallen off.  No, I don't think the one I found is hers.
Thank you very much!  I was happy to do it!
Will do.

chatpoints.chat_text: Hmm... Not that I can think of.  During the peak crop season, I can usually use help, but harvest is past.  I don't think there's much left to do in the garden, currently.

replies.reply_text: Okay, maybe I'll just take a peek around.  See you later!

chatpoints.chat_text: Butter and egg supplier for a bakery.  I suppose I could handle that.

replies.reply_text: Great!  There're some other items I need, too.  I see that you don't sell milk or cream per se, but do you sell cream cheese?

chatpoints.chat_text: You're in luck.  I just started making cream cheese as an experiment.  I might be able to handle that, too.  What sort of volume are you looking for?

replies.reply_text: Well, see for yourself. (You show Ricky Hansel's list.) Think you can handle it?

chatpoints.chat_text: Hmmm, I bet you could get a lot of these items from my neighbors here in Molten Meadows. As far as the butter, eggs and cream cheese, that looks do-able.  How do we make this happen?

replies.reply_text: Okay, so I have these letters of credit.  One for each of the items you will be supplying.
Now, sign each one and I'll take the first shipment of each item back to the bakery with me.
Got it, what's next?
Okay, and finally?
These look great! And I'll check out your neighbors like you suggested, too. Bye bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: A farmer? Well, most everyone here grows something of their own. Are you looking for anything in particular?

replies.reply_text: Yes. Orange tree saplings. The person I'm helping said someone here grew oranges.
Wow, really? Farming overload! Excuse me while I recover. I might come back later.

chatpoints.chat_text: I see. You'll want to see Bowen, then. He's in the hut southwest of here.

replies.reply_text: Oh, thanks! You've been a huge help. Have a good day!
No thank you, I'm full. But thanks for the bag! Have a super day.
Oh, not at all! This is a gift. Please, enjoy it and have a good day!

npc_list.name: Dr. Fernlove
npc_list.admin_description: Well aritculated but giggly - doesn't use contractions.
npc_list.long_description: A tall, slender man with glasses and fair wavy hair (mad scientist style), sporting a snazzy white lab coat.  He wears a ready smile which wavers between an ironic grimace and look of self-satisfaction.

chatpoints.chat_text: (Singing to seedlings) Oooh my pretty little loves! Oooh, so pretty! How well you are growing today! Hee-hee-hee!

replies.reply_text: (Sneak away.)
Excuse me, Doctor...  I hate to disturb you, but I wonder if you could help a friend of mine with her fern problem.
Pardon me Doctor, but I've been told that you might be able to assist me in my search for a berry vendor?
Ummm, haven't you forgotten something, Doctor?
They are pretty! Pretty spectacular! Oh, I've got something for you. Its a gift from Karee Dentin, a dentist in Wington.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oooh?  A problem with ferns?  Are the poor darlings sick?

replies.reply_text: I'd say they're not sick anymore, if you know what I mean.
On second thought, I don't think I want to bother you with all the gruesome details.  I'd better be going.

chatpoints.chat_text: Gross!  Disgusting!  Ferns are very easy plants to care for, especially around here.  Is your friend a local girl, hmmmm?

replies.reply_text: Yep, she lives just to the south-west of here.  She said she watered the ferns.  Could she have watered them too much?
Why is that important?  You're just weird.  See you later.

chatpoints.chat_text: Ferns can stand up to a lot of watering.  They crop up like weeds in this environment!  What could the problem have been?

replies.reply_text: Er... Perhaps it was because they're not locally grown ferns?  I found them in greener areas than Lava Isle.
Uh... Are you asking me?  I guess you can't help after all.  Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: Wait... ha ha! Did you pick some fern fronds for your friend to grow?

replies.reply_text: Well... sure!  I haven't ever seen fern seeds around.

chatpoints.chat_text: Ohh-hoo-hoo! You are too funny! Next you will tell me that your friend just stuck the fern fronds into the ground and watered them?

replies.reply_text: Uhh, now that you mention it, I think that's exactly what she did.
Forget this.  I'm not going to stand around and let you laugh at me.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oooh, it gives me a headache.  First of all, ferns usually reproduce by spores, and never from seeds.  Second, the thought of you using that monster of a shovel anywhere near helpless plants makes me shudder.   Please, PLEASE, let me give you some of these young plants I've raised specially to thrive in this climate.  They are potted, so you will just need to replant them.

replies.reply_text: That's sounds great, Doc!   She wanted seven of them.  Is that too many?
Er... What you said just went right over my head. I think I'll come back later.

chatpoints.chat_text: (Giggling throatily.)

replies.reply_text: Heh.  Now that I think about it, I can see the problem.  Well, Doc, what do you suggest?  Should I find some seeds for her to plant, or dig up some ferns, root and all?
I'll let my friend know.  Thanks again!

chatpoints.chat_text: Berry vendor you say? You mean there is someone out there who wants my berries? (Giggling) Oh joy, oh rapture unconfined!

replies.reply_text: Okaaay... Well I represent Hansel and Gretel's new bakery on Cloud Isle and they are looking for someone who can supply them with berries.

chatpoints.chat_text: How delightful, and these bakers that you represent, what kind of berries are they looking for?

replies.reply_text: Well, let me show you Hansel's list, (You pull out Hansel's list and show it to Dr. Fernlove.) and you let me know if you can handle this sort of volume.

chatpoints.chat_text: Let's see, 5 crates of assorted berries... Hmmm, yes I can do that!  And as a matter of fact, you should go see my neighbors Bowen and Peru for the orchard fruit on your list.

replies.reply_text: Very well then Doctor, here is a letter of credit from Hansel and I'll go see Bowen when we're through.
Now all you have to is sign a copy of the letter and I'll take that and the first shipment back to the bakery for you.
My word, these are the most delicious looking berries I've ever seen. (You quickly snatch one and pop it in your mouth.) And the sweetest I've ever tasted. Hansel should be very pleased.

chatpoints.chat_text: I am so glad you like them, I have been working on them for a long time now.  Now, do not forget to go see Bowen.

replies.reply_text: They are marvelous and don't worry, I'll go see Bowen too.  Bye!
Ummm, I don't think Karee had those other uses in mind... But its yours now, so do what you wish! Good-bye!

npc_list.name: Higgins
npc_list.long_description: Higgins is a tiny plump fellow who seems to be glowing.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oooo-oooooeeeeiiiiiaaaa!

replies.reply_text: Oh, restless spirit!  Please tell me how I can assist you!
(Shriek and run)

chatpoints.chat_text: What!? Oh! Gosh, you startled me. I was just in the middle of my vocal excercises. How on earth did you find me?

replies.reply_text: Well, someone on Lava Isle told me there was some sort of psychic turbulence coming from this area... I guess you must be it.

chatpoints.chat_text: Heh heh heh... I don't know about that. This morning I was a little down in the mouth about my lack of creature comforts. Does that qualify as "psychic turbulence?"

replies.reply_text: (giggle) Maybe in Selena's mind it does! Well, while I'm here, can I help you with anything?
I was expecting something much more exciting.  I should be going now.
Do you know where I could pick those things up?

chatpoints.chat_text: Sure! There's a pretty lady up on Snow who makes the best hot drinks. If I remember correctly, the bath salts I used to get from the racing steward. It shouldn't be too hard to find those people, I think.

replies.reply_text: Oh, of course.  I'll be back soon.

chatpoints.chat_text: Hello! Back again so soon?

replies.reply_text: Could you remind me where I could get the bath salts and cider for you?
Yes!  I found the things you requested.  Here you go.
Sorry, wrong house.
Hi Higgins.  Did you mention something about digging?  I wasn't paying close enough attention, I think.

chatpoints.chat_text: Heh heh heh... That's a good one. Hey, I'd like to give you a reward for your help, but you're going to have to dig it up yourself - try digging right by my front door. And thanks again!

replies.reply_text: Wow!  Thanks very much!  I was glad to do it for you.  Oh... By the way... How does a ghost use apple cider and bath salts?
Thanks!  I'll go do that now.   Bye!
That's great!  Abigail remembered you fondly.  She said that she hoped you'd get well soon.
Okeydoke.  Bye now.

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, I could tell you, but it's no fun to know ALL the answers, is it?

replies.reply_text: I guess not.   It was nice meeting you, Higgins.  Bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: I thought you'd like a reward for your help - try digging right by my front door. And thanks again!

replies.reply_text: Thanks!  I'll go do that now.  Bye!

npc_list.name: Adolphus
npc_list.short_description: The Golden Fish of the Sun
npc_list.long_description: A large, bright yellow and black Pineapplefish.  He does almost seem to have a glowing quality.

chatpoints.chat_text: Hi there!

replies.reply_text: Hello!  You must be Adolphus.
Hi!  Who are you?
Hi again Adolphus!  I'm back!
Hello again Adolphus!  It's nice to be back on your isle.  Do you feel like receiving company today?
Hi, hi.  I'm sorry, I got confused about what I was doing.  Could you send me back to Big Blue, please?

chatpoints.chat_text: Of course I am, silly!   You called out my name, didn't you?

replies.reply_text: I'm here on behalf of your friend, Big Blue.  He wanted to give you a few gifts.
It must've been the wind.  Catch you later.

chatpoints.chat_text: If you don't know already, then I don't need to be talking with you!  Off you go, now.

replies.reply_text: Sorry.  Talk to you later.

chatpoints.chat_text: Ohhh! Prezzies for me? I adore prezzies! Gimme gimme gimme!

replies.reply_text: Are you sure you're one of the wise fish of the eastern sea?  Big Blue indicated that you guys were not very welcoming of visitors.

chatpoints.chat_text: I'm willing to make an exception - you came bearing gifts, darling.  Now, be a good little person and hand them over, post haste!

replies.reply_text: Here you go - a scrumptious ear of corn and a lovely topaz.
I'm not sure.  I think I'd better check with Big Blue first.  Could you send me back to him?
You're very welcome!   So, tell me more about your life here!  Can I come back to visit you later?
Sure.  Could you send me back to the blue fish now?
Oh, brother.

chatpoints.chat_text: Mm, I might be willing to receive your company some other day. I dunno. I guess it depends upon my mood. Big Blue sure is in my good books now, though!

replies.reply_text: So, how can I get back to visit you later?

chatpoints.chat_text: Panel's closed.  Time to go!

replies.reply_text: Wait!  Could you please send me back to the blue fish now?
I'll leave you be.  I'll just explore your isle a little before I head back.

chatpoints.chat_text: Nope!  Sorry.

replies.reply_text: All right.  I'll leave you be and have a look around the isle, then.
Could you send me back to the blue fish, please?

npc_list.name: Gustavus
npc_list.long_description: A large vibrant Bicolor Parrotfish

chatpoints.chat_text: Good day!

replies.reply_text: It's a pleasure to meet you, Gustavus.  Thanks for coming to see me.
Help!  Big unexpected scary fish!
Hi Gustavus!  I'm back....
Hi Gustavus!  I'm so happy to be back on your isle again.  It's nice to see an old friend.
Hi Gustavus!  I'm so happy to be back on your isle again.  It's nice to see an old friend.
Hi Gustavus!  I'm so happy to be back on your isle again.  It's nice to see an old friend
Hi!  I'm sorry to bother you, but I got confused about what I was doing.  Could you send me back to Big Blue, please?

chatpoints.chat_text: Not everyone can chortle out the name 'Gustavus' as musically as you managed to.  Congratulations!

replies.reply_text: Thank you!  I did chortle to you for a reason.  Your friend, Big Blue, sent me bearing gifts.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, that's very sweet!  Any friend of Big Blue's is a friend of mine.  So... what did he send?

replies.reply_text: For you, he chose to send a most perfect pear, and an emerald.
Oh, I'm not sure I got the right fish.  Could you send me back to ask, please?
I was glad to bring them!  It's always fun to meet a new friend.  Would you, by chance, welcome another visit in the future?
Sure.  Could you send me back to the blue fish now?
Right on target!

chatpoints.chat_text: You do seem like a very nice person.  I'm sure I wouldn't mind having another visit from you.

replies.reply_text: Thanks!  Would you please send me back to the blue fish now?
That's great!  I think I'll go explore your isle a little.  Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: Nice to see you, friend!  I expect you want to go back to Big Blue now?

replies.reply_text: Yes, please.  Would you mind sending me?
No, thanks.

chatpoints.chat_text: I'm happy to have you here!  I remember you from before.  I wonder if you could do me a favor?

replies.reply_text: Sure!  Anything for a friend.
Ah... Maybe another time. I'm pretty busy now.  Bye.
Hm, I don't think I can right now.  Could you send me back to Big Blue, please?
I'll be happy to ask him.  Could you send me back to him now?
Oh, sure.  I'll try to remember to do that next time I see him.  Bye now.

chatpoints.chat_text: It's good to see you back again!  Did you happen to deliver my message to Big Blue?

replies.reply_text: Oh, I'm sorry, I forgot.  Could you send me back now?  I'll remember this time.
Oh, I did forget to do that.  Sorry.  As soon as I get back, I'll let him know.

chatpoints.chat_text: Nice to see you, too, my friend!  Thanks for helping me out earlier.  I expect you probably want to go back to Little Blue now?

replies.reply_text: Yes, please.  Would you mind sending me?
No, thanks.  I'd like to hang around a little longer.

npc_list.name: Mercurius
npc_list.long_description: A massive, purple, spectacularly ugly Commerson's Frogfish.  He doesn't swim, but instead waddles along the ocean floor on his fins.

chatpoints.chat_text: (Glomp!) Attack!! Fishy Hugs!!

replies.reply_text: Hello Mercurius!  You really live up to your name!
Yechhhh!  Run away!!
