Can I help at all?  I love running errands for people.

chatpoints.chat_text: Now that you mention it, I could use a few things.  I have the cloth made specially for my quilts, but I noticed my stock of cotton was a bit low.

replies.reply_text: Collecting cotton?  No way.  I didn't mean that kind of help.  Good luck!
Sure!  I can collect cotton.
Sounds good.  I'll go start searching.  Bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: Well hello.  How did the cotton hunt go?

replies.reply_text: Cotton?  What?
What was I doing for you again?
Great!  Here are the 25 pieces.
Oh, yeah. Cotton.  I'll go get more now.

chatpoints.chat_text: You were going to collect 25 pieces of cotton.

replies.reply_text: Oh, that's right.  I'll go look.
I have some right here.  I just forgot about it, I guess.
I'm glad that will work.  I have a few things to do still, maybe I'll check in later to see how it's going.
What's next?

chatpoints.chat_text: I need to use specially made cloth for these quilts.  Would you be willing to get the fabric made for me?

replies.reply_text: Sure thing.  Where do I have to bring it?
Maybe later.
I'll get right on that.  Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: You're back!  Did Barb get that fabric made up?

replies.reply_text: That's what I was doing.  I'll be back in a bit.
She did.  Here you go.
Fabric from Barb?

chatpoints.chat_text: Yep.  You were going to bring those 50 pieces of cotton to Barb Sower for me.

replies.reply_text: All right.  I'll go do that now.
Thanks!  Bye.
Thanks!  That looks amazing!  Is there anything else?  I'm getting excited to see how this is going to turn out.

chatpoints.chat_text: Wonderful.  I'm glad you are enjoying helping!  I personally dye the fabrics for my quilts.  I have everything I need, but I'm running low on some of the items to create the colors.  Would you be able to collect those things for me?

replies.reply_text: You know what?  This is sounding pretty boring.  I'll take a rain check.  Bye.
I can do that.  What exactly do you need?
All right.  I'll be back as soon as I have everything.

chatpoints.chat_text: (She looks up from sketching out a quilt pattern.) Ah, you're back. Did you get all the different things for the dyes?

replies.reply_text: I did!  Here are the dandelions and 4 leaf clovers.
I think I have it all.  Here are the blackberries and the strawberries.
Not yet.  I'll go look some more.
What exactly did you need again?
I already gave them to you.

chatpoints.chat_text: I need dandelions, blackberries, strawberries and four leaf clovers.  Twenty of each should be enough.

replies.reply_text: Oh, that's right.  I'll get those things now.  Bye.
I have the blackberries and strawberries also.
That should be everything you asked for.
I still need to get the other things.  I'll be back then.
I have the clovers and dandelions also.
That should be everything you asked for.
I still need to get the other things.  I'll be back then.
Not right now.  Maybe I'll come back later.  Bye!
Sure!  What else do you need?

chatpoints.chat_text: There is a small errand I really need help with.  I can't leave the fabric soaking unattended, otherwise it might end up the wrong shade.  You won't even have to leave the isle.

replies.reply_text: That sounds easy.  What do you need done?
Maybe later.  Bye.
I'll go see him now.

chatpoints.chat_text: (Dyed fabrics are hanging up just outside the window to dry. Leasa looks up from working with it.) Did Hudson still have the thread?

replies.reply_text: Oh, yeah.  I had to go see Hudson about the thread.  I'll do that now.
Yes, he did.  He mentioned to thank you for letting him borrow it.  Here you are.
Thanks!  Good luck finishing up the quilt!

chatpoints.chat_text: It's getting there.  I should be done soon.  Would you be willing to deliver it for me once it's completed?

replies.reply_text: I don't know.  We'll see.  Bye.
Of course!  I'm excited to see it.  I'll be back later.

chatpoints.chat_text: I just finished it.  Would you be willing to deliver it for me?  I can't leave the house quite yet, because I have bread rising.

replies.reply_text: Sure, I can do that for you.  Where do I need to bring it?
I'm tired of running errands.  Maybe another time.
All right.  Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: Welcome back.  Did Karina get the quilt?

replies.reply_text: I just brought it to her and she was very happy.
Oh, that's what I was doing.  I'll head up there now.
Thanks!  Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: Not right now.  Thanks for all your help before.

replies.reply_text: You're welcome.  Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: Really?  A proposition for me?

replies.reply_text: Yes ma'am.  Iona, over in Flipperton, wants to hold a Founder's Day Crafts Festival.  She's hoping you can attend and display your quilts.  Here's your Invitation.
I'll let Iona know that you will be attending.  Bye for now!

npc_list.name: Isleen
npc_list.admin_description: New Quests Must Start At CP 23
npc_list.long_description: A Mare made up only of the stuff of dreams.

chatpoints.chat_text: (The Dream Mare quickly takes a step back as you approach.)

replies.reply_text: Oh, I'm sorry.  I didn't mean to startle you.  Are you okay?
Sorry about that.  I guess I will leave you alone.

chatpoints.chat_text: (She shakes her head from side to side.) No. I'm afraid I seem to have hurt my leg. (She carefully lifts up her right foreleg to show you.)

replies.reply_text: You know, I'm really not all that good with injuries.  Maybe you should see a vet instead.  I'll just leave you so you can get going.
That doesn't look too bad.  If you stay off of it for the next couple of days, you should be up and walking around again in no time.

chatpoints.chat_text: (Slowly, she lets out a small sigh.) If I had a few days to rest, I wouldn't be quite so worried. However, I have many dreams to deliver, and if I don't deliver them, then who will?

replies.reply_text: What does it matter if you can't deliver your dreams?
Well, I hope you do find some way to solve your problems.  I have a few of my own that I need to solve for now.  Goodbye.
Dreams?  What do you mean by that?

chatpoints.chat_text: If I can't deliver my dreams, then no one will get a good night's sleep!  Everyone will be tired and quite cranky, really.

replies.reply_text: That does sound like a problem, but how is just one mare expected to deliver dreams to all of the residents of Horse Isle?  That just sounds like too much work to me.
I guess I better avoid some of the residents for the next few days, then.  I better leave now, so I can set up camp.

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, I am a Dream Mare.  It is my job to deliver dreams to the residents of Horse Isle.

replies.reply_text: Why can't you just take a day or two off?
Horses who deliver dreams?  This is just a little too weird for me.  I'm out of here.

chatpoints.chat_text: I'm not the only Dream Mare.  You don't see us most of the time.  Actually, I'm really quite surprised that you even noticed me.  Maybe my injury had some part in that.  Well, since you can see me, would you be able to help me out?

replies.reply_text: I'm sorry, but I have so many other things to do for people.  It seems that everywhere I go, the only thing I ever hear is, "Can you get this for me?" or, "Would you be able to tell so and so something for me?"  No, I'm sorry, but I'm just too busy.
What can I do for you?  I don't think you'll need any medicine for your leg.  It looks like time is the only thing to heal that.

chatpoints.chat_text: Unfortunately, there really isn't anything that can heal my leg.  However, I do need to get my dreams delivered, and I need someone to be able to help me do it.  Would you be able to?

replies.reply_text: Sure.  What do I need to do?  How do you deliver dreams?
Delivering dreams?  Sorry, I think I will have to pass on this one.

chatpoints.chat_text: (She bends her head and pushes at a small box that seems to have magically appeared.) Take this box. Inside is a letter. Do not open the letter or the dream will escape. Give this box to Jasper in Earton and when you have finished, come back to me.

replies.reply_text: I will be back as soon as I have delivered the dream.

chatpoints.chat_text: Have you given the box to Jasper?

replies.reply_text: No, I'm sorry.  Where did you say he lived again?
Yes, I did.  He was quite pleased to be able to sleep again.  Who else is on the list?
No, but I was just on my way there.

chatpoints.chat_text: Jasper lives in Earton on Horse Isle.  Please hurry back!

replies.reply_text: I will be back as soon as I am done.
I suppose it depends on who and where it is.
No, I need short break before I do any more.  Maybe catch up on a few of my own dreams.

chatpoints.chat_text: Are you ready for the next dream now?

replies.reply_text: I'm almost ready.  It's just that I'm feeling a little overwhelmed by these dreams.  I've barely had any time relax.  I should be back soon, though.
Yes, I am.  Where am I going now?

chatpoints.chat_text: For my next dream, I need you to find the horse WildFire.  It must be terrible for him to not be able to dream right now.  I wonder if he's getting any sleep at all?

replies.reply_text: A horse?  I didn't know they even had dreams.
Oh, that poor horse.  Where can I find him?
You know, I should probably take care of my own horses first.  I'll be back a little later.

chatpoints.chat_text: You have dreams, right?  So why can't we have dreams?

replies.reply_text: Sorry, I didn't mean to offend you.  Where can I find him?
Whether or not they have dreams, I don't really have the time right now.  I should be going now.
He shouldn't be too hard to find.  I'll be back once I'm done.

chatpoints.chat_text: WildFire should be somewhere south in Little Appleton Forest.

replies.reply_text: Okay, thank you!  I'll be back soon.

chatpoints.chat_text: Have you delivered the dream box to WildFire?

replies.reply_text: No, not yet.  I'm on my way there right now.
Where does he live again?
Yes, I did, and he seemed very happy to have it.
You're welcome.  I do need to go for a little while. I'll be back later.
I don't mind helping out.  Do you have any more dreams to deliver?

chatpoints.chat_text: I have one more dream for you to deliver, if you have the time.

replies.reply_text: Of course.  Who does it belong to?
Not at the moment.  I'll check in later, though.
I'll find the dragon and hurry back.

chatpoints.chat_text: Have you found the Purple Dragon? (She looks rather worried.)

replies.reply_text: Oh, yes, I did.  He was difficult to find, but I made it.
No, I was actually on my way there.
I'm having trouble finding him.  Where did you say he lived?

chatpoints.chat_text: He lives in the Maze on Lava Isle.  I think if you follow the purple crystals you can find him.

replies.reply_text: Purple crystals?  Okay, I think I can find him now.
You're very welcome.  I enjoy helping out others.  Good luck with your leg.

chatpoints.chat_text: (The Dream Mare seems to be resting for now.)

replies.reply_text: (You quietly leave without disturbing her.)

npc_list.name: Triton
npc_list.long_description: A merman with flowing white hair and beard holding a golden trident in one hand and a silvery twisted conch shell around his muscular neck.

chatpoints.chat_text: Who dares disturb Triton, the Sea King?

replies.reply_text: Uhh... Not me!  Could you get me back on dry land, please?
Hello, Mr. Sea King.  I come in regards to your daughter, Isadora.
Your High Sea-ness, I am back with a box that can explain everything about Crash!
Yes, it is I!  A land-dwelling traveler that can solve the problem with your daughter, Isadora!
It is I and I wish to know what the scroll that I found in the box means?

chatpoints.chat_text: And what of my daughter, Isadora?

replies.reply_text: Yes, um, well, you see, she has fallen in love with someone and...
Yeah, nevermind!  Can I go back to land now?

chatpoints.chat_text: Silence!  I will not listen to this from a land-dweller!  You have no business here, now be gone!

replies.reply_text: You are so right.  I can only tread water for so long.  Can you get me back to land now?
No wait, listen to me!  You can't help who you love or fall in love with, don't you understand?

chatpoints.chat_text: No.  Because the people of the sea, MY people, know what is right and wrong!  Isadora chose her path on land and will suffer the consequences of her actions!  Family traditions cannot be broken!

replies.reply_text: That's not very becoming of a father!  You should love her and accept her for who she really is!  You can't change someone and you can't help who you fall in love with!
You are right.  I guess kids will be kids and need to understand their punishment.  Can you get me back to land now?

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh.  Well, I guess.  I mean, she is my fifth daughter and I do love her very much.   But what of this boy... Crash?  He is not royalty, is he?

replies.reply_text: Hrm.  I don't know.  I never thought to ask him.  What if he is?
With a name like "Crash", I highly doubt it!  Can you get me back on land now, please?

chatpoints.chat_text: Then, by tradition, they would be blessed by the Ocean Kingdom to love for all eternity.

replies.reply_text: That's good!  But what if he isn't royalty?
Great.  Nice happy ending.  Now, can I get out of here?

chatpoints.chat_text: Then the ocean will take back my daughter where she will live forever in a bubble prison and the boy will no longer be allowed to use my surf as his toy!

replies.reply_text: Yikes!  Well, let's hope for the best.  I think it's time to find out more about Crash Joller.
I'll be back with good news, I hope!

chatpoints.chat_text: Is that so?  Let me see it.

replies.reply_text: I went to great lengths getting this box!  Traveling, and fishing, and...  Well, here it is!
Oh noooo!!

chatpoints.chat_text: Is that so?   Tell me, what do you know of her this time?

replies.reply_text: Yes, um, well, um.  I forgot!  Can you get me back to land now?
Here!  Behold the mighty, err I hope, scroll that will explain it all!
So what does it mean?

chatpoints.chat_text: It means that my daughter may fall in love with anyone whom she chooses.  The family traditions have been, well, skewed over the years while being passed down through word of mouth.

replies.reply_text: So Isadora can fall in love and be happy?
Whatever.  Can I just have my reward now?  Forget it.  Send me back to land.
It was my pleasure, King Triton!

npc_list.name: Crow's Nest Carrie
npc_list.admin_description: After removal of crickets/new quests start on CP7   VISABILITY OPTION REQ ACTION: 2259
npc_list.long_description: The lighthouse keeper, er, pirate... is a young woman! Imagine that.

chatpoints.chat_text: Mind ye muddy footprints, there! I jus' finished spit polishin' me floors!

replies.reply_text: Eeek! A pirate! Run for your life!
Hello, again! Looks great in here. I don't see a single cricket or scorpion! I bet you're sleeping well these days.
Yuck! That sounds nasty. I don't want any spit on my new cowboy boots. I'm leaving. Have a nice day!
take me to the start of the carrie hobby quest please

chatpoints.chat_text: Aye. And that be a problem, Matey!

replies.reply_text: A problem? How can that be a problem?
Oh, no. This sounds like the start of another quest. You lighthouse pirates tend to have long and complicate quests. I think I'll just leave. Right NOW!
You know, I think I've had enough problem solving for today. Maybe I'll go see if I can lasso up a wild zebra!

chatpoints.chat_text: (The pirate chokes back a sob.) I be sleepin' too hard and too long. Dem keelhauling, scurvy rat, scum bucket Skull pirates o'er yonder plundered me lighthouse while I was catchin' some shut eye!

replies.reply_text: Plundered? You mean they stole things from you?
Oh no! If you are talking about the Skulls, I am not getting involved. That could start an all out pirate war!
All this talk about sleep is making me... (You suddenly yawn.) sleepy! I think I'll head back home to my bed now.

chatpoints.chat_text: Aye, they did indeed! They made off wit' me foghorn! (Crow's Nest Carrie slumps down in a chair and sighs.) No self-respectin' lighthouse keeper can do their job without one! How ye gonna warn de ships? (She lays her head on the table and starts sobbing.)

replies.reply_text: Please don't cry. I'm sure we can get it back. I'll go talk to the Captain and look for it now! (Unfortunately, Crow's Nest Carrie is sobbing so loudly, she doesn't seem to hear you.)
Yikes! A sobbing pirate. (You decide to give her some privacy and leave.)

chatpoints.chat_text: (Crow's Nest Carrie is slumped over the table, sobbing.)

replies.reply_text: Oh dear. I'll go see the Captain and give you some privacy.
I've got it! I've got it! I've got your foghorn!
Thanks! This reward made all this trouble worth it!

chatpoints.chat_text: Ahoy there, Matey!

replies.reply_text: Ahoy!  Bye!
Ahoy there, Carrie! Permission to come aboard?
Hi!  I'm back from talking to the other pirates here on the Cross Bones and I have some interesting suggestions.
I'm sorry, Carrie, what did you ask me to do for you?
Sorry, but where am I supposed to go for you again?
I got a little distracted, sorry.  Now where was I? Oh yes there are more hobbies than the anchors and maps.
Ahoy Carrie!  I'm back from Art Isle with several suggestions for you, and all the ladies sent materials to get you started.
That should be everything.

chatpoints.chat_text: Aye Matey. It be good to see ya again. How be yer sailings?

replies.reply_text: I've been fine, thank you.  Traveling all over these islands.  How have you been since we got everything straightened out for you?
I've been fine.  I just stopped by to check on you.  See you again soon!

chatpoints.chat_text: Truthfully matey, now that matters be all settled and such, I find that I have time on me hands.  I think I be needin' a hobby, but don't know what to do.

replies.reply_text: That’s nice, hope you find one.  Bye for now!
That might be a good way to spend your time, any ideas about what you’d like to do?
All right, I’ll ask all the pirates here on the Cross Bones and let you know what they do with their time. I’ll be back later!
Well, one of your neighbors collects old maps, and another collects anchors.

chatpoints.chat_text: Anchors and maps??  Those seadogs must be havin' the king's own space fer their collections.  I don't be havin' that much room.  What else did ya find?

replies.reply_text: There is a collector of stamps and a painter.

chatpoints.chat_text: Now those be somethin' that sound kind of manly, I be lookin’ fer a lady-like interest.  Paintin’ might work, I don't have that eye fer detail.

replies.reply_text: Maybe I could go to another island and ask the folks there if they have any suggestions for you.
Let's see someplace where artists live....Oh, I know just the spot!  I'll be back before you know it.  Bye.
Somewhere where artists live? (Scratching your head.) I'm not exactly sure, but I'll find it. See you later!

chatpoints.chat_text: That be okay, matey.  I asked ye to inquire from all of me fellow pirates here on the Cross Bones what they be doin' with their spare time.  But remember, don't be botherin' the captains!

replies.reply_text: That's right I'm supposed to ask everybody about their hobbies.  Be right back.

chatpoints.chat_text: I asked ye to go find that island of artsy folks and ask the women folk there fer ideas.

replies.reply_text: Oh, yeah, I'm supposed to talk to the lady artists.  I'll be back!

chatpoints.chat_text: Arrrr, let’s see what ya brungs me.

replies.reply_text: Eunice is a sand painter, so she sent this starter kit.  We thought that since there is so much sand around here….
Holly collects miniature horses, she thought seeing how you are by the sea, you might like to collect sea shells.  Here’s a seahorse to start you off.
Genevieve is a potter and she thought you might like that.  She sent some clay and instructions, if you like it she’ll send more equipment.
Mona is a sculptor, but she crochets to relax. She sent this tote bag that she made, it has everything in it you’ll need to start crocheting.
Posy likes flowers, she raises them and she makes floral arrangements.  She sent some books on using live flowers and dried flowers.
That should be everything.
That's all I have with me right now, I'll come back when I finish talking to all the ladies on Art Isle.
That's good to hear, but I have more suggestions.
I have to go back and finish talking to the other artists, I'll be back soon.
That should be everything.
Beachcombing can be relaxing, but there are more ideas.
I have to go back and finish talking to the other artists, I'll be back soon.
That should be everything.
They say pottery can be a good tension reliever, but I have another suggestion.
I have to go back and finish talking to the other artists, I'll be back soon.
That should be everything.
Wow!  It sounds like you are genetically designed to crochet.  I still have more suggestions, though.
I have to go back and finish talking to the other artists, I'll be back soon.
That should be everything.
Not having a flower supply might make that difficult, but here's another suggestion.
I have to go back and finish talking to the other artists, I'll be back soon.
That should be everything.
Why thank you, Carrie, it was my pleasure.  I'll stop by to see you in a few months, bye bye!!

npc_list.name: Mother Goose
npc_list.long_description: As you can see, Mother Goose is not actually a goose, just a normal human being. She is an older woman you just know is an expert on Cloud Isle and its inhabitants.

chatpoints.chat_text: Hello there, dear. What brings you to the Cloud Isles?

replies.reply_text: Wow! Are you the real Mother Goose?
Oh, nothing much. Just exploring. See you around.
I have a delicious smelling plate of cookies that was made just for you!

It is such a lovely place to visit, I thought I'd spend the day enjoying the isles. To my surprise, there seems to a disturbance going on. I was wondering if you might know something about the banging?
Where did you say that banging noise seemed to be coming from?

chatpoints.chat_text: Indeed I am. I know just about everything there is to know about this special place.

replies.reply_text: Why is it so special?
As interesting as that sounds, I really must be going.

chatpoints.chat_text: The Cloud Isles are special because they are home to many characters from nursery rhymes and fairy tales.

replies.reply_text: Wow, that's neat! I can't wait to meet them all!

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, really, dear? From whom?

replies.reply_text: From Hansel and Gretel, to celebrate the nearing grand-opening of their new bakery!
You're welcome! And thanks!

chatpoints.chat_text: It is indeed, a lovely place to visit and I am afraid the banging has created a great deal of agitation around these parts. My geese are rattled every time the banging starts. They are so stressed by the noise, they've stopped laying eggs!

replies.reply_text: Oh dear! Can you tell which direction the noise is coming from?

chatpoints.chat_text: My hearing isn't the best these days, but that banging is so loud, I can tell distinctly that it is coming somewhere southeast of here.

replies.reply_text: That's where I'll start looking then!

chatpoints.chat_text: Somewhere southeast of here. And I do hope you get this resolved quickly. My geese are so distressed!

replies.reply_text: Thanks! I'll head over in that general direction and see what I can find.

npc_list.name: Crash Joller
npc_list.admin_description: NO NEW QUESTS
npc_list.long_description: A righteous dude that totally knows how to nosh the waves.

chatpoints.chat_text: Like, woah, little dude!  Did you see me rip on that gnarly bomb?  I was like, expecting something awesome but all I did was a baby ramp out!   Chuuuuuf!

replies.reply_text: Excuse me?
What did you just say?  Forget it, I don't want to know!

chatpoints.chat_text: You know dude, I totally, like, could have been axed but, no!  I charged in, locked on, and did a verticle in that curl!  Sshhah.  It was totally radical!

replies.reply_text: You did what, where?
Like, whatever dude.  I'm out.

chatpoints.chat_text: It's all chill, little buddy.  You like, a wannabe or a vegetable?  Or are you like on vaycay? No matter, bro!  I wanna jazz the glass again soon, but my board is getting foul!  Ya think you can hook a bud up with some wax for my board?

replies.reply_text: Wait... You want my help?
No way.  You're weird!  See ya.

chatpoints.chat_text: Pshhhyeah.  Like my grip is slip and I need the wax to keep steady or I'll really eat it out on the big old blue!  So what do ya say?  Can you get me some wax for my board?

replies.reply_text: Sure, I can help get some wax.  What do you need exactly?
No, I think I'll come back later.  The sun is really getting to me today.
Okay.  I'll be back when I have... like, 5 honeycombs, dude!

chatpoints.chat_text: I'm getting all, like... Burt Reynolds out here!  Woah.                  Oh, hey, little dude!  Did you find the beeswax that I need for my wicked board?

replies.reply_text: I forgot.  What did you need again?
Yeah buddy.  I got them right here!

chatpoints.chat_text: Like, I need some anti-slippage for the board when I hit the primo waves!  So I need like, 5 honeycombs to keep the board solid.  Shhah.

replies.reply_text: Right!  Five honeycombs.  Be right back!
Thanks, Crash!

chatpoints.chat_text: Cowabunga, little dude!  Come back later and we'll like hit that gnarly Green Room together and I'll show you a few moves, fer sure!

replies.reply_text: Sure thing, Crash. Uhh, I mean... Surf's up!
I'm back Crash and ready to learn a few moves!

chatpoints.chat_text: You were like looking for that beach bunny on Hoof for me!  Like...pshhhyeah.

replies.reply_text: That's right!  I'll be back as soon as I know something about her!
Okay!  See you at Isadora's!
You're welcome!  So when are you going to meet her?

chatpoints.chat_text: Woah, yeah. I can like, totally teach you to rip the waves, gremmie!  But like...I'm a little distracted right now.  I mean...wooaah.

replies.reply_text: What do you mean?  Are you okay?
Well, I guess I'll come back later when you feel better.  Hang ten, Crash!

chatpoints.chat_text: It's like this, buddy.  I was catchin' this gnarly riff near the shores of Hoof and I saw the most beautiful Beach Bunny...ever!  And I was like, "Woah!", and totally swallowed the foam!

replies.reply_text: Oh, so you're in love!  That's so sweet!
Dude, I still don't get it.  I gotta jet.  See ya later.

chatpoints.chat_text: Shuuuff, right?   I guess so, little dude.  When I got to the beach she, like, chucked outta there before I could like, do anything!  It's just...woah.  I just can't stop thinking about her!

replies.reply_text: Wow.  That's a great story!  Why don't you try to find her again?
Sounds like you'll never see her again.  Oh well, C'est la vie!

chatpoints.chat_text: Aikona, little bro! No way! I already wiped out in front of her and look like a real stinkbugger! There's like, no way she'd want to meet me now!

replies.reply_text: I bet I could change her mind.  Let me try to find her and talk to her for you.
Suit yourself.  Have fun catching waves by yourself!
Sure thing, Crash!  I'll be back in no time at all.

chatpoints.chat_text: Aweh!  It's like almost peak period fer ripping tide and Huey is making it totally tubular today, fer sure!

replies.reply_text: Hey, Crash!  I have some good news about the girl you saw on Hoof!
Right.  That's exactly what I mean, too.  See ya!
I'm back but I can't remember what I was doing for you...

chatpoints.chat_text: I don't wanna be a barnwaller so I'm gonna take my time, clean the board up, and head over...woah!  Do you think you could like, go ahead of me and let her, I mean, Isadora, know I'm gonna stop by?

replies.reply_text: I've done enough running around for you.  Good luck, Crash!
I guess I could do that for you.  What's one more errand anyways?
Okay!  See you at Isadora's!

chatpoints.chat_text: Woah!  Really?  What'd you find out, little dude?

replies.reply_text: Her name is Isadora and she wants to meet you!  Oh, and she wanted me to give you this gift!
I can't remember.  Umm...I'll come back when I think about it.

npc_list.name: Davisse
npc_list.admin_description: No additional quests -- single quest character only -- turns into Michelle
npc_list.long_description: A sharp-eyed lass who seems completely comfortable climbing around the ship's rigging. By the look in her eyes, you sure wouldn't want to be the target of her wrath.

chatpoints.chat_text: What'cha be lookin' at? Can't ya see I'm a busy woman! Git on wit ya already!

replies.reply_text: Sorry! Just wanted to enjoy the sea breeze for a moment. Didn't mean to interrupt you.
Ummm.... If you're Davisse, I've got a letter for you.
Yikes! Another pirate. Run for your life!
Can you remind me what we were discussing?
Can you remind me what we were discussing?
Was there something I was doing for you?
I be lookin' at you, Matey! And I've got just the answer you were looking for!
I don't think so. He seems really sad, and sincere. I know he feels terrible, and really misses Michelle.
You are probably right. I think I'll just skedaddle right on out of here!
You might be right. On the other hand, if there was a chance, a teeny little chance that he was sincere, would you want to stand in the way?

chatpoints.chat_text: (Davisse's harsh look softens a teeny-tiny bit.) You'd swear yer scruffy best horse on it?

replies.reply_text: I do!
No way! I'm outta here!
Ummm. Let me think about that. I'll let you know, sooner or later!
So if you could just tell me where Michelle is, I'll be on my way.
Ummm. I'm not sure what I'm supposed to do now. Any suggestions?

chatpoints.chat_text: Humpff! Ya got me there, Matey. Make amends, eh?

replies.reply_text: Yes. I swear the man is heart-broken.
That's what he implied. Not even strawberry pie cheered him up.

chatpoints.chat_text: Arrrgggg! (Oh dear! That was the wrong thing to say. The Harbormistress is really scowilng now!)

replies.reply_text: You know, that came out all wrong. It was the strawberry pie that made him realize how badly things had gone wrong. And how much he wanted to make amends to Michelle. Really! I swear it.
Yikes, look at the time! I've gotta run!

chatpoints.chat_text: Ye be fixin' ta lose that horse! Just 'cause ye gots faith in what that scoundrel be sayin' don't mean he be trustworthy!

replies.reply_text: Is there something he could do? Anything? That would change your mind? I really need to find Michelle!

chatpoints.chat_text: Ye was fixin' ta swear on yer best horse that Gus be havin' sincere intentions...

replies.reply_text: Oh, right! Absolutely. I swear it!
Oh, right! I'd rather not. I think I'll just look for something else to do!

chatpoints.chat_text: Ye can tell that.... foul-hearted piece of fish guts this... Iffin he can remember what he told me... ahem, I mean Michelle, iffin he can remember what he told MICHELLE the first time he saw her, well, ya be askin' him that. And iffin ye come back with the right answer, I'll listen ta what ole Gus wants to be tellin' me. I mean, tellin' Michelle.

replies.reply_text: Okay, let me understand this. I have to ask Just Gus what he told you -- ummm -- told Michelle -- the first time he met her. And come back and tell you? Sure, I can do that!
Gesh! Sounds like I'm not the only one confused! Fine, fine. I'll do it.
Good gosh already! This is way too confusing for me. Later!
I'll head over there right now! And thank you again!

chatpoints.chat_text: Aye! Ye was ta ask that scurvy dog Gus what words he be using on Michelle. The first time he laid eyes on her.

replies.reply_text: You know, this is getting way too messy. He's heart-broken, Michelle is missing, and you are one angry pirate. Piratess? Anyway, I think I'll just go look for wild horses now.
Why, yes I was! I'll be back!
Scurvy dog, foul-hearted piece of fish guts...  I take it you aren't too crazy about Just Gus. But I'll head over there now and hopefully get this quest resolved asap.

chatpoints.chat_text: Aye! Ye was trying to convince me to give up the where 'bouts of Michelle. On account of some no good scruvy dog Gus.

replies.reply_text: Oh, right! So, he really wants to find her. He's just heartbroken.
Oh, that. Yea, I've changed my mind. Pirates are too much trouble. Bye!

npc_list.name: Michelle Boatloader
npc_list.admin_description: New Quests Must Start At CP 7
npc_list.long_description: A sharp-eyed lass who looks just like Davisse. She is busy keeping her ship in tip-top shape. Seems like Michelle is wearing the glow of a woman in love! Still, she IS a pirate. You wouldn't want to get on her bad side.

chatpoints.chat_text: Be ye tongue-tied, or gots ye sometin' to say?

replies.reply_text: Umm. I was talking to Davisse.... Does she have a twin, by any chance?
I've got some gifts for you. I think Just Gus might have gotten it just right this time!
Yikes! Another pirate. Run for your life!
This is some weird trick, huh? I'm just not in the mood. Bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: (Michelle grins.) Ye can't be that daft. It weren't much of a disguise. Ye be talkin' to me all along. Ain't no Davisse.

replies.reply_text: Well, sure. I knew that. I did. I just was going along with your pretense. You know, seeing as you were pretending to be Davisse and all....
So, it's just as I suspected! You were incognito! Hiding in plain sight! Davisse was just a clever disguise. A front, a facade for you. Tricky, tricky!
Whew! So I guess I can go tell Gus all is forgiven?

chatpoints.chat_text: Aye. Like I'm daft enough ta be believin' that. Ye be ready to take another message to that bilge rat? I'll be needin' a gift or two afore I'd be willin' to talk to that scallywag.

replies.reply_text: I'll tell him right away!
Did you have something specific in mind?
A gift or two, huh? I'm carrying all kinds of things that you might like. Say, an apple treat? I could give you that.

chatpoints.chat_text: Just what any wench be wantin'. And iffn he ain't able to figure that out, he ain't be the man fer me.

replies.reply_text: Yikes! Okay, I'll let him know. I'm heading there RIGHT NOW!
I'm pretty sure he isn't a mind reader. But I'll head his way and tell him what you said.

You know, I've spent so much time on the quest, it is driving me nuts! However, I shall persevere and finish it. I must! So, is there any way I can bribe you, so I don't have to go back and forth between the two of you? I just want this quest done!

chatpoints.chat_text: Not iffin ye be wantin' yer horse, ye scurvy dog.

replies.reply_text: Scurvy dog? That is so uncalled for! I've been trying to do a good deed here, and that's what I get? I'll just make like snow on a hot day and melt right on outta here!
Okay, okay. How about giving me some kind of hint on what kind of gift you'd like?
Okay, how about a pet? Say, a starfish? That has a kinda romantic imagery to it. How about I give that to you as a gift from Gus?
Well, I certainly want to keep my horse. So could you give me a clue or two to what you might want?
How about some food? I think I've got some fried fish...
Whew! It sure is good to see you happy! I'm heading back to Gus now. Bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: (Michelle flicks her cutlass in your direction.) And yer point be, ye bilge rat?

replies.reply_text: Umm. No point. Not point at all. So... I was just kinda pulling your leg. You know, kidding. Yea, I was just kidding.
Point? Looks like my compass has a point -- and it's pointing out of here! Later!
Me? No point, none. So, is there something you want to make this whole bad pie experience go away?

chatpoints.chat_text: Ahoy! Be ye tongue-tied, or gots ye sometin' to say?

replies.reply_text: Just stopped by to say hi!
(Gulp!) I was just kidding! Haha. I guess that means that wasn't what you wanted?

chatpoints.chat_text: (Olav is busy sorting some roofing tiles, and doesn't look up when you enter.) I don't take many jobs anymore. You can leave your name, contact information and what kind of roof you have in the book on the table. No promises.

replies.reply_text: I'm just passing through.  Sorry to have bothered you!
Those are some awesome tiles.  How much are they?
I'm actually here on behalf of your sister, Katinka.
Hi, Olav.  I'm back from Kay's!
Sorry to interrupt, but who's getting this bill again?
Wow! Did you see that beautiful horse that just ran by? Oops, my bad, now what were you saying about this packet?
Hello, Olav! How have you been?
Hi, Olav....help me out here....am I doing something for you?
Hi Olav, I'm back with all your supplies!
I brought you everything you asked for, right?

chatpoints.chat_text: I'm a roofer, not a roofing supply depot!  I only do commissioned jobs nowadays.  No time for speculation!

replies.reply_text: Geez, sorry to have troubled you!  Goodbye.

chatpoints.chat_text: (This news stops Olav in his tracks!) Katinka? On behalf of Katinka? Uff da, is she all right?

replies.reply_text: Your sister is fine, or at least she was when I was last there.  She's lonely, and she misses her family.
I should think, if you really wanted to know how she is, you'd have written to her now and then, instead of Yorick!

chatpoints.chat_text: Yeah, I know I haven't been the best of brothers and all.

replies.reply_text: That's an understatement!  But still, at least you've had Yorick checking up on her.  I guess that's worth something!
You can say that again, mister!

chatpoints.chat_text: Okay, okay.  I know I made some mistakes along the way, but I do care about her.

replies.reply_text: So what are you going to do about it?

chatpoints.chat_text: Let's see, I've got a bill here that I need delivered.  It's for Kay over in Wington.

replies.reply_text: I can do that, but what has it got to do with Katinka?
I'm sorry, but I've already been running around far too much.  I can't make a trip to Wington right now.  Bye.
Okay, that's really nice of you.  Should I bring the bird to Katinka?

chatpoints.chat_text: No, I want you to come back here.  I'll have some more things for her when you get back.

replies.reply_text: All righty, then.  I'll be back soon!

chatpoints.chat_text: I asked you to bring it to Kay Macaw.  Then pick out a bird for Katinka and bring it back here.

replies.reply_text: Oh, yeah, I'm supposed to go to Wington!  See you later!

chatpoints.chat_text: Wonderful! Let's see the bird you chose.

replies.reply_text: (You show Olav the myna, and he smiles with approval.) Kay said that this myna can talk and is as smart as a whip. She should be an excellent companion for Katinka.

chatpoints.chat_text: That bird will be wonderful! While you were away, I went to the bank and opened a trust account for Katinka.  This packet contains some paperwork she has to sign and a letter I wrote explaining everything to her.

replies.reply_text: That's very thoughtful of you, but what is she supposed to do with the paperwork?

chatpoints.chat_text: It looks like one more little favor I have to ask of you. After she signs them, could you bring these papers to the bank in Witherton?  You'll get a checkbook to bring back to Katinka so that she will always have a ready supply of money.

replies.reply_text: That's more than a little favor, but I'll do it.  I happen to like your sister, and I want to see her happy.
You know, you're not such a bad guy after all.  See ya around!

chatpoints.chat_text: Thank you.  And tell her I'll come visit next spring, I promise!

replies.reply_text: You know, you're not such a bad guy after all.  See ya around!

chatpoints.chat_text: I asked you to have Katinka sign the bank papers in the packet, and then I asked you to bring them to the bank in Witherton.

replies.reply_text: Okay, I'm on it!  Bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: Welcome, friend!  I can't thank you enough for what you've done for Katinka.

replies.reply_text: It was nothing...  What have you been up to lately?
It was my pleasure, Olav.  I just popped in to say hi!

chatpoints.chat_text: I'm afraid I've been busier than I had planned.  I'm running out of roofing materials and could use some help.

replies.reply_text: Sorry, but I'm kind of busy right now, maybe next time, bye!
I thought you were semi-retired...but I'm here if you need help.

chatpoints.chat_text: I appreciate that. I have orders out for my supplies that need to be picked up. (Olav shrugs with a smile) You know what they say, once a roofer, always a roofer!

replies.reply_text: Do they?  Do they really say that?  I've got time, what do you need?
Something tells me that this is going to be long and involved....sorry I don't have time for complex right now....see ya!
All right, but where am I actually going for you?
Uh oh.....this sounds like it's going to take more time than I have.....sorry.

chatpoints.chat_text: You're going to have to do a lot of traveling for this....  There is the order of terra cotta tiles from Genevieve on Art Isle, the reeds for thatching from Greig on Horse Isle, my wood shingles from Cedric in Chillton and tar paper from Murray on Tail Isle.

replies.reply_text: That's okay, I'm a born wanderer!  Do I have to pay for any of these orders?
Nope...this one's not for me, sorry Olav, but I don't like traveling that much.

chatpoints.chat_text: No, all of the orders have been prepaid, you just have to pick them up.

replies.reply_text: Great!  Then I'm your rider!
Thanks.  I'll be back as soon as I finish!

chatpoints.chat_text: You're picking up my roofing supplies.  I gave you a list, remember?  Remember bring them back together, not in dribs and drabs!

replies.reply_text: Oh, is that what this list is.  Sorry, I'll get right back to it!
I most certainly did.  Ready?
I most certainly did.  Ready?

chatpoints.chat_text: All right, show me what you brought.

replies.reply_text: I have the reeds from Greig.
I have the shingles from Cedric
I have the terra cotta tiles from Genevieve.
I have the tar paper from Murray, (under your breath) sort of.
I believe I gave you everything!
Don't worry, I have more.
This is the last of it.
Uh oh, I think I forgot something, I'll be right back!
There's more, don't worry.
Oh, ummm looks like I left the thing at the place...I'll be right back!
That's everything!
That's everything on your list.
There's more, there's more.
Wait a minute, something's missing, I'll be right back, promise!
And of course, there's more stuff!
That's all!
I could have sworn I got everything...be back in a flash!
Wow!  Thanks for the Meerkat, Olav!  I'll stop by next time I'm in the neighborhood, bye!

npc_list.name: Smelly Toes Monroe
npc_list.admin_description: visible after action #2757
npc_list.long_description: The lighthouse keeper is a not so scary looking red-headed pirate. The heart tattoo on his arm with the word Mom on it is a nice touch!

chatpoints.chat_text: (The waves no longer splash into the lighthouse and the inside barely smells musty anymore. Smelly Toes is sitting in front of an easel. Looks like he's decided to take up watercolors.) An artist be needin' plenty o' sunshine, matey. So iffin ye could just step ta de side a bit... Ye be blockin' it from comin' in the doorway.

replies.reply_text: Howdy, howdy! Glad to see you can spend time on your hobby -- now that you aren't bailing out the sea. Take care!
I'm so confused! A lighthouse keeper that's really a pirate who's also an artist? YIKES!
Sorry, Crow's Nest Carrie asked me to ask you about hobbies.  Any suggestions?
Hey there Smelly Toes... er... umm. I guess I shouldn't call you that anymore, since you no longer have that particular problem.
Greetings! I remembered how to fix your problem but I need to make sure you are okay with the solution.
I'm back with your chickens! Baby chickens, but still! And a large bag of chicken feed to get them started.
Hello! Was there something I was doing for you? I think there was, but I just can't remember.
Good day! How's those baby chickens working out for you?

chatpoints.chat_text: I've found me spare time is best served with me paintin'.  Carrie might be likin; it too.

replies.reply_text: Painting....that might work.  I'll tell her, thanks!

chatpoints.chat_text: I ain't be takin' no offense, Matey. It be me name fer 20 plus years and it be what me friends know me by. Now what brings ye here on a day such as this be?

replies.reply_text: I was in the area and thought I'd stop by and see how you were doing. So you are an artist now?
Oh nothing. Just wanted to say hi and bye. So, HI! and now BYE!

chatpoints.chat_text: I am indeed and mighty proud of it. But recollectin' about how ye helped me out in the past has me itchin' ta ask another favor of ye.

replies.reply_text: Oh gesh! Helping you with the seawall was a lot of work. I think I'll just leave before you guilt me into helping you out anymore!
Itchin', eh? Tell me more so I can decide if its something I can help you with or not.

chatpoints.chat_text: When I be sayin' itchin', I'm talkin' literally, Matey. Check out me feet and legs! (Smelly Toes kicks off his boots and rolls up his trousers. He is covered in angry looking red bug bites.)

replies.reply_text: Holy smokes! That looks miserable. You must have a hundred bites.
I do NOT want to see anything that nasty looking. I am gone like yesterday's lunch!

chatpoints.chat_text: Can ye help me Matey? The itchin' be distractin' me to no end, and me artwork be sufferin' for it.

replies.reply_text: Those look like sand flea bites. Let me think, let me think. Seems to me I ran into someone else who was dealing with those little buggers. I'm going to say yes, I'll help you, and try to remember who that was. Sound good?
Oh dear. Look at the time. So sorry, I've got to run along. Bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: Ye be the best ever, Matey!

replies.reply_text: I'll get right on it.
Say! I've just remembered what might work.

chatpoints.chat_text: And what that might be, Matey?

replies.reply_text: Chickens. Jocosa over on Dog Isle had me get her some for sand fleas. Would you be good with some chickens? Seems they love eating sand fleas.

chatpoints.chat_text: I never met no chicken me belly didn't like. Roasted with a bit o' garlic and sage. Or even a chicken, lettuce and bacon sandwich. Makes me mouth water somethin' fierce!

replies.reply_text: No, no, no. The chickens are to eat the sand fleas. What do you think?

chatpoints.chat_text: Hmmm. I can't be makin' no promises. They might not like me. And then they'd be gone and me legs and feet would be itchin' all over again!

replies.reply_text: Fair enough. We'll give this idea a go. I'll cross my fingers that it works long enough to take care of those itchy bug bites.
Well thank goodness you are up for the plan. I took it upon myself to get the chicken and here they are!

Thank you kindly and enjoy those little peepers! I'll check back to see how you're doing with those chickens. (You look over and the baby chicks are already busy pecking around the floor of the light house.) In the meantime, take care!

chatpoints.chat_text: (Smelly Toes groans loudly.) Seriously, Mate? Dem sand fleas is eatin' me alive! Ye said ye was checking on chickens.

replies.reply_text: Checking on chickens! Of course! And I've got you a half dozen of those little peepers right here.
Opps! I'll be back shortly.

chatpoints.chat_text: (Smelly Toes peels off a boot and yanks up his trouser leg. There don't seem to be as many bites and the old bites aren't nearly as red and angry looking.) Makin' progress! I ain't seeing no new bites and them chickies are some good company. I had no idea!

replies.reply_text: Wonderful! I'm off to other adventures then. Good day!

chatpoints.chat_text: Good day! And how may I help secure your financial future?

replies.reply_text: Thanks, but no thanks.  I'm just passing through.
You can help me secure Miss Katinka's financial future.  I was told to bring you these papers.
I'm not here on financial business. I was hoping you could tell me if you'd seen any copper wind chimes? The farrier is missing his.

chatpoints.chat_text: The Hotton branch advised me that you'd be bringing these to me. (She looks over the signed papers) Let's see, these are all in order. Here you go. (She hands you the checkbook.)

replies.reply_text: Thank you.  Is there anything I need to tell her about this account?
That's very kind of you.  I'll be sure to let her know.  Good day!

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, dear! You know, there was a day or two last week when I heard the sweetest sound... must have been his chimes. I haven't seen or heard them since. Please tell Rick I enjoyed their sweet sounds.

replies.reply_text: I will be happy to tell him that. Bye!

npc_list.name: Dorothy
npc_list.admin_description: new quests start at CP11
npc_list.long_description: A sleek, smooth, and graceful dolphin swims up to shore to greet you.

chatpoints.chat_text: Hello there!  Will you be my purpose?

replies.reply_text: I'm sorry, your... purpose?
No, thanks.  I have some more exploring to do.

chatpoints.chat_text: Yes, my purpose!  Everyone must have a purpose!

replies.reply_text: I understand, I think.  But I don't think I can be your "purpose"?
Yeah.  Mine is to quest and make money and you are keeping me from it.  See ya.

chatpoints.chat_text: Sure you can!  I need a purpose and I accidently saw you from way out in the ocean.  Will you help me and be my purpose?

replies.reply_text: Well, what do you need exactly?
You mean... accidently on purpose?  I am so confused!  I'll come back later.

chatpoints.chat_text: I need my purpose in life and that's FISHIES!  Lots and lots of fishies!! Big fishies!  Small fishies!  Yes.  Purposeful fishies.

replies.reply_text: I am really not good at fishing, sorry.  Maybe you can find someone else on purpose... for your purpose.
I guess I can bring you some fish.  What do you need exactly?
Okay.  I'll be right back with your fish!

chatpoints.chat_text: Hello again!  Do you have my purpose?

replies.reply_text: I'm sorry, what was your purpose again?
Yes, I do!  They are all right here!
You need more purpose? I mean, more fish?
Yes, I have some right here, Dorothy!

chatpoints.chat_text: You were bringing me my purpose!  On purpose, of course, because I asked you!  Five big fishies and five small fishies to be used for my purpose!

replies.reply_text: That's right, I need to go fishing.  Thanks for reminding me!
Thanks so much!  Glad I could be your purpose, Dorothy!

chatpoints.chat_text: Yes, I do!  I can always use more fishies!  Yay, FISHIES!!!    So, if you bring me more purpose, or ten big fishies,  I will trade you more black shiny rocks.  How does that sound?

replies.reply_text: Five big fish for one obsidian?  That sounds like a pretty good trade!  I am off to the fishing pond!
What about little fish?
Thank you!  I'll come back when I have more.
I have more big fish!
I have some little fish!
Five big fish for one obsidian chunk?  Ten little fish for one pearl?  That sounds like a fair trade.  I'll be back with big and little fish for you, Dorothy!

chatpoints.chat_text: You have my purpose?  Really?  Yay!!  Which one, big or little?

replies.reply_text: Nothing right now.  Maybe I'll bring some by later.  Bye!
I have 5 big fish right here!
I have 10 little fish right here!
No, but maybe you can help me?  Do you know anything about a mysterious box with all of the Ocean's secrets?
I'm back with your fish and I need that box!  Ready to trade?
Thank you, Dorothy!  I'll be back with more fish for you!
I have more little fish for you!
I have some big fish for you!

chatpoints.chat_text: Yes!  Yes, I know of a mysterious secret box!  Yes, it's on the ocean floor!  Yes, I know about it!

replies.reply_text: Do you know what's in the mystery box?
Oh good.  Give it to me, then.  I need it!

chatpoints.chat_text: Yes!  No wait.... I mean, no!  I don't know what's in the box!  But I can bring it up from the ocean floor!

replies.reply_text: Would you do that for me please?
Forget it.  I'll find someone else to do it for me.

chatpoints.chat_text: I can bring you the box.... for five big fishies!  Yes!  Five big fishies!!

replies.reply_text: WHAT?  Are you serious?   No way.  Forget it.
Really?  I am terrible at fishing and this is really important! It's a matter of love and bringing two people together who love each other!

chatpoints.chat_text: Yes, important!  Like fishies!  YAY!  Fishies!!

replies.reply_text: How about I give you five normal sized fish instead?
This is hopeless and taking too long.  I'll figure something else out.
Okay, well, I'll be back with your fish soon!  Don't forget to get the box from the bottom of the ocean!
Thank you, Dorothy.  You've been a big help!

chatpoints.chat_text: Do you have my normal sized fishies??  Yay!!!

replies.reply_text: Yes, I'm back with your fish and I need that box!  Ready to trade?

npc_list.name: Soporta
npc_list.admin_description: New Quests start at CP 14
npc_list.long_description: Just hopping along Atropos is a bright colored frog in the high grasses.

chatpoints.chat_text: Hello there!  What brings you to my isle?

replies.reply_text: A talking frog?  Boring!  I think I will go find an elephant instead.
I’m just doing some exploring and thought I’d stop for a chat.  Is there anything I can help you with?

chatpoints.chat_text: Actually, there is something you could do.  I'm putting the band back together and we need to practice.   Would you mind telling them all to meet back here with their instruments?

replies.reply_text: Sure, I can do that for you!  But I don't think I've heard you play before.  What's the name of the band?
A band with... frogs?  Weird!  I don’t think I want to encourage that.  See ya!

chatpoints.chat_text: Really? You've never heard of Elsie's Roh? We're just a small group, but really know how to kick it up old school style!

replies.reply_text: Nope.  Never heard it and it sounds like a terrible name for a band!  Maybe I'll stop by later to hear you croak, err, play.
That's really cool!  I'd love to hear you play, and I happen to have time to find the rest of the band for you!

npc_list.name: Karina
npc_list.admin_description: DO NOT USE
npc_list.long_description: A fashionable woman in her 30's that seems appropriately dressed for the surroundings, yet not, at the same time.

chatpoints.chat_text: (She startles when you come up behind her.) Oh! Wow. I didn't see you there. It's so quiet out here, you think I would have heard you. I guess I'm so engrossed in this beautiful place.

replies.reply_text: I guess.  Sorry to have scared you.  I'll just be on my way.
What are you looking for?

chatpoints.chat_text: Inspiration!  This temple is amazing.  The colors and shapes.  Just exquisite.  I'm a designer, you see, and I was hoping to get some ideas out here.

replies.reply_text: I will leave you to it, then.  Good luck!
That is so neat. (You start looking around the area with a different eye than before.)
Interesting.   I actually have a really odd question.  I met a baby in Shellton.  She has the same name as you.  It's not too often people around here have the same name.
Speaking of, how does that work anyway?  Doing "research" for designing?

chatpoints.chat_text: Phew!  Wow.  Anyway, were you just going for a walk and happened to stumble up this way?  I don't mind the company, I'm just curious.

replies.reply_text: Yeah, just exploring.  I guess I should keep going.  Have fun!
Oh!  That's right!  Jean Stonwasht sent me with this package.
I'll do that.  Good luck finding your inspiration!

chatpoints.chat_text: Baby Karina?  She is a sweetheart.  Smart for her age, too.  Her mother, Sierra, is a very good friend of mine.  Let's just say I did a huge favor for her a while back.

replies.reply_text: So she named her baby after you?
Well, that answers my question.  Thanks!  I'll leave you to your work now.

chatpoints.chat_text: Basically. (She gasps and points at a tree not too far away.) Did you see that? That toucan? Wow! What a wonderful color scheme! Excuse me, I must see if I can get closer.

replies.reply_text: All right.  Well, good luck!

chatpoints.chat_text: (She laughs a little.) Well, I wouldn't call it research. More brainstorming. I find a place I haven't been to, and spend some time talking to the locals, exploring, etc. That is the best way to find new things and get new ideas. Then I write down any possibilities. I can always sort through them once I get back to the shop.

replies.reply_text: That reminds me.  Jean Stonwasht sent me with this package.
I'll leave you to your brainstorming, then.  Good luck!

npc_list.name: Katinka
npc_list.long_description: Katinka lives alone and she craves company.  She likes to knit and there are examples of her work all over the cabin.

replies.reply_text: I agree, and I'll look high and low until I find him for you, I promise.  By the way, do you know anyone in town who may have kept in touch with your brother?

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, as we both got older, he started complaining about the cold weather more and more.

replies.reply_text: You do live on Ice Isle, after all!  So what happened to Olav?
Where did your brother go? Why did he leave?

chatpoints.chat_text: I don't know, Olav said that there wasn't enough for him to do here, and he was going to go somewhere that his skills would be appreciated. (Tears begin to well up in Katinka's eyes.)

replies.reply_text: There, there. I hate to see you cry.  Would you like me to try to find your brother for you?  I'm very good at finding people and things, you know!
I can't stand seeing old people cry.  Bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: Why hello! Please come in and warm yourself by the fire.  Can I get you anything?  I just love company!

replies.reply_text: Hello there.  I'm... um... just passing by.  Thanks for the invite, though.
Hi! Thank you, I could use a little warmth about now. (You look around the cabin.) Did you make all of these blankets and sweaters and hats? They're exquisite!
Sorry to bother you again, but who did you say Olav spent time with?
Katinka, guess what?  I found Olav for you!
Oh, Katinka, I'm back from the bank!
Excuse me, but I think there were some papers in that packet that you need to sign, Katinka.
I'm sorry to bother you, Katinka, but do you remember what I'm supposed to do with the papers you gave me?
Hi Katinka!  I just wanted to stop in and let you know that I'm hot on your brother's trail.  I should have him found in no time!
Hello again, Katinka!  I have an interesting project for you, if you're interested.
Katinka!  How's the gift coming along?
Not right now, thanks.  I 've come with a proposition for you.

chatpoints.chat_text: Thank you! My bestemor taught me to knit, (You look puzzled.) oh, I'm sorry, bestemor means "grandmother". She taught me just like her bestemor before her. In fact this house was built by my bestefor, umm, grandfather, when he first arrived here on Ice Isle. He said it reminded him of his homeland.

replies.reply_text: Somehow, I feel a genealogy lesson coming on, thanks for the use of your fireplace.  Bye!
Why did he build his house so far away from Crystalton?

chatpoints.chat_text: Bestefor said that he didn't like the big cities like Crystalton.  Too crowded and noisy!  He liked the serenity out here.  He said it reminded him of the fjords of home.

replies.reply_text: What did your bestefor do for a living?
You think Crystalton is a big city?  You really have to get out more! See ya!

chatpoints.chat_text: Bestefor was a master roofer.  He taught my father and my father taught my brother, Olav.  My family has been taking care of the roofs here and on Snow Isle for 3 generations... that is until Olav left.

replies.reply_text: That's too bad about Olav.  I really have to be going, bye!
Wow, a real family business, but you said until Olav left.  Where did he go?

chatpoints.chat_text: That's so sweet of you to keep me updated!

replies.reply_text: It's no problem.  I just wanted you to know that I hadn't forgotten my promise.  I'll be back soon!

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, I'm not sure about the city folks, but Olav used to spend a lot of time talking hockey with Yorick.  Maybe he has heard from Olav.

replies.reply_text: Very good, I'm off to talk to Yorick.  I'll see you soon, I promise!

chatpoints.chat_text: That's all right, I told you that he spent a lot of time talking hockey with Yorick.

replies.reply_text: That's right, I forgot.  I'll get right over there!

chatpoints.chat_text: You found him?  You really found Olav?

replies.reply_text: I looked high and low, over hill and dale, and at last I found him.  He asked me to give these to you.
Oh, that? Olav said it contains some papers you have to sign for a trust account he set up for you.  There's also a letter for you.

chatpoints.chat_text: But what am I supposed to do with the papers after I sign them?

replies.reply_text: Don't worry, Olav's got that covered.  He asked me to bring them to the bank and bring back your checkbook.
No problem.  I'll be back in 2 shakes of a lamb's tail!

chatpoints.chat_text: Excuse me? Oh, hello again. I was just finishing up Olav's letter. You know, he said I should use this money to start a knitting business. (Looking around her home at all the knit goods piled all over.) Hmmm... Maybe I will.

replies.reply_text: That sounds like a plan!  By the way, Miss Fortune at the bank wanted me to let you know that any time you want to get a little pin money, you can cash a check over at Windy Pick's store.  Now, here's your checkbook.
Why thank you, Miss Katinka, I'm deeply touched. I'm sorry, but I must be going now. (Wiping a tear from your eye.) Goodbye!

chatpoints.chat_text: Didn't you say that Olav wanted you to bring them to the bank?

replies.reply_text: Oh, that's right, he did tell me that.  I'll be right back!

chatpoints.chat_text: How delightful to see you again!  What is this interesting project you have for me?

replies.reply_text: A man I know, named Candide, has these beautiful golden sheep, and he spins their wool into yarn, but he doesn't know any needlecrafts.  He would like you to knit a special present for a friend of his using his golden yarn.

chatpoints.chat_text: My, my, golden yarn!  This friend must be very special!  What does he have in mind?

replies.reply_text: The present is for Sara, the Mayor of Shellton.  He gave me 25 skeins of yarn... What can you make with them?
Okay, I'll go look around the town and come back later.  I can't wait to see what you come up with!

chatpoints.chat_text: I just finished, what do you think? (Holds up a sweater and hat for your approval.)

replies.reply_text: They're beautiful!
I think Sara will just love them!  I'm sure that you keeping the extra yarn will be just fine.  Thanks!

chatpoints.chat_text: Who would send a proposition to me?

replies.reply_text: Well Iona, over in Flipperton, wants to hold a Founder's Day Crafts Festival.  She's hoping you can attend and display your needlework.  Here's your Invitation.
I'm sure Olav will love to see you!  I'll let Iona know you are coming.

chatpoints.chat_text: Psssssst!  Down 'ere!

replies.reply_text: What?  You scared me and I almost stepped on you!
Eeek!  A thing with claws!  I'm outta here!!!
I got the mystery box!  What should we do with it?
I can't remember.  What was I doing?
What was I doing?  My brain is all sand today.

chatpoints.chat_text: So you 'ant to know of dis... boy?  I know of dis boy, I do!

replies.reply_text: You mean, Crash?  What do you know about Crash?
Naw, I've had it with talking sea creatures!  See ya.

chatpoints.chat_text: Aye, I know of dis boy and so does de dolphin!  De dolphin knows of de boy and de box!

chatpoints.chat_text: Give dis box to me and I see about opening dis, yes?

replies.reply_text: I can't wait to see what's inside!  I'm so excited!  Here you go.

chatpoints.chat_text: You need de box!  Ask de dolphin about de box!

chatpoints.chat_text: De scroll!  Take de scroll to de Sea King!

chatpoints.chat_text: Go see his daughter and she get you 'dere!

replies.reply_text: Oh.  Well, that makes sense, doesn't it?  Thanks for all your help!

replies.reply_text: Great!  I'll check back later, then.  Good luck with all of the construction!

replies.reply_text: That sounds like quite a job.  Could you use any help?
You'd better get busy assembling.  Good luck!

chatpoints.chat_text: Why, mortal, thou hast shown me a kindness. Thou could assist me with the assembly.  The fairies are all about these isles.  It won't be an easy task for a mere mortal, but I sense that thou hast the strength of will to persevere.

replies.reply_text: Gee, I'm sorry, my strength of will is a little weak right now.  Goodbye.
How can you tell?

chatpoints.chat_text: Oberon and Titania have resolved their argument and will raise the changeling prince together. All of the fairies are to gather in the Mystic Forest at the midsummer moon to celebrate.

replies.reply_text: Okay, that's why, but you haven't told me where I'm going.
I'm not so sure I like where this is going...  I'll just go now.

chatpoints.chat_text: You must deliver this message to the Snow Fairies, the Jungle Fairies, the Forest Fairies, the Cloud Fairies, the Water Fairies and the Flower Fairies.

replies.reply_text: That's a lot of fairy finding.  I don't have that much time, sorry!
Well, I do love a challenge!  Where do I begin?
All right.  The Snow Fairy it is, but where do I find her?

chatpoints.chat_text: She lives amongst the pine trees on Snow Isle.

replies.reply_text: Snow Fairy.  Snow Isle.  Makes sense, I guess!  I'm off to find Rhoswen.  Bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, what fools these mortals be!  I sent thee to Rhoswen, the Snow Fairy on Snow Isle amongst the pines.  She will direct you to the other fairies.

replies.reply_text: Oh, yeah, I have to start on Snow Isle.  I'll see you later!
Glad to hear it!  I'm up to the challenge.  Where do I go and what do I tell them?

chatpoints.chat_text: Thou hast done remarkably well for a mortal.  What sayeth the other fairies?

replies.reply_text: They all will be in attendence and the Flower Fairies have sent a gift for Titania.  They said that you should bring it to her.
Thank you, it was an interesting task.  Might there be anything else I can do for this celebration?

chatpoints.chat_text: Aye, there may well be.  Come by at another time and I'll have more instructions from my lord.

replies.reply_text: All right, I'll do that.  Bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: Ah, mortal, 'tis a happy circumstance that has brought thee here today!

replies.reply_text: Does this mean you have another task for me?
I'm happy you're happy, but I sense another long chore ahead.  Bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: Thou art very intuitive for a mortal.  Lord Oberon has ordered Saffron cakes and cookies for the celebration. He needs someone to get them and bring them to the Mystic Forest.

replies.reply_text: All I have to do this time is pick up some treats and bring them to the forest?  Sounds too easy...

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, he also needs to get 6 orchids from the jungles near Winchell's hut on Jungle Isle.

replies.reply_text: That's all this time?  Pick 6 orchids by Winchell's hut and get some cookies?
No, not this time.  I knew it would get more involved the more you tell me!  Bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: Verily, all thee has to do for Oberon is gather the orchids and pick up the baked goods and bring it all to the Unicorn's clearing in the Mystic Forest.

replies.reply_text: Okay... Hey! Wait a minute... Winchell's Hut? Where exactly is the bakery?
I knew this was another trap!  I'm outta here!
I guess that isn't so bad after all! Plus I finally get to meet Oberon and Titania.  I'm on it!

chatpoints.chat_text: Mortal, thy wouldst forget thy head if it twern't attached!  Thou must go to the Jungles by Winchell's home and gather 6 orchids and then go to the bakery in the clouds and pick up the cakes for Lord Oberon.  Bring them to the Unicorn clearing in Mystic Forest. Now away!  Gretel awaits thee in the clouds!

replies.reply_text: Oh, yeah, I forgot... Orchids and cookies... Got it!  See you in the Mystic Forest!

npc_list.name: Foster
npc_list.admin_description: A Fairy of the Forest
npc_list.long_description: Foster and the other Forest Fairies are dressed all in various shades of green.  This makes them harder to see among the leaves.

chatpoints.chat_text: Dash away!  Tis a Mortal approaching!

replies.reply_text: Don't run away on my account.  I'm just passing by.
Stop!  Come back!  I have a message from Oberon!
Come back, it's me again! I forgot what you asked me to get for you.
Come out, come out, where ever you are!  I'm back with your cattails!  What are you going to do with this stuff?
I wish you guys would stop hiding!  Where did you say the Flower Fairies are?

chatpoints.chat_text: Oberon?  How dost thou, a mere Mortal, know of Oberon?

replies.reply_text: I ran into Puck and he asked me to find all of the fairies and deliver Oberon's message.

chatpoints.chat_text: And what be this message from our lord, Oberon?

replies.reply_text: Oberon has sent for all the fairies to gather in the Mystic Forest at the midsummer moon.  He wishes that they join Titania and him and celebrate the changeling prince.

chatpoints.chat_text: Yea verily, this is a wondrous event!  We must prepare a suitable gift for the changeling.

replies.reply_text: I'm sure you'll come up with something.  Now, where are the next fairies located? I'd like to finish my mission.

chatpoints.chat_text: I will send thee on thy way, Mortal, if thou will help us fashion our gift for the child.

replies.reply_text: You know, all these side trips are really getting old!  I'm out.  Bye!
This is news?  What do you need me to get for you?
Well this is not too bad.  Cattails and cotton it is!

chatpoints.chat_text: Thou really should pay closer heed, Mortal!  We asked thee for 12 cattails and 10 pieces of cotton.

replies.reply_text: Cotton and cattails.  Now I remember.  Thanks!
The island in full bloom and they live by the mushrooms...  Hmmm.  Oh!  I got it now.  Thanks!

chatpoints.chat_text: The Flower Fairies are on the island of flowers and they live near the mushrooms.

replies.reply_text: Riiiight, flowers and mushrooms.  Got it.  Thanks again!

npc_list.name: Blossom
npc_list.admin_description: A Fairy of the Flowers
npc_list.long_description: Blossom wears a hat made from a flower and a skirt fashioned from petals. She and the other Flower Fairies seem to giggle incessantly, which can be very annoying!

chatpoints.chat_text: (Giggle.) A mortal amongst us! Shall we loose the wasps upon it? (Giggle.)

replies.reply_text: (Backing away.) I'm not looking for any trouble. Sorry to have disturbed you.
I really wish you wouldn't.  Puck sent me to find you.
Hold on to those wasps, it's me again.  What did you need me to get for you again?
Hey, no wasps!  I'm back with your honeycombs and wildflowers.
Stop with the wasps!!  I came back because I forgot what you said I was to do with this cloak and crown.

chatpoints.chat_text: (Giggle.) The court jester has sent us a mortal? (Giggle.) Pray thee, what be the purpose of this mission?

replies.reply_text: Puck wishes you to know that Oberon has summoned all the fairies to gather in the Mystic Forest at the midsummer moon to join the celebration of the changeling prince.

chatpoints.chat_text: Does this mean that our lady, Titania, has (Giggle.) acquiesed to Oberon?

replies.reply_text: I don't know what any of this means.  I'm just delivering the message.  So can I tell Puck you will attend?

chatpoints.chat_text: Thou can relay that to Puck, but, before thou departs (Giggle.), couldst thou help us prepare our gift for the child? (Giggle.) Do this and we will send thee back to Puck with flowers for our lady's pleasure.

replies.reply_text: I'm tired of these side jobs, I'm leaving now. You can tell Puck whatever you want, I'm through!
I might as well help you.  Puck will probably send me out for the flowers when I get back anyway!  What do you need?
Okay, that sounds doable.  I'll be back in a bit!

chatpoints.chat_text: (Giggle.) Silly mortal, we asked thee for 3 honeycombs and 10 bunches of wildflowers.

replies.reply_text: Righto.  I'm off again!
It would be my pleasure, thank you.

chatpoints.chat_text: Thou truly are a simple creature, mortal. (Giggle.) The crown and cloak are for our lady, Titania. Bring them to Puck so that he may deliver them to Titania.

replies.reply_text: Oh, Puck's supposed to get this stuff.  I forgot.

npc_list.name: Sylph
npc_list.admin_description: A Fairy of the Clouds
npc_list.long_description: The Cloud Fairies are light and airy. They are dressed in what appears to be rainbows. But the giggling and their delight is raining on people!

chatpoints.chat_text: (Giggle.) Here be a Mortal, what shall we do with it? (Giggle.) Rain upon its head! (She giggles again and all of a sudden it's raining only on you!)

replies.reply_text: Aw, come on now! I'm just passing by!
Hey, hey, hey!!  I'm here to deliver a message from Puck, that's all.
All right, stop the rain already!  What am I getting for you again?
Enough with the rain!!!  I got your supplies.  Where do I go next?
Could you please stop with all this rain!! I'm sorry, but where are the Water Fairies again?

chatpoints.chat_text: (The rain stops.) For what purpose hast Puck sent a Mortal to us?

replies.reply_text: Oberon has called all of the fairies to gather in the Mystic Forest at the midsummer moon to celebrate the changeling prince.  Puck has sent me to find all of the fairies and deliver this message.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, it's the changeling prince now is it? (Giggles.) Are we to assume that Titania and Oberon have (Giggle.) resolved their differences over the human child? (Giggle.)

replies.reply_text: Yeah, I guess so.  Now would you be so kind as to tell me where I might find the next group of fairies?

chatpoints.chat_text: (Giggle.) If thou willst help us with the child's gift, I shall tell thee where thy next destination is.

replies.reply_text: I should have seen this coming.  All right, what do you need me to do?
Oh, no, not again.  I'm outta here!
That's all?  I should be back in no time!

chatpoints.chat_text: (The rain stops.) We asked thee to bring 10 sparkling feathers and 5 silver linings back to us! (Giggle.)

replies.reply_text: (Snaps!) That's right! Be right back.
Okay.  Horse Isle, apple trees and a pond.  I think I've got it.  Thanks!

chatpoints.chat_text: (The rain stops.) Thou hast no head for details, Mortal! (Giggle.) The Water Fairies can be found near a pond, surrounded by apple trees on Horse Isle. (Giggle.)

replies.reply_text: Oh yeah, I forgot.  Thanks again!

npc_list.name: Oren
npc_list.admin_description: A Fairy of the Jungles
npc_list.long_description: Oren and his fellow fairies are dressed in dark greens and browns.  They blend so well into the jungle brush they are almost invisible.

chatpoints.chat_text: Mortals!  I sense a Mortal near my keep!

replies.reply_text: Calm down, I'm just passing by.
Are you a Jungle Fairy?  If so, I have a message from Puck.
What did you send me for?
Oren, I'm back!
Pardon me, Oren, but where did you say I'd find the next Fairies?

chatpoints.chat_text: I am Oren.  Now what does that mischevious sprite desire that he sends a Mortal in his stead?

replies.reply_text: Puck wishes to inform you that Oberon has called for all of the fairies to gather in the Mystic Forest at the midsummer moon to celebrate the changeling prince.  Puck has sent me to find all of the fairies.

chatpoints.chat_text: 'Tis glorious news that our Lord and Lady have finally resolved the issue of the changeling.  Of course we will attend, but we need a gift worthy of the little prince.  Say, Mortal, wouldst thou help me gather some items so that we may fashion such a wondrous gift?

replies.reply_text: Oh, no, not again!  I deliver messages, I don't fetch stuff!
(Sighs.) All right, what do you need?
Okay, I'll be right back!

chatpoints.chat_text: Mortal, I asked thee for 5 logs of ebony wood and 20 ferns.

replies.reply_text: Sorry, I forgot!  I'm on my way!
Cool!  Thanks.

chatpoints.chat_text: I sent thee to the Cloud Isles.  The Cloud Fairies can be found on the main cloud amongst the sparkling trees.

replies.reply_text: Right up in the Clouds.  Thanks again!

npc_list.name: Nerida
npc_list.long_description: Nerida and her kin wear gossamer gowns that glisten like the water they live by.  Unfortunately for you, they are a playful bunch!

chatpoints.chat_text: Beware my sisters, for there is a Mortal nearby! (You get splashed with water.)

replies.reply_text: Sorry to disturb you, but I'm just passing by.
More water!? It figures that Sylph would send me to another fairy who plays with water!
Stop splashing!!  What am I doing for you again?
I'm running out of dry clothes!  Here's the Unicorn hair you asked for.  Now where do I find the next fairies?
Do you have to splash me every time I come by!?  Sorry to bother you, but where am I going now?

chatpoints.chat_text: Thou hast been sent to us by our kinsmen in the Clouds?  Pray thee Mortal, why this has happened?

replies.reply_text: Puck sent me to find all of the fairies, and deliver a message from Oberon.

chatpoints.chat_text: Thou has a message from our lord, Oberon?  Speak thee his words, oh Mortal.

replies.reply_text: Oberon has called for all fairies to gather in the Mystic Forest at the midsummer moon to celebrate with Titania and Oberon their changeling prince.

chatpoints.chat_text: We were concerned that the changeling would continue to bring discord to our lord and lady.  This is truly a wonderous message.

replies.reply_text: I'm glad you're happy to get this news.  Now could you please direct me to the next group of fairies so I can continue my mission?

chatpoints.chat_text: We will gladly help thee, Mortal, but first, wouldst thou help us?

replies.reply_text: Can't you guys do anything for yourselves?  I'm gone.  See ya!
I've come to expect this.  What do you need me to do?
That seems easy enough.  I'll be back soon.

chatpoints.chat_text: We asked thee to gather 12 apples and present them to the Unicorn on Horse Isle.  In return, ask him for some tail hair.

replies.reply_text: Sorry, I forgot.  See ya!
The Forest Fairies live on the horse's tail...  Hmmmm....  I got it!!!  Thank you.  Bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: Foolish Mortal!  We sent thee to find the Forest Fairies on the island known as Tail.

replies.reply_text: That's right, I must have had water in my ears. (Glaring at the water fairies.) Bye!

npc_list.name: Rhoswen
npc_list.admin_description: A Snow Fairy
npc_list.long_description: Rhoswen and the Snow Fairies all wear white fur and their hair is white and crystal-like.

chatpoints.chat_text: Mortal, why hast thou searched for me?

replies.reply_text: You knew I was looking for you? That's cool!
Look lady, I'm not looking for any trouble.  Just pretend you didn't see me!
Excuse me, Rhoswen, what am I getting for you?
I'm back, m'lady.
Forgive my intrusion once more, but where do I find the next fairy again?

chatpoints.chat_text: I know many things, but not why thou art here.

replies.reply_text: Oberon and Titania have invited all the fairies to the Mystic Forest at the midsummer moon to celebrate the changeling prince. I'm to find all of the fairies and let them know. Puck said you'd send me to the next fairy.

chatpoints.chat_text: That I will, but first might I impose on thy good humor to assist me in preparing our gift for the child of Titania and Oberon?  If thou helpeth me I will, tell thee where to find the next fairy.
