Nothing. I was just looking for rotten tomatoes. Have you seen any?

chatpoints.chat_text: You were looking at me!

replies.reply_text: I'm sorry, I wanted to introduce myself. I'm sorry, I didn't mean to look at you oddly.
I wasn't! Honest! I was looking at the ground! I'm short on wishing coins!

chatpoints.chat_text: Nuh-uh, don't you even go there, I know you were, you always are!

replies.reply_text: What am I always doing?
But we hardly know each other, how do you know what I always do?

chatpoints.chat_text: Nuh-uh, I'm not getting into it with you. Just get outta my woods. And your little horse too!

replies.reply_text: Wow, tetchy much?

chatpoints.chat_text: No! I have not seen any tomatoes which you will doubtless throw at my head and my windows and my house and on my roof! Kids these days! Hooligans!

replies.reply_text: Wow... you know my mother, she makes this great coffee with mocha and caramel, she calls it an Attitude Adjustment, shall I go home and get you one?
With that attitude, no wonder people throw them at you!

chatpoints.chat_text: No! No telling what you'd put in it!

replies.reply_text: Them's fighting words, that's my mother's coffee you're talking about!

npc_list.name: Magda
npc_list.admin_description: Magpie who steals things on Hat Isle.
npc_list.long_description: Watch your pockets and your horse's tack- Magda has an eye for anything shiny!

chatpoints.chat_text: (She chitters merrily.)

replies.reply_text: You're that bird! You've got Beebonnet Buck's knitting needles!
Ugh, Magda! I have looked all over for those needles! Where did you put them?!

chatpoints.chat_text: (She cocks her head sideways, looking innocent.)

replies.reply_text: Don't you lie to me, you're a magpie, you steal shiny things! Knitting needles are shiny, a bird stole the knitting needles, you are a bird, Q.E.D. you stole them! Where are they?
You little... you sound like a bag of bones! Ugh, you're no help at all!
(You laugh.) Thanks for the hint, Magda! I'll go look for those needles.

chatpoints.chat_text: (Turns head sideways as if to say, "Really?")

replies.reply_text: Ugh, I give up. Guess I'll have to look for those needles on my own.

npc_list.name: Jane
npc_list.admin_description: She's a lumberjane and she's okay. Ring Isle
npc_list.long_description: Jane seems to have done the impossible- she's invented the tailored plaid flannel shirt.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, hi there! Careful!

replies.reply_text: Oh! (You carefully step over a pile of wood neatly stacked by the door.) What's all this?
Being careful! Gillian sent me to you. I'm picking up logs for her for a project she's working on.
Hi Jane, could you remind me where I'm supposed to look for those logs?

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, it's wood of course! I just got done with it; now it's drying out to be ready for Gillian.

replies.reply_text: You cut down trees?! That's awful!
What does Gillian do with it?

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, broadly, yes, it is. But people need wood- for houses, barns, furniture, even saddle trees! For every tree I cut down, I plant three more somewhere around the isles.

replies.reply_text: Well, that's good I guess... but what about the animals who live in these forests?
Why three more? Wouldn't a one-for-one replacement work?

chatpoints.chat_text: It's not easy, but I try to be responsible about the forests I work in. I stop work when there are likely to be nests in trees and I observe the woods near me. I try not to cut down anything that has a family of animals in it.

replies.reply_text: What happens if you do?
That's good, I guess.

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, I go down to Andrea, who lives down by the dock. She went to school to be a vet, but now she cares for endangered animals. Birds who've been hurt, for instance, she takes care of. She knows how to reintegrate an animal back into the local environment if its home is gone.

replies.reply_text: I guess you try to do everything you can to make sure you're not damaging the ecosystem here.

chatpoints.chat_text: I do try!

replies.reply_text: That's good.

chatpoints.chat_text: My sister Gillian is a carpenter! She does a lot of work with the local woods we have here, like pine. She built this house, actually!

replies.reply_text: Oh wow, that's really neat! So you cut the trees down and prepare them, and then she builds?

chatpoints.chat_text: You got it!

replies.reply_text: It sounds like a good arrangement for you! But you have such a small forest here. Isn't logging here harmful to it?

chatpoints.chat_text: I guess it would, but trees are important! It's because of trees that we have the air that we breathe. So I feel like if I'm going to cut trees down, I'd better replace them- for all of us!

replies.reply_text: Oh, I see!

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, it's not hard to find the places I've been working. You'll see either stumps or logs on the ground. If you dig around those spots, you'll find nice big logs, split the way Gill likes 'em. She said she wants five, which is perfect, that's how many sites I'm working on all around this isle. Don't mind the big log to the back of the house, nothing doing there.

replies.reply_text: All right, thanks.

npc_list.name: Astericky
npc_list.admin_description: Astronomer on Ring Isle
npc_list.long_description: Astericky, who appears to be remarkably young, must spend a lot of time peering into telescopes, or else her eyesight is really bad.

chatpoints.chat_text: Sorry, this telescope's busy!  It took me forever to get time on it.  If you want telescope time... uhm.  Well, too bad.

replies.reply_text: I see.  Okay, I'll come back some other time then.
Nope, don't need to use the telescope at all. I was just hoping to ask you a question.

chatpoints.chat_text: Me? Are you sure you don't want to ask my mom? She knows tons and tons and tons more than I do about astronomy.

replies.reply_text: That may be true. But I was wondering why YOU are interested in astronomy.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh my gosh! Really? Who wouldn't be? Anyone with two eyes can see how amazing astronomy is. There are celestial events to see. Shooting stars. Planets. Stuff. You know, all kinds of stuff.

replies.reply_text: I believe you. Just thought I'd ask, but since you are busy, I'll let you get back to seeing all that 'stuff.'

npc_list.name: Gillian
npc_list.admin_description: Ring Isle, carpenter
npc_list.long_description: Gillian's hair is technically red, but it's covered in wood shavings to the point that you really can't tell.

chatpoints.chat_text: Hiya! Careful, there are nails there!

replies.reply_text: Oh! I'll watch my step. What are you building?
Ow! (You hop up and down, clutching your foot.) Warning came a little late there!
I'll remember this time for sure- I'm still tracking down that first aid kit your dog stole! Where did you say I could find your dog?
I can hardly forget they're there! I found your first aid kit!
Don't worry, careful's my middle name! I was wondering, do you do anything smaller than furniture? Like could you make this? (You show Gillian the photo of the fish.)

Hiya hiya! Thanks for the warning. I was wondering- well, really Sierra was- I'll back up. Sierra wants to know if you could build a bed for her daughter Karina. (You describe what Sierra was looking for.)
Good day, Gillian.  I have a proposition for you.
Okay, I see them.  Hi!  Mehitabel sent me. Has Archy picked up his lumber order yet?
I'm sorry, I've forgotten what you told me.  Where did Archy go after he left you?

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, right now I'm just repairing this chair. The dogs were playing around in the house and crashed into it and broke the leg off! So I turned a new leg this morning and I'm just popping it on now.

replies.reply_text: So you build and repair furniture?

chatpoints.chat_text: I build and repair most anything! I built this house myself with wood my sister cut!

replies.reply_text: Wow, good for you! You live so far from everything, I guess you both learned to be pretty independent!
That's really neat! If I ever need carpentry work done, could I come to you?

chatpoints.chat_text: I guess you could say that!

replies.reply_text: Well, I'll be going now. Nice to meet you!

chatpoints.chat_text: Sure, I'm always happy for the business!

replies.reply_text: I'll remember your name, then!

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, my, I'm so sorry! Here, take off your shoe, I have a first-aid kit. Somewhere... (She rummages in a drawer, comes up empty-handed, and frowns.) Jane, have you seen the first-aid box? (Jane shouts something you can hardly understand... about a dog?!)

replies.reply_text: Er... Did I just hear something about a dog...?
Ugh, useless! I'll just go out and clean up myself...

chatpoints.chat_text: Yes, Jane just said that she thinks she forgot to put it away after the last time, and she bets Rivvie stole it again!

replies.reply_text: Who's Rivvie?

chatpoints.chat_text: (Gillian sighs a long-suffering sigh.) Rivet, better known as Rivvie, is my dog. She is a crossbreed, but has some sort of retriever in her and she will not stop retrieving! But the trouble is she never brings things back...

replies.reply_text: So you think that Rivvie made off with your first-aid kit? How about I go get it back for you?
My friend, you really need to train your dog...
Okay, I'll go look for her there!

chatpoints.chat_text: She likes to run around on the beach south of here. She doesn't often go farther west or east than those palm trees.

replies.reply_text: Okay, I'll go look for her there!
Thanks Gillian!

chatpoints.chat_text: No, don't think I could, sorry.  You need to find someone more artistic.

replies.reply_text: Oh, all right.

chatpoints.chat_text: A bed? (She ponders for a moment, nibbling her lip.) Oh, that's very do-able. I made Karina's crib, you know. Sierra and I have been friends for a long time. I'd be happy to make a bed for the daughter of an old friend. Now, there are two ways we can do this.

replies.reply_text: The easy way or the hard way?
Uh, this sounds complicated. Bye. Maybe later.

chatpoints.chat_text: Okay, so you'll be finding the logs for me. That's fine. Please go talk to my sister Jane. We forest sustainably here and she's working in specific areas of the forest. She cuts wood the way I like it. Regular logs won't do for this.

replies.reply_text: All right, I'll do that.
Okay.
Okay. See you soon!
Oh, very nice! I'm sure she'll love it.

chatpoints.chat_text: You had decided to get logs for me for the bed.  Please see my sister, Jane.

replies.reply_text: Oh yeah.  All right.  Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: Hello again!

replies.reply_text: Hello! Can you remind me what I was doing for you?
Hi Gillian, I've come back with the money for the bed!
Hi Gillian, I'm back, and I've got all of the logs you wanted for Karina's bed!
Hello there, how's the work coming on the bed?
Hello, how's the work coming on Karina's bed?
Hi Gillian, I've decided what I want to do about the bed.
HI.  What was I doing again?
Good day, Gillian.  I have a proposition for you.
Hi! Mehitabel sent me. Has Archy picked up his lumber order yet?
I'm sorry, I've forgotten what you told me.  Where did Archy go after he left you?

chatpoints.chat_text: You were deciding whether to pay me $2000 for the bed, or whether you were going to talk to my sister and fetch the logs I need. Since that would save me time, I would waive my fee. Which will it be?

replies.reply_text: I'll pay you the money. It's easier.
I'll go talk to Jane about the logs. I'm into saving.

chatpoints.chat_text: One will be more expensive than the other. I can either charge you $2000 for the materials and the work, or you could bring me the logs I'll need. Now, I need a special type of wood, and you'd have to talk to my sister about finding the logs in these woods.

replies.reply_text: I'm into saving money. I'll talk to Jane about finding the type of logs you need.
Here, cash is easier. (Hand her $2000.)

chatpoints.chat_text: A proposition?  I might as well hear you out.  What is it?

replies.reply_text: Well Iona over in Flipperton wants to hold a Founder's Day Crafts Festival.  She's hoping you can attend and display your work.  Here's your invitation.
Thanks and I'll let Iona know.  Bye!
You said he was going to see Andrea?  I guess she's next on my list.  Thanks, Gillian!

chatpoints.chat_text: That's okay. Archy was going to visit Andrea. Do you need anything else?

replies.reply_text: No, that's it... Andrea here I come!

npc_list.name: Andrea
npc_list.admin_description: Wildlife rescuer, Ring Isle.
npc_list.long_description: Andrea's hair looks like it's been nested in, but that's only because it has been.

chatpoints.chat_text: Hello there!

replies.reply_text: Hi! Wow, there are a lot of birds in here!
Hi there. I was wondering if you had any errands I could run for you?
What was I doing for you again?
Missing anything? Like all that ruckus by the pond? I made a deal with the frog and she's zipping her lip!
Hi there! Gillian said that Archy was coming to visit you. Is he still around?
Sorry to bother you again, Andrea, but where did you say Archy went?
Pony Express delivery!

chatpoints.chat_text: Yes, I run a bird rehabilitation clinic here!

replies.reply_text: Wow, what do you do?
That's so cool!

chatpoints.chat_text: When birds have been injured, people bring them to me. I'm a vet, so I nurse them back to health. Then I re-release them into the wild.

replies.reply_text: That sounds complicated! Are birds good patients?
Why re-release them? Why not keep them as pets?

chatpoints.chat_text: (She laughs.) Generally not! They're wild animals and they aren't used to being handled. Most of the time they get used to it after awhile, but I still have to be very careful.

replies.reply_text: What do you do to keep yourself safe? (You eye a red-tailed hawk with an injured wing- and wicked talons!)
If they get used to it, can you keep them as pets? I've always wanted an eagle but Mom wouldn't let me keep one.
Do you just work with birds, or do you rehab other animals too? Like... if there were a deer with a broken leg?

chatpoints.chat_text: I wear protective equipment on my hands and arms. Gloves and gauntlets made out of very tough leather that talons have to really work to pierce.

replies.reply_text: Wow, it sounds like those would wear out pretty quickly!

chatpoints.chat_text: They do, but I keep a good stock around.

replies.reply_text: Do you need any extras?

chatpoints.chat_text: Not right now, but you look like the delivering sort- I'll let you know if I ever do!

replies.reply_text: Okay, thanks!

chatpoints.chat_text: These are wild animals- they know how to be wild. They don't make good pets! Truthfully, I love that wildness. I feel awful when I put a bird into a cage to recover. They don't belong in cages or houses.

replies.reply_text: I guess that's a good point!

chatpoints.chat_text: I do treat and release other animals, but I specialize in birds.

replies.reply_text: Why birds?
So if I found an injured animal, I should bring it to you?
Okay!

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, when I was a little girl, I used to want to grow up to be a bird! I always wanted to fly. Eventually I figured out that whatever I did I was still going to grow up to be a woman, but I still love birds. This is the closest I can get!

replies.reply_text: What about inventing a flying machine? Then you could fly!
Instead of being a bird, you get to help birds- that sounds like a pretty good trade-off to me!

chatpoints.chat_text: I could, I guess, but I'd be worried about a flying machine hitting birds in the air!

replies.reply_text: Haha, I never thought of it that way!

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, yes and no. You should first talk to the closest vet. Many animals will lash out at you if you try to pick them up while they're injured- it's instinct. A vet can get closer and sedate the animal if necessary so that the vet can get near.

replies.reply_text: Okay, then what?

chatpoints.chat_text: Then, the vet can examine the animal. If the injury is within the vet's scope, he or she can treat the animal there. But if it's something unusual, or if the animal will need a lot of rehab time, they often send the animal to me.

replies.reply_text: Oh, okay! But... if an animal has been sent to you, it's far away from home. How do you integrate it back into its habitat?
Oh, that makes sense!

chatpoints.chat_text: Most times, assuming that I can release the animal back into its original home, there isn't any trouble. Complications come when the animal has spent a lot of time in captivity healing up, especially if it's very young and hasn't learned survival skills like feeding itself yet.

replies.reply_text: I bet that gets tricky- you're a person, you can't be Mama Bird!

chatpoints.chat_text: It does! It's often manageable, though; I'm able to tap into their instincts and teach them to, oh, say, hunt. It's far more complicated than that, but that will do for a short explanation, I don't want to bore you!

replies.reply_text: Thanks for being so considerate, my eyes were starting to glaze over. It's not that I'm not interested, but...
Oh, I find this all fascinating!

chatpoints.chat_text: Not really. Although, there IS an awful lot of noise coming from the pond area. If you could manage to figure out what's making all that ruckus, and get it to hush, I'd be grateful. It is unnerving, and disturbing to my birds.

replies.reply_text: You got it! I'm on the case of the mystery noise now!
Hmmm. Sounds like a quest to me. I was hoping for something quick and easy. Guess I'll go try someone else.
Noise? Maybe it is a ghost. I don't like ghosts. I'm gone like last year's Halloween!
Pony Express delivery!
I'll go look by the pond now.

chatpoints.chat_text: You were going to see what was making such a ruckus by the pond, and get it to hush.

replies.reply_text: That's right! I am heading there right now.
Thanks and have a nice day!
This trail seems awfully cold, but I'm off to Wington to see what I can find.

chatpoints.chat_text: No problem, Archy said that he was going to Wington.  Good luck!

replies.reply_text: That's right you said Wington.  Thanks again.  Bye!
You are very welcome. Thank you and I'll be sure to tell him.

npc_list.name: Rosie
npc_list.admin_description: Jane and Gill's dog.
npc_list.long_description: Rose has been temporarily exiled from the house until she can be bathed, as she has found mud.

chatpoints.chat_text: (Rosie is one muddy puppy!)

npc_list.name: Rivvie
npc_list.admin_description: Jane and Gill's dog.
npc_list.long_description: Rivvie has been temporarily banished from the house, as she has found sand... and become covered in it.

chatpoints.chat_text: (She is digging busily in the sand.)

replies.reply_text: Aha! You must be the retrieving Rivvie! You've made off with Gillian's first aid kit, haven't you?
Hi girl! You looking for something?
Rivvie, I've looked and looked- where is that first aid kit you buried?

chatpoints.chat_text: (Looks up at you, tongue lolling out, giving you a big doggy grin!)

replies.reply_text: Well, she'd really like to have it back. Where'd you put it?

chatpoints.chat_text: (Rivvie disappears halfway into her hole, resurfacing with a big stick. She brandishes it proudly, nodding her head.)

replies.reply_text: Huh?
Oh, so it's by or on a big stick or something on the beach? Okay, I'll dig around!

chatpoints.chat_text: (Holding a big stick in her mouth, she nods and turns her head, looking down the shoreline.)

replies.reply_text: Oh, so it's by or on a big stick or something on the beach? Okay, I'll dig around!

chatpoints.chat_text: (She disappears halfway into her hole, resurfacing with a little red ball. She spits it out at your feet and wags her tail.)

replies.reply_text: (You throw the ball and Rivvie takes off down the beach!)

npc_list.name: Josh
npc_list.admin_description: Andrea's son, Ring Isle
npc_list.long_description: It's hard to get a good look at Josh. He's running around with his arms held up to his mouth like tusks.

chatpoints.chat_text: Wokka-wokka! I'm a wooly mammoth!

replies.reply_text: Er... I thought wooly mammoths bellowed? I didn't know they yelled "Wokka wokka!"

chatpoints.chat_text: Sure we do! Wokka!

replies.reply_text: Okay...

npc_list.name: Killian
npc_list.admin_description: Andrea's daughter, Ring isle
npc_list.long_description: Killian has taped cardboard triangles to her back and appears to be wearing a feather boa as a tail.

chatpoints.chat_text: Rawr! I'm a stegosaurus!

replies.reply_text: Do stegosaurs roar?

chatpoints.chat_text: I do! Rooooooooar!

replies.reply_text: Okay then. That's settled.
All right. Glad we've settled that. I didn't even know there were any stegosaurs left these days!

chatpoints.chat_text: There are! I'm the very last one! It's like the last unicorn, except that everyone knows there are lots of unicorns!

replies.reply_text: Are there really lots of unicorns? Have you met any?
How about other dinosaurs, are there any of those left around?

chatpoints.chat_text: I've met all the unicorns in the world!

replies.reply_text: Really? Are there unicorns on this isle?

chatpoints.chat_text: No, we're too far north for unicorns. It's too cold. This is stegosaurus territory! Roooooar!

replies.reply_text: Okay, so no unicorns here. Any more dinosaurs?
Oh right. I forgot that unicorns liked warmth even better than dinosaurs and other reptiles. Thank you for reminding me.  It is only logical.

chatpoints.chat_text: No, I'm the only one. (She sighs.) I've always wanted to meet a parasaurolophus though.

replies.reply_text: What's a parasaurolophus?
Why not a velociraptor?

chatpoints.chat_text: They're a kind of dinosaur and they have a really big bone on their heads!  They live in marshy areas and they eat plants and they have a big thing on their heads, did I say that?

replies.reply_text: Oh, that clears it all up! Thanks!

chatpoints.chat_text: Because a velociraptor is sort of like a brother!

replies.reply_text: (You laugh and walk away.)

npc_list.name: Thomas Feri
npc_list.admin_description: dockmaster on Ring Isle
npc_list.long_description: Thomas spends more time building model boats than operating the ferry.

chatpoints.chat_text: Finally! You going somewhere?

replies.reply_text: Yes, out to the isle!
Yes, back to Wington!
I would like to go to Earton.
Sort of, I'm looking for a woodworker who lives on this island.  Any idea who I should see?
I'm looking for a jeweler who lives around here.  Would you know who I'm looking for?

chatpoints.chat_text: I thought no one would ever ask! Hop on board.

replies.reply_text: It sounds like you don't get a lot of business here!
Hoppin'!

chatpoints.chat_text: No, we're pretty secluded back here. It's nice, but I get bored!

replies.reply_text: Haha, I guess you would!

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, have fun, and come on back to talk to me when you want to head home!

replies.reply_text: Can you tell me a little about this isle?
Sure will, thanks!

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, it's pretty quiet. Only a couple people. Jane and Gillian up north and Andrea and her kids down south. And James, wherever he is today. And a bunch of dogs and squirrels and deer and fish and me.

replies.reply_text: No horses?
No cats?
No foxes?
No wyverns?

chatpoints.chat_text: Those too! More four-leggers here than two-leggers!

replies.reply_text: Sounds idyllic! I like animals, they make more sense than people.
Sounds a little boring for me, I love talking to people.

chatpoints.chat_text: What the heck is a wyvern?

replies.reply_text: It's like a dragon, only it's... never mind, I was just joking with you.

chatpoints.chat_text: Earton?  Well, I don't go to Earton.  I only go to Wington.  Earton is far too busy for my liking.  Sorry.

replies.reply_text: Oh, okay.  Sorry.

chatpoints.chat_text: You're looking for a woodworker?  I guess that would be Gillian, she lives on the other side of the island.

replies.reply_text: Okay, thanks a lot!

chatpoints.chat_text: Sounds like you want Lapis Maki.  She runs a jewelry workshop west of here.

replies.reply_text: I should head west then?  Thanks!

npc_list.name: James
npc_list.admin_description: Hanging around Ring Isle

chatpoints.chat_text: (James is whistling a tune. You decide not to bother him.)

npc_list.name: Chanda
npc_list.admin_description: New quests must start at CP8
npc_list.long_description: Chanda is a chandler of great fame.  She is the royal candle maker, but prefers to make candles for everyone else!

chatpoints.chat_text: (Without looking up from her work) If you're from King Phil, tell that royal pain his candles will be ready when I'm finished and not a moment sooner! (Looks up.) Sorry, how can I help you?

replies.reply_text: Wow!  You have a lot of candles here, did you make all these?
Just looking around, thanks.
It's me again.  I forgot, where am I taking the candles?
Chanda, I'm back! Percy said you out did yourself.
Hi, sorry to bother you, but I was wondering about that easel in the corner.
Hi! I'm not from King Phil, but I do have a proposition for you.
Hi, I'm not from King Phil, actually I'm from Mehitabel.  Have you seen Archy lately?
Hey Chanda, it's me again.  Where did you say Archy went next?

chatpoints.chat_text: (Sighs) I'm a Chandler, that's what I do....I make candles. Is there something I can do for you?

replies.reply_text: I'm sorry to have upset you, it's just that I've never seen so many different candles before.  I like the braided ones, how did you make them?
Sore-ree, guess I should be going.

chatpoints.chat_text: (Relaxing a bit.) The braided ones? Those are my favorite, they're dipped in the wax repeatedly until you get the candle the size you want, then you cut away strips while it's still warm and you twist them and reattach them to the candle. Easy once you get the hang of it!

replies.reply_text: Very interesting!  Thanks for sharing it with me.
Sounds like too much work for just a candle...see you around!
You certainly make it sound easy, are those braided candles the royal candles for King Phil?

chatpoints.chat_text: Good gracious no!  That royal nebbish only wants huge thick candles with way too many gems set into them....feh!  These are for someone who appreciates them, Percy Pakij in Whiskerton.  I just have to find someone to deliver them for me.

replies.reply_text: I happen to have some free time at the moment.  I could take them to Whiskerton for you.
That's too bad, good luck finding someone.  Bye!
All righty then, I'm off to Whiskerton, bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: I asked you to bring them to Percy Pakij in Whiskerton, and he'll give you some more wax for me.

replies.reply_text: Okay, now I remember, Percy in Whiskerton.  Got it.

chatpoints.chat_text: Percy's an old smoothy!  Did he give you my supplies?

replies.reply_text: He sure did, here you go.
Thanks!  I'll stop by sometime, bye for now!

chatpoints.chat_text: I said, tell Phil.....Oh it's you again!

replies.reply_text: I just thought I'd stop by to say hi.
Hi, sorry to bother you, but I was wondering about that easel in the corner.
Hi, Chanda! Mehitabel asked me to find Archy, have you seen him lately?
Hey Chanda.  Where did you say Archy went next?
Hi! This time I've got a proposition for you.
Hi, I'm not from King Phil, actually I'm from Mehitabel.  Have you seen Archy lately?
Hey Chanda, it's me again.  Where did you say Archy went next?

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh that?  I absolutely love fall colors!  I have this painting of leaves but I just haven't gotten around to filling it in.

replies.reply_text: Oh.  Well, I hope you find time!  I'm sure it will look great when you're done.  Bye.
I could do it for you.  I love painting!

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, very nice.  Well, each leaf should be a fall color.  The maple is red, and the other two are yellow and orange.  The background should be two shades of blue since the leaves will stand out nicely on that.

replies.reply_text: Sounds good!  I'll get right on that.

chatpoints.chat_text: A proposition?  Okay, let's hear it.

replies.reply_text: Iona, over in Flipperton, wants to hold a Founder's Day Crafts Festival.  She's hoping you can attend and display your work.  Here's your Invitation.
You're right, it does sound like fun.  I'll tell Iona to expect you.  Bye!
Alton, huh....I know I'm getting closer!  Thanks, Chanda.

chatpoints.chat_text: No problem. He was heading to Alton's place.

replies.reply_text: Thanks, I better get over to Alton's.  Bye!

npc_list.name: Woody
npc_list.long_description: Woody is sitting on his porch whittling away on a piece of wood.  He likes to carve animals.  All types and all styles of animals are on display in his home.

chatpoints.chat_text: (Woody looks up from the piece of wood he's whittling on and grins.) Howdy! Why don't you pull up a chair and set a spell?

replies.reply_text: Well, howdy right back!  What are you making?
No thanks, I'm just passing by.
Hey Woody, what am I doing for you again?
Hi Woody!  I'm back from George's and he sent back five logs for you.
Howdy, Woody! I have a little project for you if you think you can handle it....(You hold up the photo.)
Woody, what did you ask me for again?
Woody, I'm back with the wood, is the fish finished?
Hiya Woody!  Where did you say I should go to get this fish painted?
Hey Woody!  I've got an interesting proposition for you.
I don't have time for that today, but thank you anyway. I've got a package for you from Pony Express.

chatpoints.chat_text: Ain't exactly sure yet.....(Counting four bumps emerging from the wood.)...but I'm thinkin' it's some kind of quadruped.

replies.reply_text: That's neat, where did you learn to carve like this? (You point to the various animals all over Woody's house.)
This is all you do?  Sit on your porch and whittle?  I'm bored, I'm out!

chatpoints.chat_text: Grampa taught me when I was a kid.  When I got older, I traveled a lot and got interested in the different styles of wood carvings around the world.  So when I settled here I set up my shop.  Now I make money doing what I like best, whittling!

replies.reply_text: Borrrring!!!!!
So that explains all the different carving styles around here.  You're pretty much out of the way here, I'm always looking for odd jobs...need any help?
Neat!  Well, I should be going.  Thanks!

chatpoints.chat_text: Well....now that you mention it, I could use a little help with something.

replies.reply_text: Now that's more like it.  What can I do for you?
Ordinarily I'd help you out, but I'm a little busy right now.  Maybe next time!

chatpoints.chat_text: George Napper in Appleton ordered a complete zoo for his children.  I've just finished and now I need to get it to George.  Could you bring it to him for me?

replies.reply_text: Appleton?  Sorry, that's too far for me right now,  I'll see you around, bye!
I could go to Appleton for you, no problem!
Sure, I'll be back before you know it!

chatpoints.chat_text: You're bringing the toy zoo to George Napper in Appleton....and remember I want to know what he thinks of it.

replies.reply_text: Oh yeah, George Napper in Appleton...I'm on it!
George was positively thrilled, said he can't wait til his kids see it.  Gee, thanks, I'll stop by to see you again some time...bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: Let's have a look. That's a mighty fine fish. You want it to scale or life size? (Chuckles at his pun.)

replies.reply_text: Life size, definitely life size.  All the details are on the back of the photo.  And could it be mounted on a plaque too?

chatpoints.chat_text: That shouldn't be too much of a problem.  Let me have that photo.

replies.reply_text: Sure thing, here.
Okay, I'll be back with the wood. See you soon!

chatpoints.chat_text: I asked you to bring me 5 logs and 5 ebony logs to replenish my stock.

replies.reply_text: That's right, I remember now, 5 and 5.  Got it!

chatpoints.chat_text: You're just in time, I just finished it.  What do you think?  Fish and plaque.  That will be $2000.

replies.reply_text: That sounds more than fair.  Here's the wood and I'll need the photo back too.
This is awesome!  Any suggestions as to who might paint it?

chatpoints.chat_text: I have a friend on Polar Isle who might, if she can't be sure to check with those folks on Art Isle.

replies.reply_text: Okay Polar or Art Isles, got it.  Thanks for the suggestions.

chatpoints.chat_text: I reckon that my friend on Polar or the folks on Art Isle might be able to help you.

replies.reply_text: Polar and Art Isles...on my way, thanks again!

chatpoints.chat_text: A proposition?  I reckon you'd better explain that one!

replies.reply_text: Well Iona over in Flipperton wants to hold a Founder's Day Crafts Festival.  She's hoping you can attend and display your work.  Here's your invitation.
I'm sure she'll be happy to have you there too!  Thanks.
Thank you so much, and I'll be sure to tell him.

npc_list.name: Alton
npc_list.admin_description: New Quests must start at CP 6
npc_list.long_description: Alton runs Tasty Arrangements. He makes unique bouquets from fruit instead of flowers.

chatpoints.chat_text: Good day, if you're placing an order, I'll be right with you. Please feel free to look around, but...NO SAMPLING!

replies.reply_text: I'm just passing through, nice place though!
All of these look so nice.  Are they just for show or can you actually eat them?
I know, no sampling....at the risk of setting you off again, where am I going again?
Hi Alton, I'm back.  Holli thanks you for your usual beautiful work and sent these melons.
I remember, no tasting!  I'm trying to find Archy. Chanda thought he might be here. Is he?
Hey Alton, sorry to barge in again, but where did you say Archy went to?

chatpoints.chat_text: Didn't you see the sign? (He stabs the air violently pointing to a sign above the counter which reads "Alton's Tasty Arrangements - Edible Bouquets for all occasions.") So guess what, you can eat them!!

replies.reply_text: I'm sorry, I should have figured that part out.  You seem a bit stressed, is there anything I can do to help?
Sorry, to have upset you....I'll just see myself out.  Bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: Stressed? You think I'm stressed?!?! I've got a dozen centerpieces due at Holli Daysin's in Tropicton for a big party and my delivery guy hasn't shown up! These arrangements have a limited shelf life you know!

replies.reply_text: Sounds like you have a real problem, I have to go, hope your guy gets here soon!
I could deliver them for you.  I make deliveries for people all the time.
Okay, Holli gets these 2 crates of centerpieces and you get a couple of crates of melons.  Sounds like a plan,  I'll be back before you know it!

chatpoints.chat_text: You are supposed to take those centerpieces to Holli Daysin in Tropicton.  Now chop, chop...the clock is ticking!

replies.reply_text: Holli Daysin in Tropicton, now I remember....I'll be back soon!
Gee thanks!  It was my pleasure.  See you around!

chatpoints.chat_text: Hey, hey, hey...no sampling!  Oh, it's you again.

replies.reply_text: Hi Alton, I just popped in to say hello.
I remember, no tasting!  I'm trying to find Archy. Chanda thought he might be here. Is he?
Hey Alton, sorry to barge in again, but where did you say Archy went to?
I keep missing him. I hope I can finally catch up with him in Appleton.  Thanks Alton!

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, he said he had one last pick up and that was in Appleton.  Good luck!

replies.reply_text: Appleton?  Eureka!  He's on his way to see Bruno.  Thank you Alton!

npc_list.name: Lilibeth
npc_list.admin_description: New Quests must begin at CP 8
npc_list.long_description: Lilibeth is a friendly middle-aged woman whose home is filled with flowers.

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, hello!  Can I help you?

replies.reply_text: (Looking around the place.) These wreaths are lovely, did you make them yourself?
No thanks, I'll just take a look around and I'll be on my way.
Sort of...I forgot what you asked me to do for you.
Hi!  I'm back, and everything went perfectly.
Hi! Martina sent me. (You hand Lilibeth the order form.)
Sorry I wandered out, whatcha doing?

chatpoints.chat_text: Yes, working with dried flowers started as a hobby and developed into a business.

replies.reply_text: That's pretty neat, but I've got to get going.  Bye for now!
Really? Who do you sell your flowers to?

chatpoints.chat_text: I sell my arrangements to some of the flower shops and general stores around the islands.  In fact I have a couple of orders ready for delivery right now.

replies.reply_text: What an amazing coincidence, my specialty happens to be delivering things for people, can I help?
That's nice, gotta go...bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: That's so nice of you to offer!  I have one order going to Betsy Burlap in Carrotton and another for Iris Pettel in Wington.  Would that be too much for you?

replies.reply_text: Oh, I'm sorry, I don't have enough time for that. Maybe next time.
Not at all, I can do that no problem! Do I have to get the money for the flowers?
Okay, Betsy gets the wreaths and gives me your ribbons....and Iris gets the Floral Arrangements and gives me floral tape and wire...got it!  I'll be back soon!

chatpoints.chat_text: That's all right dearie, I forget sometimes too.  Take the wreaths to Betsy Burlap in Carrotton and the floral arrangements to Iris Pettel in Wington.

replies.reply_text: Okay, Betsy gets the wreaths and Iris the arrangements.  I won't forget again.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh good. And you brought back everything I said you were to get?

replies.reply_text: I have the Ribbons from Betsy Burlap, and the supplies from Iris Pettel, here you go...
Thank you, anytime you need more help, just let me know!

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, hello!  Can I help you?...Why it's you again!

replies.reply_text: Just thought I'd pop in to say hi!
How's your flower business doing?
Hi!  I have some wildflowers for you.
Hi!  Martina sent me.
Sorry I wandered out, whatcha doing?
Did you find the color scheme?

chatpoints.chat_text: It's positively blooming!  Actually it's doing so well I'm running out of flowers to dry.  I really need a steady supply of wildflowers.

replies.reply_text: I'd like to help you, but I have hay fever.
I love picking flowers.  I could bring you some wildflowers!
Okay, I'll see what I can find and bring them back next time I'm here.

chatpoints.chat_text: You remembered!  Let me see them.

replies.reply_text: Here's a bunch.
Here's another one
That's all for now!  I'll bring more the next time I'm here!
Sure, no problem. (You start whistling and wandering aimlessly around the shop until you walk up behind Lilibeth.) Whatcha doing?
(Whistling aimlessly, you walk up behind Lilibeth.) What are you doing?

chatpoints.chat_text: (To you.) Going over Martina's order. ( To herself.) Lets see...she wants 18 centerpieces made with ornate candles and dried flowers... Did Martina mention the color scheme?

replies.reply_text: Not that I recall, isn't it on the order form?
I'm pretty sure that I saw the color scheme on the bottom of the invoice

chatpoints.chat_text: Of course it is, here it is, right on the bottom of the page. (She now is busy with a calculator and an invoice.) Hmmm, an ornate candle....I have this one from Chandra (She puts the candle into the middle of the centerpiece.) There, perfect!

replies.reply_text: (You wander around looking at her shop while she finishes the invoice and sample.)
I'll bring it right back, thanks again!

npc_list.name: Mythri Fair
npc_list.long_description: Almost too perky to be allowed, Mythri Fair has a cheery smile and a kindly gaze.

chatpoints.chat_text: I'm telling you, you're happier not knowing.  Just accept that once ingested by a normal horse, they increase personality or intelligence.  Nice, sweet, done.  There ya go!

replies.reply_text: Okay, okay, you convinced me.  Bye.
Sorry, but I'm not feeding anything to one of my horses unless I know exactly what it is and where it came from!

chatpoints.chat_text: Hi there!  What can I do for you today?

replies.reply_text: Me?  Nothing, I'm just looking around, thanks.
Yes, you can, actually.  Can you tell me about the pellets?
Hello!  I was curious about these Magic Beans and Magic Droplets you are carrying now.
Hey!   How come you only buy these back for half the price?

chatpoints.chat_text: Of course.  Here.  These golden ones are Unicorn Pellets.  Eating one of these will raise your horse's intelligence stat by one point.  The cyan ones are Pegasus Pellets.  Eating one of those will raise a horse's personality stat by one point.  There you go!

replies.reply_text: What good is that?
Why are they so expensive?
What are they made from?
Interesting.  Thanks a lot!

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, being smarter is always better, isn't it?  And being more personable.  Right?

replies.reply_text: I don't know.  I always wanted a really smart horse until I actually got one.  Always opening gates and ... nevermind.  Say, why are they so expensive?
Okay then.  I think I'll save up for a couple.  Pity they're so expensive.  Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, they're rare, aren't they?

replies.reply_text: You seem to have a lot of them....

chatpoints.chat_text: Ahem. I'm rather a tad older than you, human-type. Been at this a long time. (She folds her arms and nods complacently.)

replies.reply_text: Okay, I can see how that would be.  So, you ... make these, then?
Interesting.  Okay then.  I'll just run off home and iron the feed buckets then.  Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: No, not really, I just know where to look for them, that's all.

replies.reply_text: Of course.  Well, I'll be going.  Thanks for your time.
So, what's in them that makes them so good?

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, all kinds of good things!

replies.reply_text: Well, being Unicorn and Pegasus pellets, they'd have to be.  But what "good things" exactly?"

chatpoints.chat_text: It's a secret.

replies.reply_text: Aw, come on, you can tell me.
I see.  Well, I won't detain you any longer.  Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: You don't want to know.

replies.reply_text: Fine.  I'll see you.  Bye.
Well, let me ask you this, then.  Do they have anything to do with actual unicorns and pegasi, or are they just called that?

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, no, they do have... something to do, as you say.  Good day to you.

replies.reply_text: Okay... well, I'll just be going now.  Bye.  Thanks for your time.
Oh?

chatpoints.chat_text: (Shifting uncomfortably.) Yes. Absolutely.

replies.reply_text: Yeeeeeeess?  So... do these things... grow or... so, how exactly are they (ahem) associated with pegasi and unicorns?
Okay, I'm already convinced I don't want to know.  Bye then.

chatpoints.chat_text: Really?  You really want to know?

replies.reply_text: Yes!
No, I don't really want to know.  I've just gotten this far into the conversation to yank your chain.  OF COURSE I WANT TO KNOW!
Oh forget it. (You walk away, singing to the tune of the Theme From Exodus, "There are... some things... man was not meant to know, and songs... man was not meant to sing. And this is one of them.")

chatpoints.chat_text: Fine.  But remember, YOU asked.  They're pellets.

replies.reply_text: I can see that.
Pellets?  Yes?   And?
Oh I give up. Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: I mean, "pellets."  In the sense of, say, "rabbit pellets" or "deer pellets" and ... such.

replies.reply_text: Pellets?  You mean, as in... road-apples?
You're right, I didn't want to know.  Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: (Turning redder with every word) Yes! Pellets! Road-Apples! Number-Twos! Excrement! Meadow muffins! Yesterday's lunch! Doo-doos! ORDURE! NIGHT SOIL! FECULENCE!!!!

replies.reply_text: EEEEEEEWWWWWW!!!!!!  Forget it!  I'd rather my horses stayed stupid and vapid!  Bye!
Hang on there, hang on there, you're about to ring down the curtain and join the Choir Invisible!  Now, deep breaths, deep breaths...

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, you DID ask!

replies.reply_text: That's okay, that's okay.  I know that horses are often coprophagic, especially foals.  It's okay, really.
You're right, you warned me, and I did ask.  Oh well.  I'll leave you to... it.  Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: Ah.  Well, thank you.  So often it's not okay.  Now.  Do you want any or not?

replies.reply_text: I'll think about it.  Thanks.  Bye for now.

chatpoints.chat_text: Restocking is a lot of work!  Also, I don't know where those have been once you return them.  It's our policy.  Sorry if you're not happy with it.

replies.reply_text: Oh, all right.

chatpoints.chat_text: Sure thing!  The Magic Beans are red.  It will change the horse to which you feed it, to a random height.  The Magic Droplets are green.  Once fed to a horse, it will change the color of the horse to a random color within that breed.

replies.reply_text: That's awesome!  Thanks!
That seems ludicrous!  I'm happy with my horses and I'll be keeping them just the way they are.  Bye!

npc_list.name: Old John
npc_list.admin_description: One of Ruthie's retirees
npc_list.long_description: His whiskers long and his eyes frosted with roaning and age, Old John still retains the regal bearing of his youth. He lifts his Roman nose and trumpets a whinny.

chatpoints.chat_text: (The dark bay gelding looks at you levelly, as though sizing you up- without ever taking a break from his grazing.)

replies.reply_text: Hey there, fellow. (You hold out your hands for him to sniff.) You're a handsome old man. How are you?
Hello, you big fuzzy thing, I've brought you a nice apple.
Hi there, fellow. You're a good man.
Hello, you big, handsome fuzz. I've brought you something. (Offer him the Red Rubber Ball.)
Hello there! I come bringing... drumroll please... a baseball cap!

chatpoints.chat_text: (John stares at you for a moment, then lifts his gaze beyond you to the other horses- grazing well away from him.)

replies.reply_text: They don't spend a lot of time with you, do they? Are you lonely here?
Oh, are they your friends?
Aww, poor big man. I'll go let Ruthie know.

chatpoints.chat_text: (You get the impression that John would roll his eyes at you if he could.)

replies.reply_text: Oh... I guess not, then. Are you lonely, big fellow?
Whoa! (You laugh.) I guess we know what your favorite treat is! Now, I have something else for you, too. Ruthie says you would like this rubber ball?
Whoa! (You laugh.) I guess we know what your favorite treat is! I'll tell Ruthie.
Look at all of you!
Oh, I don't have the ball yet.  Silly me.  Sorry.
Wow... you really liked that, old fella!

npc_list.name: Argus Beesty
npc_list.long_description: Argus Beesty is an unusual person.  He has complete control over all his mystical creatures, but you can see that he loves each and every one of them.  You know he'll never hurt one of them nor will he allow anyone else to!

chatpoints.chat_text: Greetings traveler, are you interested in any of my special companions?

replies.reply_text: No thank you, I'm just looking.
Maybe, can you tell me why they are so expensive?
I forgot, how was I supposed to find Apollo?
Could you please send me back to Apollo?
Hi, I'm back from Apollo.

chatpoints.chat_text: They are very rare and only the wealthiest, most experienced travelers can afford to maintain them.  Once you adopt one, however, they are loyal and devoted companions for you and your horses.

replies.reply_text: That makes sense.....they're sooooo cute!!!  I wish I could get one, but I can't afford it yet.   I'll be back when I can.
Okay, that explains the pricing, but where do you get them?

chatpoints.chat_text: There are nurseries on the outermost islands.  The creatures who produce the eggs cherish their privacy.

replies.reply_text: I don't suppose I could visit any of the nurseries......could I?
Cool!  I was just curious.  I have to go now, bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: I'm waiting for a baby Gryphon to be delivered, would you like to see if it's ready yet?

replies.reply_text: I'd like to, but I'm too busy right now.  Maybe next time.
Would I!?!? That would be fantastic, of course I'll go!

chatpoints.chat_text: I can send you to Apollo, the Gryphons are in his care.  I have this package that I have to send him, would you mind bringing it to him for me?

replies.reply_text: I'd be honored to do that for you.
I wish I could, but I don't have time right now....sorry.
Okay, but how do I find Apollo?

chatpoints.chat_text: I'll take care of that, and he will send you back here.  Ready to go?

replies.reply_text: Sure!
Thank you!

chatpoints.chat_text: Did you enjoy visiting Scoria?  And did Apollo have any Gryphons ready for me?

replies.reply_text: Yes I did, and yes, he did.  Here's the little cutie.  Apollo said he's ready for adoption.
Well, no, he said it wasn't ready.
Awww, she too cute!  Thanks, Argus, I'll come by again soon!

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, get back there and fetch me the baby!

replies.reply_text: Okay, could you send me back?

npc_list.name: Apollo
npc_list.long_description: Apollo is a tall, incredibly handsome young man with a golden tan.

chatpoints.chat_text: Can I help you?

replies.reply_text: Oh, hi! Argus sent this for you. (You hold out the box)
No thanks, I was just going to look around a bit.
Can you send me back to the main islands now?
I'm sorry, but what did you ask me to get?
Hi, Apollo!  I'm back with the gold you asked for.
Okay, Argus wants his baby Gryphon....what do you need?

chatpoints.chat_text: All right, just be careful, there are creatures on this island that don't care for strangers.

replies.reply_text: Ummm, what sort of creatures are on this island anyway?
Oh, in that case, can you please send me back?
Thank you.

chatpoints.chat_text: I keep two pairs of Gryphons here with me. The males draw my chariot when I have to travel. They are not very socialble creatures, so be very careful around them.

replies.reply_text: Well, that explains the chariot outside!  I'll be very careful.  I promise.
I know that Argus sent me to pick up one of the baby Gryphons, but won't the parents mind?
Really?  What do they make their nests out of?  There aren't many trees around here.

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, that's the problem...I know that Argus is expecting you to bring him a baby Gryphon, but could you do something for me first?

replies.reply_text: I suppose so, what do you need?
Can't I just get the baby and get back to the main island?
Is that all you need?  I can do that no problem....could you send me back to the main islands?  I'll be back in a jiffy!
I may have 20 with me.  Let me go check, then I'll be back.

chatpoints.chat_text: I asked you to bring back 20 gold nuggets for my lovelies.  They need it for their nest.

replies.reply_text: Oh yeah, that's right...I'll be back in a flash...if you don't mind.........
I should have those with me now. (Hand over 20 gold nuggets.)
Thank you and I'll see you again I'm sure!

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, the next baby isn't quite ready, if you just do this favor for me, it will be ready when you get back, promise!

replies.reply_text: All right, what do you need?
I don't have time to wait around, could you just send me back?

chatpoints.chat_text: No, not really.  Gryphons lay 3 to 6 eggs in a clutch, I can remove most of the eggs and replace them with agate eggs.  I use that small volcano outside to incubate the eggs.  When they are ready, I send some to Argus and the rest I bring to very special reserves around the world.

replies.reply_text: So that way, they are safe and you can keep an eye on them, right?  This island is so small, I bet you'd be over run with Gryphons in no time if you didn't do that.

npc_list.name: Shoneah
npc_list.long_description: Shoneah is a silversmith who specializes in the jewelry designs of his ancestors.

chatpoints.chat_text: (Shoneah is seated on a stool staring at some silver on the table, muttering to himself.) This will never do! Never, never, never...

replies.reply_text: Oops!  I didn't mean to disturb you....I'll just take my leave now.
Excuse me, but what seems to be the matter?
Sorry to bother you, but aren't I supposed to be doing something for you?
You can stop worrying, Shoneah, I'm back with everything you asked for.
Hello!  Martina asked me to give you this order form.
Sorry, I thought I saw something outside, so what did Martina order?
Pardon me, but I'm here with a proposition for you.

chatpoints.chat_text: I've made a horrible mistake and I don't know how I can fix it.

replies.reply_text: It can't be that bad. Tell me what happened and maybe together we'll figure out a solution.
Too bad, remember to err is human and you're only human.  There, problem solved!  Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: My grandfather asked me to make a silver and turquoise concho belt for my grandmother, for their anniversary.  I underestimated the materials I had on hand, now I can't finish the belt in time!

replies.reply_text: That was rather short sighted of you.  Hope you can get your supplies in time.
Oh wow, that's bad....is there anything I can do to help?

chatpoints.chat_text: I'm short both silver and turquoise...  You could help me by getting me some more turquoise and silver.

replies.reply_text: That's all you need?  No problem, I'll get right on it!
Sorry, I don't have time for a rock hunt right now.  Good luck getting your material!
Ten chunks of silver and ten pieces of turquoise, got it!  I'll be back as soon as I have everything you asked for.

chatpoints.chat_text: That's okay.  I need 10 chunks of silver ore and 10 pieces of turquoise so I can finish this concho belt for my grandmother.  Remember, you can usually find turquoise where you also find iron and copper ores.

replies.reply_text: I got it now, 10 chunks of silver ore and turquoise.  I'll be back.
Of course I'm interested!  Thanks and I'll be seeing you soon!

chatpoints.chat_text: Welcome back, friend!

replies.reply_text: I was on Web Isle and thought I'd drop by to say hi!
I stopped by to see if there was anything else I can help you with.
I brought silver ore for you.
I have some turquoise with me.
Excuse me, but who am I bringing this belt to?
Hello again!  Martina asked me to give you this order form.
Sorry, I thought I saw something outside, so what did Martina order?
Pardon me, but I'm here with a proposition for you.

chatpoints.chat_text: Now that you ask, I've finished that concho belt for my grandmother.  Could you bring it to my grandfather, they live in Santon.

replies.reply_text: Santon?  Sorry, I'm not heading in that direction.
Santon?  No problem!
Deal!

chatpoints.chat_text: I asked you to take the belt to my grandfather, Sani, in Santon.

replies.reply_text: Oh, now I remember.  I'm on my way.

chatpoints.chat_text: That's great!  I can always use more raw materials.

replies.reply_text: Here's a silver ore.
Here's a turquoise.
Here's another one.
That's all for now!  I'll come back when I have more!
Here's another one.
That's all for now!  I'll come back when I have more!
So....what did she order?
Do you mind if I ask what they ordered?

chatpoints.chat_text: Let's see...6 Turquoise and Silver belt buckles for the Groomsmen, 6 Coral and Turquoise pendants for the Bridesmaids,.

replies.reply_text: Gee, that's a lot of work, need any help with the materials?
Do you have everything you need?  I could do some side trips if you want .
Okay, see you around!

chatpoints.chat_text: You have a proposition for me?

replies.reply_text: Iona, over in Flipperton, wants to hold a Founder's Day Crafts Festival.  She's hoping you can attend and display your jewelry.  Here's your Invitation.
I'm sure they would love to see you.  I'll let Iona know, goodbye!

npc_list.name: Gofer
npc_list.admin_description: New quests must start at CP9
npc_list.long_description: Gofer is the official delivery person for the artisans of Web Isle....when he feels like working!

chatpoints.chat_text: (Glares at you as you approach.) If Alton sent you, you haven't seen me, got it?

replies.reply_text: Sure, I haven't seen anything, bye!
Nobody sent me, I'm just looking around.  Who are you anyway?
I know, I know, we covered that already!  I came back because I've forgotten what I was doing for you.
Give it a rest already!  I'm back with your parts.

chatpoints.chat_text: I'm Gofer, I sometimes do the deliveries for the folks here on Web Isle, but I've been too busy lately.

replies.reply_text: Too busy to work? What are you up to? (You notice a pile of bicycle parts strewn on the ground around Gofer.)
Hey, that's between you and them...see ya!

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, not so much busy as unable to make any deliveries.  All these jungle islands have a lot of pesky monkeys around them...the monkeys on Web thought it would be fun to dismantle my bicycle.  I've found most of the parts, but there are a few I still can't find.

replies.reply_text: Oh, well....good luck finding the rest of your bike.  Bye bye!
I could try to help you, but I've got to ask....why do you use a bicycle?  I thought everybody around here rode horses.

chatpoints.chat_text: To tell the truth, I'm afraid of horses, I'd rather ride my bike.

replies.reply_text: To each their own I guess.  So, is there anything I can do to help you?

chatpoints.chat_text: I could use some help getting the rest of my bike parts.  I found everything except the wheels and the bicycle chain.  The monkeys probably tossed them into the sea.  I had to order them.  Could you pick them up for me while I put the rest of this mess back together?

replies.reply_text: Sure thing, where did you order them from?
Sorry, I don't have any time right now, maybe next time I run into you.
Gee, thanks!  I'll be back as soon as I can.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, okay.  I asked you to pick up my new bicycle wheels from Rick Hammerstroke in Witherton and my new bicycle chain from Ferrel Ironman in Wington.

replies.reply_text: I got it now....see you soon!

chatpoints.chat_text: Let's see....let's see what you got!

replies.reply_text: I've got two brand new bicycle tires and a new bike chain. (You hold them up for Gofer's approval.)
Thanks!  I'll see you around again some time. bye bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, it's you.  Thanks to you, my deliveries are back on track!

replies.reply_text: Glad to hear it.  Have a great day!

npc_list.name: Sierra
npc_list.admin_description: Baby Karina's mom. It's about time Karina wasn't alone in the house.
npc_list.long_description: Sierra is very busy in the kitchen when you walk in, but turns around to give you a big smile, wiping her hands on her apron.

chatpoints.chat_text: Hello there.

replies.reply_text: Hello, how are you?
Hello, goodbye, wrong house.
Hi Sierra, I'm-- (You notice Karina looking up at you attentively and lower your voice.) Gillian was able to make the bed! (You point outside, where you left it.)
Hi Sierra, I was doing something for you, wasn't I?
Hi Sierra, did Jayne bring that bed in?
(Notice the bed still sitting outside.) Ah yes. I was going to go talk to Jayne. I'll be back.

chatpoints.chat_text: I'm fine, dear, thank you, how are you?

replies.reply_text: I'm just fine, thanks very much!
I'm awfully tired. Been on my feet all day. Hope your day has been easier!

chatpoints.chat_text: Now, you just set down here and rest a bit, then. We'll have a bit of a chat. Karina's napping right now, so just keep your voice low.

replies.reply_text: Well thanks very much. She's a beautiful child.
Oh, thanks very much for your hospitality. I'm actually feeling refreshed just being here. Is there anything I can do to help you?

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, actually, there is just the one thing you could do for me. And with Karina asleep right now it may be just the perfect time to talk about it.

replies.reply_text: Well, talk away.
Uh-oh... this sounds like it's about to be a surprise. I am no good at surprises. I'll come back later.

chatpoints.chat_text: My baby Karina is getting to be a little girl, not such a baby anymore! She's getting so she is too big for her bed. I wanted to have a transition bed made for her- a twin-sized bed with a detachable railing- but I haven't been able to get away from the house to commission it. Could you do that for me?

replies.reply_text: Certainly I can!
Not today, maybe tomorrow.

chatpoints.chat_text: Well aren't you just a peach. My friend Gillian made her her crib, and I'd like Gill to make her bed as well. Now, Gill just moved, and I don't remember where she has gone off to, but you could look her up. Would you please go ask her about making the bed?

replies.reply_text: Sure, I can do that no problem.
I really can't be searching for people right now.  Sorry.

chatpoints.chat_text: You were going to find my friend Gillian and talk to her about crafting a big girl bed for my Karina.

replies.reply_text: Oh, that's right.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh! (Looks out the window at the bed.) It looks just perfect! But I'm not certain we can get it into the house... it looks awfully big. I know! Will you go next door and ask my neighbor Jayne if he can help us?

replies.reply_text: I ran into him on the way... is Jayne even awake?!
I'll ask him.

chatpoints.chat_text: (Claps her hands.) Oh, he did. Such a nice man. (Jayne, in the corner, smiles sheepishly. Sierra takes no notice, watching her daughter, who is at present attempting to chew on the bed.) Oh, Karina! Look what you've got! Oh, hon, thank you so much, I truly do appreciate it! It looks beautiful.

replies.reply_text: No problem!
All right.  Bye!

npc_list.name: Jayne
npc_list.admin_description: Variant of Jayne on the road. This bit of interaction is the *only* reason that Baby Karina's Bed was written.
npc_list.long_description: This bold adventurer appears to be boldly taking a nap, sprawled in the middle of the road.

chatpoints.chat_text: (Lying in the middle of the road, snoring loudly.)

replies.reply_text: (You step over him to walk into Sierra's and Karina's house.)

npc_list.name: Jayne
npc_list.admin_description: Jayne on the road (Jayne #3)
npc_list.long_description: If there's one word that describes Jayne, it's muscles. Jayne is a big tough guy who is fiercely loyal to a select few, and simply fierce to everyone else.

chatpoints.chat_text: (Comes roaring out of his front door, brandishing a chair!)

replies.reply_text: Whoa!

chatpoints.chat_text: Eh? What're you doin' here? (Notices you looking suspiciously at the chair he's still holding above his head, and puts it down sheepishly.) Decoratin'.

replies.reply_text: Er... right. Decoratin'. Well, if you wouldn't mind lending your immense talents to a spot of decorating in Sierra's house, she'd be very appreciative. She has this bed she can't lift into the house.

chatpoints.chat_text: For Sierra?! (His eyes widen.) Why o'course. I've hefted bigger loads than a bed! (Marches outside, hefts the bed, and marches it into Sierra's house.)

replies.reply_text: Well then. (Follow him into Sierra's house.)

npc_list.name: Jayne
npc_list.admin_description: Jayne to the left of his house (Jayne #4)
npc_list.long_description: If there's one word that describes Jayne, it's muscles. Jayne is a big tough guy who is fiercely loyal to a select few, and simply fierce to everyone else.

chatpoints.chat_text: (Comes roaring out of his front door, brandishing a chair!)

chatpoints.chat_text: Eh? What're you doin' here? (Notices you looking suspiciously at the chair he's still holding above his head, and puts it down sheepishly.) Decoratin'.

chatpoints.chat_text: For Sierra?! (His eyes widen.) Why o'course. I've hefted bigger loads than a bed! (Marches outside, hefts the bed, and marches it into Sierra's house.)

replies.reply_text: Well then. (Follow him into Sierra's house.)

npc_list.admin_description: Jayne east of his house, Jayne #6, final Jayne.

replies.reply_text: Well then. (Follow him into Sierra's house.)

npc_list.name: Aili
npc_list.admin_description: Aili on Basalt. Reserved for Renn please. Too much to do, too few chatpoints.
npc_list.long_description: Your first impression is not of a person, but of an immense red braid that happens to be attached to a head. This is rather an improvement on what people normally see when they look at Aili: a pile of books, behind which can be seen parts of a person.

chatpoints.chat_text: (She scribbles away in her leather journal, occasionally looking down at one of the books next to her.)

replies.reply_text: (Clear your throat.)
Hi Aili! Sorry to bother you. I don't suppose you want to fill me in on the meaning of what I found for you?
(Quietly turn around and leave.)
Hi Aili!

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh! (Drops her journal in surprise.) Uh, hi! Hi, nice to... meet you, I guess. We haven't met before, right?

replies.reply_text: No, we've never met before. (Hold out your hand as you introduce yourself.)
Well, I hate to embarrass you, but we've met before. How are you?
We have, actually. I'm actually working on something for you right now. ...only I don't recall what it is.
Yes, we have.  You sent me out to do some field work for you.

chatpoints.chat_text: Ah, hi, I'm Aili. This is, uh... (Waves her hand vaguely.) Well, you've seen Basalt Isle I suppose.

replies.reply_text: A little bit. I did some exploring. Why, is there something interesting about it?
Every little bit about it! There's nothing I haven't seen! Nothing I don't understand! Well... except for one or two things. What do you know about the isle? Maybe you could help me.
Yes, I've seen it from right here. I haven't explored at all yet. What can you tell me about it?
As much as I want to have seen, and I am ready to go home.

chatpoints.chat_text: Well... quite a bit, actually!

replies.reply_text: Well, tell me something about it, then!

chatpoints.chat_text: What would you like to know?

replies.reply_text: Well, this isle's got a lot of volcanoes, hasn't it?
This is the only lava isle I've ever seen with a lake! What's with that?
So who lives on this isle? Other than you.
Well, these water dragons. Can you tell me about them?

chatpoints.chat_text: Only some of it. You'll notice there are only volcanoes on the north side. Basalt is unusual in that the north and south sides of the isle are... very different, ecologically speaking.

replies.reply_text: So what about the south side?
So who lives here on this unusual isle?

chatpoints.chat_text: While the north side is covered in volcanoes, the south side has none at all, and instead features a huge lake with crystal-clear waters. Do you find that strange at all?

replies.reply_text: What about the north side? You said this isle has volcanoes on it.
Yeah, that's weird. You don't expect to see such different features. Do you know why the isle is like this? What is it you do here, anyway? Other than run the boat.
I never stopped to think about it. I don't think I'll start now, either.

chatpoints.chat_text: I think I'm the only human here. That's part of the reason I come here.

replies.reply_text: Only human? Do you think there's something else here?
Part of? What else brings you here?

chatpoints.chat_text: I'm a researcher. I run the boat too, but mostly I like the peace and quiet, and Basalt Isle is very... interesting.

replies.reply_text: Interesting how? Is it particularly covered in volcanoes or something?
Interesting in what way?
You're a researcher? What do you study?

chatpoints.chat_text: Tell me, have you ever met a dragon?

replies.reply_text: Once or twice.
Oh sure, I've met loads of dragons. This isn't my first trip to the lava isles, you know.
No, I haven't met any yet.
Just the ones next door. They're like none I've ever seen!

chatpoints.chat_text: Well... (Stares off into space for a minute.) It strikes me that dragons might not be the only creatures that live on the Basalt Isles. Do you understand what I mean?

replies.reply_text: Of course I do. There are horses here too!
Do you think there's something special to be found here on Basalt?

chatpoints.chat_text: Yes, of course, there are horses too.

replies.reply_text: That's my favorite creature to be found on these isles. No offense.

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, I'd recommend you do. They're phenomenal creatures. Fascinating. But carefully. Dragons are proud. They wouldn't want to feel they're being visited as a sort of curiosity.

replies.reply_text: You sound like you know that from experience. Do you study dragons?
I'll be sure to keep that in mind should I ever meet one.
Yes, I've noticed that.

chatpoints.chat_text: Well... (She seems on the brink of confiding in you some great secret, but appears to think better of it.) It's possible. I just think this isle is too unusual to be ordinary. Do you see what I mean?

replies.reply_text: You seem to think Basalt Isle could be something special. Is there anything legendary here?

chatpoints.chat_text: Legendary? That could be a good description. I was thinking perhaps "mythological." But no matter- I'd hate to bore you with the subject of my research. It bores most people.

replies.reply_text: I'm going to go ahead and call myself "most people" and assume I'd be bored, so thanks for the warning. I'm going to go someplace else.
I don't think I'd be bored at all.

chatpoints.chat_text: (Smiles.) No, I'd hate to talk shop. What I do is very specialized, and most people don't really enjoy hearing about it.

replies.reply_text: Well, you've now told me twice how bored I'd be, so I'm going to figure you're not lying. See ya later!
I'm not really most people. What is it you study? Here on the Lava Isles- is it something about dragons?

chatpoints.chat_text: (Long pause.) In a way, yes. Studying- or rather, conversing with, since it's impolite to study another sentient being as though it were a slide under a microscope- (Takes a moment to get back on track.) As I was saying, I've spent a long time conversing with dragons. Did you know that most people thought them legends only? It's funny the way we think about our world.

replies.reply_text: How do you mean?
It is a little strange.

chatpoints.chat_text: Hundreds and hundreds of years ago, our society knew dragons were real. They'd seen them. We have reason to believe that the dragons who now live on Lava, or their ancestors, or perhaps an entirely different set that still live there now- anyway, that dragons once inhabited all of the Horse Isles. People spoke with them. We have records of their conversations. There are things our oral histories tell us that we learned from dragons, that we wouldn't know without them.

replies.reply_text: I guess I never thought about it that way. When you grow up thinking that something's an old story and isn't true, you don't stop to think too much about whether it really could be real.
But aren't our oral histories just stories too? How do we know they weren't... well... just making things up? Or using concepts as allegories?

chatpoints.chat_text: But then something changed. Either the dragons moved on, or we stopped being able to see them. And people stopped believing they'd existed at all, and they became the stuff of fairy stories and old lore.

replies.reply_text: But we know they're real again now.

chatpoints.chat_text: Yes, we know now that dragons are real. And again, we've started to interact with them. Now we know what our ancestors knew- dragons are real, not stories at all.

replies.reply_text: So how does this affect what you do? I've never seen a dragon on this isle, outside of the ones on the dock, and they're not really... typical.
I never thought about it that way. Do you think the same thing could be true for other things we think are just legends now?

chatpoints.chat_text: Well... the way I see it is, we know that dragons are real. A hundred years ago, our great-grandparents did not know that like we know it, but their great-great-great grandparents did. So: could there be other things that we think are just mythology, that are actually true? And how will we know if they are? That's what I study.

replies.reply_text: So you study old legends... to see if there's any basis in reality?

chatpoints.chat_text: Yes. (Lifts her head proudly, and a little stubbornly.) So you see that I don't exactly have an office in the libraries- most people think that what I study is a fairytale at best. But I think there's something to be gained, something to be found out, by investigating them.

replies.reply_text: Well, good luck to you. I'm not sure that I believe in what you're doing, but it's obvious it's near and dear to your heart.

I completely agree with you. Even if the old stories aren't real at all, we still have something to gain by studying them. And we won't know whether or not they're true until we investigate for ourselves.
Girl, you crazy.

chatpoints.chat_text: We don't. Not for sure, anyway. But we do know that they weren't making it up about the dragons, because we have dragons now. We know that at least part of the old mythologies are accurate.

replies.reply_text: So, because dragons are real, it follows that the old stories aren't entirely made up.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh! (Blushes.) I'm fine, thanks. Yourself?

replies.reply_text: I'm fine, thanks. You look a little preoccupied.
Fine, thanks. Well, I guess I'll be moving on.

chatpoints.chat_text: It's... well, actually, there's something I'm not quite satisfied with at the moment.

replies.reply_text: Isn't "not quite satisfied" the normal state of a researcher?
Isn't that the truth. I'm not satisfied with what I've done with my day so far. I'll be along. Good seeing you. Remember my name next time!

chatpoints.chat_text: (Laughs.) Yes, that's true. But this really... I feel like I'm on the edge of a breakthrough.

replies.reply_text: Really? How's that?

chatpoints.chat_text: When I was on my morning walk, I saw tracks in the sand near where the two halves of the isle meet. Huge prints, unlike any I'd seen before. But I had to get back up here because of the rowboat. So I didn't get a chance to investigate.

replies.reply_text: Well, I can check it out for you and report back. I'm good at stuff like that.
Off I go! I'm on the case.
...huh. Well, that's about the weirdest thing I've done today.

chatpoints.chat_text: (Smiles.) Maybe another time. (You notice she's still holding the feathers.)

replies.reply_text: AAAARGH! I hate secrets!

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh... right, you. You were walking along the beach in between the two halves of the isle, searching for the strange footprints I saw and anything else you might run across.

replies.reply_text: Oh. Oh right. That.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh! Yes! I'm so sorry, I lose track of things when I'm reading... tell me all about what you found!

replies.reply_text: Well, I found two enormous sets of foot prints, just like you said. One looked like a set of raptor prints, only huge- talons in the front and one talon behind. The other I didn't recognize. It had three toes well-spread and a very long heel.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh... (Leans forward.) Did you find anything else?

replies.reply_text: Yes, I found these feathers in the sand too. (You hand them to her.) This red one was towards the northern side of the isle, and the white one was towards the south.

chatpoints.chat_text: (Somewhat abstractedly, without lifting her eyes from her book. Oh, hi! It's good to see you again.

replies.reply_text: You too. So, can you tell me more about Basalt Isle?
How are you doing?
You too. So, uh... what was it I was doing for you, again?
I found those footprints! And some extras. Uh... you look a little distracted, is now a bad time?

chatpoints.chat_text: Dragons? Why dragons?

replies.reply_text: Well, they're really interesting, aren't they?
Well, because I've been to some of the other Lava Isles, and they have dragons.

chatpoints.chat_text: Yes, they're a local species. The waters off of Basalt Isle happen to be uniquely suited for a population of water dragons!

replies.reply_text: Really? That's interesting. What are they like?

chatpoints.chat_text: They're a peculiar breed- properly, I suppose, they're "sea serpents," not water dragons. Long and sinuous with the loveliest translucent fins. It isn't really clear how they maneuver in the water- their fins are much too fragile to use for any kind of navigation. So of course, I've been studying them. Unfortunately, they're not very bright. But they're very, very sweet.

replies.reply_text: They sound like nice companions.
Pardon me for asking, but if they're such interesting creatures and they only live here, why are they being sold?

chatpoints.chat_text: Frankly, because they're overpopulating the waters here. There are just too many of them for the ecosystem to support. And they're really social and people-oriented. You can't swim anywhere near them without them leaving off whatever they were doing and trying to climb on you. I can't communicate with them, but I asked the Blue Dragon to, and he says they're adventure-seeking and that seeing new things is good for them. If I hadn't had his approval on it I'd never, ever take a creature out of its habitat. But anyway, I help re-home them and route the proceeds into conservation efforts. Seems to suit everyone.

replies.reply_text: They look like they wouldn't be able to live out of water. But I guess they do all right?
Huh. Well, maybe I'll have to think about getting one to keep my horse company. They sound really sweet and playful and I think my fuzzball would enjoy that.

chatpoints.chat_text: Yes, in fact they scared me when I first got started with them because they spend half their time getting out of the water and slithering around on the sand. I'd originally thought they were completely ocean-dwelling and couldn't survive out of water, and I nearly had a heart attack! But as it happens, they do just fine. When the sun's out, they all cluster on that dock like nothing so much as a pile of lizards.

replies.reply_text: Not a dogpile but a dragon-pile? That sounds pretty cute.

npc_list.name: Octavia
npc_list.admin_description: Transport- or rather, consumer of pearls- on Scoria-Basalt rowboat.

chatpoints.chat_text: (Reaches a long tentacle towards you.)

replies.reply_text: (You recoil, before noticing that curled in her other tentacles is an immense pile of pearls!) Oh, are you collecting fare?

Uh... hi Octavia. I brought you a present. Not from me. I mean, I guess it's from me in the immediate sense, but really it's from Octavius. He's an octopus. I think you probably knew that. He lives on... oh, here. Take the necklace.

chatpoints.chat_text: (Looks at you levelly, then points to her pile of pearls.)

replies.reply_text: I guess so.
I guess you are... but you can't possibly own this boat!

chatpoints.chat_text: (You get the impression that she's rolling her eyes.)

replies.reply_text: Where's its owner?

chatpoints.chat_text: (She jabs her tentacle forward, pointing south.)

replies.reply_text: So it's someone else's boat and it's here without its owner? Well, I guess that person is across the way... I'll go see where this boat wants to go, I guess! Can't have its owner stranded.
So... you liked it then? And you want me to take this pearl back to Octavius? Woman of few words, aren't you? I hope I'm doing the right thing.

npc_list.name: Carolyn Caravel
npc_list.admin_description: Dockkeeper, Treeton docks
npc_list.long_description: With her bright hair, huge, dangling sand-dollar earrings, and bare feet, Carolyn looks not a day older than her eighteen years. But you realize as you watch her that she must have been working in a dock house for most of those years, too. On the table next to her is a pile of tools and implements you've never seen before.
