npc_list.admin_description: lives by the sea... Isle of Hardly
npc_list.long_description: You have a hard time seeing what Fluff actually looks like: when you look at him, you see the image of a huge green dragon, a small green dragon, and a sinuous white dragon, all at the same time. It makes your head hurt.

chatpoints.chat_text: (You've found your dragon, all right... but you've never seen such a sad face.)

replies.reply_text: Uh... we haven't met before yet, but I think you're Dalton's dragon friend, am I right? What's the matter?

Cheer up, Fluff! Do you remember Long Matty Black, the pirate who wanted to be a baker? Or Astrid, the star that you and Dalton put back up into the sky? Matty's a baker extraordinare, and she made a magic cake that helped Dalton! Come on- have some!
There doesn't seem to be anything I could do to cheer you up... I wonder if someone else could help you.

chatpoints.chat_text: Things just aren't what they used to be around here... I guess all things have their seasons, and this is the winter for me.

replies.reply_text: I don't understand. Aren't you a magic dragon? Can't you just... magic yourself better?

chatpoints.chat_text: The Isle of Hardly is my magic, young friend. And as spoiled as it is... so is my magic.

replies.reply_text: I don't know what to do about that. I'm here because of Dalton- he's very sick, and he said that coming here cured him before. Do you think it would work twice?

chatpoints.chat_text: At the rate things are going here, if you bring him here, it will only make him worse. Look around. It's no good.

replies.reply_text: Please? Can't we try? Maybe he could help you.
Well, fine, but I'm not giving up.

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, if you say so...

replies.reply_text: I say so. More importantly, Dalton says so. Here, eat up.
I told you so! And look, the whole isle is looking better, too! Now, come on- let's go get Dalton and bring him here! Surely with the Isle of Hardly better, he can get well too.

chatpoints.chat_text: Hello hello!

replies.reply_text: Fluff, what are you waiting for? Let's go back to Dalton, and bring him back here to the Isle of Hardly so he can get well again!
Hello Fluff! You look very well!

npc_list.name: Falcor
npc_list.admin_description: Falcor on the Isle of Hardly

chatpoints.chat_text: Helloooooooooooo!

replies.reply_text: Hello Falcor! Could you please fly me back to Turtle Isle?
Hello Falcor! Could you please fly me back to Turtle Isle?

chatpoints.chat_text: Are you suuuuuuuuuuure you want to leave just now?

replies.reply_text: Well... maybe I can find something else on this isle to help.

npc_list.name: Petunia
npc_list.admin_description: Isle of Hardly
npc_list.long_description: Wherever Petunia places one of her delicate hooves, flowers grow.

chatpoints.chat_text: Hello, friend.

replies.reply_text: Hello. I don't mean to insult you, but it looks as though you're not well.
Hello. I'm looking for a dragon. Is there one around here?
Hello Petunia! You look well!
Hello.  I have some things to do.  Maybe I'll come back later.

chatpoints.chat_text: (She does look as though things are hard- her neck looks gaunt rather than muscled, her coat is rough instead of sleek, and there are tangles in her mane.) We've all seen better days than what we're seeing now. I don't know how we'll keep on.

replies.reply_text: Are you ill for the same reason that Fluff is- that the isle is sick?

chatpoints.chat_text: Yes, everyone here gets our health and magic from the bounty of the Isle of Hardly. But it doesn't have much bounty to spare, these days. So we're all running low.

replies.reply_text: I'm sorry to hear it. It doesn't seem that anyone is having an easy time of it these days. Do you remember a boy called Dalton?

chatpoints.chat_text: Yes, I do. I hope he, at least, is doing well.

replies.reply_text: Actually, I'm afraid he's very ill. I was hoping that I could bring him here to recover, since he got well here once before, but it doesn't seem that that's a good idea.
Thank you. Unicorn horns have magical healing powers, right? Maybe I can help Dalton, and he can help Fluff and the Isle of Hardly, and then everyone can get well together.

chatpoints.chat_text: In the cave. But I warn you, he's not really up to visitors. He's had a hard time.

replies.reply_text: Thank you.

chatpoints.chat_text: Much better, thank you! (She tosses her silky mane.) With the Isle of Hardly blooming again, we are all doing better than ever before!

replies.reply_text: I'm so glad to hear it.

npc_list.name: Dalton
npc_list.admin_description: Dalton on the Isle of Hardly
npc_list.long_description: The Isle of Hardly has done wonders for Dalton's health. His skin has a healthy flush and he looks stronger and better than ever.

chatpoints.chat_text: Hello, hello, hello!

replies.reply_text: Hello, Dalton! You look very well!

chatpoints.chat_text: Much better now, thank you so much! I feel better than I have in years. Soon I'll be going home, but I'll keep coming back to visit Fluff- right, old friend? (He gives the old dragon a genial pat on the flank.)

replies.reply_text: That's wonderful news!

npc_list.name: Astrid
npc_list.admin_description: a star. Or she used to be. Cloud Isle
npc_list.long_description: Astrid always looks a little unreal. When she speaks, her voice sounds like it's echoing back from a long way away.

chatpoints.chat_text: Why, hello.

replies.reply_text: Excuse me, this may sound very silly... but I don't suppose you were put back up here by a little boy? Do you remember someone named Dalton?
Hello again, Astrid. I don't suppose you could refresh my memory about that companion of Dalton's? I know you said you didn't remember much...

chatpoints.chat_text: Of course I do! He's rather unforgettable! How is he?

replies.reply_text: I'm afraid he's very ill.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh dear, I'm so very sorry to hear it.

replies.reply_text: He's mentioned a magical isle where he was cured, when he was sick as a child. I don't suppose you know anything about that?
I was too, he's a very nice man. But wait- are you really a fallen star?!

chatpoints.chat_text: I'm afraid I don't know the island you mean, but I certainly believe it exists! So that was where he and that companion of his were bound? I never had cause to ask.

replies.reply_text: What kind of companion did he have? This is about the first I've heard of it.

chatpoints.chat_text: It was a bit difficult to tell, actually. He seemed to be many shapes and sizes all at once. But Dalton rode on his tail as easily as you'd hang in the sky!

replies.reply_text: Hanging in the sky isn't easy for everybody! Maybe you can do it, but I certainly can't!
That's not very easy for someone like me, but I understand what you mean. So you really don't know the isle I'm talking about? I'd think you have a great view of everything from up here.

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, aren't you doing that now? (She laughs merrily.) You're standing on a cloud, after all! Do suspend your disbelief!

replies.reply_text: So are you really a fallen star?
I guess I'll have to. So you really don't know of any magical isle?

chatpoints.chat_text: Really and truly! It's not so uncommon as you'd think. Sometimes the clouds just push us out, and if we aren't strong enough, we'll fall. It's not so bad if we fall in the right places, but I fell right onto the deck of a boat! There was no getting back up from there!

replies.reply_text: But he put you back up into the sky, huh? That sounds magical. I'm looking for a magical isle he talked about, where he was cured when he was sick as a child. I don't suppose you know anything about it?
Wait, there's a right place for falling stars to fall?

chatpoints.chat_text: Yes, the best way is to fall into a tree. You can very easily get back up from there.

replies.reply_text: What if somebody picks you up? I mean, obviously Dalton picked you up and put you back up here, but what if someone doesn't do that?

chatpoints.chat_text: Then usually they go about with mandrake roots, and it's all very boring, unless you can get away.

replies.reply_text: Wow. I'm not even going to ask. Look, I'm here because I'm looking for a magical island where Dalton was once cured. You seem pretty magical yourself. Do you possibly know which isle that was?

chatpoints.chat_text: No, I'm afraid I don't. So I would think that this isle must be a very long way away from here. On the other half of the world, probably. I'd imagine that companion of Dalton's must still be there, though. I remember that he was taking Dalton to visit his home.

replies.reply_text: Do you remember anything about this companion that you could tell me? Maybe it would ring a bell with someone I've met.
Kings and princes? Wow, that must have been something special...

chatpoints.chat_text: A very unusual pair, they were! I've never seen the like. I doubt I ever will again. Even kings and princes would bow to them. And that's an uncommon thing, I can tell you- living so near to royalty myself!

replies.reply_text: Huh. Well, that gives me an idea, anyhow. Thanks!

npc_list.name: Lucky
npc_list.long_description: This large, white shaggy dog looks like a very happy and healthy fellow!

chatpoints.chat_text: Woof! Woof-woof!

replies.reply_text: Hello there! What a pretty dog you are.

npc_list.name: Leda Swann
npc_list.admin_description: Hangs Out at Crystalton General
npc_list.short_description: a bit over-dressed, even for here!
npc_list.long_description: Leda Swann obviously came originally from somewhere warm.  You can barely see her face; she is bundled up tight in scarves, hats (yes, you saw right, she's wearing two) and mittens. She seems a happy sort, though, and waves at you cheerily when you enter the store where she is browsing.

chatpoints.chat_text: Hello there! Cold out, isn't it!

replies.reply_text: I thought it was pretty toasty for Crystalton, but yeah, it's cold.  How are you?
It sure is! Thankfully, I'm dressed for it and heading right back out! Bye!
Hi there.  I... uhm... I forgot where you said I should go.
Hi, I've got your armature parts!
I forgot to ask... where in Tropicton can I get that mosquito netting you wanted?
I have returned with stuff!
Hi... are you absolutely sure you need 40 of those hummingbird feathers from Jungle?
I'm back with the hummingbird feathers!
I don't see your clockwork birds, so I guess you need something more. What can I get for you now?
I'm back with the pearls!
Okay, I have the feathers you asked me for.
Okay, sorry I had to run out like that, I forgot I left the carpet in the bathtub.  There was something else you wanted me to do, wasn't there?
I think I've brought you everything you need for your mechanical birds!
Was there something more you needed help with?
I'm guessing you need something else for your mechanical birds?

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, I'm fine. I was just telling Windy here how homesick I've gotten lately. It's not like down in the tropics. Nope.

replies.reply_text: Well, yeah, no kidding!  I think I'll go out and play in the snow now.  See you!
Really? Where do you come from, exactly, if you don't mind me asking?
Being homesick - I can relate to that. Speaking of that, I think I'll head home and see what's for dinner.

chatpoints.chat_text: I don't mind at all, dear!  I came originally from Ashton, and then when I was ten we moved to Tropicton.

replies.reply_text: That certainly explains why you feel the cold so keenly! It's sad that you're homesick, though. That's tough.
Good grief! Whatever made you move way up here? Or are you just visiting?

chatpoints.chat_text: (Leda waves her hands in the air in an expression of exasperation.) My sister, that's what! She is so perfect and so the apple of everyone's eye and I couldn't stand it anymore! All the whining and constant... anyway, I couldn't stand it anymore so I decided to move here and live in an igloo! I adore the quiet! And you know what's the best, nobody compares me to her up here! It's wonderful! But still...

replies.reply_text: But still, you miss the warmth, I'll bet.
I hear you.  Well, look at the time, gotta go!  Bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: I miss the warmth, although an igloo can be quite surprisingly warm, don't you know. But I really miss the birds. Up here there are only a few kinds of birds and they're either brown or white or grey. Not like the jungle birds! Oh, I miss those so much!

replies.reply_text: You could build an indoor aviary and fill it with all the birds you love.
I would miss them too.  I approve of a colorful world.
I'm sure that's very poignant somehow, but I really must be going.  Goodbye.

chatpoints.chat_text: No, t's not fair to the birds to have them shipped up here, and then you have to have the food shipped up here and... it's much too complicated! And suppose I want to move to another igloo? But I have a better idea!

replies.reply_text: I agree, it does sound like it would be complicated. However, I would be interested in hearing your idea.
Uh oh... I sense a quest coming on.  I think I need to run home and iron the sofa. Bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: I do too! (Behind her, Windy snorts and chuckles.) But I have a plan, you see! I'm going to have my igloo and my colorful world, too!

replies.reply_text: I'm not sure I want to know about this... I think I'll just leave now.
Let's hear it then!

chatpoints.chat_text: I am going to make myself an aviary of clockwork birds! They don't have to be real species, they can be my own inventions, but they will chirp and sing and move a little and be just as beautiful!  All I need is stuff.  And time.  And more stuff.  And more time... you know how it goes.

replies.reply_text: Oh, wow!  That sounds like so much fun!  Say, I do a lot of traveling, maybe I can help!
Clockwork birds? That sounds interesting. Can you tell me a bit more?
Oh, is that the time?!  I need to rush home and milk the cheese.  Bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, can you ever! I get so seasick! If you could bring me things I'm looking for, that would be wonderful!

replies.reply_text: Okay, what do you want me to do first?
I think maybe I'll leave this for some other time.  Bye.
Ugh! I know about being seasick. What a horrible feeling. I've found that if you keep yours eyes straight ahead on the horizon, it helps a bit.

chatpoints.chat_text: Let's start with the armatures!

replies.reply_text: Fear not, I'm on my way!  I'll be back as soon as I can!

chatpoints.chat_text: The farrier in Shellton.

replies.reply_text: Oh!  Yeah!  Right, now I remember.  Back shortly.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh!  I can't wait to see them!  Let's see what he gave you!

replies.reply_text: Here they are.
Anything else I can do for you?
Oh, is that the time?!  I need to rush home and shave the ceilings.  Bye!
I'm on my way. Bye!
Feathers, eh?  Might you be wanting me to pick up feathers for you while I'm travelling?

chatpoints.chat_text: Good heavens, they use so much of it down there I'll bet everybody carries it.  Try the general store first.

replies.reply_text: Right.  See you.
I'll keep my eye out for them.  Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, goodie!  What did you bring me?

replies.reply_text: Four meters of mosquito netting, and Ben Burlap says to tell you that everyone in Tropicton misses you!
And you wanted feathers as well, yes?   I believe I have them here.
Now, you mentioned feathers.  Would you like me to bring you feathers, too?
Great!  So, what's next?

chatpoints.chat_text: Now, this is going to be where you actually earn your reward!  What I'm sending you out to do is not easy but it pays well. Are you up for a trip around Jungle Isle?

replies.reply_text: Uhm... no.  I think I'd better go home and hang the wallpaper out to dry.  Bye.
Seriously? I was just there! Argh!!! Exactly what is it you want me to do?
I love Jungle Isle!  Sure.  What do you want me to do?

chatpoints.chat_text: I need hummingbird feathers. There's a grove just west of one of the jungle temples. It looks like an orange blob. It's full of hummingbird nests. Search the ground carefully to find the feathers. You might want to ask a tribesman for help.

replies.reply_text: Which Jungle Temple?
Okay, my trusty telescope and I will find the grove!  How many of them do you want?

chatpoints.chat_text: Uhm... the one south of Tropicton. Oh, I know there are a few, but that's all I remember. A temple with an orange blob-shaped grove of trees west of it.

replies.reply_text: I'll give it a go.  How many feathers do you want?
Wow, that could take... a while.  I'll be back.

chatpoints.chat_text: Positive.

replies.reply_text: Oooo-kay.
And where did you say I could find them?
Great news! That's exactly how many I have!
No, I think I've had enough, I'll just stop here if it's all the same to you.  Bye.
Let me guess. You've got armature. So that makes the body. You've got feathers. I know! You need eyes! What can I get for you?
Pearls for eyes?  Ooo, that'll be creepy!  But if that's what you want, I'll go get them.
Six pearls?  I believe I have six on me.  Here you are.
Thanks!  Enjoy your birds!  I'll try not to spend this all in one place.
I think that's everything!

chatpoints.chat_text: I've tried that, and eating ginger, drinking ginger ale, and even pressing the insides of my wrists. Nothing seems to help. My sister says it's all in my head. Regardless, I've sworn off of boat rides.

replies.reply_text: I'm sorry to hear that. So, back to your mechanical birds. What would you like me to do first?

chatpoints.chat_text: Of course! A clockwork bird would never be hungry, the climate would always be right, and it would be immortal! I could make several and they can be any color I choose. Of course, I would need help.

replies.reply_text: You know, while your idea certainly has merit, I suspect it involves a long and arduous quest. One that I am just not up for today. So, good day and good luck!
Sounds like you are going to need supplies that aren't readily available to you. Maybe I could help?

chatpoints.chat_text: As a matter of fact, I do! You can't have birds without feathers, now can you?

replies.reply_text: Good point. How many feathers do you need?

chatpoints.chat_text: There's a grove just west of one of the jungle temples. It looks like an orange blob. It's full of hummingbird nests. Search the ground carefully to find the feathers. You might want to ask a tribesman for help.

replies.reply_text: Alrighty then. I am on my way.

npc_list.name: Kevin
npc_list.admin_description: Bailey's nephew
npc_list.long_description: Kevin is sitting on a rock, all by himself, staring out to sea.

chatpoints.chat_text: You were going to ask Aunt Bailey about the currents. But remember, she can't know that the Hesperpuss is broken!

replies.reply_text: Oh dear. I remember the whole ugly situation now. I'll go talk to her now. And I'll be VERY discreet!

chatpoints.chat_text: There was an eagle that grabbed the line and started to fly away with it. (You see Kevin tearing up as he once again realizes exactly how much trouble he's in!) The tide was going out, and he pulled the boat against those rocks over there, and the line broke and the boat broke and... and Auntie Bailey doesn't know I took the ship and when she finds out...

replies.reply_text: Oh no.  She's bound to find out if something that big is missing. What are your plans now?

Hmmm... this really is a problem for you, I must say.  You are going to have to fess up and tell her and face the natural consequences of your actions. Hopefully, you think twice next time before you take somebody else's property!
That's a great idea. I'll get right on that! Hang in there, buddy!  We'll find her!
It was bobbing in the water around the rocks off the northeast corner of the island.
It's a secret.

chatpoints.chat_text: No, not Auntie Bailey.  She doesn't do that.  She's usually nice.  But when something makes her mad, she explodes!

replies.reply_text: I will need more information about how the currents go.  Auntie Bailey will know about that, surely.
I think that might be one heck of an exaggeration. But just in case, I think I'll just leave for a bit. Give her time to cool down. I may be back to help you. Maybe.
Bailey explodes? I bet that is NOT a pretty sight!

chatpoints.chat_text: (Kevin is just sitting on the rock. Whether or not he's noticed you is really hard to tell.)

replies.reply_text: Hey Kevin.  Sorry, buddy. I remember looking along the shoreline for boat parts, but its been so long, I don't remember what I was going to do next.
So, Kevin. Where was I in helping you? I remember giving you the hull and talking to your aunt Baily.
I seem to remember helping you with something, but for the life of me, I can't remember what!
Hi there.
(Turn around and leave him alone.)
Hey there!  Look what I found!
I searched the beach all the way up to the tip and back, and I am still not finding anything more of the Hesperpuss.
I talked to Bailey, she said to speak to the harbormaster on Turtle about the currents, so I'm on my way there.  I just wanted to stop and let you know.
Hi Kevin!  Look what I found on Haven Isle!
I'm back with stuff!!
Hey there! Can you remind me what I was going to do for you?
Drat! Okay, I remember I gave you the Foremast that I found on Haven, but I don't remember where I was going to look next. Did I say anything to you about that?
Okay, I need my memory jarred. It's been like - well - forever since I started helping you on this. Who did I tell you gave me information I needed on finding boat parts? Do you remember?

chatpoints.chat_text: Hi.

replies.reply_text: Bye.
Is something the matter? You seem fairly dejected and morose.

chatpoints.chat_text: What do you care?

replies.reply_text: Oh, nothing. Forget it then.  Enjoy your rock.
I care because I want to think I am a decent person.  What's wrong?  Maybe I can help.
No, I'm just a Nosy Parker who likes to meddle in things.

chatpoints.chat_text: (Kevin turns and looks at you as if he's never seen anything quite like you before. Whether this is a good thing or a bad thing, you can't exactly tell.) I'm in awful trouble. Do you really think you can help me?

replies.reply_text: Maybe. I can't make any promises, but I will try my best.  Please tell me what the problem is.
Honestly, "awful trouble" sounds like it might be time consuming and I just don't have time today. But I will try to come back another time and help you. Off to get my chores done!
I might help you, yes, for a fee.

chatpoints.chat_text:
Well, Auntie Bailey had this wonderful wooden ship her father made called the Hesperpuss. Three masts, and all the sails and rigging and every little detail! All I ever wanted was to see it sail. It was so big, you could almost sit in it. So I thought it would be okay to sail it.
So, I tied a long string to it, and I put it in the ocean here. The waves moved it around as the tide was going out. It was beautiful!

replies.reply_text: Yup! I can see this is going to lead to a big time-consuming quest. I don't even want to hear what happened next! Good luck, kid. You are going to need it.
Oh, dear. I can already understand how this didn't turn out well! Tell me what happened next.

chatpoints.chat_text: I don't like you. Go away.

replies.reply_text: Fine, be that way.
You're right. I don't blame you. Okay, I'll do it without the fee. Tell me more. Please? Come on, tell me.

chatpoints.chat_text: You were going to help me find the wreck of my aunt's boat, the Hesperpuss.

replies.reply_text: Now I remember! Okay, heading out to search the coastline.  Maybe I'll see some clue on those rocks in the water. Keep your fingers crossed!

chatpoints.chat_text: I thought if I could find all the parts I could put it back together again but the parts floated off in the currents and I don't know where they are!

replies.reply_text: Oh gosh! This is a disaster. It won't be easy! And I don't know if we'll succeed, but I will try my best to help you.
Yikes! Floated off in the currents? I can see now that this is going to be way too time-consuming for me to tackle today. I'll try to come back some other day. Good luck!

chatpoints.chat_text: Aww, don't be that way! I need to find the rest of this boat! I keep looking out at the rocks. It looks like there are all kinds of things there.  If I had binoculars, I could see them better.

replies.reply_text: Okay, okay.  I found it bobbing against the rocks a little north of here.

chatpoints.chat_text: That means the current here flows north. Was there anything else up that way?  We should ask someone where the currents go.

replies.reply_text: I'll go look again. Just in case I missed something.
I didn't see anything else, no.

chatpoints.chat_text: I don't know what to do!  If I go off looking somewhere else, Auntie Bailey will get suspicious.

replies.reply_text: She's probably suspicious already.
Well, we'll have to do what we can anyway. Parts of the boat might have washed up on other islands. I need to know how the currents flow around here to know which islands to check.
I bet this will make you think twice before using things without permission!
I will be the very soul of discretion.  You keep an eye on the shoreline here, and I'll go find what I can.  Good luck!

chatpoints.chat_text: Aww, gee, thanks a lot!  I hope you find out loads!

replies.reply_text: Never fear, I am on the case!  As soon as I find anything I'll be back.  Hang in there!

chatpoints.chat_text: Well what about The Neverending Isles?  Have you been there?

replies.reply_text: No, I haven't been there yet.
Yes, I went there with Falcor. Again, not sure where this is all going. Do you think the parts may have ended up on those islands? Like they floated out on the tide or something?

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh. Then you can't help me. I'll just... never mind. Maybe some time later. Bye. (Kevin goes back to staring bleakly into the waves.)

replies.reply_text: Oh.  That's... final. See you around, kid.
Well drat! Tell you what. I'll find a way to help you and come back someday! In the meantime, keep your chin up!

chatpoints.chat_text: I hope you can.  Have you ever been to Hotzeplotz?

replies.reply_text: Yes, I've been there, and I've even met His Majesty King Phil. I'm not quite sure what this has to do with finding the pieces of the Hesperpuss, but as I said, yes, I've been to Hotzeplotz.
Hotzeplotz?  No, actually, I've only heard about it as a ... probably mythical place at the ends of the earth.
Great!  The sooner you can get the ship repaired, the better!
Good!  I'm off to look for more stuff!
I have more stuff, too!

chatpoints.chat_text: Did you find anything else?

replies.reply_text: No, not yet. I wanted to get this to you right away so you could start work on fixing the Hesperpuss. Seamus suggested I check Quiet Isle, Crazy Eddie's Isle, Neverending Isles, and the west shoreline of Hotzeplotz.
Yup!

chatpoints.chat_text: What have you found?

replies.reply_text: I think this might be the mainsail!  Here you are!
More sails!  I think this one is a topgallant!  Here's the lot.
This is the rudder and keel, isn't it?
Look!  I found the aft part of the ship!
Nothing, I was just kidding.  I'll keep on looking.  Or do you have everything?
But wait!  There's more!
Honestly, that's all I could find.  Do you have everything now?
Great!  Do you have everything now?
I have more stuff!
Do you have all the parts now?
I found something else, too!
Best of luck getting it back together!
Okay!  Anything else missing?
Got more!

chatpoints.chat_text: Right. You talked to Aunt Bailey about the currents. Maybe you should go talk to her again. But remember, she can't know that the Hesperpuss is broken!

replies.reply_text: My lips are sealed on that! See you soon.
That's right! She told me to talk to Seamus about the currents. Thanks for jogging my memory. I'll head over to Seamus now.

chatpoints.chat_text: You were going to talk to Seamus about the currents, remember?

replies.reply_text: Yes! I did that! Yes, I did! I might have to ask him to refresh my memory, but no fear! I am on it. Keep your fingers crossed, Boy!

chatpoints.chat_text: Just that Seamus told you about the currents. Can you go talk to him again?

replies.reply_text: Great idea! Thanks for reminding me.
Wait! Now I remember. I needed to rake through some sand on the shorelines of Half Haven and Crazy Eddie's place.
Memory surge! I remember all of that! And guess what? I've got the Rudder section right here!

Drat! I need to go through my notes. ( You take a moment and scan through your notes. ) Looks like Hotzeplotz, Quiet and The Neverending Isles are the best bets. I've got my rake handy for all that sand! I'll be back shortly!

npc_list.name: Eric Awlaboard
npc_list.long_description: This is Heather Awlaboard's brother. If the last name didn't give it away, the red hair and freckles surely would! Since this harbor isn't very busy, the Harbormaster usually spends his time fishing the crystal blue waters.

chatpoints.chat_text: Fair sailing and good day to you!

replies.reply_text: Thank you and same to you!
Say, by any chance, would you have any errands I could run for you? I'm trying to earn some money for a sweet little mare that's for sale down the road.
Good day to you, too! I am quite sure I remember agreeing to help you out. Can you help me out by reminding me what it is exactly that I agreed to help you with?
I'm back with your sandwich! Sorry it took so long. Maksum stole it and then I had to pick up groceries from Barrett so Mandy could make you a new one.

chatpoints.chat_text: Actually, I could use your help. My wife usually brings me a sandwich about midday - but that's a good hour or so past and my belly is rumbling something fierce! If you could ask her about it, I'd be much obliged.

replies.reply_text: I don't suspect this will pay much, but it surely can't take much of my time. So sure, I'd be happy to help!
You know, speaking of food - I could use some right now! If I remember, I'll come back and check on you. She might bring you your sandwich any minute now.
I'll be back shortly!

chatpoints.chat_text: (Eric bursts out laughing.) That's a complicated way of saying 'what was I doing for you?' My pappy always told me to keep it simple when it comes to communication. You were going to ask my wife about my sandwich.

replies.reply_text: Oh that's right! I'll head over to your house now.
Where was your house again?
Thanks so much and I hope you enjoy the sandwich!

chatpoints.chat_text: Our cabin is just a hop and a skip past the wagon station.

replies.reply_text: That's right.  I'll be back in a bit.

npc_list.name: Burrtree Booster
npc_list.admin_description: TAKE VISIBLE TO ADMINS OFF WHEN QUEST GOES LIVE
npc_list.long_description: Described by many as 'mentally negligible,' Burrtree Booster is a wealthy young bachelor who really should not be allowed in public without supervision. Dressed impeccably and with an accent redolent of the highest education money can buy--all now forgotten--he is a permanent resident of the Earton Inn.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, hello.

replies.reply_text: Hello there!  I say, you're looking a bit down in the mouth.
Hi.  Sorry to bother you, was just leaving.
Hello again.  I thought I'd better stop by and let you know I've spoken to Marilyn Pugg.
What ho, Burrtree, I've spoken to the loony doctor.
Burrtree! We had a word awhile back. I would so appreciate it if you could shake my memory up a tad so I might recall what errand I was running for you.

chatpoints.chat_text: 'Down in the mouth' describes it to within an ace!  I don't mind telling you that I am in trouble of the very worst sort!

replies.reply_text: Oh dear.  I'm afraid I really must be going.  Good day.  Good luck!
(You take a seat beside him.) Anything you might care to talk about?

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, I might as well tell you.  Under most circumstances, I would lay my troubles before my man Skeeves, but alas Skeeves is away catching prawns at dawn in some far-away vacation spot.

replies.reply_text: I'm a good listener. You can ask just about anyone here. So, please do lay your troubles before me. Since your man Skeeves is not around.
Well, perhaps not.  I've got troubles of my own.  Goodbye and good luck.

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, it's this way, don't you know.  I have become engaged to one Marilyn Pugg.

replies.reply_text: Oh, well, congratulations are in order then!
This is a problem?
Oh, I sense trouble. I think its time to take my leave! Good day, Sir.

chatpoints.chat_text: On first sight, you might say so! The Pugg, I must say, is a creature to behold.  But let her open her mouth and your world collapses in a heap around you! She actually thinks that every time a drop of rain touches a fern, the wee elves come to their senses, or some such thing! The Pugg is an absolute nightmare!

replies.reply_text: Oh dear, one of those, eh?
I hate to say it, but matrimonial entanglements are not really my area of expertise.  Perhaps I'd just better go.  Best of luck, mate!

chatpoints.chat_text: Soupy to the extreme!  She says that sunsets always make her sad, because they remind her of someone sucking on their teeth, or some such nonsense.

replies.reply_text: However did you get entangled with her?
So why not break the engagement?

chatpoints.chat_text:
Here is the mise en scene as you might say. The Pugg was originally engaged to an old school friend of mine, "Fussy" Spink-Bottle. And may I say that they were perfectly matched for he is as much a goop as she is!
Then it happened that the Pugg decided that Fussy should begin wearing a false beard, and Fussy, in the only show of actual bravado he has ever had in his life, refused. So she ditched him!

replies.reply_text: That's all very well, but how did she ever get engaged to you?
I can understand your reticence, certainly.  Can't you break the engagement, then?

chatpoints.chat_text: Let this be a lesson to you that no good deed goes unpunished!  Fussy was too terrified of this blister to speak his love, so he asked me, as it were, to pave the way for him.  So I did.  I told her that there were hearts which ached for love of her.  As she assumed I meant mine and announced the engagement!

replies.reply_text: But surely, you could point out that no such engagement was ever on offer.
Well, my friend, you certainly are in the deepest kimchee!  Hello, I must be going.  Best of luck to you.

chatpoints.chat_text: I hear that such is done in this day and age, but such would not be the action of a preux chevalier, and one endeavors always to be preux.

replies.reply_text: I guess not.  So what are you going to do about it?
Good point. Listening to your woes has made me terribly weary. I shall need to take my leave now, kind Sir. For rest is what I need now, rest assurd!

chatpoints.chat_text:
Well, the obvious thing to do would be to mend the 'rift in the lute' between the Pugg and Fussy. But how?! The blister is absolutely dead-set on Fussy wearing a false beard, and Fussy is absolutely dead-set on letting no such thing touch his face.
If only my man Skeeves were here. He'd sort everything out! Brain the size of a planet, that man has. But I suppose one must honor the man's annual vacation.

replies.reply_text: I guess one must.  Say, I've got an idea.  Presenting myself as a neutral third party, perhaps I can talk to Fussy and Miss Pugg and see what I can do.
I guess you'll just have to wait until Skeeves comes back.  I'm sure the wedding won't take place before then.  Well, good luck to you!  Goodbye!
I'll speak to them at once.  Where can I find them?

chatpoints.chat_text: Fussy is, I believe, currently staying with his aunt, Yancy, in Treeton.  Woman must be a saint.  Him and his tadpole obsession. I don't know where the Pugg might be at the moment, but I suspect Fussy would know.  All I can say is, thank heaven she isn't here, what?

replies.reply_text: Okay, I'll go see Fussy and who knows, maybe I'll accomplish something.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, did you, you poor fish.  Have you recovered yet?

replies.reply_text: She is... soupy in the extreme, yes.  But she still intends to marry you.
We can pass over anything she said, as I'm sure you've heard it before.  But Raleigh Spade was there as well so--

chatpoints.chat_text: There must be some way to scare the blister off! Oh, Skeeves, where art thou now in my hour of need?!

replies.reply_text: Well, Rodney Spade was there too, he seems to think there is.

chatpoints.chat_text: (Pulling off his hat and clutching at it as if it were a lifeboat) SPADE?! What... what did he have to say?

replies.reply_text: Perhaps I'd better not tell you.  No, you don't need to know.  It'll all work itself out.  Goodbye.
Okay, well, I don't mean to be offensive or anything, but... do you know anybody named Rickroll Glossover?

chatpoints.chat_text: You mean Doctor Rickroll Glossover, the famous loony-specialist?  Of course I do!  In fact I'm here in Earton trying to avoid him!  He's staying at the inn in Appleton and I don't dare run into him.  Not after that afternoon with the 23 cats in my bedroom...

replies.reply_text: Okay, well, he wants me to bring Glossover to him so he can bad-mouth you to Madeline.
Wait, what?  23 cats?

chatpoints.chat_text: It's a long story.

replies.reply_text: Fine.  Well, anyway, he wants me to bring Glossover to him so he, Glossover, will badmouth you to Miss Pugg.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, my sainted aunt!  But -- but wait!  This may yet be my salvation.  If you could find Glossover and convince him to convince the Pugg that I am so hopelessly loopy I am liable to lose my entire fount of worldly goods....

replies.reply_text: I'm sure something suitable can be arranged.  I'll go to Appleton and find the loony specialist, and let you know what happens.

chatpoints.chat_text: And is he going to put in his oar in our hour of travail?

replies.reply_text: Alas, no.  He does rather seem to have had enough of you.

chatpoints.chat_text: (Burrtree sits down and puts his head in his hands.) And this, of all the times of all the glad new year, Skeeves is away on his yearly sabbatical, leaving the Young Master in the lurch!

replies.reply_text: Maybe you should go find Skeeves and ask his advice, if the situation is that desperate.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, I couldn't possibly.  I mean, what if the Pugg happens to be walking around the place?  What if Fussy Spink-Bottle is out there waiting for me?!

replies.reply_text: You're hopeless.  I give up.  Good luck and wedded bliss!  Bye!
Fine.  I'LL go find Skeeves.  Where does he go on his vacations?
Great.  How do I recognize him?
I'm on my way.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, you can't miss him.  He has an enormous brain that sticks out at the back.  The man is an absolute genius.  Eats plenty of fish, don't you know. He'll probably be reading a book on philosophy.

replies.reply_text: Okay, then.  See you soon.

chatpoints.chat_text: I say, Chap! You agreed to try and reunite Fussy and The Pugg. You were headed towards Yancy in Treeton. He was visiting there, you know?

replies.reply_text: Oh, just hearing those names has dredged up the very guts of my memory. I shall head there straight away!

npc_list.name: Raleigh Spayde
npc_list.admin_description: In Sir Sleepwell's, conspiring
npc_list.long_description: Spayde might have looked a little crazed outside, but in here, his level of agitation has risen to a whole new level.

chatpoints.chat_text: Listen!  You don't like that blighted hound Booster any more than I do, do you?  Of course you don't!  A priceless pearl like Marilyn can't go manacling herself for life to a shiftless, lazy lay-about like Booster, can she?!  Of course not!  Well, I have a plan!

replies.reply_text: Yes, I can tell, and that's what worries me.  Au revoir.  (You walk to the door, and run out!)
Oh?  You think you have a way to get Marylin to change her mind?
oops

chatpoints.chat_text: I do! And it's a good one! Now listen! No doubt you've heard of the eminent brain specialist, Sir Rickrol Glossover? Of course you have! Everybody has! I don't know why I'm even asking you this! Well, I happen to know that Glossover considers Booster Loopy In The First Degree!

replies.reply_text: That's going a bit far, isn't it?  I mean, the man struck me as, perhaps, mentally negligible, but not overtly crazy.
I can see where this is going.  I need to go home and wash out my eyes.  Goodbye.

chatpoints.chat_text: Mentally negligible?  Why the man's a miserable little, pusillanimous, half-baked nitwit!  If it weren't for that man Skeeves of his, he wouldn't be fit to be seen on the streets off a leash!

replies.reply_text: Speaking of half-baked, I think I must have had a mental lapse to have agreed to pursue the errand. I think I'll got lay down in a dark, quiet space for a bit.
I keep hearing about this person Skeeves, but I've never met him. Anyway, he's away pursuing prawns at the moment.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, is he?  More's the pity. Anyway. About this brain specialist. You need to find him! He's travelling now and he's no doubt in one of the inns. Find him and tell him I'm looking for him, and that I'll pay anything he wants for any dirt he can dish up that I can use to convince Marilyn to break the engagement!

replies.reply_text: Me?  Why me?  Why don't you find him yourself?  Heck, why don't you just ask Marilyn to marry you, if you feel so strongly about her?
Find him yourself, I'm off!  If anybody needs a brain specialist, mate, it's you!  Good day to you.
Look, you don't have to go through all that trouble. Burrtree doesn't even want to marry Marilyn.

chatpoints.chat_text: Doesn't want to marry Marilyn?! ? Well, that makes my point! Who wouldn't want to marry Marilyn? I've known her and admired her since she was so-high! Proves my point!

replies.reply_text: Sounds to me that YOU want Marilyn for yourself. If she is so wonderful why don't YOU pursue her?
This is just getting way, way too crazy for me. I shall leave you to your rantings.

chatpoints.chat_text: (Visibly redding) Because she doesn't want me!

replies.reply_text: Well, I see that distresses you, and I'm sorry for the pain it must cause. On the brightside, she doesn't want Booster either, really.
Yikes! I really didn't see that coming. Okay. So getting back to your plan. Why not have the good doctor to encourage Marilyn to see a possible future with you?
Okay, I'll see what I can do.  How about some funds for travel expenses?
Yeah, okay then, I'm (ahem) on my way.  Toodle-pip!

chatpoints.chat_text: I'll reimburse you when you get back.

replies.reply_text: Whatever.

chatpoints.chat_text: Hello again! Tell me you've come with good news?

replies.reply_text: Good news? Hmm. About what? Please, refresh my memory.
Of course I have good news! The day has been good to me, and that IS good news!
Actually, I'm afraid the news is less than ideal.

chatpoints.chat_text: Blasted! You were to search the inns for the brain specialist.

replies.reply_text: Oh, right. Well, that's going to take some time. So you might want to pratice your patience skills. I've had to do a lot of that lately. I'll be back when I can.

npc_list.name: Marilyn Pugg
npc_list.short_description: A stunner--until she opens her mouth.
npc_list.long_description: This face could launch a thousand ships.  Alas, her words would immediately cause their crew to scuttle the ships and live as hermits.

chatpoints.chat_text:
Oh look! A visitor to our fair shores!
Raleigh Spode: Oh forget about visitors! You are NOT marrying that Booster disaster! I have a plan that will show you once and for all what a fool you’d be making of yourself!
Marilyn Pugg: Don’t you sometimes feel that every time a warthog sneezes, a shower of wee little fairies comes out for their little showers?

replies.reply_text: Uhm... bye.
Uh... yeah, suuuuure, rrriiiight.  Uhm.  Any chance of me speaking to you privately, Miss Pugg?

chatpoints.chat_text:
Oh look!
Raleigh Spode: You can speak to ME! I’ve known her since she was so-high! Tell her that only an idiot of the worst sort could love a nincompoop like Booster! Booster, the snake! Booster, the weasel!
Marilyn Pugg: (with a look of theatrical sadness) No, it is true. Life is so sad, isn't it? I do not love Burtree Booster. But I have promised to be his wife, and to make him happy.

replies.reply_text: Actually, it was Booster I wanted to talk to you about.
(Thinking fast) I quite agree. Nobody in their right mind would marry Booster.

chatpoints.chat_text:
(Bouncing on her toes, pointing in no particular direction) Oh look! The dear, tiny botflies have come out to play with their friends, the horses!
Raleigh Spode: Well, there you are, Marilyn! If you won’t take the word of someone who’s known you since you were so-high and has only your best interests at heart, why not listen to a perfect stranger?! You! Tell her what a low hound that blasted Booster is!

replies.reply_text: I couldn't agree more!  Fussy Spink-Bottle is exactly the man for you.  You may not realise it, but at this very moment, Fussy is pining away for love of you!
I'm sorry, but I changed my mind.  This is really something I desperately need not to be involved in.  Tally-ho and all that. Au revoir.

chatpoints.chat_text:
(Skipping back and forth, pointing in no particular direction) Oh look! The Fairy Princesses’ Scorpion!
Raleigh Spode: Oh yes? Booster is it, eh? Well you can talk to ME then, she is NOT marrying Booster, promises or NO promises!

replies.reply_text: Well, as much as I fear to bring this up, I've been talking to Burtree and it seems he finds himself in something of a quandary.  It seems (ahem) that you may have mistaken his intentions when he--
My mother would be so embarrassed if she saw me here now.  I think I'll just go over there and have a good cry.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, but it's so like Burtree to pretend he's misconstrued things. He wishes to save me from embarrassment. It's his gallant nature.  But a girl always knows.  It is very sad.  He loves me very, very, deeply, and sincerely.  And I will be his wife and make him waffles.

replies.reply_text: Yeah, that's what they all say.
To be honest, I don't think anybody knows anything, ever.
Oh, is that the time?  I need to run to the barn and iron the hay.  Goodnight.

chatpoints.chat_text: (Looking at the ground as if thanking it for feeling so sorry for her) The world is cruel, is it not. Although somewhere in my soul's heart a tiny flame still flickers, my love for Fussy has died. How could one love someone who will not wear a false beard? How can she be the lode-star of his life if he will not perform this simple act for her? No, my love for Fussy has died.

replies.reply_text: It's a sad, sad, sad, sad world.  I give up.  Bye.
(Noticing that Marilyn's attention is in the ozone, and Spayde is trying to get your attention)  Yes, Mr. Spayde?
Right-o.
Not a chance.  Goodbye to you both!

npc_list.name: Raleigh Spayde
npc_list.admin_description: Standing with Marylin on the beach
npc_list.long_description: Raleigh Spayde appears to be just about to, as they say, blow a gasket.  He has the manic look of a honey badger who's just been offered something it [b]does[b] care about.

npc_list.name: Skeeves
npc_list.admin_description: Skeeves at the resort
npc_list.long_description: Impeccably dressed, absolutely correct Skeeves gives one the impression that one might rely on him with absolute assurance for rescue from any situation, no matter how trying.

chatpoints.chat_text: May I help you?

replies.reply_text: I doubt it.  I'm beyond hope.  Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: That is correct.  I take it you have been looking for me?

replies.reply_text: Have I ever! Your "young master" is in serious trouble. (You explain the problem.)
I'll go on ahead and tell him you're on your way.  Thanks!

npc_list.name: Rickrol Glossover
npc_list.long_description: Old and perhaps not so much 'wise' as 'jaded,' Dr. Glossover has seen it all.

chatpoints.chat_text: Yes?  Yes?  What is it?  I'm a busy man.

replies.reply_text: Nothing, nothing.  I'll just leave.  Goodbye.
Dr. Glossover, I was sent by Mr. Spade, apparently he knows you. (You explain the situation.)
I see.  Well, thanks, then, I'll let them know.  Goodbye.
Again?  You've already discussed this with Miss Pugg?

chatpoints.chat_text: Yes, I did.  At the time he was found with a policeman's helmet stuffed inside a silver cow creamer!

replies.reply_text: Okay, I will.  Goodbye.
Okay.  (But perhaps I ought to tell Burrtree about this development...)

npc_list.name: Fussy Spink-Bottle
npc_list.short_description: A man with a face like a halibut.
npc_list.long_description: A hopeless young man constantly surrounded by tadpoles.  When he talks, you hear the voice of an extremely depressed owl.

chatpoints.chat_text:
Yes? What do you want?
Yancy: That's no way to speak to visitors, dear.
Fussy Spink-Bottle: Oh, all right. Hello. Welcome to my aunt's house. What can I do for you?

replies.reply_text: Oh nothing, I'll just leave you to your tadpoles.
Hello!  Burrtree Booster sent me.

chatpoints.chat_text: Burtree Booster?!  Him and his brilliant ideas!  If it hadn't been for Booster... well, nevermind.  Only Skeeves can help me now.

replies.reply_text: I don't know if I'd exactly call him "brilliant."  What did he do?
Well, if you are going to be a fuss-budget, I shall not waste my time on you! Good day!

chatpoints.chat_text: What if there is?  She's engaged to that blighted Booster now.  The flickering flame has died.  Skeeves might possibly, perhaps, think of something with that brilliant brain of his.  But Booster tells me he's on vacation.  So that's that.

replies.reply_text: Well, perhaps I could talk to Ms. Pugg and make her see reason.  Can you tell me where I might find her?
Okay.  I am definitely out of my depth here. I think I'll just leave you with your tadpoles.

chatpoints.chat_text: What did he do?!  I'll tell you what he did!  Him and his ruddy knock-about cross-talk Pat and Mike act!  We were all visiting his aunt Traverse and there was Booster, getting his costume ready for this Pat and Mike act.  He's wearing a green beard!  And Marilyn, seeing this green beard, tells me that she wants ME to wear a false beard.  Not necessarily green.  But she wants ME to wear a false beard all the same!  The thing's preposterous!

replies.reply_text: Well, really, how bad can it be?
I think I'm out of my depth here.  Goodbye.
That strikes me as rather childish.  There is nothing of the old love left then?

chatpoints.chat_text:
How bad can it be? Dreadful! Preposterous! Embarrassing! How idiotic would I look in a false beard? I'd be the laughing stock of Treeton!
Yancy: But you need only wear it for a short time as a love token, dear.
Fussy Spink-Bottle: No! Absolutely not! Not for any amount of time! If I let her get away with this, the next thing she'll want is for me to get rid of my tadpoles!
Yancy: (wrinkling her nose) Well, dear, they are a bit niffy...

replies.reply_text: Well, okay, I'll concede that point. But is there nothing that will reconcile you to Ms. Pugg?
I guess I can see your point. Why would anyone want to look foolish? Better to lose true love, I suppose. I will leave you to your lose. I've got some competions I want to participate in.
Oh, does she know Sir Sleepwell then?
Thanks.  I think I'll pay her a visit.

chatpoints.chat_text: Of course she knows him, he's her father!  He's also a magistrate, so keep clear of him!  And Lady Sleepwell, she was a positive harpy before she took to her bed!  Good luck to you, I say!

replies.reply_text: But... her name's 'Pugg.'  And his is...

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, of course it is, his name is Sir Sleepwell Pugg!  What did you expect?  Now please go away before my head explodes.

replies.reply_text: Going, going...

npc_list.name: Petra Piers
npc_list.long_description: Petra is pouring over ancient maps spread out all over her desk.  Every so often she scribbles some notes in a nearby notebook.

chatpoints.chat_text: I didn't hear you come in (stashes the notebook). How can I help you?

replies.reply_text: Did I interrupt something?
No thanks, just looking around.
Sorry to bother you, but would you know of a woodworker here on Web?
Excuse me, do you know of a jeweler around these parts?
Pardon me, but do you know where I can find a chandler

chatpoints.chat_text: Yes, no... no you didn't.  I'm a...I'm a Marine Biology Grad student. yeah, that's the ticket!

replies.reply_text: All righty then, I'll just leave you to your Marine Biology stuff, see ya!

chatpoints.chat_text: A woodworker?  You must be looking for Woody.  He's on the southwest part of the island.

replies.reply_text: Southwest you say?  Thanks!

chatpoints.chat_text: Shoneah is the only jeweler in these parts.  He lives on the northwest part of the island.

replies.reply_text: Thanks!

chatpoints.chat_text: A chandler?  Oh, that's right, a chandler makes candles.  You need Chandra, head southwest and you'll find her.

replies.reply_text: Chandra it is, you've been a great help!

npc_list.name: Atl Kenu
npc_list.long_description: Atl has his back to the door.  He is busy attaching rope to stones.

chatpoints.chat_text: (Atl turns and looks at you.) You want to rent a boat?

replies.reply_text: No thanks, I'm just looking around.  Sorry I disturbed you.
Pardon the intrusion, but what are you doing?
I'm sorry to bother you, but would you know where I can find a woodworker around here?
Hi, I'm back again.  This time I need to find a metalworker.
No, but thanks for the offer. I'm trying to backtrack a rider that had a crate of noisy parrots. Do you remember someone like that?
What was the advice you gave me concerning the strange rider?

chatpoints.chat_text: I'm making weights for the pearl divers and the sponge divers.

replies.reply_text: Oh, that's interesting, sort of.  Gotta go now, bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: Best woodworker in the jungle is Xamba.  He lives in a tree on the pseudo-island west of Tropicton.

replies.reply_text: Thanks for the information!

chatpoints.chat_text: You on a human scavenger hunt?  Only man who works with metal is Inigo.  He lives west of town, near Xamba.

replies.reply_text: Okay, thanks again!  Oh, By the way, I'm not on a scavenger hunt, I'm delivering invitations to the Flipperton Founders Day Festival.

chatpoints.chat_text: Sure, whatever floats your canoe. (Atl goes back to his weights, clearly unimpressed by your announcement.)

replies.reply_text: Umm...  all right.  Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: Yup. Saw him.

replies.reply_text: Would you happen to know where he was before he came through this dock?

chatpoints.chat_text: He'd need a crate for the birds. Check in town. Someone will point you in the right direction.

replies.reply_text: Oh. Okay. Thanks.

chatpoints.chat_text: Ask around town for someone who makes crates.

replies.reply_text: Ah, that's right. Thanks.

npc_list.name: Murron Skiff
npc_list.long_description: Murron is a giant of a man with flaming red hair, a warm smile and a hearty laugh.

chatpoints.chat_text: Hidey ho stranger! What brings you to my little corner of Paradise?

replies.reply_text: Just looking around, that's all.
Looking for a woodworker, got any suggestions?
I need to find a jeweler for Iona, can you help me?
I'm backtracking the trail of a convoluted tale that has my head spinning. You wouldn't happen to have seen a rider come through here that had a crate of parrots, would you?
Could you tell me what we last discussed about the strange rider?

chatpoints.chat_text: You're in luck! Right here in Carrotton resides the best woodworker in all the isles. Rebecca's her name and woodworking is her game! (Lets out a hearty laugh.)

replies.reply_text: Rebecca?  I think I know where she lives, thanks!

chatpoints.chat_text: Have I got a jeweler for you, he's the royal jeweler for his royal crackpot, I mean his royal highness King Phil I.  Go talk to Grey Slate, he's your man.

replies.reply_text: Grey Slate?  Okay, thanks for the tip!

chatpoints.chat_text: He came through here all right! Those squawkers were noisy as all get-out. Said he was on his way to sell 'em to someone who could take proper care of them. He rushed into town and came back with a load of carrots. Then he headed back out.

replies.reply_text: Well that explains the carrots. The crate of parrots is the clue I need to backtrack. And thank you for the hummingbirds. They really are amazing.

chatpoints.chat_text: Happy to. You said that the crate of parrots was the clue you needed to backtrack.

replies.reply_text: Ah yes. Thanks so much.

npc_list.name: Maj. Manesale
npc_list.long_description: Maj is repairing a sail when you walk in. He looks up, smiles, and waves you into his office.

chatpoints.chat_text: Come on in and warm yourself by the stove.  I don't get many visitors. How can I help you?

replies.reply_text: Whatcha doing?
I don't want anything, thanks.  Just exploring.
Do you know where I can find a couple of woodworkers around here?
By any chance, did a rider carrying a purple chest come through this dock?
Can you remind me again of which way the rider wearing the purple vest had come from?

chatpoints.chat_text: This?  I'm repairing a sail for my friend's sailboat.  There aren't many of us left who know the old ways of the sea.

replies.reply_text: Couldn't your friend just buy a new sail? (Maj glares at you.) Oh, right, maritime traditions and all that. Sorry!
Very neat!  Thanks for sharing.

chatpoints.chat_text: Woodworkers you say?  Let me think... Right!  There are three ladies who live northwest of here.  Hanska and Cristel are toy makers, and Kelda makes nesting dolls and dala horses.  Why do you ask?

replies.reply_text: Well, if you must know, I have invitations for them to attend the Flipperton Founders Day Festival.  Now thank you for the information, I must get going.  Bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: He wasn't carrying a purple chest, but he was wearing a purple vest. It had beautiful gold embroidery designs on it. He said something about his lost monkey.

replies.reply_text: That's good enough for me. Can you tell me which way he had come from?

chatpoints.chat_text: If memory serves, he came in on one of the boats serving the more southern island.

replies.reply_text: Thanks so much!

npc_list.name: Chevis Charter
npc_list.long_description: Chevis looks up from the net he is repairing and waves you into his office.

chatpoints.chat_text: Bon jour, bon jour!  Can I help you?

replies.reply_text: Bon jour.  I was just looking around.
Good day, I was just wondering what you are doing.
I'm hoping that you can.  I need to find a Native artist in Santon and a maker of exquisite boxes on the Sand Isles. You wouldn't happen to know who I need, do you?

chatpoints.chat_text: What does it look like I'm doing?  I'm repairing the nets of some of the local fishermen.

replies.reply_text: (Watching him a while longer.) I don't suppose you need any help with that, do you?

chatpoints.chat_text: No, mon ami, I can do this in my sleep.

replies.reply_text: All right then, if you ever need anything let me know. Bye! (Chevis waves goodbye.)

chatpoints.chat_text: But of course I know the Native Artist. Everyone on this island knows Yepa. She's the finest Native artist around here.

replies.reply_text: Okay, good, Yepa is the person I need to see in Santon...what about the person on the Sand Isles?

chatpoints.chat_text: Alas I am not familiar with the residents of the Sand Isles.  You should ask Koleyna.  She's the Harbor Mistress for the Desert Isle docks.

replies.reply_text: Thanks for the help, I'll go ask Koleyna.  Bye!

npc_list.name: Koleyna Coracle
npc_list.long_description: Koleyna is sitting on the dock attaching cords to large rings. Whatever could she be making?

chatpoints.chat_text: Welcome traveler, what brings you to my dock today?

replies.reply_text: Excuse me, but what are you doing?
I'm exploring, gotta keep moving.  Good bye!
Chevis suggested I should talk to you.

chatpoints.chat_text: I'm making a conical crab trap for one of the fishermen.

replies.reply_text: How are you supposed to catch any crabs with some rings and some string?

chatpoints.chat_text: Once I've attached all the cord. I'll knot them together making a sort of net around the rings.  This way the crabs can go inside the trap to eat the bait, but they can't get out again.

replies.reply_text: Wow, that's neat!  It's been swell chatting with you, bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: He did, did he?  Why did he think I could help you?

replies.reply_text: I'm looking for someone who lives on the Sand Isles who makes decorative boxes.  Chevis said you would know the residents of the Sand Isles better than he.

chatpoints.chat_text: So he finally acknowledged that I might know something that he doesn't.  Be that as it may, he's right, I do know all the residents on the Sand Isles.

replies.reply_text: Good, now can you help me?

chatpoints.chat_text: But of course, as Chevis would say.  I'm pretty sure you are looking for Palila.  She makes the most exquisite wooden jewelry boxes.  You can find her just north of the Sandy General Store.

replies.reply_text: Just north of Sandy General Store.... Thanks for your help.  Bye!

npc_list.name: Kelsea Kayak
npc_list.long_description: Kelsea is busy painting a cylindrical wooden object on a stick.  His walls are decorated with many more of these fully painted.

chatpoints.chat_text: Ahoy!  What wind blew you my way?

replies.reply_text: What are you painting?
A cold one!  Now if you'll excuse me, I'm heading somewhere warm.
Ahoy!  I was sent up here to find two artisans who live in these parts. Do you think you could help me?
A brisk and chilly one! I'm wondering if a rider came through with a purple chest?

chatpoints.chat_text: These? (Gestures around the office walls.) These are lobster floats. Each lobster fisherman has his own colors and patterns on the floats to identify their traps. I paint them to pass the time.

replies.reply_text: And every lobster fishereman uses a different combination? (Kelsea nods) That's cool!

chatpoints.chat_text: I suppose I could, who are you looking for?

replies.reply_text: I need to find a rug maker and a needle crafter...any ideas?

chatpoints.chat_text: Lets see, the rug maker, that would be Miss Linnea.  You'll find her in town.  Now the needler crafter, I bet you are looking for Miss Katinka.  You'll find her on the Western most part of the island..

replies.reply_text: Okay, that's Linnea in town and Katinka out West.  Thanks for the help!

chatpoints.chat_text: A purple chest? Wouldn't that be something to see? Wish I'd seen one - it would be a nice dash of color. Most days all I see is snow, snow and more snow. Sorry I can't help you.

replies.reply_text: Okay. Thanks anyways.

npc_list.name: Catriona Catamaran
npc_list.long_description: Catriona is standing by an extremely large fish tank, feeding the inhabitants. You look again and realize the tank is full of catfish!

chatpoints.chat_text: Just half a mo' (She finishes feeding her fish.) Now, how can I help you?

replies.reply_text: No thanks. I'm just looking around.
Iona sent me to Whiskerton to find a jeweler. Do you know who I should see?
Actually, no help needed. I am here with a Pony Express delivery for you.
Did a rider happen to come through the dock with a crate of birds?
It would be ever so helpful if you could remind me what you know of the stranger that rode through here. I got distracted and have forgotten what you told me. No disrespect meant.

chatpoints.chat_text: A jeweler?  I suppose you are looking for Jade Maki.  You'll find her at the Jewelry Workshop in town.

replies.reply_text: The jewelry workshop?  Of course!  Thanks for the suggestion.
Thank you and have an awesome week.

chatpoints.chat_text: Can you believe it? No one in their right mind would bring birds to Cat Isle. They'd have to be crazier than a barrel full of monkeys. I told him so but he said there wasn't a direct route to where he needed to be. Heck of a storyteller too. Something about indigenous people and thieving flowers. Talk about tall tales! Oh, and he was munching on carrots. Hopped off one boat and only stayed here long enough to catch another. Funny thing, he was sneezing up a storm by the time he left here.

replies.reply_text: Well aren't they adorable! Thanks so much! I think I know just where to head next.

chatpoints.chat_text: No disrespect taken! Happens to me all the time. He said there wasn't a direct route to where he needed to be. I think he was a tad touched in the head. He said something about indigenous people and thieving flowers. Thieving flowers! What an imagination! Forgot to mention the carrots. The way he was munching on them I'm guessing he was pretty hungry.

replies.reply_text: Thank you. I know just where to head next.

chatpoints.chat_text: Avast ye scurvy landlubber!  Be ye pickin' up or droppin' off?

replies.reply_text: Not again!  Didn't we just have this conversation?
Deja vu, what a concept!  I think I just want to look around.
Neither now, I'm finished.  Can I go back to the other side?
Okay, I guess I'm dropping off.  Where can I find Mapmaker Mike?

chatpoints.chat_text: If ya turned up on me doorstep, ya just left me brother Pat.  So I repeat, pickin' up or droppin' off?

replies.reply_text: Your brother told me to ask you about buying a treasure map.  How do I do that?
Neither, just looking.

chatpoints.chat_text: Go ask our siblin' Mapmaker Mike in the tent over yonder.

replies.reply_text: I guess I will.  Thanks...I think.
Thank you!

chatpoints.chat_text: Be ye finished pickin' up or droppin' off?

replies.reply_text: Yes, thank you.  Can you send me back to the other side now?

chatpoints.chat_text: Mike be in that tent over yonder.

replies.reply_text: That tent by the fire? (Pegleg Pete nods) Okay, thanks!

chatpoints.chat_text: Arrr, be ye pickin' up or droppin' off?

replies.reply_text: Picking up or dropping off what, exactly?
Are you talking about the treasures that Ocean Born Mary was talking about?
Too many questions!  I'm outta here!
I guess I'm dropping off. I'm supposed to see Mapmaker Mike.

chatpoints.chat_text: Treasure!  Are ye pickin' up or droppin' off treasure?

replies.reply_text: Right, treasure.  How does this picking up and dropping off treasure work around here?
Neither I guess right now nice to meet you, Pegleg Pat.  Bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: Of course I be talkin' about treasure, ye scurvy landlubber.  Why else would I be here?

replies.reply_text: You like seashells?  But seriously, how does this picking up and dropping off of treasure work?
I seriously have no idea why you are here.  I'm just going to keep looking around, see ya!

chatpoints.chat_text: Ya have ta git to the other side ta me twin.  There are 3 ways to do that.  Ya got a treasure map from a pirate, ye got a treasure ya want to bury, or ya wants to buy a map and take yer chances.

replies.reply_text: I don't have a treasure to bury and I don't have a map.....yet. Do you know how I buy a map?
I don't have either a map or a treasure, and I don't feel like chancing anything today.  I guess I'll come back some other time.
But...what do I do next?? (You hear Pegleg Pat holler "Ask me twin!!!")

chatpoints.chat_text: Arrr, be ye pickin' up or droppin' off?

replies.reply_text: Neither.  I actually didn't mean to talk to you.  Off I go!  Bye.
Ahoy Pat! Requesting permission to go to your brother again.
Thanks!

npc_list.name: Mehitabel
npc_list.long_description: Mehitabel is bustling around her cabin.

chatpoints.chat_text: Bon jour!  Is there something I can do for you?

replies.reply_text: Yes, actually, I was considering purchasing a ranch around here.  Do you take care of this entire island?
No thanks, I'm just looking around.  Nice island, though.
Pardon me, madam, but what was I doing for you again?
Great news, Mehitabel! I found Archy!

chatpoints.chat_text: Alas, mon mari has gone to gather supplies for the ranches and he has't come back yet.

replies.reply_text: That's too bad I would have liked to have met him.  Sorry, but I have to go on about my business. Au revoir!
You make it sound like he's been gone a long time.  How long has he been gone?

chatpoints.chat_text: Oui.  My husband and I are the caretakers here.

replies.reply_text: Your husband?  It looks like you are all alone here.
I'm sorry I missed him, perhaps he'll be back next time I'm around.  Good bye!
I'm sorry, but I don't see anybody here but you and I.

chatpoints.chat_text: My Archy has been gone for several months now.

replies.reply_text: Several months!?!  How many supplies could you possibly need?
It sounds like you need to notify the authorities, file a missing person report or something. Good luck with that.

chatpoints.chat_text: I am saddened to admit that my Archy is something of a procrastinator.  He always says: "Procrastination is the art of keeping up with yesterday."

replies.reply_text: Several months is a little more than procrastination. Good luck finding him!
So, you're saying that Archy brings procrastination to an art form.  Is there anything I can do to help you find him?  I'm good at finding people.

chatpoints.chat_text: You could do that for moi?  That is so wonderful of you to offer.

replies.reply_text: Like I said, I'm pretty good at finding people and things... Do you have any idea of where I should start my search?

chatpoints.chat_text: He was going on the annual supply trip. I have a copy of the list of all of the people he had to see.  Would that be of help?

replies.reply_text: That would be a great help.  May I have the copy, please?
This is sure a long list.  I might as well begin at the top and see where it goes from there. I’m sure I'll find him in no time!

chatpoints.chat_text: Mon ami, you said you would help me find my Archy.  You have his list, remember?

replies.reply_text: Oh, the list, that's your list! I'll get right back on the hunt, promise.

chatpoints.chat_text: You have found mon mari? My Archy?  Is he safe and unharmed? Is he coming home?

replies.reply_text: Yes he's fine and he's on his way home.  He said that he will be here in time for your anniversary.
(You watch Mehitabel dance through their home singing "There's a dance in the old dame yet, toujours gai, toujours gai!". You quietly close the door on your way out.)

chatpoints.chat_text: Mon mari, Archy is across the road tending to our garden.  You can drop by, he welcomes distractions.

replies.reply_text: I just might do that, have a nice day!

npc_list.name: Archy
npc_list.admin_description: You found Archy!  NO NEW QUESTS
npc_list.short_description: Standing next to a fully loaded supply wagon
npc_list.long_description: Archy is staring at a newly repaired wagon wheel, maybe he needs help?

chatpoints.chat_text: Hello, fellow traveller!  Could you help an old soul fix his wagon?

replies.reply_text: By any chance are you Archy, Mehitabel's husband?
I could do that, by the way, might you be Archy, Mehitabel's husband?

chatpoints.chat_text: Yes indeedy, the one and only.  I'm guessing that you have already met my beautiful Mehitabel?

replies.reply_text: She's worried sick about you and she asked me to find you.  I've been all over these islands looking for you!
Yes I have, and the poor dear is worried sick about you.  She asked me to find you.

chatpoints.chat_text: And you've done an excellent job. See, you found me!

replies.reply_text: Thanks.  I saw from your list that you've picked up everything on it. Why are you still here?
Okay, I found you, now what's wrong with your wagon?

chatpoints.chat_text: When I got back to my wagon from my visit with Faustus, I found one of my wagon wheels had cracked.

replies.reply_text: How were you going to get home with a broken wagon wheel?
How can I help you with the broken wheel?
There you go, your wagon is fixed.  Is there anything else I can help with?

chatpoints.chat_text: Yes, could you go on ahead and let Mehitabel know I’m on my way home.  Tell her I’ll be there in time for our anniversary.

replies.reply_text: I would be my pleasure.  Good bye and happy trails!

npc_list.name: Archy
npc_list.admin_description: Second Archy at home
npc_list.long_description: Archy is leaning on his rake, daydreaming when you come up to him.

chatpoints.chat_text: Well hello there!  I didn't see you come in. It's nice to see you again.

replies.reply_text: Hi Archy! Is this how you spend your time here?
Didn't mean to startle you. I was just looking around the island.  See ya!

chatpoints.chat_text: Yes. As you know, we are the caretakers here on Horn and gardening helps me relax.  Can I help you with anything?

replies.reply_text: I was just exploring the island.  I don't suppose you need any odd jobs or errands done?
Nope, I'm just passing through.  Nice to see you again!

chatpoints.chat_text: Not right now, thank you. Feel free to check back...  You never know.

replies.reply_text: Okay, I guess I'll see you again some time, bye for now!

npc_list.name: His Majesty King Coel
npc_list.long_description: A white headed, crown adorned, red cloak wearing King who loves to see his daughter smile.

npc_list.name: Ocean Born Mary
npc_list.long_description: Mary has an interesting name, maybe she'll tell you about it.

chatpoints.chat_text: Avast matey! Me name's Ocean Born Mary. Be ye lookin' fer some vacation adventure?

replies.reply_text: That depends. What is this place and what sort of adventure do you have in mind?
Not right now, thanks. I just want to look around.
Ahoy Mary! How is the resort business doing?
I'm sorry Mary, what was I doing for you again?
I'm back with good news!  I found Jackie and he's back at the tent straightening up.
Not really, I was sent here by No-Navel Nancy to see one of your kids. Mapmaker Mike?
Ahoy Mary! You know I am!
G'day Mary, I got a little side tracked, what am I doing for you again?

chatpoints.chat_text: Yer at the one ‘n’ only Treasure Isle Pirate Resort!  A place where the tired buccaneer can rest, or the avarice swashbuckler can search fer treasure, and the clandestine pirate can safely stash his treasure.

replies.reply_text: Wow, you really offer all kinds of things for the pirate community.  Is this resort open to the public?
That's a pretty big agenda. How does that treasure finding or saving thing work?

chatpoints.chat_text: This be a haven fer pirates, former pirates 'n' their kin.  But, if ye have been adventurous enough to get to our shores, ye be welcome too.

replies.reply_text: Well, I guess that's me, a real adventurous soul!  Mind if I look around a bit?
How does that treasure finding or saving thing work?

chatpoints.chat_text: Me children, Mapmaker Mike 'n' the twins, Pegleg Pat 'n' Pegleg Pete keep watch on the treasure part of Treasure Isle.  Go palaver with Pegleg Pat south of here by the barricade fer the rules.

replies.reply_text: Your children, eh?  I think I'll head on over to Pegleg Pat for that palaver, bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: Shiver me timbers, welcome back, matey!  Me business is doing well.  But I could use yer help if ye have a wee bit of time.

replies.reply_text: I'm sorry, Mary, but I just stopped by to say hi.  I've got to get going, maybe next time, okay?
I would be delighted to help you, Mary. What can I do for you?

chatpoints.chat_text: I hired me a cabin boy to look after the beach supplies, Jackie Sparrow be his name.  I surveyed the tent this morn 'n' everythin' were tossed about like a hurricane had hit, and twern't no sign of that young scalliwag!

replies.reply_text: What did you do?
Where did he go?

chatpoints.chat_text: I looked around and didn't find hide nor hair of that scamp...

replies.reply_text: How can I help?
It would be my pleasure. (You bow gracefully.) I'm going to look around for clues. I'll be back before you know it!

chatpoints.chat_text: Arrr, I asked ya to find that scamp, Jackie Sparrow.

replies.reply_text: Right. I'm on it, be right back!
Where was he last?
Thanks, I'll see you again soon!
Pegleg Pat, SouthWest of here...got it!  Thanks.

chatpoints.chat_text: The beach equipment tent.

replies.reply_text: Oh, okay.  I'll go take a look.

chatpoints.chat_text: Davey Jones be praised, I've been hopin' ta see ya sooner than later!  I got meself in a most difficult situation that could scuttle me entire little paradise.

replies.reply_text: No offense Mary, but I would like to know what’s going on before I commit to anything!
Madam, I am at your service, as always. (With a sweeping bow) What do you need?

chatpoints.chat_text: Ah dearie, ‘tis a sticky mess I be in, a sticky mess indeed. I can’t even let me own kith and kin know about this.

replies.reply_text: Oh no, Mary, what could be so bad?
Well, if you can't tell your own kids, maybe I'm not the one to tell either, sorry!!

chatpoints.chat_text: Here goes, all the pirates here abouts know I fancy a Gin Rummy game now and then, and I pride meself in the fact I never lose, that is ‘til last month. I played in a shady game and I lost big!

replies.reply_text: That's really too bad, Mary, but I don't have a lot of time right now.  I'm sure you'll work out something.  Bye!
Oh my!  Tell me what I can do to help you!

chatpoints.chat_text: I was hornswoggled by a guest I met here at the Tavern.  I should have seen it t’were a shady game, the sea dog I was playing with was playing too bad ta be fer real.

replies.reply_text: Hornswoggled?  What happened?
Didn’t anyone ever tell you that playing cards was bad?  You should  be ashamed!  I’m out of here!

chatpoints.chat_text: First, I was winning like, as usual.  After a while me luck turned and this sea dog starts ta win every hand.  Finally, he talked me into one last hand with the deed to me resort on the line.

replies.reply_text: Oh no!! What happened then?
Serves you right, you should have quit while you were ahead!

chatpoints.chat_text: I lost, after he left with me deed, I discovered he were cheatin’ the entire time.   I finds him and I says to him, I says, “You cheatin’ blackguard, give me my deed back!” And he laughs at me, the blighter laughs at me!

replies.reply_text: I’m out, I don’t deal with poor winners or losers!
You have me on pins and needles…what did you do?
I’m in, Mary, I’ll help you find the treasure and save your resort!  Where do I start?

chatpoints.chat_text: Ah, matey, I’m not sure if anybody knows where it is, I only knows legend has it the secret of the treasure’s been passed down Mum t’ daughter. Me best suggestion is ye go talk t’ the other piratesses ta see if any of them wenches know anything.

replies.reply_text: Ok, I’ll keep you posted!

chatpoints.chat_text: By Neptune’s trident, I asked ya to help me find the Treasure of the Lioness of Brittany!

replies.reply_text: That’s right, now I remember.  I’m back on the hunt, see you soon!

npc_list.name: Oringo
npc_list.admin_description: New quests at CP20
npc_list.short_description: A strange man who wants to be alone.

chatpoints.chat_text: Hold it you, what are you doing in my home?

replies.reply_text: I'm sorry, I didn't mean to upset you.  I was exploring and I came upon your tree.
You mean somebody actually lives in here?  Who knew?
Sorry, I'll just show myself out. No harm, no foul!  Good day, sir.
(Knocking on the tree.) What was I doing for you again?
I'm looking for your bell. I found the bracket.  It's a start!
Remember, I'm looking for your bell, and I sort of found it...
I'm sorry, what was I doing for you again?
Hi!  I'm back with your bell.

chatpoints.chat_text: Do you always just walk into strange homes without being invited?
