replies.reply_text: As I said, I'm sorry, but it's not like you have a door knocker or a doorbell.
Not as a rule, and I'm sorry I walked into this one.  Good bye!
Hmmm. Now that I think about it, I guess I do.

chatpoints.chat_text: Don't you think I know I don't have a knocker or a bell?  I used to have a bell, but I left it at my old house.

replies.reply_text: Really?  Where is your old house?  I could go back and get your bell if you would like.
Well then, I guess you just need to get yourself a replacement.  Buh-bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: You could?  Why would you want to do that?

replies.reply_text: To tell you the truth, I have no idea why I would do that, see you around!
Because, that's what I do, I go around doing things for people.  Now, as I said, where is your old house?

chatpoints.chat_text: I used to live up on the northern most tip of this island.  I had a cozy shack on the beach.  I liked to collect whatever treasures the sea washed up on my beach.

replies.reply_text: That tells me where you used to live, but how did you end up here?
Okay, you were up on the beach, now tell me, what does the bell look like and where did you have it?

chatpoints.chat_text: I reveled in my solitude, but then those noisy townsfolks settled on my island with their houses and civic centers and the like. It was too busy, too crowded, so I high tailed it here to the jungle to get my peace and quiet back.

replies.reply_text: I guess that makes sense, now getting back to the task at hand, the bell….tell me about it.
Excuse me, the bell??

chatpoints.chat_text: Yes, yes, my bell.  One day while I was searching the beaches for any interesting tidbit, I came across a ship’s bell that must have come from one of the ships that have sunk around the island.  It was a beautiful brass bell with a glorious tone.  I found a bracket and hung it outside my hut where it glistened in the sun.

replies.reply_text: Why didn’t you take it with you when you moved?
So, why isn’t it hanging on this tree?

chatpoints.chat_text: Those gosh darned towns people started arriving slowly, not too bad at first. But more and more people and more and more noise, I high tailed it into the jungle one moonlit night and have been here ever since.  Unfortunately, I left so quickly, I forgot my bell.

replies.reply_text: So all I have to do is go to your hut and bring back your bell?  Piece of cake!
I sense a catch coming….

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, it might not be that simple any more.  We’ve had a few real bad tropical storms since I moved.  I haven’t heard the bell in the wind in a while, it might not be hanging on my hut anymore.

replies.reply_text: I knew this was going to be harder than it sounded.  Good luck finding your bell, but I’m outta here!
That’s okay, I’m always up for a challenge, any suggestions on how to find it?
I’ll do my best.

chatpoints.chat_text: You're looking for my bell, remember?

replies.reply_text: Right, just a slip of the old memory....find the bell.
So you think I should use a rake in the sand?  Sounds like a plan.

chatpoints.chat_text: What do you mean by sort of?

replies.reply_text: (You hold out the battered bell and the clapper.) I found the parts. Can you fix it?

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, my bell, my beautiful shiny bell!  I don't know anyone who could possibly fix this.

replies.reply_text: I might be able to find somebody. Would you like me to get this fixed for you?
I've traveled around a lot. I think I can find someone for you.
I might know of someone, I'll be back as soon as I can.

chatpoints.chat_text: You're looking for someone who can repair my bell.  Have you found anybody yet?

replies.reply_text: That's right, fix the bell... Not yet. I'm still looking.  See you later!
Thanks a lot for the tidbits!  I'll stop by some time for a visit.

chatpoints.chat_text: No, not yet.  Do you have time to help me now?

replies.reply_text: Yes, as a matter of fact, I do have some time now.  Any ideas as to who can fix it?
Sorry, I'm still too busy, maybe next time I'm in the neighborhood!

chatpoints.chat_text: (You ring the shiney brass bell hanging on the tree.) Why hello friend, what brings you back to me?

replies.reply_text: I just came by to see how you are.
Just stopped by to see if you needed anything. I'm working on the island's shopping list.

chatpoints.chat_text: Everything is fine, thanks for asking. And thanks again for my bell!

replies.reply_text: It was my pleasure.  Take care now, bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: Ahoy matey!  What brings ye to me humble abode?

replies.reply_text: I'm looking for Mapmaker Mike. Do you know where I can find him?
Just looking, thanks!
Ahoy Mike! I'd like to buy another map. (Hand over $10,000.)
I'm back for another map! (Hand over $10,000.)
I'm ready to try my luck again. (Hand over $10,000.)
Ahoy Mike!
Okay, I'm back and the treasure is nicely buried right where you told me.

chatpoints.chat_text: Ya found 'im. Me given name is Michaela, but everyone calls me Mike.  Now, how can I be of service to ya?

replies.reply_text: Your brother told me to ask you about buying a treasure map.  How do I do that?
I really don't need anything right now, I'm just looking around the island.  Thanks for offering though.
No-Navel Nancy sent me.
The Earton Librarian said a map maker could help me out with this letter.

chatpoints.chat_text: On occasion I’ve been known ta bury a treasure or two around these parts.  Then I makes me a map and sells it to the likes of ya.  Then ya can pretend yer a pirate and find it and dig it up!

replies.reply_text: That sounds like fun.  How much are your maps?
And if I want you to make a map after I bury my own treasure can you do that?

chatpoints.chat_text: They be $10,000 each, but I'll only sell ya one at a time.

replies.reply_text: I guess that sounds like a fair price.  Are your treasures guaranteed?
Fair enough. What do you charge to make me a map of my own buried treasure?

chatpoints.chat_text: Aaarrr, ye be a right smart businessman.  I only charge $5,000 to make ya a map of yer own booty.  After all, ya did all the work!

replies.reply_text: I'll keep that in mind for future reference, thanks.

chatpoints.chat_text: Now matey, have ya lost yer scurvy little mind?  I'm a pirate!  Ya pays yer money 'n' ya takes yer chances.  Nothin' is guaranteed.

replies.reply_text: I should have seen that one coming!
Well, I'm feeling lucky. Can I buy a map?
Okay, I will, thanks!
I will, thanks!
I know, drop the map when I'm done,
I will, thank you!

chatpoints.chat_text: And what does she want o' me?

replies.reply_text: No-Navel Nancy sent me to you to bury her treasure.

chatpoints.chat_text: What brings ye back to ol' Mike today?

replies.reply_text: No-Navel Nancy sent me to you to bury her treasure.

chatpoints.chat_text: All righty then, matey!  There's a nice spot in the middle of those four barrels over yonder.  Go bury it and come back fer yer map.

replies.reply_text: All right. I'm off to the barrels!
Okay, thanks!

chatpoints.chat_text: (He looks over the letter and hands it back to you.) That ain't be the kinda map me name be referrin' to. Now, how can I be of service to ya? Other than that letter ye be carryin' around.

replies.reply_text: Well darn. I guess you can't be. Thanks anyway.

npc_list.name: Skeeves
npc_list.admin_description: Skeeves in Earton with Burrtree
npc_list.long_description: Impeccably dressed, absolutely correct Skeeves gives one the impression that one might rely on him with absolute assurance for rescue from any situation, no matter how trying.

npc_list.name: Illiana
npc_list.long_description: Illiana obviously does a lot of outdoor activity as she is well tanned with callused hands.

chatpoints.chat_text: (Wipes sweat from her brow.) Well, hello! How are you doing this fine day?

replies.reply_text: I'm amazing!  I absolutely love the heat.  It's great down here.
I'm doing all right.  This heat is way too much for me though.  I think I'm going to leave before I melt.  Bye.
Hot.  That's how I'm doing.  Geesh.  I don't know how you survive down here.
I'm doing all right.  I know I was doing something for you, but I can't seem to remember right now.
I'm doing great, and I bet you will be too!  I'm back with your tools.
Would you be able to tell me where I might find a woman by the name of Itzel?

chatpoints.chat_text: I can't disagree with you there!  I love the heat.  That's why I moved down here.

replies.reply_text: Really?  Neat!  Where did you live before?
Fun!  Well, I was just wandering around and saw this hut, so I wanted to check if there was anything you needed or wanted me to do for you?

chatpoints.chat_text: I used to live on the main isle.  It was nice and green, but got too cold for me.  I moved down here as soon as I learned about it.

replies.reply_text: Fun!  Well, I was just wandering around and saw this hut, so I wanted to check if there was anything you needed or wanted me to do for you?
That must have been quite a move.  Well, I hope you have a good day and keep cool!  Bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, I absolutely love the heat.  That's why I moved here.

replies.reply_text: Well, I guess it was a good move for you.  It's too much sun for me.  I'm outta here.  Good luck!
Really?  Neat!  Where did you live before?
Fun!  Well, I was just wandering around and saw this hut, so I wanted to check if there was anything you needed or wanted me to do for you?

chatpoints.chat_text: You know, now that you mention it, I did need to run to Hotton to pick up some new tools.  Mostly a rake.  The one I have just doesn't do what I need.

replies.reply_text: I'm really not going that way right now.  Maybe another time.
I would love to head there for you.  What do you need exactly?
Sounds good.  I'll be back soon.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh!  Well, that's all right.  You were bringing a note I gave you to the general store in Hotton to get me some new tools.

replies.reply_text: Okay.  I'll get on that.  Bye!
Thanks.  Bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: The last time I saw her, she was on the beach. Seems like it was west of here. But she wanders, so you just never know.

replies.reply_text: Thanks so much!

npc_list.name: Jebidiah Jibb
npc_list.short_description: Harbor Master on Yellow Brick Isle
npc_list.long_description: This Harbor Master is foot-loose and fancy-free. Barefoot and wearing raggy clothes, Jebidiah obviously dresses for comfort, and not for fashion!

chatpoints.chat_text: Ahoy matey!  How can I be of service ta ye?

replies.reply_text: Just looking around, thanks.
This sure is a really hot island, are you all right out here?
I'm sorry to tell you, but I forgot what you asked me to do.
I'm back with your supplies.
I was sort of curious if you had that Orangeade made up that I would be able to try?
I think there was something I had agreed to do for you. Can you please remind me what it was,? I can't seem to remember what it was.
Can you tell me where I might find a woman named Itzel?

chatpoints.chat_text: Aye. It be a frightfully hot place, I'll give ye that.  I could use a little help if ye have some time.

replies.reply_text: I have a little time on my hands. What do you need help with?
I'm sorry, can't help right now.  Maybe I'll be able to give you a hand next time I come by.  Bye for now!
I don't have anything else on my to-do-list. Tell me what you need help with and I'll see if it sounds interesting.

chatpoints.chat_text: That's right neighborly of ye.  With all this heat, I've been havin' a hankerin' fer some nice cold Orangeade.

replies.reply_text: Orangeade?  That's all that you need?  Sure, where can I get it?
Wait a minute, it this was simple, you'd get it yourself.  What's the catch?

chatpoints.chat_text: Matey, it's a little complicated. I only drink me own Orangeade.  I would like you to pick up the ingredients.  I make the best Orangeade this side of the known world!

replies.reply_text: So sorry, matey, but that sounds too complicated for me right now!  Maybe some other time, see ya!
I think I can find some time to help you if I can have a glass of the best Orangeade in the known world!
At least everybody is in Hotton.  I'll be back as soon as I can!

chatpoints.chat_text: No worries, mate.  I asked you to go to see Charla Mae, Ethel Barryjam, and Quinn in Hotton for my Orangeade supplies.

replies.reply_text: Oh, the Orangeade. I completely forgot!  I'll be right back with the supplies.

chatpoints.chat_text: I can't wait, let's have them!

replies.reply_text: Here are the oranges.
Here's the sugar.
Here's the barrel of water.
That's should be everything.
I'm probably missing something.  I'll be back.
Don't worry, there's more!
That should be everything.
I've got more.
That should be everything.
He definitely does.  I've got more.
That should be everything.
He is kind of cute, thanks!
That was delicious!  Thanks so much.
I've had better.  Thanks though.

replies.reply_text: But wait! I've got more!

replies.reply_text: But wait! I've got more!
That should be everything.

replies.reply_text: But wait! I've got more!

chatpoints.chat_text: Aye, mate! Anywhere on the beach. She's a bit of a beachcomber, I'd say.

npc_list.name: Nikara
npc_list.short_description: Owner of Nikara's Fish and Rocks
npc_list.long_description: She obviously gets plenty of exercise considering her arms appear to be the size of a tree.  She appears to have a constant smile on her tanned face.

replies.reply_text: Thanks!  I'm just looking around.
Hi!  Thanks!  You buy rocks as well as fish?

chatpoints.chat_text: Thank you. I find great joy in discovering the gifts hidden within the ebony.

replies.reply_text: Don't you mean you enjoy carving things from the ebony?
And it appears that you are masterful at it.
Okay, I am sure you believe that. And I believe I must be leaving now!

chatpoints.chat_text: Not at all. The ebony holds many amazing things within its grains. It is my job to simply release the art the ebony has already created.

replies.reply_text: That's a really interesting way of explaining what you do. I bet you are masterful at confuscation.
What a cool way of looking at that. What else can you tell me about ebony?
I see. And oh look at the time! I see that I have to leave now.

chatpoints.chat_text: Confuscation is mankind's intent to confuse another by means of trickery, or say, something like a maze. And I am not one for making mazes. They confuse me too much! But with this art, it is Mother Nature that is masterful.

replies.reply_text: I have to agree with you. Mystic Forest always confuses me. It is like one big maze. Speaking of a forest, I've got some unfinished business in one. Gotta run!
Well, then you are masterful at helping Mother Nature out. Those figurines are amazing. By the way, do you happen to have any chores I can run for you?
Speaking of mazes, did you know that mazes have been around for hundreds of years?

chatpoints.chat_text: I have many orders to fill and little time to find the wood I use to carve. If you would be willing, I am happy to pay $750 for 15 logs of ebony.

replies.reply_text: Gosh. That just doesn't seem worth it to me. I think I'll go find something else to do. Thanks anyway.
I have that much ebony right now!
I'll be back in a jiffy with some.
Wait, I have more!
Thanks. I might be back with more some day!

chatpoints.chat_text: Sounds like you know something about mazes and puzzles. Care to take a maze challenge?  You give me $1000 and if you get all the questions right, I'll pay you $50,000.

replies.reply_text: Not today. Thanks anyway.
Absolutely! (You hand him $1000.)

chatpoints.chat_text: Ebony wood is so dense, it sinks in water. Its density also makes it difficult to carve. My blades go dull very fast.

replies.reply_text: Yikes! I sure wouldn't want a boat made out of ebony then. Speaking of a boat, I need to catch the next one off this island. Bye!
Guess that means you use your whetstone often!

chatpoints.chat_text: save for later.
It is Mother Nature that is masterful.

replies.reply_text: Well, then you are masterful at helping Mother Nature out. Those figurines are amazing. By the way, do you happen to have any chores I can run for you?
Speaking of being masterful, there are several mazes on these islands and you can get lost for days if you aren't masterful at remembering the way!
Indeed she is! Well, I best be off. I've got chores to take care of. Bye!
Sure!
I changed my mind,  you can keep my $1000,  but I'm out of here.

chatpoints.chat_text: INCORRECT! I'm sorry, I've won the challenge, but you are more than welcome to take it again.

replies.reply_text: Well that's a bummer. Thanks anyway.
Darn it! I'd like to try again right now. (You hand him $1000.)

chatpoints.chat_text: I'll start you off with an easy one. First question: Which of these contain a maze?

replies.reply_text: Rider Isle.
Dog Isle.
Flower Isle.
Whorl Isle.

chatpoints.chat_text: CORRECT! This maze in Massachusetts is both a mental and physical challenge and claims to be a most complex murder-mystery adventure maze. The unusual features include:

replies.reply_text: An underground lake.
A burning bridge.
A zip line.
A house of mirrors.

chatpoints.chat_text: CORRECT! Buffalo, New York is famous for its snowfall and its yearly festival featuring a maze made out of what material?

replies.reply_text: Stacks and stacks of wooden sleds.
Rows and rows of snowmobiles.
Blocks and blocks of ice.
Cords and cords of firewood.

chatpoints.chat_text: CORRECT! Boasting a 100 year old yew hedge maze built in the Victorian era by William Waldorf Astor, the Hever Castle also has two other mazes. They are:

replies.reply_text: The Tower Maze and Splashing Water Maze.
Rose Garden Maze and The Royal Tapestry Maze.
The Dungeon Maze and The Bed Chambers Maze.
Birch Forest Maze and Herb Garden Maze.

replies.reply_text: A huge water slide originating in the center of the maze's tower.
A boat ride down the winding moat.
A path through an underworld grotto.
An elevator that takes you down to the dungeon.

Laser light telemetry.
Geothermal graphic imaging.
Satellite technology.

Leonardo da Vinci.
Christopher Columbus.
Marco Polo.

replies.reply_text: Bora Bora, Polynesia.
Oahu, Hawai’i.
Mykonos, Greece.
Galápagos Islands, Ecuador.

replies.reply_text: China.
Russia.
Egypt.
Rome.

chatpoints.chat_text: CORRECT! That was the Lost Labyrinth of Egypt. Here's your last question of the quiz. How was the Lost Labyrinth of Egypt rediscovered?

replies.reply_text: An archaeologist fell through the sand covered roof while excavating a nearby tomb.

replies.reply_text: Fantastic! Thanks so much.
Thank you. And yes, I would like to answer the bonus question.

replies.reply_text: The Vanderbult Mansion.
The Winchester House.
The Hearse Castle.
The Wrigley Mansion.
Thank you so much!

npc_list.admin_description: Cordovan is blind.
npc_list.long_description: A well-built and friendly looking man. Cordovan is obviously blind but that doesn't stop him from enjoying his love of reading. There are plenty of books in braille here!

chatpoints.chat_text: (The man raises his head while his fingers rest on the pages of a book. It appears that he was reading a book in braile.) Is that you, Colbert?

Colbert?

chatpoints.chat_text: Colbert is my son. I was expecting him.

replies.reply_text: Is there anything else I can do for you? I'm looking for ways to make some money.
No worries! I think I'll go explore your lovely island. Have a great day.

Sure!

Africa
Australia
South America
Asia

They are the longest mountain range above water in the world.
They are the wettest mountain range above water in the world.
They are the oldest mountain range above water in the world.

chatpoints.chat_text: Correct! The Mid-Atlantic Ridge in the Atlantic Ocean is the longest mountina range in the world. Okay, shall we get back to alpacas?

replies.reply_text: Sure!

A joey.
A vicuna.
A foal.
A cria.

Alpacas only have bottom teeth.

Alpacas are so fierce, mountain lions will not attack them.
Alpaca's cashmere-like fleece was once reserved for Incan royalty.

replies.reply_text: Thank you so much!
Thank you. And yes, I would like to answer the bonus question.

chatpoints.chat_text: Wrong guess. That is a true statement about alpaca.  I've won the challenge, but you are more than welcome to take it again.

replies.reply_text: Oh, so close! I'd like to try again right now. (You hand him $1000.) I've got it in the bag this time!

Huarizo.
Malpacas.
Almazos.
Guarpacas.

chatpoints.chat_text: Congratulations! Huarizo it is.

replies.reply_text: Thank you so much! Have a great day.

chatpoints.chat_text: How kind of you! No, we just got a delivery recently. But thank you for offering.

replies.reply_text: You are very welcome. Have a great day.

Please, please, pretty please tell me the ball of yarn is ready now.

chatpoints.chat_text: We have a lovely little herd of alpaca that produces a wonderful array of fleece.

replies.reply_text: I'd be happy to talk to him about that. I know just where to find him! I saw him earlier.
Okay, so he wanders around. Where exactly is he wandering around at?

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, silly me! The herd is at the southern end of the island. You'll find him there.

replies.reply_text: Alrighty then! I'm on my way.

chatpoints.chat_text: I need 3 clumps each of white and cream fleece, and two of silver, please.

replies.reply_text: I'll head there now!
Yay! That's exactly what I have!

chatpoints.chat_text: Wonderful! May I have them?

replies.reply_text: Sure! Here are the white clumps.

Sure! Here are the silvery clumps.

I think that's all the fleece you asked for.
I think that's all the fleece you asked for.
But wait, that's not all! I have more clumps.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh dear, no! I've barely cleaned the fleece. Now it must dry.

replies.reply_text: Okay. I'll go snack on a coconut.

But wait, that's not all! I have more clumps.
I think that's all the fleece you asked for.

replies.reply_text: Okay, I'll go search the beach for gemstones.

chatpoints.chat_text: Just a bit more time needed. Its been washed, dried, combed and now its ready to spin!

replies.reply_text: Okay, maybe I can count my toes a kabillion zillion times!

chatpoints.chat_text: It is indeed!

replies.reply_text: Oh my gosh! I'm so relieved I could almost cry. Thank you so much.

chatpoints.chat_text: My cupboards are well-stocked and I can't think of anything I need at this point that I can't get right here on Dog Isle. But thank you for checking.

replies.reply_text: You are welcome! Have a wonderful day.

npc_list.name: Zander
npc_list.short_description: A cute chocolate colored male alpaca
npc_list.long_description: A delicate, smaller, and softer version of the llamas that roam Jungle Isle.

chatpoints.chat_text: (This little guy is so cuddly he looks just adorable! Unfortunately, he also looks scared to death of you. )

replies.reply_text: Oh look what I have! Yummy, yummy for your tummy! (You hold out the Alpaca Treat and get ready to snatch a clump of fleece. )
Sorry! Didn't mean to scare you. I'll just leave right now!
Hey! I was supposed to get a clump of fleece for that treat! Oh, I see the problem. You aren't the color I'm looking for.

npc_list.name: Bettina Peddler
npc_list.short_description: Owner of Howling Moon Boutique & Sweets
npc_list.long_description: A short and energetic woman with an easy laugh.

chatpoints.chat_text: Welcome to Howling Moon Boutique.  Are you looking for something specific?

replies.reply_text: Do you have anything that would make a nice gift for someone who loves cats?
Not really, but thanks for asking. I'll be going now.
I was interested in purchasing one of the throws. How much did you say they were again?
Are your goods all produced here on Dog Isle?
Can you tell me something about the guitars? I may be interested in purchasing one.
How much did you say the guitars sell for?
Just looking for you. I've got a Pony Express Delivery!
It seems like I was doing something involving you?
Yes I am, as a matter of fact! I'm looking for information on the shopping list!
Hello Bettina! I've been shopping.
I'm back with requests for the shopping list!
Hello again. Can you remind me where to get the things on this shopping list?

chatpoints.chat_text: Indeed, indeed! I have a fine assortment of throws, perfect to warm you up on a chilly night.

replies.reply_text: Gosh, it is so warm here, I can't imagine anything but keeping cool. Thanks anyways. I must be leaving now.
Why would a cat lover want one of those?
You don't really get chilly nights here, do you?

chatpoints.chat_text: (Bettina chuckles.) Because they shed so darn much! These are woven of the finest alpaca wool in a mishmash of colors. Cat hairs blend right in.

replies.reply_text: That makes sense. These are really lovely. How much are you asking for one?
Let me make sure this is something my friend could use. I'll try to find out and get back quickly.

chatpoints.chat_text: Not really, but they do make lovely gifts!

replies.reply_text: Let me think about it. They really are lovely. I may be back.
They certainly are tempting. How much do they cost?
Why would a cat lover want one of those?

chatpoints.chat_text: $1800, but remember, this is some of the finest wool around and the craftsmanship is remarkable. This is a work of art.

replies.reply_text: Wow. I was hoping they would be a bit more affordable. Would you be open to bartering? I could run an errand or two in trade for one of the throws.
I'm sure my friend will love it. I'll take one!
You know what?  I don't think I have a use for one right now.  Thanks though.
I don't have that much money on me right now. I'll be back in awhile.

chatpoints.chat_text: What an excellent idea! My good friend Cecelia would like to dye some of her wool, but she needs ingredients to make dyes. Would you be willing to get the supplies?

chatpoints.chat_text: No problem. Just to remind you, I need a bale of daisy hay, two apples and three 4 leaf clovers. And of course, my fee of $200.

replies.reply_text: Of course. And I've got everything right here.
Thanks for the reminder. I'll be back shortly with the items.

chatpoints.chat_text: Okay, let's see what you've got for me.

replies.reply_text: Here's one bale of daisy hay.
Here are two apples and three 4 leaf clovers.
Oh shoot! I'm missing something. I'll be back.
On second thought, I think I've given you everything you need.
Wait, I have more for you.
I think that's everything you need.
Wait, I have more for you.
I think that's everything you need.
Thanks so much! I'll be sure to tell him hello.

chatpoints.chat_text: Unfortunately, all I have are young females at the moment. However, I have one that is a bit of an outcast from the herd. She needs a friend. Take her to Colbert. Hopefully this will do the trick.

replies.reply_text: Gosh. I just don't know what to do. He said a young male. I'll have to go back and discuss this with him. Thanks for the offer, and I may be back.

chatpoints.chat_text: The only cost is taking good care of her. I've known that family for years, and I trust that they will do exactly that.

replies.reply_text: Oh she's adorable! I'll take her straight to Colbert's, with great care. Thank you so much!

chatpoints.chat_text: I'm so glad to hear it! I think she'll be a perfect solution.

replies.reply_text: I sure hope so. Oh, and how much does she cost?
Thanks so much!

npc_list.name: Twyla
npc_list.long_description: Twyla makes luscious body creams and soaps from the local coconuts, which are rich in oil.

chatpoints.chat_text: Why, hello. Can I help you with something?

replies.reply_text: No thank you. Sorry to bother you. I'll just show myself back out.
Your home smells heavenly!
I can tell by the smells in here that you must like coconuts.
I actually come with some coconuts to sell!
Why yes indeed! You can accept this special delivery from Pony Express!
I'm hoping I can help you. I'm putting together a shopping list and wondered if there was anything you needed.
Yes please. Can you remind me what I was doing for you?

chatpoints.chat_text: I love coconuts. I am behind in filling orders and have no time to spare to collect them. I need both regular sized and giant coconuts.

replies.reply_text: I'd have to be nuts to go coconut collecting! They are heavy, and ugly to boot. I think I'll just ske-daddle along now.
Both kinds? Is there a difference in the two?
Tell me more!

chatpoints.chat_text: Thank you. I love the smell of coconuts so I use them in all the bath and body products I make. I would be happy to buy coconuts from you if you have some to spare.

replies.reply_text: Fantastic! I've got coconuts right here.
Looky here, looky here! I've got a giant coconut for you!
Well, I don't have a single coconut for you. Maybe some other day.

chatpoints.chat_text: I don't buy coconuts individually, but in groups - five giant ones for $1500 and twenty regular coconuts for $650.

replies.reply_text: Lucky for you and fantastic for me! I have five giant ones right here.
This is my lucky day! I have twenty regular coconuts.
Well, I don't have that much of either kind, so I guess I'll sell some to you some other times.
I've got five more giant ones for you!
I've got 20 regular ones for you!
Well darn. That's all I have for now. See you later!
I've got 20 more regular ones for you!
I've got five giant ones for you!
Looks like I need to collect more. See you later!

chatpoints.chat_text: There is! My husband Victor knows tons about coconuts. You should talk to him, if he's not busy, of course.

replies.reply_text: I just might do that now!
Thanks and have a coconutty day!

chatpoints.chat_text: You have just made my day! I want to try a new scent. I thought I was going to have to wait until next month.

replies.reply_text: What exactly do you need?

chatpoints.chat_text: I want some Oil of Orange. It is made from the peel of oranges. It should give lotion a nice fresh scent.

replies.reply_text: Happy to get that for you. (You add this to your list.) Sounds yummy! Have a sweet smelling day!

chatpoints.chat_text: Of course! You were going to get me some Oil of Orange.

replies.reply_text: Silly me! Of course I was.
Yes I was. And I happen to have it right here with me.
Happy to accept that as payment in full. Have an awesome day.

npc_list.name: Isaac
npc_list.long_description: Isaac makes beautiful guitars.

chatpoints.chat_text: (Isaac is busy restringing a beautiful guitar. He is so intent on his work, you almost hate to bother him.)

replies.reply_text: Hello? Excuse me, but I was wondering if you had any chores I might help you with?
(On second thought, you really don't need to bother him now so you head back out the door.)
That's a beautiful guitar you are working on.
What was I doing for you again?
I've got something for you!
Hello again!  Is that a new guitar you're working on?
Excuse me for bothering you, but I was hoping to buy a guitar. I was wondering if any of these are for sale?
Hello there! I am putting together a shopping list and wondered if you needed anything.
Was there something I was doing for you?

chatpoints.chat_text: (Isaac smiles kindly.) Thank you for the offer, while there I things I want, I really need nothing today.

replies.reply_text: Okay. Sorry to have bothered you.
Well, that leaves hope for tomorrow! I'll try again another day. Bye for now.
That guitar you are working on is a work of art.

chatpoints.chat_text: (Isaac blushes.) I am working hard on a new design to honor my father's artistry. Unfortunately, I don't have the materials to make the inlays really stand out.

replies.reply_text: Well now, that's something I can help with! I'm great at getting things for people.
Isn't that a shame. Oh gosh, look at the time. I've got to run. Later, gator!

chatpoints.chat_text: (Isaac stops what he is doing, looks up and grins.) Thank you for your kind words. I hope one day to be the master crafter that my father was. (He points to a stunning example hanging on the wall.)

replies.reply_text: I see what you mean. But it looks to me like you are certainly as gifted as he was.
That is a fine example of workmanship. Well, have a nice day!
May I look at it more closely?

chatpoints.chat_text: (Isaac gently removes it from the hook on the wall and carefully hands it to you.)

replies.reply_text: The inlaid design is amazing! The gold inlay really sets off the turquoise parts. The design looks a lot like the one you are restringing.
You know what, that looks really expensive and I would hate to drop it or something. I'm just going to hand it back to you and head out now. Bye!
I wish I knew how to play. Music has to sound awesome coming from something like this.

chatpoints.chat_text: I would be in your debt if you could bring me a chunk of obsidian, 20 rubies, and lapis lazuli.

replies.reply_text: I am more than happy to take on the challenge.
You know, I think I'll take on that on another time. I forgot I've got some other errands to run. See ya!
That's right! I'll be back soon.
And I have the obsidian right here!
I've got the lapis lazuli!
On that lapis, can you tell me more? I can't seem to find any.
I have the rubies right here!
Where was that lapis lazuli again?

chatpoints.chat_text: Wonderful! May I see?

replies.reply_text: Check out this huge piece of obsidian!
This lapis lazuli going to look amazing against the dark color of the ebony guitar.
Actually, on second thought, I'm not finding it with me.  I must have dropped it.  I'll be back.
Check out these rubies!
I think I brought everything.
I'll be back soon!
The red of the rubies will look classy inlaid with the obsidian. Too bad you don't have a tad more color.
I've got the obsidian, too!
I think that's all you asked for.
The black against the red of the rubies will look classy. Too bad you don't have a tad more color.
I've got the rubies too!
I think I've given you everything now.

chatpoints.chat_text: It will be a beautiful blue colored stone.

replies.reply_text: See ya soon!

chatpoints.chat_text: Exactly what I was thinking! That's why lapis lazuli will be perfect.

replies.reply_text: Never heard of the stuff. And truthfully, this sounds like more work than I have time for right now. Enjoy creating!
Lapis Lazuli! I believe it was treasured by ancient civilizations. I've never seen it. Where can I get it?

chatpoints.chat_text: There is a place my father spoke of, many moons ago. Rumors were that a piece was buried at the base of a pyramid on the northern most edge of Jungle Isle.

replies.reply_text: Oh easy breezy! I'm on Jungle Isle all the time. Its one of my favorite islands.
Jungle Isle is not my favorite island. Too many bugs. Too easy to get lost. I think I'll pass.

chatpoints.chat_text: You were going to get me a piece of obsidian.

replies.reply_text: That's right! I'll be back soon.
I've got it right here!

chatpoints.chat_text: You were going to visit the most northern pyramid on Jungle Isle to dig for some lapis lazuli.

replies.reply_text: That's right! Be back in a jiffy.
And I have it right here! This lapis lazuli is going to look amazing against the dark color of the ebony guitar.

chatpoints.chat_text: You were going to get me 20 rubies.

replies.reply_text: That's right! I'll be back soon.
I've got them right here!

chatpoints.chat_text: It is! I hope to keep improving with each one.

replies.reply_text: It looks like you are. It's looking amazing. I'll leave you to your work.  Bye!
That is simply stunning. I'm actually looking for a guitar for a gift. Would you be willing to sell this one?
Well it is said, practice makes perfect! I'm off now to another adventure. Have a great day.

chatpoints.chat_text: Only if the one strumming is as gifted as the musical instrument is well-crafted. Alas, I cannot play that beautifully.

replies.reply_text: I am so sorry to hear that! Say, if you ever know of someone who plays that well, I'd love to know about it. Got to go now. Have a great day.
What a shame. Still, you are very gifted to have crafted such a wonderful guitar.
Maybe I'll take guitar lessons some day. In the meantime, I best be getting back to horse chores!

chatpoints.chat_text: This is a stunning piece! My father was right. He talked many times about the rumors and now we know they were true.

replies.reply_text: I've got the rubies, too!
I've got the obsidian, too!
I think that's everything!

chatpoints.chat_text: (Isaac checks to see if you've given him everything he's asked for.)

replies.reply_text: Awesome! I can't wait to see the finished product. Have a great day.

chatpoints.chat_text: I wouldn't know how to price this. It has such a rare piece of lapis azuli in it. I just don't think I could ever duplicate this one. I'm so sorry. I just don't think I could sell it.

replies.reply_text: I completely understand. Can I buy a different guitar?
Oh well, as they say, nothing ventured, nothing gained! Maybe I can find one for sale elsewhere.

chatpoints.chat_text: All the guitars that I have available for sale are over at the Howling Moon Boutique and Sweets shop. I would be honored if you went there and bought one.

replies.reply_text: I'll head over there right now!
I've done business with Bettina before. What a delightful woman. I'll let you get back to your work. Have a great day.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh yes please! I just got an order for a new design in mother of pearl. Two dozen oyster shells should be sufficient.

replies.reply_text: Mother of Pearl comes from oyster shells? (Isaac nods and you carefully write down 2 dozen oyster shells. Then you realize you forgot to add 6 dozen corn husks to the list, so you quickly do that..) Got it! I'll be back.

chatpoints.chat_text: Indeed there was. You were going to bring me a 2 dozen oyster shells so I'll have mother of pearl to add to this guitar design.

replies.reply_text: That's going to be beautiful! I'll get right on that.
And wouldn't you know it, I happen to have them with me. Here you go!
Thanks so much! I'm sure the guitar will be beautiful when you are finished laying in the pearl design.

npc_list.name: Victor
npc_list.admin_description: Will Have Victor's Coconut Quiz someday
npc_list.long_description: Victor doesn't have much to say. Unless you ask him about coconuts! He's crazy talkative when it comes to coconuts. Or his hobby of collecting sugar skulls for Day of the Dead celebrations.

chatpoints.chat_text: (Victor is busy reading. You decide not to bother him.)

replies.reply_text: (On second thought, you decide its better to bother him and deliver the packages than risk carry them around and hope whatever is inside doesn't get broken.) Excuse me, Victor?

chatpoints.chat_text: (Victor takes one look at the packages you are holding and breaks into a huge grin.) My sugar skulls! These are specially crafted to celebrate Día de los Muertos!

replies.reply_text: Thank you for the generous payment. Adios!
Día de los Muertos?

chatpoints.chat_text: Si! Día de los Muertos. Otherwise known as Day of the Dead. It is when we remember our loved ones that have passed on. There is much joy and traditions and celebrations. Sugar skulls are part of the traditions and I collect them.

replies.reply_text: Wow. I guess I should learn more about Día de los Muertos. But it will have to wait for another day, and another time. Gotta run!

chatpoints.chat_text: Welcome back. Isn't this a fine day? Replace this convo CP#0, change on 2nd thought - leave go part

replies.reply_text: make CP 3 - would you like to test your knowledge of coconuts? You give me $1000 and if you get all the questions right, I'll pay you $50,000.

chatpoints.chat_text: You agree to take the coconut quiz - make this an action
The first question is an easy one. The white fleshy edible part of a coconut is called what?

replies.reply_text: Belly Jelly.
Bark.
Meal.
Meat.

chatpoints.chat_text: I'm so sorry, that answer is not right. I won the challenge, but you are welcome to try again if you'd like.

replies.reply_text: Darn. I thought I knew a lot about coconuts, but you obviously know more. Thanks for the offer, but I don't have time to try again today. Maybe some other day. Bye!
Darn it! I'd like to try again right now. (You hand him $2500.)

chatpoints.chat_text: Yes, indeed. We are off to a good start. Coconut meat has nutritional value by having high amounts of what?

replies.reply_text: Copper, folic acid, marrow and dextrose.
Fiber, chaff, copper and propolis.
Quinoa, spelt, sodium and sugar.
Iron, protein, vitamin b and fiber.

chatpoints.chat_text: Good job! Coconut meat is packed with nutrients that improve lean muscle mass and support the overall body. Traditionally, what have the coconut tree roots been used for?

replies.reply_text: Dyes, toothbrushes, mouthwash.
Canoes, paddle boats, rafts.
Recyclable utensils.
lariats, saddles, and pommels.

npc_list.name: Ruslan
npc_list.long_description: Ruslan is an older man with a kind face. He stands tall, especially next to his petite wife!

chatpoints.chat_text: I am afraid there isn't much to explore here. Our island is pretty small, has few trees and is fairly uninteresting. But I hope you enjoy yourself just the same.

replies.reply_text: Well darn. That doesn't sound very exciting. I think I've just lost my sense of adventure. Maybe I'll just head back over to one of the bigger islands. Bye!
I think I'll head out and explore it anyway. You never know what I might find! And if I find anything exciting, I'll let you know.

chatpoints.chat_text: Welcome to our home. What brings you to our little isle?

replies.reply_text: Thank you! I am a great explorer and it is my intent to explore every isle there is!
Why thank you! Say, that looks like a sheep dog. But I didn't see any sheep.
I just thought I'd check it out. However, in doing so, it appears that It seems that Svetlana had some garden trolls in her yard, and they've gone missing. Would you know anything about that?
Its me again. Did you think of anything else that might be helpful in solving the missing troll mystery?
Hey Ruslan! Olena said you might know where I can find a dinosaur bone?
I am looking for the person who supplies ice blocks for the ice sculptures. Might that be you?
Anastacia said that there is a cargo ship arriving soon and she wants to know if you have anything ready to ship.

chatpoints.chat_text: Ach! That is what I told my wife! What good is a sheepdog if you have no sheep? But this is no place to raise sheep, and she loves that dog. Since the kids grew up and moved out, she acts like it is her baby.

replies.reply_text: I know some people treat their dogs like kids. That's a-okay in my book! This doesn't look quite like the sheepdogs I've seen before. Is it a mixed breed?
Well that sounds pretty weird! I think I'll just leave now.

chatpoints.chat_text: Not at all! Muktdar is a fine example of the Ukrainian Ovcharka. Look at that wool! You can't spin most dog hair into yarn, but with this breed? Yes, you can! Yes, indeed.

replies.reply_text: I have never heard of that breed. And I am sure I couldn't spell that if I was blindfolded and bet $100!
He seems like a friendly dog. Well darn. Look at the time. Seems its time I headed out. I've got horse chores that need to be done. Bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: I won't bet you that. It took me a day or two to learn how to spell it, myself.

replies.reply_text: Well thank goodness for that! I am not the greatest at spelling. Thank you for telling me about your dog. Its always a good day when I learn something new! See you around!

chatpoints.chat_text: Gone missing? That IS a mystery! Unfortunately, I haven't a clue about that.

replies.reply_text: Okay, thanks for your time.

chatpoints.chat_text: Not a thing. So sorry I can't help you.

replies.reply_text: Well, darn. Thank you for your time.

chatpoints.chat_text: Possibly. I saw one when I was walking along the beach north of here the other day. But I can't promise it will still be there, since the tide might have covered it up or washed it away.

replies.reply_text: Thanks so much!

chatpoints.chat_text: Sorry to disappoint you, my friend. It is not me that does that, but my son-in-law.

replies.reply_text: Thanks for that information! See you around.

chatpoints.chat_text: Why thank you for checking.  I don't but check with my beautiful bride to see if she has.

replies.reply_text: All right then, I'll do that.  Bye!

npc_list.name: Svetlana
npc_list.long_description: Svetlana is an attractive woman who seems to be cheerful. She has rosy red cheeks. You suspect its from living in such a cold climate!

chatpoints.chat_text: Come in, come in! Have a seat and make yourself at home. We don't get visitors very often, so it is nice to see someone.

replies.reply_text: I can see why! You live out in the middle of nowhere. And nowhere is a place where I don't belong. I think I'll just move along.
Why thank you. I think I will. And while I'm here, you wouldn't happen to have any chores or errands that need tending to, do you?
I seem to remember that I agreed to help you. Can you remind me what was I doing for you?
Why thank you! But I really can't stay. I hope you have a wonderful day.
I'm back! I've talked to everyone and it seems like no one has a clue.
Good news, Svetlana! I've talked to your daughter, and it appears that Muktdar has something to do with the missing trolls!
Hello, Svetlana! I think you will be happy to know I've got your garden trolls. The trolls are a little worse for wear, as it appears Muktdar chewed on them.
Thank you.  Anastacia said that there is a cargo ship coming soon and she wanted to know if you had anything to go out on it.

chatpoints.chat_text: Are you good at solving mysteries?

replies.reply_text: Well, I hate to brag, but I am one of the best mystery solvers around! How about you give me a little more information?
Of course I am! I am fantabulous! Awesome and amazing! Send me on a quest, and I don't quit until I've succeeded!
I must say, my reputation speaks for itself. I'm just that good. However, we've run out of time today chatting about this. I'll have to come back another time!

chatpoints.chat_text: Well now, after hearing that, I think this might be too easy for you. Are you sure you want to know more?

replies.reply_text: Too easy? Nothing is too easy nor too difficult for me to take on! Just call me Mystery Buster Supreme!

Well, when you put it that way, nope, I don't want to know anything more. I like a challenge. Something that makes the cogs in my brain turn. Something that challenges me to be a better, more enlightened ME! So, I think I'll just mosey on out of here
Absolutely! Bring on the details!
Fee fie foe fum. I smell the scent of irish grub! Dinner's ready and I need to eat. See ya!

chatpoints.chat_text: Since you seem supremely sure of your abilities, I am confident you can solve the mystery of our missing garden art. I had a lovely display of garden trolls and they started disappearing almost a week ago. Today, the last one went missing.

replies.reply_text: I would be happy to take this mystery on. This island is so small, it should take me no time to solve it!
So let me get this straight. You have garden trolls but you don't have a garden? Doesn't that seem the least bit odd to you?
I am as confident as you are! However, it has come to my attention that I have pressing matter to attend to. I might be able to help you some other time. But for now, I must run. Good-bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: This climate is too difficult to garden in. What food grows in snow? Not much that I'd want to eat! However, the garden trolls were made by a friend many years ago and they added a decorative and colorful touch to a yard that is always covered in snow.

replies.reply_text: You make an excellent point! I would be happy to help you with that mystery.
Still, is seems strange to have garden art and no garden. This is a bit too odd for my blood. I think I'll head over to another island now.
Have no fear - Mystery Buster Supreme is on it like ticks on a pig!

chatpoints.chat_text: You were trying to solve the mystery of our missing garden trolls.

replies.reply_text: Oh that's right! I'll get right on that.
Would you have any suggestions to get me started in the right direction?
And I have! I had to dig through the snow to find where Muktdar buried them. But find them, I did!
I remember now. And I remember that I asked everyone.

chatpoints.chat_text: I thought you were a wiz at this kind of thing. You might try asking my parents Ruslan and Olena, or my sister Lesia and her husband Vasyl.

replies.reply_text: Oh, great idea! I'll do that now.
Maybe I'll get to that another day. That's going to take more time than I thought. See ya!

chatpoints.chat_text: You asked everyone? Well, that is certainly frustrating.

replies.reply_text: Okay, I'll go check with everyone again.

chatpoints.chat_text: That's wonderful. So where are the trolls now? I was hoping you would return with them.

replies.reply_text: You asked me to find out what happened to the trolls and I did. The rest is up to you! Toodle-loo!
Good question. I'll make a few more inquiries and see what I can come up with.
You are so welcome! The mystery has been solved and you've got them back to cheer up your yard again. Thank you for making this island a bit more exciting!
Will do!  Good bye for now, see you soon.

npc_list.name: Olena
npc_list.long_description: Olena is an older woman with a kind, bright smile. She looks grandmotherly in a friendly, helpful sort of way.

chatpoints.chat_text: Hello? Can I help you? Are you lost or something?

replies.reply_text: Well actually, I was hoping I could help you! Do you have any chores that need to be done? I'm trying to make some money.
Hello! No help needed, not lost at all, and good-bye!
I'm not lost, but something else is! Svetlana's garden trolls have up and vanished. Would you happen to know anything about that?
You can help me by telling me what I was helping you with!
Actually, I've helped you! I gave Muktdar a dinosaur bone. Hopefully, that will keep him busy for awhile and he'll leave Svetlana's trolls alone.
Hello again. I know I already asked, but I was hoping maybe you remembered something in the meantime that might help solve the mystery of the missing garden trolls.
No ma'am, Anastacia asked me to check to see if you had anything to get sent out on the cargo ship.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh dear! She loved those ugly things. I'm terribly sorry, but I don't know how to help you.

replies.reply_text: Gosh darn it! I was hoping you could tell me something. Thanks for your time.

chatpoints.chat_text: You could do me a big favor for me . Remember when Muktdar carried off Svetlana's trolls? I'm afraid he'll do it again unless we give him something to keep him occupied. Do you have any suggestions?

replies.reply_text: I don't have a clue. Sorry!
Well, he acts like a puppy, and I noticed the trolls had chew marks in them. Puppies love to chew things. What if he had a really big bone to keep him occupied? Like a dinosaur bone?

chatpoints.chat_text: That's a great idea. However, I have no bones. Is that something you would be willing to get for Muktdar?

replies.reply_text: I would be happy to do that!
Maybe some other day. Bones are kind of creepy, so I'm going to pass on this today.

chatpoints.chat_text: I believe Ruslan saw a dinosaur bone on the beach the other day. You might ask him about that.

replies.reply_text: Thanks for the tip!
Oh silly me! I have a dinosaur bone right here! Let me give it to Muktdar.
Thanks so much and have a great day!

chatpoints.chat_text: You were going to help get Muktdar a bone. Ruslan saw one on the beach. You might ask him about that.

replies.reply_text: I can't believe I forgot about that! I think you'll be pleased to know that I gave Muktdar a dinosaur bone. I hope that keeps him out of trouble for awhile.
Thanks for the reminder. I'll get right on that.

chatpoints.chat_text: I wish I could be helpful, but I just can't think of a thing in regards to the trolls.

replies.reply_text: Okay. Thanks anyways.

chatpoints.chat_text: I might have, just a moment while I check.

replies.reply_text: Sure thing. (Whistling while she looks.)
Yes ma'am, I'll bring them to her right away!

npc_list.name: Lesia
npc_list.admin_description: Makes pysanky
npc_list.long_description: Lesia looks just like Svetlana except for her darker hair. Its easy to tell they are sisters. They even have the same bright smile. Lesia has followed her mother's footsteps as a pysanky artist.

chatpoints.chat_text: Why hello! Please, come in.

replies.reply_text: Thank you, I will. It is a bit nippy out there! I'm wondering if you might have any chores or errands I could do for you? I find myself in a bit of a bind and in need of some money.
Thank you for the offering, but I was just checking to see who lived here. I'll be on my way now.
Thank you, but I hope to only stay for a moment or two. I'm here on a mission to solve a mystery.
Hello again. Its just me, doing a follow-up call. Is there any chance that you have remembered anything out of the ordinary about the past week, when the trolls went missing?
Thank you, I don't mind if I do. It's very chilly out here! But I'll only come in long enough to give you this package from Pony Express.
Why thank you!  Anastacia asked me to see if you needed anything shipped out, the cargo ship should be here soon.
Hello again! I was wondering if you were done with the egg yet?
I was hoping you might help me. I have a broken egg that I need glued back together and I know you work with eggs to make the pysanky.

chatpoints.chat_text: A mission? Goodness. That sounds important.

replies.reply_text: It certainly is to Svetlana. It seems her garden trolls have gone missing, and I am hoping you might know a thing or two about that to help me solve what happened to them.

I guess it would depend on who you were talking to. It is important to Svetlana, as she loved her garden trolls. And it is important to me, because I told her I would solve the mystery of what happened to them. I gave my word and I intend to keep it!
Oh it does, doesn't it? But right now, dinner is ever so much more important! See you later!

chatpoints.chat_text: Her trolls are missing? Poor Svetlana. She loved those trolls. They were cute in an ugly sort of way. Unfortunately, I don't think I can help you at all.

replies.reply_text: Foiled! Drat, darn and gosh. Okay, thanks for your time.

chatpoints.chat_text: I'm really sorry, but I can't think of a thing. I'd love to be able to help, as I know how important the trolls are to Svetlana. Sorry.

replies.reply_text: I'm sorry, too. But thank you for your time.
Yummy! Thank you so much and have a great day.

chatpoints.chat_text: I have a pysanky that was a special order.  Let me go get it.

replies.reply_text: No problem, I'll wait!
Oh my, the craftmanship is breathtaking! (You keep staring at the egg and it's case.) The Easter Bunny is getting this?

chatpoints.chat_text: Yes, he's a collector of rare eggs as well as a distributer of decorated ones. Now hurry back to Anastacia and don't forget who it is going to!

replies.reply_text: I know, I know...to the Easter Bunny.  Bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: I am always happy to pay $300 for two pearls. I add crushed pearls to my pysanky designs. This is not the traditional way of painting pysanky, but I like to try new and different styles of bringing Ukrianian traditions into my art.

replies.reply_text: What a great idea! No wonder your pysanky are so beautiful. I have two pearls right here!
Gosh. I can get more money for them on the other islands.
Thanks!
Wait! I've got two more!

chatpoints.chat_text: That may well be true. Unfortunately, it is not cheap living on a small island. That is all I can afford to pay.

replies.reply_text: You know, it would be enough to buy my passage off this island, so I'll do it! I've got two pearls right here.
I'll have to think about it. I may be back.
Thank you so much! I'll be back in awhile.

chatpoints.chat_text: Almost. The glue hasn't hardened enough. Let's give it another couple of minutes. (Lesia starts humming and watching the clock.) That should do it!

replies.reply_text: You've done an amazing job! At a quick glance, you'd never know this was in pieces. Thank you, thank you!

npc_list.name: Vasyl
npc_list.long_description: Vasyl is a handsome and hardworking man.

chatpoints.chat_text: (Vasyl is busying polishing the floor.)

replies.reply_text: (You decide to leave him be.)
(You can't solve the mystery if you don't talk to him!) Excuse, I'm sorry to bother you but I'm wondering if you can help me? I need to solve the mystery of Svetlana's trolls. They've disappeared.
Excuse me again. I am here about the missing trolls. I was wondering if you might have remembered anything - a strange sound - something or someone that looked suspicious?
I hate to bother you, but I was wondering if you supply ice blocks?

chatpoints.chat_text: I would love to help you, but I don't know anything about any missing trolls. I've been very busy refinishing the inside of our cabin. I haven't been out much. However, if I think of anything, I'll be sure to let you know.

replies.reply_text: Well darn. Okay. Thanks anyway.

chatpoints.chat_text: I'm so sorry. Like I explained earlier, I've been busy in the cabin. Sorry I can't be of more help.

replies.reply_text: Alrighty then. See you around!

chatpoints.chat_text: Sorry, that would be my brother-in-law Vladyk.

replies.reply_text: Okay. Thanks so much.

npc_list.name: Galina
npc_list.long_description: Galina is a delightful child full of boundless energy.

chatpoints.chat_text: Hello! Want to help me and my mommy make cookies? They are going to be sooooo good! I love cookies!

replies.reply_text: No thank you. Maybe some other time.
I'm so sorry. I don't have time today, but maybe I'll come back again. In the mean time, maybe you can help me solve a mystery?
Not today, thank you. I'm still trying to find those pesky trolls. Where did you say Muktdar went?
No, but I appreciate the offer. What I do want is to ask you about  - oh, never mind.  You seem to be awfully busy with your cookies. I should stick with asking the adults around here.

chatpoints.chat_text: A mystery? I love, love, love, love, LOVE mysteries! Did you find unicorn tracks? Fairy dust? Magic elves? Or maybe a magic kitty? Tell me, tell me, please!

replies.reply_text: Whoa! Slow down there! Nothing like that. This has to do with Svetlana's missing trolls.
Oh dear. Sounds like you are all about living in the fantasy world. This is real world stuff. Maybe I'll come back and chat with you another time.

chatpoints.chat_text: Her trolls are missing? Oh, no! They are so cute. I like to play with them. EVERY day! We have tea parties. And slumber parties! Not at night, because it would be too too cold to sleep out there with them at night! The tallest one, I named Daryll. The shortest one, I named Daryllinka! Ha ha ha. That means little Daryll. I think that is soooo funny.

replies.reply_text: Okay, we need a little focus here. Stay with me. That's all very nice and all, but do you know where they are? Did you hide them or something?
You know, I think I need to go take a nap or a walk or something. You are just too - too - I don't know. Just too much to deal with right now!

chatpoints.chat_text: Why would I hide them? That would be very silly.  Like, how are they going to have tea parties? Or slumber parties? Or play house or play Grumpy Big Daryll gets mad at the other trolls?

replies.reply_text: This is nuts! You are one chatter-box, you know? I think I'll come back some other day.
Kid, you are giving me a headache. I didn't mean to imply that you hid them. I just want to know if you know where they are. Do you?

chatpoints.chat_text: I don't know where they are. Not really. If I did, I would go get them, because it hasn't been any fun without them to play with. But I have an idea about where they MIGHT be. Would you like to know?

replies.reply_text: Don't make me hold my breath. I would LOVE to know. Can you please tell me?
Arggggg! Just tell me please! Before I pull out all of my hair.

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, Muktdar has been running past our house every day now. And you know what? Every time he had something big in his mouth. And I think that something was a troll. That's what I think. And he likes to bury things. So if I were you, I would look all over in the snow, somewhere over there. (She points east.)

replies.reply_text: Muktdar? The dog? That makes so much sense! Thank you so much!
You want me to look in the snow for buried trolls? No thank you!

chatpoints.chat_text: I think you would look very silly if you pulled out all of your hair. So I will tell you so you don't have to look silly. Besides, its cold out there. Without hair, you'd be even colder!

replies.reply_text: You are so right. I do not want to look silly or be any colder than I already am. Please, tell me, Dear Child, where you think the trolls are.
Oh for Pete's sake! I'm leaving already!

chatpoints.chat_text: (She points east.) He runs all over the place out there!

replies.reply_text: Thank you so much! Maybe next time we can make cookies!

npc_list.name: Vladyk
npc_list.long_description: Vladyk carves ice blocks from the pond near his home for the ice sculptures found on some of the colder isles. He is a pleasant looking man who he adores his daughter. You can tell by the way he breaks into a smile every time he looks at little Karolinka.

chatpoints.chat_text: Good day! Good day!

replies.reply_text: Good day to you, too! And good-bye! Good-bye!
Well hello there! I was wondering if you might be able to help me. Your wife said her garden trolls are missing. Would you happen to know anything about that?
I know I've talked to you already, but I was wondering if maybe you saw something or heard something out of the ordinary in regards to the missing trolls?

Hello there! Since this is Glacier Isle, I was wondering if you were the guy who supplies the ice blocks for the ice sculptures. I need to find a way to help cool off a dock master in a really hot climate and was hoping to obtain one of those blocks.
Can you remind me what I was doing for you?
Is that block of ice ready yet?
Brrrr! Its cold out there. I'm hoping the ice block is ready?
Good day, Vladyk!  Anastacia asked me to see if you had anything to go out on the cargo ship.

chatpoints.chat_text: Indeed! Indeed! She had seven, and last week they started to go missing. One a day! Until they were all gone. I wonder what happened to them?

replies.reply_text: Sounds like its a mystery to you, too. Okay, thanks anyway.
I feel like I'm going in circles here. How about I just let you get back to your day.

chatpoints.chat_text: Not a clue! Not a single clue! Didn't hear a thing. Didn't see a thing. Nothing out of the ordinary. Sorry I can't be of more help.

replies.reply_text: No worries. I will just keep working on this until I figure it out.

chatpoints.chat_text: Indeed! Indeed! I am that man and this is a perfect place to get an ice block. There's a frozen lake just outside my door that I can cut out a block of ice for you. I just need someone to get my chainsaw repaired and we can get right to the task.

replies.reply_text: It sounds suspiciously like that "someone" might be me if I want the block of ice. I'm going to have to do this some other day. I just don't have the time now. Bye!
So, if I get the chainsaw fixed, you'll give me a block of ice?

chatpoints.chat_text: Of course! Of course! Its a messy job cutting the ice, but for a fixed chainsaw, I'd be happy to do it.

replies.reply_text: Well. I told Jebidiah I'd helped him, so I will get your chainsaw fixed. Do you have any idea on who can fix it?

This sounds more complicated then what I was led to believe. I haven't the time nor desire to get your chainsaw fixed. So sorry. I just don't have that much time. Good luck in getting that taken care of.
Actually, I'm surprised you use a chainsaw. I would have thought you'd be all traditional and use an old fashioned tool to cut the ice.

chatpoints.chat_text: If you are talking about an ulu, Yup'ik, Inuit, and Aleut women use those. Then there are ice augurs and ice chisels and ice saws. However, for the amount of blocks needed for an ice sculpture, I'd rather work quickly and efficiently.

replies.reply_text: That makes sense, and I sure don't want to wait long to get that ice block from you. Okay, let me get your chainsaw fixed. Do you know who can fix it?
Well, that's all very interesting, but I have to go now.
All right. Back in a jiffy.

chatpoints.chat_text: Of course! Of course! You were taking my chainsaw to Rick in Witherton to get it fixed.

replies.reply_text: Thanks. I'll head over there now.
That's right! I should have remembered. Rick fixed it, oiled it and gave it an all over thumbs up. Here it is!
Okay. Be back in a few minutes.

chatpoints.chat_text: It isn't like rolling a snowball. This takes time!

replies.reply_text: Sorry. I guess I need to practice patience.

chatpoints.chat_text: It is, it is!

replies.reply_text: Thanks so much!

chatpoints.chat_text: That was nice of Anastacia.  Please let her know that I don't have anything ready to go right now.

replies.reply_text: I'd be happy to let her know.  Bye!

npc_list.name: Karolinka
npc_list.long_description: A bubbly blonde young toddler who seems to giggle over most anything.

chatpoints.chat_text: Hi! Hi!

replies.reply_text: Well, hello, hello to you, too! And bye-bye now!
Say, I wonder if you might help me.
What am I thinking? Asking a toddler about a mystery doesn't seem to make a lot of sense. Good bye for now, you adorable child!

chatpoints.chat_text: (The child giggles and nods at you. This may be a total waste of time!)

replies.reply_text: (You decide not to waste your time, and just leave.)
So, you know your mom's garden trolls?
(You make a funny face at her, and both of you burst out laughing. Time to get back to the business at hand!)

chatpoints.chat_text: (Karolinka giggles and jumps up and down.) Yes! Yes!

replies.reply_text: The garden trolls are missing. Do you happen to know anything about that?
(Karolinka needs to spend time away from her father. She repeats things just like he does! Asking her for information seems crazy. You decide to go talk to someone else.)

chatpoints.chat_text: Woof! Woof-woof!

replies.reply_text: What? You think you are a puppy? Nice puppy! But that isn't what I was looking for. Listen closely now. Did you see what happened to the garden trolls?
Woof! Woof-woof to you too! Bow-woo and meow! And good-bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: Yes! Yes! Woof! Woof-woof!

replies.reply_text: Well this is getting me nowhere! So good-bye, happy but confused child!
Wait a minute! Woof? Woof-woof? Are you trying to tell me Muktdar has something to do with the missing trolls?

chatpoints.chat_text: Woof! Woof-woof! Took! Took!

replies.reply_text: What a brilliant child! A genius, that's what you are! Thank you, thank you!

npc_list.name: Muktdar
npc_list.admin_description: Ruslan's dog.
npc_list.short_description: A Shaggy Sheepdog on Glacier Isle
npc_list.long_description: Muktdar is a big shaggy puppy. At least he acts like a puppy! He seems to be grinning with his open smile. His tail is constantly wagging and he looks like he wants to play.

chatpoints.chat_text: Woof! Woof-woof!

replies.reply_text: Hello to you and good-bye!
What a cutie you are! I can see you want to play. However, I don't have time for that. A little birdie told me that you might know something about the missing garden trolls?
Hello there, Muktdar! Look what I've brought for you!

chatpoints.chat_text: Woof! Woof-woof!

replies.reply_text: Great! I must be crazy to be asking a dog for information! What was I thinking? Time to ask a real person! Seems like the only one paying attention was that little toddler Karolinka. Galina might be just as observant! I think I'll go talk to her.
Hopefully, that will keep you out of trouble for awhile!

npc_list.name: Anathema
npc_list.short_description: An eclectic recluse with wild green hair.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh look! A lovely, lovely moonbeam. How are you doing, my bright and gleaming moonbeam?

replies.reply_text: Um, no, I'm not a moonbeam. Oh wait! You must be talking to that moonbeam in your hand. Silly me!
Wow. That's some wild green hair you've got there!
Oh, Confused Lady! I am baaaaacccck! And I am ready to prove to you that I am real.

chatpoints.chat_text: (The lady with green hair seems startled as she stares at the moonbeam in her hand.) What's that you say?

replies.reply_text: Hey! You. It's me talking. Not the moonbeam.
Crazy lady! I'm outta here.
I said, that's some wild green hair you have there!

chatpoints.chat_text: Little moonbeam, did you hear something strange just now? Perhaps it was a flurry of pixie dust? You get too much pixie dust together and all that static gets noisy!

replies.reply_text: Hello? Hello? I'm talking to you strange lady with green hair!
I assure you that I am not a moonbeam and I'm not pixie dust either!

chatpoints.chat_text: You are NOT here! No one can be here but ME! It would be utterly preposterous and simply impossible for anyone else to be here. This is my private cloud. This must be some kind of trickery.

replies.reply_text: This is no trick, I insist. I am here. See? I'm talking to you.
What is preposterous is your wild green hair!

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh silly, little moonbeam. We both know that this is my very own private cloud island. And no one can ever find it. No one will ever come here. Never, ever, ever!

replies.reply_text: Well, I DID find it and I AM here!
Well, it can't be too private because here I am! Ta-daa! But no worries, because here I GO!

chatpoints.chat_text: This is simply ludicrous. Absurd! NO ONE, absolutely unequivocally NO one. Not a single soul other than me can be here! There's no way for someone to get here. There is no stairway. No boat dock. No portal. No magic carpet!

replies.reply_text: I didn't need any of those things. I rode this pegasus here.
What is ludicrous is having this conversation with you. I'm outta here.

chatpoints.chat_text: Ah, ha! This makes complete sense now! I have been a recluse for so long, my mind has created this figment of my imagination. That is the only possible explanation. My mind is brilliant! Spectacular! Amazingly clever! To create this... this... person! Out of thin air. I amaze myself. Utterly and completely.

replies.reply_text: Ugh! What can I do to prove to you that I am no illusion or figment or your imagination. That I am really, truly here?
You know what? I am just going to leave you with that thought. Have a brilliant, wonderful life!

chatpoints.chat_text: Utterly, fantastically amazing! This figment even talks! My mind wants to challenge me. Brilliant! My brain has thrown down the gauntlet. So be it! I accept the challenge!

replies.reply_text: Um. Okay? This is a little weird. You want ME to challenge You? To prove to you that I am real? Bizarre. Seems pretty backwards to me. But okay, let the games begin!
This is a waste of time. Goodbye, good day, and good riddance!
Accept? I'm not throwing down a gauntlet or challenging you or anything. Shesh! I must be crazy to even be talking to you. I've got better things to do. Good bye Lady!
Okay, to prove I'm real and not something your brain created, I'll give you things that can't be found on any of the Cloud islands!
I bet a giant coconut, a chunk of obsidian, juicy grapes and a candy cane will prove I'm real. And I best be finding those things. I'll be back shortly.

chatpoints.chat_text: This should be interesting! Very, very interesting!

replies.reply_text: I can't believe you can just ignore the obsidian so easily. Fine. Here is a giant coconut, from the far off islands where pirates can be found! This proves I'm real!
Let's see what you think about this! Here is a chunk of obsidian, from the far off islands as black as night.
Seriously? Alrighty, then. How about a succulent bunch of juicy grapes, from the land of sand!
Here is a minty sweet candy cane, from the North Pole. Courtesy Santa Claus, of course! How can you deny the reality of that?
You already ate that candy cane...  Thankfully, someone more brilliant than your brain said, "an interaction between two things cannot exist unless the things themselves exist."
Really? Okay, fine. I've got something else to give you. This should prove I'm real.
Speaking of night - I need to get some rest. Dealing with you is exhausting!

chatpoints.chat_text: I sense defeat coming quickly, Hence, I surmise, the 'sour grapes!' attitude.

replies.reply_text: You are the one showing your 'sour grapes!' Because you know I'm real. You just aren't ready to admit it. So let's give it one more try!
You're right. I'm calling it quits.

chatpoints.chat_text: Ha! A pun of sorts - coco-nut? Surely you don't think I'd fall for that!

replies.reply_text: Do you not see how huge it is? How real it is? Fine! Let's try something else.
You ARE nuts! And I am, too. Standing here arguing with someone who is clearly out of it! I'm making like a bird and flying outta here!

chatpoints.chat_text: What's this?  I am no child that you can bribe with sweets.

replies.reply_text: Santa Claus is real! He's as real as your crazy green hair. And so am I.  But at this point, I give up on proving otherwise to you!
Thankfully, someone more brilliant than your brain said, "an interaction between two things cannot exist unless the things themselves exist."

chatpoints.chat_text: (Anathema's smile slowly fades as the realization of what you said dawns on her.) I ate some of the candy. So, I've interacted with it. That means it IS real? That YOU are real? I'm not alone on this island anymore? Noooooo!

replies.reply_text: Alrighty then! That's the sound of sweet success. Too bad you don't have someone you can 'high five' right now. You win!

chatpoints.chat_text: What is that annoying voice in my head? I've got green hair. So what? Maybe tomorrow I'll have blue. Now do hush up little voice in my head.

replies.reply_text: Well, that wasn't very interesting! I'm gone like yesterday's breakfast!

npc_list.name: Vee Ender
npc_list.long_description: A friendly looking lady with an easy smile.

chatpoints.chat_text: Hello! Welcome to Cabin Isle. Is there anything I can help you with?

replies.reply_text: No thanks, just looking around.
You sure can. Frannie sent me to pick up some supplies she ordered from you.
About those pirated goods... I was wondering if you could give me a little more information. I'm trying to track down the thieves.
Hello there. Seems like there was something you wanted me to do but I've forgotten what.
Hello, Vee! Did your missing goods show up by any chance?
Hey Vee! I forgot to ask you if Frannie Oakley got the supplies she was looking for.

I'm trying to chase a mysterious rider in a purple vest. Tighe said you might me able to help me. I understand a rider wearing a purple vest came through. You wouldn't happen to know where he was coming from, would you?
Could you remind me who you thought I should talk to regarding the mysterious rider in the purple vest?

chatpoints.chat_text: I was just looking for someone to give her the bad news. The boat that was carrying the supplies was waylaid by pirates.

replies.reply_text: Oh dear! I'll pass the message onto Frannie and leave you to your ordering then.
Whoa! I'm not going be telling anyone bad news! I may be crazy, but not that kind of crazy! Sorry, but you'll have to find someone else to deliver the bad news.

chatpoints.chat_text: I was hoping you'd tell Frannie that I don't have her order. The supply boat was pirated.

replies.reply_text: That's right. Okay. If I head down that way, I'll stop in and let her know.

chatpoints.chat_text: All I know is that Marina Mooring sent a message saying the supply boat came in empty and the captain of the ship said he'd been pirated.

replies.reply_text: Okay, thanks. That's strange. I haven't heard of any pirating going on lately. I think I'll head up there and see what else Marina can tell me.

chatpoints.chat_text: Yes they did! That pirate was shaking in his boots, offering up apologies to high heaven. I can't thank you enough for tracking down all the information.

replies.reply_text: Happy to do that for you. Did Frannie get the supplies she wanted?

chatpoints.chat_text: I made that sorry excuse for a pirate head down there with her supplies. He practically flew out of here. I'm sure he delivered them, but why don't you head down there and say hi. I'm sure she'd like to thank you for doing all that you did.

replies.reply_text: I've got some chores to attend to, but when I'm in the area, I'll be sure to check in on her. Thanks again and have a great day!

chatpoints.chat_text: As a matter of fact, a rider did come through here. I think he'd been out in the sun a bit too long as he was rambling about Frannie needing a funky bandana. Frannie is one of the most practical women I've ever met, and that just didn't sound like something she'd want. So I didn't think twice about sending him away with a piece of pie. Good riddance, I say!

replies.reply_text: Thanks. I'll head down to Frannie and see if she knows anything about this. And the pie looks delish! I'm going to eat it right now. Thank you so much.

chatpoints.chat_text: Head down to Frannie's. Maybe she can sort this all out.

replies.reply_text: Thanks so much!

npc_list.name: Anathema
npc_list.admin_description: 2nd Anathema (after quest that proves you are real)
npc_list.short_description: An eclectic recluse with wild fushia colored hair.

chatpoints.chat_text: Go away! Go away! Go away! You can't be here. Leave me alone!

replies.reply_text: Gesh! You are as grumpy as Ebenezer! I've leaving already.

npc_list.name: Frannie Oakley
npc_list.long_description: Frannie is a feisty cowgirl who looks like she can take care of herself in any situation.

chatpoints.chat_text: What brings you to these here parts, Stranger?

replies.reply_text: Oh, just wandering around, checking out the isle. Say, are you related to that famous folk hero, Annie Oakley?
Nothing much! Just looking for something to do. You wouldn't have any chores or errands that you could use some help with, do you?
Hey there, Frannie. About your missing supplies - I've reconsidered and would like to help you with that. Any suggestions on where to get started?
I've got unfortunate news for you, Frannie.
I've come to make sure Milo, that miserable excuse of a pirate, brought your goods back to you.
Seems like I had agreed to do something for you, or you wanted me to agree to do something for you, but I've been so busy, I've plum forgot!
Was there something I agreed to do for you?
Hello there. I was traveling through some wormholes and ended up on this isle. I found this cap that says Cabin Isle Caretaker. I thought that might be you?
There's an odd and convoluted tale I'm trying to unravel - something about a mysterious rider, sunburnt and blathering about a funky bandana.
Can you remind me just what it was that I was doing for you?
I'm back with the monkey! And it came to me with just one banana!
You remembered something about the mysterious rider. Can you remind me of what it was?

chatpoints.chat_text: Absolutely not. I was born an Oakley. She was born Phoebe Anne Mosey. She just went by the name Annie Oakley. But that's not to say I wouldn't have been proud to be related to her. She was an amazing woman.

replies.reply_text: Wow. So that wasn't her real name? Why would she do that?
