replies.reply_text: No, no I wouldn't.  I'm gone like yesterday's lightning.

chatpoints.chat_text: I see your confusion! I've helped you but have you helped ME? No! You grabbed what you came for and disappeared. Did you bother to ask what I wanted from the deal? No! It was all about you. I should turn you into a fly right now. I held up my part of the deal, and I expect you to hold up yours.

replies.reply_text: Gosh. You're right. I am so sorry. Really. My confusion. My fault. When I agree to do something, I follow it through. So, what do you need me to do?

chatpoints.chat_text: I need the frog's gems. The ones she uses to teleport from one pond to another. I can use that magic! (Her bulging eyes glitter in a way that makes you very, very uncomfortable.)

replies.reply_text: I don't think this is a good idea. I won't do it.
Well drat. The berry fairies would never forgive me if I left Murigal raising a ruckus forever and a day. Okay. I'll do it.
Any ideas where I should start looking?

chatpoints.chat_text: Ask the one in my cage! Would you like me to zap you into it? (Elphiblah suddenly looks very happy with this new thought. You best melt like ice on a summer's day - and fast!)

replies.reply_text: Nope. No need! I'm gone!

chatpoints.chat_text: You've made me wait. Obviously that is too long. Hand them to me, already!

replies.reply_text: Gesh! What a grouch. I had to go all over digging in mucky water to collect them. You could show some appreciation for my efforts. Does this mean I don't even get a thank you?
My apologies. I've had to travel all over searching the isles for them. But here they are! (<i>You place the Royal Gemstones on the ground next to the witch<?i>).
I already left! (You flee as quickly as you can - before the witch hexes you!)

chatpoints.chat_text: You didn't take notes? Use the potion on Murigal! Now go! Leave! Before I hex you!

replies.reply_text: Gone. I'm so gone.

chatpoints.chat_text: (Elphiblah leaps up, twirls around and lands with her back to you.) Go away! If you vex me, I'll be forced to hex you. I've had a bad day and I don't need to spend any more energy on hexing! GO AWAY!

replies.reply_text: Here's the thing. I really can't. I've agreed to help a wizard and if I don't, that will vex HIM and he might hex ME. I would be ever so grateful if you could work with me on this.
Not in the mood for being hexed today! I think I'll just take my leave and RUN!!!!!

chatpoints.chat_text: (Elphiblah leaps up, twirls around and lands facing you. She kind of chortle/laugh/croaks.) Soooooo, my Pretty! You've got yourself into quite a pickle! Seems you need my help most desperately!

replies.reply_text: (Her apparent glee at your desperation makes you very uncomfortable. Still, you gave your word to Festus. You swallow hard and take a deep breath.) It seems you are right.

chatpoints.chat_text: Of course I am! I am ALWAYS right! I love being right! You'll not find a witch that is more right than I am! I am the most right witch you'll ever find! Now, what is it that I can do for you?

replies.reply_text: I need a reversal potion for the hex you put on the wizard's raven. Please.

chatpoints.chat_text: Which wizard? Which raven? There are countless hexes I've graced the world with. A bit more information - before I become vexed. Get to the POINT!

replies.reply_text: Ah yes. Moldy Socks Festus and his Raven Beltran. Does that ring a bell?

chatpoints.chat_text: Do NOT question my memory! My mind is like a steel trap! Steel trap, I say! Of course it rings a bell! That raven thought much too highly of himself and was incredibly rude to me! Guess he isn't saying rude things now, is he?

replies.reply_text: Um. No. He isn't saying or doing or blinking or anything these days. Can I please get a curse reversal or antidote or something for him? Please?

chatpoints.chat_text: Of course you can! Easy peasy! You just need to agree to my challenge. Easy peasy, as I said.

replies.reply_text: (You've got a suspicion that for YOU nothing involved will be easy peasy! However, you gave your word.) Okay, let's do this! What's the challenge.
This sounds like an awful idea.  I'm out.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh, just a little something I like to call The Three Dares.

replies.reply_text: UGH! (This doesn't sound good! Next time, find out what's involved before you agree!) And what might those dares be?

chatpoints.chat_text:
The first dare - to bring me physical proof that the legend of a frightful most hideous beast is more than just foolish chatter.
The second dare - to fetch me a skein of the silken strands of a most accomplished spinner.
And lastly, the third dare - to present me with a rare and magical gryphon's egg.

replies.reply_text: Wow. Can you give me any hints where I might get that stuff?
Okey-dokey. Guess I'd better get started.
Perfect! I've got those right now.
I believe I've given you all the things you asked for.

chatpoints.chat_text: Let see what you've brought.

replies.reply_text: May I present you with one rare and magical gryphon's egg.
Here is a skein of the silken strands of a most accomplished spinner.
I offer proof that the frightful, most hideous beast exists.
Looks like I've given you everything.
That's all for now. I'll be back with more.
I have something else!
I think that's everything.
I'll come back later with more.
I have something else!
That should be all you requested!
I have something else!
That should be everything on the Three Dares list.
Yes I did! Now, may I please have whatever it is to change Beltran back again?

chatpoints.chat_text: You want the Curse Reversal Potion, do you? Ask nicely. VERY nicely!

replies.reply_text: May I please, please have the Curse Reversal Potion. Pretty please with a cherry on top?

chatpoints.chat_text: Why ever would I want a cherry? Foolish mortal! I'm a frog, not a kid in an ice cream shop!

replies.reply_text: Thank you, thank you! I'm so gone! (You skedaddle out here as quickly as you can.)

npc_list.name: Charles
npc_list.admin_description: New quests/chat must start at CP 5
npc_list.long_description: This frog has a rather regal appearance. It might be the purple cloak he has draped around his shoulders. Or maybe its the tiny crown perched on his warty head.

chatpoints.chat_text: Ribbit! Do my eyes deceive me or have a I spied a human? Indeed! I have. Greetings! And welcome to my royal home.

replies.reply_text: Greetings to you, too.
Thank you for that welcome. I was wondering what a charming frog such as yourself was doing on an island like this?

chatpoints.chat_text: Ah! A sordid tale of love gone wrong. I was searching for a true love, and vexed a witch. She hexed me into a frog and next thing I knew, I was here. Ribbiting day and night, night and day. The sadness of it all!

replies.reply_text: That's very interesting. If I could just share something, it might give that story a happy ending. (You lean forward and quickly spray Charles with a big squirt of the Love Potion #9.)
Ugh. A sad story. I'm gone like yesterday's sneeze!

chatpoints.chat_text: (Charles is so startled that he flips backwards and his crown flies off his warty head. Then Charles jiggles. And wiggles. And spins around three times. He falls to his side, his eyes roll back, and his tongue slides out. Oh dear! He looks lifeless!)

replies.reply_text: Charles! Charles! Wake up! (You wiggle and jiggle and nudge and budge the frog. Finally he lets out a slow, low moan.)
Dead frog! RUN!!!!

chatpoints.chat_text: Ohhhh. I feel so strange.

replies.reply_text: But are you okay? You gave me quite the scare!
I think I'll just leave you now!

chatpoints.chat_text: I think so. Actually, yes. Now that I consider it. I'm feeling more than okay. I'm feeling quite hopeful! I think I sense a bit of love in the air. Ribbit! Ribbit!

replies.reply_text: In that case, I'd better skedaddle pronto! I've got more work to do with this potion!

chatpoints.chat_text: Ribbit! Love is in the air! In the air I say! And how is your day going?

replies.reply_text: Quite well, thanks for asking. I'm in a rush and must hurry off. Good day, good day!

npc_list.name: Murigal
npc_list.admin_description: After she finds Charles, her true love.
npc_list.long_description: Murigal looks like a frog in love. She keeps batting her eyes and swooning.

chatpoints.chat_text: Hello, hello, hello! Ribbit!

replies.reply_text: Looks like things are working out well for you.
Hello to you, too! Lovely to see you again, but I've no time to chat. See you later!

chatpoints.chat_text: Absolutely, wonderously, magically, splendifically yes! I see you've met Charles, my one and only true love! I never thanked you for all your help.

replies.reply_text: Thanked me? Well, I suppose thanks are in order. After all, because of me, you have found your true love!

chatpoints.chat_text: You did more than that! What is the worth of knowing to ribbit? Silver? What is the worth of being free? Gold?  And the worth of true love? Priceless! However, living here in a pond, as a frog,

replies.reply_text: Wow! Thanks so much. Good to see true love wins the day!

npc_list.name: Horacio
npc_list.long_description: This man looks just like Cordovan. No surprise there - as the two men are brothers.

chatpoints.chat_text: Hola! Welcome to our humble abode.

replies.reply_text: Hello to you too. I'm just passing by right now, but thank you for the offer.
What a nice welcome! I don't mean to bother you, but I was wondering if you knew anything about petroglyphs?
I was wondering if there was anything you needed? I'm putting together a shopping list for the island residents.

chatpoints.chat_text: Muy poquito. In fact, I know so little, you may know more than me!

replies.reply_text: I doubt that. So, there are these boulders around the island, and they've got odd petroglyphs carved on them. Can you tell me something about them?
Well I doubt you'll be much help then. Never mind!

chatpoints.chat_text: There is a tale, of an explorer, many, many moons ago who wrote a book about these petroglyphs. But more than that, I cannot tell you.

replies.reply_text: More than that, meaning what? More about the petroglyphs? The explorer? The book?
Great. You've been no help at all!

chatpoints.chat_text: The explorer was a woman, but I don't know of her name. I don't know what happened to the book. And for the petroglyphs, all I know is that no one on this island can tell you what they mean. Oh, I did remember one small thing.

replies.reply_text: Please, do tell.
I think I'm going to need a lot more information than one small thing. Thanks anyway.

chatpoints.chat_text: When Josoca was building her hut, she found something she believed was related to those carved boulders. Whether she is correct or not is not for me to say. But it might be worth your while to talk to her about it.

replies.reply_text: Hmm. That isn't much, but it seems its the only thing that offers hope. Thanks for that bit of information. Hopefully, it'll pan out.

chatpoints.chat_text: My lovely wife handles those details. You would need to ask her.

replies.reply_text: Of course! Thanks for letting me know.

npc_list.name: Vega
npc_list.long_description: Vega is busy making tortillas for her family. Her hands work quickly, shaping the dough into thin discs and charring them on the stove's griddle.

chatpoints.chat_text: Come in! Would you like to join us? We are just getting ready to eat and I've got plenty of ricotto rellenos and sopa.

replies.reply_text: Oh no! Thank you very much but I've already eaten. Although it certainly smells mouth watering! Perhaps another day.
That is a very kind offer. But I'll have to pass. I need to make some money and was hoping to find someone who needed errands run.
Was there something I was doing for you?

chatpoints.chat_text: You are welcome back anytime. Have a lovely day!

replies.reply_text: Thanks!  Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: I have just used the last bit of my corn husks. I can't make any more tamales without them. I would be happy to pay you if you could get me some. You would need to ask Bettina to add it to the monthly list.

replies.reply_text: Monthly list? I don't understand.
It's a reallly long trip out here. I don't think I can do it for one small request like corn husks. I'm so sorry.

chatpoints.chat_text: As I'm sure you've noticed, Dog Isle is pretty much out in the middle of nowhere. We try to be as self-sufficient as we can, but there are always things we need from other islands. So, Bettina keeps a running list, and usually about once a month, some kind stranger agrees to do the town's shopping.

replies.reply_text: Wow. I never thought about that aspect of living on a small island before. But that totally makes sense. So, do you know if that would pay well?
That makes sense. Unfortunately, doesn't look like I'm going to be that kind stranger. Good day and good luck.

chatpoints.chat_text: I suspect it depends on how much shopping there is to do. You might want to talk to Bettina about it.

replies.reply_text: I would be happy to do that. So, you want corn husks, correct?

chatpoints.chat_text: Si! Six dozen would hold me over for the season. Bettina can tell you where to get them. Since deliveries were made just recently, that's all this family needs for now.  Gracias.

replies.reply_text: Happy to help. I'll head over to Bettina's now.

chatpoints.chat_text: Indeed there was! You were going to get me 6 dozen corn husks so I could make tamales. You need to see Bettina about the community shopping list.

replies.reply_text: That's right. I'll get that taken care of a.s.a.p!
Done and done! Here they are.
And thank you!

npc_list.name: Tomas
npc_list.long_description: Tomas is the eldest son and very proud of that fact! Tomas was named after a great-grandfather who was a famous explorer. Tomas can't wait to grow up and start exploring his world.

chatpoints.chat_text: (Tomas is deeply focused on looking through his map collection. And he has quite the collection!)

replies.reply_text: (You hate to bother him, so you look for someone else to talk to here.)

npc_list.name: Rico
npc_list.long_description: Rico is the middle son. Rico loves reading. Unfortunately, there is no library on Dog Isle so he has to read the few books he has over and over again.

chatpoints.chat_text: Hello. Do you have any books that I could borrow? I love reading and there is not much to read here on the island.

replies.reply_text: I'm so sorry, I don't. If I come across any, I'll be sure to bring them to you. Bye now!

npc_list.name: Ociel
npc_list.long_description: Brother of Vega, Ociel's name means sky, which is perfect, as Ociel loves to study clouds in the sky. Most especially, the different clouds and what that means regarding the changing weather. That makes him a Meteorologist Nepholologist!

chatpoints.chat_text: Hola! Hello and welcome to our home.

replies.reply_text: Hola and hello to you, too.
Thank you so much! I'm putting together a shopping list and was wondering if there was anything you needed?
Thank you for that warm welcome. I believe you had something on the community shopping list. Can you remind me what you needed?

chatpoints.chat_text: Si! I would love for you to check out a book for me on clouds. I understand the library in Shellton just got a new one in.

replies.reply_text: Clouds? Like cirrus and cumulus? (Ociel gives you a big thumbs up!) Happy to add that to my list, but before I do, I see your wife is rocking the baby and I don't want to both her. Is there anything she might need?

chatpoints.chat_text: How considerate of you! You know what? My wife loves popcorn. Would you be so kind as to bring back some?

replies.reply_text: Absolutely! (You add a book of clouds and 2 bags of popcorn to your list.) Have a great day!

chatpoints.chat_text: Certainly. The Shelton library sent me a notice that a book of clouds just came in. I would like you to pick that up, and 2 bags of popcorn for my lovely wife, please.

replies.reply_text: Silly me! That's right here on my shopping list. I hope to be back soon.
Perfect! I've got everything you need right here with me.
So glad I could help out. And I appreciate your generosity. Have a wonderful day.

npc_list.name: Oribella
npc_list.long_description: Oribella is a cherubic, chubby cheeked baby girl. There is a smattering of freckles across her nose. Isn't she adorable?

chatpoints.chat_text: (Oribella is fast asleep in her mother's arms. As the saying goes, don't wake sleeping babies!)

npc_list.name: Bonita
npc_list.long_description: Bonita is a rosy cheeked young lady with a cheerful and welcoming smile.

chatpoints.chat_text: (Bonita is rocking the baby. They are both smiling. Isn't that sweet?)

replies.reply_text: (You hate to interrupt the loving interaction between mother and daughter, so you kindly leave them be.)

npc_list.name: Jocosa
npc_list.long_description: Her name means joking - and she thinks she has one heck of a sense of humor! She loves making people laugh. Once you engage her in some real conversation, she might get a giggle out of you. But then again, not everyone thinks she's as funny as SHE thinks she is!

chatpoints.chat_text: I'm collecting seashells by the seashore, kicking up the seashore sand! And you?

replies.reply_text: Uh, no. Just riding through!
I'm hot on the heels of a mystery. Horacio mentioned that you found something you thought might be related to the petroglyphs on the pyramids of this island?
I'm creating a new shopping list. Is there anything you need?
Was there something I was doing for you?

chatpoints.chat_text: I love mysteries! And what I found is mysterious, just as, my friend, you are! (Jocosa lays her hand on your forehead.) You say you're hot but you don't appear to be running a fever. Do you feed a fever and starve a cold? I can't remember. Either way, would you like a sand witch?

replies.reply_text: Sand witch? I think you mean sandwich. And no, no, no. I don't have a fever. I meant to say I was tracking a mystery. That's all.

chatpoints.chat_text: What do you call a witch that lives at the beach? Sand witch! Ah ha ha ha. What day of the week do witches cook their victims? Fry day! Ha ha ha ha. How do you make a witch itch? You take away her 'W'! Ha ha ha!

replies.reply_text: ARGH!!! Can you please focus? Horacio said you found something? When you were building your home. Something you thought related to the pyramids on the isle.
Not interested in jokes. Especially lame ones. Gosh! I'm gone.

chatpoints.chat_text: Ohhhhh! I did indeed. You are such a serious person. Okay, I can be serious too.

replies.reply_text: Wonderful. What did you find? Can I see it? Please? And why do you think it has something to do with the petroglyphs on the pyramids?

chatpoints.chat_text: Goodness! So many questions. I found a very odd key. Yes you can see it. And when you see it, you'll see why I think it has something to do with the pyramids. Hang on just a minute. (Josoco pulls a loop of string out of her pocket. There is a small golden key attached to the string.)

replies.reply_text: Wow! That is one weird key! (<i>Looking closely, you see tiny symbols on it that look like petroglyphs, along with the symbol of a pyramid.

chatpoints.chat_text: I would love some chickens. Three would be lovely. Say! What do you call a flapping chicken? Poultry in motion! What does a chicken do at the gym? They egg-cercise!

replies.reply_text: Ha. Ha. Chickens? You want chickens?

chatpoints.chat_text: Yes I do. The sand fleas here are fierce! I'm sure chickens will help keep them at bay.  Three of the Minorca breed, please. They are well suited to the hot and humid conditions here.

replies.reply_text: Please. Stop with the jokes already. I'm putting chickens on my list. (And you do!) Good-bye for now!

chatpoints.chat_text: You offered to get me some chickens. Minorca was the breed I requested. And by the way, do you know what you call a mischievous egg? A practical yolker! Ha ha ha ha!

replies.reply_text: Why, I did know that. And I have those chickens right here.
That's right! Hopefully, I'll be back soon.

chatpoints.chat_text: Ohhhhh! I love their plumage!

replies.reply_text: Ah... right. Thanks. (Time to leave Jocosa to her jokes.)

npc_list.name: Alejandro
npc_list.long_description: Alejandro is Horacio and Vega's youngest son, who, unfortunately, loves playing in the dirt. He has dirt in his hair, on his face, and all over his clothing. Every time he moves, he leaves bits of dirt and leaf debris behind him.

chatpoints.chat_text: Hello. Do you want to play with me? I'm making mud castles.

replies.reply_text: I'm not very good with mud, but thanks for the offer.

npc_list.name: Sundance
npc_list.long_description: This is one bedraggled looking cowboy! Long legged and with a leathery face as wrinkled as a prune, he's probably spent most of his life out in the sun.

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, hey there, Stranger! When'd the wind blow you in?

replies.reply_text: The wind didn't blow me here. I got here all by myself! Just now. But it is really windy here today.
It blew me in just now and it is blowing me out just as quickly! Good-bye!
You said you might need my services some day. Did you have something you needed me to deliver?
Just about 2 seconds ago. Was there something I was doing for you?
Not sure. I wasn't paying much attention to the time. I've been so busy doing something for YOU! And now I've got some maybe good, maybe not-so-good news.

chatpoints.chat_text: Windy? This ain't windy. Why yesterday, it was so windy it blew them cacti inside out and backside out again! It was so windy it blew that yonder Sand Castle into bits of sand and then right back into a Sand Castle again!

replies.reply_text: I'm not sure I'm buying this. Sounds like a tall tale to me. Good day, Sir.
Wow. That is windy. Here - let me give you this package before the wind blows it away.

chatpoints.chat_text: So you're the acting agent for the Pony Express, eh?

replies.reply_text: Thanks! And I am the acting agent for the Pony Express. So I must get back to Pony Expressing! Have a fine day.

chatpoints.chat_text: I do indeed! I'd like you to deliver something to my horse. He's the fastest horse around. Why, he is so fast, he can outrun the wind. He is so fast, the wind takes training lessons from him. He is SOOOO fast, if you blink your eyes, you'll miss him.

replies.reply_text: If he's so fast, how am I going to get close enough to deliver something to him?
Yikes! What's with the wind? I think I'll make like the wind and blow right out of here.

chatpoints.chat_text: Don't you worry your head about that! He's fast when I'm riding him. And as you can clearly see, I'm not riding him right now. But if I WERE riding him, why, we'd run circles around you so fast, we'd stir up a whirlwind!

replies.reply_text: Yeah, yeah, yeah. Whatever! Watch how fast I leave this place!
Okay. I got it. He's super duper fast. And you want me to deliver something to him?

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, you'll have to find him to do that. Finding him isn't always easy. It can be quite the challenge. It can be so challenging, some people might want to quit before they acually find him. But if you persevere and actually find Hindsight, then yes. I do want you to deliver something to him.

replies.reply_text: Ugh! Can you just get to the point? Where do I find him and what do I give him?
Oh, look at the time! Time for me to leave this craziness behind!

chatpoints.chat_text: Will you do it, or won't you?

replies.reply_text: Fine. I'll deliver whatever it is you need to have delivered. Can you PLEASE tell me where to find this horse of yours?

chatpoints.chat_text: Sure, sure. But first things first. You'll need to pick up the package from the vet in Tropicton. And for where you'll find Hindsight?

replies.reply_text: That's not fair. You should have said I'd have to make a trip to Tropicton BEFORE I agreed. But fine. Whatever!
That will work.  I had to head that direction anyway.  Bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: Well yes there was. You were going to head over to Tropicton to get a package from the vet that you were supposed to deliver to Hindsight. Ring any bells?

replies.reply_text: Now that you mention it..... Yes it does. I'll be back. Sooner or later. Probably later. Much later!
And where could I find Hindsight again?

chatpoints.chat_text: Good news is always good to hear. Not-so-good news isn't. So tell me, which is it?

replies.reply_text: I'm not sure. I got the package from the vet in Tropicton, and boy was it stinky! Then I delivered it to your horse. And he ate it. I'm a little worried that he shouldn't have done that and now he might get sick.

chatpoints.chat_text: That's fantastic news! That's his seaweed supplement. He ate it because that's just what he is supposed to do. Smelly stuff but just what he needs to keep healthy.

replies.reply_text: Wow. Thanks.
Excuse me. Not that I mind being paid in diamonds. I don't at all. I'm just wondering why you don't use money?

chatpoints.chat_text: Well shoot. I much prefer the barter system. You know, trade stuff instead of money. And with the wind always blowing so much, it is likely to blow any money I get clean across the island and into the ocean. Why, it is so windy here...

replies.reply_text: Yeah, yeah, yeah. You alread told me all about the wind. Speaking of which, I'm going to let the wind blow me right out of here!

chatpoints.chat_text: He grazes in the grass that is soooo green, it makes Envy jealous! That'd be the grass between the desert and the sandcastle. Or there abouts.

replies.reply_text: Okay, thanks.

npc_list.name: Hindsight
npc_list.long_description: Hindsight is a fine example of a horse. Beautiful with bright eyes, bushy tail and a golden coat with a healthy sheen. He is alert, but calm, respects your space, yet inquisitive. Just the kind of horse you'd like to own. Sundance is one lucky fellow!

chatpoints.chat_text: (The horse lowers his head and looks at you with kind eyes.)

replies.reply_text: Hey there. Aren't you a pretty one!
I've got something for you. Look!
Really? You ate it? I sure hope that was what Sundance intended and you don't get sick!

npc_list.name: Anastacia Selsup
npc_list.long_description: Anastacia is bundled up in a fur hat and wool coat. Her breath fogs the air. It makes you wonder if you've dressed warmly enough to visit this place! However, her warm welcoming smile makes you want to stay, no matter how cold it is here.

chatpoints.chat_text: Welcome, welcome! I hope you enjoy visiting our little isle.

replies.reply_text: Thanks! In the meantime, I have a delivery for you.
If everyone is as welcoming as you are, I am sure I will.
I'm a wandering soul looking for odd jobs...is there anything I can do for you?
Sorry Anastacia, but what am I doing for you again?
Hi Anastacia, I'm back!  I have packages from each household.
Thank you so much and have a most awesome day!
Thanks. Say, do you custom make knitted goods? I was thinking I could use a new pair.

chatpoints.chat_text: I hadn't thought about doing so, but I'll consider it. Ask me again in a month or two.

replies.reply_text: Will do! Bye for now.

chatpoints.chat_text: Hmmm, I just might.  There's a cargo ship coming by any time now to drop off supplies for the island.  Could you check with my neighbors to see if they have any packages they need sent out?

replies.reply_text: That seems like too much bother, maybe next time I'm around.  Bye!
Sure, I can do that!
OK, I'm off to check on everyone, be back soon!

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh dear, I asked you to check with everybody to see if thay have anything that needs to be shipped on the cargo ship.  Now hurry, the ship is almost here!

replies.reply_text: I'm sorry, I forgot.  I'm on it right now!!

chatpoints.chat_text: Wonderful!!

replies.reply_text: Well, Svetlana sent this.
Olena sent these.
Lesia sent this.
I believe I gave you everything.
I think I might still have a person or two to talk to.  I'll be back.
Embroidery?  I was wondering what was in there.  But I have more.
I believe I gave you everything.
Yes, Seniors do seem to like to keep in touch by mail.  But I have more.
I believe I gave you everything.
It truly is exquisite...and yes she said it's for the Easter Bunny.
I believe I gave you everything.
Um, thanks I think.  I've got to go now, see you next time!

npc_list.name: Maricella
npc_list.long_description: Maricella is a bubbly happy young girl adored by her brothers, who love spoiling her .

chatpoints.chat_text: Hi there! Do you like picarones? Mamma makes the best ones ever.

replies.reply_text: I'm afraid I don't know what picarones are, so I don't know if I like them or not.

chatpoints.chat_text: Ohhh! You will like them a lot! My best friend Giuliana loves them as much as I do. Mamma is going to make them for dessert tonight.

replies.reply_text: I certainly like dessert, but I can't stay for dinner.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh that is so sad! I will cry for you. ( Maricella's face suddenly crumples as she breaks into tears. Then just as suddenly, her face brightens into a huge smile. ) Then maybe Mamma will give me your helping of them!

replies.reply_text: Well if she does, you make sure you enjoy them for me! Bye for now.

npc_list.name: Tika
npc_list.admin_description: After returned to Giuliana
npc_list.long_description: A little monkey with a sparkly pink collar around its neck. What a cutie!

chatpoints.chat_text: Eee-eee-eee-eeek!

replies.reply_text: No worries. I'm not going to hurt you.

npc_list.name: Rowdy Wellshod
npc_list.long_description: Owner of Equestrian Park Farrier, Rowdy is a friendly looking man with bright red cheeks and a long beard that's a bit singed around the edges.

chatpoints.chat_text: Good day. Do your horse's hooves need balancing? Seen too many shoddy fittings lately. That'll take your horse right out of action you know.

replies.reply_text: No, actually, I'm good and my horse is good. But thanks for asking.
My horse is good. I have some spare time on my hands and I was looking for something to do. Do you have any errands you need help with?
Hey Rowdy! Can you remind me where to look again?
Good day? It is a great day! I've found your fishing pole.

chatpoints.chat_text: Actually, I do. I was out fishing this morning and snagged a big bass. That fish yanked my pole right out of my hands. I had my good chaps on and wasn't about to go into that water. You'd be doing me a big favor in finding it for me.

replies.reply_text: Well that seems easy enough. I just have to go wading into the pond here?
Wading in water doesn't sound appealing right now. Slimey, stinking, muddy, buggy. All that. Sorry!

chatpoints.chat_text: No, no. I was fishing up north a bit. The problem was a heron swooped in and snagged my fish and flew off - pole and all. That darn bird  landed somewhere in the cotton patch and I lost track of it. I'm hoping my pole is still somewhere in there.

replies.reply_text: Well sure, I can search the cotton patch for you. I'd be happy to do that.
I'm sure I'll be back in a jiffy.

chatpoints.chat_text: The cotton patch just north of here. And again, I sure appreciate your efforts.

replies.reply_text: Happy to help! I'll head there now.
Thanks so much and have an awesome day!

npc_list.name: Karta Gruffee
npc_list.long_description: A very serious looking young woman. She is resting against an overstuffed backpack and looks right at home sitting on the ground. You see an assortment of tools laying next to her, including a compass, protractors, dividers, rulers, and colored pencils.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh! You startled me. I thought I was the only one out here in the middle of nowhere!

replies.reply_text: That makes two of us! I didn't expect to see you, either. Now that we know there are two of us out here, may I ask what you are doing sitting there?

I've been busy and suddenly realized that I was going to do something for you. I know, embarrassing, right? Tell someone you are going to do something and then forget to do it! What can I say? I am a busy adventurer! Can you remind me what it was?
I've got something for you, Karta!
Hello and goodbye!

chatpoints.chat_text: It is my life's goal to create a map to document each and every place that I find fascinating and unusual. And that is my intent with this lovely spot.

replies.reply_text: What is so unusual about this spot?
Sounds intriguing. Well, I'll leave you too it. Enjoy!

chatpoints.chat_text: I find the deposits look strikingly like they could be constellations. Especially if you kind of squint your eyes and tilt your head just so. (Karta tilts and squints to show you what she means.)

replies.reply_text: Ohhh....kay.....  If you say so! Well, its time for me to head out. Good luck with your map making.
Hmmm. You might have a point there. But you don't look very happy. Anything amiss?

chatpoints.chat_text: Unfortunately, my luck has skipped a beat. I seem to be missing my astrolabe. It is a family heirloom. It belonged to my great-grandfather and I am just heartbroken about losing it.

replies.reply_text: Well that is a bit of unfortunate luck. Hope you find it! Toodle loo!
Maybe I could help you find it. I'm pretty good at that sort of thing.
Why would you want to use something so outdated as an astrolabe?

chatpoints.chat_text: Really? That would be wonderful. I got all settled down here with my backpack and all my tools and notepads and then it hit me - I must have left it behind. I feel so foolish. Your help would be so appreciated.

replies.reply_text: I'll do it!
So sorry. Don't have time to be dilly-dallying around in the jungle. Good day.
I know just the place you are talking about! See you soon.

chatpoints.chat_text: It is very sentimental to me. While I could use a sundial and such, I'd rather use the very instrument that my great-grandfather used. He was a very famous map maker.

replies.reply_text: Well then it seems fitting that I go find it for you!
Well that is all very nice, but I really must be on my way.

chatpoints.chat_text: You were going to find my astrolabe that I left down south.

replies.reply_text: That's right! In the area where you answer a riddle to part the jungle thickets! It is all coming back to me now. I shall head there now and return quickly.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh my gosh! You are awesome! I can't believe my eyes. Thank you. Just in time. I was getting ready to stretch my legs.

replies.reply_text: You are welcome, and thank you! These will do just fine.

npc_list.name: Barbette Dingee
npc_list.long_description: A cheerful woman who says crazy things, just for laughs. At least that's what she's hoping for. She is actually a very good-natured person and just wants everyone to be happy.

chatpoints.chat_text: Day-be-day-be-day! Daaayyyy! Ooohh! Day-a-a-oh! Skiddle-be-rue. And how do you do?

replies.reply_text: Umm. Fine. Actually, busy. So busy, I need to leave right this minute!
Well you certainly are a happy camper! And look what I've got for you! A Pony Express delivery.
I'm doing fine. You wouldn't by any chance have an errand or two you'd like done?
Please remind me what I was doing for you?
I'm back, Barbette! Your package made Hank laugh out loud without even opening it. Oh, and he sent this over for you.

chatpoints.chat_text: Walla walla zingo bingo!

replies.reply_text: Thanks, and walla walla zingo bingo to you too!

chatpoints.chat_text: I do, I do, I do! Indeed, I do!

replies.reply_text: Alrighty then. Maybe you could tell me what you need done and I could get started on it?

chatpoints.chat_text: Silly, silly me! Yes, please. Yes, please. If you would be so kind as to take this package to Hank I would so appreciate it.

replies.reply_text: I'll head over now.

chatpoints.chat_text: Day-be-day-be-day! Ohhh! It was my lumpy bumpy gift for grumpy Hank. Trying to cheer the boy up.

replies.reply_text: Okay dokey. I'll get that over to him now.

chatpoints.chat_text: (Barbette has a twinkle in her eye as she breaks out in a huge grin.) Just what I was hoping for! He has a great laugh. Shooby-do-blue! Looky here! A flamingo! I love it.

replies.reply_text: Thanks so much!

npc_list.name: Felicity Fender
npc_list.long_description: Felicity is a serious looking woman who looks like she'd rather be elsewhere. Anywhere other than here! It makes you wonder why she works here, instead of traveling around the world.

chatpoints.chat_text: Did you need something? Yes? No? Speak up already. I've got things to do and can't stand around dilly-dallying all day.

replies.reply_text: Sorry. Didn't mean to bother you. I'll be out of your way in a flash.
I just need you to accept this package. It's a Pony Express delivery.
I'm trying to track down a rider who lost a monkey that might have come through here a couple days ago. Did you see anyone like that?
Who did you say I should talk to regarding a rider who lost a monkey?
Thank you, and good day.

chatpoints.chat_text: This is the busiest dock in the world! I can't keep track of who comes and who goes. But maybe Griffin can help you out. He watched the docks the other day while I ran some errands.

replies.reply_text: Thanks so much!

chatpoints.chat_text: Griffin. And good luck!

replies.reply_text: Thanks.

npc_list.name: Batten DeHatchez
npc_list.long_description: Batten is a burly fellow who looks like he's been living the sailor's life ALL his life!

chatpoints.chat_text: Howdy, howdy. Name's Batten, but you can call me Cap'n B.

replies.reply_text: Well hello and good day to you, Cap'n B. Just passing through...
Hello, Cap'n B. I am pleased to meet you. I also have a delivery for you!

chatpoints.chat_text: Well don't keep me waiting. I'm a busy man.

replies.reply_text: Oh, sorry. Here it is! (You hand over the package.)

chatpoints.chat_text: Just the hardware I needed! We had quite the storm come through and it loosened everything up on the dock.

replies.reply_text: Thanks so much!

npc_list.name: Haley
npc_list.long_description: Hudson's older sister Haley recently returned from her travels to the jungle isles.

chatpoints.chat_text: Certainly! I'm trying my hand at map making. I met a map-maker while I was in the jungle and learned a bit about different kinds of maps.

replies.reply_text: Sounds intriguing. Well, I'll leave you too it. Enjoy!
Would you by any chance be willing to make a map for me?

chatpoints.chat_text: (Haley is snuggled up under some quilts, napping on the sofa.)

replies.reply_text: (You probably shouldn't bother her.)
(Looking at the packages in your hands, you decide to wake her up.) Haley? Excuse me, but I have a delivery for you.

chatpoints.chat_text: (One big yawn and Haley is bright-eyed and wide awake.) Hello!

replies.reply_text: Thanks so much!
Thank you. By the way, I was wondering what you planned on using those for.

chatpoints.chat_text: When I was traveling in the jungle, I met a map-maker. I'm going to try my hand at making a map of Turtle Isle.

replies.reply_text: Sounds interesting. Well, good luck with map-making and have a great day!

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh goodness. I have no clue what I am doing. I'm just trying my hand at it, and at this point, not very successfully. If you want a map made, you should probably talk to Karta on Jungle Isle. She's a map making expert!

replies.reply_text: Thanks so much for giving me that lead. I'll head over there now. By the way, can you tell me in what part of Jungle I can find her? It is such a large island.

chatpoints.chat_text: (Haley is sitting cross-legged on the floor with several sketchpads spread out around her.) Hello there!

replies.reply_text: Looks like you've been busy with the sketchpads I delivered to you. I'll leave you to it!
May I ask what you are doing with those sketch pads?

chatpoints.chat_text: I know she travels around, but the last time I saw her, she was near the bottom of the island.

replies.reply_text: Thanks so much!

npc_list.name: Scar-Nose Pete
npc_list.long_description: This is one ragged looking pirate. Pete's got a nose that is road mapped with scars. Looks like he was on the losing end of a battle. Or maybe two... or twenty...

chatpoints.chat_text: Ahoy, Matey. What can I do you for? (Now that you are face to face, you notice the pirate's totally scarred up bulbulous nose. And once you've seen it, its hard to draw your gaze away from it.)

replies.reply_text: Not much. I was just checking out the view.
Nothing much today, but thanks for asking.
You could remind me what I needed to do next to help you. That would be really helpful!
I got the smores!
Scar-Nose Pete! About the Great Buried whatever you called it thingy....
I got the riddle from Barbossa!
Scar-Nose Pete! About the Great Buried whatever you called it thingy....
What did you say I needed to do with this scrap of paper?
I've solved The Great Pirate Buried Treasure Puzzler  and I've returned with the goods.
I failed to get a reward for all my efforts on getting you those 7 ornate chests.
Hello, hello! I'm back for my reward.

chatpoints.chat_text: Ye ain't checkin' out me nose, are ye? Iff'n ye are, I be telling' you right now, I've got a cutlass that'd make yer nose match mine! Then ye can look in the mirror and check yerself out any day o' the week!

replies.reply_text: No, no, no! Not at all. I was just... gazing. Yes! Gazing. Ummm...gazing at the ocean views. Look! 180 degrees of ocean views.

chatpoints.chat_text: I kin tell ye a thing or two about ocean views. I seen tons o' ocean views. Traveling here 'n there. Drifting and drifting and drifting. And drifting.

replies.reply_text: Drifting. I get the point. That sounds like a sad tale. How about you hold that story for another day. I've got to gallop!
That sounds sad.

chatpoints.chat_text: It be far worse'n sad. It be tragic. I was on a great adventure 'til this huge wave rose and rose. It rose so high ye couldn't see o'er it. Then - KABOOM - it smashed down into me ship. Shattered the mast. Shredded me sails. Left me hull in splinters. Nothing for me to do but drift about, riding them waves for days and days and days.

replies.reply_text: Wow. So, you were adrift at sea. And then what happened?
Days and Days. This sounds pretty repetitive and boring to me. I'm just going to ride off and find another adventure.

chatpoints.chat_text: Barbossa found me. Not the best company, but there be times when a pirate ain't got no choice. We washed up here. That's when I discovered he's got a secret, he does. It gots to be somethin' about TGPBTP.

replies.reply_text: Who? The bird?
The TGPBTP?

chatpoints.chat_text: Aye, the bird. I got 'em to tell me the riddle one time, and one time only. Iffin’ ye can solve the riddle, I'd be kind enough ta share a bit o' the reward wit ye.

replies.reply_text: Hmmm. I might be tempted. What will you pay me? Diamond necklaces? Lots and lots of diamond necklaces?

Sorry, that's just not something that interests me. Perhaps, someday, if I get bored of entering my horse into competitions, I might consider it. For now, I'm leaving you two to your own company. Toodle-loo!

chatpoints.chat_text: Are ye cracked in the skull? Do it look like I be sitting on diamond necklaces? Do ye think I'd be giving passage on this dinky beat up boat if I had diamond necklaces? Ye think I wouldn't buy me a yacht and leave this here island? Ye be daft, I say. Daft!

replies.reply_text: Well fine. What will you give me?
Makes sense, but I have to survive too.  Taking all that time looking for these treasures...

chatpoints.chat_text: Find them seven treasures, and bring 'em here. I'll be turnin' 'em o'er to the Cap'n. Whatever reward there be, ye be gettin' a share.

replies.reply_text: Seven treasures? What exactly are we talking about here?

chatpoints.chat_text: Ye gots to trick Barbossa. And ye best be havin' yer pen and paper ready, cuz he'll only be tellin' ye the riddle once.

replies.reply_text: Trick him? And how would I go about tricking him to give me this riddle?  He doesn't seem like a very friendly bird.

chatpoints.chat_text: Ye gots to trick Barbossa to hear the pirate riddle.

replies.reply_text: I'm not sure this rings much of a bell. Can you tell me about the riddle again?
And how to I trick him to giving me this riddle?

chatpoints.chat_text:
The tale be long an’ twisted, Matey.
‘Bout travels far and riches deep and a Cap’n who be
so legendary he be as close to mythical as…. as…. well.
Mythical. He hid seven treasures. Then he scattered 19
pieces of a puzzle ‘round the lands that ye gots to gather
up. Barbossa gots the riddle that be the key to findin' the
puzzle pieces. So unless ye get the bird to talk, ye ain’t
never gonna get no treasures. Got it?

replies.reply_text: Got it. I'm willing to help you on this. So, what happens now?
Got it, but passing on it too. This sounds way too complicated. Maybe someone else will come along to help you. Or maybe I'll change my mind. But not today. Have a great one.
Oh, right. So what exactly is the bird supposed to give me?

chatpoints.chat_text: He ain't givin' ya a thing but opportunity. Ye might get to hear the riddle. Make sure to write it down.

replies.reply_text: Okay. So what's the trick in tricking him? Give him a cracker or two?

chatpoints.chat_text: Barbossa got himself somethin' of a sweet tooth. He's got a powerful reaction to a Smore. But ye best be gettin' a couple if ye want to hear the whole riddle.

replies.reply_text: Seriously? Okay then. I know just where to get those! I'll be back.
Awesome! I've got some on me right now.

chatpoints.chat_text: Aye. The Great Pirate Buried Treasure Puzzler.

replies.reply_text: And that is, what exactly?

chatpoints.chat_text: I don't wan' 'em! Give 'em to Barbossa!

replies.reply_text: Oh right!

chatpoints.chat_text: That be yer problem, not mine, Matey.

replies.reply_text: Thanks a lot. For nothing!

chatpoints.chat_text: I don't want the riddle, I want the seven buried treasures! Ye gots to figure it out what the riddle be meaning.

replies.reply_text: That's all you can tell me?

chatpoints.chat_text: If I'd figure'd it out, I wouldn't be stuck here in this crummy job, now would I, Matey?

replies.reply_text: But I don't remember what he said!
UGH!! Fine! I'll figure it out on my own.

chatpoints.chat_text: The Great Pirate Buried Treasure Puzzler? What about it?

replies.reply_text: I found some odd tiles. I can't make any sense out of them. Will you take a look?
I don't know what to do with the information I got from Barbossa.
I've got all these keys in all these colors and I don't know what to do about them.

chatpoints.chat_text: Unless ye gots 19 of 'em, we ain't got nothin' to talk about.

replies.reply_text: That's the exact amount I have!
Alrighty then. I'll be back.

chatpoints.chat_text: (Scar-Nose Pete counts the tiles). Nineteen exactly. Hang onto yer topsail, this'll take a minute.

replies.reply_text: Well shoot. I'll go rake some more.
What am I supposed to do with this?

chatpoints.chat_text: This be The Great Pirate Buried Treasure Puzzler ye be working on. Ye didn't expect it to be easy, did ye?

replies.reply_text: Dang. I guess not.

chatpoints.chat_text: I told ye to write it down. Ya shoulda listened ta me. The bird'll tell a body once and never again. Can't help ye Matey. Sorry. That why I needed your help. Now I gots to hope someone else will come along to get the bird to talk. Shesh!

replies.reply_text: Argggg!

chatpoints.chat_text: Anagrams, Matey. Anagrams. They'll be giving you clues to where ye need to be headin' next.

replies.reply_text: Really? After all that traveling and raking and getting sand blown in my eyes? I have to figure out these words and then go somewhere else?

chatpoints.chat_text: Ye be tellin' me ya gots the seven chests of the legend? Ya solved The Great Pirate Buried Treasure Puzzler? I gots to see this to believe it!

replies.reply_text: Glad to see you so happy. Now about my reward...
Whoops. I'm sure I'll find them soon.  Bye.

chatpoints.chat_text: First things first, Matey. Many a pirate lived and died with that legend in their ears. It only be fitting I hear the tale. Do tell! An' don' be skippin' any juicy of the details.

replies.reply_text: (You tell Scar-Nose all about how you figured out the anagrams and dug beneath all the sand castles and got a ton of keys and convinced the dragons in the maze to step aside so you could dig.) May I please have my reward now?

chatpoints.chat_text: That be a fine tale. A fine tale indeed! I could listen to it again an' again. Tell ye what. I'll mosey these chests o'er to the Cap'n, jus' like I said I would when I first talked to you about this. Come back tomorrow and I'll have a reward waitin'.

replies.reply_text: Tomorrow? Gesh! Fine. I'll be back then. And don't think I'm going to forget about it either!

chatpoints.chat_text: Here ye go, Matey. And a fine reward ye be gettin'. I've a hankerin' to hear yer tale again, but wit' me share o' the reward,

replies.reply_text: Thanks for the reward and enjoy your travels!

chatpoints.chat_text: Them colors seem like they be all the clue ya need. Iff'n ye be itching' for a bit more, I could share a bit o' pirate lore wit' ye.

replies.reply_text: No thanks. I've got this!
Yes please. I just want to be done already.

chatpoints.chat_text:
Here be part o' an old lullaby me sweet mudder used to sing to me:
A need for 3 of each to best
each padlocked hidden treasure chest
The denizens of labyrinth sleep
upon the pirate’s treasure keep.

replies.reply_text: Diamond necklaces! A ton of diamond necklaces! Thanks so much!

npc_list.name: Toodles
npc_list.admin_description: Toodles lost on the beach
npc_list.long_description: A little monkey with a sparkly blue collar around its neck. What a cutie!

chatpoints.chat_text: (The little monkey is wet and is chittering very quietly. It looks scared and lost and is probably hungry.)

replies.reply_text: Hey little fellow! What are you doing here? Shouldn't you be on one of the jungle islands?

chatpoints.chat_text: (The little monkey is obviously scared and starts looking around for an escape route. It starts chittering in panic.)

replies.reply_text: Shhhhh, Its okay. I'm not going to hurt you. Look. I've brought you something. (You slowly place the banana on the ground.)
Well that worked nicely. Let's head back to Frannie's. I think you are going to like it at her place! That is of course, until we can find your real owner.

npc_list.name: Moldy Socks Festus
npc_list.admin_description: no new quests on this Festus
npc_list.long_description: Festus has no shoes on and is mucking around in patched up moldy socks through the jungle swamp. You totally understand where his name comes from but you can't begin to guess why he has - what looks like - a taxidermied raven stuck on the brim of his hat.

chatpoints.chat_text: (Festus is squish-squish-squishing around in the swamp in his patched up moldy socks. Suddenly the mage spots you and lets out a high pitch squeal.) You! Yes, YOU! Hold up there.

replies.reply_text: Uh, hello?
Eek! A freaky mage! RUNNNN!!!
Where did you say I could find the source of the swamp stench?
It's just me again. What IS that horrible purple stuff buried in the swamp?
I know! I know! I told you I would help you once the swamp stench was gone and now it's gone. That's why I'm back here - to help you! Now what is it that you need?
Yep. It's me. What was it that I needed to do again?
Yes, ME! The one that faced Elphiblah and had to do her stupid Three Dares challenge. But I did it. ME! I've got what you wanted - something to reverse the curse on Beltran!

chatpoints.chat_text: I am challenged here in this muckity-muck swamp and I need your help most expeditiously.

replies.reply_text: What? You want me to go on an expedition with you?

chatpoints.chat_text: Kindly do not mock me! Expeditiously means quickly, promptly, with speed and efficiency....

replies.reply_text: Yes, I know that. I was jesting. Actually, I need YOUR help most expeditiously.
Okay, okay already. I was teasing. I totally know what expeditiously means. Look, all I need to know is what is that horrible smell and how to get rid of it.

chatpoints.chat_text: BAH! (Festus swirls his robe around and stomps about. He removes his hat and asks the taxidermied raven stuck to the hat's brim, 'Beltran, what to do, what to do?' Of course, the raven doesn't answer him. ) You try to barter with me? I am offended by your impertinence!

replies.reply_text: Well, you need me and I need you. Sounds more like a win-win situation and not impertinence at all.

chatpoints.chat_text: (Festus squishes and squashes and twirls and whirls about. Finally he stops and glares at you.) Prey tell, you wish to suggest that you will do for me what I need done if I do for you what you need done to solve both of our dilemmas hence simultaneously benefitting the both of us?

replies.reply_text: Well, yes. Exactly. I'll help you if you help me. If what you need isn't unreasonable. Deal?

chatpoints.chat_text: Of course it isn't unreasonable! (He glares at you suspiciously.) Is what YOU want unreasonable? Ah ha! I've foiled your plan to trick me!

replies.reply_text: Busted. I might as well leave since I can't fool you. Not that I was going to trick you! I don't have time for that! I'm so outta here!
All I want is to stop the swamp from stinking.

chatpoints.chat_text: (Festus makes the 'zip-the-lips' gesture.) I've locked my lips and I'm not telling!

replies.reply_text: Seriously? You're the one who said you needed my help. But if you are going to act that way, I might as well just leave.

chatpoints.chat_text: (Festus nods to the raven and carefully puts his hat back on). A reciprocal agreement, eh? You want the swamp to be rid of the smell. In exchange, you will help me most expeditiously with my challenge?

replies.reply_text: Um, well, kinda depends on what exactly it is that you need. You never did say.

chatpoints.chat_text: (Festus mumbles and grumbles and somehow manages to look chagrinned!) It pains me to say this. (Festus shudders as if the thought of saying whatever it is he plans to say - really does pain him!) There was a witch that became vexed.

replies.reply_text: I have no idea who you're talking about and I don't think I want to know.  Good luck!
Ohhh! Let me guess! You vexed a witch and she hexed Beltran? (You can't help yourself from laughing - until Festus gives you the 'evil eye." That stops your laughter!)
Oh dear. I've dealt with that witch before. I think I'll just skedaddle right out of here!

chatpoints.chat_text: WAIT! I mean -- wait, please. I see we are at a bit of an impasse.

replies.reply_text: If you will allow me to make a suggestion. You appear to know something about the nasty smell from the swamp. I need that information. And you said you need my help. We can create a reciprocal agreement.

chatpoints.chat_text: (Festus throws up his hands in exasperation.) I need help with Beltran of course! Anyone with a wit of sense can see that he isn't his normal self! He's stiff as a board and doesn't squeak a peep. Doesn't blink his eyes and doesn't peck my cheek! (The old wizard is obviously very distressed by the state of the raven.)

replies.reply_text: Okay. Sure. If there's something I can do to help, I will. (You fervently hope that you haven't agreed too hastily!)
That's right. So remind me please what happened to your - er - um - Beltran?
Thank you! That smell burns my eyes and makes it hard to think. Once I take care of that, I'll be back to help you. (And you mean it! You'd hate to vex a crazy wizard!)

chatpoints.chat_text: You'll find that which stenches the swamp buried 'tween a pair swamps trees.

replies.reply_text: I think you said exactly the same thing the first time you said it! Thanks!

chatpoints.chat_text: An errant spell. I was distressed and misspoke and BOOM! Stench galore that moves about as if it has a mind of its own. Hence my decision to bury it.

replies.reply_text: I've never smelled anything so horrible! What can I do to make the stench disappear?

chatpoints.chat_text: Why don't you try to deodorize it.

replies.reply_text: Ooh-kay. And do you have a spell to do that?

chatpoints.chat_text: (Festus throws up his hands in exasperation again.) Do you think I ENJOY the stench? If I had a spell I would have used it. I did my part by telling you where the stench emanated from. Now it is in your hands! Go ask someone else what to do about it!

replies.reply_text: Okay, okay! Gosh you're grumpy!

chatpoints.chat_text: There is nothing - NOTHING - humorous about what happened to poor Beltran!

replies.reply_text: I'm sorry. It was insensitive of me to laugh. I don't look forward to dealing with HER again, but I told you I would help. What do you need me to do? Get some sort of spell reversal or something from her?
You're right.  I really shouldn't get involved though.  Bye!
I'm on my way!

chatpoints.chat_text: Visit the witch that hexed poor Beltran! You need to fetch an antidote or curse reversal or whatever! But do it quickly!

replies.reply_text: Ding, ding, ding! That rings a bell! I'm on my way.

chatpoints.chat_text: Go search for it! Gah!

replies.reply_text: Well that's not a real helpful response!

chatpoints.chat_text: Can this be true? (Festus takes off his hat with Beltran on the rim, then he reaches towards you with the other hand. It shakes as he takes the potion from you. You realize that with both hands full, he’ll be unable to pop the cork out of the vial, so you do that for him.)

replies.reply_text: Umm...  Okay.

npc_list.name: Baba Yaga
npc_list.short_description: A recent resident of Jungle Isle
npc_list.long_description: Baba Yaga's dark eyes glitter from under grey wispy hair that pokes out all over from her bun. She has a hooked nose and snaggled teeth. You aren't sure if that's a sneer or a smile she's aiming at you!

chatpoints.chat_text:
(The inside of the hut is even more frightening than the outside appearance. A huge cauldron is bubbling in the middle of the room. There are shelves lining every wall, and every shelf is filled with assorted bottles and jars of all types of strange things.)

Eh? What's that you said? Speak up!

replies.reply_text: (All you can think is - Scary woman - RUN!)
Wowzers! Are you Baba Yaga? The cruel witch?
Could you please remind me what you wanted for the soup, stew whatever?
Good day! I've brought you soup ingredients!

chatpoints.chat_text: (She hacks out a cough or two and blinks her beady eyes before croaking out a response to you.) There are two sides to every feather. An upside and a downside. Some say cruel. Some say benevolent. To the carrot in the ground, to be eaten would be cruel. To the hungry child I give the carrot to, that would be benevolent. Two sides, Deary. Two sides.

replies.reply_text: Fair point. Fair point, indeed. I've heard wild tales about you. How you've traveled far and wide. Personally, I think that's all some kind of grandiose hogwash to make you look more important than you really are!
I think I'll just take my leave now. Umm... have a nice day!
What a great perspective! I'll be sure to keep that in mind. Since I am here, is there anything you need help with?

chatpoints.chat_text: Be they tales or be they true, that's for me to know and not for you. Begone! (Baba Yaga's cauldron erupts into an explosion of smoke.)

replies.reply_text: Well now. Don't you feel silly!

chatpoints.chat_text: (Baba Yaga blinks her beady eyes.) An offer of help for an old biddy like me?

replies.reply_text: That's a good question! I think I'll just mosey on out of here.
I wouldn't call you an old biddy. (Baba Yaga gives you the 'slide-eye' so you know she doesn't believe you!) Getting back to helping people, I've been on all kinds of adventures doing that.

chatpoints.chat_text:
(Baba Yaga blinks her beady eyes rapidly. A gust
of wind blows through the house, bringing a raven with it!
The raven settles on Baba Yaga’s shoulder and appears to
whisper to the old woman. Baba Yaga’s face breaks into a
large toothy grin.) You've been deemed trustworthy.

replies.reply_text: (Well that's a bit creepy! It appears that the raven has been keeping an eye on you. On the bright side, Baba Yaga trusts you.) Wonderful! What can I do for you?
You know what? I just remembered I have a previous engagement. Goodbye! (You hurry out of there before anything else weird happens.)

chatpoints.chat_text: (Baba Yaga crooks her head sideways, sort of like an owl would. It kinda creeps you out but you keep smiling!) Go on, Deary. Go on.

replies.reply_text: I've made money and gotten all kinds of cool things. So for me, its more a question of why wouldn't I help you?
That's good advice! I think I will go on - right on out of here.

chatpoints.chat_text: Long are the days, longer the nights. My soul begs for the borscht of my youth. (The raven squawks as if in agreement.)

replies.reply_text: Borscht? That doesn't ring a bell. What is it?
Somehow, something about what you just said kinda creeps me out. I think I'll be moving on!
Sure.  I know what borscht is.  Super yummy.  What would you need me to bring?

chatpoints.chat_text: A soup, a stew, a broth of beets. A ladle of red, a sip of sweet. Root vegetables to ground the soul. Mother Earth incarnate in a bowl.

replies.reply_text: Ohhh-kayyyy. I heard the word 'beets.' You need me to get you some beets?
Hmm. You've got a lot going on there. I'm more in the mood for quick and easy. See ya!

chatpoints.chat_text: Beets. And carrots. (Baba Yaga squints her eyes as if she is thinking.) And potatoes and onions. Cabbage. And we mustn't forget the sour cream.

replies.reply_text: I'd be happy to help you with that.

npc_list.name: Karta Gruffee
npc_list.admin_description: (After returning her astrolab)
npc_list.long_description: A very serious looking young woman. She is resting against an overstuffed backpack and looks right at home sitting on the ground. You see an assortment of tools laying next to her, including a compass, protractors, dividers, rulers, colored pencils and an old fashioned astrolabe.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh! You startled me. I thought I was the only one out here in the middle of nowhere!

replies.reply_text: Opps! Didn't mean to startle you. I was hoping you could help me out on that map graph thingy?
Sorry about that. It is just me again. The Earton Librarian said a map maker could help me out with this letter. Oh and there was a (-2,1) and a (-3,0) on the envelope, if that makes any sense.
That makes two of us! I didn't expect to see you, either. Have a great day.
I'm sorry, but I don't remember what you told me about the letter the Postmaster gave me and who I need to deliver it to. Can you bring me up to date?
Sorry! Just me again. I'm hopeful that you remember that letter with directions for a map?

chatpoints.chat_text: Match the corner of the map that has the compass rose to the corner of the map that has clouds in it. So fold the map corner to corner using those indicators on which corners to use.

replies.reply_text: Ah! Okay. Now I understand. And I can do the same with the other 'wed' part. Whew!
Thanks, but I need a bit more help, please.

chatpoints.chat_text: (Karta reads the letter with great interest and returns it to you.) How exciting! These are directions for creating a graph on the backside of a map. It won't be precise, but it will give you a general area to search. The (-2,1) and (-3,0) are map coordinates. Given the terms of Pirate's Hat and Cloud, you need a map of the entirety of Horse Isle!

replies.reply_text: Wow! Darn it - my belly is rumbling. I'll have to come back later to talk to you about it.
Really? That sounds pretty cool. Can you tell who the letter should be delivered to?

chatpoints.chat_text: What part do you need help with?

replies.reply_text: I don't understand the 'wed' part.
What does 'map's backside' mean?
What is a compass rose?
I'm confused about the numbering part.
I've changed my mind. I'm going to try my hardest to figure this out. I just need to take my time and think about what the directions are saying!
What is the epicenter?
I don't understand what vertex means.
Do you have any tips you could share with me?

chatpoints.chat_text: I can't see a single clue here to determine who this should be delivered to. I think your best bet would be to make the map graph and see where it leads. These directions won't create a precise way to find exactly the spot these coordinates indicate. Just search in the general area.

replies.reply_text: Wow. That sounds really complicated. I think I'll just leave now. Maybe I'll be back some day when I feel more adventurous. Toodles!
Do you think you could help me create the map?
Awesome! I will take it from here. I'm smart and really good at figuring things out. If I need more help, I will come looking for you!

chatpoints.chat_text: I can give you some tips, but I only make maps of small parts of the isles at a time. Your best bet is to try to look at a map that shows all of Horse Isle.

replies.reply_text: Drat. Okay, I can do that. Once I'm looking at the map, what do I do?
Whoa there Nellie! This sounds like an awful lot of work. I think I'll pass for now.
Perfect! You don't need to say another word. This is my "lightbulb moment." I know exactly what to do now. Thanks so much and toodle-loos!
I've made the map, but what I don't understand is how to figure out how to plot the numbers that were on the envelope.

chatpoints.chat_text: You can trace it. I don't think it has to be perfect, but at the very least, you'll need the outlines of the isles. Make sure to include the larger isles, the compass rose and the Cloud Isles.

replies.reply_text: Okay. Thanks! I think I'll be able to handle it from here.
I think I need a bit more help. Once I get the outlines, then what?

chatpoints.chat_text: Sure! The letter is basically directions for creating a graph on a map of the entirety of Horse Isle. Isn't that cool? It must create some kind of treasure map.

replies.reply_text: Great. I can take it from here. Thanks so much for all your help.
Wow. That is cool. Can you help me do that?

chatpoints.chat_text: The intersection of where two or more lines meet is called a vertex.

replies.reply_text: Thanks! That helps a lot. Unfortunately, I still could use your help, please.

chatpoints.chat_text: Fold the map according to the directions. That part should be pretty easy.

replies.reply_text: Thanks. I think I need a bit more help beyond the folding part.
Easy peasy! I can do this! Yes I can! Yes I can! Ha-ha! That's my new motto! I'll get out of your hair now.

chatpoints.chat_text: That's the symbol on a map that shows the directions. For example, it points which way is North.

replies.reply_text: Ah! I didn't know that. Thanks so much.
Thanks, but I need a bit more help, please.

chatpoints.chat_text: Well, you'll have the map on one side of the paper, and if you flip it over, the back of the paper would be the map's backside.

replies.reply_text: That makes total sense! Thanks.
Thanks, but I need a bit more help, please.

chatpoints.chat_text: Using the backside of the map, put the paper up to a light source, like a window. You should be able to see the map showing through from the front side. Make sure the Clouds are in the lower right.

replies.reply_text: Okay, then what?

chatpoints.chat_text: You should have a total of 32 boxes created by the fold lines. There should be 8 across and 4 down.

replies.reply_text: Perfect. Thanks so much. I've got it from here.
Thanks, but I need a bit more help, please.
Okay, starting at 0, then what?

chatpoints.chat_text: The epicenter is the middle of the graph.

replies.reply_text: Ohhhh! Thanks.
Thanks, but I need a bit more help, please.

chatpoints.chat_text: You know, I have an exceptional short-term memory. My long term memory is not so great. As soon as you left, I copied down the directions. I figured they might be important.

replies.reply_text: Awesome! Can you tell me what they were? I need to make another map.

chatpoints.chat_text: Nope. That's long term memory. But I carved them into that curious upright boulder just east of here. I just carved the important stuff.

replies.reply_text: You are a life saver! Thank you so much.
Could you give me a bit more help?

chatpoints.chat_text: 0 is the epicenter. Now, starting at 0 and moving up that fold line, which is called Y, the next vertex would be number 1. The vertex above that would be numbered 2.

replies.reply_text: Got it! Now what?
I can take it from here. Thanks so much for your help.

chatpoints.chat_text: You'll number the vertex moving down the center fold line - called Y - in the negative. So, The next vertex down from 0 would be -1. The vertex at the edge of the map would be -2.

replies.reply_text: Okay. Now, what about numbering along the horizontal line?
Thanks, but I need a bit more help, please.

chatpoints.chat_text: Left of zero will be ascending negative numbers. Right of zero will be ascending positive. Just remember, all this graph information is on the backside of your map.

replies.reply_text: Gosh, this is more complicated than I thought. I need a bit more help, please.
Ta da! I've got it. Thank you so much!

chatpoints.chat_text: The X axis is stated first, and then the Y axis. For instance, if the equation is (1,1) you would start at the epicenter and move right along the axis X one vertex, then up one vertex.

replies.reply_text: Perfect! Thanks so much.
If you could just help me a bit more?

chatpoints.chat_text: Think of your graph as one big box, with zero right in the middle. The X axis and the Y axis divide your box into four parts. Each quarter is called a quadrant.

replies.reply_text: Now that I have an X axis and a Y axis, what happens now?
Hmm. Not sure I need that information, but I asked for it! Thanks.
If you could just help me a bit more?
Can you tell me more about quadrants? I might need to know!

chatpoints.chat_text: Sure. Remember that the graph is on the backside of the map. Folding the map will make figuring out an exact location tough. So you might need to search around a bit.

replies.reply_text: Great tips. Thanks so much.
Can we discuss the backside of the map just a tiny bit more? Does this mean I still need to look at the map through a light to see where on the other side the location would be?
Gosh, there is so much to learn about graphs my head is spinning. That said, can you help me on one other thing about the map.

chatpoints.chat_text: Of course!  Knowing more about the quadrants can help you figure out where to find a specific coordinate. The quadrants are numbered I, II, III and IV, starting in the top right hand corner.

replies.reply_text: Okay. And then what?
Thanks so much! I think I've got this now.

chatpoints.chat_text: Then go counter-clockwise. So the top left quadrant is II. The bottom left quadrant is III. Coordinates in Quadrant I will always be expressed as positive numbers. Coordinates in Quadrant III will be negative.

replies.reply_text: And the other two quadrants? How are those coordinates expressed?
Thanks so much! I think I've got this now.

chatpoints.chat_text: Quadrant II will have a negative X axis expression with a positive Y axis expression. Quadrant IV will have a positive X axis expression with a negative Y axis expression.

replies.reply_text: Ugh! This makes my head hurt! Can't you just make the map for me?
Thanks so much! I think I've got this now.

chatpoints.chat_text: Just think through each step and you'll get it. Besides, it does a brain good to be exercised.

replies.reply_text: Okay. I think I might like to go over some of the information. Can you help me with that?
You are right. I'm up to the challenge! Thanks so much.

chatpoints.chat_text: That's exactly what it means! If you need more help, you can find me around these rocks.

replies.reply_text: You've been very helpful. Hopefully I won't have to pester you again. Have a most wonderful day!

replies.reply_text: The Cloud Isles are magical, and when you dig, you disrupt the magical fabric. So, you dug one too many times and ripped a hole in the cloud.

chatpoints.chat_text: Are you saying I can't have a garden if I live here? That's unacceptable! Gardens are my life! What ever will I do? This is such depressing news.

replies.reply_text: Have you considered raised garden beds? That might work, as you won't be digging into the cloud itself.

chatpoints.chat_text: I hadn't! What a terrific idea. You've solved what happened and given me hope for future gardening.

replies.reply_text: That was very kind of you. Thank you.

chatpoints.chat_text: Well don't keep me waiting!

replies.reply_text: Evidently, your garden fell down to the cloud just beneath this one.
I hope I don't upset you, but  I'm back with some news.

chatpoints.chat_text: What? Fell through? How is that possible?

replies.reply_text: I'm not sure yet, but I'm working on it. I'll let you know when I find out. I just wanted to let you know that I am working on it.

chatpoints.chat_text: Hello there.

replies.reply_text: Hey there. How's gardening in raised boxed going?

chatpoints.chat_text: Not bad. Not bad at all, if I do say so myself. Thanks again for the suggestion.

replies.reply_text: Awesome. And happy to have helped. Have a lovely day.

chatpoints.chat_text: The banging that is driving me nuts? If that's the banging you are talking about, well then yes, I certainly know about it!

replies.reply_text: Do you by any chance happen to know the direction it is coming from?

replies.reply_text: I'll see what I can do. Thanks for your time.

npc_list.name: Astrape
npc_list.admin_description: aka Angie
npc_list.long_description: A young girl with bright fuchsia hair, wearing pajamas embroidered with lightening bolts. She has two large old beat up cymbals that she loves to clang together. While they may have sounded lovely in the past, clang is all they do now.

chatpoints.chat_text: Behold the Most Awesome Goddess of Lightening - Astrape! (She twirls the banged up cymbals, flinging them into the air and catches them behind her back and brings them together with a loud clang.) Tadaa!

replies.reply_text: Wow. That's impressive. Say, I notice your pajamas have the name Angie on them.
What a talented young lady! What's that your pajamas say? Oh, I see. Angie! So, Angie. I'm wondering where your parents might be?
Was I doing something for you?
Hey there, Astrape. I was talking to your sister Bronte, and it seems like I need to talk your parents into buying new instruments for the two of you. What's the fastest way to your house from here?

chatpoints.chat_text: (The young girl glares at you.) The name on my pajamas has nothing to do with this!

replies.reply_text: Whatever. So Angie, do your parents know where you are? You seem to be pretty young to be up on Cloud this time of day.

chatpoints.chat_text: (The young girl glares at you.) My name is Astrape! Not Angie! And parents, schmarents! Who needs them!

replies.reply_text: Goodness. Sounds like your parents have done something to annoy you.

chatpoints.chat_text: (Angie nods her head emphatically.) Yes they have!

replies.reply_text: Care to tell me about it? I'm a really good listener.

chatpoints.chat_text: Bronte wouldn't like me talking to you. You're a stranger.

replies.reply_text: You're a smart young lady. You shouldn't talk to strangers. If you'll be so kind as to who Bronte is, and where I can find her, I'd be happy to talk to her.
Why yes I am. And this stranger is saying good bye!

chatpoints.chat_text: Well DUH! You were going to talk to my sister. Remember?

replies.reply_text: Yes. Yes I was! And I'm on my way.

chatpoints.chat_text: She's just on the other side of this beautiful sparkling glitter tree! But she won't talk to you unless you tell her that I said it was okay.

replies.reply_text: Thank you for that information! I'll do just that.

chatpoints.chat_text: Oh that's easy peasy! Take the Cloud exit to Tropicton then head over to... WAIT! You're trying to trick me, aren't you? Bronte won't tell anyone which island we live on! That's mean!

replies.reply_text: I'm sorry. That was mean of me. I'm just trying to make you girls happy so I can make the residents of Cloud happy! I'll be on my way now. (You are thrilled with this clue and hurry off to find the Cloud exits.)

npc_list.name: Bronte
npc_list.admin_description: aka Brooklynn
npc_list.long_description: A young girl with bright green hair wearing pajamas embroidered with clouds. She has what looks like a very impressive set of drums. Until you look closer and notice there's duct tape on every sign drum. No wonder it sounds like thunking instead of drumming!

chatpoints.chat_text: Behold the Most Beautiful Goddess of Thunder - Bronte! (The girl does a drum roll on her very impressive set of drums.)

replies.reply_text: Wow. That's loud. But very impressive! Astrape sent me to speak to you. I  notice your pajamas have the name Brooklynn. That's a lovely name!
Gadzooks! That's loud enough to break my eardrums! (The girl ignores you and continues to do drum roll after drum roll after drum roll.)
Could you remind me what I was doing for you?
Did you say the first letter of your mom's name was in the first 10 letters of the alphabet?

chatpoints.chat_text: (She performs another impressive but very very very long drum roll, glaring at you the entire time. Finally, she stops.)

replies.reply_text: Your talent is amazing. But here's the thing. These drums are very loud, and it is upsetting some of the residents here. I would never ask you to give up drumming, but I'm wondering if you might consider drumming elsewhere?
