quest_list.success_npc_chat: Well, these will do just fine!  I'll stick one here... and a few here... There!  That'll get Widow-Maker's attention all right!

quest_list.notes: Get first small neem bark.
quest_list.success_message: Fending off small claws and small teeth, you hurridly scrape a bit of bark from the neem tree before being forced to retreat.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: (The squirrel takes offense to you pushing her aside, and immediately begins attacking you.)

quest_list.notes: Kiah sends you after more neem bark.
quest_list.success_message: You have been asked to gather more neem bark.

quest_list.notes: Give Kiah a small neem bark.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: I see nothing there. You must go back and get the bark. Seach at the tree behind the temple on the smallest isle west of here.
quest_list.success_message: You gave Kiah the Small Neem Bark.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: You call this neem bark? (Kiah shakes her head in disgust.) There's barely enough here to fill my tiniest nush'kua! Go back and get more.

quest_list.notes: Get second small neem bark
quest_list.success_message: Doing your best to avoid the furry beast attacking you, you manage to scrape more bark from the neem tree.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: (The squirrel takes you up on your offer, and jumps into the fray with much enthusiasm.)

quest_list.notes: Give Kiah more small neem bark.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You do not have any. You must re-visit the tree!
quest_list.success_message: You give Kiah the small neem bark.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: (Kiah narrows her eyes.) It will be enough when I say it's enough, no'hani? However, this bit and the other together should do. Now, go and tend to those scratches. I surely hope you did not harm a creature of the Jungle!

quest_list.notes: Nilla sends you after 10 walnuts.
quest_list.success_message: The squirrel asks you for 10 Walnuts.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: (The little squirrel sits back and appears to be anticipating your return.)

quest_list.notes: Give Nilla 10 walnuts, get a diamond and the neem bark.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: (The squirrel does a quick count and looks at you with disappointment. She thrusts out both hands again so you can count all 10 of her fingers.)
quest_list.success_message: You gave the squirrel 10 Walnuts and received a Diamond!
quest_list.success_npc_chat: (The squirrel does a little happy dance as she takes her treasure. She holds up a paw and scurries under the tree only to reappear a moment later with a shiny object in her hands. She hands you the object with obvious gratitude.)

quest_list.notes: Get the large neem bark.
quest_list.success_message: Sliding past the happy squirrel, you are able to carefully peel a large piece of bark from the neem tree. You got the Neem Bark!

quest_list.notes: Done visiting Nilla the Squirrel. Tracking only.
Return Widow-Maker to Pecos Bill
quest_list.title: Pecos Bill's Lost Horse
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Hey!  Where's m' lasso?!  Go find it!
quest_list.success_message: You Completed Pecos Bill's Lost Horse!  You earned $4000 and 50 quest points.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Well, by golly, you do!  Thanks, and much obliged to you, pardner!  Here's a little bit of a reward for you!
quest_list.author: SpottedRose

quest_list.notes: Capture Widow-Maker
quest_list.success_message: You have captured Widow-Maker!  He will now follow you back to Pecos Bill, and probably never realize it!
quest_list.success_npc_chat: (Carefully, very carefully, waiting until Widow-Maker's full attention is on the feathers, you fling the lasso over Widow-Maker's head.)

quest_list.notes: Ready to go after Kiah's third item. Tracker only.
Kiah sends you after fireflower leaves.
quest_list.success_message: Kiah has asked you to find leaves from three fireflower plants.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Maa'hala, you should be careful. Bring back the leaves from three fireflower plants, and then we shall see...

quest_list.notes: Fireflower plant here
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You look all over at all the tiny details, but alas, nothing interesting.
quest_list.success_message: You found a Fireflower Plant! You carefully pluck a few leaves.

quest_list.notes: Fireflower plant here
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You look all over at all the tiny details, but alas, nothing interesting.
quest_list.success_message: You found a Fireflower Plant! You carefully pluck a few leaves.

quest_list.notes: Fireflower plant here
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You look all over at all the tiny details, but alas, nothing interesting.
quest_list.success_message: You found a Fireflower Plant! You carefully pluck a few leaves.

quest_list.notes: Give Kiah the fireflower leaves and complete the quest.
quest_list.title: Kiah's Jungle Harvest
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You do not have them all. You must travel far to the south of here and find the fireflowers growing next to tall carnivorous plants.
quest_list.success_message: You Completed Kiah's Jungle Harvest! You earned a Pearl Necklace, a Dinosaur Bone and 200 quest points.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Maa'hala! You have done well! These are exactly what I need. I'll be able to make some much needed pashni. Your kii has served you well. Please take this as a small reward for your help. Please come back again, Namaste!
quest_list.author: Tempest

quest_list.notes: Sara sends you to Eldorado Isle
quest_list.success_message: You have been transported to Eldorado Isle.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: There you are. Just use the dock there to get back to the mainland!

quest_list.notes: Trade Periwinkle Calumet for Wooden Spirit Disk
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You do not have the required offering, child.  Goodbye.
quest_list.success_message: The Dawn's White Horse has given you a strange but interesting Wooden Spirit Disc.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: You have done well, child. Give this to Nizhoni now.  She will know what to do.

quest_list.notes: Trade Aquamarine Calumet for Wooden Spirit Disc
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You do not have the required offering, child.  Goodbye.
quest_list.success_message: Dusk's Blue Horse has given you a strange but interesting Wooden Spirit Disc.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: You have done well, child.  Go back to Nizhoni now.  She will know what to do.

quest_list.notes: Give coloring book
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You don't have that.
quest_list.success_message: You've given her the coloring book. Time to talk to her dad.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: (She grabs her crayons, sits at the table and starts coloring. She is totally absorbed in her craft, so you leave her be.)

quest_list.notes: Trade the Amber Calumet for Wooden Spirit Disc.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You do not have the required offering, child.  Goodbye.
quest_list.success_message: The Dusk's Golden Mare has given you a strange but interesting Wooden Spirit Disc.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: You have done well, child.  Go back to Nizhoni now.  She will know what to do.

quest_list.notes: Trade the Fire Opal Calumet for a Wooden Spirit Disc
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You do not have the required offering, child.  Goodbye.
quest_list.success_message: The Night's Black Horse has given you a strange but interesting Wooden Spirit Disc.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: You have done well, child.  Go back to Nizhoni now.  She will know what to do.

quest_list.notes: Paras asks for feathers and moonbeams.
quest_list.success_message: Paras the Phoenix asks you for 14 Sparkling Feathers and 3 Moonbeams.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Well.  I suppose you have a point.  All right, then.  Can you get me, say, 14 of those sparkly feathers, and 3 moonbeams?  To tie them, you see.

quest_list.notes: Nizhoni gives you the Periwinkle Calumet.
quest_list.success_message: Nizhoni has given you the Periwinkle Calumet.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Here is the Beaded Periwinkle Calumet. Go far North, most north, of a small isle of white. Search there at the easternmost point.

quest_list.notes: Nizhoni gives you the Aquamarine Crystal Calumet
quest_list.success_message: Nizhoni has given you the Aquamarine Calumet.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Here is the Aquamarine Crystal Calumet.  You go to the West, as far as you can go where white appears blue, white that is not snow.  There find the Dusk's Blue Horse.

quest_list.notes: Nizhoni gives you the Amber Calumet
quest_list.success_message: Nizhoni has given you the Amber Calumet.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Here is the Amber Calumet. Go to the South, where heat rules the day and water is no mirage. There you can find the Sun's Golden Mare.

quest_list.notes: Nizhoni gives you the Black Fire Opal Calumet
quest_list.success_message: Nizhoni has given you the Black Fire Opal Calumet.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Here is the Black Fire Opal Calumet. Take it to the North and to the far east. Search near vessel wrecked upon sandy shore. There you will find the Night's Black Horse.

quest_list.notes: Rescue the First Little Pig
quest_list.success_message: You pull the First Little Pig up onto your horse.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Yikes!

quest_list.notes: Rescue the First and Second Little Pigs
quest_list.success_message: You pull the First and Second Little Pigs up onto your horse.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Yikes!

quest_list.notes: Tracker to move on to part 2 of Kiahs Harvest
Pigs Saved!
quest_list.title: Pig Rescue!
quest_list.success_message: You Completed Pig Rescue!  You earned $2000 and 25 quest points.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: No!  He's afraid of glass, you see.  Goodbye, and thank you, I think.  Please accept this small reward with my... thanks.  Goodbye!
quest_list.author: SpottedRose

quest_list.notes: Hope gives popcorn and soda.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: I'm sorry, it doesn't look like you have enough money.
quest_list.success_message: You were given Popcorn and Soda Pop for $25.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Here you are! Come again.

quest_list.notes: Princess Lilianna sends you out to find frogs.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: What?  You didn't find me a frog, already?
quest_list.success_message: Princess Lilianna bids you return with a Red, a Blue and a Green Frog for her to kiss.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Well, gee.  I've heard that the Red, Green and Blue Frogs are pretty special, especially since there's only one of each.  They stay by those Pegasus statues.  Go find them!

quest_list.notes: Hope gives pie and cocoa.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: I'm sorry, it doesn't look like you have enough money.
quest_list.success_message: You were given Pie a la Mode and Hot Cocoa for $45.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Here you are! Come again.

quest_list.notes: Hope gives fish and lemonade.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: I'm sorry, it doesn't look like you have enough money.
quest_list.success_message: You were given Fried Fish and Lemonade for $80.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Here you are! Come again.

quest_list.notes: Hope gives waters and breads.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: I'm sorry, it doesn't look like you have enough money.
quest_list.success_message: You were given 3 Waters and 3 Loaves of Bread for $120.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: That's correct. Here you are! Come again.

quest_list.notes: Find the Red Frog
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You rake all over, but uncover nothing interesting.
quest_list.success_message: Using your rake, you carefully pin down the Red Frog long enough to pick it up and put it in your pack.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: You captured the Red Frog.

quest_list.notes: Find the Green Frog
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You rake all over, but uncover nothing interesting.
quest_list.success_message: Using your rake, you carefully pin down the Green Frog long enough to pick it up and put it in your pack.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: You captured the Green Frog.

quest_list.notes: Find the Blue Frog
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You rake all over, but uncover nothing interesting.
quest_list.success_message: Using your rake, you carefully pin down the Blue Frog long enough to pick it up and put it in your pack.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: You captured the Blue Frog.

quest_list.notes: Present Three Frogs to Lilianna.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You don't have all the frogs!  Excuse me, what kind of person are you, anyway?  I'm a princess!  Bring me my frogs!
quest_list.success_message: You hand over the frogs to Princess Lilianna.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Oh, aren't they just... slimy... Ew...

quest_list.notes: The Princess' Reward Princess Lilianna's Frogs
quest_list.title: Princess Lilianna's Frogs
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Eww.  That frog didn't work.
quest_list.success_message: You Completed Princess Lilianna's Frogs.  You earned $3000 and 25 quest points.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Thank you so much for your help in securing my happiness.  Please accept this small token of my esteem.
quest_list.author: SpottedRose

quest_list.notes: Aladdin sends you for gold and silver.
quest_list.success_message: Aladdin sends you to find 5 Gold Ores and 5 Silver Linings, and gives you $1000 traveling money.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: First, you must find 5 ores of the purest gold, and 5 silver linings!  Take this small sum to help with your expenses.  And the best of luck go with you.

quest_list.notes: Aladdin takes gold and silver and asks for rubies and pearls.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Wait!  This is insufficient!  I beg of you that you return to me when you have collected five ores and five linings!
quest_list.success_message: You gave Aladdin 5 Gold Ores and 5 Silver Linings.  You have agreed to find 5 Rubies and 5 Honeycombs.  You were given $1000.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: I shall start making the map at once!  Now, I need 5 rubies and also, five honeycombs, that I may use the beeswax to make castings of the gold!

quest_list.notes: Aladdin has all his materials.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Please, did I not say five rubies and five honeycombs?  Please do as you agreed to do!
quest_list.success_message: Aladdin takes the rubies and honeycombs from you. /*1247*/
quest_list.success_npc_chat: There!  Now I can make the lamp!  After that, it will only be a matter of enticing a djin to live within!

quest_list.notes: Aislin sends you after peacock feathers.
quest_list.success_message: Aislin has asked you to collect 20 Peacock Feathers.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Oh, only the prettiest feathers will do! Let's say maybe 20 peacock feathers to start?

quest_list.notes: Aladdin wonders how to stuff a genie in a lamp
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Wait!  This is insuffienct!  I beg of you that you return to me when you have collected five rubies and five honeycombs!
quest_list.success_message: You gave Aladdin 5 Rubies and 5 Honeycombs.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: This is very good.  And now, alas, I have but one conundrum!

quest_list.notes: Aislin sends you for sparkling feathers.
quest_list.success_message: Aislin asks you to collect 20 Sparkling Feathers.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Let's do 20 again. That'll be another ten for each wing.

quest_list.notes: Give Aislin 20 peacock feathers.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Oh, it doesn't look like you have enough. I need 10 for each wing. That's 20 all together.
quest_list.success_message: You gave Aislin 20 Peacock Feathers.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: These are perfect! Thank you so much! These will definitely make Elowyn feel special.

quest_list.notes: Aislin asks you to get pegasus feathers.
quest_list.success_message: Aislin asks you to get her Pegasus Feathers.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: As many as you can, I suppose. Any amount will be helpful, really.

quest_list.notes: Give Aislin 20 sparkling feathers.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: It doesn't look like you have enough. I need 20 sparkling feathers.
quest_list.success_message: You gave Aislin 20 Sparkling Feathers.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Perfect! These are very sparkly. Elowyn will feel so special!

quest_list.notes: Aladdin rewards you... for now.
quest_list.title: Aladdin's New Lamp
quest_list.success_message: You Completed Aladdin's New Lamp.  You earned an Emerald Necklace and 50 quest points.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: But perhaps, someday, I shall learn how to do this!  And when I do, perhaps you can help me!  In the meantime, please accept this small reward, with my humble thanks!
quest_list.author: SpottedRose

quest_list.notes: Give Aislin pegasus feathers and finish the quest.
quest_list.title: Elowyn's Wings
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: I don't see any on you. You'd better go back and ask the pegasus again.
quest_list.success_message: You Completed Elowyn's Wings! You earned $10,000 and 200 quest points.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Oh, this is wonderful! It's more than I hoped for. These will bring just the right finishing touch to my wings! I can't thank you enough. Please take this as a token of my appreciation.
quest_list.author: Tempest

quest_list.notes: Caeralus sends you to Erebus.
quest_list.success_message: *POOF*  You have been jumped to a small, enclosed meadow.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Just don't stay too long, now!

quest_list.notes: Erebus gives you a bag of feathers.
quest_list.success_message: You were given a Bag of Feathers and jumped out of the meadow.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Here you are, as many as I could spare. I hope they will be useful. Goodbye, now.

quest_list.notes: Finishing with Flo (tracking only)
You win a bet with a duck
quest_list.title: Duck Sculpture
quest_list.success_message: You Completed Duck Sculpture!  You earned $500 and 25 quest points.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: I don't believe it!  You did it!  I'm stunned!  Here, here's a prize!  And thanks!
quest_list.author: SpottedRose

quest_list.notes: Mother Cat sends you out looking for Kitten Mittens
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Oy vey...
quest_list.success_message: Mother Cat would be forever grateful if you found her kittens' mittens.
quest_list.success_npc_chat:
You kittens wait 'til your father gets home! Sigh! If you could find them, I'd be so grateful!
Mehitabel: Thanks, Arch, now we're in big trouble!
Mother Cat: That's IT! Go to your baskets, the lot of you! NOW!

quest_list.notes: Duck Has Two Pairs of Mittens
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Didn't I already give you those?
quest_list.success_message: The Ugly Duckling gives you two pairs of Kitten Mittens.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Oh, is that what these things are?  I thought they tasted funny.  You want them?  Here you go!

quest_list.notes: Search for Mittens outside Lilianna's Castle
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You look all over at all the tiny details, but alas, nothing interesting.
quest_list.success_message: Looking closely, you see something made of wool sticking out of the cloud.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: You've found a pair of woolen Kitten Mittens!

quest_list.notes: End of Kitten Quest!
quest_list.title: Kittens' Lost Mittens
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: But... they're not all here!  Please, you've got to find them all!
quest_list.success_message: You Completed Kittens' Lost Mittens!  You earned some Pie a la Mode, $2000 and 25 quest points.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Oh, what a relief!  Thank you so much!  Here, please have this as a reward!
quest_list.author: SpottedRose

quest_list.notes: Whystan sends you in search of Blocks.
quest_list.success_message: Whystan asks you for pieces for a building set.  He gave you $2000 to cover travel expenses.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Okay, here's what I want: 50 bricks, 2 large windows, 6 small windows, 2 front doors, 2 back doors, and 6 roofing pieces.  You can bring them all at once; it will probably save you money on travel.

quest_list.notes: Vern will make plans for Whystan's blocks set.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Block set... block buildings... block city... hmmm...
quest_list.success_message: Vern agrees to draw up designs for the block set components.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: I think I remember that set!  I loved it.  And then my dog chewed it up.  Oh, well.  But yes, certainly, I'd be happy to!  Give me a day or so to draw up the plans.

quest_list.notes: Vern gives you the completed plans for Whystan's block set
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: I already gave you the plans.  What did you do with them?
quest_list.success_message: Vern gives you the Block Set Plans.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Here are the plans.  Cecil will be good for the wood parts.  Try Nicolette in Chillton for the glass, and Grey Slate, he's good with small metal parts.

quest_list.notes: Cecil asks for logs.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You know, I really don't like repeating myself.
quest_list.success_message: Cecil Shuteye asked you to collect 1 log of Ebony Wood and 5 Logs.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Here you go.  Now, can you get me 1 log of ebony wood and... oh... say... 5 regular logs?

quest_list.notes: Give Cecil his logs.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: No, that's not enough.
quest_list.success_message: You gave Cecil 1 log of Ebony Wood and 5 Logs.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: These will do.  Come back tomorrow or the next day with $500 and I'll have them done.

quest_list.notes: Cecil sells you the blocks.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Aw, come on, that's not a lot of money for handmade work!
quest_list.success_message: You gave Cecil $500 for 50 Wooden Building Blocks.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Here they are, 50 building blocks.

quest_list.notes: Grey Slate sends you to Earl Bronze.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Hey.  Didn't you listen to me the first time?
quest_list.success_message: Grey Slate recommends Earl Bronze to make the metal parts for the block set.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Earl Bronze in Shellton does great tiny work.  He builds wooden ships, you know, and those take lots of small parts.  Makes 'em all himself.  I'd try him.

quest_list.notes: Earl Bronze asks you for Iron Ore.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Not now.
quest_list.success_message: Earl Bronze wants 10 Iron Ore and a Honeycomb.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Oh.  Well, okay.  Let me think...  How about $500 for my work, and I'll need some iron ore--ten should do--and a honeycomb for wax resin when I solder.

quest_list.notes: Give Earl Bronze his iron and wax (and money) and he gives you the parts.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Naw, that's not enough.  Keep tryin'!  Don't forget I need $500 to pay for it, too!
quest_list.success_message: You gave Earl Bronze $500, 10 chunks of Iron Ore and a Honeycomb.  You were given a sack of Assorted Metal Parts.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Thanks so much! Here are your parts! (Earl Bronze puts a hefty sack on a table and opens it for your inspection.)

quest_list.notes: Nicolette agrees to make glass windows and bricks.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Thought I already did that...
quest_list.success_message: Nicolette will make glass parts for $500.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Oh... Let me think... How about... $500?

quest_list.notes: Nicolette gives you a box full of glass parts.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You don't have the money.
quest_list.success_message: You pay $500 to Nicolette for a box of Assorted Glass Parts.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: There!  I made windows in two sizes, and some glass blocks, and some other things I thought might be fun.

quest_list.notes: Give Whystan the wooden parts.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: I asked for 50.  There aren't enough to share here.
quest_list.success_message: You gave Whystan 50 Wooden Building Blocks.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Oh, these are wonderful!  Look, there are some ebony ones--and some half blocks!  I remember those!  Who made these?

quest_list.notes: Give Whystan the metal bits.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You don't have what I asked for.
quest_list.success_message: You gave Whystan the bag of Assorted Metal Parts.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Oh, look!  Doors with knobs, and railings, and coping strips to finish off the tops, and... here's some roofing, too!

quest_list.notes: Give Whystan the glass bits and Get a Reward!
quest_list.title: Whystan's Building Set
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You're missing something.
quest_list.success_message: You Completed Whystan's Building Blocks.  You earned $8000 and 200 quest points.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Wonderful!  Windows, and clear blocks--and they snap onto the wooden ones just fine!  And here are the plans!  Thanks so much, please accept this reward!
quest_list.author: SpottedRose

quest_list.notes: Have either glass or metal parts (tracking only)
LRRH leaves for her grandmother's.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You can leave now.
quest_list.success_message: The... charming... little tyke skips off across the clouds toward Grandmother's house.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: No!

quest_list.notes: Davy sends you to Flipperton
quest_list.success_message: Davy asked you to head to Flipperton.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Well, he last had a house in Flipperton. I know it's a lot to ask, but if there are any clues, I suppose they would be there. Ask around to all the residents there, and let me know if you learn anything.

quest_list.notes: Davy sends you to Crescent.
quest_list.success_message: You have been jumped to Crescent Isle.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Here you go!

quest_list.notes: Iona gives information on Sam McGee. (tracking)
Felton gives you a photograph and a diary of Sam's
quest_list.success_message: You were given a Torn Photograph and an Old Diary.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Great. Let me just run into the back room and grab them. (Felton quickly leaves and returns.) Here you are. Thanks.

quest_list.notes: Paras gets his feathers and moonbeams.
quest_list.title: Paras' Feathers
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Now, really, this is not enough!
quest_list.success_message: You Completed Paras' Feathers.  You earned $2000 and 25 quest points.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Thank you.  These will do.  Now, if you'll just give me a hand here... and tie there... there!  I suppose this will have to do.
quest_list.author: SpottedRose

quest_list.notes: Finished in Flilpperton for Sam's quest (tracking)
Give Davy photo and diary.
quest_list.success_message: You gave Davy the Torn Photograph and Old Diary.

quest_list.notes: Davy sends you to Carrotton.
quest_list.success_message: Davy has asked you to go to Carrotton.

quest_list.notes: Tucker gives you a book for Sam.
quest_list.success_message: You were given an Old Book.

quest_list.notes: Give Davy Sam's book from Tucker.
quest_list.success_message: You handed Davy Sam's Old Book.

quest_list.notes: Davy sends you to Horse Shoe Village

quest_list.success_npc_chat: Oh, this is wonderful! I'm sure, using this special feed, I can befriend the wild horse in no time. Please take this reward for a job well done!
quest_list.author: Tempest

quest_list.notes: Silver Mary Sends You Out Shopping
quest_list.success_message: Silver Mary wants a Drum, a French Horn, a dress with a hoop skirt, a Major General's outfit, and paint in four colors (red, yellow, green and blue).  You were given a Ruby Necklace for expenses.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Ye wretched lubber, don't ye got nothin' inside that skull o' yours?  Now, like I be sayin, don't ye bother comin' back here until ye got the lot!  Because I be right busy and not toleratin' needless interruption!  Here be a token fer expenses.

quest_list.notes: Sam McGee rattles on about his Triumph (tracking only)
Grandmother asks you to Waylay her granddaughter
quest_list.success_message: Grandmother Riding Hood asks you to help waylay her granddaughter, and gives you $2000 for expenses.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Oh, you are a dear! Here's $2000 to help cover your expenses. Please, please hurry!

quest_list.notes: Barnabas Cookie Cutter
quest_list.title: Cookie Cutter for Barnabas
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You must have already completed this cookie cutter.
quest_list.success_message: You Completed Cookie Cutter for Barnabas!  You earned $3000 and 50 quest points.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: That's perfect!  Thanks!

quest_list.notes: Happy Birthday, Red!
quest_list.title: Red Riding Hood's Surprise
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Oh, I'm... I'm worried that that won't be enough!  Can't you find someone else that's more or less on her way that can delay her for a bit?  I'm just not ready!  She does wander a bit, you know...
quest_list.success_message: You Completed Red Riding Hood's Surprise!  You earned $5000 and 50 quest points.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Ahh, I am so relieved!  I just finished the cake!  Isn't it wonderful?  Please take this reward, with my gratitude!
quest_list.author: SpottedRose

quest_list.notes: Agree to help prince charming find the glass slipper
quest_list.success_message: You have agreed to help Prince Charming find his Glass Slipper!
quest_list.success_npc_chat: That would be so helpful. It was only a short rest, so it couldn't have gone far.

quest_list.notes: Ugly Duckling gives you the glass slipper
quest_list.success_message: You were given a Glass Slipper by the Ugly Duckling to take back to Prince Charming.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Yes, yes, yes - here it is. Just take it back to him and stop bothering me. He is one of the few who do not laugh at this ugly duckling, so he may have his item back.

quest_list.notes: Rose asks the box question (tracking only)
Find a glass slipper clue
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You look all over at all the tiny details, but alas, nothing interesting.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: There are very interesting webbed feet tracks all around this area. You should hurry back and tell Prince Charming!

quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You must not have found it yet. Please keep looking.
quest_list.success_message: You Completed Prince Charming's Glass Slipper! You earned $2500 and 75 quest points.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Thank you so much. Now I am off to find my one true love!
quest_list.author: Jule

quest_list.title: Rose's Quest
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Oh, you don't have any yet? You might be able to find some in a food shop somewhere.
quest_list.success_message: You Completed Rose's Quest! You earned $200, a Ruby and 25 quest points.  You were given an Embroidered Handkerchief.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Thank you! How sweet of you to find this for me. Here, let me give you something in return. (She takes some gold and a ruby out of her pocket and wraps it in a handkerchief, then hands it to you.)
quest_list.author: Arica

quest_list.notes: Will tells about his lost love
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You've talked to me so many times about the same thing!! 32,767 times, do you realize that?! OMG!! You need a life!!!

quest_list.notes: Give Will handkerchief and agree to bring him to Rose
quest_list.success_message: You have given Will Rose's handkerchief and offered to bring him to her.

quest_list.notes: Reunite Will and Rose
quest_list.title: The Sailor's Lost Love
quest_list.success_message: You Completed The Sailor's Lost Love Quest! You earned $3000, a Ruby, an Amethyst, and 100 quest points.
quest_list.author: Arica

quest_list.notes: Aladdin asks for a Blue Morpho.
quest_list.success_message: Prince Aladdin asks you to find him a wild Blue Morpho butterfly in return for delaying Red Riding Hood at his castle.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: I have heard that in the Isle of Flowers there can be found, wild, Blue Morpho butterflies!  Find me a wild one, and I shall do this... onerous favor for you.

quest_list.notes: Give Aladdin a Blue Morpho
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You have no such thing!  How dare you deceive a Prince of the East!  Begone!
quest_list.success_message: Prince Aladdin takes the butterfly, and gives you a sapphire and his thanks.  He will detain Red Riding Hood for a while.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Ah!  More beautiful than sapphires!  For this I shall detain her for... a while.  A short while.  Here, take this sapphire, which pales in comparison to the beauty of this beast!

quest_list.notes: Unicorn Uniter will do a favor for his favorite Pie maker.
quest_list.success_message: The Unicorn Uniter will help delay Red Riding Hood!
quest_list.success_npc_chat: I'd rather not.  But I owe Grandmother a favor for all those delicious pies she sends.  I'll let her granddaughter pet the unicorns for... a little while.

quest_list.notes: Get Sticks and Hay for Pigs
quest_list.success_message: The Third Little Pig wants 20 Strong, Skinny Branches and 10 Hay Bales so his brothers will move out.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Excellent!  Think of all the people you'll be helping!  Now, 20 branches and 10 hay bales, mind.  Thank you ever so much.

quest_list.notes: Stick the Pig, Hay the Pig, Get Cooperation.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Twenty!  Can't you count?  This isn't enough!  I'm not putting up with that child for anything less than twenty!
quest_list.success_message: You gave the Third Little Pig 20 Strong, Skinny Branches and 10 Hay Bales, and he promised to detain Red Riding Hood for 30 minutes.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: These will do splendidly.  I will detain the child for exactly 30 minutes.

quest_list.notes: Nicolette Gives You A List
quest_list.success_message: Nicolette gives you a list of things you will need to get in order to make pigments, and requests that you find some paint base.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Here, let me write this down.... Take this.  This is a list of what I need; 10 each copper and iron ores and chrome and tin oxides.

quest_list.notes: Temperton sells you oxides.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Sorry, come back when you can pay for the goods!
quest_list.success_message: Arthur Temperton sold you 1/2 kilo of Tin and Chrome Oxides for $100 each.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: The SnO is the tin, and the Cr2O3 is the chrome, just so you know.

quest_list.notes: Agrees to get things for Peter the pumpkin eater.
quest_list.success_message: You have agreed to find 15 Pinches of Pixie Dust and 15 Moonbeams for Peter.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Thanks.  That would be helpful.  I need 15 pinches of pixie dust and 15 moonbeams.  Something about making it sparkle, or some such thing.

quest_list.notes: Give Peter the pumpkin eater items.
quest_list.title: Peter the Pumpkin Eater's Glittery Decor
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Sorry, I really do need 15 of each. She is pretty sure of what she wants.
quest_list.success_message: You Completed Peter's Quest! You earned $2500 and 25 quest points!
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Great! Thanks again. She's gotta move in now!
quest_list.author: Jule

quest_list.notes: Robin sends you to Marisole with the harp.
quest_list.success_message: *POOF*  You are on Paradise Isle.  You were given a Singing Harp.

quest_list.notes: Robin jumps you to Paradise Isle
quest_list.success_message: You have been jumped to Paradise Isle.

quest_list.notes: Give Robin the Thank You note and complete the quest.
quest_list.title: Robin's Secret Crush
quest_list.success_message: You Completed Robin's Secret Crush! You earned $2000 and 25 quest points.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Oh, thank you so much! (Robin holds the note up to his nose to smell the scented stationery.) I'm going to go read this now, but please take this small reward and my many thanks for your help!
quest_list.author: Tempest

quest_list.notes: Give Marisole the harp and get her thank you note.
quest_list.success_message: You gave Marisole the Singing Harp and received her Thank You Note.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Oh, isn't it lovely? It really is beautiful! How thoughtful of him! Please, just give me a moment to write a quick thank you note... there! Please take this back to him for me.

quest_list.notes: Vern sells you four cans of white paint.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Actually, I already gave you the paint.  I hope you don't need more, because I don't have any more.
quest_list.success_message: Vern gives you four Cans of White Paint.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Here you go.  Four cans of fresh, white paint.

quest_list.notes: Give Nicolette the Oxides
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Sorry, you don't have what you said you had.  Please see if you can find it.
quest_list.success_message: Nicolette takes the Tin and Chrome Oxides from you.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Thank you.  This is very good--enough chrome oxide and more than enough tin!  And now the ores, please?

quest_list.notes: Give Nicolette the Ores
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: I need 10 of each, remember.  Check the list.
quest_list.success_message: You give Nicolette 10 chunks of Iron Ore and 10 chunks of Copper Ore.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Yes, these are excellent.  I have all I need to make the colors now.  Oh, why don't you give me that list, too?  I'll toss it in the bin for you.

quest_list.notes: Give Nicolette her list (to clear it from your inventory)
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: How did you manage to lose... oh, well, never mind.
quest_list.success_message: Nicolette agrees to get busy on the pigments.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Thanks!  I'll get on this right away.  It will take a day or so, so why don't you go do something else in the meantime?

quest_list.notes: Nicolette sends you for skim milk for a paint base.
quest_list.success_message: Nicolette needs 5 liters of milk for a paint base.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Well, there's a general store right down the street.  When you come back tomorrow, bring me five liters from there.

quest_list.notes: Tony sells you some goat's milk.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Aw, come on, it's not like it's expensive!
quest_list.success_message: Tony Grocer sells you five liters of skimmed Goat's Milk for $500.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Okay, here you go.  Don't spill it, and hurry, you don't want it to freeze.

quest_list.notes: Nicolette Sells You Four Cans Of Paint
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Sorry, either you already picked up the paint already, or you can't afford it.
quest_list.success_message: Nicolette sells you four cans of handmade paint for $4000.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Here you go, then!  Red, Yellow, Green and Blue!  I hope these will do.

quest_list.notes: Give Nicolette the White Paint
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: I thought you had four cans of white paint!  Please get some more now.
quest_list.success_message: You give Nicolette four Cans of White Paint.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Perfect.  This will do very nicely.

quest_list.notes: Give Nicolette the Goat's Milk
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Didn't you buy the goat's milk?  Please get it now.
quest_list.success_message: You give Nicolette the 5-liter bucket of Goat's Milk.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: This is excellent.  Smells funny, though...

quest_list.notes: Dewey gives you fishing lures and sends you to Loch Isle
quest_list.success_message: You were given a box of Fishing Lures and sent to Loch Isle.

quest_list.notes: Give 10 worms to Davy
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: I don't see 10 there. Come on back when you have 10 worms.
quest_list.success_message: You were given $500 for 10 Earthworms.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Great! Thanks!

quest_list.notes: Dewey sends you to Loch Isle
quest_list.success_message: You were sent to Loch Isle.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Sure! Say 'hi' to ol' Sam for me!

quest_list.notes: Give lures to Davy.
quest_list.title: Dewey's Lures
quest_list.success_message: You Completed Dewey's Lures! You earned $2000 and 25 quest points!
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Oh, great! I've been waiting for these. Fishing is my grandfather's true passion. He's always happy when we go fishing together. Here, please take this as a token of my thanks!
quest_list.author: Tempest

quest_list.notes: Lucie sends you to Grant Funds.
quest_list.success_message: Lucie suggests you ask Grant Funds in Wington about old band instruments.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: But you know who to try? Grant Funds, in Wington now, I believe.  He was our band instructor and he might just still have some of those old school instruments!

quest_list.notes: Grant Funds sells you a very expensive French Horn.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: I'm sorry, but you don't seem to have the funds.  And I'm afraid I cannot make you a loan at this time.
quest_list.success_message: You bought a new French Horn from Grant Funds for $5,000.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Done.  Let me get it from my office......................... Here you are, a nearly new French horn.  Treat it with respect and it will reward the player for many years to come.

quest_list.notes: Grant Funds sells you a really cheap French horn.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: I'm sorry, but you don't seem to have the funds.  And I'm afraid I cannot make you a loan at this time.
quest_list.success_message: You buy a very beat up, quite badly abused French Horn from Grant Funds for $500.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: One moment, let me get it from my office..................................... Here it is.  The poor dear has seen many, many semesters come and go, but she is still quite serviceable.

quest_list.notes: You Have Acquired a French Horn.
quest_list.success_message: You have acquired a French Horn.

quest_list.notes: Wolf tells you he was invited to the party (tracking only)
Harry Holterz sells you costumes.
quest_list.success_message: You bought two old costumes from Harry Holterz for $500.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Here you go. One dress and one captain's outfit. Good luck with Pirates.

quest_list.notes: Silver Mary Checks To See If You Have Everything She Asked For (tracking)
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Avast, ye, WHO DO Y' THINK YE BE FOOLIN' WITH?!  Y'ain't got all what I asked for!  Now shove off afore I hang ye from the yard arm and get me my stuff like ye said ye was going to!
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Arr, well, this all seems to be in order.  Now... let me take a closer look here...

quest_list.notes: Silver Mary takes the grungy old French Horn.
quest_list.success_message: Silver Mary accepts the Used French Horn.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: This has seen better days, I reckon... (Mary picks up the old horn, raises it to her lips, and blows with all the power she possesses. From out of the bell comes a loud BLEAT!) Arr, but it do sound good! Thank ye!

quest_list.notes: Silver Mary takes the new French Horn.
quest_list.success_message: Silver Mary accepts the French Horn.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Arr, now this be a fine instrument! (Mary picks up the horn, raises it to her lips, and blows with all the power she possesses. From out of the bell comes a loud BLEAT!) Arr an' it do sound good! Thank ye!

quest_list.notes: Mary Is Less Than Enthused with the dress.
quest_list.success_message: You give Silver Mary the Costume Dress.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Ye call this a hoop dress?  I asked ye fer a hoop dress!  Ah, well, at leas' it'll fit.  An' now, MY uniform.

quest_list.notes: Silver Mary takes the Captain's Costume
quest_list.success_message: Silver Mary takes the Captain's Outfit from you.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Avast now, ye lubber, what ha' we here?  This be a captain's uniform!

quest_list.notes: Mary Takes The Paint.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Arr, ye got no paint!  What be wrong w'ye?  Go get me the paint afore I makes ye walk the plank!
quest_list.success_message: You give Silver Mary 4 cans of paint.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Ah. Paint. (Silver Mary pries open one of the lids, examines the color... and then sniffs.) This be a funny-smellin' paint to be sure.

quest_list.notes: Vern Has Paint you can buy.
quest_list.success_npc_chat:
Let me think... I have some leftover cans, I think. Hold on a second....
(Vern goes into a back room, and comes out with a few well-splattered cans.)
I have some lime, and navy... and four cans of good white, but that's it.

quest_list.notes: Agree to get Rapunzel a hairpiece made.
quest_list.success_message: You agreed to get Rapunzel's hairpiece! You were given $2000 to help with travel and payment costs.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Thank you so much! Here is some money to help with the cost of getting it made and travel. I can't wait to see it - please hurry. I wouldn't want my prince to come without having that to look my best.

quest_list.notes: M. Renard asks that you visit the local cheese emporium (tracking only)
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You would do this pour moi, un vieux renard? Merveilleux! You comprehend, an old fox, he does not have the money to pay you. But I can offer you for your services ces raisins magnifiques! They grow nowhere else! Pick as many as you like.
quest_list.success_message: M. Renard, the Fox, asks you to get him some cheese.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: You would do this pour moi, un vieux renard? Merveilleux! You comprehend, an old fox, he does not have the money to pay you. But I can offer you for your services ces raisins magnifiques! They grow nowhere else! Pick as many as you like.

quest_list.notes: M. Renard teleports you off his island.
quest_list.success_message: *POOF!*  You are suddenly transported back to Dust Isle.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Et voilà!

quest_list.notes: Silver Mary's Reward
quest_list.title: Silver Mary's Big Production
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Get ye gone afore I sends ye t' Davey Jones!
quest_list.success_message: You Completed Silver Mary's Big Production.  You earned two Diamond Necklaces, two Pearl Necklaces and 400 quest points.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Well, these be just lyin' around.  Should be good enough reward for ye.
quest_list.author: SpottedRose

quest_list.notes: Fitzgerald sends you to Aesop Island.
quest_list.success_message: *POOF*  You are on Aesop Isle.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: All right, then.

quest_list.notes: Agree to get the copper ore for Inigo to make hair piece
quest_list.success_message: You have agreed to get 20 pieces of Copper Ore for Inigo Webster.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: That sounds fine. Just come back when you have the ore and I will get started.

quest_list.notes: Give copper ore to Inigo for Rapunzel's hairpiece.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You don't have everything I need yet. Make sure and come back with 20 copper ores so I can get started.
quest_list.success_message: You give 20 pieces of Copper Ore to Inigo. He asks you to come back later for the hairpiece.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Great! I will go ahead and get started. You can come back in a bit and it should be ready.  The price will be $1000.

quest_list.notes: Pick up Rapunzel's hairpiece from Inigo
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You don't have quite enough money. The total cost will be $1000. I will keep it here for you while you go and get the money.
quest_list.success_message: You were given an intricately woven elegant hairpiece for Rapunzel!
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Yep - here it is! It is cooled down and should be safe for you to carry. Make sure to take it right back to Rapunzel.

quest_list.notes: Tony sends you to Shaylene Shampu for cheeze.
quest_list.success_message: Tony Grocer recommends Shaylene Shampu as a source of cheese.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Shaylene Shampu. She's up in Whiskerton, she's got a grooming salon up there. Ask her. Maybe she knows something.

quest_list.notes: Give Rapunzel her hairpiece.
quest_list.title: Rapunzel's Beautiful Hairpiece
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You might have dropped it along the way. Please go and find it and come back.
quest_list.success_message: You Completed Rapunzel's Beautiful Hairpiece! You earned $5000 and 75 quest points.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Oh, this is so elegant! Thank you so much for getting this for me. Here is something for you since you were so kind.
quest_list.author: Jule

quest_list.notes: Shaylene gives you a list of cheese-making ingredients.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: I already gave you the list!
quest_list.success_message: Shaylene gives you a List of items she needs to get started as a cheesemaker and $3000.
quest_list.success_npc_chat:
Okay! Here's a list of what I need: a large, copper pot, some red wax to coat the cheese, cheesecloth, paper cheese wrap and a curd knife.
Here's $3000 to get you started. Take the list, too.

quest_list.notes: Shylene takes back her list if you refuse the quest.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You spent the $3000 already?  Well, by spending the money, you've agreed to get the things, so either bring me the $3000 or shoo.
quest_list.success_message: Shaylene takes back the $3000 and her list and tucks it away in a book.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Fine.  Be that way.

quest_list.notes: Winchell Takes You To The Clouds
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: My child, you don't have what I asked for!  I do not perform on command!  Come back when your quests are done AND you have 3 Giant Coconuts!
quest_list.success_message: You are transported to the Cloud Isles.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Hold on!

quest_list.notes: Winchell sends you to Cloud Isle
quest_list.success_message: Winchell transports you to the Cloud Isles!
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Climb aboard!  Let us away to the heights of higher things!

quest_list.notes: Hansel thanks you
quest_list.title: Hansel's Little List
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You're missing something, check the list and come back when you've gotten everything.
quest_list.success_message: You Completed Hansel's Little List!  You earned $10,000, 10 Silver Linings and 400 quest points.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: You did a fabulous job for us! Let me have the list back and here, please accept these as a token of our appreciation.
quest_list.author: Bklyn Filly

quest_list.notes: Jayne sends you after his cunning hat.
quest_list.success_message: You have agreed to go find Jayne's cunning hat.

quest_list.notes: Fluffy sends you for carrots.
quest_list.success_message: Fluffy the rabbit has sent you for 3 Carrots.

quest_list.notes: Give Fluffy 3 carrots.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: (The rabbit looks dangerously angry again. He points to his picture of three carrots still outlined in the dirt. Obviously you don't have what he wants.)
quest_list.success_message: You were given Jayne's Cunning Hat in exchange for 3 Carrots.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: (The bunny makes a quick grab for the carrots, and tosses the knit hat at you in exchange before dashing off to his burrow.)

quest_list.notes: Give knit hat to Jayne and complete the quest.
quest_list.title: Jayne's Cunning Hat
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Where's my hat?!
quest_list.success_message: You Completed Jayne's Cunning Hat! You earned $5000 and 100 quest points.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: My hat! My cunning hat! Sorry for getting all bent up before. I been a might jumpy since that lousy day. You've done me a kindness, and I won't soon forget it! Here, it ain't much, but I best be giving you some form of payment.
quest_list.author: Tempest

quest_list.notes: Agree to see if Inigo can build Grey Slate a menorah.
quest_list.success_message: You have agreed to go and ask Inigo Webster on Jungle Isle to make a menorah for Grey Slate to give to King Phil.  You were given $1500.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Great! I really appreciate the help. Tell Inigo I need a menorah that will fit into the throne room.  It needs to be tall and well, heh, kinda gaudy.  Here's a little something to start you off.

quest_list.notes: Agree to get supplies for Inigo to start on the menorah
quest_list.success_message: You have agreed to get 20 chunks of Iron Ore and 20 chunks of Copper Ore for Inigo to use to build the menorah.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Well, I have all the chemicals I need, but I am out of the metals.  I need 20 iron ore and 20 copper ore and, oh, wait, never mind, I have the steel here, too. Just the iron and copper.

quest_list.notes: Give Inigo the iron and copper for the menorah.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You don't quite have 20 of each. I need the iron and the copper ores.
quest_list.success_message: You gave Inigo 20 chunks of Iron Ore and 20 chunks of Copper Ore for him to use in making the menorah.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: These are exactly what I need. While I am working on this, can you get what I need for the middle?

quest_list.notes: Agree to get a glass piece for Inigo from Nicolette.
quest_list.success_message: You have agreed to go to Nicolette to ask her to make the middle piece for the menorah.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Tell her it can be in any style, but I would like it blue with white animals. Oh, and it should measure, in inches, 12h X 18l X 1w.

quest_list.notes: Agree to get tin oxide for Nicolette to use for Inigo's piece.
quest_list.success_message: You have agreed to go to Arthur Temperton and buy some Tin Oxide for Nicolette.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: I am pretty sure Arthur Temperton will have more that you can buy. Just bring it back as quick as you can.

quest_list.notes: Get tin oxide from Arthur Temperton for Nicolette.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: I will need 100 dollars for the oxide.
quest_list.success_message: You were given Tin Oxide to take back to Nicolette.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: I sure do. Here you go. That will be $100.

quest_list.notes: Give Nicolette the tin oxide
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Didn't Arthur have any oxide? Could you check again?
quest_list.success_message: You gave Nicolette the Tin Oxide.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Thanks so much. This will take a little while, so why don't you wander over to Christmas Isle and say hi to Santa and Mrs. Claus? Oh, and there will be a $500 charge for the piece when you pick it up.

quest_list.notes: Pick up glass scene for the menorah
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: I'm sorry, but you don't have enough.  I need $500 before I will give you the glass piece.
quest_list.success_message: You were given a glass scene to take back to Inigo for him to use in the menorah.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: It sure is. Here you go. That will be $500. Tell Inigo I appreciate the opportunity for royalty to see my craftsmanship.

quest_list.notes: Give Inigo the glass piece to be inserted into the menorah.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You don't have it? Did you drop it somewhere along the way? Perhaps you had better go and look for it.
quest_list.success_message: You gave Inigo the glass piece to use in the menorah.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: This is exactly what I was looking for!! This will take just a bit for me to complete, so if you would like to explore some, feel free.

quest_list.notes: Pick up menorah from Inigo
quest_list.success_message: You were given a very heavy, and tall, Metal and Glass Menorah to take back to Grey Slate.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: It certainly is. Here you go.  Tell Grey Slate I will send him a bill.  I think King Phil will definitely like this piece.

quest_list.notes: Tell Linnea about Dalton's Reaction
quest_list.success_message: You told Linnea how Dalton liked his rug.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: That's so nice! I never imagined that a simple gift could do that. So, tell me, who did you give the blue-green rug to?

quest_list.notes: Agree to take the menorah to King Phil
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You don't have the menorah yet? Or was it left somewhere along the way? Could you get it please and bring it back to me?
quest_list.success_message: You agreed to take the Menorah to King Phil. You were jumped to Hotzeplotz Isle.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Thanks!  Now, just grab ahold of the scepter and off you go.

quest_list.notes: Give King Phil the menorah from Grey Slate
quest_list.title: King Phil's Menorah
quest_list.success_message: You Completed King Phil's Menorah! You were given a Persian Kitten and earned 250 quest points.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Now that's a nice piece of hardware! Take this as a token of my appreciation - Please!! (King Phil mutters under his breath -If they would only stop having litters!)
quest_list.author: Jule

quest_list.notes: Get paint base for Nicolette (tracking only, 1335 and 1340 chain to this)
Agree to find wood and leather for Xamba
quest_list.success_message: You have agreed to collect 6 logs of Ebony Wood and 6 Leather Strappings for Xamba.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Six pieces.  Yes, six pieces of ebony wood.  Six leather strappings.  That's it.  Yep yep. That will do.

quest_list.notes: Xamba gives you the drum
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Not enough.  Only $300 needed.
quest_list.success_message: You were given a Drum for $300.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Done.  Finished.  Here.

quest_list.notes: Xamba tells you about Lucie B. Euro possibly knowing about french horns (tracking only)
Give Xamba wood and leather for drum
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Six!  Must have six.  Ebony wood and leather strappings.  Off you go.  Go now.
quest_list.success_message: You gave Xamba 6 logs of Ebony Wood and 6 Leather Strappings.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Aha!  Perfect.  Yes.  You go.  I work.  Come back later.  With $300.  Yep, yep.  Later.

quest_list.notes: Silver Mary Takes the Drum
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Arr, but where be my drum?!  Why ye filthy, lyin' pirate, I'll run you through!  Begone an' get me me drum!
quest_list.success_message: Silver Mary accepts the Drum.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Arr, now this be a nice... if a wee bit exotic... kind of a drum.  T'will do.

quest_list.notes: Give Mary one of the french horns (tracking only)
Cinnamon sells you four liters of cow's milk.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Wait a minute, you don't have $200!  Can't you get that amount?
quest_list.success_message: Cinnamon sells you four liters of cow's milk for $200.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Here you go.

quest_list.notes: Find Victor Voice, Harold Nickelendime's Sock Puppet
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You dig all over, but turn up nothing.
quest_list.success_message: Digging carefully, you see a bright red thread!
quest_list.success_npc_chat: You found Victor Voice, Harold Nickelendime's Sock Puppet.

quest_list.notes: Agree to find Victor Voice the sock puppet
quest_list.success_message: You have been asked by Wesley Haffdoller to find Harold Nickelendime's sock puppet.

quest_list.notes: Return the Lost Sock Puppet
quest_list.title: Harold Nickelendime's Lost Voice
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Wait a second, you don't have Victor Voice at all, do you?
quest_list.success_message: You Completed Harold Nickelendime's Lost Voice.  You earned $2000 and 25 quest points.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Wonderful!  Thank you!  Please take this reward, you deserve it!
quest_list.author: SpottedRose

quest_list.notes: Silver Mary Has Her Horn (chained action)
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Silver Mary has her Horn.

quest_list.notes: Sandy Flint sends you in search of ore and logs so he can make a copper pot.
quest_list.success_message: Sandy Flint asks you to bring him 25 chunks of Copper Ore and 10 Logs.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Yeah, I do.  I don't normally make pots completely out of copper, mostly I use iron.  So if you could get me... let's see now... say, 25 copper ores, that'd be good.  Oh!  And bring 10 logs for the forge, I don't want to use up too much of Arthur's stock.

quest_list.notes: Give Sandy Flint some copper ores
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: No, no, this isn't enough.  Please collect it all.
quest_list.success_message: You gave Sandy Flint 25 chunks of Copper Ore and 10 Logs so he can make a copper pot for Shaylene.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Thanks a lot!  I'll get right on it!  It'll take a while, so why don't you lounge around Appleton for a bit?

quest_list.notes: Give Sandy Flint Grapes and he agrees to make the pot for free!
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Aww, you don't have any grapes.  Oh, well...
quest_list.success_message: Sandy Flint will trade you the Copper Pot for three bunches of Grapes.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Oh!  Look at these!  Wow!  ....Mmmm!  Wonderful!  Fabulous!  Tell you what, I'll trade the pot for three of these!

quest_list.notes: Sandy Flint gives you the finished Copper Pot for a nominal fee.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Sorry, but you don't have enough money.  Please come back when you do.
quest_list.success_message: Sandy Flint sells you a big, shallow Copper Pot for $200.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Here's your pot!

quest_list.notes: Sandy Flint gives you the pot for grapes.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: I thought you had grapes!
quest_list.success_message: Sandy Flint gives you a big, shallow copper pot in exchange for three Bunches of Grapes.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Here you go!  These are fabulous!  Aesop Island Grapes, you said?  Incredible!  Thanks a lot!

quest_list.notes: Sandy Flint Gives You The Copper Pot (chained action)
quest_list.success_npc_chat: The pot is huge and shallow, just right for cheesemaking.

quest_list.notes: Nicolette takes your leftover oxides
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Do you have that old list?  I'll bin that for you, too.
quest_list.success_message: Nicolette takes the oxides from you.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Sure, here, let me have them.  Do you have that old list?  I'll bin that for you, too.

quest_list.notes: You deliver a bag of hazelnuts to Cara Cook
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Hazel must have forgotten to give you the hazelnuts. Maybe you should go back and ask her for them.
quest_list.success_message: You have successfully delivered the Bag of Hazelnuts to Cara Cook.  Now hurry back to Hazel in Earton and see if she has any more deliveries for you.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: I'll be sure to let her know and thanks for making the delivery!

quest_list.notes: Nicolette Bins Your Leftover List
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: What did you do with it?  Don't litter!
quest_list.success_message: Nicolette bins your list for you.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: There you go.  Thanks for not littering!

quest_list.notes: Hazel gives you a bag of hazelnuts to deliver.
quest_list.success_message: You were given a Bag of Hazelnuts to deliver to Cara Cook and $600.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Okay, wonderful!  Here's a bag of hazelnuts and a little traveling money.  Please tell Cara to let me know when she needs more.  Hurry back; I'll have another bag of nuts ready for delivery!

quest_list.notes: Hazel pays you for the the first delivery
quest_list.title: Hazel's Delivery #1
quest_list.success_message: You Completed Hazel's Delivery #1.  You earned $1000 and 25 quest points.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Wonderful.  Here's a little something for your time and trouble.  Come see me again when you have time.  I'm sure I'll have another delivery for you.
quest_list.author: Minet

quest_list.notes: Hazel sends you to deliver hazelnuts to Ethel Barryjam in Hotton.
quest_list.success_message: You have agreed to deliver a Bag of Hazelnuts to Ethel Barryjam.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Remember Ethel Barryjam in Hotton at the general store is where you need to go.  Here's the bag of hazelnuts to deliver.  Hurry back now!

quest_list.notes: Trayja agrees to make cheese wrap (tracking)
quest_list.success_message: For three hundred dollars, Trayja will make you some cheese wrap.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Three hundred dollars.  It'll be good paper, and worth it.

quest_list.notes: You deliver a bag of hazelnuts to Ethel Barryjam in Hotton.
quest_list.success_message: You have successfully delivered the Bag of Hazelnuts to Ethel Barryjam in Hotton.  Now hurry back to Hazel in Earton and see if she has any more deliveries for you.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: No, thanks.  You can just leave them on the counter.  Tell Hazel I'll probably be needing another bag soon.

quest_list.notes: Hazel sends you to deliver hazelnuts to Phoebe Wares in Shellton.
quest_list.success_message: You have agreed to deliver a Bag of Hazelnuts to Phoebe Wares in Shellton.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Thanks for being such a big help!  Now hurry off, Phoebe will be waiting for these.

quest_list.notes: You deliver a bag of hazelnuts to Pheobe Wares in Shellton
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Are you sure Hazel gave you the bag?  Perhaps you should go back and get it.
quest_list.success_message: You gave the Bag of Hazelnuts to Pheobe.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Be sure to tell Hazel I'll contact her again when I need more. Thanks again.

quest_list.notes: Hazel pays you for the the second delivery
quest_list.title: Hazel's Delivery #2
quest_list.success_message: You Completed Hazel's Delivery #2.  You earned $4000 and 25 quest points.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Yes, I'm finally getting rid of a lot of the nuts. Thanks so much for all your help.  Here's a little something for your trouble.  Be sure to come again when you have time; I may have one more delivery for you.
quest_list.author: Minet

quest_list.notes: Hazel pays for delivering hazelnuts to Phoebe Wares.
quest_list.title: Hazel's Delivery #3
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You still have the hazelnuts!  You'd better take those to Pheobe in Shellton right away!
quest_list.success_message: You Completed Hazel's Delivery #3.  You earned $6000 and 25 quest points.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Thanks again.  You've been a great help and now I can finally move about my cabin without tripping over piles of nuts!  Here's a small reward.
quest_list.author: Minet

quest_list.notes: Evelynn tells you to get her honeycombs and venetian food.
quest_list.success_message: Evelynn asks you to bring her 3 Honeycombs and 5 Venetian Food so she can make some red wax.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Sure, I can do that.  Can you bring me 3 honeycombs and 5 Venetian Food?

quest_list.notes: Evelynn makes some red wax for Shaylene's cheese
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: That's not enough.  Please bring the right amount when you come back.
quest_list.success_message: Evelynn gives you a warm brick of Red Wax.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Oh, excellent, thank you.  Let's see... okay... and now... okay... and sift off this here... and add a little this... and here you go!

quest_list.notes: Trayja sells you some cheese wrap.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Sorry, but you don't have enough money.  Please come back when you do.
quest_list.success_message: Trayja sells you a few sheets of Cheese Wrap for $300.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Here you go, this should keep cheese nice and fresh and moist.

quest_list.notes: Shaylene sends you on your way (resets the chat point if you decide to actually read the list she gave you).
quest_list.success_npc_chat: That'd be awesome!  Thanks so much!  Mmm!  Cheese!

quest_list.notes: Give Shaylene the Copper Pot
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: I thought you said you had the pot?  Please bring it, I can't do anything without it.
quest_list.success_message: You give Shaylene the Copper Pot.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Oh, this is fabulous!  Just what I wanted!  Thanks so much!

quest_list.notes: Give Shaylene the Red Wax
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Didn't you say you had the wax?  Please get it for me. Without it, the cheese will spoil.
quest_list.success_message: You gave Shaylene the Red Wax.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Lovely!  Just right!  Thanks!

quest_list.notes: Mrs. Claus Validates that you can go to Cloud Isle.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Oh, dear, looks like you haven't quite made it to the 75% award level to be able to go to Cloud Isle.  Why don't you come back and see me when you can?
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Oh, that's great. And you wouldn't mind bringing me some back?

quest_list.notes: Mrs. Claus buys Pixie Dust
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Oh, you don't have quite enough there. Please come back when you have more.
quest_list.success_message: You sold Mrs. Claus 15 pinches of Pixie Dust.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: This is perfect - it will help Santa and the elves so much.

quest_list.notes: Franklin Forge sells you a Curd Knife.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You can't afford this knife.  Come back when you can.
quest_list.success_message: Franklin sells you a Curd Knife for $300.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Here you are, then.  Hope she finds it useful.

quest_list.notes: Miguela Pommel sells you a pack of cheesecloth.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Sorry, you can't afford this.
quest_list.success_message: Miguela Pommel sells you a pack of Cheesecloth for $100.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Here you go, one pack of cotton cheesecloth.  If you need more, I have plenty.

quest_list.notes: You Have All the Cheesemaking Things (other successes chain to this).
Give Shaylene the Cheesecloth
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: What?  I thought you said you had it.  Please get it, I need it to finish the cheese.
quest_list.success_message: You gave Shaylene the pack of Cheesecloth.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Just what I wanted!  This will do nicely.

quest_list.notes: Give Shaylene the Cheese Wrap
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Oh, please, you didn't lose it already?
quest_list.success_message: You give Shaylene the paper Cheese Wrap.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Oh... is this cheese wrap?  Not what I was envisioning, but it will do.

quest_list.notes: Give Shaylene the Curd Knife
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You must have dropped it somewhere.  See if you can find it, won't you?
quest_list.success_message: You gave Shaylene the Curd Knife.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Mmm!  Very nice!  Just the thing.  Franklin does such good work.

quest_list.notes: Shaylene Checks That She Has Everything She Needs
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: No, sorry, I still don't have everything I need.  Please keep looking.
quest_list.success_message: You have given Shaylene everything she needs.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Wonderful!  You've brought me everything I wanted.

quest_list.notes: Shaylene gives you Chevre for Renard
quest_list.success_message: Shaylene gives you two types of goat cheese, Brunost and Prim.  Better get them to Renard as soon as you can!
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Here you go!  The one in the cheese wrap is (sort of) Brunost; and the one in the wax is Prim.  I hope your friend likes them.

quest_list.notes: Shaylene Rejects the Cow's Milk... but...
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Didn't you say you had cow's milk?
quest_list.success_npc_chat: (Shaylene takes the cow's milk from you, looks at it critically, and then sniffs. She shakes her head sadly.) I'm afraid this milk has already spoiled.

quest_list.notes: Give Cheese to Renard
quest_list.title: Monsieur Renard's Cheeses
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Oh, but please, you have no cheese here!  And you promised!
quest_list.success_message: You Completed Monsieur Renard's Cheeses.  You have earned $10,000 and 300 quest points.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Oh, these are... (Monsieur Renard takes a bite.) ...acceptable, for a first try. Yes, acceptable. You have done well. I have come up with a reward for you. Please take this.
quest_list.author: SpottedRose

quest_list.notes: Nicolette Shows You The Pigments She's Made (tracking only)
quest_list.success_npc_chat:
Come see the colors!
(On a table in a corner sit the box of chrome oxide, and three mortars and pestles. Inside are powders: leaf green, dusky pumpkin orange, deep sky blue, and dark mulberry.) I can mix you up the paint for $4000 for the lot

quest_list.notes: Sandy Flint offers a trade of grapes for a pot.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You already did this bit.
quest_list.success_message: Sandy Flint will trade you his new copper pot for three bunches of Aesop Island Grapes.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Wow, I tell you what, I'll trade you the pot for three bunches of grapes!   How's that?

quest_list.notes: Agree to get broom for Phyllis Clipper
quest_list.success_message: You have agreed to get the broom for Phyllis Clipper.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Ed Klippit is the owner of the Hotton Groomer on Desert Isle.  Just tell him I sent you.

quest_list.notes: Return the broom to Phyllis Clipper
quest_list.title: Phyllis Clipper's Broom
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: I'm sorry, but it doesn't seem that you have my broom.
quest_list.success_message: You Completed Phyllis Clipper's Broom!  You earned $2000 and 25 quest points.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Thank you so much!  Now I can clean up this floor.
quest_list.author: CheshireKitty

quest_list.notes: Recieved Broom from Ed Klippit
quest_list.success_message: You were given Phyllis Clipper's Broom from Ed Klippit.

quest_list.notes: Retrieve stolen map for Materia
quest_list.success_message: You have agreed to find Materia's stolen constellation map!
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Try talking to Cupcake to the north of here.  There are a lot of monkeys around there and Matata has been known to hide out around that area.  Please hurry back!

quest_list.notes: Cupcake tells you where Matata should be
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Oh, has he really, now?  Well, I'm sure if you look around outside, you should be able to see him.  He's usually here about this time of day.
quest_list.success_message: Cupcake has told you that Matata likes to play around her house.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Oh, has he really, now?  Well, I'm sure if you look around outside, you should be able to see him.  He's usually here about this time of day.

quest_list.notes: Shaylene Bins The List She Gave You
quest_list.success_message: Shaylene takes the Cheesemaking Supplies List from you.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Excellent!  I'll get right to that cheesemaking!  Here, why don't you give me that list and I'll chuck it for you?

quest_list.notes: Renard sends you out to purchase some cheesy comestibles, but doesn't know where you should go.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Hélas, that I do not know. You will need to search for someone who has cows, or goats.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Hélas, that I do not know. You will need to search for someone who has cows, or goats.

quest_list.notes: Player accepts M. Renard's quest. (Tracking only)
quest_list.success_npc_chat: M' chere, vous êtes un trésor! Yes, an absolute treasure! Now, pick for yourself the grapes délicieux that grow on the vines in the trees! Take as many as you like!

quest_list.notes: Agree to get 15 bananas for Matata
quest_list.success_message: You have agreed to bring Matata 15 Bananas.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Hurry back, I'm getting kind of hungry!

quest_list.notes: Give 15 bananas to Matata
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: No, I'm sorry, but you don't have enough.  I wanted 15.
quest_list.success_message: You were given Materia's Constellation Map in exchange for 15 Bananas.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Here's your map.  Thanks for the yummy bananas!

quest_list.notes: Return Materia's Constellation Map
quest_list.title: Materia's Constellation Map
quest_list.success_message: You Completed Materia's Quest!  You earned $5000 and 50 quest points.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Oh, thank you so much!  I can finally stargaze again.
quest_list.author: CheshireKitty

quest_list.notes: Kiah sends you to find Murukan the Lion
quest_list.success_message: Kiah has sent you to find Murukan, the War Lion. You were given medicine for Katukilal.

quest_list.notes: Filmore the Pig Will Take Cattails
quest_list.success_message: Filmore, the First Little Pig, will pay $100 for ten cattails.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: I'll give you $100 for every bunch of ten cattails you bring me.

quest_list.success_message: Carefully raking the snow aside, you pick a flower and immediately put it in the chilly box. You take a moment to make sure the flower is okay, but it looks perfectly nestled in its cold carrying case.

quest_list.notes: Kilye will go to Cloud and get Lilianna's measurements.

quest_list.success_npc_chat: Oh, how nice of you to remember.  I'd be happy to do it.  I'll send a message up with Winchell for her lady-in-waiting.  For measurements.  The dress will be ready in a few days.  You can pay me for it on her behalf when it's ready.

quest_list.success_npc_chat: Here you go, one bolt of white silk.  Can't wait to see this dress.

quest_list.notes: Kilye takes the silk from you and begins work on the wedding dress.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You don't have any silk at all!  Please come back when you do.
quest_list.success_message: You gave Kilye the Bolt of Silk.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Excellent!  This is fine.  I've got Lilianna's measurements, so I'll get to work right away.

quest_list.notes: Kilye Will Deliver the Wedding Dress to Lilianna.
quest_list.success_message: Kilye will deliver the wedding dress herself.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Great.  Well, see you at the wedding, I presume!

quest_list.notes: Give the Wedding Ring to Dorcas, Lilianna's lady in waiting.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Oh, no!  Have you not gotten it?  Was it lost?  Did someone steal it?!  Please find it at once!
quest_list.success_message: You gave the Wedding Ring to Dorcas.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Oh, such a lovely job that man does with rings and things.  Very nice.  Her Highness will be pleased.

quest_list.notes: Give the Cake to Dorcas.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Oh, no!  You don't have my lady's wedding cake at all!  Please go fetch it at once.
quest_list.success_message: Dorcas calls the kitchen staff, and they take the Royal Cake off to the Royal Fridge.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Oh!  Oh dear!  How on Earth did you... My goodness, that's splendid!  I'll have the kitchen staff fetch it at once!

quest_list.notes: Dorcas Acknowledges that you've spoken to Phil (tracking for replies only).

quest_list.success_npc_chat: Well, to be honest, we thought that would really be a bit excessive.  But thanks for trying anyway.

quest_list.notes: Dorcas Acknowledges that you've spoken to Kilye (tracking for replies only).
quest_list.success_message: Dorcas acknowledges that you've spoken to Kilye.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Oh, yes, I've seen the design; it's going to be ever so splendid!

quest_list.notes: You and Dorcas agree that you've done all you can.   (Princess can now be kidnapped.)

quest_list.success_npc_chat: Well, that's all the preparations underway, then.  Can I have that list back?  She likes to keep anything with her own handwriting on it.  Thanks.  You wait here and I'll go inform Her Highness.

quest_list.notes: You've brought Dorcas all the Things and Promises you can.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: No, I'm afraid you're not done yet.  Please go do what's left, and then come back.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Oh, yes, that's all of it.  I'll go an inform Her Ladyship at once.  Please wait here.
