quest_list.notes: Lilianna's Reward
quest_list.title: The Royal Wedding
quest_list.success_message: You Completed The Royal Wedding!  You were given a Pomeranian Dog and earned 350 quest points.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Accept this reward from my hands, Errant, and come upon the appointed day to the Royal Wedding you have helped arrange.
quest_list.author: SpottedRose

quest_list.notes: Princess Lilianna makes her exit.
quest_list.success_message: With a rustle of fine silks, Princess Lilianna leaves the audience chamber.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Then say nothing.  Just come for the wedding!  Goodbye now!

quest_list.notes: Search For Clues In The Castle
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You search carefully, but find nothing.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Searching the otherwise pristinely clean carpet, you can just make out the outlines of dusty boots with a curiously pointed toe.  Time to check outside!

quest_list.notes: Search Outside the Castle for clues
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Whatever might have been here has long since faded away.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Ah!  Here in the slowly billowing cloud are the tracks of pointed-toed boots, heading east!

quest_list.notes: Search for Prints around the Tree
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Alas, whatever tracks were here have long since faded away.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: The boot tracks stop here--next to many hoofprints, as of a horse impatiently standing.  And on either side of the hoofprints, two deep gouges made by something long and thin!

quest_list.notes: Find a broken feather tip!
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You rake all over, but uncover nothing interesting.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Raking carefully amongst the wisps of cloud, you uncover a piece of... the tip of a large feather?  Definitely a clue here!

quest_list.notes: Obtain the Clue of the Red-Stained Feather!
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Oh, that?  Don't know.  She had it all over her muzzle, though.  Guess it was from something she was eating when she was... wherever she was.  Rubbed her face on me and got it on this.  Kind of insisted on doing it, too...
quest_list.success_message: You have gotten the Clue of the Red-Stained Feather!
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Oh, that?  Don't know.  She had it all over her muzzle, though.  Guess it was from something she was eating when she was... wherever she was.  Rubbed her face on me and got it on this.  Kind of insisted on doing it, too...

quest_list.notes: Find the fingerprints, hear the princess!
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You look all over at all the tiny details, but alas, nothing interesting.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Behind the scoreboard, you see a small area where some dust has been moved away--fingermarks!

quest_list.notes: The Princess Flees!
quest_list.success_message: You have rescued the princess!  Best to head back to the castle.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: No, no!  I'll call Falcor, he'll come and get me!  Meet me back at the castle!  Hurry!  Be careful!  Go now!

quest_list.notes: Princess Lilianna gives you a perk for being such a brave knight...
quest_list.success_message: Princess Lilianna bestows upon thee a likeness of herself in quartz.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: O Knight of the Realm of Hotzeplotz, take firstly this Crystal Statue, wrought in my likeness, that thou mayst remember my gratitude!

quest_list.notes: You Decide To Take Action on this Princess Business (actions 1567 and 1566 chain to this)
Santa gives a snowman for free once.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: I have already given you your gift.
quest_list.success_message: Santa has given you a Snowman companion!
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Here you go!  It won't last forever, but it's still helpful!
quest_list.author: Joe

quest_list.notes: Agree to find ingredients for Rose
quest_list.success_message: You have agreed to check around and try to find Rose a pound of Nopales and 1/2 cup of Dried Cilantro.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: You would do that? Oh, thank you sooo much! I need just a small bunch of nopales - about a pound - and about 1/2 cup of dried cilantro.

quest_list.notes: Buy cilantro from Rika
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: I'm afraid you don't have enough money. It will be $50.  Why don't you come back when you have it?
quest_list.success_message: You were given dried Cilantro to take back to Rose.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Okay, here you go.  That will be $50. Thanks.

quest_list.notes: Get nopales from Wynona
quest_list.success_message: You were given a pound of Nopales for Rose.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: No charge! Tell her it's a wedding gift - of sorts. I think this will work perfectly for her!

quest_list.notes: Talk to Mrs. Claus
quest_list.success_message: You have agreed to talk to Mrs. Claus and find out if she needs any help.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Thank you.  She should be in the kitchen, if I am correct.

quest_list.notes: Give Rose the ingredients she's missing
quest_list.title: Rose's Missing Ingredients
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Oh, this isn't what I needed. Perhaps you could keep checking?
quest_list.success_message: You Completed Rose's Missing Ingredients! You earned a Sapphire Necklace, a Topaz Necklace, and 100 quest points.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Oh, thank you so much! I know it isn't much, but please take these trinkets from Will's sailing days.
quest_list.author: Jule

quest_list.notes: Agree to get ingrediants for Mrs. Claus
quest_list.success_message: You have agreed to bring Mrs. Claus ingredients for her soup and received $1,000 for expenses.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Windy in Crystalton should have the carrots I need, Clementine in Hotton should have the noodles, and Nana in Tropicton has the best celery!  Here's $1,000 to help cover travel costs.

quest_list.notes: Recieve Carrots from Windy.
quest_list.success_message: You received five Carrots from Windy.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Oh, goodness, no! I just received a shipment yesterday, so I have plenty to spare. (She rummages around in the back and then comes back out.) Here you go!

quest_list.notes: Recieve noodles from Clementine
quest_list.success_message: You received two Packages of Noodles from Clementine.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Here you go! Two packages of noodles.  See you later.

quest_list.notes: Recieve Celery from Nana
quest_list.success_message: You have received Celery from Nana.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Here you go!  Be sure you get that to her before it spoils.

quest_list.notes: Give ingrediants to Mrs. Claus
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: I'm sorry, but it seems that you are missing something.  I need all three ingredients to make the soup.
quest_list.success_message: You gave Mrs. Claus 2 Packages of Noodles and some Celery.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Oh, these look perfect!  Now for the carrots.  Do you have 5?

quest_list.notes: Give Mrs. Claus the carrots for Santa's soup
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You don't have 5 yet?  Did you eat some on the way?  I really need those 5.  Could you get some more, please?
quest_list.success_message: You gave Mrs. Claus 5 Carrots.  She gave you a Bowl of Soup for Santa.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Oh, thank you! Now I can start on that soup for Santa. Wait here a moment and I will give you some to take to him. (She goes into the kitchen and a few minutes later brings back some soup.) Just give Santa this, please? Thank you!

quest_list.notes: Give the Soup to Santa
quest_list.title: Soup for Santa
quest_list.success_message: You Completed Soup for Santa!  You earned $5500 and 75 quest points.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Oh, thank you!  I should be feeling better in no time!
quest_list.author: CheshireKitty

quest_list.notes: One of Pookies Trolls appears.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Hey, Troll!  Get over here an' troll!
quest_list.success_npc_chat:
*SNAP!* (For the first time, Princess Pookie actually speaks.) HEY! GUARD!
(Suddenly, from a door to the right, a large troll appears, and stands in front of the pile of shoes, behind which the baby dragon is held.)

quest_list.notes: Pookie sends you off to get a new pair of shoes.
quest_list.success_message: Princess Pookie would like a new pair of shoes in return for the freedom of the baby dragon.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: (The princess' jaw drops as if she can't believe how you just read her mind.) Yeah, like, yeah, really! And *SNAP!* not just plain old shoes. Remember, I'm a princess!

quest_list.notes: Thorn asks for stuff to make Pookie's shoes with.
quest_list.success_message: Thorne needs two Leather Pieces and two Rubies to make shoes for Princess Pookie.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Stuff, oh, I always need stuff.  Could you get me two leather pieces and two... uhm... rubies?

quest_list.notes: Thorne begins work on Pookie's Shoes
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: I'm sorry, you haven't got what I need: two leather pieces and two rubies.  Come back when you do.
quest_list.success_message: You gave Thorne 2 Leather Pieces and 2 Rubies.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: These will do, thanks.  Why don't you go wander around the isle for a while, while I work?

quest_list.notes: Thorne Sells You Some Shoes...
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Sorry, but that's the price.  My work is worth something, you know.
quest_list.success_message: Thorne sells you a pair of... shoes... for $5000.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Here they are.  Oh, don't wince like that.  She'll love them, trust me.

quest_list.notes: Pookie Takes The Shoes
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: WT... were shooz?
quest_list.success_message: That probably means she likes them.  You gave Princess Pookie the Kooky Shoes.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: o wow KUUL!

quest_list.notes: The Troll releases the baby dragon
quest_list.title: Princess Pookie's Kooky Shoes
quest_list.success_message: You Completed Princess Pookie's Kooky Shoes.  You earned $9000 and 75 quest points.
quest_list.success_npc_chat:
got dragon, u go bibi.

Troll: Thanks for saving Grendel. Here, for you.
quest_list.author: SpottedRose

quest_list.notes: Amariel gives you the Quest of the Seven Orbs.
quest_list.success_message: Amariel wants seven orbs from within the great maze.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: You will be my Errant, then.  And I send you forth on the Quest for the Seven Orbs.  Now listen carefully to what I have to tell you.

quest_list.notes: The Red Dragon asks for Five Magenta Shards.
quest_list.success_message: The Red Dragon wants five Magenta Crystal Shards.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: (The dragon tilts its magnificent crimson head.) Have it? Nay, not until I see what thou hast for me in return! Five Shards of Magenta Crystal is the price of my Orb. Bringest thou them hither, and I shall give thee mine orb.

quest_list.notes: Red Dragon trades Five Magenta Shards for the Red Orb.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Thou swell!  Five is the number thou shalt count of shards!  Nay, thou hast not five here!  Begone and get them!
quest_list.success_message: You've traded five Magenta Crystal Shards for the Red Dragon Orb.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Thank you.  Now I vouchsafe unto thee my Red Dragon Orb.  Bring it unto Amariel with my highest complements.

quest_list.notes: Mabel tells you to search the castle. (tracking only)
quest_list.success_message: Miss Mabel advised you to search the castle inside and out for clues.

quest_list.notes: You told Miss Mabel about the red (tracking only)
The Blue Dragon sends you for Red Shards
quest_list.success_message: The Blue Dragon wants 5 Red Crystal Shards in return for his orb.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Prove it by giving me five Red Crystal Shards from the Red Dragon's lair, and I will give you my orb.

quest_list.notes: Trade Red Crystal Shards for the Blue Dragon's Orb
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: I wanted five of them.  Bring me five and you can have the orb.
quest_list.success_message: The Blue Dragon trades you his Blue Orb for 5 Red Crystal Shards.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Ah.  That will do.  Here is my orb.  I hope it gives her some comfort.

quest_list.notes: The Purple Dragon sends you for Blue Shards.
quest_list.success_message: The Purple Dragon requires five Blue Crystal Shards before handing over her Orb.
quest_list.success_npc_chat:
Well, hie thee hence, and bring them here!
Then orb you shall have, never fear.

quest_list.notes: You obtain the Purple Dragon Orb
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: That's not five!  Can't you count?
quest_list.success_message: In exchange for five Blue Crystal Shards, the Purple Dragon gives you the Purple Orb.
quest_list.success_npc_chat:
Ah, splendid! Here, now have my orb
For doing such a real good jorb.

quest_list.notes: The Green Dragon waxes histrionic.
quest_list.success_message: The green dragon wants five Purple Crystal Shards.  (At least, you -think- that's what he's trying to tell you.)
quest_list.success_npc_chat: The kid was quick!  Quick as a freshman erasing the right answer on a test and putting in the wrong one.  The kid knew what I wanted all right.  Purple shards, yeah.  And if the kid could get it, I'll know the dame means business.

quest_list.notes: The Green Dragon gives you his Green Orb
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Nah, it looked like the kid didn't have what I needed.  Too bad.
quest_list.success_message: You were given the Green Dragon Orb for 5 Purple Crystal Shards.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Well, it turned out the kid was the real deal after all.  And me?  Well, I kept my end of the bargain.  I handed over the jewel.  Here's lookin' at you, kid.

quest_list.notes: The Cyan Dragon asks you for green shards.
quest_list.success_message: The Cyan Dragon would like five Green Crystal Shards.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: I should have known.  Of course, she wants something.  She's never forgiven me for breaking her best dragon saddle.  Well... fine.  I will part with my Orb.  What is it to me anyway?  Just a reminder of... bad times.  Fetch for me five green shards.

quest_list.notes: Acquire the Cyan Dragon Orb
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: That is not what I asked for.
quest_list.success_message: You gave five Green Crystal Shards and got the Cyan Dragon Orb.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Here it is, then.  My own scales, my own gems, encased in resin and polished.  Take it away.

quest_list.notes: Yellow Dragon wants Cyan Shards
quest_list.success_message: The yellow dragon will give you the Yellow Orb in exchange for five shards of Cyan Crystal.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Oh.  She does, does she?  Well, I suppose you can have it.  I have no use for it.  But I'd like something in return: 5 shards of Cyan Crystal.

quest_list.notes: Acquire the Yellow Dragon Orb
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Sorry, but that just won't do.
quest_list.success_message: You have obtained the Yellow Dragon Orb in return for five Cyan Crystal Shards.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Ah, well, here you go, then.  Can't say I'll miss it.  Hopefully it won't be a bad penny that always saves nine.

quest_list.notes: The Magenta Dragons wants Yellow Shards
quest_list.success_message: The Magenta Dragon wants five Yellow Crystal Shards in return for his orb.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: In return for my orb, I ask of you one last thing.  Honor our Dragon Traditions by bringing me five Yellow Shards.

quest_list.notes: The Magenta Dragon gives you the Magenta Orb
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Do no mock me!  Do you think I cannot count?  Bring me what I asked for, and earn my Orb, and my respect.
quest_list.success_message: You have gotten the Magenta Dragon Orb!
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Here it is.  My scales.  My feathers.  A little bit of the finest of dragons, made into this jewel.  I would be better served if you kept it for yourself.  But do with it what you will.

quest_list.notes: Amariel checks to make sure you have all the orbs.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You don't have all of them.  I need all of them at once.  Please, you have to get them all.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Yes, that's fine.  Now, if you would give them to me, please?

quest_list.notes: Give Amariel the Red and Blue Orbs.
quest_list.success_message: You gave Amariel the Red and Blue Dragon Orbs.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Thank you, they are beautiful.  Now, the Purple and Green orbs, please?

quest_list.notes: Give Amariel the Green and Purple Orbs.
quest_list.success_message: You gave Amariel the Green and Purple Dragon Orbs.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Lovely.  I am so well pleased.  The Cyan and Yellow, now, please?

quest_list.notes: Give Amariel the Cyan and Yellow Orbs.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Where are they?  You don't have them!  What happened to them!  Find them at once, please!
quest_list.success_message: You gave Amariel the Cyan and Yellow Dragon Orbs.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Thank you, you've done so well.  And last, the Magenta Orb.

quest_list.notes: Give Amariel the Magenta Orb
quest_list.title: Amariel's Seven Orbs
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Where is it?  You don't have it!  Find it at once, please!
quest_list.success_message: You have completed Amariel's Seven Orbs!  You earned $20,000 and 200 quest points!
quest_list.success_npc_chat: You are a gem yourself.  Thank you so much for getting all these orbs for me.
quest_list.author: SpottedRose

quest_list.notes: Freddy asks for pumice stones (first pass through)
quest_list.success_message: Freddy needs 30 Pumice Stones in a hurry!
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Okay.  Get a grip there, Freddy, old boy.  Deep calming breaths, thaaaaaaat's it.  Thirty. Can you bring me 30 pumice stones?

quest_list.notes: Give Freddy his 30 pumice stones
quest_list.title: Freddy's Pumice Stones
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Oh, no oh no oh no oh no, that's not enough, not enough!  Thirty, I said!  Please, I've got a deadline!
quest_list.success_message: You Completed Freddy's Pumice Stones.  You earned $3000 and 25 quest points.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Oh, wonderful!  Just splendid, splendid, I'll get to work right away.  Thank you so much!  I don't know what I'd do without you!
quest_list.author: SpottedRose

quest_list.notes: Freddy buys pumice stones for $75 each (after you've done his quest)
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Oh, you're all out.  That's too bad, but you'll find me more, won't you?  There's a good chap. Ahem, a good... Yes, well, there you go.
quest_list.success_message: You sold a Pumice Stone to Freddy for $75.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Oh!  This is excellent!

quest_list.notes: Xiang sends you off to find Dragons' Teeth
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Oh, thank you so much!  I'm sure they are buried right around the bases of the volcanoes, but you will have to search for them.

quest_list.notes: Dig up the Magenta Dragon's Tooth
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You dig all over, but turn up nothing.
quest_list.success_message: You dig carefully and see something!
quest_list.success_npc_chat: You found a Dragon's Tooth!

quest_list.notes: Dig up the Yellow Dragon's Tooth
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You dig all over, but turn up nothing.
quest_list.success_message: You dig carefully and see something!
quest_list.success_npc_chat: You found a Dragon's Tooth!

quest_list.notes: Dig up the Cyan Dragon's Tooth
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You dig all over, but turn up nothing.
quest_list.success_message: You dig carefully and see something!
quest_list.success_npc_chat: You found a Dragon's Tooth!

quest_list.notes: Dig up the Purple Dragon's Tooth
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You dig all over, but turn up nothing.
quest_list.success_message: You dig carefully and see something!
quest_list.success_npc_chat: You found a Dragon's Tooth!

quest_list.notes: Find Wonder #2
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You look all over at all the tiny details, but alas, nothing interesting.
quest_list.success_message: Searching for details, you find a clue! Posy holds the sketch for which you search.

quest_list.notes: Dig up the Blue Dragon's Tooth
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You dig all over, but turn up nothing.
quest_list.success_message: You dig carefully and see something!
quest_list.success_npc_chat: You found a Dragon's Tooth!

quest_list.notes: Dig up the Red Dragon's Tooth
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You dig all over, but turn up nothing.
quest_list.success_message: You dig carefully and see something!
quest_list.success_npc_chat: You found a Dragon's Tooth!

quest_list.notes: Dig up the Green Dragon's Tooth
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You dig all over, but turn up nothing.
quest_list.success_message: You dig carefully and see something!
quest_list.success_npc_chat: You found a Dragon's Tooth!

quest_list.notes: Give the teeth to Xiang
quest_list.title: Xiang and the Volcanoes
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: I'm sorry, but you don't have them all.  Please try harder!
quest_list.success_message: You Completed Xiang and the Volcanoes.  You earned $10,000 and 200 quest points.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Thank you so much for returning these to me. Please accept this reward.
quest_list.author: SpottedRose

quest_list.notes: Search Pella the Fire Salamander's Cave
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Everything here is a jumble.  Many things have gone in and out from this spot, including yourself!
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Searching carefully, you see many tracks on the ground, most overlapping one another.  The freshest tracks are those of a salamander going out, and booted feet going both in and out.

quest_list.notes: A search of the road reveals nothing, but hints you should talk to Pookie.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You dig all over, but turn up nothing.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: The stone road is so hard and wind-swept that no footprints of any kind can be found.  Oh, well, you could always ask Princess Pookie.

quest_list.notes: Pookie sends you to Bruce the Scotsman
quest_list.success_message: She might be suggesting Bruce lives in Ashton.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: idk town maB

quest_list.notes: Colina tells you where you might actually find Bruce
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Didn't find him?  He's around the outside of the maze somewhere, never strays far.  Keep looking, he'll be there.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Och, aye, just wander around the outside of the maze, and listen for the skirling o' the pipes!

quest_list.notes: Zik tells you where to find Zak
quest_list.success_message: You have agreed to find Zak for Zik.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Martian sense say Zak west island, south, by ocean?  Hurry, ship need be fixed!

quest_list.notes: Agree to get Pumice rock and Iron ore for Zak
quest_list.success_message: You have agreed to find 15 Pumice Stones and 10 chunks of Iron Ore for Zak.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Hurry back soon.  Need ship working.

quest_list.notes: Give Pumice rock and Iron ore to Zak
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: No, not right.  Something missing.  I need 15 grey rock and 10 iron rock.  Hurry back.
quest_list.success_message: You gave Zak 15 Pumice Stones and 10 chunks of Iron Ore.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Wonderful!  Now can do me one more favor?

quest_list.notes: agree to get 10 blue crystal shards and 10 green crystal shards for Zak
quest_list.success_message: You have agreed to find 5 Blue Crystal Shards and 5 Green Crystal Shards for Zak.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Last things, promise.  Hurry, ship need be fixed.

quest_list.notes: Give Crystals to Zak
quest_list.title: Zik and Zak's Broken Ship
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: No, no, something still missing.  Need 5 blue and 5 green crystals.
quest_list.success_message: You Completed Zik and Zak's Broken Ship.  You earned a Diamond, 3 Dinosaur Bones and 125 quest points.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Oh, yes, this good! Now ship can run. Here some found things. I return to my brother now. (He disappears in a poof of green smoke.)
quest_list.author: CheshireKitty

quest_list.notes: Bruce agrees to carry on piping for dragons and sends you on your way.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Well, here, you see?  These are Pella's tracks.  That line is her tail dragging, and footprints on either side.  She was here, and she ran off there to the northeast.  Salamanders like Pella, they like it warm, so she'd be somewhere warmish.

quest_list.notes: Pookie sends you to get her some purple ink from Kilye.
quest_list.success_message: Her Highness would like some Purple Ink.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: u get me purpl ink i pay u kk?

quest_list.notes: Kilye needs ink ingredients.
quest_list.success_message: Kilye needs 20 Blackberries and 2 Oranges.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: I see.  Okay, purple ink I can make, if you'll get me some ingredients.  Let's see, purple... I'll need 20 blackberries for a nice dark ink, and I'll need some acid... oranges will do.  I'll need salt, too, but I've got enough.

quest_list.notes: Give Kilye the Ink Ingredients
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: That's not enough.  This much won't make a very servicible ink.  I needed 20 blackberries and 2 orange.  Please find the rest.
quest_list.success_message: You gave Kilye 2 Oranges and 20 Blackberries.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Excellent, these will do nicely.  I'll have the ink ready for you in a little while.

quest_list.notes: Kilye sells you Purple Ink
quest_list.success_message: You bought a bottle of purple ink from Kilye for $500.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Here you are.  I hope it suffices.

quest_list.notes: Give Pookie her Ink
quest_list.title: Pookie's Purple Ink
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: I dun lik it
quest_list.success_message: You Completed Pookie's Purple Ink!  You earned two bags of Honey Oats and 50 quest points.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: kthxbai
quest_list.author: SpottedRose

quest_list.notes: Give the agates to Dakota
quest_list.title: Dakota's Home Remedy
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Sorry, you don't have quite enough yet.  I need 25.
quest_list.success_message: You Completed Dakota's Home Remedy! You earned $500 and 25 quest points.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Thank you so much. Now I can get back to my scorpion collecting!
quest_list.author: Nonsensemom

quest_list.notes: Selena will buy Moonbeams from you for $42 each.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: If you could but bring me some, I should be especially grateful.  I will pay you $42 each for any and all you bring me!
quest_list.success_message: Selena buys Moonbeams for $42 apiece.

quest_list.notes: Sell Moonbeams to Selena

quest_list.notes: Lenny sends you off to bring Rock Glass goblets to Mona on Art Isle

quest_list.success_npc_chat: Meow meow meow! (To a nearby cat.) Mew meeew, meow meow, meow? (Faces you again.) Mew meow.
