quest_list.notes: Give Xamba 5 ebony wood, receive clarinet molds.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Five logs!  Ebony wood.  Get five logs.  Then maybe I have molds.  Go!
quest_list.success_message: You gave Xamba 5 logs of Ebony Wood.  You were given Xamba's Clarinet Key Molds to bring to Sandy Flint.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Yes, yes! Perfect logs! The molds have not been found, but close I am. Yes, close. Stay! (Digging through a shelf of boxes.) Aha! There! I take ebony wood. You take molds to Sandy, yes? Do not forget reeds! Go now. Quick, quick.

quest_list.notes: Give Sandy Flint clarinet molds, agree to find 25 silver ore.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: But I will need the clarinet molds.  Xamba should have them.
quest_list.success_message: You have agreed to get Sandy 25 chunks of Silver Ore to make the clarinet keys.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Yes, these will do nicely.  I will need silver ore to fill them with, of course.  Would you mind getting that for me?  Twenty-five should do it.

quest_list.notes: Give Sandy 25 silver, go to get reeds from Barrett.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: That isn't enough silver to make all the keys.  Come back with 25 pieces, okay?
quest_list.success_message: You gave Sandy 25 chunks of Silver Ore.  Time to visit Barrett on Tail Isle.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Reeds?  Those I can't make.  I usually get them from Barrett, on Tail Isle.  He makes them from wood he finds in the swamps there, but I don't have any right now.  Could you go pick some up while I start on these keys?

quest_list.notes: Shark Soup Brady Accepts 10 Oranges
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Arrr, I can't eat 10 oranges if you don't bring 10 oranges, friend.
quest_list.success_message: You gave Brady 10 Oranges.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Arrr, friend, I'll try to force 'em down, if ye think it be fer the best.

quest_list.notes: Shark Soup Brady Accepts 10 Strawberries and 10 Rotten Tomatoes
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You're not totin' them fruits... Do ye have a bug in yer brain now?
quest_list.success_message: You gave Brady 10 Strawberries and 10 Rotten Tomatoes.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Well, I be leery of this, friend.  I never heard a thing good about strawberries, and in me travels, I heard tell that them tomato things be poison.

quest_list.notes: Purchase a Box of Clarinet Reeds from Barrett for $1000
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You don't have the cash.  Come on back when you have $1000.
quest_list.success_message: You purchase a Box of Clarinet Reeds for $1000.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Here you are.  Go ahead and ask any clarinetist.  Good reeds make all the difference.

quest_list.notes: Shark Soup Brady is on her way to a healthier lifestyle and rewards you
quest_list.title: Shark Soup Brady's Mysterious Ailment
quest_list.success_message: You Completed Shark Soup Brady's Mysterious Ailment!  You earned a Ruby Necklace, two Gold Chains, and 150 quest points.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Arr!  In that case – not that I be promisin' -- but I may try them.  I'll be working away at me oranges fer now.  Thank ye fer helpin' in me time of need, friend.  Take this bit o' booty as a reward fer all ye've done.
quest_list.author: Vetiver

quest_list.notes: Return to Sandy for clarinet keys and molds.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: No, not yet.  But they should be done by the time you pick up the reeds from Barrett.
quest_list.success_message: You receive Xamba's Clarinet Molds and a Bag of Clarinet Keys.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Very good.  Here are the keys.  And don't forget to return Xamba's molds to him, either.  Tell him it was a pleasure working with him again.

quest_list.notes: Give Xamba the keys and molds.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: No, no!  Clarinet needs wood parts, yes, but also keys and reeds.  Talk to Sandy Flint.
quest_list.success_message: You gave Xamba his Clarinet Key Molds and the Bag of Clarinet Keys.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Aha! Good, great. You sit here, I attach keys to clarinet. (Taking a set of small tools, Xamba sets about attaching the silver pieces to different parts of the clarinet.) Reeds? You have reeds, yes?

quest_list.notes: Give Xamba the reeds and receive completed clarinet.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Ah, but you do not have the reeds.  Cannot play clarinet without reeds.
quest_list.success_message: At last, you receive a Clarinet for Harmony.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: (He selects a reed from the box, soaks it, and carefully secures it to the clarinet mouthpiece with a silver band. He then tests the instrument. Seeming satisfied, he takes the reed off and puts it back inside the box.) Listen to her, you should.

quest_list.notes: Give Harmony her clarinet.
quest_list.title: Harmony's New Clarinet
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: But you don't have the clarinet!  Talk to Xamba, he can make them.
quest_list.success_message: You have delivered Harmony's New Clarinet!  You receive $20,000 and 250 quest points.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Thank you.  This is a fine instrument, you deserve a reward for your work in getting it to me.
quest_list.author: Bazjack

quest_list.notes: You gave Pillan either a rat or gerbil (tracking only)
Shark Soup Brady buys 10 Rotten Tomatoes for 1 Pearl
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You don't have what I be requirin', friend.
quest_list.success_message: You were given a Pearl for 10 Rotten Tomatoes.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Arrr!  Thanks!

quest_list.notes: Shark Soup Brady tells you she'll take tomatoes.
quest_list.success_message: Brady says she'll give you a reward for Rotten Tomatoes in batches of 10.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: If ye be bringin' me them tomatoes in groups o' ten, I can't say that I wouldn't give ya a bit of reward fer them.

quest_list.notes: Cupid gives you chocolates for Venus
quest_list.success_message: You have agreed to give a Box of Chocolates to Venus on Magma Isle.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Please take these chocolates to Venus on Magma.  I can send you there, of course.

quest_list.notes: sends you back to Venus.
quest_list.success_message: *POOF*  You are now on Magma Isle.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: There you go!  Be sure to talk to her, she will send you back when you're done.

quest_list.notes: Jubal asks you to find him some stinky salve
quest_list.success_message: Jubal asked you to check with retired sailors about a Healing Salve.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Thank you for doing this for me.

quest_list.notes: Mr. Fin suggests Eunice for stinky salve
quest_list.success_message: Mr. Fin thinks that Eunice might be a resource for a Healing Salve.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Nereus was an old man when I was a young man.  I'm sure he wouldn't be around anymore.  He had a little girl, though.  I believe her name was Eunice. If you can find her, maybe she could help you.

quest_list.notes: Eunice wants you to ask Odysseus about her recipe
quest_list.success_message: Eunice asks you to talk to Odysseus about aspects of her father's Liniment recipe.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Could you also ask him if he knows what lanolin is, and where we could get it?

quest_list.notes: Pass Odysseus' info to Eunice
quest_list.success_message: You let Eunice know what a gill, a peck, and lanolin are.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: (Eunice annotates changes on the recipe, then scribbles down some quick equations.) I have to halve the recipe, I don't have this much aloe. Are you ready to search for the other ingredients?

quest_list.notes: Odysseus helps translate the old recipe.
quest_list.success_message: Odysseus has informed you that a gill equals half a cup, a peck is about two gallons, and lanolin comes from wool.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: I would assume you'd have to find someone with sheep.  Lanolin is wool oil.

quest_list.notes: Agree to seek liniment ingredients for Eunice
quest_list.success_message: You have agreed to seek liniment ingredients for Eunice.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: You should probably write a list of everything I'll need you to find. The first is four cups of this lanolin stuff.  I've never met anyone with sheep, so you'll have to figure that out for yourself.

quest_list.notes: Get list of liniment ingredients
quest_list.success_message: You have a list of Eunice's required ingredients.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Well, that's everything I'll need.  Please be careful with that list.

quest_list.notes: Candide gives lanolin
quest_list.success_message: You received a gallon of Lanolin from Candide.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Oh, don't worry about paying me for it.  You've helped me so much - it's on the house.

quest_list.notes: Buy rosemary from Rika
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: I'm afraid you don't have enough money. It will be $50.  Why don't you come back when you have it?
quest_list.success_message: You paid $50 for half a cup of Rosemary.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: There you go!  Half a cup of the freshest of rosemary leaves.  That'll be $50, please.

quest_list.notes: Buy Camphor and Witch Hazel from Engolo-mbe
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: I'm afraid you don't have enough money. It will be $1000 for both.
quest_list.success_message: Engolo-mbe has given you a well-wrapped package of Camphor and a small sealed jug of Witch Hazel.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: And here they are.  Don't open that package of camphor until it's absolutely necessary!

quest_list.notes: Eunice takes lanolin
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: I don't see what I need here.  Please check that list again!
quest_list.success_message: You gave the Lanolin to Eunice.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Wow!  This is a lot of lanolin!

quest_list.notes: Eunice takes rosemary
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: I don't see what I need here.  Please check that list again!
quest_list.success_message: You gave the Rosemary to Eunice.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Thanks!  This rosemary is nice and fresh.  Rika always has the best.

quest_list.notes: Eunice takes camphor and witch hazel
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: I don't see what I need here.  Please check that list again!
quest_list.success_message: You gave the Camphor and Witch Hazel to Eunice.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Wow, this is some strange stuff!  I'll bet it's this camphor that makes the liniment smell so awful.

quest_list.notes: Eunice takes the list
quest_list.success_message: You gave Eunice the list you made.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Thank you for understanding.

quest_list.notes: Eunice gives liniment
quest_list.success_message: You were given four large tins labeled Nereus' Aromatic Liniment.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Yes it is.   The smell should fade soon, now that it's all put away into tins.  If you don't mind me keeping the extra lanolin, we'll consider that payment for preparing the liniment.  This is wonderful stuff!

quest_list.notes: Jubal takes liniment
quest_list.success_message: You gave Jubal four large tins of Nereus' Aromatic Liniment.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: That's great!  It sounds like you went through a lot of trouble to find some.  I'm sorry about that.

quest_list.notes: Jubal gives you reward and ...whoosh!
quest_list.title: Jubal's Healing Liniment
quest_list.success_message: Jubal opens one of the tins and the horrible smell shunts you out the door.  You Completed Jubal's Healing Liniment.  You earned a Diamond Necklace, a Pearl Necklace and 300 quest points.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Leaving so soon?
quest_list.author: Vetiver

quest_list.notes: Venus/Eros sends you back to Cupid When asked.
quest_list.success_message: *POOF*  You are now on Igneous Isle.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: There you go! I hope you do come back to visit.

quest_list.notes: Give chocolates to Venus
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: I'm sorry, but you don't have the chocolates you mentioned.
quest_list.success_message: You gave the Chocolates to Venus!  You should go tell Cupid.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Oh, why, thank you!  Would you tell him thank you for me?

quest_list.notes: Cupid confirms that you've talked to Venus
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: I'm sorry, but it looks like you still have those chocolates.  You should give those to Venus and then come back.
quest_list.success_message: You told Cupid how much Venus loved her chocolates.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Oh, thank you!  Do you think you could make another delivery for me?

quest_list.notes: Have a nice gossip session with Eunice
quest_list.success_message: Eunice is a good gossip!
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Thank you for passing that along.  I'll have to visit the Sand Isles again soon.

quest_list.notes: Cupid gives you chocolates  for Eros
quest_list.success_message: Cupid has given you a Box of Chocolates.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Could you take these chocolates to Eros for me, please?  He's on Pumice Isle.

quest_list.notes: Cupid sends you to Eros when asked.
quest_list.success_message: *POOF*  You are now on Pumice Isle.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: There you go! Just talk to Eros when you're ready to come back.

quest_list.notes: Give Eros chocolates and you are given a letter to give to Cupid.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: I'm sorry, but you don't have the chocolates you mentioned.
quest_list.success_message: You gave Eros the Box of Chocolates and received a letter to give to Cupid.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Oh, thank you!  Do you think you could take this letter to Cupid on your way back?

quest_list.notes: Give Eros' letter to Cupid
quest_list.title: Cupid's Valentines
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: I'm sorry, but it looks like you still have those chocolates.  You should give those to Eros and then come back.
quest_list.success_message: You Completed Cupid's Valentines.  You earned $5000 and 50 quest points.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Oh, thank you! (He begins to read the letter.) Oh, yes! It looks like that was exactly what Eros needed. He was beginning to worry about me.
quest_list.author: CheshireKitty

quest_list.notes: Agree to Help Jubal find out about his past, and check for 50% award
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: That's very kind of you, but you should wait till you know your way to Pirate Isle before you consider helping me, since I did have a past with pirates.
quest_list.success_message: You have agreed to help Jubal figure out his puzzling scraps of paper.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: That's very kind of you to want to help someone like me.  I wish I had more I could tell you about these scraps of paper.  My memories are pretty hazy.

quest_list.notes: Capri runs into her clearing
quest_list.success_message: You've startled the faun into the trees.  Perhaps by using a tool, you could find her again.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: (Vanishes into the trees behind her.)

quest_list.notes: Decide to talk to Palila for more Jubal gossip
quest_list.success_message: You decide to talk to Palila about the mysterious scraps of paper.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Good luck to you!  Come back if you find out about these paper scraps!

quest_list.notes: Captain Solomon sends you to Silver Mary for scraps
quest_list.success_message: Captain Solomon suggests that you visit Silver Mary.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Nay, but go see Silver Mary.  She can steer ye right.

quest_list.notes: Rogue Scrap Taker
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Baaa!
quest_list.success_message: Athamos took one torn scrap of paper from you and ate it.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Baaa! (Burp.)

quest_list.notes: Help Rashida with Checker Slide
quest_list.title: Rashida's Checkers
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You must have already completed this puzzle.
quest_list.success_message: That's it!  Great!  Thanks!
quest_list.success_npc_chat: You Completed Rashida's Checkers.  You earned $5000 and 25 quest points.

quest_list.notes: Jubal hands over scraps 2 & 15
quest_list.success_message: Jubal gives you a torn scrap of paper that says MAKE-2 and another that says ROPE-15.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: I'm pretty sure I can remember what they say.  Here you go.

quest_list.notes: Palila gives clues about Calico Jack and a circus performer
quest_list.success_message: You learn that a strange circus performer, and a pirate called Calico Jack were the last to leave Jubal's party.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: That suave Calico Jack.  I'm sure he's some bigwig pirate. Maybe even the captain of that band.  He left very late.  I'd say it was a good quarter hour after the man in the turban left.

quest_list.notes: Reuben says that Gritty wore a turban for his act
quest_list.success_message: Reuben tells you that Gritty wore a tuxedo and turban for his hypnotism act.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Yes, that's it.  I'm not sure where Gritty is now, but he wore a costume just like the one you described.

quest_list.notes: Gain Gritty's Trust
quest_list.success_npc_chat: You have to understand that I just mesmerized him. I don't know why they wanted me to.  I've never done that before – hypnotized someone then not brought them out of it completely.

quest_list.notes: Gritty gives scraps 1 & 16
quest_list.success_message: Gritty gives you a torn scrap of paper that says STIG-1 and another that says VOKES-16.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Here they are.

quest_list.notes: Silver Mary sells you scraps 4 & 13
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: That don't look like 5 amethysts to me.
quest_list.success_message: Silver Mary gives you a torn scrap of paper that says UBAL-4, another that says UREA-13, and she hints that Nathaniel has some scraps.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: I can feel it in me bones that they're some kind o' riddle.  If ye shift the letters around-like, it says 'Bear Luau.'  Nate's shift around to read 'Sea Horns!'

quest_list.notes: Squalid Nathaniel sells you scraps 5 & 12
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: That don't look like 5 topazes to me.
quest_list.success_message: Squalid Nathaniel gives you a torn scrap of paper that says ONSH-5, another that says REAS-12, and hints that the bridge guard has scraps.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Here be yer scraps.  If ye're wantin' more, ask that fella who guards the bridge. Long life to yeh!

quest_list.notes: Crossbones Bridge Guard sells you scraps 6 & 11
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: That don't look like 5 topazes to me.
quest_list.success_message: The Bridge Guard gives you a torn scrap of paper that says OREN-6, another that says THET-11, and tells you to talk to Black Bart.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: No time to chew th' fat, go see Black Bart.  He'll steer ye right.

quest_list.notes: Black Bart Faints
quest_list.success_message: Black Bart sort of tells you to see his wife, Rhianna, and he might-or-might-not have said to talk to Sam and the pirate who shuttles the rowboat.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: (Black Bart falls down in a dead faint.)

quest_list.notes: Bird Rowboat Pirate sells scraps 9 & 8
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: That don't look like 5 topazes to me.
quest_list.success_message: The Dinghy Pirate gives you a torn scrap of paper that says THEW-9 and another that says BOATS-8.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: There ya be!

quest_list.notes: Silvertooth Sam sells scraps 7 & 10
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: That don't look like 5 Amethysts to me.
quest_list.success_message: Silvertooth Sam gives you a grubby scrap of paper that says OTIN-7 and another that says AYTO-10.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Arr, feels good to get them papers out of me hands!

quest_list.notes: Rhianna gives scraps 3 & 14
quest_list.success_message: Rhianna gives you a torn scrap of paper that says EPSJ-3 and another that says GUMD-14.  Rhianna mentions that Dieter could help you with the puzzle if you get stuck.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: If you have all 16 scraps and if there's a puzzle involved, my neighbor Dieter is especially fond of that kind of thing.  With the proper incentive, I'm sure he'd love to help you!

quest_list.notes: Swiftly Shuffle Sixteen Scraps - not tracked for Dieter
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: I'm sorry, you don't seem to have all 16 pieces yet.  You might want to retrace your steps and find what you're missing.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Oh, yes, I see them.  Let me just arrange them properly.

quest_list.notes: Pay a diamond to Dieter to spoonfeed you - not required
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: I don't see the answer to my riddle here.  Please try again.
quest_list.success_message: You gave Dieter a Diamond in response to his riddle.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Wow, thanks!  I should offer quest answers on a regular basis.  I'd make a lot of money!

quest_list.notes: Swiftly Shuffle Sixteen Scraps - not tracked for Jubal
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: I don't think this is the entire note - there seem to be some pieces missing.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: I can see how my two that say “Make Rope” fit in there!  But what's the solution to the riddle?

quest_list.notes: Give Jubal a Gum Drop -and sneakily the 16 scraps
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You sure have a lot of great stuff, but I don't see anything that has to do with this note.  Maybe someone who's good with riddles can help you figure it out.
quest_list.success_message: You gave Jubal a Gum Drop.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: (Jubal takes the gum drop, he sits up straight, his eyes shine as if with sudden enlightenment.) I REMEMBER!

quest_list.notes: Jubal Remembers
quest_list.success_message: Jubal leaps up and tells you to dig.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: I remember everything!  How I thought Jack was my friend, but in reality he was... Oh my gosh!  I'm sitting on a treasure!  Quickly!  Get your shovel out!

quest_list.notes: Dig up Jubal's Treasure Chest
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You dig all over, but turn up nothing.
quest_list.success_message: Your shovel quickly hits something buried in the sand that serves as the floor of the teepee.  A treasure chest!  Better give this to Jubal.

quest_list.notes: Jubal Rewards You After All -
quest_list.title: Jubal's Puzzle of the Scraps
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: I don't think you found what I remember being there!
quest_list.success_message: You Completed Jubal's Puzzle of the Scraps.  You earned 15 Topazes, 10 Amethysts, $30,000 and 350 quest points.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: All this treasure!  Thank you so very much.  Please let me give you some of this, as a reward for your generous heart.  You have helped me so much more than you can imagine.
quest_list.author: Vetiver

quest_list.notes: Patsy sends you to Igneous Isle
quest_list.success_message: *POOF*  You are now on Igneous Isle.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: There ya go.  Good luck getting back!

quest_list.notes: Koko sends you to Patsy, missing by a little ways.  This is the normal way to get back to Lava Isle from Igneous Isle
quest_list.success_message: *POOF* You are now on Lava Isle.  Though still not quite to Patsy...
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Aha!  There!  See?  I take you right to Patsy!

quest_list.notes: Koko sends you to Patsy, missing by a little ways (tracked so you know when you have gone first time)
quest_list.success_message: *POOF* You are now on Lava Isle.  Though, not right by Patsy...
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Aha!  There!  See?  I take you right to Patsy!

quest_list.notes: Cidny-Grynstrit Gives You Some Hints.
quest_list.success_message: With that, the great, rotund dragon wanders off into the maze.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Excellent!  Yes, excellent.  Bring it to me and I will make it worth your while, very much so.  But remember this: the Malted Falcon craves the dark!  So look for it down long alleyways, deep in corners!  Good day to you!  I will see you again!

quest_list.notes: Agree to get roses for Venus.
quest_list.success_message: You have agreed to bring back three Red Roses and two Yellow Roses for Venus.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Well, the first two things I'll be needing are three red roses and two yellow roses.  I'm not sure exactly where you'll be able to find those, but you seem like the sort who can figure things out quite easily.

quest_list.notes: Give roses to Venus
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: I'm sorry, but it looks like you are missing some.  I needed 3 red roses and 2 yellow roses.  I can't finish the potion without all the roses.
quest_list.success_message: You gave Venus 3 Red Roses and 2 Yellow Roses.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Oh, thank you!  These are quite perfect!  Are you ready for the next two items?  It will be a little trickier to get these.

quest_list.notes: Agree to get Bananas and Strawberries for Venus.
quest_list.success_message: You have agreed to bring back a Bunch of Bananas and 10 Strawberries.  You were given $1000.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Now I need a bunch of bananas and ten strawberries.  However, the bananas have to come from Cupcake, any others just won't do.  The strawberries, however, can be found anywhere.  Here's a little money to help pay for travel costs.

quest_list.notes: Recieve bananas from Cupcake for Venus.
quest_list.success_message: Cupcake has given you a Bunch of Bananas.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Let me see what I have. (She walks into her kitchen and a few minutes later comes out carrying bananas.) You're in luck. These are my last ones. Please be sure to get those to Venus before they start to spot.

quest_list.notes: give bananas and strawberries to Venus
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: I'm sorry, but it looks like you don't have everything I need.  I need a bunch of bananas and 10 strawberries.
quest_list.success_message: You gave Venus a Bunch of Bananas and 10 Strawberries.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Why, thank you!  Now I only need two more items.  Do you think you're up to it?

quest_list.notes: Agree to get cinnamon and chocolate for Venus
quest_list.success_message: Venus has asked you to bring her Cinnamon and Chocolate.  You were given $1000.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: The last two items that I need are cinnamon and chocolate.  However, the cinnamon needs to come from Bena in Santon and the chocolate needs to be from Nana in Tropicton.  Here's a little more money to help pay for expenses.

quest_list.notes: Bena Buket gives you Cinnamon for Venus.
quest_list.success_message: Bena Buket gives you Cinnamon.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Yes, she does. (She goes into the back and then comes back out.) Here you go. Please let her know I said hello.

quest_list.notes: Recieve Chocolate from Nana Knutcake.
quest_list.success_message: You were given a Chocolate Brick from Nana.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Oh, yes, let me look. (She walks into the back and comes out with a carefully wrapped, small brick of chocolate.) This is what she likes best. Please let her know I said "Hi."

quest_list.notes: Give Cinnamon and Chocolate to Venus.
quest_list.title: Venus' Potion
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: I'm sorry, but it looks like you don't have everything I need.  Please come back when you have cinnamon and chocolate.
quest_list.success_message: You Completed Venus' Potion.  You earned $10,000 and 200 quest points.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Oh, thank you!  Now I can finish my potion.  Please take this as a reward.
quest_list.author: CheshireKitty

quest_list.notes: Get treasure riddle from Demetrius
quest_list.success_message: You agreed to follow the clues for the treasure riddle found by Demetrius! You get a slip of paper with Demetrius' riddle on it.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Intriguing, yes? Take this copy. If you stay, for yet a moment more, I'll recite the clue. One would surmise that additional clues follow.

quest_list.notes: Banana for a Monkey
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You look all over at all the tiny details, but alas, nothing interesting.
quest_list.success_message: Looking carefully around the boulders you spy nut shells! Just as you put the banana on the rock pile, Tika swoops down. You quickly grab her leash.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: You grabbed Tika! Time to take her back to Giuliana.

quest_list.notes: First treasure location riddle
quest_list.success_message: You were given the Demetrius' Clue Riddle. Good luck in finding the treasure.
quest_list.success_npc_chat:
You'll find this remarkably concise:
She studies the skies
She lives by the sea
On a slice of the moon
Is where she'll be.

Clever little ditty, I must confess.

quest_list.notes: Get #2 riddle from Luna
quest_list.success_message: Luna gave you Demetrius' Clue Riddle #2.
quest_list.success_npc_chat:
In front of the tree
As far down as you go
There lies a secret
Buried below.

I have no need of this, so you may have it. I'll throw away the first clue for you. You have no need of it now.

quest_list.notes: Dig Crescent Isle riddle #3
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You dig all over, but turn up nothing.
quest_list.success_message: Digging under the trees, you come upon an old metal chest. Carefully opening it, you find a piece of paper. You found Demetrius' Clue Riddle #3.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: As you place the third clue in your inventory, the wind blows away the second clue. No worries. You don't need it anymore.

quest_list.notes: Easter Bunny gives you free chocolate bunny
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: I've already given you one.  Sorry, one per person.
quest_list.success_message: You were given a Chocolate Bunny companion!
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Here you are!  Enjoy it while it lasts.  Chocolate bunnies are awfully yummy to eat.

quest_list.notes: Rake out of Capri's Clearing
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You rake all over, but uncover nothing interesting.

quest_list.notes: Rake out of Iambe's Clearing
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You rake all over, but uncover nothing interesting.

quest_list.notes: Rake out of Fauna's Clearing
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You rake all over, but uncover nothing interesting.

quest_list.notes: Pederlaurie appears at Lornbacoll's cave
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: (Lornbacoll gets up and begins to pace her cave.) Yeah, I know how he is. So long as you can get before... well...
quest_list.success_npc_chat: (Lornbacoll gets up and begins to pace her cave.) Yeah, I know how he is. So long as you can get before... well...

quest_list.notes: Big Blue puts you back on land
quest_list.success_message: **POOF** Big Blue magically got you back to shore, and you're perfectly dry!
quest_list.success_npc_chat: And out you go, kid!

quest_list.notes: Big Troll tips you into the ocean because you're too chatty
quest_list.success_message: Big Troll nudged you into the ocean!
quest_list.success_npc_chat: (Nudge.)

quest_list.notes: Big Troll tips you into the ocean
quest_list.success_message: Whoops!  Big Troll gave you a nudge while you were laughing so hard, and you lost your balance.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: (Nudge.)

quest_list.notes: Capri tells you to see Iambe
quest_list.success_message: Capri tells you to look for an inaccessible part of West Treeton Forest to find Iambe.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Iambe usually can be found in the north part of West Treeton Forest.  She favors a particular clearing surrounded by trees, quite a bit like this one. If you check around, you should find a good spot where you can push through the trees.

quest_list.notes: Iambe tells you to go see Fauna
quest_list.success_message: Iambe tells you to look for an inaccessible part of Shell Forest to find Fauna.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: She stays in the Shell Forest of Turtle Isle.  She prefers a hidden clearing in that forest, much like this one. She is the eldest, largest, and most goat-like of us sisters.

quest_list.notes: Rake to get into Fauna's Clearing
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You rake all over, but uncover nothing interesting.
quest_list.success_message: Wielding your rake, you managed to push aside the branches here just enough to get through.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: You are now in a small clearing surrounded by trees.

quest_list.notes: Agree to look for clues and help find Lulu for Nerina
quest_list.success_message: You have been asked by Nerina to find clues leading to where Lulu may be.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Oh, thank you!  They have tiny feet, so be sure to examine very closely.  There are likely to be empty shells around, too.

quest_list.notes: Find Lulu's Footprints
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You look all over at all the tiny details, but alas, nothing interesting.
quest_list.success_message: After closely examining the area, you see a few scattered and empty shells and some small footprints leading off and into the water.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Best to go tell Nerina!

quest_list.notes: Nerina asks you to check Lava Beach and find Lulu
quest_list.success_message: You have agreed to help Nerina find Lulu on Lava Isle.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Just try looking along the western beach on Lava.  Look closely under trees along the beach, she should have left some footprints in the sand.  You should be able to follow those.

quest_list.notes: Find 2nd set of Lulu's prints
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You look all over at all the tiny details, but alas, nothing interesting.
quest_list.success_message: After closely examining the area, you see a few footprints heading to the south.

quest_list.notes: 3rd set of foot prints
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You look all over at all the tiny details, but alas, nothing interesting.
quest_list.success_message: After closely examining the area, you see a few footprints heading west.

quest_list.notes: Fauna tells you where to find Wee Troll
quest_list.success_message: Fauna tells you that Wee Troll is in the lake to the northeast of her clearing.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: You'll find him in the tiny lake to the northeast.  I can hear his stomach growling, too. Please make sure to get him back to his family quickly, before he eats up all your rations.

quest_list.notes: Duplicate feel free to use
Find Lulu
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You look all over at all the tiny details, but alas, nothing interesting.
quest_list.success_message: After closely examining the area, you see a small otter lying between two rocks.  Gently, you pick her up.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: You found Lulu!  You should take her to Nerina.

quest_list.notes: Give Lulu to Nerina
quest_list.title: Nerina's Lulu
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: I'm sorry, but it doesn't seem that you have found her yet.
quest_list.success_message: You Completed Nerina's Lulu.  You earned $5000 and 100 quest points.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: I'm glad you found her, though it looks like you are right.  Hmm... I'm going to need some supplies to help fix this cut of hers.
quest_list.author: CheshireKitty

quest_list.notes: Wee Troll Poofs Home
quest_list.success_message: **POOF** The Wee Troll has vanished.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Go back now!  **POOF**

quest_list.notes: you accept the challange of helping Holly with snowman supplies
quest_list.success_message: You agree to help Holly by getting 100 Snowballs, 2 Strong Skinny Branches, 2 Walnuts and a Carrot.  You were given $1300.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Thank you.  I appreciate the help.  Here is some money to help you with your travel costs.

quest_list.notes: Nerina asks you to get medicine from Audrey for Lulu
quest_list.success_message: You have agreed to get medicine for Lulu from Audrey in Hotton.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Oh, thank you!  Audrey has a tab running for me and she'll know exactly what you will need.  Please hurry back.

quest_list.notes: Receive medicine from Audrey
quest_list.success_message: You received Otter Medicine from Audrey.  You should take it to Nerina.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Nerina, huh? Okay, I'll put this on her tab. (She goes into the back and then brings out a small package.)

quest_list.notes: Give medicine to Nerina
quest_list.title: Medicine for Lulu
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: I'm sorry, but you don't seem to have the medicine yet.  Please come back when you do.
quest_list.success_message: You Completed Medicine for Lulu.  You earned $5000 and 50 quest points.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Oh, thank you!  I'm sure this will help her feel much better.  Here, take this for a reward.
quest_list.author: CheshireKitty

quest_list.notes: Holly accepts the first lot of snowballs from you
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You don't appear to have enough there.  Come back later when you do.
quest_list.success_message: You gave Holly 50 Snowballs.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Thank you for that.

quest_list.notes: Holly accepts the Second lot of snowballs from you
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You don't appear to have enough there.  Come back later when you do.
quest_list.success_message: You gave Holly 50 more Snowballs.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Thank you for that.  That's 100 snowballs in all.

quest_list.notes: Holly accepts 2 skinny branches from you
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You don't appear to have enough there.  Come back later when you do.
quest_list.success_message: You gave Holly 2 Strong Skinny Branches.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Thank you.  These are superb.

quest_list.notes: Holly accepts 2 walnuts from you
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You don't appear to have enough there.  Come back later when you do.
quest_list.success_message: You gave Holly 2 Walnuts.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Thank you.  These will make great eyes.

quest_list.notes: Holly accepts a Carrot from you
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You don't appear to have a carrot yet.  Maybe you ate it on the way here?
quest_list.success_message: You gave Holly a Carrot.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Thank you.  This will make a fine nose.

quest_list.notes: Quest Check - Giving you cheese - now go back to Renard
quest_list.success_message: You've got the cheese, now go see Renard

quest_list.notes: Holly checks to be sure you gave her everything
quest_list.title: Holly's Snowman Supplies
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: It doesn't look like you have given me everything yet.
quest_list.success_message: You Completed Holly's Snowman Supplies.  You earned $8000 and 150 quest points.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: It looks like we do have everything. Thank you for your help. Come back and check in on him a bit later when he is finished.
quest_list.author: LinuxDude

quest_list.notes: You agree to help Holly get a hat for the snow man
quest_list.success_message: You agreed to go and see Jayne on Turtle Isle for a Snowman Hat.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Why, thank you for offering to do that.  I think he will look really nice with one of Jayne's specials.

quest_list.notes: you accept a hat from Jayne for the Holly's snowman
quest_list.success_message: Jayne gives you an Old Hat.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Since I got this new hat from my mom, I suppose Holly can have this here old one.

quest_list.notes: (Holly accepts the hat from you
quest_list.title: Holly's Snowman Hat
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You don't seem to have a hat.
quest_list.success_message: You Completed Holly's Snowman Hat.  You earned $3000 and 50 quest points.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: That is exactly what I had in mind!  Thank you for you help.  Here is a little something for your trouble
quest_list.author: LinuxDude

quest_list.notes: Bridge Troll rewards you
quest_list.title: Wandering Baby Troll
quest_list.success_message: You Completed the Wandering Baby Troll Quest!  You earned Red Tennis Shoes, a Stirrup, $7000 and 125 quest points.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Wee Troll is home under bridge now.  Middle Troll happy!  Big Troll happy!  Now human get reward:  junk from cracks in bridge.
quest_list.author: Vetiver

quest_list.notes: Lornbacoll sends you to look down an alley by a volcano...
quest_list.success_npc_chat:
If I were you, you know what I would do? I'd find an alley by a volcano, that's what I should do. Shouldn't I, Peder?
(Pederlaurie frowns and turns away.)

quest_list.notes: Find the Malted Falcon
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You rake all over, but uncover nothing interesting.
quest_list.success_message: Carefully sifting through volcanic ash and debris with your rake, you suddenly see a glint of red---and there, at last, it is.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: You found the Malted Falcon!

quest_list.notes: Give The Malted Falcon Away
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You don't have it?!  You lied!  You said you had it!  Get out of here at once!
quest_list.success_message: You hand over the Malted Falcon.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Finally! (All the dragons' eyes become very wide indeed!) After all these years!

quest_list.notes: The Stuff That Cremes Are Made Of...
quest_list.title: The Malted Falcon
quest_list.success_message: You Completed The Malted Falcon!  You earned 15 Obsidian Chunks and 75 quest points.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: (As the dust settles, you see Lornbacoll holding the box. Abrubtly, she smashes it against the wall of the cave and quickly scoops up the beans.) There! The Stuff that Cremes are made of! Take this as reward, rider, and get out while you can!
quest_list.author: SpottedRose

quest_list.notes: quest checking - give me murigal's gems
quest_list.success_message: You recieved 10 Royal Gemstones

quest_list.notes: Find the Snake
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You dig all over, but turn up nothing.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Digging under the shade of the tree, you find a beautiful little iridescent Indigo Snake--and a Chunk of Obsidian.

quest_list.notes: Lornbacoll jumps you to Ashton.
quest_list.success_message: POOF!  You find yourself in Ashton.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Sure.

quest_list.notes: Joe Longbeard asks you for help
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Aargh! I already told ye what t'was I wanted o' ye.  Now away with ye.
quest_list.success_message: Joe Longbeard asked you to see Captain Solomon.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Arrgh, that be right neighborly of ye.

quest_list.notes: Joe Longbeard gives you money for his kit.
quest_list.success_message: Joe Longbeard gave you 6 Rubies for his Grooming Kit.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: So, the Captain says he be gettin' his gear from Ricardo in Hotton. Since yer gettin' it, here ye be. (Joe Longbeard goes to the corner of the room to a huge chest overflowing with jewelry and gems.) This be fer his troubles and yer travels.

quest_list.notes: Ricardo agrees to make grooming kit
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Well, do you or don't you have a reason to be bothering me?
quest_list.success_message: Ricardo agreed to make the kit for Joe Longbeard.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Sure, no problem, but it will take a little while for me to assemble everything.  Why don't you explore Hotton and come back in a couple of hours?

quest_list.notes: Ricardo gives you the finished grooming kit
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You do not have the 5 rubies you said you did.  Come back when you have them, then you may have the kit.
quest_list.success_message: Ricardo gave you a Grooming Kit for 5 Rubies.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Here it is. (Ricardo gives you an exquisitely tooled leather box. ) This kit contains the finest men's grooming products in all of Horse Isle.

quest_list.notes: Joe Longbeard gets his grooming kit
quest_list.success_message: You gave Joe Longbeard his grooming kit.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Ye be back with me kit?

quest_list.notes: Joe Longbeard gives you reward for giving him the kit
quest_list.title: Joe Longbeard's Beard
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Aargh...  Ye hands are empty!  Now away w'ye!
quest_list.success_message: You Completed Joe Longbeard's Beard.  You earned a Pearl Necklace and 75 quest points.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Aargh, I haven't forgotten ye. Here yer be (Joe Longbeard goes back to his treasure chest and reaches for something.) Don't be tellin' none of them other scurvy dogs about this, no way, no how! Ye be catching me drift?
quest_list.author: BklynFilly

quest_list.notes: Linnea asks you to make her donations
quest_list.success_message: Linnea tells you to ask the caretaker of a retirement community for help in making her donations.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: I've heard that there's a caretaker in a retirement community. Perhaps you could ask that person if they know who would need the rugs most.

quest_list.notes: Tell Linnea about Flavius' Reaction
quest_list.success_message: You told Linnea how Flavius liked his rug.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: That's such a sweet story!  What about the second rug?

quest_list.notes: Linnea gives three rugs and travel money
quest_list.success_message: You were given three large Braided Rugs, and $3000 for travel fees.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Here are the three rugs, a red-orange, a purple, and a blue-green.  Also, please take this money for travel expenses.

quest_list.notes: Iona says to give a rug to Flavius
quest_list.success_message: Iona told you that Flavius might appreciate a rug.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Flavius, the old hermit who lives northwest of town.  If you succeed, come back and tell me!  I'm dying to find out what happens!

quest_list.notes: Give the rug to Flavius
quest_list.success_message: You have unrolled the beautiful large rug across the floor, and you move Flavius' rocking chair onto it.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Well, isn't that something?  It does seem to take the chill out of my old bones.  It really ties the room together, too!  Won't you take some form of payment for it?  I don't have a lot, but...

quest_list.notes: Flavius' rug response
quest_list.success_message: Your kindness to Flavius helped him feel happy, and hopeful about the future.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: ...like I'm feeling hopeful again.  For the first time in a long time.

quest_list.notes: Iona sends you to Temperance
quest_list.success_message: Iona thinks that the Mayor of Treeton could help you with Linnea's donations.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: I don't think so, not around here.  Maybe you can try asking the Mayor of Treeton.  She can probably think of someone that could use a free rug.  It's our duty as leaders of these communities to try and force kindness where it's needed.

quest_list.notes: Temperance think Dalton needs a rug
quest_list.success_message: Temperance told you that Dalton might appreciate a rug.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Oh, I misunderstood!  This is a nice change!  I think that Dalton, who lives in the southwest part of town, might just love that purplish rug.  He's such a nice man, but he hasn't been feeling well lately, and I do worry about him.

quest_list.notes: Give Rug to Dalton
quest_list.success_message: You spread the beautiful rug out beside Dalton's bed.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: This is beautiful!  Where did you get this?  I wish I could afford such a luxury.

quest_list.notes: Dalton's Rug Response.
quest_list.success_message: The beautiful rug, and the thoughtfulness of the mayor have helped Dalton feel proud and strong.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: I haven't felt this well and strong for a long time. And the idea that the mayor thought of me? It makes me proud to live in this fine town.

quest_list.notes: Temperence Sends You to Sara
quest_list.success_message: Temperance tells you that Sara, the Mayor of Shellton, could help donate Linnea's last rug.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: I can't, but I know someone who can!  Sara is the mayor of Shellton.  She is quite the traveler, too.  She might know just the right person for your last rug.

quest_list.notes: Sara tells you to give Ormand the rug.
quest_list.success_message: Sara told you that Ormand on Desert Isle could use the comfort of the last rug.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Oh, do I ever!  His name is Ormand.  He has very few comforts in his life, and he has a really ferocious sense of pride.  You might have some trouble getting him to accept the rug, but he's the one who needs it.

quest_list.notes: Force a rug on Ormand
quest_list.success_message: You have unrolled the last of Linnea's beautiful rugs in Ormand's cabin.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: What's this all about?  You plannin' to roll me up in that thing and kidnap me?

quest_list.notes: Ormand's rug reaction
quest_list.success_message: Ormand really is human.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: (Dropping down to inspect his new rug, you can see his dark eyes swimming with tears as he whispers) Who would be this kind to me?

quest_list.notes: Linnea gives you more travel money to find out about Ormand's reaction, if you skipped it.
quest_list.success_message: You were given an additional $1000 and asked to find out if Ormand liked his rug.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: I know it's asking a lot... Please take a little more travel money and see if you can find anything out.

quest_list.notes: Linnea Rewards you
quest_list.title: Linnea's Donations
quest_list.success_message: You Completed Linnea's Donations!  You earned $7500, 2 Gold Chains and 200 quest points.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Won't you take this as a token of my appreciation for all that you've done?
quest_list.author: Vetiver

quest_list.notes: Demetrius' clue riddle #3
quest_list.success_message: You found a clue to the next location! Dang! The wind just blew away the paper with the second clue.  Oh, well, you didn't need it anyway.
quest_list.success_npc_chat:
This must be the third clue!
Keeper of the aging
The equine dears
A place of sanctuary
With no worries or fears

quest_list.notes: Demetrius' clue riddle #4
quest_list.success_message: Ruthie gave you Demetrius' Clue Riddle #4.
quest_list.success_npc_chat:
Listen to this:
Across the bridge
In between two trees
North of the pond
Look carefully to see.

quest_list.notes: Demetrius' clue riddle #5 on Haven Isle
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You look all over at all the tiny details, but alas, nothing interesting.
quest_list.success_message: You carefully examine the area and find a small tube of papyrus in a hole in the tree. You unroll it and read a new clue!
quest_list.success_npc_chat:
Queen of past
Asp caused grief
'Tween shrine of sand
and thirst relief.

The wind blows clue #4 away.

quest_list.notes: Brea gives you her list
quest_list.success_message: Brea gave you her Shopping List.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: That's awfully kind of you.  Here's my shopping list.  Please give it to Zeke and tell him to put it on my account.

quest_list.notes: you give Brea's list to Zeke
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: What happened to the list?  Did you drop it somewhere?  You better go find it!
quest_list.success_message: Zeke takes the list and gives you a bag of groceries for Brea.
quest_list.success_npc_chat:
Okay, let me see that list... Ah, yes. She wants this, and one of these, and...
(Zeke runs busily around the store, putting various objects into a bag.)
Here you go! Goes on her tab, right?
quest_list.author: BklynFilly

quest_list.notes: Brea gets her groceries and rewards you
quest_list.title: Brea's Groceries
quest_list.success_message: You Completed Brea's Groceries!  You earned $1000 and 25 quest points.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Oh, you're back.  Here's a little something for your trouble.
quest_list.author: BklynFilly

quest_list.notes: Correctly answer all ten of Epona's questions.
quest_list.title: Epona's Horse Breed Quiz
quest_list.success_message: You Completed Epona's Horse Breed Quiz.  You earned $10,000 and 50 quest points.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: That is correct!  The Morgan can be traced back to a single Bay stallion named Figure.   Congratulations!  You have answered all nine of my questions!  Here is your reward.
quest_list.author: CheshireKitty

quest_list.notes: Eros asks you to find his wife.
quest_list.success_message: Eros has asked you to find his wife Parisa.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Oh, wonderful!  You'll find her at the southeast corner of this isle.  She's an archaeologist, so she should be relatively easy to find.  Just look for the clutter and the dust cloud!  Ha ha! I'm just messing with you. But please do hurry back soon.

quest_list.notes: Parisa asks you to help her find two missing bones.
quest_list.success_message: You have agreed to help Parisa find the last two bones.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: For the most part, I've looked through this area.  Just try looking very closely at the ground.  The bones should be relatively easy to spot.

quest_list.notes: Find the first bone.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You look all over at all the tiny details, but alas, nothing interesting.
quest_list.success_message: You think you might see something, so you start brushing away the dirt.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: You found an Eohippus Bone!!

quest_list.notes: Find the second bone.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You look all over at all the tiny details, but alas, nothing interesting.
quest_list.success_message: You think you might see something, so you start brushing away the dirt.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: You found an Eohippus Bone!!

quest_list.notes: Give bones to Parisa
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: I'm sorry, but it doesn't look like you have the bones that I needed.  Please come back when you do.
quest_list.success_message: You have given Parisa the two Eohippus Bones.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Why, yes!  These are exactly what I needed.  Now I can complete the Eohippus.  Thank you so very much.  Please tell my husband that I will be home in a little while.

quest_list.notes: Return to Eros and tell him you helped Parisa
quest_list.title: Parisa's Bones
quest_list.success_message: You Completed Parisa's Bones.  You earned $6000 and 100 quest points.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Oh, really?  That does sound like her.  She always has to finish everything.  Well, thank you very much for finding her for me.  Please take this as a reward.
quest_list.author: CheshireKitty

quest_list.notes: Accept Nomasonto's quest to go find her daughter
quest_list.success_message: Nomasonto has asked you to find her daughter and tell her to come home.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Very kind, very kind. She won't be hard to find. She's big now, she's growing so fast... (Nomasanto shakes her head and gets back to her cooking.)

quest_list.notes: Bailey wants to build a rose trellis
quest_list.success_message: Bailey has asked you to gather 5 Logs and 15 Strong Skinny Branches.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: That's so nice of you, dearie.  The first thing I need will be 5 logs and 15 strong skinny branches.

quest_list.notes: Accepted Mtomka's quest to find Odetho.
quest_list.success_message: Mtomka is desperate that you find Odetho for her.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: He's... my age and my height and he's... handsome and he's... smart and he's funny and kind and... please, please find him!

quest_list.notes: Odetho is nowhere to be found.  (Tracker to make Mtomka disappear.)
quest_list.success_npc_chat: (Mtomka says nothing, but climbs up and sits behind you on your horse. Her face is dry now, as if she's given up crying.)

quest_list.notes: Return Mtomka to Nomasonto and get a surprise... or something.
quest_list.title: Nomasonto's Lost Daughter
quest_list.success_message: You Completed Nomasonto's Lost Daughter.  You earned 20 chunks of Gold Ore, 2 Rubies and 50 quest points.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: I'm sorry she put you through all that trouble, but thanks for bringing her back.  I'll talk to her later when... well... oh, this age.  It's tricky, being her age.  Please accept this reward.
quest_list.author: SpottedRose

quest_list.notes: Bailey gets her lumber.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: I'm sorry, dearie, but I need all of the wood at once.  I needed 5 logs and 15 strong, skinny branches.  Come back when you have it all.
quest_list.success_message: You give Bailey 5 Logs and 15 Strong Skinny Branches.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Why, thank you, these will do just fine.

quest_list.notes: Bailey sends you for her roses
quest_list.success_message: Bailey asked you to pick up her Roses from La Fleur.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Great!  Just tell Calla Lilly that you're there to pick up my order.

quest_list.notes: Calla Lilly gives you the rose bushes
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: I'm sorry, was there something specific you're looking for?
quest_list.success_message: Calla Lilly gives you the 3 Rose Bushes for Bailey.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Oh, yes, 3 beautiful Veilchenblau rose bushes. (She hands you the rose bushes wrapped in burlap.) These are pink when they first open and then turn a beautiful purple. The color will go so well with her other flowers.

quest_list.notes: Bailey gets her roses
quest_list.title: Bailey's Rose Trellis
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Weren't you able to get my roses, dearie?
quest_list.success_message: You Completed Bailey's Rose Trellis.  You earned $3000, 5 Bunches of Daisies and 50 quest points.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Oh, my!  These are even more glorious than their pictures in the flower catalog.  Thank you for your help.  Here's a little something for you.
quest_list.author: BklynFilly

quest_list.notes: You've met Mtomka (tracking only)
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You again!  Please, please, please help me!
quest_list.success_npc_chat: (Running back and forth through the trees is a young girl almost shaking with fear.) Help! I need help!

quest_list.notes: Agree to do Gina's Scavenger Hunt
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You're doing the scavenger hunt for me, remember?  You said you would!
quest_list.success_npc_chat: I donno.  I'd love it if someone did it, but this one's kind of hard.

quest_list.notes: Gina Tells You To Get A Scorpion (in a roundabout way)
quest_list.success_message: Gina asks you to go find something that stings.
quest_list.success_npc_chat:
Well, okay. Let's see. (Gina stands up and opens and reads from a copybook she was sitting on. She opens it and (rather pompously) reads aloud:)
About this thing, no songs are sung.
Just be sure you don't get stung.

quest_list.notes: Give Gina a Scorpion, get the 2nd clue
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: No, that's not it. Keep looking.
quest_list.success_message: Gina's given you the instructions for the next item in her scavenger hunt.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Oh.  Okay.  Here's the next clue.  Uhm... Okay.

quest_list.notes: Give Gina a Strong, Skinny Branch, get instructions to find a blue mouse.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: No, that's not it. Keep looking.
quest_list.success_message: Gina wants you to find something blue that rhymes with blouse.......?
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Right.  Now.  Here it goes.

quest_list.notes: Find A Blue Mouse
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You rake all over, but uncover nothing interesting.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Raking through the leaves, you discover a little toy mouse, made of wood and painted blue.

quest_list.notes: Give Gina the Blue Mouse, get instructions for finding the snake.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: No, that's not it. Keep looking.
quest_list.success_message: Gina wants you to find her a snake.  Or maybe a radiator...
quest_list.success_npc_chat: You found it. Thanks. (Gina takes it and flings it at her brother.) Next: Just south, a palm tree sways with bliss. Find me something that goes HISS. You'll have it made if you look in the shade.

quest_list.notes: Asher asks you to find his brother Studly.
quest_list.success_message: You have agreed to find Studly for Asher.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Thank you!  Hisss name is Ssstudly and if you have sssome sssort of glassssss, you might be able to find him better.  Pleassse hurry back!

quest_list.notes: Find tracks 1
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You look all over at all the tiny details, but alas, nothing interesting.
quest_list.success_message: After carefully examining the ground beneath you, you find some snake tracks leading off to the west.

quest_list.notes: Tracks 2
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You look all over at all the tiny details, but alas, nothing interesting.
quest_list.success_message: After carefully examining the ground beneath you, you find some snake tracks leading off to the south.

quest_list.notes: Tracks 3
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You look all over at all the tiny details, but alas, nothing interesting.
quest_list.success_message: After carefully examining the ground beneath you, you find some snake tracks leading off to the east and north.

quest_list.notes: Tracks 4
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You look all over at all the tiny details, but alas, nothing interesting.
quest_list.success_message: After carefully examining the ground beneath you, you find some snake tracks leading off to the south.

quest_list.notes: Find Studly and take him back to Asher.
quest_list.success_message: You have agreed to carry Studly back to his brother Asher.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: I am sssso glad my brother ssssent you.  I really don't know how I would have gotten back to him otherwisssse.

quest_list.notes: Give Studly back to his brother.
quest_list.title: Asher's Maze Woes
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Where isss my brother?  He doesss not ssseam to be with you.  Pleassse go find him.
quest_list.success_message: You Completed Asher's Maze Woes.  You earned a Ruby Necklace and 75 quest points.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Thank you ssso much.  I am glad to have my brother back.  Pleassse take thisss asss a reward.  Feel free to visit usss anytime you wish.
quest_list.author: CheshireKitty

quest_list.notes: Mary Molasses Bets you $1000 that you can't answer her questions
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You do not have the $1000 for this challenge.  Come back when you do, please!
quest_list.success_message: You have given Mary Molasses $1000 to take her challenge.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Great!  Okay, are you ready for my questions?

quest_list.notes: Correctly answer all ten of Mary's questions.
quest_list.title: Mary Molasses's Horse Breed Quiz
quest_list.success_message: You Completed Mary Molasses's Horse Breed Quiz.  You earned $10,000 and 50 quest points.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: That is correct!   Great Job!  You have answered all ten of my questions!  Here is your reward.
quest_list.author: Rosela

quest_list.notes: Give Gina a snake, get the fourth clue.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: No, that's not it. Keep looking.
quest_list.success_message: You gave Gina the baby Indigo Snake.
quest_list.success_npc_chat:
Aww, she's so cuuuuuuute!
Enzo: Stupid little worm! Yech!

quest_list.notes: Captain Solomon reveals his grooming secrets
quest_list.success_message: Captain Solomon filled you in on his grooming secrets.  You best let Joe know!
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Me cousin, Ricardo in Hotton, makes up everything I need. Just tell him I sent ye fer a complete groomin' package just like he made fer me and he'll give it to ye, but it'll be very dear.  Tell old Joe to open up his sea chest and give ye somethin nice.

quest_list.notes: Gina reluctantly gives you another clue (item 4, halter)
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Sorry, I decided not to after all.
quest_list.success_message: Gina wants you to go find... something else.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: There's a bright yellow thing that hangs from a branch. Underneath that's something lost from my ranch.

quest_list.notes: Find the halter hanging near the beehive.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Nope, nothing else up there but bees.
quest_list.success_message: You found a Halter, and a Giant Coconut!
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Looking high up in the tree from which the beehive hangs, you spot a halter.  Carefully avoiding the beehive, you can just grab the lead rope and pull the halter gently down. As you gather up the rope, you notice a Giant Coconut on the ground and grab it.

quest_list.notes: Give Gina the halter with lead rope, get the last clue.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Nope, that's not it.
quest_list.success_message: You gave the Halter to Gina; she's asked you to go find something in a box with a fox.
quest_list.success_npc_chat:
Yeah! That's it! Say, you're not bad at this. Last thing, ready? Here's the clue:
A box, with a fox.
Something that will rock your socks.

quest_list.notes: Give Gina the box, win the quest.
quest_list.title: Gina's Scavenger Hunt
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Nope, that's not it.
quest_list.success_message: You Completed Gina's Scavenger Hunt!  You earned 3 Diamonds and 200 quest points.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Wow! You found it! Cooooool! Here, you can have these. I don't need them. (Gina opens the box and hands you what was inside: three diamonds!)
quest_list.author: SpottedRose

quest_list.notes: Find the last of Gina's items, the Fox Box
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You dig all over, but turn up nothing.
quest_list.success_message: You found a Fox Box.  Better get it back to Gina.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Digging near the base of the bridge, where sand has piled up against the pylons, you find a wooden puzzle box with a picture of a fox painted on the lid.  Something rattles inside, but you can't open the box.

quest_list.notes: Ilom gives you a word of advice
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: I have already told you!  Have forgotten so quickly?  That seems unwise to me!
quest_list.success_message: Ilom gives you a quote to add to Guru Wiseman's Encyclopedia.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: It is just this:  Be careful what you wish for.  After all, you might get it!

quest_list.notes: Agree to check in on Nerina for Eros.
quest_list.success_message: You have agreed to check in on Nerina for Eros.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Oh, thank you!  She lives just to the south of here.  There really aren't many homes here, so she should be easy to find.  Please do let me know how she is.

quest_list.notes: Nerina asks you to check up on the sea creatures.
quest_list.success_message: You have agreed to check up on the local sea life.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: This really does help!  If you go south from here to the beach, you should find Shiri.  She's a seal and keeps up with all the sea life.  If anything needs to be done, she will know.  Please let me know if anything is out of the ordinary.

quest_list.notes: Shiri asks you to take a bird to Nerina.
quest_list.success_message: You have been given a small Tangled Bird to take to Nerina.
quest_list.success_npc_chat:
Here he is. (She carefully hands the bird over to you.) Be gentle with him.
(She then jumps into the ocean and disappears.)

quest_list.notes: Nerina takes the bird from you.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: I don't know what you are talking about, but there isn't any bird with you.
quest_list.success_message: You gave the bird to Nerina.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Oh!  The poor thing.  It looks like it got tangled up in some yarn.  This is what happens when people litter.  It really just drives me nuts.  Poor innocent animals such as this little bird end up being affected by it and it is not fair to them.

quest_list.notes: Nerina gives you a reward for brining the bird to her.
quest_list.success_message: Nerina gave you a Seashell Necklace.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Yes, I can help him. (She moves over to her desk and pulls out a small pair of scissors and then carefully cuts the yarn away.) He'll have to stay with me for a few days to recover, but he'll do just fine. Please take this as a reward.

quest_list.notes: Eros gives you award for checking on Nerina.
quest_list.title: Eros' Concern
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: I don't think you have talked to her yet.  Please come back once you have.
quest_list.success_message: You Completed Eros' Concern.  You earned $2000 and 75 quest points.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: I'm sorry to hear that.  I hope she feels better soon.  Please take this as a reward.
quest_list.author: CheshireKitty

quest_list.notes: Betsy Burlap asks you to go to Loch Isle
quest_list.success_message: You've been asked to go to Loch Isle.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Please hurry back and let me know what they say.  I'll be waiting with bated breath for your return!

quest_list.notes: Davy McGee tells you whre to find Ben
quest_list.success_message: You have been told where to find Ben Burlap.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Oh, he's continuing in the family business...  He owns the General Store in Tropicton.

quest_list.notes: Betsy rewards you
quest_list.title: Betsy's Long Lost Brother
quest_list.success_message: You completed Betsy's Long Lost Brother. You earned $3000 and 50 quest points.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Thank you for helping me.  Here's a little something for your trouble.  Now, if it wouldn't be too much, could you stop in again next time you're here?  I may have another job for you.
quest_list.author: BklynFilly

quest_list.notes: Betsy gives presents to be delivered
quest_list.success_message: Betsy Burlap gave you gifts for Ben and Bena.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Thank you.  Now here's a present for Ben and one for Bena.  Could you deliver these gifts first to Ben and then to Bena?  And then come back and let me know how they liked them.

quest_list.notes: Ben gets Betsy's present
quest_list.success_message: You have given Ben Burlap his Birthday present from Betsy.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: For me? From Betsy?? (Ben starts tearing open the present like a little child.) How did she find me?

quest_list.notes: Ben sends a gift to Bena
quest_list.success_message: Ben Burlap has given you a gift for Bena Buket.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Could you give this to Bena? (Hands you a gaily wrapped box.) And please, don't forget to stop by here on your way back to Betsy.

quest_list.notes: Bena receives her gifts
quest_list.success_message: You gave Bena her presents.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Oh, that's so thoughtful of Betsy... (Her eyes widen with the shock of recognition.) ...and Ben? You said Ben?? You found Ben??? (Bena's now squealing with excitement.)

quest_list.notes: Bena sends Ben a gift
quest_list.success_message: Bena gave you a Thank You card for Betsy, a present for Ben and $750.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Thanks for waiting.  Here's a note for Betsy and could you please give this gift to Ben?  Here's a little something to cover the extra travel costs.

quest_list.notes: Ben gets Bena's gift
quest_list.success_message: You gave Ben his present from Bena.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Oh, that Bena... (Staring at the present you've just handed him.) She was always looking out for me. Thank you.

quest_list.notes: Ben gives you a gift for Betsy
quest_list.success_message: Ben has given you a gift for Betsy and $500.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: While you were gone, I got this for Betsy from one of our local artisans.  Would you mind bringing it back to Betsy for me?  And take this to offset your travel expenses.

quest_list.notes: Betsy gets her gift
quest_list.success_message: You gave Betsy the Note from Bena and the Gift from Ben.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Oh, my! (Looking over the Thank You note.) That Bena, always the proper lady. Oh, and that Ben... (Opens Ben's gift.) Look at this exquisite ebony statue!!

quest_list.notes: Betsy thanks you
quest_list.title: Burlap Family Reunion
quest_list.success_message: You completed the Burlap Family Reunion.  You earned $5000 and 125 quest points.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Yes, it did, better than I had hoped for!  And I owe it all to you.  Please accept this as a token of my appreciation.
quest_list.author: BklynFilly

quest_list.notes: Jungle Observation Deck Access (1)
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You search high and low all around, but find nothing interesting.
quest_list.success_message: Looking up into the trees, you see a platform high in the canopy.  You climb up to the deck using the ramps.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: You've found your way up to Omand's Observation Deck!

quest_list.notes: Jungle Observation Deck Progress (2)
quest_list.success_message: Using your binoculars, you spot the next platform in the series.  You move west.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: You're on Omand's Deck #2!
