quest_list.notes: Penfold suggests places to look for the ferrets (tracking)
quest_list.success_message: Penfold identifies the paw prints as ferret tracks.

quest_list.notes: Dig up Anika's Lost Hat
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You dig all over, but turn up nothing.
quest_list.success_message: Digging around the pier, you notice a yellow thread.  Digging further, you uncover a yellow knitted cap.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: You found a Yellow Hat!

quest_list.notes: Get the yellow hat quest from Anika
quest_list.success_message: Anika would like you to dig around the bridge ends for her lost yellow woolen hat.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: It blew off my head while I was crossing the bridge to Snowball Isle.  With any luck, it washed up on the beach somewhere near one of the ends of the bridge.  If you dig or rake around there you may find it.

quest_list.notes: Give Anika the Hat
quest_list.title: Anika's Lost Hat
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: That's not my hat, sorry.
quest_list.success_message: You Completed Anika's Lost Hat!  You earned $2000 and 50 quest points.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: That's it!  Thanks so much!  This was my horse's favorite hat, for... whatever reason!  I think it looked better on me, personally, but hey.  Thanks!  Please take this reward!
quest_list.author: SpottedRose

quest_list.notes: Bowen gets the letters of credit
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: I'm sorry, but aren't you supposed to give me something?  Go back and get them!
quest_list.success_message: You gave Bowen 2 of Hansel's Letters of Credit.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: (Looking over the letters.) These seem to be in order. What's next?

quest_list.notes: Bowen gives you the apples
quest_list.success_message: Bowen gave you the 5 Bushels of Apples and the Signed Letter of Credit.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: All righty, here's your copy of the letter and the apples.

quest_list.notes: Bowen gives you the oranges
quest_list.success_message: Bowen gave you the 5 Bushels of Oranges and the other Signed Letter of Credit.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Certainly!  Here's your oranges and the copy of the letter, all square.

quest_list.notes: Chaffie gets Hansel's letter of credit
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: I thought you were going to give me something. Go get it!
quest_list.success_message: You gave Chaffie Hansel's Letter of Credit.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: (Reading the letter.) So all I have to do is sign this and give you a copy?

quest_list.notes: Chaffie gives you the flour shipment
quest_list.success_message: Chaffie gave you the 5 Barrels of Flour and the Signed Letter of Credit.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Here you go, then.  I gave you the flours I thought would most be used in a bakery. Hansel can always change the order.  By the way, you don't have to yell.  I'm not deaf, you know!

quest_list.notes: Dr. Fernlove gets the letter of credit.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You obviously forgot something... We shall continue our business when you come back with it!
quest_list.success_message: You gave Dr. Fernlove Hansel's Letter of Credit.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: All this legal-ese...  What do you want me to do with this?

quest_list.notes: Dr. Fernlove gives you the berries (!)
quest_list.success_message: Dr. Fernlove gave you 5 Crates of the most incredible Assorted Berries you have ever seen and the Signed Letter of Credit.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Here you go.  Here is your copy of the letter of credit and an assortment of my finest berries.

quest_list.notes: Ricky gets the letters of credit
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You already gave me the letters.  What next?
quest_list.success_message: You gave Ricky Mantequilla 3 of Hansel's Letters of Credit, one for each of his items.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: (Looking over the letters.) These look all right. What do we do next?

quest_list.notes: Ricky gives you the eggs
quest_list.success_message: Ricky gave you 5 Cases of Eggs and the Signed Letter of Credit.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Here's the first signed letter and the eggs.

quest_list.notes: Ricky gives you the butter
quest_list.success_message: Ricky Mantequilla gave you 20 Pounds of Butter and the Signed Letter of Credit.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Next?  How about the butter and the butter letter?

quest_list.notes: Ricky gives you cream cheese
quest_list.success_message: Ricky Mantequilla gave you 20 Pounds of Cream Cheese and the Signed Letter of Credit.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Finally, here's my brand new cream cheese, and the letter, of course. Hope they like it!

quest_list.notes: Hansel gets his apples
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: I need the apples and the signed copy of the letter of credit, come back when you have both.
quest_list.success_message: You gave Hansel the 5 Bushels of Apples and the Signed Letter of Credit.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: These apples are the best I've seen.  They'll be perfect!

quest_list.notes: Hansel gets his berries.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: No, this isn't right.  I need the berries and the signed letter of credit.
quest_list.success_message: You gave Hansel 5 Crates of Assorted Berries and the Signed Letter of Credit.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: These berries are the biggest, most perfect berries I've ever seen.  You've outdone yourself!

quest_list.notes: Hansel gets his spices.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Have you gone daft? I need both the signed letter and the spices! Now, get going!
quest_list.success_message: You gave Hansel 5 Sacks of Assorted Spices and the Signed Letter of Credit.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: (Looking through the spices.) That's so intuitive of Rika. I realized I forgot to add these to the list. She's an excellent choice, thanks!

quest_list.notes: Hansel gets the milk
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Again you forgot that I need both the milk and the signed copy, get going!
quest_list.success_message: You gave Hansel 5 Cans of Milk and the Signed Letter of Credit.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: I can't believe you found me a milk vendor so near to me.  Wonderful work!

quest_list.notes: Hansel gets the butter
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You forgot again?  I need the butter and the signed copy of the letter of credit.
quest_list.success_message: You gave Hansel the 20 Pounds of Butter and the Signed Letter of Credit.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: This is a very high quality butter.  Excellent work!

quest_list.notes: Hansel gets the cream cheese
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Again... I need both the product and the copy!
quest_list.success_message: You gave Hansel the 20 Pounds of Cream Cheese and the Signed Letter of Credit.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: This is a very tasty cream cheese.  Good job!

quest_list.notes: Hansel gets his oranges
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: I need both the produce and the signed letter of credit, remember?!
quest_list.success_message: You gave Hansel the 5 Bushels of Oranges and the Signed Letter of Credit.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Excellent oranges.  You chose a fabulous orchard man.

quest_list.notes: Hansel gets his eggs.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Okay, let's try this again... I need the product and the signed copy of my letter of credit... Got it?
quest_list.success_message: You gave Hansel the 5 Cases of Eggs and the Signed Letter of Credit.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Very good.  Can't run a bakery without eggs, you know!

quest_list.notes: Hansel gets the flour.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: I need both the product and the signed letter of credit, remember?
quest_list.success_message: You gave Hansel the 5 Barrels of Flour and the Signed Letter of Credit.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: I'm glad that she grinds different types of flour.  I like to experiment until I find just the right combinations.  Again, you've proven to be an excellent choice!

quest_list.notes: Hansel gets the coconuts.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Please remember, I need both the product and the signed letter of credit!
quest_list.success_message: You gave Hansel 5 Large Sacks of Coconuts and the Signed Letter of Credit.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: My, these are, without a doubt, the best looking coconuts I've seen in a good long time.  Thank you.

quest_list.notes: Hansel gets the walnuts
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Once more... I need the signed copy of the letter of credit AND the product!
quest_list.success_message: You gave Hansel 5 Sacks of Walnuts and the Signed Letter of Credit.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Very nice, very nice indeed.  You found a real quality vendor for my walnuts.  Good job!

quest_list.notes: Hansel gets the molasses.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: The signed letter and the molasses... remember?!
quest_list.success_message: You gave Hansel the 5 Kegs of Molasses and the Signed Letter of Credit.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Ah, my molasses.  Can't make great gingerbread without molasses!  Well done!

quest_list.notes: Give fish to Augie
quest_list.title: A Meal for Shadow
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You were going to bring me 3 Little Fish.  You don't have that many yet.
quest_list.success_message: You completed A Meal for Shadow! You were given 50 Scorpions and earned 50 quest points.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Wonderful! This should feed Shadow for a day or two. Here's some scorpions in trade.
quest_list.author: Desertmorn

quest_list.notes: Agree to get scallops for Shadow
quest_list.success_message: You agree to get Scallops for Shadow.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: That would be wonderful!
quest_list.author: Desertmorn

quest_list.notes: Get scallops for Shadow
quest_list.success_message: You were given a Package of Fresh Scallops for Shadow.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Oh?  Well, I just happen to have some fresh ones right here.  There you go.  Please say hello to Augie for me.
quest_list.author: Desertmorn

quest_list.notes: You give the scallops to Augie.
quest_list.title: Scallops for Shadow
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Did you forget something? You don't have those.
quest_list.success_message: You Completed Scallops for Shadow. You earned a Dinosaur Bone and earned 50 quest points.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Wonderful! Thank you so much. Please take this dinosaur bone as a thank you. It does me no good, but might be of use to you.
quest_list.author: Desertmorn

quest_list.notes: Agree to get honeycombs for Crash
quest_list.success_message: You have agreed to bring Crash Joller 5 Honeycombs for his wicked surfboard.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Woah.  That's totally excellent!  I think, like, 5 honeycombs outta be enough for my wicked board.  Pssshah.

quest_list.notes: You agree to help Just Gus find his long lost love
quest_list.success_message: You agreed to find a lass named Michelle for Just Gus.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: And iff'n ye find the lass? What then?

quest_list.notes: Give Honeycombs to Crash-Completed
quest_list.title: Wax for Crash
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Whoa, buddy.  Like, you don't have 5 honeycombs yet.  And I, like, seriously need to get some wax on the board to hit the tube, fer sure!
quest_list.success_message: You Completed Wax for Crash.  You earned 2 Seashell Necklaces, a Starfish and 75 quest points.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: All right!  Thanks little dude!  Now I can, like, wax up the board and ride the curl before getting some grindage.  Sshhuah!  Oh, and here's some stuff I found while hitting the sand.
quest_list.author: Nuova

quest_list.notes: You deliver a letter to Willamena and get another.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You don't have a letter! Please don't waste my time. I'm very busy. Very!
quest_list.success_message: You delivered the letter to Willamena and were given a letter for Priscilla Printer.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: (Willamena frowns as she tries to figure out what Gus has scribbled on there. Then a quirky smile slides up her face and she quickly adds a couple of lines to the letter in her careful, easy-to-read penmanship.) Please deliver this to Priscilla.

quest_list.notes: You deliver a letter to Priscilla and get another.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Oh, my. You don't have that.
quest_list.success_message: You delivered the letter to Priscilla, and are expected to pass it on to Davisse.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Well now, this is interesting. (Priscilla adds to the growing letter with a delicate swirling font. Very fancy!) Please take this to Davisse. She's the harbormistress of the Hoof Isle dock.

quest_list.notes: You agree to tell Gus.
quest_list.success_message: You hurry back to tell Just Gus what Davisse has said.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Ye best be gettin' on yer way! Now!

quest_list.notes: You give Davisse the letter
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Are ye messin' wit me, ye bilge rat! Ye ain't got no such thing!
quest_list.success_message: You delivered the letter to Davisse.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: (Davisse breaks out laughing when she reads the letter.) 'Tis a good prank, matey. That scurvy rat Gus be trickin' ya!

quest_list.notes: You swear that Gus is sincere about making amends
quest_list.success_message: You swear on your best horse (Gulp!) that Gus is sincere.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: I be gettin' that great horse of yers iffn that bildge rat ain't be sincere.

quest_list.notes: You agree to deliver the engraved compass to Davisse
quest_list.success_message: You agreed to deliver the Engraved Compass to Davisse.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: I'd be indebted, matey. Now, be gone wit' ye and smartly, too!

quest_list.notes: You give the engraved compass to Davisse
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Ye ain't got that! Don't make me be a keelhaulin' ye!
quest_list.success_message: You delivered the Engraved Compass to Davisse.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: (Davisse reads the engraving, then swipes at a tear rolling down her cheek.) Arggg! That scurvy dog! He had this made for me? I mean, for Michelle? (Before you can answer, Davisse disappears below deck.)

quest_list.notes: You get diamonds and roses for Michelle
quest_list.success_message: Just Gus gave you 12 Red Roses and an Antique Diamond Necklace to deliver to Michelle.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Sail as fast as ye kin, matey. Afore she changes her mind!

quest_list.notes: Just Gus rewards you
quest_list.title: Just Gus Makes Amends
quest_list.success_message: You Completed Just Gus Makes Amends. You earned 4 Diamond Necklaces and 300 quest points.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Ye done the impossible, matey. Iffn ye be needin' sometin' -- anytin' -- ye can count on me!
quest_list.author: DesertMorn

quest_list.notes: You give the gifts to Michelle
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Ye ain't got that! Don't make me be a takin' that thar horse!
quest_list.success_message: You gave Michelle a dozen Red Roses and an Antique Diamond Necklace.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: (Michelle practically falls over in surprise and bursts into an ear-to-ear grin.) Well, shiver me timbers! If he ain't gone soft on me! Ye kin tell 'em it be about time!

quest_list.notes: You annoy Michelle - just for tracking purposes
quest_list.success_npc_chat: That horse thar be lookin' awfully good.  As mine, of course.

quest_list.notes: You get empty feed sacks
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You don't have enough money. I need $600.
quest_list.success_message: You bought 6 Empty Feed Sacks for $600.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: That should do it.  If you need more, let me know.  And good luck!
quest_list.author: DesertMorn

quest_list.notes: You made a sandbag
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You dig all over, but turn up nothing.
quest_list.success_message: You shovel sand into the empty feed sack. You created a Sandbag!
quest_list.author: DesertMorn

quest_list.notes: You give sandbags to Smelly
quest_list.title: Smelly Toes' Sea Surge Mess
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Ye don't have what I asked fer! I be needin' 6 sandbags.
quest_list.success_message: You completed Smelly Toes' Sea Surge Mess. You earned a Ruby Necklace, three Sapphire Necklaces and 150 quest points.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: May ye be blessed wit' good grog and clear passage past Davy Jones' locker! I'll stack 'em up shortly. Here be a bit o' reward for thee.
quest_list.author: DesertMorn

quest_list.notes: Dolly sends you to Olav
quest_list.success_message: Dolly told you Olav was in the Sweltry Forest.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Why, sure.  Olav had his house built on the western edge of Sweltry Forest.  Said he still wanted to be near pine trees.

quest_list.notes: Agree to help Smelly Toes
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Be a right smart idea, gettin' feed sacks. Heave ho and on ye go!
quest_list.success_message: You agree to get empty feed sacks for Smelly Toes.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Be a right smart idea, matey! Heave ho and on ye go! Smartly, please!
quest_list.author: DesertMorn

quest_list.notes: Katinka asks for your help
quest_list.success_message: You've been asked to find Katinka's brother, Olav.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Could you?  Could you really find my brother Olav for me?  Bestefor always said family is so important.

quest_list.notes: Give Merry Comber the jar of oil
quest_list.title: Merry Comber's Detangler
quest_list.success_message: You completed Merry Comber's Detangler.  You earned $2000 and 25 quest points.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: (She examines the bottle contents closely.) This looks like just the right stuff. Thanks! Take this as a small payment.
quest_list.author: Miranda

quest_list.notes: Agree to bring a package to Karina for Jean Stonwasht
quest_list.success_message: You have agreed to bring a package to Karina.  She should be somewhere on Jungle Isle.  You were given $1500.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: She mentioned something about Jungle Isle and how animal prints are going to be so in soon. I think she wanted to see some animals up close for inspiration. Start there, I guess. Here's a little something for the trip.

quest_list.notes: Olav sends you to Kay Macaw in Wington
quest_list.success_message: Olav asked you to pick out a bird for Katinka.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: I'd like you to take this bill to Kay Macaw in Wington, and instead of money, I want you to pick out a bird to keep Katinka company, okay?

quest_list.notes: Kay gets her bill
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: I thought you had something from Olav. Better go back and get it!
quest_list.success_message: You gave Kay the bill and she gave you a Hill Myna for Katinka.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: My, this bill isn't too bad!  Now, this Myna already can talk and is as smart as a whip. She'll make a wonderful companion. I hope his sister enjoys her!

quest_list.notes: Olav gives you important papers for Katinka.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: I asked you to pick out a bird for Katinka, remember? Go back and get one!
quest_list.success_message: Olav gave you a Leather Packet and $2500.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Remember, take this packet to my sister along with the myna and here's some traveling money. Will you do that for me?

quest_list.notes: Agree to find Frog band members
quest_list.success_message: You have agreed to find M-Lap, Eram, Calil, and Remmihs for Soporta.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: M-Lap, Eram, Calil, and Remmihs.  A very smart explorer, like yourself, should be able to figure out where they live.

quest_list.notes: Katinka gets her presents
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: I thought you said Olav sent me presents, please go find them...
quest_list.success_message: You gave Katinka the Myna and the Packet.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Oh, what a pretty bird!  And what's in this packet?

quest_list.notes: Stinky gives you a diamond to cover traveling expenses.
quest_list.success_message: You've been given a diamond to help cover the costs of your travels.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: This bit o' sparkle should do it, matey. Now be off wit' ye!
quest_list.author: DesertMorn

quest_list.notes: Agree to teach Augie how to fish
quest_list.success_message: You agree to teach Augie how to fish.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: This could make life much easier!
quest_list.author: Desertmorn

quest_list.notes: Give fishing equipment to Augie.
quest_list.title: Augie Learns to Fish
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: I thought you said you were going to bring me a fishing pole and a dozen earthworms?  You don't have that.
quest_list.success_message: You Completed Augie Learns to Fish! You earned $3000 and 50 quest points.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: These look perfect! Thank you.
quest_list.author: Desertmorn

quest_list.notes: Katinka gives you the signed papers
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Packet, what packet? Go find the packet!
quest_list.success_message: Katinka gave you the Signed Bank Papers.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: I should have known that Olav would still be looking out for his only sister.  Here you go, dearie.

quest_list.notes: Ivanna takes care of Katinka's account.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: I'm sorry, I can't open this account without the signature card and papers, please get them from Miss Katinka and come back to me.
quest_list.success_message: Ivanna gave you Katinka's New Checkbook.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: (She hands you the checkbook.) Please let Miss Katinka know that we have made arrangements that will enable her to cash checks at Windy Pick's Store any time she needs a little pocket money.That way she won't have to travel all the way here.

quest_list.notes: Katinka gets her Checkbook and thanks you
quest_list.title: Katinka's Family Ties
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: I thought you said you had a checkbook for me, please go back and get it.
quest_list.success_message: You Completed Katinka's Family Ties.  You earned $6000, a Topaz Necklace, 300 quest points and an old lady's eternal appreciation!
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Thank you, dearie.  Since I don't have any children of my own, please accept my mother's Topaz Necklace and some money for everything you've done for me.
quest_list.author: BklynFilly

quest_list.notes: Fishies for Dorothy
quest_list.success_message: You have agreed to bring Dorothy 5 Big Fish and 5 Little Fish.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Yay!  Fishies!  I need, yes, ten fishies!  Big and small sized!  Please be my purpose and bring me fishies!!

quest_list.notes: Give Fishies to Dorothy
quest_list.title: A Dolphin's Purpose
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: No no no.  That's all wrong!  You have to come back with my purpose!
quest_list.success_message: You Completed A Dolphin's Purpose.  You earned 3 Obsidian Chunks and 150 quest points!
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Yay fishies!!  Here is your purpose!  So long and thanks for all the fish!!
quest_list.author: Nuova

quest_list.notes: Dorothy trades 5 big fish for 1 Obsidian
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: I'm sorry but the deal is for 5 big fishies!  Not the fried stuff, either.  Gross!
quest_list.success_message: You traded 5 Big Fish for 1 Obsidian Chunk.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: My purpose!  Yay fishies!!  So long and thanks for all the fish!
quest_list.author: Nuova

quest_list.notes: Dorothy trades 10 little fish for 1 Pearl
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: I'm sorry but the deal is for 10 little fishies!  Not the fried stuff, either.  Gross!
quest_list.success_message: You traded 10 Little Fish for 1 Pearl.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: My purpose!  Yay fishies!!  So long and thanks for all the fish!
quest_list.author: Nuova

quest_list.notes: Dorothy takes fish trades
quest_list.success_message: Dorothy will trade 5 Big Fish for 1 Obsidian Chunk and 10 Little Fish for 1 Pearl.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Yes, I do!  I can always use more fishies!  Yay, FISHIES!!!  So, if you bring me five big fishies, I will trade you more black shiny rocks.  Ten little fishies for one round shiny.  How about that?

quest_list.notes: Holli Daysin tells you she saw Karina
quest_list.success_message: Holli mentions that she sent Karina to go speak to Witherton Jones.

quest_list.notes: Witherton Jones says he sent Karina up to Rainy Meadows
quest_list.success_message: Witherton Jones mentioned that he told Karina to head to Rainy Meadows.

quest_list.notes: Manco tells you Karina is at the Jungle Temple
quest_list.success_message: Manco told you to check around the Jungle Temple for Karina.

quest_list.notes: Give Karina the package
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You don't have a package.
quest_list.success_message: You gave Karina her Package and received Karina's Notes.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Marvelous!  Thank you!  It is so important to me to know exactly what is going on with the shop, even if I can't be there. Give these notes to Jean for me.  She will give you something for your hard work also.

quest_list.notes: Give Jean Stonwasht the notes from Karina
quest_list.title: Jean Stonwasht's Package
quest_list.success_message: You Completed Jean Stonwasht's Package.  You earned Racing Silks, Racing Breeches and 200 quest points.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: What? Oh. I suppose she couldn't pay you. Let's see. (She takes the notes, heads into the back and comes back with racing silks and breeches.) These should fit you.
quest_list.author: Miranda

quest_list.notes: Karina sees a Toucan and runs off (tracking only)
Vicky Shank gives you a package to deliver to Colina and check to be sure you have 25% award
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: I'm sorry, I guess you aren't quite adventurous enough yet to make this delivery.  I guess you better get to work doing work for some others first.
quest_list.success_message: You have agreed to deliver a package to Colina on Lava Isle.  You were given Colina's Package.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Great!  This is a set of tack specifically for Colina in Ashton.  It's all wrapped up, so it should travel fine.  Stop back here once you are done.

quest_list.notes: Give Colina the package from Vicky Shank
quest_list.success_message: You gave Colina the Package.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: It's finally here!  Thank ye for tha'.

quest_list.notes: Colina gives you reward
quest_list.title: Vicky's Package
quest_list.success_message: You Completed Vicky's Package.  You earned $2500 and 50 quest points.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Peachy!  Here's a little something for your trouble.  If I need another delivery in the future, I'll remember to keep you in mind.
quest_list.author: Miranda

quest_list.notes: Eli's tip (tracking only)
quest_list.success_message: Eli Grits has sent you to Skullton.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Let's see... There's a fellow that I get my molasses from.  Go see Captain Jack in Skullton.  Maybe he can help you with the coconuts, too.

quest_list.notes: Captain Jack's Tip (tracking only)
quest_list.success_message: Captain Jack sends you to Cate and Wilma.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: So yer lookin' fer some real like vendors fer yer bakery buddies?  I've been actin' the facilitator, so to speak, fer Wilma and Cate. Mayhaps it be time fer them to step up their production and get their molasses business really up and running.

quest_list.notes: Cara's tip (tracking only)
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: I 'eard tell of a new butter and egg man over in Molten Meadows.  Go see if 'e'd want the business.  While yer there, check out the miller. She's my supplier, but I'm sure she could handle a bakery, too.
quest_list.success_message: Cara sends you to Molten Meadows.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: I 'eard tell of a new butter and egg man over in Molten Meadows.  Go see if 'e'd want the business.  While yer there, check out the miller. She's my supplier, but I'm sure she could handle a bakery, too.

quest_list.notes: Nana's tip (tracking only)
quest_list.success_message: Nana sends you to Rainy Meadows and to see Cinnamon.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Manco, the Chief of Rainy Meadows, has begun a walnut business to support his village.  I'm sure he'd welcome this opportunity.  For the milk, go see Cinnamon. She's at the southern tip of the isle, which means easy delivery of fresh milk to the Clouds.

quest_list.notes: Minnie's tip (tracking only)
quest_list.success_message: Minnie sends you to Molten Meadows.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Why, yes, yes I do.  I happen to know that a rather strange little man in Molten Meadows is setting up a berry business.  I'd go ask him if he thinks he could handle your volume.

quest_list.notes: Patricia's tip (tracking only)
quest_list.success_message: Patricia sends you to Ursala and Shaylene.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Hmmm...  No, I don't handle that sort of volume. You could ask Ursala if she could handle the apples, and maybe Shaylene over in Whiskerton could handle the cheese.  Good luck finding all those vendors!

quest_list.notes: Pony Express Agree to delivery #16
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You still need to make that delivery to Timothy Bromegrass on Rider Isle!
quest_list.success_message: You have agreed to deliver a package to Timothy Bromegrass on Rider Isle for the Pony Express.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Yes, there are!  Please take this package to Timothy Bromegrass on Rider Isle.  Now dash away!

quest_list.notes: Pony Express Completed Delivery #16 Timothy/Rider
quest_list.success_message: You gave Timothy Bromegrass the package from the Pony Express.  You were given $2500!
quest_list.success_npc_chat: The barn supplies have arrived!  Thank you very much and send my best to the Postmaster General, will ya?

quest_list.notes: Pony Express Agree to delivery #17
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You still need to make that delivery to Spike Lizzard in Treeton!
quest_list.success_message: You have agreed to deliver a package to Spike Lizzard in Treeton for the Pony Express.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Yes, there are!  Please take this package to Spike Lizzard in Treeton.  Get going and scurry on outta here!

quest_list.notes: Pony Express Completed Delivery #17 Spike/Treeton
quest_list.success_message: You gave Spike Lizzard the package from the Pony Express.  You were given $1500 and a Pet Rock!
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Wonderful and thank you!  See these?  They are a big hit with the kids!  Here, why don't you take one, on the house of course, and enjoy it!

quest_list.notes: Pony Express Agree to delivery #18
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You still need to make that delivery to Phyllis Colt in Hotton!
quest_list.success_message: You have agreed to deliver a package to Phyllis Colt in Hotton for the Pony Express.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: That's a good one! Sometimes we get items better than that!   We have more work to do! Please take this package to Phyllis Colt in Hotton.  Get it done, now!

quest_list.notes: Pony Express Completed Delivery #18 Phyllis/Hotton
quest_list.success_message: You gave Phyllis Colt the package from the Pony Express.  You were given $2500 and 3 Hearty Treats!
quest_list.success_npc_chat: That's nice, dear.  Please place it on the counter and here's something extra for all the hard work your horse has been doing!

quest_list.notes: Pony Express Agree to delivery #19
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You still need to make that delivery to Stephen Saddletree on Hare Isle!
quest_list.success_message: You have agreed to deliver a package to Stephen Saddletree on Hare for the Pony Express.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Okay, then, here we go!  Please take this package to Stephen Saddletree on Hare Isle.  Make with the quickness, now!

quest_list.notes: Pony Express Completed Delivery #19 Stephen/Hare
quest_list.success_message: You gave Stephen Saddletree the package from the Pony Express.  You were given $3000.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Aye, that's the package I have been waitin' on.  Now I can get to soapin' up these saddles!  Here's your payment and thanks!

quest_list.notes: Pony Express Agree to delivery #20
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You still need to make that delivery to Jack Reelin on Bird Isle!
quest_list.success_message: You have agreed to deliver a package to Jack Reelin on Bird for the Pony Express.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Okay, then, here we go!  Please take this package to Jack Reelin on Bird Isle.  Speed it up, kiddo!

quest_list.notes: Pony Express Completed Delivery #20 Jack Reelin/Bird
quest_list.success_message: You gave Jack Reelin the package from the Pony Express.  You were given $200 and 4 Big Fish.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: I'm a bit short on cash, but I can offer you a few of my best fish in payment, if that's all right with you.

quest_list.notes: Yorick gives you a clue.
quest_list.success_message: Yorick has suggested you look in Witherton.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Well, Olav moved around a lot, picking up odd roofing jobs wherever he could.  The last letter I got was from Witherton, after that I lost track.

quest_list.notes: Kyleigh gives you a clue.
quest_list.success_message: Kyleigh suggests you look in Earton.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: He probably didn't stay in Earton very long.  He was staying in the Inn there.  I hope you find him, for Katinka's sake.

quest_list.notes: Agree to find Crash's crush
quest_list.success_message: You have agreed to find and talk to Crash's mystery beach girl.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: You'd do that for me?  That's, like, so wicked cool.  What a real bud!  Sheeah.  So, like, come back here when you find out anything, 'K?

quest_list.notes: Basil gives you a clue.
quest_list.success_message: Basil suggests you go to Whiskerton.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: That he did, put a new roof on the inn for me, but he moved on once he finished it.  He was in Whiskerton the last I heard.  It seems that I recall he was staying with Karl there.

quest_list.notes: Agree to take a message to Crash
quest_list.success_message: Isadora gave you a Seashell Necklace to give to Crash.  You better head back to him with the good news!
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Goodness, I'm so nervous!  Could you tell him I would like to meet him and give him this from me?  It's something I had made from Deidra, but I think he would like it.

quest_list.notes: Karl gives you a clue.
quest_list.success_message: Karl sends you to Art Isle.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: He told me, being from Ice Isle, he wanted to get as far away from the ice and snow as he could.  Last I heard, he was working on Art Isle and staying at the Inn there.  Go figure!

quest_list.notes: Remy gives you a clue.
quest_list.success_message: Remy suggests you go to Shellton.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: I got a postcard from the Inn on Turtle Isle, maybe he's still there.

quest_list.notes: Rosemary gives a clue.
quest_list.success_message: Rosemary sends you to Appleton.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: He said he was heading to a warmer climate, I’ve got a postcard here someplace… (She starts to shuffle some papers around and pulls out a postcard.) Here it is. Says here that he's working in Appleton and staying at the inn.

quest_list.notes: George gives a clue
quest_list.success_message: George sends you to Jungle Isle.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: He said he wanted to go somewhere warm.  He's from Ice Isle originally, you know.  After he left here, I got a card from Tropicton.  You could try there.

quest_list.notes: Holli gives a clue.
quest_list.success_message: Holli sends you to the Desert Isles.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: As a matter of fact, he recently sent me a postcard from the Inn in Hotton.  I'd ask around there.

quest_list.notes: Give Crash necklace from Isadora
quest_list.title: Crash's Crush
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Like, are you sure you have a gift from her?  Maybe you should, like, check your other pockets or something.  Pshhheah.
quest_list.success_message: You Completed Crash's Crush!  You earned a Topaz Necklace and 75 quest points.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Cooleo!  She wants to meet me?  That's, like, wicked gnarly!  Thanks little dude for all your help!  Here, I found this!  It should be worth something.
quest_list.author: Nuova

quest_list.notes: Agree to run ahead of Crash
quest_list.success_message: You agreed to run ahead of Crash to let Isadora know he's on his way.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: You're so boss, little bro!  I'll be right behind ya after I stash my gear.  Chuuuuuf!

quest_list.notes: Isadora sends you to Triton (1st time)
quest_list.success_message: **POOF** You have been transported to the middle of the Ocean.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Oh, thank you, thank you!! And good luck! (Sploosh!)

quest_list.notes: Triton Poofs you to land
quest_list.success_message: **POOF** You have been transported to Hoof Isle.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Very well. (Triton blows on the conch shell. ) AhhroooOOOoooo!!

quest_list.notes: Isadora sends you to Triton
quest_list.success_message: **POOF**  You have been transported to the middle of the Ocean.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Good luck! (Sploosh!)

quest_list.notes: Triton sends you to land for more info
quest_list.success_message: Triton asks that you return when you find out more about Crash.  You have been transported to Hoof Isle.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Very well.  Come back when you learn more of this... boy my Isadora has fallen in love with!

quest_list.notes: Bastien tells of the dolphin and box
quest_list.success_message: You better find the dolphin and ask about the mystery box!
quest_list.success_npc_chat: De box has all de mysteries of de ocean deep.  De dolphin knows 'here it dis!  Ask de dolphin about de box!

quest_list.notes: Dorothy wants 5 Normal Fish
quest_list.success_message: You agree to get Dorothy 5 Normal Sized Fish for the mystery box.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Yes!  Five more fishies!  I will trade mystery box for fishies!  YAY!

quest_list.notes: Trade normal fish for box from Dorothy
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: No no no!  Five fishies!  Not big or small!  Just right!
quest_list.success_message: You traded Dorothy 5 Normal Fish for a Mystery Box.  You better take this to Bastien.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Yay!  More fishies!  Here is the mystery box from the ocean!

quest_list.notes: Give Triton Box? (oops!)
quest_list.success_message: Oops.  You tried to give the box to Triton, so his waves washed you away!
quest_list.success_npc_chat: What is this? Sea junk? Out of my sight, land-dweller, and come back when you know something important! (Triton blows on the conch shell.) AhhroooOOOoooo!!

quest_list.notes: Give Bastien the box
quest_list.success_message: You gave Bastien the Mystery Box.  He found a Hand Written Scroll inside.  Better take that to the Sea King!
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Look at dis!  Dis is it!  Dis has all the answers for de boy!  Give dis to de Sea King!

quest_list.notes: Give Triton the scroll
quest_list.success_message: You gave the Hand Written Scroll to Triton.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: A scroll from the Lost City of the Ancients?  Oh, I see now...  Very interesting.  Yes, very interesting indeed!

quest_list.notes: Triton poofs you to land and thanks you!
quest_list.success_message: You received a Crystal Statue and a beautiful Sapphire Necklace from the Sea King.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Yes.  Please let her know she has her father's blessing and all of the Sea Kingdom's!  Thank you for all that you have done.  Please accept our gratitude for your patience!

quest_list.notes: Isadora thanks you and quest completed!
quest_list.title: Under The Sea Mystery
quest_list.success_message: You Completed the Under the Sea Mystery!  You earned $3000 and 200 quest points.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Goodness!  I can't believe how much you have done for me and, well, for us!  Here, take this as a token of our thanks!
quest_list.author: Nuova

quest_list.notes: Rose gives you fruit salad ingredient list
quest_list.success_message: You have agreed to collect fruit salad ingredients for Rose.  You were given a Fruit Salad Ingredients List.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Wonderful!!  Here's the list of all the different fruits I need.  Oh!  Also, I really love grapes in my fruit salad.  I know they can be found somewhere, but I really can't remember where...  Hopefully you will be able to find them for me.

quest_list.notes: Give Rose oranges
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: I needed 2 oranges.  Be sure you have both!
quest_list.success_message: You gave Rose 2 Oranges.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: These look perfect!  Thanks!

quest_list.notes: Give Rose the apples
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: I needed 3 apples.  Be sure you have them all.
quest_list.success_message: You gave Rose 3 Apples.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Oh!  These are very bright.  These will work perfectly.

quest_list.notes: Give Rose the bananas
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: I needed 2 bananas.  Be sure you have both!
quest_list.success_message: You gave Rose 2 Bananas.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: These look great.  Thanks!

quest_list.notes: Give Rose the pears
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: I really needed 2 pears.  Be sure you have both!
quest_list.success_message: You gave Rose 2 Pears.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: These look yummy.  Thanks.

quest_list.notes: Give Rose the grapes
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: I needed one bunch of grapes.  Thanks.
quest_list.success_message: You gave Rose 1 Bunch of Grapes.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: These will be perfect.  I'm glad you were able to find them!

quest_list.notes: Give Rose the berries
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: How about bringing all the berries at the same time?  So I need 10 strawberries and 10 blueberries.
quest_list.success_message: You gave Rose 10 Strawberries and 10 Blueberries.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: These will work.

quest_list.notes: Check that Rose has all the fruit salad ingredients
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: It doesn't look like you have brought me everything yet.  Be sure to check that list!
quest_list.success_message: You gave Rose her list of Fruit Salad Ingredients.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: That's everything!  Now I just have a couple more things I need to complete this.

quest_list.notes: Agree to get marshmallows and cream for Rose
quest_list.success_message: You have agreed to get Rose 10 Marshmallows and a Jar of Cream from Cinnamon.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Let's see.  Cinnamon should be able to get the cream for you.  Just have her give you a jar and that will be enough.  I'll need 10 marshmallows, also.

quest_list.notes: Cinnamon gives you a bottle of cream
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: I'll need the $300 for that.  Please come back when you have the money.
quest_list.success_message: You were given a Bottle of Cream for $300.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Here's the cream.  Nice and fresh.

quest_list.notes: Give Rose the marshmallows and cream
quest_list.title: Rose's Fruit Salad
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: I still need the cream from Cinnamon and 10 marshmallows.
quest_list.success_message: You Completed Rose's Fruit Salad.  You earned a Diamond Necklace and 275 quest points.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Perfect!  I'll just put some sugar in here, whip it up and voila!  This will be perfect!  Thanks so much for your help.  Here's an old necklace.  Hopefully that will be sufficient to pay you back.
quest_list.author: Miranda

quest_list.notes: Agree to run errand for Venda
quest_list.success_message: You have agreed to run over some palm fronds to Anani on Palm Isle.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Excellent!  Please run these palm fronds over to Anani on Palm Isle.  She needs them for her beautiful baskets.  Let her know I'll have some more for her soon!

quest_list.notes: Give Anani Palm Fronds
quest_list.success_message: You gave Anani the Palm Fronds.  Anani asks that you pay Venda $2000 for the fronds.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Yes, palm fronds for baskets!  Thank you.  Please give money to Venda for fronds, yes?  Thank you.

quest_list.notes: Give Venda money
quest_list.title: Venda's Errand
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: I'm sorry, but Anani and I have a deal of $2000 for palm fronds.  Maybe you lost it on your way back here?  Come back when you find it.
quest_list.success_message: You Completed Venda's Errand! You earned a Crafted Western Bridle and 50 quest points.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Thank you very much!  I appreciate you running that errand for me.  Here, maybe you and your horse can get a use out of this.
quest_list.author: Nuova

quest_list.notes: Smiddy needs iron for scoops
quest_list.success_message: Smiddy Jones requires 10 chunks of Iron Ore and $1000 for the feed scoops for Ginger.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: I'll be needing 10 chunks of iron ore to complete the scoops.  And $1000 for the cost of labor.  Come back when you have that and the scoops will be done.

quest_list.notes: Give iron to Smiddy get scoops in return
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Naw, that ain't right.  I need 10 chunks of iron ore to replace my stock and $1000 for my payment!  Come back when you have all of it.
quest_list.success_message: You gave Smiddy 10 chunks of Iron Ore and you received 5 Galvanized Feed Scoops for Ginger.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: That'll do perfectly.  Thanks.  Here's Ms. Ginger's feed scoops.  Hopes she likes 'em!

quest_list.notes: Give scoops to Ginger
quest_list.title: New Scoops For Ginger
quest_list.success_message: You Completed New Scoops for Ginger! You earned 3 sacks of Honey Oats and 75 quest points.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: These are perfect!  Thank you for all of your help and here's a little something for your hard work!
quest_list.author: Nuova

quest_list.notes: Erebus jumps you out of forest ring.  Just in case player gets there...
quest_list.success_message: *POOF*  You are outside the forest ring.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Sure thing.  There you go.

quest_list.notes: Hansel moves on from the refrigerator
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You don't have all of my dairy products yet.  Go get the rest.  Remember, I need butter, eggs, cream cheese, and milk.
quest_list.success_message: You gave Hansel all of his dairy items.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Very good, now we move on to the produce items.  That's the apples, oranges, coconuts, berries, and walnuts.

quest_list.notes: Hansel moves on to the Pantry
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: I asked you for all of my produce items; that would be the apples, the oranges, the berries, the coconuts, and the walnuts. Come back with the rest of my produce.
quest_list.success_message: You gave Hansel all of his produce items.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: These look absolutely fabulous.  Now let's move on to the pantry and put away the rest of my items, shall we?

quest_list.notes: Big Tom needs ebony wood
quest_list.success_message: You have agreed to bring back 30 Ebony Wood to Big Tom.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: We are needin' good, solid wood, like that hard stuff on Jungle.  About thirty pieces outta do.  Come back 'ere when you got it.

quest_list.notes: Give Big Tom Ebony logs
quest_list.title: Cat Construction Job #1
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: No!  No!  Heeeey!  We need thirty pieces of wood, 'ere!  Got it?  Now get it!
quest_list.success_message: You Completed Cat Construction Job #1!  You earned $5000 and 75 quest points.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Yeah, that's what we need, 'ere!  Thanks, pal!  'Ere's your payment for the wood.
quest_list.author: Nuova

quest_list.notes: Big Tom needs lots of cotton
quest_list.success_message: Big Tom gave you $3000.  You have agreed to bring back 100 pieces of Cotton in two trips.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: All right.  See, we need about one hundred pieces of cotton for the stuffin'.  You can bring it in two trips, 'cause we know you can't carry it all.  Fifty each way and here's some travel money.

quest_list.notes: Big Tom gives you a bit more $
quest_list.success_message: Big Tom gave you $2000.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Yeah, yer right, kid.  'Ere's a few bucks more.  Don't spend it all in one shop.

quest_list.notes: Give Big Tom 50 cotton
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: No!  NO Heeeey!  We need fifty pieces of cotton, 'ere!  Got it?  Now get it!
quest_list.success_message: You gave Big Tom 50 pieces of Cotton.  You received $3000 for your expenses.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: That's it!  Now we need some more of this 'ere cotton.  Remember, fifty pieces more. No less!  'Ere's some cash for your time and expenses.

quest_list.notes: Give Big Tom 50 more cotton
quest_list.title: Cat Construction Job #2
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: No!  NO Heeeey!  We need fifty pieces of cotton, 'ere!  Got it?  Now get it!
quest_list.success_message: You Completed Cat Construction Job #2!  You earned $8000 and 100 quest points.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Yeah, this is what we need for the post base.  Thanks, kid.  'Ere's your payment for the cotton.
quest_list.author: Nuova

quest_list.notes: Big Tom needs feathers
quest_list.success_message: You have agreed to bring back 30 Feathers.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: We need about thirty of 'em feathers to place around the post.  Not the fancy ones, just the ones you find layin' abouts.  Bring 'em all back 'ere when you find 'em all.

quest_list.notes: Give Big Tom 30 feathers
quest_list.title: Cat Construction Job #3
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: No!  NO Heeeey!  We need thirty feathers over 'ere!  Got it?  Now get it!
quest_list.success_message: You Completed Cat Construction Job #3!  You earned $7000 and 50 quest points.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Yeah, right.  These are just what I was sayin'!  'Ere's your payment for the feathers, kid.
quest_list.author: Nuova

quest_list.notes: Tell M-Lap about band practice
quest_list.success_message: You told M-Lap about the band getting back together.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Right on, jack!  I'll put it in the mix in a New York minute as soon as the beat gets square!  Can ya dig it?

quest_list.notes: M-Lap is here for practice!
quest_list.success_message: M-Lap has arrived at band practice.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: That's great!  M-Lap is one of the best drummers around!

quest_list.notes: Tell Eram about band practice
quest_list.success_message: You told Eram about the band getting back together.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Yeah, I can dig it and the sound of the groovy tunes, man!  I'll be there.

quest_list.notes: Eram is here for practice!
quest_list.success_message: Eram has arrived at band practice.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Wonderful!  Eram is the best bass player you'll ever find!

quest_list.notes: Tell Calil about band practice
quest_list.success_message: You told Calil about the band getting back together.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Woah, like, for sure, man.  I am so there!  Let me pack up the sound and I'll hop on over.  Rock on!

quest_list.notes: Calil is here for practice!
quest_list.success_message: Calil has arrived at band practice.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Awesome!  Calil can really riff on those steel strings!

quest_list.notes: Tell Remmihs about band practice
quest_list.success_message: You told Remmihs about the band getting back together.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: As the June's light turns to moonlight. I'll be on my waaaay!

quest_list.notes: Remmihs is here for practice!
quest_list.success_message: Remmihs has arrived at band practice.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Beautiful!  Remmihs has such the perfect voice, don't you think?

quest_list.notes: Band members present
quest_list.title: Soporta's Band Practice
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: No, I think you are missing someone.  Come back when you find them all, okay?
quest_list.success_message: You Completed Soporta's Band Practice.  You earned $8000 and 175 quest points!
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Rock and roll and rock on!  Thank's for all your help, daddy-o!  All right, now, let's get practicing.  A one, and a two, and a three...
quest_list.author: Nuova

quest_list.notes: Told about talking to people in Molten Meadows for Hansels Bakery suppliers (tracking only)
Agree to collect cotton for Leasa
quest_list.success_message: You have agreed to collect 25 Pieces of Cotton for Leasa.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Wonderful!  I need 25 pieces of cotton.  Once you find that, just bring it back here.

quest_list.notes: Give 25 pieces of cotton to Leasa
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You don't have 25 yet.  Come back when you have it all.  Thanks.
quest_list.success_message: You gave Leasa 25 Pieces of Cotton.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Oh, this looks wonderful.

quest_list.notes: Agree to bring cotton to Barb Sower for Leasa
quest_list.success_message: You were given 50 Pieces of Cotton and agreed to bring it to Barb Sower.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Barb, here in town, makes beautiful cloth.  Just tell her it's for me and she'll know what to do.  Here is the cotton you brought, along with the rest she will need.

quest_list.notes: Give cotton to Barb Sower and get quilting fabric back
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Leasa should have given you 50 pieces of cotton.  I will need that much in order to make this fabric.
quest_list.success_message: You gave Barb Sower 50 Pieces of Cotton and have agreed to return later to pick up the fabric.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Perfect.  Now, come back in a bit and I should have it done.

quest_list.notes: get the fabric bolt from Barb for Leasa
quest_list.success_message: You were given a Bolt of Quilting Fabric.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Wonderful timing!  I just completed it.  Here you are.  Don't worry about the cost.  Leasa and I have an agreement.

quest_list.notes: Give the bolt of fabric to Leasa
quest_list.success_message: You gave Leasa the Bolt of Quilting Fabric.  You were given a piece of Pie a la Mode.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: This looks perfect.  Thank you.  Here.  Have some pie.

quest_list.notes: Agree to gather dye ingredients for Leasa
quest_list.success_message: You have agreed to collect 20 Dandelions, Blackberries, Strawberries and 4 Leaf Clovers for Leasa.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: I need dandelions, blackberries, strawberries and four leaf clovers.  Twenty of each should be enough to replenish my supply and have enough to dye what I need of this fabric.

quest_list.notes: Give 4 leaf clovers and dandelions to Leasa
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: I need 20 dandelions and 20 four leaf clovers.  Bring them at the same time.  That should be easier.
quest_list.success_message: You gave Leasa 20 Dandelions and 20 4 Leaf Clovers.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: These will work great.

quest_list.notes: Give blackberries and strawberries to Leasa
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: I need 20 blackberries and 20 strawberries.  Bring them at the same time.  That should be easier.
quest_list.success_message: You gave Leasa 20 Blackberries and 20 Strawberries.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: These are perfect!

quest_list.notes: Leasa checks that you gave her all the dye items
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: I'm afraid you are still missing something.  I need it all in order to start dying this fabric.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Ah, yes.  These will work well.  I know that was probably quite a bit of work, but I just have one more thing, if you are willing?

quest_list.notes: Agree to get thread from Hudson for Leasa
quest_list.success_message: You have agreed to pick up some Spools of Thread from Hudson.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Hudson, my grandson, borrowed some of my thread.  The one color I really need.  Could you please go pick it up for me?

quest_list.notes: Pick up thread from Hudson
quest_list.success_message: You were given 3 Spools of Thread.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: I was using it to tie a flag up to my fort.  I think it will stay now.  Tell Grandma thanks.

quest_list.notes: Give thread to Leasa
quest_list.title: Leasa's Quilt
quest_list.success_message: You Completed Leasa's Quilt.  You earned $10,000 and 250 quest points.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Wonderful.  Now I can get to work piecing this together.   I have the batting and backing all ready, so you won't need to worry about that.  Here.  Take this for all your hard work.
quest_list.author: Miranda

quest_list.notes: Leasa asks if you will deliver the quilt once it's completed (tracking only)
Agree to bring Leasa's Quilt to Baby Karina
quest_list.success_message: You were given Leasa's Quilt.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: I made this to replace my granddaughter's quilt since she has worn hers to shreds.  Bring this up to Baby Karina.  Let her know I'll be up to visit soon.

quest_list.notes: Give Baby Karina the quilt from Leasa
quest_list.success_message: You gave Baby Karina Leasa's Quilt.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: (Claps her pudgy hands.) Gamma bankie! Tank yous!

quest_list.notes: Tell Leasa that Baby Karina got the quilt
quest_list.title: Leasa's Quilt Delivery
quest_list.success_message: You Completed Leasa's Quilt Delivery.  You earned $1500, a Loaf of Bread and 25 quest points.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Thanks again!  The bread just came out of the oven.  You can have a loaf for all your help.
quest_list.author: Miranda

quest_list.notes: Agree to get Azmaguru's Necklace
quest_list.success_message: You have agreed to find a jeweler for Azmaguru.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Thank you, explorer!  Yes, you must find a woman who smells as beautiful as her home.  There you will find my necklace maker.

quest_list.notes: Floria needs items for necklace
quest_list.success_message: You have agreed to find the items needed for Azmaguru's necklace.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Hrm, yes, well, we need three peacock feathers, two leather strappings, some homemade beads, and one dinosaur bone.  That should do it.

quest_list.notes: Genivive gives you beads
quest_list.success_message: Genevieve gave you a set of tribal beads.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Not a thing!  I have a feeling I will be rewarded kindly for my creation.

quest_list.notes: Give Floria feathers
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: No.  I think three peacock feathers will look nice.  Come back when you have them, please!
quest_list.success_message: You gave Floria 3 Peacock Feathers.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: These are nice and big feathers, too!  Well done!

quest_list.notes: Give Floria leather
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: No.  We need two leather strappings for the necklace.  Come back when you have them!
quest_list.success_message: You gave Floria 2 Leather Strappings.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Perfect!  This will hold everything together nicely!

quest_list.notes: Give Floria dino bone
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: No.  There needs to be one dinosaur bone to be the main focus of the necklace!  Come back when you find one.
quest_list.success_message: You gave Floria 1 Dinosaur Bone.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Yes, this bone is exactly what I had in mind!

quest_list.notes: Give Floria beads
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: No.  We need those special beads to add to the necklace.  Come back when you find them!
quest_list.success_message: You gave Floria the Tribal Beads from Genevieve.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Wonderful work!  These beads are fantastic!

quest_list.notes: Floria checks for everything then gives you necklace
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: No, I think you are missing something.  Come back when you find everything we need for the necklace!
quest_list.success_message: Floria gave you the completed Honor Necklace for Azmaguru.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Let me just put all of this together... a bead here and a feather there...  Perfect!  Here you go!

quest_list.notes: Agree to help Betty Garments get organized
quest_list.success_message: You have agreed to help organize the Wington Clothing Store.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: You could?  Really?  Thank you so much!!  Where should we get started first?

quest_list.notes: Give Azmaguru necklace
quest_list.title: Azmaguru's Honor
quest_list.success_message: You Completed Azmaguru's Honor!  You earned 5 Rubies, 25 chunks of Gold Ore and 125 quest points.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: An honorable deed has been done.  The magic of your honor will flow with mine, young explorer.  I express my eternal gratitude.
quest_list.author: Nuova

quest_list.notes: Spister Mooner asks for Cifteen Foconuts.
quest_list.success_message: You have agreed to get Mister Spooner cifteen foco... that is, 15 Coconuts.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Cifteen foconuts.

quest_list.notes: Give Mr Spooner his coconuts.
quest_list.title: Spister Mooner's Coconuts
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Sorry, not enough.  Try again.
quest_list.success_message: You Completed Mister Cooner's... Mister Spooner's Coconuts!  You earned $3,000 and 25 quest points.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Excellent!  Excellent!  He can't resist coconuts, that cunning canterer.  Please accept this reward. Dood cay to you!
quest_list.author: SpottedRose

quest_list.notes: Return to Isleen after delivering the dream to Jasper
quest_list.title: Isleen's Dreams #1
quest_list.success_message: You Completed Isleen's Dreams #1.  You earned an Amethyst Necklace and 50 quest points.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Thank you so much!  Are you sure you're ready for the next delivery?
quest_list.author: CheshireKitty

quest_list.notes: Get nails and logs for Betty
quest_list.success_message: Betty gave you $100 for shelving supplies.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Good idea!  Here's a little bit of money to help pay for the supplies we'll need.  Hurry back!

quest_list.notes: Liam gives you nails for Betty
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You need some cash before I can give you these nails.  Iron is expensive, you know.
quest_list.success_message: Liam gave you a handful of nails to help with building Betty's shelves.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Here you go.  Tell Betty I'll stop by when the place is cleaned up a bit.

quest_list.notes: Give nails to Betty
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: No, you still need to grab those nails from the blacksmith here in town.  Come back when you do!
quest_list.success_message: You gave Betty the handful of nails from Liam Flux.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: These will work just fine.  I even have an old hammer left in the back from the previous store owner that we can use!

quest_list.notes: Give logs to Betty
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: No, you said five logs would do it.  Maybe look around for a few more and come back?
quest_list.success_message: You gave Betty 5 Logs.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Great!  My dad taught me how to split wood, so we'll have a more natural shelving.  It will look great!

quest_list.notes: Betty checks that you have nails and logs
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: No, you're still missing something. We need nails and logs!
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Yes, we are ready to make shelves!

quest_list.notes: Get bins and paint from Percy.
quest_list.success_message: Percy gave you 3 Storage Bins and 1 Bucket of Brown Paint.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: There you go!  No charge.  I'm happy to help someone else get organized!

quest_list.notes: Check Whiskerton Store for stuff
quest_list.success_message: You agreed to go to the general store in Whiskerton for Betty.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: The closest general store is in Whiskerton.  Maybe you should run over there while I finish splitting these logs.

quest_list.notes: Give bins and paint to Betty
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: No, you still need to run over to the Whiskerton General Store to get what we need!
quest_list.success_message: You gave Betty 3 Storage Bins and 1 Bucket of Brown Paint.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: All right!  This will do perfectly!  The brown paint will really create a nice accent against the wood shelves!

quest_list.notes: Betty's store completed!
quest_list.title: Getting Betty Garments Organized
quest_list.success_message: You Completed Getting Betty Organized!  You earned 1 Tan Cowboy Hat, 1 Pair of Black Cowboy Boots and 200 quest points.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Thank you for all of your help!  Here's something that just came in and I want you to have them as my gratitude.
quest_list.author: Nuova

quest_list.notes: Pony Express Agree to delivery #21
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You still need to make that delivery to Seamus Schooner on Turtle Isle!
quest_list.success_message: You have agreed to deliver a package to Seamus Schooner on Turtle Isle for the Pony Express.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: You are far too eager!  Please take this package to Seamus Schooner on Turtle Isle.  Shape up and ship out!

quest_list.notes: Pony Express Completed Delivery #21 Seamus/Turtle
quest_list.success_message: You gave Seamus Schooner the package from the Pony Express.  You were given $1000 and 5 chunks of Gold Ore.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Aye, that be me new wheel.  Thank ye kindly, young lad.  Here be the payment you were expecting.

quest_list.notes: Pony Express Agree to delivery #22
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You still need to make that delivery to Sally Drift on Hoof Isle!
quest_list.success_message: You have agreed to deliver a package to Sally Drift on Hoof Isle for the Pony Express.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Yes, I do!  Please take this package to Sally Drift on Hoof Isle.  Get on outta here, now!  Shoo!

quest_list.notes: Pony Express Completed Delivery #22 Sally/Hoof
quest_list.success_message: You gave Sally Drift  the package from the Pony Express.  You were given a Sapphire Necklace.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Oh, good!  Those are my rare gem necklaces I ordered from the other isles.  Why don't you take one as payment?

quest_list.notes: Pony Express Agree to delivery #23
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You still need to make that delivery to Yorick on Snowball Isle!
quest_list.success_message: You have agreed to deliver a package to Yorick on Snowball Isle for the Pony Express.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Please take this package to Yorick on Snowball Isle.  I hope you packed your mittens!

quest_list.notes: Pony Express Completed Delivery #23 Yorick/Snowball
quest_list.success_message: You gave Yorick the package from the Pony Express.  You were given $3000!
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Perfect!  It's the new team logo for the Horse Isle Battalioneers. I can't wait to see what the guys think!  Thanks for the delivery!

quest_list.notes: Pony Express Agree to delivery #24
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You still need to make that delivery to Bess on Starfish Isle!
quest_list.success_message: You have agreed to deliver a package to Bess on Starfish Isle for the Pony Express.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Please take this package to Bess on Starfish Isle.  Make a break for it, hurry!

quest_list.notes: Pony Express Completed Delivery #24 Bess/Starfish
quest_list.success_message: You gave Bess the package from the Pony Express.  You were given $500.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Oh, my new pillow.  Great!   Here.  Bye.

quest_list.notes: Pony Express Agree to delivery #25
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You still need to make that delivery to Brock Limestone in Earton!
quest_list.success_message: You have agreed to deliver a package to Brock Limestone in Earton for the Pony Express.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: This one isn't too bad.  Please take this package to Brock Limestone in Earton.  Go on and take a hike up the way, now!

quest_list.notes: Hyrokkin sends you to find herring
quest_list.success_message: You have agreed to see John O'Lantern for Hyrokkin's Herring and Cod Roe.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: I haven't a clue.  Maybe my friend Jack O'Lantern might know.  He knows more about these islands than I do.

quest_list.notes: Pony Express Completed Delivery #25 Brock/Earton
quest_list.success_message: You gave Brock the package from the Pony Express.  You were given 5 Gold Chains!
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Wonderful! My box of gold chains I bought at that very famous and well-known auction site!  I got such a good deal, I can spare a few for you!

quest_list.notes: Jack sends you to Jack Reelin
quest_list.success_message: John O'Lantern gave you a Box of Lures for Jack Reelin and $750 to cover travel expenses.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Here you go, give these to Jack and tell him to give you the herring and cod roe in exchange.  And this is for your trouble.

quest_list.notes: Jack gives you Hyrokkin's fish
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: I thought you said Jack gave you a box for me, go back and get it!
quest_list.success_message: Jack Reelin gave you a Barrel of Herring and a Can of Cod Roe.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Scandinavian feast is it.  These should do nicely.  They're just the way my in-laws like them.  Enjoy!

quest_list.notes: Hyrokkin get's her fish
quest_list.title: Hyrokkin's Feast
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You said you had my fish, go back and get them!
quest_list.success_message: You Completed Hyrokkin's Feast.  You earned a Pearl Necklace and 75 quest points.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: (Hyrokkin opens the barrel and inhales deeply.) These are perfect, reminds me of home. Here, take these for your trouble and wish me luck!
quest_list.author: BklynFilly

quest_list.notes: Phyllis Colt needs formula
quest_list.success_message: Phyllis Colt asked you to pick up foal formula and gave you $1500 for expenses.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Just head over to Oliver Oates' store in Treeton.  He should have what I need in stock.  Here's some money to cover expenses.

quest_list.notes: Oliver Oates gives you formula
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: No, you need $500 for the formula.  Please come back when you all of it!  Thanks.
quest_list.success_message: Oliver Oates gave you the Foal Formula for $500.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Tell Phyllis I said hello and give the babies a pet for me!

quest_list.notes: Give formula to Phyllis
quest_list.title: Formula for the Foals
quest_list.success_message: You Completed Formula for the Foals!  You earned $2000 and 50 quest points.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Excellent!  Thank you so much!  Here's something I know you can use.
quest_list.author: Nuova

quest_list.notes: Recieve the second dream box from Isleen
quest_list.success_message: You have been given the Dream Box and asked to deliver it to Wildfire in Little Appleton Forest.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Well, whenever I deliver his dreams, he's usually in Little Appleton Forest, so I'm guessing you should be able to find him in that area.

quest_list.notes: Give WildFire The dream box
quest_list.success_message: You delivered the Dream Box to WildFire.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Neigggghhh... whinny.

quest_list.notes: Return to Isleen after delivering the second dream box.
quest_list.title: Isleen's Dreams #2
quest_list.success_message: You Completed Isleen's Dreams #2!  You earned an Emerald Necklace and 50 quest points.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: I'm sure he was glad to have his dreams back.  Thank you for delivering that for me.
quest_list.author: CheshireKitty

quest_list.notes: Get the third and final dream box from Isleen.
quest_list.success_message: You have received the Dream Box to give to the Purple Dragon.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: This dream belongs to the Purple Dragon.  He lives in the maze on Lava Isle so he might be hard to find.

quest_list.notes: Give the dream box to the Purple Dragon
quest_list.success_message: You have delivered the Dream Box to the Purple Dragon.
quest_list.success_npc_chat:
A welcome gift, for seems 'tis true
I shall be seeing dreams anew!

quest_list.notes: Talk to Isleen after delivering the third dream box.
quest_list.title: Isleen's Dreams #3
quest_list.success_message: You Completed Isleen's Dreams #3!  You earned a Pearl Necklace and 75 quest points.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Thank you so much.  You really have no idea how much you have helped me out.  Hopefully my leg will heal soon and I can go back to work, but you've given me some time to heal.
quest_list.author: CheshireKitty

quest_list.notes: Agree to pick up Hay for Ted Capocella
quest_list.success_message: You have agreed to pick up Ted's Hay from Mary Molasses in Earton.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Mary Molasses in Earton should already have a load ready for me.  She runs the feed store.

quest_list.notes: Agree to get 3 more bales for Mary
quest_list.success_message: You have agreed to get three more Bales of Hay for Mary.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: There's a place where you can build bales of hay up by the jumping arenas just north of here.  It shouldn't be to hard to do.

quest_list.notes: Give Mary 3 Bales of Hay
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: I'm sorry, it doesn't look like you have enough bales yet.  Please come back when you do.
quest_list.success_message: You gave Mary 3 Hay Bales and received Ted Capocella's Hay Order.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: It looks like I have everything for Ted's order. Hang on for just a moment. (She goes into the back for a minute and then comes back with Ted's order.) There you are! Have a nice day.

quest_list.notes: Give Ted Capocella his Hay Order.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: I'm sorry, but I think you may have forgotten the hay with Mary.  You should probably go get it.
quest_list.success_message: You delivered Ted's Hay Order.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Oh, thank you so much!  This has made my life a little easier.
quest_list.author: CheshireKitty

quest_list.notes: Candide gives you the yarn
quest_list.success_message: You were given 25 Skeins of Golden Yarn to have made into a present for Sara.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: I've heard tell of an old woman on Snow or Ice Isle that makes extraordinary hand-knitted garments.  Take this yarn to her and see what she can make for me.

quest_list.notes: Katinka gets the yarn
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: So, where's all the yarn?  You'd better go back and get it all!
quest_list.success_message: You gave Katinka the Golden Yarn.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: What lovely yarn!  And this is a gift for a prominent lady?  Da!  I will make the important lady a very special gift.  Come back later and I'll have it ready.

quest_list.notes: Katinka gives you the Sweater and Hat Set.
quest_list.success_message: Katinka has given you a handknit Sweater and Hat Set.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: I hope she likes it.  Don't worry about payment, I'll just keep the leftover yarn.

quest_list.notes: Sara gets her gift
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: I thought you said you had a gift for me...
quest_list.success_message: Sara loves her Sweater and Hat and gave you a Strawberry Pie to take back to Candide.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Oh, my. (Holding up the sweater.) I'm speechless! Please bring this strawberry pie back to Candide for me and thank him for this wonderful gift.

quest_list.notes: Candide gets his pie and thanks you.
quest_list.title: Candide's Gift
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You said Sara sent me something, go get it!
quest_list.success_message: You completed Candide's Gift!  You earned $10,000 and 150 quest points.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: I LOVE her pies! Thank you so much for all of your help. Here. Take this for your kindness.
quest_list.author: BklynFilly

quest_list.notes: Nerida sends you to the Unicorn
quest_list.success_message: Nerida has sent you to gather apples for the Unicorn.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: We want to make a special gift for the prince. Would thou bring 12 apples to the Unicorn on this island?  Ask him for some hair in return.

quest_list.notes: Agree to pick up grain for Ted Capocella
quest_list.success_message: You have agreed to pick up Ted Capocella's Grain from Daria Pale.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Daria Pale should have the order ready for me.  She owns the feed store in Whiskerton.

quest_list.notes: Pick up Grain from Daria Pale for Ted.
quest_list.success_message: Daria gave you Ted Capocella's Grain.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Oh, yes!  I was wondering if he was ever going to stop by and pick it up. Here it is.

quest_list.notes: Deliver Grain to Ted Capocella.
quest_list.title: Ted's Hay and Grain
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: I'm sorry, but I think you may have forgotten the grain with Daria.  You should probably go back and get it.
quest_list.success_message: You Completed Ted's Hay and Grain.  You earned $3500 and 75 quest points.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Why, thank you!  I can spend more time racing now that I don't have to worry about hay and grain.  Here's something for your trouble.
quest_list.author: CheshireKitty

quest_list.notes: You agree to find Ted Capocella's Racing Saddle
quest_list.success_message: You have agreed to find Ted Capocella's racing saddle.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: I believe I left it with Adrianna, she lives to the east of me.  I would check with her.

quest_list.notes: Receive Ted Capocella's broken racing saddle from Adrianna.
quest_list.success_message: Adrianna gave you Ted Capocella's Broken Racing Saddle.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Well, whenever I have anything that needs to be fixed, I go to Bridgett Briddel.  She owns the tack shop in Tropicton.

quest_list.notes: Give Ted's racing saddle to Bridgett
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: I'm sorry, but I don't see the saddle.  You should probably go back to Adrianna and get it.
quest_list.success_message: You gave Bridgett Briddel Ted Capocella's Broken Racing Saddle.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Just a strap? That doesn't sound too hard. Let me see it. (She carefully examines the saddle.) If you come back tomorrow, I'll have it ready for you.

quest_list.notes: Receive Ted Capocella's fixed racing saddle from Bridgett Briddel
quest_list.success_message: Bridgett gave you Ted Capocella's Racing Saddle.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: (She reaches behind the counter and then hands you the saddle.) I fixed the straps and a few other things to make it stronger and last longer.

quest_list.notes: Return Ted Capocella's Racing Saddle.
quest_list.title: Ted's Racing Saddle
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: No, I'm sorry, I don't believe you do.  You should come back when you've found it.
quest_list.success_message: You Completed Ted's Racing Saddle.  You earned $3000 and 75 quest points.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Oh, thank you!  This will help relieve some of my stress and it's one less thing I have to do.  Please have this in return.
quest_list.author: CheshireKitty

quest_list.notes: Puck sends you to Rhoswen
quest_list.success_message: Puck has sent you to find Rhoswen, the Snow Fairy.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Thank thee, mortal.  Thy search begins with Rhoswen, the Snow Fairy.  She will send thee to the next fairy and so forth.  When thou hast found all 6 fairies, come back to me.

quest_list.notes: Rhoswen asks you for help.
quest_list.success_message: Rhoswen has asked for 10 Candy Canes and a Geode.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: I will need 10 candy canes from Christmas Isle and a Geode.  Look carefully, and you can find Geodes among the rock piles here on Snow Isle.  Look for a rock that weighs less than it should!

quest_list.notes: You found a Geode!!
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You look all over at all the tiny details, but alas, nothing interesting.
quest_list.success_message: You have found a Geode for Rhoswen.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Hmmm, this rock weighs less than it should... You found a Geode!!

quest_list.notes: Rhoswen gets her items.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: I will need the 10 candy canes and the geode together.  Come back when you have it all.
quest_list.success_message: You gave Rhoswen the Geode and the Candy Canes and she has sent you to Jungle Isle.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: These are perfect!  Thank thee, mortal.  Next you must go to the Jungle Fairy.  You will find him on the largest island around Jungle Isle, by the native woodworker.

quest_list.notes: Oren sends you for supplies
quest_list.success_message: Oren has asked for 5 logs of Ebony Wood and 20 Ferns.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Bring me 5 logs of ebony wood and 20 ferns so that we might fashion a cradle fit for Fairy royalty.  After thou hast done this for us, we will gladly send thee on thy way to the next Fairy.

quest_list.notes: You give Oren his supplies
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You are missing something!  Come back when you have gathered everything!
quest_list.success_message: Oren has accepted the Ebony and Ferns and sent you to Cloud Isle.
