quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You rake all over, but alas, uncover nothing interesting.
quest_list.success_message: Raking carefully through the sand, you uncover a beautiful fringed scarf. You gently brush the dirt from it.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: You found one of Madame Babushka Fringed Scarves!

quest_list.notes: You find a scarf #4/1st dbl palm on beach north of shack
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You rake all over, but alas, uncover nothing interesting.
quest_list.success_message: Raking carefully through the sand, you uncover a beautiful fringed scarf. You gently brush the dirt from it.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: You found one of Madame Babushka Fringed Scarves!

quest_list.notes: You find a scarf #5/palm just south of pyramid
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You rake all over, but alas, uncover nothing interesting.
quest_list.success_message: Raking carefully through the sand, you uncover a beautiful fringed scarf. You gently brush the dirt from it.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: You found one of Madame Babushka Fringed Scarves!

quest_list.notes: You find a scarf #6/single palm south of shack
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You rake all over, but alas, uncover nothing interesting.
quest_list.success_message: Raking carefully through the sand, you uncover a beautiful fringed scarf. You gently brush the dirt from it.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: You found one of Madame Babushka Fringed Scarves!

quest_list.notes: You find a scarf #7/sandcastle
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You rake all over, but alas, uncover nothing interesting.
quest_list.success_message: Raking carefully through the sand, you uncover a beautiful fringed scarf. You gently brush the dirt from it.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: You found one of Madame Babushka Fringed Scarves!

quest_list.notes: Madame Babushka rewards you {travel costs $600}
quest_list.title: Madame Babushka's Missing Scarves
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: I'm afraid you don't have all of the scarves I'm missing. Can you come back when you have seven?
quest_list.success_message: You Completed Madame Babushka's Missing Scarves. You earned 1 Diamond and 75 quest points.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: My lovely scarves! How unexpected and delightful! I am ever so grateful that you found these. (Madame Babushka hugs her scarves.) Please, take this as a reward.
quest_list.author: Desertmorn

quest_list.notes: Crow's Nest Carrie rewards you. {travel costs Zero}
quest_list.title: Crow's Nest Carrie's Missing Foghorn
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Ye don't be havin' that!
quest_list.success_message: You Completed Crow's Nest Carrie's Missing Foghorn. You earned 3 Diamond Necklaces and 150 quest points.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: (Crow's Nest Carrie sits up abruptly, looking shocked! A huge grin spreads across her face.) I be much obliged to ye, matey. Here's a bit a glitter for all yer troubles. Now clear out so's I kin git back to me job!
quest_list.author: Desertmorn

quest_list.notes: You return Stinky's copper-bottomed pot
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Ye ain't got that! You best be finding me copper pot!
quest_list.success_message: You return Stinky Breeches Vincent's Copper-Bottom Pot to him. He gave you a Diamond!
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Me pot's a bit messy, but I'll be takin' that as a compliment! They almost licked it clean. Thank ye, kindly! Take this bit o' glitter for returnin' me pot!

quest_list.notes: tracking Madame Bubushka.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You don't have that.

quest_list.notes: Carlotta checks to see if you are adventurous enough
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Aye, carumba! You need to build up your adventuring muscles. Come back when you are able to visit pirates, my friend.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: You are indeed brave and adventurous. Indeed, my friend!

quest_list.notes: tracking Madame Babushka/missing scarves quest
quest_list.success_message: Maybe you should go talk to Harriet about Madame Babushka's strange behavior.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: (Madame Babushka begins whirling again, sobbing softly.)

quest_list.notes: Captain Jack tells you where to look for the foghorn
quest_list.success_message: Captain Jack told you to search the empty barrels for the foghorn.

quest_list.notes: You've agreed to help Marina
quest_list.success_message: You agreed to get a new headsail made for Marina's sailboat. She gave you the Sail Specifications and $7000.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Thank you so much for suggesting this! Here's some money to help with the costs, and the sail construction specifications.

quest_list.notes: Get indigo dye from Sasha in Treeton
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You don't have that.
quest_list.success_message: You have been given a jar of powdered indigo dye. Trudy needs it for the cloth.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Be careful not to get any on you. It'll stain your clothes.

quest_list.notes: Get bolt of cotton canvas from Barb in Shellton
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You don't have enough money.  I need $1500.
quest_list.success_message: You pay Barb $1500 and she hands you a Bolt of Cotton Canvas. Now you need to get the cloth dyed indigo.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: (Barb takes the specifications note and reads it.) Marina also wants it dyed indigo. You'll need to take the material to someone else to have that done. Then bring it back so I can get started on it.

quest_list.notes: Give Trudy in Hotton bolt of cotton canvas
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You don't have the $500.
quest_list.success_message: You gave Trudy the Bolt of Cotton Cloth. Now you need to get the dye.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Now all I need is the indigo dye. You'll need to have Sasha order it. Once it comes in, bring it here and I'll start dying the fabric.

quest_list.notes: Give indigo dye to Trudy in Hotton
quest_list.success_message: You gave Trudy the Indigo Dye. Plenty of time to look for wilds!
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Thanks. This is just what I need! Give me some time to get it dyed.

quest_list.notes: Get indigo dyed cotton canvas
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You don't have that.
quest_list.success_message: Trudy gave you the Bolt of Blue Cotton Canvas. Time to get it sewn into a sail now!
quest_list.success_npc_chat: It is! The canvas took the dye really well. Enjoy!

quest_list.notes: Give indigo dyed bolt of cotton canvas to Barb in Shellton
quest_list.success_message: You gave Barb the Bolt of Blue Cotton Canvas.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: What a gorgeous color! Trudy did an amazing job for so much fabric. Give me some time to get this sewn.

quest_list.notes: Get finished headsail
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You don't have that.
quest_list.success_message: Barb Sower gave you the Bright Blue Headsail.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: It sure is. I took it upon myself to add the white whorl design to the center of the sail. I hope Marina likes it!

quest_list.notes: Marina rewards you {$8400=mat'ls + travel costs}
quest_list.title: Marina's Missing Headsail
quest_list.success_message: You Completed Marina's Missing Headsail! You earned $15,000 and 150 quest points.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: I'm stunned! This is far more beautiful than I could have imagined. And the whorl design is perfect! Thank you so much. Please, take this as a show of my deep appreciation.
quest_list.author: Desertmorn

quest_list.notes: You've agreed to help Bruno/Appleton
quest_list.success_message: Bruno gave you 5 Bushels of Apples and a Note of who needs a delivery.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Here's a list of the people you need to see, and 5 bushels of apples. Ruthie's delivery is on the house. I know she can't afford much. Please come back when you are done and I'll have a reward for you!

quest_list.notes: Deliver to Barrett Braunbag/Tail
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You don't have that.
quest_list.success_message: You delivered a Bushel of Apples and received $2000.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: I've been hungering for one of Bruno's apples! Thank you so much. Here's $2000.

quest_list.notes: Delivery to Bena Buket/Santon
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You don't have that.
quest_list.success_message: You delivered a Bushel of Apples and received $2000.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: What plump apples! Thank you so much. Here's $2000.

quest_list.notes: Delivery to Ruthie/Half Haven
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You don't have that.
quest_list.success_message: You delivered a Bushel of Apples and received much gratitude from Ruthie!
quest_list.success_npc_chat: My horses are going to love these. I can't thank you enough. And please, send my thanks to Bruno.

quest_list.notes: Delivery to Su Comida/Sandy Gen'l Store
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You don't have that.
quest_list.success_message: You delivered a Bushel of Apples and received $2000.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Oh, my! My mouth is already watering just looking at these apples. Thank you so much. Here's $2000.

quest_list.notes: Bruno rewards you  {$3400 travel costs}
quest_list.title: Bruno's Apple Deliveries
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You haven't delivered all the apples yet.
quest_list.success_message: You Completed Bruno's Apple Deliveries! You earned $2000 and 100 quest points.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Fantastic! Keep the $8000 they gave you as payment.  Here's a little extra also.  You've saved me a lot of time.
quest_list.author: Desertmorn

quest_list.notes: You've agreed to help Bruno again
quest_list.success_message: Bruno gave you a Bushel of Apples.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: I know those forest mazes take time, so I really appreciate your efforts.

quest_list.notes: Delivery to Allaire/Tail Forest
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You don't have that.
quest_list.success_message: You delivered the Bushel of Apples and were paid $2000. Time to head back and let Bruno know.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Oh my! These look scrumptious. I was all out. Please let Bruno know that someone stole the rest of my other apples, and thank him for sending these.  Here's $2000 for braving the maze.

quest_list.notes: Bruno rewards you {no travel costs}
quest_list.title: Bruno's Special Delivery
quest_list.success_message: You Completed Bruno's Special Delivery! You earned $5000 and earned 50 quest points.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Great job! Here's a reward for your efforts.  Keep the money Allaire gave you also.
quest_list.author: Desertmorn

quest_list.notes: Agree to help Allaire
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You don't have that.
quest_list.success_message: You agreed to help Allaire figure out who stole her apples. Time to start looking for clues.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: That would be wonderful! You might want to start looking near the dead tree out there.

quest_list.notes: You find a clue!
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You look all over at all the tiny details, but alas, nothing interesting.
quest_list.success_message: You look very closely around the tree and suddenly spot a clue! There are apple peelings on the ground!
quest_list.success_npc_chat: You found a clue on the ground!

quest_list.notes: You find yet another clue!
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You look all over at all the tiny details, but alas, nothing interesting.
quest_list.success_message: You look closely through the flowers in the meadow and suddenly you spot another clue! There are three apple peelings on the ground! Best to head east.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: You found another clue on the ground!

quest_list.notes: You find clue #3
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You look all over at all the tiny details, but alas, nothing interesting.
quest_list.success_message: Looking through the leaf litter on the forest floor, you find more apple peelings! You'd better follow the trail further.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: You found another clue on the ground!

quest_list.notes: You find clue #4
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You look all over at all the tiny details, but alas, nothing interesting.
quest_list.success_message: Not only are there more apple peelings on the ground, there is a long spiral peel hanging in the dead tree! You feel motivated to continue to search.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: You found another clue!

quest_list.notes: You find clue #5
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You look all over at all the tiny details, but alas, nothing interesting.
quest_list.success_message: There are apple peelings on the boulder AND an apple core. You look closely at the core. Looks like human teeth marks to you. Surely, you must be getting close to the perpetrator!
quest_list.success_npc_chat: You found another clue!

quest_list.notes: You find clue #6
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You look all over at all the tiny details, but alas, nothing interesting.
quest_list.success_message: There are more apple peelings on the ground! Now to decide which way to search. Left or right?
quest_list.success_npc_chat: You found another clue!

quest_list.notes: You find clue #7
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You look all over at all the tiny details, but alas, nothing interesting.
quest_list.success_message: Yes! You've found a tiny speck of a peel caught in the branches of the fir tree. You must be heading in the right direction.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: You found another clue!

quest_list.notes: You find clue #8
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You look all over at all the tiny details, but alas, nothing interesting.
quest_list.success_message: Ah ha! The tell-tale apple peel in a dead oak clue! Success is near!
quest_list.success_npc_chat: You found another clue!

quest_list.notes: You find the culprit!
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You look all over at all the tiny details, but alas, nothing interesting.
quest_list.success_message: You see an elderly man. There are apple peelings all around him, along with what looks like.... shrunken heads? Best go tell Allaire what you've discovered.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: You've found the remains of the missing apples!

quest_list.notes: You agree to go talk to the elderly gentleman
quest_list.success_message: You agreed to go talk to the elderly gentleman.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Thank you for being willing to check up on him.

quest_list.notes: Agree to help Andrea
quest_list.success_message: You agreed to find out what's making all that ruckus and get it to quiet down.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: I would sure be grateful!

quest_list.notes: Find the frog
quest_list.success_message: This must be why Andrea was complaining about noise. If you can get the frog to hush up, you'll solve Andrea's problem.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Croak! Ka-blurp! Ribbit! Greedeep! Bruddup! Oh, woe is me! All for naught, I say. All for naught. Croak! Ka-blurp! Ribbit! Greedeep! Bruddup!

quest_list.notes: Agree to help Murigal
quest_list.success_message: You agreed to find Murigal's ten lost gems. Might as well let Andrea know. Then you best start checking all the ponds!
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Oh yes, indeed and please do! My lips are zipped. Sealed. Swallowing the key! No more noise from me. But please, bring back my gems as quickly as you can. Oh, in case you were wondering, there's ten missing.

quest_list.notes: Andrea rewards you {travel costs $1000}
quest_list.title: Andrea's Mysterious Noise
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You don't have that.
quest_list.success_message: You Completed Andrea's Mysterious Noise! You earned $2500 and 25 quest points.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: How wonderful not to hear all that noise! Here, please take this as a small thank you.
quest_list.author: Desertmorn

quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You don't have that!
quest_list.success_message: You gave Edgar the Lump of Wax. Now to ask Ricky Mantequilla for a small paper bag.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Deal! I'll have to talk Farley into this. He tends to be a very private individual. In the meantime, will you please go ask Ricky for a paper bag? He's just two buildings up from here. I'd hate to see this wax travel unprotected in your backpack.

quest_list.notes: Get paper bag from Ricky Mantequllia/Molten
quest_list.success_message: Ricky Mantequllia gave you a Small Paper Bag. Time to head back to Edgar.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Here you go! Would you like some pudding with that?

quest_list.notes: Bag up the wax impression
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You don't have that.
quest_list.success_message: Edgar gave you the Bagged Dental Impression. Time to get it to the dentist!
quest_list.success_npc_chat: (Edgar gently places the dental impression inside the bag. Then he closes the top and tapes it shut.) There you go. Please be careful with it.

quest_list.notes: Give wax impression to Karee/Wington
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You don't have that.
quest_list.success_message: You gave the dentist the Bagged Dental Impression.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: (The dentist removes the wax impression and studies it carefully.) Looks great! It will take me awhile to create a new set. You'll need to come back in a day or two. In the meantime, why don't you explore the town?

quest_list.notes: Agree to get polishing paste from Cara/Wington Food
quest_list.success_message: You agreed to get some polishing paste from Cara at Wington Food Store.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: I really appreciate at this. As soon as I get the paste, I'll have the new teeth reading in minutes!

quest_list.notes: Get polishing paste from Cara/Wington Food
quest_list.success_message: Cara Cook gave you Dental Polishing Paste. The dentist is waiting for it. Better hurry!
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Good timing. It just came in. Here you go! I'll put it on her tab. Tell the good dentist I said hello!

quest_list.notes: Farley/Molten Meadows agrees to get a makeover
quest_list.success_message: You get Farley's Wish List and read it over. This should keep you busy for awhile!
quest_list.success_npc_chat: I'll do it! (Farley awkwardly writes out a list and shoves it at you.) Here. This is what I want. Oh. Please and thank you.

quest_list.notes: Exchange paste for dentures
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Remember that it costs $1500.  You don't quite have that much.  Please come back when you do.
quest_list.success_message: Karee Dentin gave you a Set of New Dentures for Farley. Time to head back to Molten Meadows!
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Terrific! (The dentist takes the paste and buffs the new teeth into a perfectly shiny smile.) Here you go! I hope your friend likes them. Let me know if he has any problems with the fit.

quest_list.notes: End quest at Edgar's. {$2700 min travel/expenses}
quest_list.title: Edgar's Good Deed
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You don't have that!
quest_list.success_message: You Completed Edgar's Good Deed! You earned $25,000 and 175 quest points.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: These look amazing. I am deeply grateful. I know Farley will love them. Here, take this as a gesture of my gratitude.
quest_list.author: Desertmorn

quest_list.notes: Agree to help Edgar/Molten Meadows cheer Farley up
quest_list.success_message: You've agreed to talk to Farley about getting an extreme makeover.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: What a splendid idea! If Farley has no objections, I would be very appreciative of your help.

quest_list.notes: Agrees to find someone to buff out Farley's chipped nails.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Wait, never mind about the nails yet, you haven't given me everything yet!
quest_list.success_message: You've agreed to find someone to repair Farley's chipped nails.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Ragged nails simply ruin the entire effect! And you DID say Extreme Makeover.  That should include all of me!

quest_list.notes: Get cloth tape measure from Barb/Shellton
quest_list.success_message: Barb Sower gave you a Cloth Tape Measure. Time to head back to Molten Meadows and get Farley's measurements..
quest_list.success_npc_chat: You know, Quincy's sister is recently widowed and just moved into The Mare over on Hoof. I understand she used to be quite the seamstress.  She might be able to help you.

quest_list.notes: Get Farley's/Molten Meadows Measurements.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You don't have that.
quest_list.success_message: You now know Farley's measurements.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: (Edgar takes the measuring tape from you and quickly starts measuring Farley. You memorize all of Farley's measurements.)

quest_list.notes: Agree to exchange leather for shoes Hershel/Appleton
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You don't have those.
quest_list.success_message: You agree to give Hershel five Leather Pieces and one Leather Strapping in exchange for Farley's shoes.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: I can draw up a pattern from these measurements of his feet. As soon as you get me that leather, I'll cut out the pieces and stitch the shoes together.

quest_list.notes: Agree to trade Su Comida/Sand Isle 3 Gen'l Store - 12 bundles of sage for jojoba oil
quest_list.success_message: You agreed to get 12 Bundles of Desert Sage.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: There are a few sage bushes around here. They are small compared to  saguaros. You are most likely to find them around areas where people are living in the desert. Please get stalks of sage that have blossoms on them.

quest_list.notes: Give Hershel/Appleton leather [$1400 costs}
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You don't have that. We agreed to five leather pieces and one leather strapping.
quest_list.success_message: You gave Hershel the leather for Farley's shoes. Now you need to get him Jojoba Oil.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: This leather is perfect! While I sew these shoes together, can you get me Jojoba oil from Su Comida? I'll need it to buff and protect the leather shoes.

quest_list.notes: A bundle of Sage/just west of Santon

quest_list.success_npc_chat: These are just perfect! This will save me some time. Here is the bottle of Jojoba oil. You've earned it.

quest_list.notes: Trade Hershel/Appleton Jojoba oil for Farley's new shoes
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You don't have that.
quest_list.success_message: You were given brand new handmade leather shoes. Perfect for Farley.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: This oil is amazing. A quick buff over these shoes and... Voila! Look at that shine! Here you go. I think they turned out really well. Hope your friend likes them.

quest_list.notes: Zerena/Hoof agrees to make Farley's new clothes.
quest_list.success_message: Zerena agreed to make Farley's new outfit! She needs Farley's measurements.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: I will need your friend's measurements before I can even start creating a pattern.

quest_list.notes: Give Zerena/Hoof Farley's Measurements.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You don't have those! You'll need to get your friend's measurements.
quest_list.success_message: You agreed to have Albert Junker order some fabric.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Your friend is very little! Let me get started on the pattern. In the meantime, I'll need some specialty fabric. Please ask Albert next door to order me a bolt each of navy Chambray and white Broadcloth.

quest_list.notes: Have Albert Junker/Hoof order fabric (tracking)
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Happy to do that for her! Zerena sure has a nice smile. I'm expecting my supplier sometime today. He usually carries tons of stuff. Hopefully he'll have this on his boat. Then you'll be able to get it today.

quest_list.notes: Get fabric from Albert Junker/Hoof
quest_list.success_message: Albert Junker gave you a Bolt of Broadcloth and a Bolt of Chambray.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: There you go! I'll just put this on Zerena's tab. Please tell her hello for me.

quest_list.notes: Give Zerena/Hoof the material
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You don't have that. I asked for one bolt each of Chambray and Broadcloth.
quest_list.success_message: You gave Zerena the Broadcloth and Chambray.  You agreed to ask Barb Sower for 2 dozen Doll-sized Buttons.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: He's such a nice man! This fabric should be perfect. I can't wait to get started. In the meantime, would you ask Barb Sower for 2 dozen doll-sized buttons? I need them to finish the outfit.

quest_list.notes: Get buttons from Barb Sower/Shellton
quest_list.success_message: Barb Sower gave you 24 Doll-sized Buttons.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: There you go! No charge, I've got plenty.

quest_list.notes: Give Zerena/Hoof the buttons/Get clothes
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You don't have what I need. I need both the buttons and the cost of my labor, which is $1200.
quest_list.success_message: Zerena gave you a custom made Broadcloth Shirt and Chambray Suit for Farley!
quest_list.success_npc_chat: (Zerena takes the buttons and quickly stiches them on the suit jacket and the shirt.) There you go! I hope your friend likes it!

quest_list.notes: Give Farley/Molten Meadows the shirt.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You don't have that.
quest_list.success_message: You gave Farley a Broadcloth Shirt.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Look at the detailing! The workmanship on this is amazing. I'll look very handsome in it.

quest_list.notes: Give Farley/Molten Meadows the suit.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You don't have that.
quest_list.success_message: You gave Farley his Chambray Suit.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: This is exquisitely made. I'll look dashing in it!

quest_list.notes: Offer Farley/Molten Meadows the shoes.
quest_list.success_message: Looks like you need to figure out who can make Farley some socks.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Are you crazy? I can't put those shoes on! I need some socks first! And I would prefer argyle socks.

quest_list.notes: Get argyle socks from Yolanda/Hoof
quest_list.success_message: Yolanda gave you a pair of small Argyle Socks. How cute!
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Of course! I've knitted several pair in expectations of my soon to be born child. Here, take this pair. Given the size your friend wears, they should fit.

quest_list.notes: Give Farley/Molten Meadows the argyle socks.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You don't have those!
quest_list.success_message: You gave Farley the Argyle Socks.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: These socks are amazing! I can't wait to try them on.

quest_list.notes: Tuque agrees to buff out Farley's chipped nails.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You don't have those!
quest_list.success_message: Tuque agreed to repair Farley's chipped nails.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: That shouldn't take me more than a few minutes. I'll dash over there now.

quest_list.notes: rewards you for completing part of the extreme makeoever
Get wool from Candide/Eldorado for Farley's hair.
quest_list.success_message: Candide has given you a bundle of golden fleece. Perfect for making a toupée for Farley.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: I clipped them just yesterday, so I have plenty. Here you go! Hope it works well for your friend.

quest_list.notes: Get dyed toupée from Yahzi/Sandy Meadows
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You don't have that.
quest_list.success_message: Yahzi took the Golden Fleece and gave you the Dyed Toupée.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: This golden fleece is wonderful. Here's the toupée. I hope your friend likes it.

quest_list.notes: Yahzi/Sandy Meadows agrees to create toupée
quest_list.success_message: Yahzi agreed to create the Toupée.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: I have a hairpiece I can modify but it will take me a few minutes. Why don't you explore the local desert? You might find a wild horse, or even a diamond.

quest_list.notes: Give Farley/Molten Meadows the toupée
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You don't have that.
quest_list.success_message: You've given Farley a finely made woolen toupée.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Oh. The texture. The curls. I'll look 10 years younger!

quest_list.notes: Farley checks that you've gotten him everything on the list.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You certainly haven't! Try reading the wish list I gave you!
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Well, you've certainly done a fine job of making over my appearance. Except for one thing! What about my nails? They look wretched. Just wretched!

quest_list.notes: Give Farley/Molten Meadows the shoes.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Are you crazy? I can't put those shoes on! I need some socks first! And I would prefer argyle socks.
quest_list.success_message: You gave Farley his new Handmade Leather Shoes.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Ohhh. These are really spiffy. With these on, I'll be all that and more! I'm better than I ever was!

quest_list.notes: Try to give Farley the suit
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: I can't put on a suit without putting on a shirt first! Gesh!
quest_list.success_npc_chat: I can't put on a suit without putting on a shirt first! Gesh!

quest_list.notes: Karee Denin/Wington checks to see if you have 25%
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You need to build up your adventuring muscles. Come back once you've met Patsy, Sir Sleepwell's loyal servant.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Terrific! Looks like you've been adventurous enough to meet Patsy, Sir Sleepwell's loyal servant. Ready for another adventure?

quest_list.notes: Karee Denin/Wington checks to see if you have 50%
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Looks like you need to build up your adventuring muscles a bit more. Come back once you've visited Pirate Isle.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Looks like you've got exactly what it takes to do this job for me.

quest_list.notes: Check to see if Farley's Extreme Makeover is complete (tracking)
quest_list.success_npc_chat: (Farley flashes his newly repaired and buffed hands at you.)

quest_list.notes: Ask Zerena/Hoof Inn about making socks/tracking
quest_list.success_npc_chat: I don't. However, my neighbor Yolanda has been knitting up a storm. I bet she could help you. She lives just below the apple trees.

quest_list.notes: End quest at Edgar's/Molten {min $4000 travel/exps}
quest_list.title: Farley's Extreme Makeover
quest_list.success_message: You Completed Farley's Extreme Makeover! You earned $75,000 and 325 quest points.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: And he looks amazing. I can't thank you enough. He's a new man because of you. Here, please take this as a gesture of my deep gratitude.
quest_list.author: Desertmorn

quest_list.notes: Karee Denin/Wington checks to see if you have 75%
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Looks like you need to build up your adventure muscles just a bit more. Come back once you are able to visit those fluffy isles in the sky!
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Wow. You've got some seriously impressive adventuring skills. This errand should be a breeze for you.

quest_list.notes: Agree to make some simple deliveries/Karee Dentin/Wington
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: But you already said you would deliver those.  You must not be done yet though.  Off you go!
quest_list.success_message: You agreed to deliver Brand New Toothbrushes to all the residents of Soaring Meadows.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Here are some toothbrushes. Please deliver them to all the residents of Soaring Meadows. This will let them know that I'm here ready to help them if they have a need, and it will encourage brushing.

quest_list.notes: Deliver a toothbrush to River/Soaring Meadows
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You don't have that.
quest_list.success_message: You delivered a Brand New Toothbrush to River.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Ohh. I guess I should eat some breakfast so I can try this out. Thanks!

quest_list.notes: Deliver a toothbrush to Frederick/Soaring Meadows
quest_list.success_message: You delivered a Brand New Toothbrush to Frederick.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Isn't this a nice gesture of her! Please tell her thank you for me.

quest_list.notes: Deliver a toothbrush to Willow/Soaring Meadows
quest_list.success_message: You delivered a Brand New Toothbrush to Willow.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Oh, my! This is lovely. Thank you.

quest_list.notes: Deliver a toothbrush to Harmony/Soaring Meadows
quest_list.success_message: You delivered a Brand New Toothbrush to Harmony.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Well isn't that the oddest gift! Oh! Excuse my manners. Please tell her thank you.

quest_list.notes: Deliver a toothbrush to Rainey/Souring Meadows
quest_list.success_message: You delivered a Brand New Toothbrush to Rainey.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Wow. I've never gotten a toothbrush before I've even seen the dentist! Please tell her thank you.

quest_list.notes: Deliver a toothbrush to Melody/Soaring Meadows
quest_list.success_message: You delivered a Brand New Toothbrush to Melody.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: A toothbrush? That doesn't seem like much fun.

quest_list.notes: Deliver a toothbrush to Sunny/Soaring Meadows
quest_list.success_message: You delivered a Brand New Toothbrush to Sunny.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: I didn't even know there was a dentist in Wington! Thank you.

quest_list.notes: Deliver a toothbrush to Storm/Soaring Meadows
quest_list.success_message: You delivered a Brand New Toothbrush to Storm.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: That does make my day better! Please tell her thank you.

quest_list.notes: End quest at Kareen Dentin/Wington {$600 travel}
quest_list.title: Karee Dentin Serves Up Toothbrushes
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Looks like you aren't quite done with the deliveries. Come back when you are! Thanks.
quest_list.success_message: You Completed Karee Dentin Serves Up Toothbrushes! You earned $3500 and 75 quest points.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Great job! I've already had three of the Soaring Meadow residents stop by and say hi. Here's your payment for a job well done.
quest_list.author: DesertMorn

quest_list.notes: Agree to make simple delivery to Torrid For Karee Dentin/Wington
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Well, I already gave you the toothbrushes. Remember they need to be reinforced by Liam and then taken to Laurence on Torrid Isle.
quest_list.success_message: Karee Dentin gave you three Customized Camel Toothbrushes and you agreed to deliver them Laurence on Torrid Isle. You'll need to stop at Liam's first.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Wonderful! Please take these to the local blacksmith. Liam has agreed to reinforce them with wire. Seems Chauncey likes to chew.
quest_list.author: Desertmorn

quest_list.notes: Have Liam Flux/Wington reinforce the toothbrushes (tracking)
quest_list.success_message: Liam Flux gave you three Reinforced Camel Toothbrushes. Time to head to Torrid!
quest_list.success_npc_chat: (Liam takes the toothbrushes from you and deftly wraps wires between the bristles. Then he fuses the wire ends together.) There you go!
quest_list.author: Desertmorn

quest_list.notes: Deliver the toothbrushes to Laurence/Torrid
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You don't have that!
quest_list.success_message: You delivered three Reinforced Camel Toothbrushes to Laurence.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Wow! These sure look like they are heavy duty now. When I ordered them, I never thought to have them reinforced. I see these have been. I think they'll be perfect for Chauncey. Please thank Karee for me.

quest_list.notes: End quest back at Karee Dentin/Wington {$1600 travel exp}
quest_list.title: Karee Dentin's Camel Toothbrush
quest_list.success_message: You Completed Karee Dentin's Camel Toothbrush. You earned $4500 and 75 quest points.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: I'm so glad he was pleased. Thanks for a job well done. Here's your pay!
quest_list.author: Desertmorn

quest_list.notes: Agree to make deliveries to Molten Meadows for Karee Dentin/Wington {$600 travel costs}
quest_list.success_message: You were given 8 customized toothbrushes and have agreed to deliver them. Time to head to the Lava Isles!
quest_list.success_npc_chat: He doesn't feel needed anymore. If more of our residents had healthy, happy smiles, they might find a renewed interest in Cupid's services. When you've delivered those, I'll have the next batch ready and waiting for you.

quest_list.notes: Deliver a toothbrush to Liza/Molten Meadows
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You don't have that.
quest_list.success_message: You've delivered a toothbrush to Liza.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: A toothbrush? What an odd gesture... Still, I'm happy to have it.  Please tell her thank you.

quest_list.notes: Deliver a toothbrush to Tuque/Molten Meadows
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You don't have that.
quest_list.success_message: You've delivered a toothbrush to Tuque.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: What am I supposed to do with this? Buff my wood projects?

quest_list.notes: Deliver a toothbrush to Bowen/Molten Meadows
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You don't have that.
quest_list.success_message: You've delivered a toothbrush to Bowen.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Oh! I wasn't expecting this. Still, I think I'll be able to put it to good use. Thank you.

quest_list.notes: Deliver a toothbrush to Peru/Molten Meadows
quest_list.success_message: You've delivered a toothbrush to Peru.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: How lovely! I was just telling Bowen I needed a new one. This will do nicely. Please tell Ms. Dentin thank you for me.

quest_list.notes: Deliver a toothbrush to Dr. Fernlove/Molten Meadows
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You don't have that.
quest_list.success_message: You've delivered a toothbrush to Dr. Fernlove.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: A toothbrush? And a lovely one at that. An interesting item, don't you think? While the primary use is for dental hygiene, here in my laboratory, I can think of many alternative uses!

quest_list.notes: Deliver a toothbrush to Farley/Molten Meadows
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You don't have that.
quest_list.success_message: You've delivered a toothbrush to Farley.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Ohhh! This is perfect for maintaining my brand new sparkly smile! Go away so I can brush!

quest_list.notes: Deliver a toothbrush to Edgar/Molten Meadows
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You don't have that.
quest_list.success_message: You've delivered a toothbrush to Edgar.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Why, this is certainly unexpected. But not unappreciated. However, I am concerned that Farley's feelings will be hurt, so I'll just hide it. Please extend my appreciate to Ms. Dentin.

quest_list.notes: Deliver a toothbrush to Chaffe/Molten Meadows
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You don't have that.
quest_list.success_message: You've delivered a toothbrush to Chaffe.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Oh. A toothbrush. Um... thanks. I guess.

quest_list.notes: Deliver a toothbrush to Ricky/Molten Meadows
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You don't have that.
quest_list.success_message: You've delivered a toothbrush to Ricky.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Is this a salesman's sample? Does she want me to stock toothbrushes now?

quest_list.notes: Deliver 2 of Karee's special toothbrushes to Cupid/Igneous
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You don't have that.
quest_list.success_message: You've delivered 2 toothbrushes to Cupid. Time to head back to Wington and let Karee know how the deliveries went.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: What a great idea! That Karee Dentin is so smart. Sparkling smiles makes my job so much easier! And I especially love the red - the color of hearts! Tell her I'm grateful to the moon and back!

quest_list.notes: Deliver a toothbrush to Felton/Flipperton
quest_list.success_message: You've delivered a toothbrush to Felton.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: This will be perfect for dusting out the fine lines of my bone collection!

quest_list.notes: Deliver a toothbrush to Waverly/Flipperton
quest_list.success_message: You've delivered a toothbrush to Waverly.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: A toothbrush? Well. I just don't know what to say. I guess a thank you is in order.

quest_list.notes: Deliver a toothbrush to Sandra/Flipperton
quest_list.success_message: You've delivered a toothbrush to Sandra.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: A toothbrush? What a perfect thing to have on hand. Thank you!

quest_list.notes: Deliver a toothbrush to Helga/Flipperton
quest_list.success_message: You've delivered a toothbrush to Helga.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Oh my. This is a surprise. Well, tell her thank you for me.

quest_list.notes: Deliver a toothbrush to Flavius/Flipperton
quest_list.success_message: You've delivered a toothbrush to Flavius.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Well. Okay. I'll take it. I guess you could tell her thank you for me.

quest_list.notes: Deliver a toothbrush to Nolan/Flipperton
quest_list.success_message: You've delivered a toothbrush to Nolan.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Well! Isn't this special. Please tell her thank you for me.

quest_list.notes: Deliver a toothbrush to Fin/Flipperton
quest_list.success_message: You've delivered a toothbrush to Fin.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Well this is certainly an unusual gift. Please pass on my gratitude.

quest_list.notes: Deliver a toothbrush to Iona/Flipperton
quest_list.success_message: You've delivered a toothbrush to Iona.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Oh. A toothbrush. Goodness. Not something I expected. Please tell her thank you.

quest_list.notes: Deliver a toothbrush to Mabel/Flipperton
quest_list.success_message: You've delivered a toothbrush to Mabel.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Well isn't this interesting. A toothbrush. One can never have too many! Please tell her thank you for me.

quest_list.notes: Deliver a toothbrush to Trixie/Flipperton
quest_list.success_message: You've delivered a toothbrush to Trixie.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Isn't this clever? Does she want me to stock them? I might be able to sell them for her.

quest_list.notes: Karee checks to see if you've delivered the toothbrushes to Molten Meadows.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You haven't delivered all the toothbrushes yet. Please do that and then come back.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Hmmm. Farley is the dummy, right? And on Ricky, I hadn't planned on giving toothbrushes to businesses, but there is no reason not to! In the meantime you've done a great job so far. Ready to deliver this next set?
quest_list.author: Desertmorn

quest_list.notes: John O'Lantern sends you out to the pumpkin patch.
quest_list.success_message: John O'Lantern asked you to go to the pumpkin patch and use the end of your shovel to cut three pumpkins off of the vines.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Great! Will you please go outside and cut three pumpkins? Try using your shovel to cut them off the vine.

quest_list.notes: Agree to deliver toothbrushes to Flipperton for Karee/Wington {$900 travel costs}
quest_list.success_message: You've been given 10 more toothbrushes and agreed to deliver them to the residents of Flipperton.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Here's the next batch of toothbrushes. Please deliver them to the residents of Flipperton.
quest_list.author: Desertmorn

quest_list.notes: Karee checks Flipperton/deliveries. {Karee Shares More Toothbrushes!}
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You haven't delivered all the toothbrushes yet. Please do that and then come back.
quest_list.success_message: You Completed Karee Shares More Toothbrushes! You earned $20,000 and 150 quest points.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: You've done a fantastic job. Here's $20,000 for all your work and travel expenses.
quest_list.author: Desertmorn

quest_list.notes: Agree to make a delivery to Cupid Karee/Wington {$1500 travel costs}
quest_list.success_message: You were given 2 more toothbrushes and agreed to deliver them to Igneous Isle.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: I can't believe Cupid heard about my services all the way out there. But I'm thrilled. If you could take him these, I'd be thrilled.
quest_list.author: Desertmorn

quest_list.notes: Complete Karee Dentin's Gift to Cupid {min $3000 travel exp}
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You haven't delivered all the toothbrushes yet. Please do that and then come back.
quest_list.success_message: You've completed Karee Dentin’s Gift to Cupid. You've earned $25,000 and 125 quest points., and a new pair of boot!
quest_list.success_npc_chat: I'm so glad the toothbrushes were well received. Thanks for a job well done. Here's your pay! As a bonus, enjoy this new pair of boots.
quest_list.author: Desertmorn

quest_list.notes: Karee checks to see if you've delivered the last of the toothbrushes
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You haven't delivered all the toothbrushes yet. Please do that and then come back.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Looks like you've done a great job! I suppose you are tired of delivering things and want to be paid now?
quest_list.author: Desertmorn

quest_list.notes: Agree to help Zachava
quest_list.success_message: You agreed to bring Zachava two Seashell Necklaces.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Hannah hasn't stopped talking about Patience's necklace since the moment she saw it.  If you could get me two seashell necklaces, that would be wonderful!

quest_list.notes: Give Zachava two seashell necklaces {$600 travel costs + 30 seashells}
quest_list.title: Zachava's Matching Necklaces
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: I'm sorry, you don't have that. I asked for two seashell necklaces.
quest_list.success_message: You Completed Zachava's Matching Necklaces. You earned $4000 and 25 quest points.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Wonderful! Thank you so much. Here's something for your troubles.

quest_list.notes: +3 pumpkin for John O'Lantern
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You dig all over, but turn up nothing.
quest_list.success_message: You collected three Pumpkins!

quest_list.notes: in Use for Ford Prefect
quest_list.success_npc_chat: And yay! we are back to chat point #0

quest_list.notes: John O'Lantern sends to to Arbuckle with the pumpkins.
quest_list.success_message: John O'Lantern asked you to deliver the Pumpkins to Arbuckle.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: So you do! Thanks! Can you take those over to Arbuckle for me, please?

quest_list.notes: Arbuckle takes pumpkins, starts carving, sends you for stump.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: I can't carve these pumpkins with you hovering over my shoulder! I need you to go over to those stumps just to the west and dig one up!
quest_list.success_message: Arbuckle asked you- well, demanded really- to dig up one of the stumps just to the west of his house while he carves the pumpkins.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: My pumpkins! (He snatches them out of your hands.) Now I can carve my masterpieces! You! I need a stump. Not just any stump! One of the stumps just to the west of the house. Dig one up for me! ...Please.

quest_list.notes: Dig up a stump for Arbuckle.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You dig all over, but turn up nothing.
quest_list.success_message: You heave one of the stumps out of the ground, but you can't figure out why Arbuckle thinks it's special.

quest_list.notes: Arbuckle takes stump, gives you jack o'lanterns.
quest_list.title: John O'Lantern's Pumpkin Delivery
quest_list.success_message: Well, you delivered the pumpkins and the stump, but Arbuckle botched the carving so badly that he gave the jack o'lanterns to you. You completed John O'Lantern's Pumpkin Delivery! You earned $3000 and 50 quest points. And apparently three Jack o'Lanterns.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: So this is the stump? Well... thanks. But my masterpieces... (Gestures to three very lackluster jack o'lanterns.) Well, it didn't go quite right. So you can keep those! I'll take the stump though. I guess you can have this for trying to help.
quest_list.author: BrightLights

quest_list.notes: You've met the Pallas cats.
You propose the idea of a pumpkin jungle gym.
quest_list.success_message: Batkhuyag seems to think your idea of a pumpkin playground is brilliant! He's given you an idea for where to put the pumpkins.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: (Batkhuyag looks most pleased!) Mrrrao! (Dislodging Sarangerel, he quickly scratches some figures into the ground, then stamps decisively next to them.) Mrao!

quest_list.notes: Batkhuyag confirms that you're in the right place.
quest_list.success_message: Batkhuyag seems to think that this is a good spot for a pumpkin playground for his kittens, so you set down the Jack o'Lanterns. Why don't you help him clear the leaves away?
quest_list.success_npc_chat: (Nods enthusiastically as he bats leaves away with his paw.)

quest_list.notes: Kittens love pumpkins.
quest_list.success_message: Immediately, the kittens leap away and scramble into, out of, between, and over the pumpkins! Batkhuyag immediately flops down and falls asleep, but Lianhua looks like she has something to say.

quest_list.notes: Lianhua rewards you
quest_list.title: The Pallas Cat Pumpkin Playground
quest_list.success_message: You Completed The Pallas Cat Pumpkin Playground! You earned a Ruby Necklace and 35 quest points.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: (With an air of great relief, Lianhua drops a ruby necklace at your feet! She rubs against your leg briefly, purring. Then she mimics Batkhuyag and falls asleep.)
quest_list.author: BrightLights

quest_list.notes: Vole Hole #7
quest_list.title: Vole Hole #7
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You have already completed this vole hole.
quest_list.success_message: You Completed Vole Hole #7!  You earned $3000 and 25 quest points.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: You got the vole to its food!

quest_list.notes: Agree to help Ed Klippit
quest_list.success_message: Apparently you agreed to pick up Ed Klippit's cleaning supplies at the local general store.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: What?  Help?  Well, if you really must have something to keep you busy, I need more cleaning materials.  Head over to the general store to get my order.

quest_list.notes: Get cleaning supplies from Ethel
quest_list.success_message: Ethel Barryjam gave you the Cleaning Supplies.

quest_list.notes: Give Ed Klippit the cleaning supplies
quest_list.title: Ed Klippit's Cleaning Supplies
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You don't have it.  Come back later.
quest_list.success_message: You Completed Ed Klippit's Cleaning Supplies.  You earned $2500 and 25 quest points.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: There you finally are.  Here.  Take this.  Figured I should pay you something.
quest_list.author: Miranda

quest_list.notes: Agree to find Fergus' 2 gold chests
quest_list.success_message: You agreed to dig up Fergus O'Toole's two Gold Chests.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: I never left Flower Isle.  I can tell ya that much.  There are two buried.  I remember they were buried next ta plants that were twins.

quest_list.notes: Find a gold chest
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You dig all over, but turn up nothing.
quest_list.success_message: Digging deep, you hit something solid.  You clear away the dirt carefully.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: You found a Gold Chest!

quest_list.notes: Find a gold chest
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You dig all over, but turn up nothing.
quest_list.success_message: Digging deep, you hit something solid.  You clear away the dirt carefully.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: You found a Gold Chest!

quest_list.notes: Give Fergus his two Gold Chests
quest_list.title: Fergus O'Toole's Lost Chests
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Ya don't have two.  I said there was two missin'!
quest_list.success_message:
You Completed Fergus O'Toole's Lost Chests. You earned 25 Wishing Coins, 25 Chunks of Gold Ore and 75 quest points.
**POOF**You are in the middle of Wington!
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Ah ha! Me chests! (He carefully opens one of them then closes it again before you get a chance to see what's inside.) Here. Take this fer yer troubles. Now leave me be.
quest_list.author: Miranda

quest_list.notes: Fergus' New pot quest completed.  Tracking to get rid of Ferrel Ironman replies
You annoy Grendel
quest_list.success_message: Looks like you've made a mess of things!

quest_list.notes: Get bone from Rocco
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You don't have sufficient funds to purchase that.
quest_list.success_message: You bought a Dinosaur Bone from Rocco Shale for $2100! Time to head back to Whorl.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: There you go! One dinosaur bone.

quest_list.notes: Grendel sends you to the dock
quest_list.success_message: You've been whooshed to the dock! What a great shortcut!
quest_list.success_npc_chat: (With a huge swipe of his hairy paw, Grendel flings you through the air.)

quest_list.notes: Agree to find a bone for Grendel
quest_list.success_message: You agreed to find a bone for Grendel. Time to find a really BIG bone!
quest_list.success_npc_chat: I doubt you'll find anything big enough to satisfy my hunger, but I remain foolishly hopeful.

quest_list.notes: Give Grendel dinosaur bone.
quest_list.title: Grendel's Big Appetite
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You don't have anything that can satisfy my appetite. Beat it, now.
quest_list.success_message: You completed Grendel's Big Appetite. You earned 18 Red Pine Cones and 25 quest points.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: You are kind. This should bring me a bit of solace. In gratitude, let me give you these red pinecones. Now, please. Be gone!
quest_list.author: Desertmorn

quest_list.notes: Carmina tells you about the fox problem
quest_list.success_message: You've agreed to go off in search of the local fox and attempt to convince him to leave the hounds alone for the day.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: I appreciate that. You understand, I'd have no objection to the fox having some fun- if that's what it is- if it weren't that my young entry on furry Shetlands are not prepared to go full-tilt!

quest_list.notes: You ride out to catch the scent.
You find fox tracks #1 at the veggie patch.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You look all over at all the tiny details, but alas, nothing interesting.
quest_list.success_message: Tiny fox prints dot the edges of the vegetable patch.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: You look very closely and notice small drips of honey.

quest_list.notes: You find fox tracks #2 at the honey tree.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You look all over at all the tiny details, but alas, find nothing.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Looking closely, you spot more pawprints. A lot more- it looks like this is a favorite spot for the fox.  You also spot scattered berries on the ground under the tree- they're squished, but you can identify two varieties.

quest_list.notes: Find more tracks at the raspberry/thimbleberry pile.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You look all over at all the tiny details, but alas, find nothing.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: It looks like you've found another foxy favorite spot as there are plenty of fox prints all around. A smattering of silvery, gold, and coppery dust is faintly visible on the grass.

quest_list.notes: Find Renard Jr. on the rocks
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: (Grins at you, tongue lolling out of his mouth.)
quest_list.success_message: Looks like your fox hunt has ended in success!
quest_list.success_npc_chat: (Grins at you, tongue lolling out of his mouth.)

quest_list.notes: Ruthie tells you about Old John and the baseball cap.
quest_list.success_message: Ruthie gave you $60 for the purchase of a new White Baseball Cap for her retiree Old John.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: That would be very kind of you! I think a white baseball cap would be best. That way if it gets filthy I can bleach it. Here is a little something to cover the cost.

quest_list.notes: OPTION- Stop quest here. Do not help R.J. Back to Carmina.
quest_list.success_message: You did not agree to help Renard Jr. win his bet with Orly. Instead, you decided to tell Carmina what he was up to.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: All right, you just do that. I'll be right here, preparing myself. A fox needs his strength, you know.

quest_list.notes: OR OPTION- Help R.J. Put him in your pack. Do not do this at home.
quest_list.success_message: You elected to help Renard Junior win his bet while at the same time keeping the hunt safe for the kids. You'll have to go up to Carmina to tell her you have a good plan.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: But once we do that, we'll need to go down to Orly. He lives down by the old scraggly tree down around the fuzzy stuff.

quest_list.notes: Offer cap to Ruthie. I want to check that they bought the cap, so taking AND giving in same cp, but they must buy the cap 1st or this action makes no sense.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: This isn't a white baseball cap, though.
quest_list.success_message: Ruthie asked you to give the White Baseball Cap to Old John.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Oh, he'll love this! Please go out and give it to him, won't you? This leg of mine is really playing up.

quest_list.notes: IF YOU CONTINUED- Tell Carmina you found him. Continue on.
quest_list.success_message: You told Carmina that you're working out her fox problem. Now you'll have to take the problem fox in question and go find his friend Orly.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: (Looks a little baffled, although you can't tell if it's because of you, or because of her hounds' strange behavior.) Well, all right. Now if you'll excuse me... I don't know what has gotten into them!

quest_list.notes: Find Orly the Owl
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You search high and low all around, but find nothing interesting.
quest_list.success_message: You look up in the scraggly tree, searching the branches and see a bird.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Looks like you've found Renard Junior's owl friend.

quest_list.notes: Leave Renard Jr. with Owl Friend to watch fireworks. Get mini-reward from Renard.
quest_list.success_message: You set Renard Junior down at the base of the tree. He gave you 2 Diamonds in return for your help. Now that you've helped him out, it's time to go back to Carmina to explain.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Well, yowhooooo better put him down then. We'll see if your trick confwhooooooooses the hounds- althooooooough I don't like that you had help, that wasn't part of the deal! (Flutters and fusses and nearly falls over.) Junior, whoooat are you doing?

quest_list.notes: Hunt Quest Endgame
quest_list.title: The Earton Hunt's Fox Problem
quest_list.success_message: You Completed The Earton Hunt's Fox Problem quest! You earned $40,000 and 275 quest points.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Well, all's well that ends well, and my kids and my hounds will have a safe go. Thank you for your help today!
quest_list.author: BrightLights

quest_list.notes: You made a decision about R.J., and you cannot change your mind now. (tracking only)
Give the cap to Old John.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: (Old John looks at your empty hands quizzically.)
quest_list.success_message: You gave Old John the White Baseball Cap! Better tell Ruthie.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: (Old John snatches the cap out of your hands and goes trotting off, looking very young for such an old fellow!)

quest_list.notes: Endgame.
quest_list.title: Ruthie and the Birthday Cap
quest_list.success_message: You Completed Ruthie and the Birthday Cap quest! You earned $3500 and 50 quest points.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Thanks for all of your help! That ought to keep him out of my hair- or out of my hat, rather!
quest_list.author: BrightLights

quest_list.notes: Lelu sends player back to Tail Isle
quest_list.success_message: *POOF*  You were sent back to Tail Isle.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Here you go. I hope you find that adventure you are seeking.

quest_list.notes: Agree to help Lelu
quest_list.success_message: You've agreed to look for Lelu's lost locket. Best giddy-up and go!
quest_list.success_npc_chat: That would be wonderful! A woman named Hessa organized a camel trail ride. I remember we rode all around Santon.

quest_list.notes: Talk to Hessa (tracking only)
quest_list.success_npc_chat: I remember that lady! Bless her heart! She and her husband spent hours looking for her necklace. If that darned packrat hadn't run out and scared the camel, I doubt she would have lost it.

quest_list.notes: Magnify before raking, southern rat midden.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You look all over at all the tiny details, but alas, nothing interesting.
quest_list.success_message: No sense using the magnifying glass. There is too much cactus and sticks in the way to see much of anything. Maybe you need to remove some of the debris first.

quest_list.notes: Dig before raking, packrat nest south of Santon
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You dig all over, but turn up nothing.
quest_list.success_message: The midden is piled high with bits and pieces of sticks and cholla. The shovel can't break through the mess. Maybe you can rake away some of the stuff.

quest_list.notes: Rake 1st time, southern packrat's nest
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You rake all over, but uncover nothing interesting.
quest_list.success_message: You carefully use the rake to pull back some of the sticks and cholla. Something glitters in the pile.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: You found a Diamond! Maybe if you rake again, you will find Lelu's locket.

quest_list.notes: Rake again, southern packrat's nest- find locket
quest_list.success_message: You carefully rake more of the debris away. Wowzers!
quest_list.success_npc_chat: You see an antique gold locket. This must be Lelu's!

quest_list.notes: Give Lelu her locket.
quest_list.title: Lelu's Lost Locket
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You don't have that.
quest_list.success_message: You Completed Lelu's Lost Locket. You earned $3000 and 75 quest points.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: My mother's locket! Thank you so much! Here, take this as a small reward.
quest_list.author: Desertmorn

quest_list.notes: Dig before raking, packrat nest north of Santon
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You dig all over, but uncover nothing interesting.
quest_list.success_message: You try to dig through the tangle of cholla, branches and other debris but it is too difficult. Looks like you need to try raking first.

quest_list.notes: Agree to ask Karee Farley/toothbrush tracking
Magnify before raking, northern rat midden.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You look all over at all the tiny details, but alas, nothing interesting.
quest_list.success_message: No sense using the magnifying glass. There is too much cactus and sticks in the way to see much of anything. Maybe you need to remove some of the debris first.

quest_list.notes: Rake 1st time, northern packrat's nest
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You rake all over, but uncover nothing interesting.
quest_list.success_message: You carefully use the rake to pull back some of the sticks and cholla. Something glitters in the pile.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: You found a Diamond! Maybe you should rake again.

quest_list.notes: Rake again, northern packrat's nest - find pocketwatch
quest_list.success_message: You carefully rake more of the debris away. Wowzers!
quest_list.success_npc_chat: You see an antique gold pocket watch.  Maybe you should examine it more closely.

quest_list.notes: Give Ed his grandfather's pocket watch.
quest_list.title: A Pocket Watch For Ed
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You don't have that.
quest_list.success_message: You Completed A Pocket Watch For Ed. You earned $2000 and 75 quest points.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: You have made my day! Thank you so much. Here, a small reward for reminding me of a great man.
quest_list.author: Desertmorn

quest_list.notes: Renard tells you about his kits.
quest_list.success_message: You've agreed to find Renard's four children, and report back with news of how they're doing.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: One left the home for fun, was the mane motivation. One went to seek what she felt she was dew. One stowed away, because he wouldn't shell out for the boat ride. And one... well, she just got lost. They have tended to live in rather rocky circumstances.

quest_list.notes: You found Tricksy (Dew fox)
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Aha, so my father sent you, did he?
quest_list.success_message: You found Tricksy, one of Renard's children!
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Aha, so my father sent you, did he?

quest_list.notes: Tricksy tells you about the gift
quest_list.success_message: You agreed to take a Nectar Sample from the iris just northwest of Tricksy as a present for Renard.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: The nectar from the great huge irises here (indicates the flower next to her) is supposed to boost the brain! Please take this vial and get a nectar sample from the iris just northwest of me. It's easiest to get to on the side by the sign.

quest_list.notes: Collect nectar sample
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You look all over at all the tiny details, but alas, nothing interesting.
quest_list.success_message: You collected a Nectar Sample from the iris to give to Renard from his daughter Tricksy!

quest_list.notes: Found Wily (Lost fox)
quest_list.success_message: You found Wily, one of Renard's children!

quest_list.notes: Wily sends you for gift
quest_list.success_message: You agreed to collect a Honeycomb from under the wagon station to give to Renard.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: He said that a bitter attitude makes for a bitter ending. I've buried a honeycomb under the wagon. Won't you bring it to my father?"

quest_list.notes: Procure honeycomb
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You dig all over, but turn up nothing.
quest_list.success_message: You dug up a particularly large Honeycomb from under the wagon station!

quest_list.notes: Found Renard Jr.
quest_list.success_message: You found Renard's son, Renard Junior!

quest_list.notes: Renard Jr.'s present
quest_list.success_message: Renard Jr. asked you to give his father a big toothy grin as a present. He demonstrated to show you just how.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: I'll confess, I'm flat broke. Too much adventuring, too little honest work. But Dad always said it didn't matter what you do in life so long as you're happy. So will you please give him a big, big grin from me as a present? (Bares all his teeth.)

quest_list.notes: Find Witsy (Shell fox)
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Dear old dad! I keep meaning to go back and visit the old dog, but frankly, I don't have the money to catch a boat there, and the dock patrols are... well, I haven't gotten down. How's he doing?
quest_list.success_message: You found Witsy, one of Renard's children!
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Dear old dad! I keep meaning to go back and visit the old dog, but frankly, I don't have the money to catch a boat there, and the dock patrols are... well, I haven't gotten down. How's he doing?

quest_list.notes: Witsy's gift
quest_list.success_message: Witsy asked you to take a sample of the water from the Shell Forest Wishing Well as a present to his father.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Now, what to give... ah! Dad said that success was part hard work and part luck. Hard work's too hard for me, so I've lived by luck! Will you please take him a sample of the water from the well here? It sure is lucky.

quest_list.notes: Procure well sample
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You look all over at all the tiny details, but alas, nothing interesting.
quest_list.success_message: You took a sample from the water in the Wishing Well to give to Renard as a gift from his son Witsy.

quest_list.notes: Renard checks for gifts, part 1
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Ah, but you have forgotten to visit at least one of my children! I do have four, you know.

quest_list.notes: Get reward from Renard for finding children
quest_list.title: Renard's Wayward Children
quest_list.success_message: You Completed Renard's Wayward Children quest! You earned $50,000, 10 Wishing Coins for luck, and 250 quest points.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Smarts, luck, a positive attitude, and happiness. That is all I could have wished for my children. I miss them at home, but I am glad they are doing so well. Merci beaucoup for your travels!
quest_list.author: BrightLights

quest_list.notes: Agree to look for Zamora's family jewel (fix for an old quest)
quest_list.success_message: You've agreed to look for Zamora's family jewel.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: I doubt if you can find it, but if there's a chance... Well. I would certainly appreciate it!

quest_list.notes: Holli checks your levels and sends you to Martina
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: I'm sorry but I think you are going to have to be a lot more adventurous this time.  Come back when you can travel to ALL of our beautiful islands.
quest_list.success_message: Holli sends you to see Martina on Whorl Isle with $2000 for expenses.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: This is just perfect!  Now off you go to Whorl Isle to see Martina, she's my wedding planner.  Here's some traveling money, now get a move on, she's expecting you!

quest_list.notes: Martina send you to Web Isle
quest_list.success_message: Martina gave you two Order Forms.  One each for Lilibeth and Shoneah of Web Isle.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Now, start on Web Isle.  You need to see Lilibeth and Shoneah there. Here give them these orders and come back when you're finished.

quest_list.notes: You give Lilibeth the order form
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: What about the order form, where is it?  Go back and find it!
quest_list.success_message: You gave Lilibeth the Order Form.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: (Looking over the order.) Let's see, it's unique all right. Can you wait a bit while I figure out the bill?

quest_list.notes: Lilibeth gives you her invoice and sample.
quest_list.success_message: Lilibeth gave you an Invoice  and a beautiful Table Centerpiece to bring back to Martina.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: All done. Now bring these back to Martina.  Tell her I'll need 4 weeks advance notice, but they'll make it the wedding of the decade!

quest_list.notes: You give Shoneah  Martina's order form
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You said you have an order form from Martina, where is it?
quest_list.success_message: You gave Shoneah the Order Form.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: (Looks over the order form.) I'm honored that Martina thought of me for this monumental occasion.

quest_list.notes: Shoneah givres you his invoice and samples.
quest_list.success_message: Shoneah gave you his Invoice for Martina along with a sample pendant and belt buckle in a Velvet Pouch.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: No thank you, I'm good.  Please bring these back to Martina.  Tell her that I will need 2 months to fill this order.

quest_list.notes: Aili mentions the strange prints in the sand
quest_list.success_message: You agreed to search carefully along the sand between the two lava-surfaced halves of Basalt Isle for the large tracks Aili mentioned.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Excellent. I appreciate your help. As I said, it was between the two halves of the isle, on the beach sand. Tell me all about what you see. Maybe while you're looking closely for the prints, you'll see other things too.

quest_list.notes: Phoenix prints
quest_list.success_message: You hardly need your magnifying glass to see the enormous prints left in the sand. You observe carefully: three talons facing forward, and one behind. The prints are very deep. Could there be more?

quest_list.notes: Halcyon prints
quest_list.success_message: You don't need your magnifying glass to see these enormous prints. Three long toes stretch forward, well spread. The heel is long and narrow.

quest_list.notes: Phoenix feather
quest_list.success_message: Half-buried in the sand, you discover an enormous red feather. It's iridescent and its color seems to fade into oranges and yellows as you turn it to and fro. The tip looks a little burnt. How odd!
quest_list.success_npc_chat: You found a Long Red Feather.

quest_list.notes: Halcyon feather
quest_list.success_message: You barely notice this long, slender white feather half-buried in the sand. Particles of sand and ash stick to it and you have to brush it off. It's coated with a waxy substance and feels waterproof. Curious!
quest_list.success_npc_chat: You found a Long White Feather.

quest_list.notes: Is there more to find? (3808-3811 chain to this. Imaginary flagcount check)
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Could there be more to find?
quest_list.success_message: You look around some more, but there doesn't seem to be anything left to find for Aili.

quest_list.notes: Give Aili the feathers and tell her about the prints
quest_list.title: Aili and the Strange Prints
quest_list.success_message: You Completed the Aili and the Strange Prints quest!  You earned 2 Red Crystal Shard, 3 Blue Crystal Shards, and 75 quest points!
quest_list.success_npc_chat: (She quietly looks at the feathers, running the white one through her fingers.) Well. (She seems to be about to say more, but changes her mind.) That's that, then. Take these. Thank you. I suppose what you found means more to me than to you.
quest_list.author: BrightLights

quest_list.notes: Olivia asked you to pick up her holiday cookie ingredients (need to choose difficulty level after this stage)
quest_list.success_message: You offered to help Olivia collect the special ingredients for her holiday cookies.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Would you? That's very kind. Now let me just organize my thoughts a minute and make sure I tell you the right things- I had a shipment of pecans just come in for the pfefferneusse so we're all set on that front...

quest_list.notes: You chose NOT to go to Cloud Isle
quest_list.success_message: Olivia gave you a List of the Ingredients she needs, as well as $3000 for travel and expenses.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Super! Here's a list of all the ingredients I need. You should only need to make two stops to get all of it. Here's a little money for your travels, and in case I forgot to pay anyone in advance...

quest_list.notes: You chose TO go to Cloud Isle. You CAN select this path even if you can't get to Cloud, because why not; but you have to double-confirm that you want to do that.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Hmmm... it doesn't look like you can actually get to Cloud Isle yet. You won't be able to finish the job for me until you can get there. Do you really want to wait until you can go there to finish this? It's OK if you want to just help me with the first t
quest_list.success_message: Olivia gave you a List of the Ingredients she needs, as well as $4000 for travel and expenses.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Super! Here's a list of all the ingredients I need. You should only need to make three stops to get all of it. Here's a little money for your travels, and in case I forgot to pay anyone in advance...

quest_list.notes: Get spices from Rika
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Sorry, but this was to be $1000. Olivia paid half in advance, but the rest was due upon pickup. I really will need that. The anise in particular is very dear.
quest_list.success_message: You purchased Olivia's Box of Spices from Rika Millgrater for $1000.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Certainly. I supply these for her every year. Olivia's pfeffernuesse are famous!

quest_list.notes: Get chocolate from Emma
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: (Raises an eyebrow.) I'm sure Olivia didn't forget that she'd only paid half up front. The remaining $1000 is due on pickup.
quest_list.success_message: You purchased Olivia's Dark Chocolate from Emma for $1000.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: There you are now! My very best dark chocolate, made from 72% cocoa solids- the finest, darkest chocolate you can get. Now, the chocolate's good, but Olivia's truffles really make it special.

quest_list.notes: Get sprinkles from Hansel if and only if you chose quest path 3816
quest_list.success_message: Hansel gave you the Shaker of Sprinkles Olivia had ordered.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Yup! Here you are! One shaker of our magic sprinkles. Don't let Olivia forget our deal now! Everyone needs to know the sprinkles came from us!

quest_list.notes: Give the spices and the chocolate; this starts endgame chain for the no-Cloud path
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: I'm sorry, but you're missing something. I'd needed the spices and the chocolate.
quest_list.success_message: You gave Olivia the Box of Spices from Rika and the special Dark Chocolate from Emma.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Oooh! This all smells heavenly! Rika and Emma have outdone themselves as usual.

quest_list.notes: Give the sprinkles, if you got them; chains to 3823 to finish quest
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Sorry, but you're missing the sprinkles from Cloud. You agreed to get those for me also.
quest_list.success_message: You gave the Shaker of Sprinkles from Hansel.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: And these sprinkles even look magical! I wonder what Hansel puts in them?

quest_list.notes: Give the spices and the chocolate; this starts endgame chain for Cloud path
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Sorry, but you don't have everything here. I'd needed the spices and the chocolate and the sprinkles. Please come back when you have everything.
quest_list.success_message: You gave Olivia the Box of Spices from Rika and the special Dark Chocolate from Emma.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Oooh! This all smells heavenly! Rika and Emma have outdone themselves as usual.

quest_list.notes: Endgame for Cloud path
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Oh! And I nearly forgot, since you went all the way up to Cloud for me, I've also given you a $7000 bonus. That should help cover the cost of the giant coconuts, if nothing else!
quest_list.success_message: You Completed Olivia's Holiday Cookies quest! You earned $20,000 plus a $7,000 bonus for traveling to the Cloud Isles, as well as 200 quest points.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: What a fabulous job you've done! I do appreciate all your help. Since you went all the way up to Cloud for me, I've also given you a $7000 bonus. That should help cover the extra cost. I think this year's cookies will be the best yet!

quest_list.notes: Endgame for non-Cloud path
quest_list.success_message: You Completed Olivia's Holiday Cookies quest! You earned $20,000 and 200 quest points.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: What a fabulous job you've done! I do appreciate all your help. I really think this year's cookies will be the best yet!

quest_list.notes: Finish Olivia's quest. You can now learn any of the recipes you've helped her with. These all come from my family's holiday cookie recipe collection
quest_list.title: Olivia's Holiday Cookies
quest_list.success_message: Olivia offered to teach you the recipes for the cookies you've helped her with. (You could use these recipes to make some yummy cookies to share with family and friends! You can always come back later if you don't want to learn them now.)
quest_list.success_npc_chat: I'd best get to baking. Say... since you've been such a big help, I'll let you in on a secret. Would you be interested in learning my cookie recipes?
quest_list.author: BrightLights

quest_list.notes: You chose your path for Olivia's quest (allows for dialogue checking so you can't do 3814 and log out and get into a muddle.) Chained from both options.
Olivia checks if you can go to Cloud Isle
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Hmm... it doesn't look like you can get to the Cloud Isles yet. If you can't get there, you'll have to wait until you can to finish this job for me. Do you really want to wait to finish this job until you can go to the Cloud Isles?
quest_list.success_npc_chat: It does look like you've been adventurous enough.  Are you sure you're up for it?

quest_list.notes: You agree to help Kendi make sand soup.
quest_list.success_message: You agreed to ask Kendi's parents and neighbors for 'soup stuff' - presumably ingredients- so she can make her sand soup.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Hmmm... maybe not e'rybody. But soup stuff from Mommy, and Daddy, and Sando, and Mandala, and...

quest_list.notes: Get nopales from Sando
quest_list.success_message: Sando gave you some Nopales for Kendi's soup.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Well, if I'm going to have to eat the stuff, I may as well make sure there's something I like in it. Here, take these nopales.

quest_list.notes: Get cilantro from Mandala
quest_list.success_message: Mandala gave you some Cilantro for Kendi's sand soup.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: (She wrinkles her nose.) Far be it from me to discourage cooking. Here, give her this cilantro. Cilantro makes everything better!

quest_list.notes: Get tomatillos from Loyada
quest_list.success_message: Loyada gave you some Tomatillos for Kendi's sand soup.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Her parents really ought to discourage her... or at least teach her how to really cook! I guess she can have these tomatillos. I picked more than I needed, and I'd hate to have them go to total waste.

quest_list.notes: Get serranos from Alati
