quest_list.success_message: Dolly gave you the Ice Cream Ingredients List and $3000.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Here's my list. I've already ordered the chocolate and bananas from Nana and the Vanilla from Rika, all you have to do is pick them up.  You'll have to collect the strawberries and snow balls. Here's some travelling money too.

quest_list.notes: Nana gives you the bananas and chocolate
quest_list.success_message: Nana Knutkake gave you a Crate of Bananas and a Crate of Chocolate for Dolly.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Here you go, honey, bananas and chocolate.  Hope Dolly's Ice Cream Social is a huge success.

quest_list.notes: Rika gives you Vanilla Beans
quest_list.success_message: Rika Millgrater gave you 5 Packages of Vanilla Beans for Dolly.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: I have them right here. Tell Dolly they are on her bill and it's a pleasure doing business with her.

quest_list.notes: You give Dolly the Bananas
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: I thought you said you had my bananas, go back and get them.
quest_list.success_message: You gave Dolly her Crate of Bananas.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: These bananas look delicious!  They'll make fabulous banana splits!

quest_list.notes: You give Dolly her Chocolate
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: I thought you said you had my chocolate, go back and get it.
quest_list.success_message: You gave Dolly her Crate of Chocolate.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: My, this chocolate will make incredible chocolate ice cream.

quest_list.notes: You give Dolly her Vanilla Beans
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: I thought you said you had my vanilla beans, go back and get them, please.
quest_list.success_message: You gave Dolly her 5 Packages of Vanilla Beans.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Ah, these will make exquisite vanilla ice cream!

quest_list.notes: You give Dolly her Strawberries.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Sorry, but I need 50 strawberries.  Come back when you have them all.
quest_list.success_message: You gave Dolly 50 Strawberries.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: You picked the best strawberries I've seen in quite some time.  I bet the strawberry ice cream will become a thing of legends!

quest_list.notes: You give Dolly her Snowballs.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Sorry, but I need 50 snowballs.  Come back when you have them all.
quest_list.success_message: You gave Dolly 50 Snowballs.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Thank you!  You know you can't make ice cream without ice!

quest_list.notes: Dolly rewards you.
quest_list.title: Dolly's Ingredients
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: It looks like you're missing something.  Take a look at the list I gave you and see if you can figure out what it is.
quest_list.success_message: You Completed Dolly's Ingredients!  You earned $5000, some Ice Cream and 150 quest points.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: You've done a wonderful job helping me with my Ice Cream Social.  Here's a little something for your efforts...and a sample of my ice cream!
quest_list.author: BklynFilly

quest_list.notes: Mehitabel gives you Archy's to do list
quest_list.success_message: Mehitabel gave you a copy of Archy's List and $10,000 for travel expenses.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Let me get it for you. (She goes into another room and comes out with a list.) Here it is, although I’m sure he did not follow the list in order, someone on this list should be able to tell you where he is. Take this to defray your expenses.

quest_list.notes: Talk to Gillian
quest_list.success_message: Gillian told you Archy went to vist Andrea.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Why, he was here a few months ago.  Picked up his lumber and said he was going to drop by Andrea's place before he left Ring Isle.

quest_list.notes: Talk to Andrea
quest_list.success_message: Andrea told you Archy was on his way to Wington.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Archy stopped by months ago. He brought me suet and seeds for my birds, but he's long gone... Said he was heading to Wington.

quest_list.notes: Talk to Cadence
quest_list.success_message: Cadence told you Archy went to check up on Zamora.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Yes, he picked them up quite a while ago. Ask Zamora if she knows his whereabouts.  He always stops by to check on her when he's here.

quest_list.notes: Talk to Zamora
quest_list.success_message: Zamora told you Archy went to pick up the tar.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Just a sec, let me look.  Nope, he left. Said he was going to see a man about some tar.

quest_list.notes: Talk to Karl
quest_list.success_message: Karl told you Archy went to see Arbuckle.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Why sure!  Archy got his tar, oh, about a month or two ago. Check with Arbuckle, Archy always stops by for a chat whenever he's around here.

quest_list.notes: Talk to Arbuckle
quest_list.success_message: Arbuckle told you Archy went to pick up his signs.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Well, truth be told, he brought me some new shelves but that was over a month ago. He said he'd visit longer, but he had to pick up his signs.

quest_list.notes: Talk to Salvador
quest_list.success_message: Salvador told you Archy wanted a couple of knishes and to check the Inn..
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Archy picked up his signs a little over a month ago. I usually don't make signs, but for those two, I'd make anything!  He said he was craving some knishes. Look for him at the Inn.

quest_list.notes: Talk to Remy
quest_list.success_message: Remy told you Archy went to see Cedric.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Sure Archy was here.  He had his fill of knishes and picked up a dozen bagels for Mehitabel, but he left. Said he was going north to see Cedric.

quest_list.notes: Talk to Cedric
quest_list.success_message: Cedric told you to see if Rupert has seen Archy.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: He sure did. Picked them up about a month ago. Said he was going to drop in on Rupert. I'd check with him.

quest_list.notes: Talk to Rupert
quest_list.success_message: Rupert told you Archy was on his way to Ice Isle.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Archy?  Sure he was here about a month ago. Gave me a couple of cords of wood. Such a nice guy.  He said he was heading to Ice Isle next.

quest_list.notes: Talk to Linnea
quest_list.success_message: Linnea suggested you look for Archy at Yorick's place.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: That poor dear. Archy picked up his rugs about a month ago. He probably went to visit his old friend, Yorick. See if he knows where Archy is.

quest_list.notes: Talk to Yorick
quest_list.success_message: Yorick said Archy left for Rider Isle.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: He was here. We ate some stew, played some checkers and talked some hockey, then he left for Rider.

quest_list.notes: Talk to Miguela
quest_list.success_message: Miguela told you Archy went to see Kyleigh.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Si! Si! He picked it up about 4 weeks ago. He said he had something for Kyleigh. Ask her where Archy is.

quest_list.notes: Talk to Kyleigh
quest_list.success_message: Kyleigh told you Archy left for Earton.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: He was here recently, gave me these bags of sachet that Mehitabel made for me. He couldn't stay long. Said he was on his way to Earton.

quest_list.notes: Talk to Tobias
quest_list.success_message: Tobias told you Archy went to see Twig.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Been and gone. Archy picked up his chocolate spread about three or four weeks ago.  I think he said he was going to check on Twig. Maybe he's still there.

quest_list.notes: Talk to Twig
quest_list.success_message: Twig told you that Archy went on to Treeton.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Nope, he dropped off a big bag of red pine cones for me and left.  I think he said he was heading down to Treeton.

quest_list.notes: Talk to Oliver Oates
quest_list.success_message: Oliver Oates told you to go see Ryland.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: He picked up his order of oats almost a month ago.  I know he always drops in to visit Ryland.  I'd check there.

quest_list.notes: Talk to Ryland
quest_list.success_message: Ryland told you that Archy went to Shellton.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Archy's gone on walkabout again?  He was here and gave me some of Mehitabel's chicken soup. Said he was on his way  to Shellton, I'd check there..

quest_list.notes: Talk to Ollie Scooper
quest_list.success_message: Ollie Scooper told you Archy went to visit Atreyu.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Archy pick those up about three weeks ago or so.  I believe he was going to say hello to Atreyu before he left town. Go ask Atreyu.

quest_list.notes: Talk to Atreyu
quest_list.success_message: Atreyu told you Archy was on his way to Hotton.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Archy was here about three weeks ago. We had a nice visit. He had some gifts for my special pets.  He said he had to move on to Hotton.  I'd look there.

quest_list.notes: Talk to Ward Anvil
quest_list.success_message: Ward Anvil told you Archy went to see Ormand.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Archy picked up his nails three weeks ago.  He said he wanted to drop in on Ormand before he left Hotton. Maybe he knows where Archy got off to.

quest_list.notes: Talk to Ormand
quest_list.success_message: Ormand told you that Archy was heading to Flipperton.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Yeah, he came by. Told him I don't need no help from the likes of him and to git. He said okay, said he was heading to the old folks town next. Now you git!

quest_list.notes: Talk to Sandra
quest_list.success_message: Sandra told you that Archy might be at Fin's.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: He most certainly did pick up their preserves.  He was here two or three weeks ago. You might check with Fin.  He and Archy love to chew the fat.

quest_list.notes: Talk to Fin
quest_list.success_message: Fin told you that Archy left to go to see Lilac.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Archy came by and we had a real nice visit, but he left.  He said he was heading to see Lilac.

quest_list.notes: Talk to Lilac
quest_list.success_message: Lilac told you that Archy was going to visit Tulippe.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Archy?  He picked up his seed order about two weeks ago. He said he was going to stop in on Mehitabel's cousin, Tulippe. Go see her..

quest_list.notes: Talk to Tulippe
quest_list.success_message: Tulippe told you that Archy was on his way to see Murray.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Oh, my!  Archy dropped off some baskets for me about two weeks ago. He said he was almost finished with his supply run and was going to Murray next.

quest_list.notes: Talk to Murray
quest_list.success_message: Murray told you that Archy went to see the Caretaker on Starfish Isle.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Yes he did. Archy picked that up two weeks ago. I know he was heading to Mortimer for some shop talk. Maybe he's still there.

quest_list.notes: Talk to Mortimer
quest_list.success_message: Mortimer told you that Archy left for Tropicton.

quest_list.notes: Talk to Harry Oaterson
quest_list.success_message: Harry Oaterson told you Archy picked up his hay and went to see Orson Shells.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: He picked up a couple of bales of hay and arranged for the rest to be delivered next month.  I think he said he had some business with Orson. Maybe he's still there.

quest_list.notes: Talk to Orson Shells
quest_list.success_message: Orson Shells told you that Archy was on his way to Web Isle.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Archy vas here. He picked up a special jewelry set he vanted me to make for his vife.  Ven it vas finished, he left. He said he vas going to Veb Isle.

quest_list.notes: Talk to Chanda
quest_list.success_message: Chanda told you Archy was there but went to see Alton.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: He was here last week. Picked up the candles for the ranches and a pair he ordered for Mehitabel. He may have dropped in on Alton. Ask him.

quest_list.notes: Talk to Alton
quest_list.success_message: Alton told you that Archy was heading to Appleton.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Archy wanted a special bouquet for their anniversary with Mehitabel's favorite fruits.  He left a couple of days ago.  He said something about Appleton. Look there.

quest_list.notes: Talk to Bruno
quest_list.success_message: Bruno told you to look for Archy at Faustus' place.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: You just missed him. We packed all of the apples we could fit on his wagon and he left.  He said he was going to Faustus and then head home. He might still be there.

quest_list.notes: Talk to Faustus
quest_list.success_message: Faustus told you Archy had parked in the clearing.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: He was here, parked his wagon in the clearing below my cabin, but I think he left this morning. Go have a look for yourself.

quest_list.notes: Fix Archy's Wagon
quest_list.success_message: You helped Archy fix his wagon.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: I brought it into town last night for repair and I picked it up today.  If you could help me get it back on the wagon I’ll be on my way.

quest_list.notes: Mehitabel rewards you
quest_list.title: Archy and Mehitabel
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Mon Dieu! You do not have my list! Please go back and find it.
quest_list.success_message: You Completed Archy and Mehitabel!  You earned 4 Pearl Necklaces and 300 quest points.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Oh, mon ami, you have made an old woman very happy. Let me have my list back for our records and here take this for all your efforts.
quest_list.author: BklynFilly

quest_list.notes: Pegleg Pat sends you to Pegleg Pete
quest_list.success_message: *POOF* You were jumped to Pegleg Pete.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Aye matey, hang on ta yer britches cos here ya go!

quest_list.notes: Pegleg Pete sends you to Pegleg Pat
quest_list.success_message: You were jumped to Pegleg Pat.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Aaarrrrr, so be it.  Here ye go then!

quest_list.notes: Mike's 1st Map
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: I be needin' $10,000.  No money, no map!
quest_list.success_message: You bought a map from Mapmaker Mike for $10,000.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Here ye be, just leave the map in the hole when ye find yer treasure.  Good hunting!

quest_list.notes: You found a treasure
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You dig all over, but alas, nothing interesting.
quest_list.success_message: You dig until you hit something hard. You pull up a small chest and find 2 Pearl Necklaces inside.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Congratulations, you found a treasure!

quest_list.notes: You buy Mike's 2nd map
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: I be needin' $10,000.  No money, no map!
quest_list.success_message: You bought another map from Mike for $10,000.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Remeber ta drop the map when yer finished. Good hunting!

quest_list.notes: You found a 2nd treasure
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You dig all over, but alas, find nothing interesting.
quest_list.success_message: You dig until you find a rectangular box. You open it and find a Telescope!
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Congratulations, you found a treasure!

quest_list.notes: You buy Mike's 3rd Map
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: I be needin' $10,000.  No money, no map!
quest_list.success_message: You bought another treasure map from Mike for $10,000.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Remember the rules and good hunting!

quest_list.notes: You found another treasure
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You dig all over, but alas, nothing interesting.
quest_list.success_message: You dig until you find a burlap bag. You open it and find a Blue Baseball Cap!
quest_list.success_npc_chat: You found a Baseball Cap. You can't win them all!

quest_list.notes: You buy Mike's 4th Map
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: I be needin' $10,000.  No money, no map!
quest_list.success_message: You bought Mike's 4th Map for $10,000.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Thank ye fer yer busines. Happy huntin'!

quest_list.notes: You found the 4th treasure
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You dig all over, but alas, find nothing interesting.
quest_list.success_message: You dig until you find a leather saddlebag. You open it and find $25,000!
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Congratulations, you found a treasure!

quest_list.notes: Dr. Glossover refuses to take the case. [TRACKING]
quest_list.success_message: Dr. Rickroll Glossover refuses to become involved with the excesses of Miss Pugg.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Oh no!  While I am a good friend of Miss Pugg's family, and an ... acquaintance of Mr. Spayde, this is something with which I refuse to become involved again.

quest_list.notes: Burtree tells you where to find Skeeves [TRACKING]
quest_list.success_message: Burrtree Booster says that you can find his man Skeeves at a resort up north.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: He goes to seaside resorts.  He said there was a new one that just opened.  Somewhere up north.

quest_list.notes: Skeeves agrees to return to Burtree.
quest_list.success_message: Skeeves agrees to return to Burrtree to give him advice.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Hmmm... I shall have to give this matter my attention.  Perhaps I should return to Mr. Booster with you, as any solution I might be so fortunate as to come up with, he will do doubt want to hear from, as he would say, "my own personal lips."

quest_list.notes: Jebidiah asks for help
quest_list.success_message: You agreed to go to Hotton and pick up Jebidiah's supplies.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: I'll be needin' a crate of Charla Mae's finest oranges, a sack of sugar from Ethel Barryjam, and a barrel of cool clear water from Quinn.

quest_list.notes: Jebidiah rewards you
quest_list.title: Jebidiah's Orangeade
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Ya didn't give me all me supplies. I need everything I asked fer!
quest_list.success_message: You Completed Jebidiah's Orangeade.  You earned $4500 a Starfish companion and  50 quest points.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: You done a right fine job fer me. Here, this should cover yer expenses and this little fella can keep ya company. He don't do much, but he's kinda purty!
quest_list.author: BklynFilly

quest_list.notes: Charla gives you the oranges
quest_list.success_message: Charla Mae gave you a Crate of Oranges for Jebidiah.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Jebidiah must be getting ready to make his Orangeade again.  Here you go, I'm sure he'll like these.

quest_list.notes: Ethel Barryjam gives you the sugar
quest_list.success_message: Ethel Barryjam gave you a Sack of Sugar for Jebidiah.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: A sack of sugar, eh?  Sounds like old Jeb is getting ready to make his famous Orangeade!

quest_list.notes: Quinn gives you the barrel of water
quest_list.success_message: Quinn gave you a Barrel of Water for Jebidiah.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: So, Jebidiah must be planning on making his famous Orangeade.  Here you go. Just let him know I expect some Orangeade in return.

quest_list.notes: Jebidiah gets his Oranges
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: I thought you said you had my oranges.  Go back and get them!
quest_list.success_message: You gave Jebidiah the Crate of Oranges.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: These oranges look and smell so good. Charla has out done herself!

quest_list.notes: Jebidiah gets his sugar.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Where's my sugar?  Go back and get it!
quest_list.success_message: You gave Jebidiah the Sack of Sugar
quest_list.success_npc_chat: To be sure Ethel figured out I was goin' ta make me Orangeade.  Guess I should send her some.

quest_list.notes: Jebidiah gets his Water.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: I can't make me Orangeade without water!  Go back and get it!
quest_list.success_message: You gave Jebidiah the Barrel of Water.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Ya don't have to tell me, Quinn wants some of me Orangeade, don't he?

quest_list.notes: Agree to get tools for Illiana
quest_list.success_message: You agreed to pick up tools for Illiana.   She gave you a Note and $2500.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: That's great! (Scribbles out a note quickly.) Here. Head to the general store and give this to Ethel. She should have what I need. This money should cover the cost of the tools also.

quest_list.notes: Get the tools from Ethel
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: I mentioned the total would be $1900.  It looks like you don't have that much with you.
quest_list.success_message: Ethel Barryjam gave you a Tool Bundle for $1900.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Ah ha!  Here you go.  I wrapped them up together to make it a bit easier to carry.

quest_list.notes: Give tool bundle to Illiana
quest_list.title: Illiana's Tools
quest_list.success_message: You Completed Illiana's Tools.  You earned $5000 and 25 quest points.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: (She separates the tools and goes through some of the motions with them.) Oh, these look perfect! Thanks so much!
quest_list.author: Miranda

quest_list.notes: Jebidiah gives you a glass of orangeade
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Ye've already had quite a few glasses!  I need ta save some for meself and other visitors!
quest_list.success_message: You drank a Glass of Orangeade.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Sure thing!  Here ya go.  Enjoy.

quest_list.notes: You agree to help Isaac
quest_list.success_message: You agreed to bring Isaac 20 Rubies, a Chunk of Obsidian and some Lapis Lazuli.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: That would be wonderful! Here's $2000 for expenses.

quest_list.notes: Isaac gets his rubies
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You don't have that.  Please come back when you have 20 rubies!
quest_list.success_message: You gave Isaac 20 Rubies.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: The rubies are tiny, but 20 should do it. Thank you so much.

quest_list.notes: Isaac gets his obsidian
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You don't have that. Please get me some obsidian.
quest_list.success_message: You gave Isaac the Obsidian. I guess he really does mean he'll be in your debt. He owes you!
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Thank you so much. I am in your debt, as I cannot pay you yet.

quest_list.notes: tracking for lapis
quest_list.success_message: You head out to get some Lapiz Lazuli.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Remember, dig at the most northern pyramid of the jungles. Be careful of the monkeys.

quest_list.notes: You find the lapis lazuli
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You dig all over, but turn up nothing.
quest_list.success_message: You dig and see something blue sticking out of the dirt.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: You've found a beautiful piece of Lapis Lazuli! This will be perfect for Isaac.

quest_list.notes: Isaac checks to see that you've given him everything.
quest_list.title: Isaac's New Design
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: I asked for rubies, obsidian and lapis lazuli. I don't have everything yet.
quest_list.success_message: You Completed Isaac's New Design! You earned $45,000 and 125 quest points.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Now that I have everything, I can complete the design. And thankfully, I can pay you now.
quest_list.author: Desertmorn

quest_list.notes: Twyla pays for Giant Coconuts
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: I need five giant coconuts!  I feel it is a waste to purchase them individually, but thanks for the effort.
quest_list.success_message: Twyla gave you $1500 for 5 Giant Coconuts.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: These are wonderful. Thanks for your help!

quest_list.notes: Twyla pays for Coconuts
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: I need 20 regular coconuts!  I feel it is a waste to purchase them individually, but thanks for the effort.
quest_list.success_message: Twyla gave you $650 for 20 Coconuts.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: These are wonderful. Thanks for your help!

quest_list.notes: Indigo pays for ebony wood
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: That's not enough ebony. Thanks for the effort, though.
quest_list.success_message: Indigo gave you $750 for 20 pieces of Ebony Wood.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: These are terrific. Thanks for your help!

quest_list.notes: Isaac gets the lapis
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: I asked for lapis. Please return when you have it.
quest_list.success_message: You gave Isaac the lapis lazuli.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: I must inlay this quickly. I already have a potential buyer!

quest_list.notes: Twyla tells you she will buy coconuts
quest_list.success_message: Twyla mentioned that she will buy five Giant Coconuts or twenty regular Coconuts.

quest_list.notes: Hanska will sell you a plushy unicorn or pegasus
quest_list.success_message: Hanska told you she will sell Plush Unicorn or Plush Pegasus companions for $250 each.

quest_list.notes: Hanska sells you a Plush Unicorn companion
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: It will be $250.  It appears you don't have that much with you at the moment.
quest_list.success_message: Hanska sold you a Plush Unicorn companion for $250.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Here you are.  I hope your horse enjoys it.

quest_list.notes: You agree to help Mikko
quest_list.success_message: Mikko gave you $6500 and you agreed to buy a gift for Britt from the jungle islands.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Here's $6500 for expenses. Let me know if that doesn't cover everything.

quest_list.notes: Get Alpaca Wrap From Bettina
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: I'm sorry, but you don't have that much. You'll need $1800.
quest_list.success_message: Bettina sold you an Alpaca Throw for $1800. Mikko should be pleased with the gift you've bought for Britt.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Here you go! One beautiful Alpaca throw. Perfect to snuggle into on a cold night.

quest_list.notes: Agree to get the wrap wrapped!
quest_list.success_message: You agreed to see Santa about getting Britt's gift wrapped.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: And once its wrapped, if you could please just deliver it to Britt, that would be great.

quest_list.notes: Britt Gets Her Wrapped Wrap!
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You don't have that.
quest_list.success_message: You gave Britt the Birthday Gift. Time to let Mikko know how much she likes it.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: A gift for me? (Britt unwraps the gift and smiles broadly.) This is beautiful! Please thank Mikko for me. I love it!

quest_list.notes: Santa Wraps the alpaca throw
quest_list.success_message: Santa hands you a cheerfully wrapped Birthday Gift for Britt. Best get this to Britt asap! You'd hate to miss her birthday.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Ho ho ho! Here you go!

quest_list.notes: Mikko rewards you (exps min $5900)
quest_list.title: Mikko's Gift Request
quest_list.success_message: You Completed Mikko's Gift Request. You earned $20,000 and 150 quest points.

quest_list.notes: You agree to 'challenge' Anathema
quest_list.success_message: Now that you've agreed to challenge Anathema, you'd better put your thinking cap on!

quest_list.success_npc_chat: Tsk, tsk. Such a feeble attempt. Clouds block the light of the stars, night is so black, I see nothing! Ha! I bested you on this one. You have three more tries.

quest_list.notes: You give Anathema a bunch of grapes
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Oh, brilliant brain who's gone a bit daft. You've yet to share the grapes you mentioned. Come back when you've got them. I can't wait for your feeble attempt!
quest_list.success_message: You gave Anathema a Bunch of Grapes.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: This bitterness you show towards your pending defeat is uncomely. Perk up, brilliant mind. You've yet got a chance to prove me wrong.

quest_list.notes: Give Anathema a Giant Coconut
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: I must say you've given me a good laugh. But you've yet to share the giant coconut you mentioned. Come back when you've got one. I can't wait for your next attempt!
quest_list.success_message: You gave Anathema a Giant Coconut.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: I may be nuts, but I think you are nuts for trying that one on me. You've failed once, and now you've failed twice. You've got two tries left, oh great gray matter in my skull.

quest_list.notes: You give Anathema a candy cane
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Oh, my lovely, brilliant brain. You've yet to share the candy cane you mentioned. I can't wait for your last and final, try! Come back when you've got that.
quest_list.success_message: You gave Anathema a Candy Cane. And you still haven't succeeded in proving you are real. Time to use logic!
quest_list.success_npc_chat: And really, how ironic is that? Your proof of the impossible is to make me believe in a fairy tale named Santa Claus? This was your 4th attempt, pathetic brain. You've failed. I win! (Anathema takes a triumphant bite of the candy cane and smiles.)

quest_list.success_message: You Completed Oringo's Bell. You earned a Dinosaur Bone, a Leather Turquoise Necklace and 100 quest points.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Oh my, the bell looks beautiful!  Here I don't have much cash money, but take some of my beach tidbits for your trouble.
quest_list.author: BklynFilly

quest_list.notes: Quest checking - trade King's Crown & Sceptor for payment envelope
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Now that you've gotten the envelope, time to pay Gray Slate.

quest_list.notes: Agree to help Dusty

quest_list.success_npc_chat: Please deliver this letter to Gritty. And if you could come back and tell me what his reaction was to it, I'd be very grateful. Maybe this will help with travel expenses.

quest_list.notes: Pony Express Agree to Delivery #34
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You still need to make that delivery to Jordan Row on Torrid Isle! Now ske-daddle!
quest_list.success_message: You have agreed to deliver a package to Jordan Row on Torrid Isle for the Pony Express
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Great attitude! Please take this package to Jordan Row on Torrid Isle.  Now giddyup already!
quest_list.author: Desertmorn

quest_list.notes: Pony Express Completed Delivery #34 Jordan/Torrid
quest_list.success_message: You gave Jordon the package from the Pony Express. You were given $2500.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Well this will make life less boring! Its the Boat in a Bottle kit I ordered. Here's payment for the delivery.

quest_list.notes: Pony Express Agree to Delivery #35
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You still need to make that delivery to Venda on Quiet Isle! Now ske-daddle!
quest_list.success_message: You have agreed to deliver a package to Venda on Quiet Isle for the Pony Express.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Please take this package to Venda on Quiet Isle. Don't throw your back out - its a heavy one!
quest_list.author: Desertmorn

quest_list.notes: Pony Express Completed Delivery #35 Venda/Quiet
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You don't have that!
quest_list.success_message: You gave Venda the package from the Pony Express. You were given 3 rubies.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: I am so excited! These are the books I ordered. I don't have much, but you can have these for the delivery. I found them on the shore.

quest_list.notes: Agree to help Giuliana
quest_list.success_message: You've agreed to search the jungle for Giuliana's pet monkey Tika.

quest_list.notes: Scare Tika away
quest_list.success_message: Tika got scared and jumped up into a tree. Time to head back to see Giuliana with the bad news.

quest_list.notes: Pony Express Agree to Delivery #36
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You still need to make that delivery to Leontine on Rain Isle! Now hurry up!
quest_list.success_message: You have agreed to deliver a package to Leontine on Rain Isle for the Pony Express.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Awesome. Please take this package to Leontine on Rain Isle. You might want to take your umbrella!

quest_list.notes: Pony Express Completed Delivery #36 Leontine/Rain Isle
quest_list.success_message: You gave Leontine the package from the Pony Express. You were given 2 Geckos.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Did I order something? I don't remember ordering something. I hope this isn't a trick. Here - take these. Now go.

quest_list.notes: Pony Express Agree to Delivery #37
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You still need to make that delivery to Grendel on Whorl Isle! And don't get lost trying to find him.
quest_list.success_message: You have agreed to deliver a package to Grendel on Whorl Isle for the Pony Express.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Awesome. Please take this package to Grendel on Whorl Isle. Go, go, go!

quest_list.notes: Pony Express Completed Delivery #37 Grendel/Whorl
quest_list.success_message: You gave Grendel the package from the Pony Express. You were given 5 Red Pinecones.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Woe be to the instigator perchance this be but a trick. Here. ( He throws some pinecones your way.)

quest_list.notes: Pony Express Agree to Delivery #38
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You still need to make that delivery to Frank in Appleton! Hurry, scurry!
quest_list.success_message: You have agreed to deliver a package to Frank Tackle in Appleton for the Pony Express.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Please take this package to Frank in Appleton. Just a quick gallop away!

quest_list.notes: Pony Express Completed Delivery #38 Frank Tackle/Appleton
quest_list.success_message: You gave Frank the package from the Pony Express. You were given $1000.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Ah! The new lures I sent for. If they work out, I might start selling them! Here's your payment.

quest_list.notes: Pony Express Agree to Delivery #39
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You still need to make that delivery to Sara, the Mayor of Shelton. Don't just stand there. Get going!
quest_list.success_message: You have agreed to deliver a package to Sara, the Mayor of Shellton for the Pony Express.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Please take this package to Sara, the Mayor of Shellton. And try to be a lot faster than a turtle!

quest_list.notes: Pony Express Completed Delivery #39 Sara, Mayor of Shellton
quest_list.success_message: You gave Sara the package from the Pony Express. You were given $2000.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: I've been waiting for these new pie tins. And aren't they lovely! Thank you so much.

quest_list.notes: Pony Express Agree to Delivery #40
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You still need to make that delivery to Lesia on Glacier Isle. She's waiting!
quest_list.success_message: You have agreed to deliver a package to Lesia on Glacier Isle for the Pony Express.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Please take this package to Lesia on Glacier Isle. Make tracks, fast!

quest_list.notes: Pony Express Completed Delivery #40 Lesia/Glacier
quest_list.success_message: You gave Lesia the package from the Pony Express. You were given $2000 and a Hot Cocoa.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: I am so excited! These are new pysanky tools from far away lands. I can't wait to get started on decorating new eggs. Here is your payment and some hot cocoa to warm you up.

quest_list.notes: Pony Express Agree to Delivery #41
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You still need to make that delivery to Tighe Debowt on Cabin Isle. Don't be dilly-dallying around.
quest_list.success_message: You have agreed to deliver a package to Tighe Debowt on Cabin Isle for the Pony Express.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Please take this package to Tighe Debowt on Cabin Isle. Away with you already. Away!

quest_list.notes: Pony Express Completed Delivery #41 Tighe/Cabin
quest_list.success_message: You gave Tighe the package from the Pony Express. You were given $3500.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: A package for me? I wonder who it is from. Here's a reward and happy travels to you!

quest_list.notes: Pony Express Agree to Delivery #42
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You still need to make that delivery to Hank Halyard on Horn Isle. Can't give you another delivery until you get that one done.
quest_list.success_message: You have agreed to deliver a package to Hank Halyard on Horn Isle for the Pony Express.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Please take this package to Hank Halyard on Horn Isle. Gesh! Talk about a tongue twister.

quest_list.notes: Pony Express Completed Delivery #42 Hank Halyard/Horn
quest_list.success_message: You gave Hank the package from the Pony Express. You were given $2500.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Wonderful! Supplies for the dock rigging. Thank you kindly! Here's your payment.

quest_list.notes: Pony Express Agree to Delivery #46
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You still need to make that delivery to Fitzgerald on Dust Isle.
quest_list.success_message: You have agreed to deliver a package to Fitzgerald on Dust Isle for the Pony Express.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Please take this package to Fitzgerald on Dust Isle. Hurry, scurry!

quest_list.notes: Pony Express Agree to Delivery #43
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You still need to make that delivery to Dusty on the Sand Isles. Giddy up and go already!
quest_list.success_message: You have agreed to deliver a package to Dusty on The Sand Isles for the Pony Express.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Please take this package to Dusty on The Sand Isles. Hi-ho and off you go!

quest_list.notes: Pony Express Completed Delivery #43 Dusty/Sand Isle
quest_list.success_message: You gave Dusty the package from the Pony Express. He gave you a Diamond!
quest_list.success_npc_chat: (Dusty reads the mailing label and tears up.) It's from my brother! We haven't talked in years. I can't pay you in cash, but I hope this makes up for that.

quest_list.notes: Pony Express Agree to Delivery #44
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You still need to make that delivery to Reuben in Appleton. Remember?
quest_list.success_message: You have agreed to deliver a package to Reuben in Appleton for the Pony Express.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Please take this package to Reuben in Appleton. Make haste!

quest_list.notes: Pony Express Completed Delivery #44 Reuben/Appleton
quest_list.success_message: You gave Reuben the package from the Pony Express. You were given 10 Balloon Animals and $250.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Woohooo! My new balloons. Pretty colors! Here, you can have some! Oh, and a bit of change.

quest_list.notes: Pony Express Agree to Delivery #45
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You still need to make that delivery to Rocco on Rock Isle.
quest_list.success_message: You have agreed to deliver a package to Rocco Shale on Rock Isle for the Pony Express.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Please take this package to Rocco on Rock Isle. Gesh! Another tongue twister!

quest_list.notes: Pony Express Completed Delivery #45 Rocco/Rock
quest_list.success_message: You gave Rocco the package from the Pony Express. You were given $3500.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Wonderful, wonderful! My books on constellations! The stars are amazing at night out here, away from all the city lights. Oh, you probably don't want to hear about that. Here's your payment!

quest_list.notes: Pony Express Completed Delivery #46 Fitzgerald/Dust
quest_list.success_message: You gave Fitzgerald the package from the Pony Express. You were given $3500.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Oh! My package. I thought it would never come. Thank you so much, and here is your fee.

quest_list.notes: Pony Express Agree to Delivery #47
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You still need to make that delivery to Heather on Art Isle.
quest_list.success_message: You have agreed to deliver a package to Heather Awlaboard on Art Isle for the Pony Express.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Please take this package to Heather Awlaboard on Art Isle. Hurry, scurry!

quest_list.notes: Pony Express Completed Delivery #47 Heather/Art
quest_list.success_message: You gave Heather the package from the Pony Express. You were given $2000.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Finally! New rare and exotic plants from far away lands!  Thank you so much, and here is your fee.

quest_list.notes: Pony Express Agree to Delivery #48
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You still need to deliver the package to Andrea on Ring Isle.
quest_list.success_message: You have agreed to deliver a package to Andrea on Ring Isle for the Pony Express.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Please take this package to Andrea on Ring Isle. Time's a wastin'.

quest_list.notes: Pony Express Completed Delivery #48 Andrea/Ring
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You don't have that.
quest_list.success_message: You gave Andrea the package from the Pony Express. You were given $3000.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: I am so excited! These are my new binoculars for bird watching! Thank you so much! And please tell the Postmaster I said hi.

quest_list.notes: Pony Express Agree to Delivery #49
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You still need to make that delivery to Clara on Jungle Isle.  Heave ho and away you go!
quest_list.success_message: You have agreed to deliver a package to Clara on Jungle Isle for the Pony Express.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Please take this package to Clara on Jungle Isle. The day isn't getting any longer, you know. Now go!

quest_list.notes: Pony Express Completed Delivery #49 Clara/Jungle
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You don't have that.
quest_list.success_message: You gave Clara the package from the Pony Express. You were given $2000.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Oh wow. A package. I wasn't expecting one so this should be interesting. Here's your delivery fee.

quest_list.notes: Pony Express Agree to Delivery #50
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You still need to make that delivery to Twyla on Dog Isle. Grab a gust of wind and go!
quest_list.success_message: You have agreed to deliver a package to Twyla on Dog Isle for the Pony Express.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Please take this package to Twyla on Dog Isle. Hurry, scurry!

quest_list.notes: Pony Express Completed Delivery #50 Twyla/Dog
quest_list.success_message: You gave Twyla the package from the Pony Express. You were given 20 giant coconuts.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: More supplies for my lotions and soaps! I can't wait to start a new batch. I'm short on cash, but I hope these will be sufficient compensation for your efforts.
quest_list.author: Desertmorn

quest_list.notes: Deliver letter to Gritty
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You don't have that.
quest_list.success_message: You gave Gritty the Origami Dove Letter from Dusty. Time to head back to Dusty.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: (Gritty unfolds the dove and reads the letter. To your amazement, he tears up just like Dusty had! Then he grabs you in a big bear hug. After an awkward second or two, he releases you.) Thank you.

quest_list.notes: Dusty rewards you
quest_list.title: Dusty's Origami Dove
quest_list.success_message: You Completed Dusty's Origami Dove. You earned 20 Wishing Coins and 50 quest points.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: I can't thank you enough. You've given this old man a great amount of joy today. Here, please take these. I find them in the grass now and then.
quest_list.author: Desertmorn

quest_list.notes: Ocean Born Mary asks for help
quest_list.success_message: Mary asked you to find Jackie Sparrow.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Could ye be helpin' me out and find that scurvy little imp?

quest_list.notes: footsteps by the beach tent
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You look around but see nothing interesting.
quest_list.success_message: Aha!  You find footprints in the sand, you should follow them!
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Looking carefully, you see footprints heading East.

quest_list.notes: Coconut shells by the palm tree
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You look around but see nothing interesting.
quest_list.success_message: Coconut shells are strewn around the palm tree and more footsteps are heading NorthWest.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Someone must have rested here.  Keep looking for clues!

quest_list.notes: check out the treasure chest
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You look around but see nothing interesting.
quest_list.success_message: Looks like somebody was trying to pick this lock!
quest_list.success_npc_chat: New footprints are leading to the NorthWest. Better follow them.

quest_list.notes: You hear someone snoring!
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You look around but see nothing interesting.
quest_list.success_message: The foot prints stop here outside the tent.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: You hear somebody snoring inside the tent. Better check inside!

quest_list.notes: Mary rewards you
quest_list.title: Where's Jackie?
quest_list.success_message: You Completed Mary's quest! You earned an Emerald Necklace, a Sapphire Necklace and 25 quest points.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: He better be!  Thank ye fer yer help. Here take this bit of shiny with me compliments.
quest_list.author: BklynFilly

quest_list.notes: Colbert sells you an alpaca treat for a ruby in case you accidentally sold the one you needed for his quest
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You don't have a ruby.
quest_list.success_message: Colbert gave you an Alpaca Treat for a Ruby.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Don't try to sell it back to me this time.  That treat is for Zoetta.

quest_list.notes: Tracking 50th delivery for pony express
quest_list.success_message: Postmaster General gave you a Kookaburra!
quest_list.success_npc_chat: For all your hard work, I'd like to present you with a little gift. Here's a little Kookaburra to keep you company.

quest_list.notes: Nancy gives you her treasure chest
quest_list.success_message: No-Navel Nancy gave you her Chest and $5000. Now it's off to Treasure Isle you go!
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Here ye be. Bring this to Mike and bring me back me map.  Here be the money fer Mike's fee.

quest_list.notes: Ocean Born Mary send you to find Mike
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Arr, so she be needin' the services of me Mike does she? (Chuckles to herself.) Go ta Pegleg Pat, he'll git ye a Mike. He be SouthWest of here.
quest_list.success_message: Ocean Born Mary has sent you to find Mike via Pegleg Pat.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Arr, so she be needin' the services of me Mike does she? (Chuckles to herself.) Go ta Pegleg Pat, he'll git ye a Mike. He be SouthWest of here.

quest_list.notes: You bury No-Navel nancy's treasure
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You dig all over, but turn up nothing.
quest_list.success_message: You dig a big hole, drop the chest in, and carefully cover it back up.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: You successfully buried the Chest. Now it's back to Mike for the map.

quest_list.notes: Mike gives you No-Navel Nancy's map
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: I be needin' $5000 before ye can have the map.
quest_list.success_message: You paid Mike $5000 for Nancy's map.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Here ye be, matey. (She takes the money and hands you a map.) Tell Nancy it's always a pleasure doin' business with her!

quest_list.notes: No-Navel Nancy gets her map and you get rewarded
quest_list.title: No-Navel Nancy's Treasure
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Ye don't have me map?  Go back and find it!
quest_list.success_message: You Completed No-Navel Nancy's Treasure quest.  You earned 2 Pearl Necklaces and 75 quest points.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: (You hand Nancy her treasure map.) Thank ye, matey. Now I know me bounty is safe and sound. Here be a little bit of shiny for yer troubles!
quest_list.author: BklynFilly

quest_list.notes: You agree to take Cordovan's Alpaca Challenge
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You do not have the $1000 for this challenge.  Come back when you do, please!
quest_list.success_message: You gave Cordovan $1000 to take his Alpaca Challenge.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Great!  Okay, are you ready for my questions?

quest_list.notes: Harlan sends you to Zeke
quest_list.success_message: Harlan gave you 10 Pearls.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: I sent Zeke me shopping list already. He should have everything ready fer ya when ya gets there.  Here's some Pearls ta pay fer yer travels.

quest_list.notes: Zeke needs Huckleberries
quest_list.success_message: Zeke asked you to find 25 Huckleberries for Harlan's order.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: I've got everything but enough Huckleberries for his tea.  Could you find me 25 huckleberries to complete this order?

quest_list.notes: Zeke gets the Huckleberries and you get the Provisions
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: I need 25 huckleberries. Go back and get the rest of them!
quest_list.success_message: You gave Zeke 25 Huckleberries.  He gave you Harlan's Provisions.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Great!  Let me put them in this last crate and voila!  Take these crates back to Harlan and tell him I'm sending him the bill.

quest_list.notes: Harlan gets his provisions
quest_list.title: Harlan's Provisions
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Don't toy with me, ya scurvy dog!  Where be the provisions?  Git out and find them!
quest_list.success_message: You Completed Harlan's Provisions. You earned 1 Dinosaur Bone, a Pie a la Mode and 50 quest points.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Thank ye, ya made it right on time!  Here's something fer yer troubles.  Come back anytime, matey. Yer always welcome!
quest_list.author: BklynFilly

quest_list.notes: Agree to get Kelda supplies
quest_list.success_message: You agreed to get supplies for Kelda. Best head over to Jungle Isle!
quest_list.success_npc_chat: To start with, I'll need ebony nesting forms.  Xamba can make those. I'll need gold leaf.  You'll want to talk to Smiddy Jones. The last thing would be some colorful beetle shells. A bug collecter can supply those.

quest_list.notes: Get ebony nesting forms from Xamba
quest_list.success_message: Xamba gave you an Ebony Nesting Form Set made of ebony.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: No charge necessary. Good deed for the day.  Yes yes.

quest_list.notes: Give ebony nesting forms to Kelda
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You don't have that!
quest_list.success_message: You gave Kelda the Ebony Nesting Form Set.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: These are wonderful. He does such beautiful work! I can get started on painting them right away.

quest_list.notes: Track Xamba
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Hmm...  Two days.  Yes.  Two days will be enough time.  Go.  Explore!

quest_list.notes: Get assorted colorful beetle shells from Flicka
quest_list.success_message: Flicka gave you a handful of Colorful Beetle Shells.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Here you go. I'm always sorry to see one expire, but at the same time, I'm thrilled to collect their beautiful shells.

quest_list.notes: Give Kelda the beetle shells
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You don't have that! I need colorful beetle shells to represent the colors of the Jungle. Please come back when you have those.
quest_list.success_message: You gave Kelda the Colorful Beetle Shells.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: These are outstanding. The colors perfectly represent the jungle's flora and fauna. Thank you so much.

quest_list.notes: Get gold leaf from Smiddy Jones
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You don't have those. I need 3 gold ores to hammer into gold leaf. Please return when you have those.
quest_list.success_message: Smiddy Jones gave you a Sheet of Gold Leaf.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: There you go! Careful now, a brisk wind will blow it right out of your hand.

quest_list.notes: Give Kelda the sheet of gold leaf
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You don't have that. How can I properly decorate these dolls without the gold leaf? Please return when you have it.
quest_list.success_message: You gave Kelda the Sheet of Gold Leaf.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Beautiful! Just beautiful. This will create the perfect highlights to compliment the ebony.

quest_list.notes: Kelda checks to see that you've brought her everything.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Not quite. I needed ebony forms, gold leaf, and beetle shells. Please come back when you have everything.
quest_list.success_message: You agreed to give Kelda a week to finish the work.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: You did an amazing job of getting these things. Now I need to do my work and paint, paint, paint. Please give me about a week to complete the set.

quest_list.notes: Track Kelda first time
quest_list.success_npc_chat: And here's the second smallest one. It is covered in charming chameleons. I've still got four more nesting shapes to paint. Come back in a few days.

quest_list.notes: Track Kelda 2nd time
quest_list.success_npc_chat: And look here! I've covered the fourth form in lovely parrots! I wanted to share everything that's beautiful about the Jungle. So, that said, give me a couple more days, please.

quest_list.notes: Track Kelda 3rd time
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Please give me one more day to finish the outer shell. My reputation is on the line here and I simply won't be rushed.

quest_list.notes: Kelda gives you the beautiful ebony nesting doll set
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: I'm sorry, you don't have that. I've spent many many hours on this and deserve to be paid. Please come back when you have the $2500.
quest_list.success_message: Kelda gave you a beautiful Ebony Nesting Doll for $2500.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: If you are ever in the area, I would love to know the young girl's reaction. I do hope she loves the set!

quest_list.notes: Track Mandy
Give Stacie the Ebony Nesting Doll set
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You don't have that. Please come back when you do.
quest_list.success_message: You gave Stacie the Ebony Nesting Doll Set. Time to get your reward from Mandy.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Oh my gosh! For me? It is beautiful. (Stacie opens the doll and each successive doll form until she has all six lined up on the table. Her eyes glisten with excitement.) I love them!

quest_list.notes: Mandy rewards you.
quest_list.title: Mandy's Gift Idea
quest_list.success_message: You Completed Mandy's Gift Idea. You earned $10,000 and 150 quest points.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Thank you so much! Here's a small reward for your time and travel.
quest_list.author: Desertmorn

quest_list.notes: Track Kelda
Harlan takes back his bean and rice burrito.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You don't have that.  You must not have gotten that from me.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: You've given Harlan a Bean and Rick Burrito. He's given you 2 Pie a la Modes in exchange.

quest_list.notes: Offer to help Eric Awlaboard
quest_list.success_message: You agreed to talk to Eric's wife about his lunch.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Our cabin is just a hop and a skip past the wagon station.

quest_list.notes: Track Mandy
Agree to get Mandy groceries
quest_list.success_message: You agreed to pick up groceries for Mandy. She gave you $100 for travel money.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: That would make my day. Barrett runs a tab for me, but take this for travel money.

quest_list.notes: Give Mandy groceries.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You don't have my groceries! Please return when you have them.
quest_list.success_message: You put away the groceries while Mandy makes a new sandwich for Eric. Mandy gave you $300.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Let me just grab the bread and sliced ham and get started on that sandwich. Here's some money for all your time.

quest_list.notes: Get groceries from Barrett
quest_list.success_message: Barrett Braunbag gave you three Bags of Groceries.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: There you go! Please tell Mandy I added some zuccini, free of charge. I've got zuccini coming out of my ears.

quest_list.notes: Get sandwich from Mandy.
quest_list.success_message: Mandy gave you a Ham Sandwich to take to Eric.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Dinner isn't too far away so this will be enough to tide him over. Good thing he is a very patient man! Thank you so very much!

quest_list.notes: Give Eric his sandwich
quest_list.title: Eric's Ham Sandwich
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Oh that's just mean of you. I'm hungry enough to eat the dock, but I'd settle for the ham sandwich I thought you would bring me.
quest_list.success_message: You completed Eric's Ham Sandwich. You earned $7500 and earned 100 quest points.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Thank you so much. Excuse me while I wolf this down. I can't believe how hungry I am.

books.title: Wild Horses
books.author: The Ancients
books.text:
Katie was an ordinary girl, with one large secret. On her ranch, hidden in the Valley of Dreamstar was a herd.  A herd of pounding hooves, swishing tails, soft silky manes, and eyes that held nothing but compassion.  They were the Wild Horses of Dreamstar Valley.  Katie was the only girl who had ever gotten close enough to see them.  The lead stallion was a chestnut stallion with the Arabian face but the body of a Morgan and an Andalusian.  He had a white snip and a brown mane.  The lead mare was a beautiful palomino, with a dark grey muzzle, red tipped ears, and a barely visible white star on her forehead.  At night under the sparkling and grinning stars, a coyote can usually be heard, as the crickets chirp making music of their own.  Katie snuck out the front door quietly in her pajamas.  The barn was completely silent.  Not even the cows made a noise as she raced across the field and stopped to stare down upon a herd of around 24 horses.  The palomino mare rushed up to greet Katie, ears pricked forward as she trotted up the hill.  Slowly she held out her hand, a red apple sitting on the palm.  The wild mare flicked her ears slightly, but moved forward all the while staring into the little girl's eyes.  The mare ate the apple and let Katie pet her.  The mare left and Katie watched them, sitting down on a rock until it was, by her watch, almost midnight.  She rushed back home and fell asleep, dreaming of the next night with the wild horses. 
~The End~

books.title: In the Clouds
books.author: The Ancients
books.text:
High in the sky, the clouds moving slowly as the wind sweeps them around the world, there is a garden.  A garden of crystals, which shimmer as the sun peeks at them through the cirrocumulus clouds that scatter about the sky like a field of wheat.  The crystal garden lay on a large cumulus cloud, a cloud that is never ending white and fluffy but very thick.  In the garden, so very fair, lay a beast that is quite rare.  A mane of golden, hooves slight dark pink, gold wings with pink tips and sweet understanding black eyes.  In one swift motion, it disentangled itself from the crystals and burst through the air.  It whinnied a soft melodic noise, echoing through the air.  The Pegasus, her wings stretch sparkling as she dives through the clouds.  Never in fear of storming clouds, she comes home at night to her secret garden in the sky, safe among all the crystal. 
~The End~

books.title: The Lost Filly
books.author: The Ancients
books.text: The day was nice and peaceful.  The foals grazing by their mothers peacefully frolicking around in the green grass and the spring flowers. Grey clouds slowly rolled in towards the pastures.  The owners saw this and began to bring in the horses and livestock.  It began to rain.  The thunder clashed with the clouds and the lightning struck the sky like a flaming whip.  Some of the foals scattered, but all were caught and brought back to their mothers, except one little filly.  The filly had dashed away in fear and got lost in the little shade there was from the rain.  Under the four large trees, she could hear her mother calling for her.  Her neighs of fear, slowly fading and drowned out by the rain and the thunder. The small filly laid down leaning against one of the trees and tucked her head between her knees until she felt a pair of warm hands picking her up and laying her across something.  The filly squealed in terror struggling to get up and off whatever was holding her captive, but the figure just put a blanket and a warm hand over her.  Minutes that seemed like hours passed by, until they could see light.  The strange figure picked her up, rubbed her dry of all the water and put her in the stall where she met with her mother, happy as can be to see her filly once again. ~The End~

books.title: The Dramas of Pirate Isle
books.author: The Ancients
books.text: This is a tale of high adventures and seamanship.  Back in the days before recordings a large band of pirates roamed the lands, but, of course, as the group's size grew, there were arguments over leadership.  They eventually split into two.  The Skull Pirates took over the portion of Pirate Isle resembling a skull.  This was the larger of the two groups.  The Crossbones Pirates took the remainder for themselves.  Travel between the two islands is still restricted to this day.  They employ secret passwords and the like which only the captains are allowed to give out.  No one is sure what exactly caused the split, or what they still hold as grudges today.  What is known is that the Skulls seem to sail around the Eastern Seas, Near Saddle Isle.  While the Crossbones have been seen patrolling the Western Seas, docking occasionally at Bird Isle.  The Pirates are all notorious for their pearl use instead of money and most appreciate shiny rocks of all sort.

books.title: Lullaby
books.author: The Ancient Stag
books.text:
In the dark of the night, a soft voice whispers in the trees. Its singing to her so quiet and meek. Her eyes shine like stars, her mind filled with wonders of the years that may come. She sees unicorns and a Pegasus, while her brother sleeps in the bed next to her and as he listens to his mother singing the soft song, he dreams of the pirates and their wild crusades on their sturdy zebras. Their eyes slowly close as their mother continues singing softly as the rain pours down upon the house like a soft melody and the wind whispers like the voices of a chorus with no voices. As the night goes on the voiceless chorus fades into a bird's song as the sun begins to rise. 
The End

books.title: Secrets of the Forest
books.author: The Ancient Stag
books.text:
In a dark forest, where the leaves barely allow the sun in, there is a meadow filled with butterflies and birds singing softly, where the wind whispers songs of tales forgotten and the trees move and speak with soft groans and grunts, there lived a creature of myth and legend. It was a creature so majestic and amazing that no one dare come near the forest anymore. Stepping out from the trees, came a creature with a long sparkling mane and a strange thing upon its head. Above a jewel that was right betweens its eyes was a horn, glistening and pale. The ears were long like a mules but rounded like zebras. It had a wispy beard and on its chest was long wavy fur. Its eyes fogged with knowledge beyond comprehension. This magnificent thing was the unicorn. No one had dared to go near it. Once in a while the youngest daughter of Erebus' daughters would come to listen to the wise ones tales of years ago. Secretly the unicorn wished he could be with his mare and foal, but they were separated by a large body of water. Both hidden in mazes, they dare not come out to humans eyes, though none would ever be able to catch him for he was too fast, too strong. That was how he would spend his life, hiding and watching as the world changed and the rains poured and the streams still rippled on. 
The End

books.title: Adrenaline
books.author: The Ancient Stag
books.text: *Badump* *Badump*. The sound echoed in his ears, what was it? Was it a fly? No, not a fly, it wasn't a human noise either, no wait it was the sound of his heart beating so fast as the body under him moved with powerful strides. The powerful beast in need of no urgings rushed past the others on the soft turf. Ears flicked back as it's breathing becomes rapid like one simple motion. The clanging of metal flowed through his ears. Flags passed by as they reached near the other. The adrenaline pulsing through his veins was more than enough to make him scream in a mixture of a dozen emotions. With one swift slash of the whip the beast under him rushed forward surpassing the other grey creature. The other rider looked over in shock and then all he could remember was a flash and the beast under him slowing its sides heaving. He clung on with all his might as the creature reared into the air and came down shaking its head as people began to surround it a pad of flowers was put onto its sweating neck. He dismounted and patted the bay creatures neck. The once smooth coat was damp with sweat. He smiled they had won the race together as one. The End

books.title: Lost and Found
books.author: The Ancient Stag
books.text:
It was raining, the mud slick, and the roads damp. All the animals were huddled together to wait out the storm, except one small foal. Only the rain and the tired step of the foal could be heard as he made his way down the empty plains. His small mane clung to his neck as he continued walking. He could see his own breath as it continued to rain. A young foal shouldn't be out in a storm like this. His head hung low he continued to bear through the storm. His once shining chestnut coat was now thick with mud and rain water. Snorting softly he made his way to a fenced area where he squeezed through to stand on a hard winding road. Finding this safer than the mud he continued on his way. Something large, with a fierce growl and bright eyes swerved past him and stopped. He stared, frozen, unsure of what to do. A figure came out of it. The figure picked him up ignoring his struggles and brought him into a dry, warmed cage, also known as a wagon. The figure grabbed something soft and warm from and began to dry him, while the other figure got the horses moving again and went home. From that day on the foal grew from a lost baby to a trusting, children loving chestnut stallion. 
The End

books.title: Homes of the Elves
books.author: The Ancient Stag
books.text:
Elves are a funny lot, addicted to collecting strange trinkets. They often have strange and unusual things: boxes with no bottoms, coats with endless pockets, buckets or cauldrons that grant wishes. Elves like cozy homes, though their terms of cozy vary between elves. One elf could simply love soft bright colors and fluffy chairs, while another elf could quietly adore a nice wooden chair set and dim lights. Elves are generally nice creatures, but there will be the occasional selfish elf. The secret to getting in an elf's home is to dig. Elves are picky about the trees they live in. If you dig in front of a willow tree you might just pop into an elf's house, and the elf would usually gladly greet you and shake you by the hand or offer you a cup of tea or coffee. So if someone mentions an elf, be prepared to dig to find their house, in case you need something from them, or you think they might like something! 
The End

books.title: Tribal Natives
books.author: The Ancients
books.text: The wind rages and the rain streamed down the lightning streaked sky.  A strange chanting could be heard through the windswept isle. A ritual was going on. Sacred items, jewels, and other symbolic creations were being carried to large stone heads of ancient people who were thought to be Mystics who created all of the elements and the animals. A man in a strange feathery costume walks forward. Raising his hands he shouts something into the wind and the people behind him, all in colorful feathered outfits, walk forward and set something in the ground near the stone head. Afterwards the winds die down and they cover up the precious offerings. The natives slowly decreased in their size and old rituals became locked in the back of their memories. Still, something inside says there is something important about those statues.

books.title: Snapping Plants
books.author: The Ancients
books.text: In the midst of the hot humid jungle there is an awkward place of sanction. The fruits are bountiful the animals are plenty, but in the end of the small trek through the dangerous traps and false paths a meadow filled with strange plants is found. Near the right just below the exit is a small hut. A crazy scientist used to live there, experimenting with the strange exotic plants and testing chemical substances on them. One day a chemical broke from the glass tube it was being held in, because of overheating, and splattered on the scientists favorite plant. The plant trembled grew, a huge mouth formed from the petals. It wrapped around the entire house, while a few more of these plants grew in the yard. The scientist left scared of the plants, but a native with a gift for growing things stumbled upon the entrance and proceeded to nurture and tame the large plants. Now he lives there with his daughter teaching her how to care for the environment.

books.title: The Star of Solomon Sapphire
books.author: Ima Alias
books.text: (Excerpt From: Unbearably Cool Gems and Jewels of the Isles) The great Star of Solomon Sapphire is said to have originally been found in the Muki region of the great Shiro-neko mountains by Verdigris Solomon, the great Explorer-turned-Pirate. It is the most perfect star sapphire ever known to exist. Its color is a pure ultramarine blue, and its star so pronounced and perfect that were sunshine to shine upon it, beams of light would refract from the star in six directions. Legend passed down through the centuries tells of a great treasure of the Solomon family, buried in a special vault which can only be opened with the aid of this stone. The stone was lost in antiquity, however; and its current whereabouts are unknown.

books.title: Wonders of the Legendary Cloud Isle
books.author: The Ancient Stag
books.text: In a place far above the islands of Horse Isle, there is a land, filled with shooting stars, moonbeams, and candies of all kinds. It is a place, where story book characters come to life. Three giant coconuts and a ride on a hot air balloon takes you to this large fluffy area. Princes and Princesses and enchanted animals, many are in need of friends who can help them out in a tough situation. Rumors of mysterious creatures are there. These creatures so fascinating may someday end up giving you a lift around the entire globe!

books.title: This Is Peace
books.author: The Ancient Stag
books.text: The forest was beautiful, small rays of light filtering through the evergreen leaves. Birds flew overhead, small creatures frolicked around on the ground, foxes, deer, bunnies, and squirrels could be seen in many trees, chattering and twittering. Farther off in fields of flowers and clover, two young riders were laughing, riding on their large beautiful steeds. They joked as they rode along a small path that led to the forest, one with a butterfly on her horse's forelock, the other having a small white foal by its mare's side, jogging along. This is peace.

books.title: Little Shop of Foals
books.author: The Ancients
books.text:
Emily rode down the pathway, surrounded by trees. Her friend Jamie had told her of a new pet shop that recently opened up. She remembered her friend giving her the instructions.
 "Take the path from Earton to Appleton and down the path you'll see a traditional Pet Shop building, but it's actually a Foal Adoption Center.  The owner will gladly help you, and probably tell you how the different foals act. It costs a bit more than a dog or a cat though!"
 Smiling to herself she stopped her horse in front of the shop, and entered, being greeted by several whinnies from the small foals that were lying in the pens. The owner went up to Emily and smiling warmly, helped her choose a foal that suited her horse.

books.title: First Horse
books.author: Ponyo
books.text:
Jenny waited patiently for her parents to come home. Today was the day she finally got to go to the auction house and choose out her very own horse. Her skin prickled at the thought of her very own horse. Jenny could only imagine what type of horse she would be getting. A thin, majestic Akhal-teke with a sparse black mane, an elegant grey Arabian with an arched neck, and a long flowing grey mane that she could braid every day, or perhaps a chestnut Danish Warmblood, a horse she could win with in the jumping arena in the nearest town. The sound of her parents honking the horn on their old beat up truck jolted Jenny from her thoughts, and she rushed out to greet her parents. The ride to the auction center was short. Jenny stepped out of the truck, following her parents closely. The auctioning blocks were large, filled with many horses and very noisy. She passed by several stalls where little ponies, barely up to her waist, tried to look out of the pen to see the people passing by. Jenny looked around, she didn't have much to buy a horse because she'd put away half of her money for the tack she'd need. A buyer walked by, leading a large black Friesian towards the loading area.  She didn't know where to go, and her parents had disappeared into the crowd of people.  Not knowing what to do Jenny walked along the pens of several horses, passing by beautiful horses, many out of her price range. Across from the pens holding all of the champion bloodline horses was a small stall, out of the way, holding a tall bay stallion. His head was lowered, as if he were trying to avoid any attention at all. He had a large snip, two hind white socks and the largest brown eyes she'd ever seen, eyes that begged for a good home. Jenny slipped through the bustling crowd, to reach the stall of the bay stallion. She ducked into the pen, checking the horse's hooves, the firmness of the ankles, and the overall conformation. She asked the owner how much for him, hoping with all her might, that she'd have enough for the beautiful beast.

 "The Gelderland be  three thousand on the spot." The seller stated in a deep voice.

 Jenny's parents came up behind her, almost making her jump. They'd heard the price of the horse and willingly paid for it.  Jenny grabbed the black halter from her parents and carefully put it on the bay's large head. Together they headed home, with her new horse.

books.title: Dreaming Of You
books.author: Starlit Eyes
books.text:
Staring across the glistening ocean
Waves crash against the sand
You pivot like a ballerina
Head high, ears alert
I want to get closer to you, but when I draw near
You sense my presence and disappear
I sit here on the rock, watching you play
The water glistens on your silver coat
I�m afraid to say anything
I can hardly breathe
You know I�m here
Your delicately curved ears are always in my direction
Velvet nostrils flare
Testing the air for something
Something far off, something close
I do not know
You make me curious
Silver horse
You waltz across the golden sands
The soft sand does not hinder your swan-like movements
Instead you float like the foamy waves
I can�t help but wonder
What makes you dance
Your hoof steps so light
I can�t seem to fathom your secret
And deep inside, in my heart
I don�t want to know
Silver horse
I just want to see you prance
And as the day draws to the end
I must leave you on the sands
Weeks may pass before I see you again
Silver horse, always in my heart

riddle_room.reason: 2nd place because you passed the guy that was in 2nd not 1st

riddle_room.reason: The Letter S is found in those places in those words

riddle_room.reason: A shadow follows the horse around.  At noon, the sun is above, and the shadow is smallest.  At different times of the day it's bigger.

riddle_room.riddle: Buried alive? I surely once was. Unburied I died. Should have been a 'Parrot', then that horse wouldn't have done what it did to me. What was I?
riddle_room.reason: A carrot grows underground,  and dies when you pick it. Rhymes with parrot. Horses eat it.

riddle_room.riddle: This horse breed and waffles go well together.
riddle_room.reason: Belgian waffles

riddle_room.riddle: What 9 letter horse breed starts with A and ends with A?
riddle_room.reason: Appaloosa is a breed

riddle_room.riddle: A horse breed and a machine.  What am I?
riddle_room.reason: Mustang is a model of car

riddle_room.riddle: What is an Equus Caballus?
riddle_room.reason: Equus Caballus is the scientific name for a horse

riddle_room.riddle: In the desert sun I may look like gold and as a breed I'm very old.
Peanuts are named after the country this breed is from. Look hard.  I'm no illusion.
riddle_room.reason: Spanish peanuts, rhymes with illusion

riddle_room.riddle: My hooves are striped but my body is not. I can run a great distance without getting hot. What breed am I?
This breed says this when left in very cold weather.  I'm ____!
riddle_room.reason: Sounds like freezing!

riddle_room.riddle: A meticulous loaf of wheat that is also an equine breed.
riddle_room.reason: Sounds like thorough-bread

riddle_room.riddle: You could paint this horse breed red, white and blue.
riddle_room.reason: Red, white and blue are America's colors

riddle_room.riddle: This horse breed may live in Germany, perhaps in Hanover?
riddle_room.reason: Sounds like Hanover

riddle_room.riddle: When mature this horse breed is white and don't give it any lip about it!
riddle_room.reason: White and starts with lip

riddle_room.riddle: I may be stubborn but I'm always ready to listen.
riddle_room.reason: Expression: stubborn as a mule

riddle_room.riddle: I'm a breed from Central America...don't pass me by, and with an Italian accent I'm so fine!
This breed has a big heart but comes in a small package and is from the island it is named after.
What has 1,000 eyes, 2,000 shoes and eats grass?
If a king sits on gold, who sits on Silver?
riddle_room.reason: Silver was the name of Lone Ranger's horse

riddle_room.riddle: It's small and sharp but a horse will wear it.
riddle_room.reason: Tacks are tiny,  and horse equipment is called tack

riddle_room.riddle: Your horse might shout this, or shout for this.
What word has these in common: tack, shower and to restrain.
This footwear is very lucky.
This breed is no hobbit, though you might have thought it at first, until you saw one.
riddle_room.reason: Hobbits are from the Shire

riddle_room.riddle: Justin's favorite horse is more than awesome, but what is its name?
riddle_room.reason: Justin Morgan is the founder of the Morgan

riddle_room.riddle: Not only is this a salad dressing, you might find a horse here too!
This breed only throws half of what it's got.
riddle_room.reason: It sounds slightly like half-flinger

riddle_room.riddle: This tack isn't very happy.

I was on my way to Treeton one day, when I met a girl with five horses. Each horse had five dogs, each dog had five cat friends, and each cat had five mice. All in all, how many were going to Treeton?
riddle_room.reason: You met them because they were going the other way

riddle_room.riddle: This sounds like the  most important thing, it sits between two corn and lies above a double 'i'.
riddle_room.reason: The mane sounds like main, is between two ears (ears of corn) and above two 'eyes'

riddle_room.riddle: The question with this gait is, can you or can't you?
This brush isn't made out of a tasty dish.
riddle_room.reason: Curry is a spicy dish but also a horse brush

riddle_room.reason: The chestnut is located on the forearm of the horse

Your friend always keeps water bottles in her backpack. What animal does this remind you of?
riddle_room.reason: Camels store water in the fatty tissue of their hump(s) on their back

riddle_room.riddle: This animal spelled backwards is a very common destination for girls.
riddle_room.reason: Spells "A Mall" backwards

riddle_room.riddle: What has 4 hooves, 2 ears, and blends with a crowd?
riddle_room.reason: Zebra's black and white stripes provide for excellent camouflage blending them all together so that predators cannot distinguish them

riddle_room.riddle: A Breed named after steep sided ocean inlets in Norway.
"Stubborn as a ?" or "Kicks like a ?"
riddle_room.reason: "Stubborn as a mule" is an old saying

riddle_room.riddle: I don't think I'd like a nice Hawaiian one, but one from Suffolk might do. What breed am I?
riddle_room.reason: "Punch" here refers to a fruity party drink

riddle_room.riddle: Do you get hungry when you hear my name? Many people do! But I am not a breakfast pastry. What am I?
riddle_room.reason: A "danish" is also a popular breakfast or snack treat

riddle_room.reason: The tips of the Kathiawari's ears almost touch; if they were wired hooked up to a battery, you might see a spark jump across them

riddle_room.riddle: I'm not the breed used by the RCMP, but you might yell, "Oh, Canada!" when you see me! What am I?
riddle_room.reason: 'O Canada' is the national anthem of Canada

riddle_room.riddle: I'm a big, milky-white horse who's risen to the top in America. I can truly say I'm the top of the crop!  What breed am I?
riddle_room.reason: To say that something is "The cream of the crop" means that it is the best of its kind. There is also a saying that "The cream rises to the top," referring to milk fresh from the cow

riddle_room.riddle: I don't pile up points, but I garner lots of praise! But please don't put wet dishes on me!  What breed am I?
riddle_room.reason: "To rack up points" means to get lots and lots of them, and one puts wet dishes in a drying rack to let them drain

riddle_room.riddle: I love oysters, saltines and the Sunshine State! What breed of horse am I?
riddle_room.reason: Two types of crackers and the Sunshine State is Florida

I'm the "horse of the sea." My coat is white or grey like the sea foam, so bring your camera for a picture!
riddle_room.reason: Camera is similar to Camargue, the Camargue is called the "horse of the sea."

riddle_room.riddle: If my mother was my father and my father was my mother, my name would be Hinny. Instead I joined the army and I'm a plain old ____.
riddle_room.reason: The mule is the Army mascot, and opposed to the hinny, the offspring of male horse and female donkey.

riddle_room.riddle: Don't let my name scare you.  I'm not angry, although I might be a little hungry! I love a good steeplechase and I'm fast in the harness.
riddle_room.reason: The is similar to "furious" and the bloodline includes Hungarians.

riddle_room.riddle: You may think it's a little corny, but I'm a pony and a horse! I can stand as low as 13.2 hands, but as high as 16, and that's a whale of a pony!
riddle_room.reason: Corn cob and originates out of Wales.

riddle_room.riddle: I like to give MORE! They crossed two great breeds to make me, and now I'm my own breed.  What am I?
My bloodlines are ancient.  I was a warhorse for the Romans, a draft horse for medieval peasants, and a sure-footed, hard-wintering mountain horse for all of Austria. What am I?
I must be done by now.  I've been domesticated for 4,000 years! I have a thick shaggy coat and love the snow, but I can jump and even do dressage. There's no way you won't love me.
riddle_room.reason: Fjords are dun and "no way" hints at Norway.

riddle_room.riddle: I'm a souped-up horse with plenty of spirit. I'm a star jumper who really knows how to leap up from down under, and I come in every color - even Botany Bay!
riddle_room.reason: References to Australia (down under, Botany Bay) and soup stock.

riddle_room.riddle: I am a horse robed in bright red gems! What am I?
riddle_room.reason: Clad is another word for robed and ruby is a red gem.

riddle_room.riddle: I won't fall apart while moving, as my name might suggest.
riddle_room.reason: Name makes it sound like it would come loose while walking.

riddle_room.riddle: There. In few words: what breed?
riddle_room.reason: When one says something in as few words as possible, one is being "terse."

riddle_room.riddle: No, I'm not made of French maize! I'm an old, proud breed.
riddle_room.reason: Normandy is a coastal region of France, and maize grows on a cob.
